summary: This paper presents an end-to-end framework for reconstructing overhead power utility network topology and extracting span-level physical metadata from large-scale aerial LiDAR. The pipeline begins with semantic segmentation of the input point cloud using an improved KPConv-based model, in which data sampling and loss functions are adapted to emphasize pole and conductor (wire) classes. Network topology inference then proceeds in two stages: (i) pole instances are obtained by clustering pole-class points and validating candidates using geometric criteria, including height and verticality estimated via PCA, and (ii) candidate pole pairs are evaluated using a heuristic method and a lightweight ResNet-based classifier on 2D top-view projections of pole and wire point distributions to determine whether a physical conductor span exists. By explicitly classifying candidate spans, the approach mitigates common failure modes of heuristic connectivity rules in dense or cluttered scenes and under partial wire observation. For each validated wire, attributes regarding utility infrastructure geometry are computed, including endpoint conductor heights, ground elevation, sag-related lowest-point features, conductor arrangement, and wire width. Evaluation on multiple real-world aerial LiDAR datasets demonstrates decimeter-level endpoint height accuracy and approximately 9% relative improvement in recall for topology reconstruction compared to heuristic nearest-neighbor baselines, with larger gains in complex layouts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端框架，可从大规模航空LiDAR点云中重建架空电力线路网络拓扑，并提取跨档物理元数据。
AI.motivation: 传统基于启发式最近邻的连通性规则在密集、杂乱场景或导线部分缺失时容易失效，因此需要更稳健的拓扑推断与物理属性提取方法。
AI.method: 首先使用改进的KPConv模型进行语义分割，并通过调整数据采样和损失函数强化电杆与导线类别；随后分两阶段推断拓扑：(i) 对电杆类点聚类得到实例，并用PCA估计高度和垂直度等几何准则验证候选电杆；(ii) 对候选电杆对，结合启发式方法与轻量级ResNet分类器，在电杆和导线点分布的2D俯视投影上判断是否存在物理导线跨档。对验证后的导线计算端点高度、地面高程、弧垂最低点特征、导线排列和线宽等属性。
AI.result: 在多个真实航空LiDAR数据集上评估，端点高度精度达到分米级；相比启发式最近邻基线，拓扑重建召回率相对提升约9%，在复杂布局中提升更大。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效重建电力线路拓扑并提取跨档级物理元数据，在复杂场景下优于传统启发式方法。

title: Layered e-skin for Shear Sensing
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE Sensors Journal
summary: This paper presents a stacked two-layer force-sensing resistor (FSR) array designed for robotic fingertips that combines high-resolution pressure mapping with shear-force estimation. A compliant lattice elastomer spacer converts shear loading into a measurable inter-layer displacement, producing relative center-of-pressure (CoP) shifts between layers. A physics-based moment balance links inter-layer CoP displacement to shear force, while an end-to-end CNN--GRU model captures nonlinear effects from load-dependent compression and contact redistribution. This model, with both layers as input, achieves coefficients of determination $R^2 = 0.914$ for $F_x$ and $R^2 = 0.944$ for $F_y$, consistently outperforming single-layer baselines for shear-force estimation. Robotic manipulation experiments show that, for contact-motion tracking, the deep layer tracks the translation and rotation imposed by the robot arm, whereas the superficial layer tracks the slip at the contact surface. Transient changes in the difference between the total pressure responses of the two layers provide the best slip-event detection performance among the tested cues. These results demonstrate that two-layer FSR arrays can provide three-axis force estimation, contact-motion tracking, and slip-event detection beyond conventional normal-force sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于机器人指尖的双层堆叠力敏电阻（FSR）阵列，可同时实现高分辨率压力映射与剪切力估计，并用于接触运动跟踪和滑移事件检测。
AI.motivation: 传统FSR阵列主要用于法向力感知，难以估计剪切力、跟踪接触运动或检测滑移，而机器人灵巧操作需要这些能力。
AI.method: 采用柔性晶格弹性体间隔层将剪切载荷转化为层间位移和相对压力中心（CoP）偏移；用基于物理的力矩平衡建立层间CoP位移与剪切力的关系，并用端到端CNN-GRU模型学习载荷相关压缩和接触重分布的非线性效应。
AI.result: 双层输入模型对Fx和Fy的R²分别为0.914和0.944，优于单层基线；机器人操作中，深层跟踪机械臂的平移和旋转，浅层跟踪接触面滑移；两层总压力响应之差的瞬态变化在滑移检测中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 双层FSR阵列可提供三轴力估计、接触运动跟踪和滑移事件检测，超越了传统仅法向力感知的能力。

title: Authority-Preserving Evaluation of Medical Vision-Language Assistants
comment: Accepted at 2nd Emerging LLM/LMM Applications in Medical Imaging (ELAMI) 2026, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026. To appear in the Springer proceedings
summary: Medical vision-language models can propose how urgently a skin lesion should be reviewed, but the local service retains authority to accept or replace that proposal under referral policy, capacity, and locally held patient context. Proposal quality and selected-action quality are therefore distinct evaluation targets, and benchmark evidence transfers between them only when local review preserves the expected action score. We introduce AuthEval, a logging and evaluation framework that records both actions, scores the selected action under declared local criteria, and, where feasible, scores the declined proposal under the same rule. It reports the resulting authority gap only when the record supports it. Because the gap is the product of the proposal-change rate and the mean score change on changed cases, that rate alone determines neither its magnitude nor its sign. On ISIC 2019, with MedGemma and simulated local review, two constraint regimes with similar change rates produced an optimistic image-equal gap under capacity ($+0.744$ simulator units) but no detectable gap under safety. The declared evaluation unit also mattered: under mixed constraints the gap reversed from $+0.374$ to $-0.206$ when weighting shifted from image to lesion-aware cluster. AuthEval thus clarifies whether a study's records support claims about the model, the workflow, or both.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AuthEval框架，用于记录并评估医学视觉语言模型给出的建议动作与本地实际选择动作，量化“权限差距”，并在ISIC 2019上用MedGemma和模拟本地审查进行验证。
AI.motivation: 模型建议质量与本地最终选择动作质量是不同评估目标；基准证据只有在本地审查保持预期动作分数时才能迁移。因此需要区分对模型、工作流或两者的评价。
AI.method: AuthEval记录提议动作与选中动作，按声明的本地标准给选中动作打分，并在可行时用同一规则给被拒绝的提议打分；仅在记录支持时报告authority gap。该差距被分解为提议改变率与改变病例上平均分数变化的乘积。在ISIC 2019上使用MedGemma和模拟本地审查，比较容量与安全两种约束制度，以及图像与病变感知聚类两种评估单元。
AI.result: 两个约束制度的改变率相近，但在容量约束下出现乐观的图像等价差距（+0.744 simulator units），在安全约束下未检测到差距。混合约束下，评估单元从图像改为病变感知聚类时，差距由+0.374反转为-0.206。
AI.conclusion: AuthEval能澄清研究记录支持关于模型、工作流还是两者的主张；仅凭提议改变率不能决定authority gap的大小或方向。

title: Context Poisoning as Extreme-Value Attention Interference in Long-Context Language Models
summary: Large language models can process increasingly long prompts, yet their ability to locate and use decisive evidence may degrade as irrelevant or confusable context is added. We formulate this phenomenon, which we call context poisoning, as extreme-value interference in attention: the decisive-evidence score is upper-bounded, while the maximum score among effective distractors grows with their number. Under a softmax retrieval abstraction, we derive a finite-sample upper bound showing that maintaining a fixed accuracy target above base rate requires the evidence margin to scale as $Ω(\sqrt{\log N})$, where N denotes the effective distractor count rather than necessarily the raw context length. The analysis connects long-context degradation to score aliasing, positional aliasing, and softmax dilution. Controlled experiments show that retrieval accuracy decreases as total context grows in the presence of embedded hard negatives, that the same-format condition produces the largest observed accuracy drop among the tested distractor constructions at fixed context length, and that retrieval gating can improve evidence use while its net benefit depends on preserving evidence recall. These results motivate evidence bottlenecks, alias-resistant representations, retrieve-then-reason architectures, verifier-mediated memory, and contrastive anti-poison training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并研究“上下文投毒”现象：随着无关或易混淆上下文增加，大模型定位和利用决定性证据的能力会下降。作者将其形式化为注意力中的极值干扰，并通过理论分析和控制实验验证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽能处理越来越长的提示，但当上下文中加入无关或可混淆内容时，模型可能无法稳定找到并利用关键证据。这促使作者从注意力和检索机制角度解释长上下文性能退化。
AI.method: 作者将上下文投毒建模为注意力中的极值干扰：决定性证据分数存在上界，而有效干扰项的最大分数随数量增长。在softmax检索抽象下推导有限样本上界，并进行控制实验，考察硬负例、同格式干扰项和检索门控对检索准确率与证据利用的影响。
AI.result: 理论表明，若要在基础准确率之上维持固定准确率目标，证据边际需按 Ω(√log N) 增长，其中N是有效干扰项数量而非原始上下文长度。分析关联到分数别名、位置别名和softmax稀释。实验显示：存在嵌入硬负例时，检索准确率随总上下文增长而下降；固定上下文长度下，同格式条件造成最大准确率下降；检索门控可改善证据使用，但其净收益取决于能否保持证据召回。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果支持若干方向：证据瓶颈、抗别名表示、先检索后推理架构、验证器介导记忆，以及对比式抗投毒训练。

title: Splitting Documents at Lower Cost: Multi-Split Boundary Decisions for LLM-Based Page Stream Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the DocInsights Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Scanned mail, uploaded PDFs, and consolidated attachments often arrive as page streams that must be split into individual documents before downstream classification, extraction, or routing. Zero-shot large language models can detect document boundaries without task-specific training, but standard Page Classification (PC) and Boundary Decision (BD) formulations resolve only one boundary per model call. We introduce Multi-Split Boundary Decision (MSBD), which predicts multiple boundaries within a page window in a single call, reducing the number of inference requests. We evaluate MSBD across multiple language models, document collections, input modalities, and window sizes. The results reveal a model- and corpus-dependent operating range in which MSBD preserves strong segmentation accuracy while substantially improving inference efficiency, followed by a sharp decline at larger windows. MSBD provided the strongest overall accuracy--efficiency trade-off, while large windows expose distinct over- and under-segmentation behavior across models. These findings show that multi-boundary prediction can make zero-shot page stream segmentation more efficient when the window size is selected for the target corpus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多分割边界决策（MSBD），在单次模型调用中预测页面窗口内的多个文档边界，以提升零样本页面流分割的推理效率，并在多种语言模型、文档集、模态和窗口大小下进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 扫描邮件、上传的PDF和合并附件常以页面流形式到达，需分割成单个文档以便下游分类、提取或路由。零样本大语言模型无需任务特定训练即可检测文档边界，但标准的页面分类（PC）和边界决策（BD）每次模型调用只能解决一个边界，导致推理效率低下。
AI.method: 提出多分割边界决策（MSBD），在单次调用中预测一个页面窗口内的多个边界，从而减少推理请求次数。在多个语言模型、文档集合、输入模态和窗口大小上评估MSBD。
AI.result: 结果揭示了模型和语料库相关的操作范围，在此范围内MSBD保持强大的分割精度，同时显著提升推理效率，但在更大窗口时精度急剧下降。MSBD提供了最强的整体精度-效率权衡，而大窗口则暴露出不同模型间过分割和欠分割行为的差异。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明，当针对目标语料库选择窗口大小时，多边界预测可以使零样本页面流分割更加高效。

title: On The Robustness-Resolution Tradeoff In Temporal Quantization Of Event Streams
summary: Event pipelines often discretize asynchronous timestamps before learning. This step looks harmless, but its stability depends directly on temporal resolution. We study this dependence at the representation level. We first show that hard temporal binning is discontinuous: an arbitrarily small timestamp shift near a boundary can move unit event mass between bins. We then define a class of nonnegative, mass-preserving, resolution-faithful continuous encoders and prove that every encoder in this class has global L1 sensitivity at least 2/Delta, where Delta denotes bin width. Linear two-bin interpolation attains this limit. Local support and first-moment preservation also make it unique. Experiments on SHD, N-MNIST, and DVS128 Gesture support the analysis. Across uniform timestamp budgets, linear interpolation lowers mean representation drift by 47-72% while keeping clean accuracy nearly unchanged. On DVS Gesture, it produces zero prediction flips across all tested budgets and three seeds. On SHD, measured drift follows 1/Delta with R^2 = 0.992.

AI.tldr: 论文研究事件数据时间戳离散化（硬时间分箱）对表示稳定性的影响，证明硬分箱不连续，提出满足质量保持和分辨率保真的连续编码器类，并证明其L1敏感度下界为2/Δ；线性双箱插值达到该下界且具有唯一性。实验表明线性插值显著降低表示漂移且基本不影响精度。
AI.motivation: 事件管线常在学习前离散异步时间戳，但该步骤稳定性依赖时间分辨率。微小时间戳偏移在边界附近可导致单位事件质量在箱间跳变，因此需从表示层面研究并设计连续编码器。
AI.method: 形式化硬时间分箱的不连续性；定义非负、质量保持、分辨率保真的连续编码器类；证明全局L1敏感度下界2/Δ；证明线性双箱插值达到下界，并因局部支撑和一阶矩保持而唯一；在SHD、N-MNIST、DVS128 Gesture上验证。
AI.result: 在均匀时间戳预算下，线性插值将平均表示漂移降低47–72%，清洁精度几乎不变；DVS Gesture在所有测试预算和三个随机种子下预测翻转数为零；SHD测得漂移随1/Δ变化，R^2=0.992。
AI.conclusion: 时间离散化不应忽视，硬分箱在表示层面不稳定；采用线性双箱插值等连续、质量保持编码器可在不牺牲精度的情况下提升时间戳扰动下的表示稳定性。

title: AoI-Driven Hierarchical Learning for Cooperative Resource Sharing in Multi-Operator UAV Networks
summary: Uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV)-assisted networks provide a versatile paradigm for on-demand connectivity. However, in multi-operator aerial networks (MOANs), the joint optimization of cooperative resource sharing and 3D trajectory control to maintain information freshness is a complex combinatorial problem, which can be shown to be NP-hard. To address this computational complexity, we propose an age of information (AoI)-driven hierarchical deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework. Specifically, a Dueling Double Deep Q-Network (D3QN) architecture is deployed at both the operator and UAV decision layers to mitigate overestimation bias and enhance stability in high-dimensional state spaces. To improve system resilience, we introduce an AoI- and load-aware outage compensation mechanism that prioritizes users based on instantaneous transmission demands and temporal freshness. Furthermore, a normalized load exchange balance metric is incorporated to regulate cooperative behavior and ensure resource fairness across operators. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed hierarchical D3QN significantly outperforms conventional DRL, non-cooperative, and cooperative benchmarks, reducing the average AoI by up to 56.1% under severe congestion while ensuring superior inter-operator fairness and outage mitigation.

AI.tldr: 针对多运营商空中网络中的信息新鲜度优化问题，提出一种基于AoI的分层深度强化学习框架，通过D3QN和补偿机制实现资源与轨迹协同优化。
AI.motivation: 多运营商空中网络（MOANs）中，联合优化协作资源共享和3D轨迹以保持信息新鲜度是一个NP难的复杂组合问题，需要高效解决方案。
AI.method: 提出AoI驱动的分层DRL框架，在运营商和UAV决策层部署D3QN架构，引入AoI和负载感知的中断补偿机制及归一化负载交换平衡度量。
AI.result: 仿真表明，所提分层D3QN显著优于传统DRL、非协作和协作基准，在严重拥塞下平均AoI降低高达56.1%，并确保更好的运营商间公平性和中断缓解。
AI.conclusion: 该分层D3QN框架能有效解决MOANs中的资源与轨迹联合优化问题，提升信息新鲜度、公平性和鲁棒性。

title: Latent Policy Steering: An Efficient and Flexible Framework for Cross-Embodiment Transfer
summary:
The performance of learned robot visuomotor policies depends heavily on the size and quality of their training data, yet collecting high-quality demonstrations remains costly for robots in the real world. Although large-scale robot and human datasets are increasingly available, embodiment gaps and mismatched action spaces make them difficult to leverage directly. Cross-embodiment transfer, reusing experience from other embodiments to improve learning on a target embodiment, is therefore crucial for scaling robot learning beyond per-robot data collection.
  In this work, we find that efficient transfer can be achieved by learning from what is shared across embodiments, the visual dynamics of how the world responds to motion, and by effectively exploiting the scarce target-embodiment data at test time. The proposed framework, called Latent Policy Steering (LPS), implements an embodiment-agnostic pretraining phase, which trains an image-based World Model (WM) with optical flow across diverse embodiments. The resulting WM is finetuned on the target embodiment with robot actions. It then steers the base policy toward better actions by searching in the WM's latent space for plans that stay close to the finetuning data. LPS is a policy-agnostic framework: it can flexibly accommodate different policies without having to retrain them. In Robomimic and real-world evaluations, LPS improves the average performance of Diffusion Policy relatively by 16% and 62%, and Pi0.5 by 8% and 14%, with only 50 demonstrations on an unseen target embodiment.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent Policy Steering（LPS）框架，通过跨具身预训练视觉动力学世界模型并在目标具身微调，测试时在潜空间搜索动作以引导基础策略，实现高效跨具身迁移，显著提升机器人策略性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人视觉运动策略性能高度依赖训练数据的规模与质量，但真实世界高质量演示采集成本高昂；现有大规模机器人/人类数据存在具身差异和动作空间不匹配，难以直接利用。跨具身迁移对于超越单机器人数据采集、扩展机器人学习至关重要。
AI.method: LPS框架包含：1）具身无关预训练阶段，利用光流在多种具身上训练图像世界模型（WM）；2）在目标具身上用机器人动作微调WM；3）测试时在WM潜空间中搜索既接近微调数据又能提升动作的规划，从而引导基础策略。该框架策略无关，可灵活适配不同策略而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在Robomimic和真实世界评测中，仅使用目标具身上的50条演示，LPS将Diffusion Policy的平均性能相对提升16%和62%，将Pi0.5提升8%和14%。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习跨具身共享的视觉动力学（世界如何响应运动），并有效利用测试时稀缺的目标具身数据，LPS实现了高效的跨具身迁移，且策略无关，能显著提升现有策略在新具身上的表现。

title: DeepInstructor: An Agentic AI Instructor for Experience-Driven Idea Evaluation
summary: As automated scientific discovery advances, Large Language Models (LLMs) can now generate research ideas at an unprecedented scale, shifting the bottleneck from idea generation to idea evaluation. Existing evaluators mainly rely on parametric LLM knowledge or unstructured retrieval, producing judgments that lack the experience-grounded reasoning used by human instructors. To address this, we propose DeepInstructor, an agentic framework that formulates idea evaluation as reasoning over structured scholarly experience. DeepInstructor constructs an Experience Graph from 58,607 peer reviews and employs a ReAct-based agent to retrieve dimension-specific evidence for traceable evaluation. We further introduce DeepInstruct, a dataset with controlled pairwise comparisons across novelty, significance, and feasibility. Experiments show that DeepInstructor substantially outperforms existing baselines, improving Hit@1 and Hit@2 alignment with human judgments by 24.4% and 29.7%, respectively. Our findings suggest that scientific idea evaluation can be grounded in explicit reasoning over structured scholarly experience

AI.tldr: 提出DeepInstructor，一种将想法评估建模为结构化学术经验推理的智能体框架，通过经验图和ReAct代理进行可追溯评估，并引入DeepInstruct数据集，实验证明其显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM能大规模生成研究想法，评估成为瓶颈；现有评估器依赖参数化知识或非结构化检索，缺乏人类导师那种基于经验的推理。
AI.method: 提出DeepInstructor框架，将想法评估形式化为对结构化学术经验的推理；从58,607条同行评审构建经验图；使用基于ReAct的智能体检索维度特定证据；引入DeepInstruct数据集，包含新颖性、重要性和可行性方面的受控成对比较。
AI.result: 实验显示DeepInstructor显著优于现有基线，与人类判断的Hit@1和Hit@2对齐分别提升24.4%和29.7%。
AI.conclusion: 科学想法评估可以基于对结构化学术经验的显式推理。

title: GameReplica: A Benchmark for Black-Box Visual Game Replication by Vision-Language Agents
summary: Coding-agent benchmarks usually evaluate implementation after the target behavior has been specified in text, code, or demonstrations. Existing research has extensively evaluated the ability of coding agents to generate programs from textual specifications. However, under black-box conditions where neither source code nor documentation is available, it remains underexplored whether an agent can induce the rules solely through visual observation and active interaction and reproduce the target system as a verifiable executable system. To this end, we present GameReplica, a closed-loop evaluation framework for end-to-end black-box game replication that covers the full perception, exploration, induction, reproduction, and verification pipeline. GameReplica comprises 125 tasks spanning 25 games across 5 core mechanism families, with each game instantiated at five difficulty levels. The tasks require an agent to access the target game only through screenshots and an action interface, induce the key visual elements and gameplay rules from pixel feedback and interaction outcomes, and generate a self-contained, runnable game replica that can be automatically verified by an external program. Experiments show that current coding agents still face substantial challenges in end-to-end black-box replication: the best-performing model (Claude Opus 4.8) achieves an overall score of 71.6\%, while the remaining models score only 4.0\%--42.9\%. Further analysis reveals a consistent pattern across all models: visual-fidelity scores are substantially higher than implementation- and rule-consistency scores, indicating that agents replicate visual appearance more readily than game mechanics. The difficulty levels further amplify the performance gap: from L1 to L5, the overall score of weaker agents drops sharply, whereas that of the best-performing agent declines only slightly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GameReplica，一个面向端到端黑盒游戏复制的闭环评测框架，覆盖感知、探索、归纳、复现与验证全流程，包含125个任务、25款游戏、5类核心机制家族、5个难度等级。实验表明当前编码智能体在黑盒复制上仍面临巨大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体基准通常在目标行为已被文本、代码或演示明确指定后评估实现能力，而对既无源码也无文档的黑盒条件研究不足。作者想探究：智能体能否仅通过视觉观察与主动交互归纳规则，并将目标系统复现为可自动验证的可执行系统。
AI.method: 提出 GameReplica 闭环评测框架，涵盖感知、探索、归纳、复现和验证的完整流水线。框架包含125个任务，覆盖25款游戏、5类核心机制家族，每款游戏设5个难度等级。任务要求智能体仅通过截图和动作接口访问目标游戏，从像素反馈与交互结果中归纳关键视觉元素和游戏规则，并生成可由外部程序自动验证的自包含可运行游戏副本。
AI.result: 实验显示当前编码智能体在端到端黑盒复制中仍面临显著挑战：最佳模型 Claude Opus 4.8 总体得分71.6%，其余模型仅为4.0%–42.9%。所有模型呈现一致模式：视觉保真度得分显著高于实现一致性与规则一致性得分，表明智能体更易复现视觉外观而非游戏机制。难度等级进一步放大差距：从L1到L5，较弱智能体得分急剧下降，而最佳智能体仅略有下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前编码智能体在端到端黑盒游戏复制上仍存在巨大困难，且普遍呈现“重外观、轻机制”的倾向；难度提升会显著拉开不同能力智能体之间的差距。

title: Text, Pixels, or Both? Evaluating Input Representations for Multimodal Document QA
comment: Accepted as a poster at the Context Beyond the Window (CBW) Workshop at COLM 2026 and the DocInsights Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Every document QA system begins with a choice that is rarely studied on its own: whether to feed the model page images, extracted text, or both. We isolate this choice, holding the prompt, judge, and scoring pipeline fixed, across four commercial model endpoints, two corpora, and two context regimes (gold evidence pages and the full document). On documents that fit the image budget, page images lead on accuracy at every document length on both corpora, but this advantage carries a growing latency and cost premium: text latency stays roughly flat as documents lengthen while image latency rises steadily. Text and images also fail on different questions, with exactly one representation correct on 19--25% of items across the reported cells, so neither subsumes the other. Exploiting this complementarity, a lightweight TF-IDF router that reads only the question text gains 2.6 points over always-text while cutting median latency 30% relative to always-vision, on a document-disjoint held-out split.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较文档问答中输入表示的选择：页面图像、提取文本或两者兼用。在固定提示、评判与评分流程下，跨四个商用模型端点、两个语料和两种上下文设置进行实验，发现图像在精度上占优但延迟与成本更高，文本与图像具有互补性，轻量路由器可兼顾精度与延迟。
AI.motivation: 文档问答系统通常直接选择输入表示，但这一基础决策很少被单独研究。作者希望隔离并量化页面图像与提取文本对精度、延迟和成本的独立影响，并探索能否利用二者互补性。
AI.method: 固定提示、评判模型和评分流程，在四个商用模型端点、两个语料、两种上下文机制（黄金证据页与完整文档）下比较页面图像、提取文本及两者输入。还分析不同表示的错误互补性，并训练仅读取问题文本的轻量TF-IDF路由器来选择表示。
AI.result: 在文档符合图像预算时，页面图像在两个语料、各文档长度上均取得更高准确率，但延迟和成本溢价随文档变长而扩大：文本延迟大致平稳，图像延迟持续上升。文本与图像在不同问题上失败，报告单元格中恰好仅一种表示正确的比例为19%–25%，说明二者不能互相替代。基于TF-IDF的路由器在文档不重叠的留出集上比始终用文本提升2.6个点，同时相比始终用图像降低约30%中位延迟。
AI.conclusion: 页面图像通常带来更高问答准确率，但有随文档长度增长的延迟与成本代价；文本与图像在错误上互补。利用问题文本的轻量路由器可有效发挥二者互补性，在精度和延迟之间取得更好权衡。

title: VGG16-MCA UNet: Whole-Tumor Segmentation in 2D FLAIR MRI with Decoder-Side Channel Attention
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Code and data splits: https://github.com/ShubhamGajjar/vgg16-mca-unet
summary: Automated brain tumor segmentation supports diagnosis, treatment planning, and monitoring of disease progression, but building models that generalize across heterogeneous tumors and limited annotated data remains difficult. We present VGG16-MCA UNet, a hybrid architecture pairing an ImageNet-pretrained VGG16 encoder with a decoder in which a Multi-Channel Attention (MCA) module recalibrates features after each skip-connection fusion, trained with the Focal Tversky loss to counter severe foreground-background imbalance. We evaluate the model as a 2D, FLAIR-only, whole-tumor segmenter on tumor-positive slices from two public datasets: the BraTS 2020 benchmark and the LGG MRI Segmentation dataset. Using 5-fold cross-validation and a single network formed by averaging the weights of the five fold models, the method attains an aggregate pixel-level Dice (F1) of 95.10% on our held-out BraTS 2020 split and 88.32% on LGG. These scores are computed over all test pixels pooled into a single confusion matrix rather than averaged per case, and are therefore not directly comparable to the per-case mean Dice used in the BraTS challenge protocol. All partitions were drawn over individual slices rather than over patients, so every patient contributes slices to both training and test; the figures above therefore measure interpolation within known patients and should be read as an upper bound rather than as generalization to new ones. The model segments a 256x256 slice in 66.32 ms on a single 6 GB NVIDIA RTX 2060, approximately 8 ms more than an equivalent VGG16-UNet without MCA. We release the split records and report the protocol in full, with the aim of providing a precisely specified and reproducible 2D FLAIR baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出VGG16-MCA UNet混合架构，将ImageNet预训练VGG16编码器与带多通道注意力（MCA）的解码器结合，并用Focal Tversky损失训练，在BraTS 2020和LGG数据集上进行2D FLAIR全肿瘤分割，报告像素级Dice分别为95.10%和88.32%，但明确指出评估协议限制，结果应视为已知患者内的上界而非泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 自动脑肿瘤分割有助于诊断、治疗规划和疾病进展监测，但构建能泛化到异质性肿瘤且仅依赖有限标注数据的模型仍然困难。
AI.method: 提出VGG16-MCA UNet：ImageNet预训练的VGG16编码器 + 解码器，在每次跳跃连接融合后使用多通道注意力（MCA）模块重新校准特征，并采用Focal Tversky损失应对严重的前景-背景不平衡。评估为2D、仅FLAIR、全肿瘤分割器，在BraTS 2020和LGG MRI Segmentation数据集的肿瘤阳性切片上进行5折交叉验证，并将5个折模型的权重平均为单一网络。数据按切片而非患者划分，测试像素汇入单一混淆矩阵计算Dice。
AI.result: 在留出的BraTS 2020划分上像素级Dice（F1）为95.10%，在LGG上为88.32%。在单张6 GB NVIDIA RTX 2060上分割256x256切片需66.32 ms，比不带MCA的等效VGG16-UNet多约8 ms。这些分数基于所有测试像素池化的单一混淆矩阵，而非BraTS协议中的按病例平均Dice，故不可直接比较；又因按切片划分，每位患者同时贡献训练和测试切片，因此结果衡量的是已知患者内的插值，应视为上界而非对新患者的泛化。
AI.conclusion: 发布划分记录并完整报告协议，旨在提供一个精确指定且可复现的2D FLAIR基线，但结果不能直接与BraTS挑战协议比较，且泛化到新患者的能力有限。

title: ORION-CMR: On-scanner Reporting with Integrated Foundation Model for End-to-End Cardiac MRI Analysis and Interpretation
summary: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) provides comprehensive cardiac assessment but remains underutilized because of the complexity of acquisition, post-processing, and interpretation. Existing artificial intelligence (AI) methods address isolated tasks, limiting clinical integration. We present ORION-CMR (On-scanner Reporting with Integrated fOunda-tioN Model), the first clinically evaluated scanner-native end-to-end CMR foundation model. Pretrained on 12,896,733 CMR images from 9,258 studies, ORION-CMR performs sequence classification, ventricular function assessment, late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) detection, binary and multiclass disease classification, and local large language model-based report generation in approximately 90 seconds. The framework. was evaluated on public benchmarks and clinically validated in a multi-vendor cohort of 68 subjects with normal examinations, congenital heart disease, dilated cardiomyopathy, and myocardial infarction. ORION-CMR outperformed supervised baselines and the previously published CMR foundation model (CMR-FM), achieving state-of-the-art performance for LGE classification and scar segmentation. Clinical evaluation achieved an AUC of 0.96 for normal-versus abnormal classification and 0.88 for multiclass disease classification, while generated reports demonstrated 81.4% agreement with expert interpretation. These results demonstrate the feasibility of real-time scanner-native AI-assisted CMR analysis and automated report generation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出ORION-CMR，这是首个经临床评估的扫描仪原生端到端心脏磁共振（CMR）基础模型，可在约90秒内完成多项CMR分析任务并生成报告。
AI.motivation: CMR可全面评估心脏，但因采集、后处理和解读复杂而应用不足；现有AI方法多针对孤立任务，难以整合到临床流程中。
AI.method: 基于9,258项研究的12,896,733张CMR图像预训练ORION-CMR，支持序列分类、心室功能评估、晚期钆增强（LGE）检测、二分类和多分类疾病分类，以及基于本地大语言模型的报告生成；并在公开基准和多厂商临床队列（68例，包括正常、先天性心脏病、扩张型心肌病和心肌梗死）中验证。
AI.result: ORION-CMR优于监督基线和已发表的CMR基础模型（CMR-FM），在LGE分类和瘢痕分割上达到最先进性能；临床评估中正常与异常分类AUC为0.96，多分类疾病分类AUC为0.88，生成报告与专家解读一致率为81.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明实时、扫描仪原生的AI辅助CMR分析和自动报告生成具有可行性。

title: Self-Organizing Agent Teams Learn to Reason Together
summary: Collective intelligence depends not only on what team members know, but also on how they organize their work. When the structure of a solution is unknown, useful roles and divisions of labor cannot be specified in advance; teams must learn from experience how to organize reasoning as it unfolds. Human teams routinely adapt this way, while existing AI agent teams rely on fixed protocols, explicit task decomposition, or routing. We introduce Self-Organizing Agent Teams (SAT), fixed teams of AI agents that learn reusable strategies from prior collaborations to organize roles, conversational phases, participation, and information flow. These strategies enable what we call collaborative computation: agents exchange, challenge, repair, and synthesize partial reasoning into solutions no member produced independently. In two independent settings, we learn teamwork strategies that transfer unchanged to unseen benchmarks, using only 15 mathematics and 25 graduate-level knowledge problems. Across five mathematics and physics benchmarks, self-organizing teams average 66.7% accuracy, versus 48.8% for their strongest member, 58.7% for compute-matched inference by that agent, and 59.0% for a perfect router over members' independent answers; on AIME 2026, they exceed this router by 13.4 points. Because gains vary across benchmarks, we ask when self-organizing collaboration helps. Across eight benchmarks, demonstrability (the organizational-psychology construct of whether a team can distinguish correct from incorrect reasoning) strongly tracks improvement over the strongest member (Spearman $ρ=0.90$, $p=0.005$): teams benefit most when correct reasoning can be recognized once it appears. More broadly, these results suggest that organization itself can become an agent capability: agent teams can learn how to reason together and produce solutions their members could not reach independently.

AI.tldr: 论文提出「自组织智能体团队（SAT）」，让固定的AI智能体团队从过往协作中学习可复用的团队策略（角色分工、对话阶段、参与度与信息流），实现「协作式计算」，即通过交换、质疑、修正与综合局部推理，产出任何单个成员都无法独立得到的解。
AI.motivation: 集体智能不仅取决于成员掌握的知识，还取决于他们如何组织工作。当解决方案的结构未知时，有用的角色与分工无法预先指定，人类团队会边推理边从经验中学习如何组织协作，而现有AI智能体团队依赖固定协议、显式任务分解或路由机制，缺乏这种自组织能力。
AI.method: 构建固定成员的AI智能体团队，学习可迁移的团队协作策略，涵盖角色分配、对话阶段、发言参与和信息流动；在数学与研究生水平知识两类独立场景中训练策略，仅用15道数学题和25道研究生知识题，并将学习到的策略原封不动迁移到未见过的基准测试上评估。
AI.result: 在五个数学与物理基准上，自组织团队平均准确率66.7%，而最强单成员为48.8%、同等算力的单智能体推理为58.7%、对成员独立答案的完美路由器为59.0%；在AIME 2026上比该完美路由器高出13.4个百分点。跨八个基准的分析显示，「可论证性」（团队能否区分正确与错误推理）与相对最强成员的提升高度相关（Spearman ρ=0.90, p=0.005）。
AI.conclusion: 自组织协作的收益因基准而异，当正确推理一旦出现就能被识别时团队受益最大。更广泛地说，组织能力本身可以成为一种智能体能力：智能体团队能够学会如何共同推理，并产出成员独立无法达到的解决方案。

title: Yarn tracking of large-scale 3D textile reinforcements using topological material features
summary: Automated segmentation of CT images has become increasingly important to enhance the reliability of simulations through the generation of high fidelity numerical models. This study addresses the challenging task of semi-automatically tracking textile reinforcements in fan blade dry preforms using X-ray CT images captured at coarse resolutions (i.e., above 140 $μ$m). Our approach offers a scalable, slice-based analysis conducted on planes orthogonal to the main yarn directions, applied to a large-scale real industrial component. This enables accurate identification and tracking of yarn paths while requiring minimal training. The method models three key yarn properties statistically: their typical cross-section shape, their continuity and movement in the 3D space, and their spatial relative arrangement with respect to neighboring yarns. These statistical properties are integrated into a tracking framework via a variational formulation that optimizes all yarn center positions in successive cross-section planes. The method tracks more than 3,000 warp yarns across 1,500 slices and achieves a tracking success rate above 90%. Overall, this work demonstrates a promising approach toward large-scale, automated textile reinforcement annotation, paving the way for more efficient material characterization in complex composite structures.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于X射线CT图像的半自动纱线跟踪方法，用于粗分辨率下风扇叶片干预制体的纺织增强体分割，在工业级大尺寸部件上实现了超过90%的跟踪成功率。
AI.motivation: 自动CT图像分割对于生成高保真数值模型、提升仿真可靠性日益重要；但粗分辨率CT图像中纺织增强体的跟踪仍具挑战，且需要适用于大型工业部件并尽量减少训练数据。
AI.method: 采用基于切片的正交于主纱线方向的分析方法；统计建模纱线横截面形状、三维空间中的连续性与运动、以及相邻纱线间的空间相对排列；通过变分公式在连续横截面平面上优化所有纱线中心位置。
AI.result: 在1500个切片中跟踪了超过3000根经纱，跟踪成功率超过90%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有望实现大规模、自动化的纺织增强体标注，为复杂复合材料结构更高效的材料表征铺平道路。

title: FRAMES: Failure Recovery And Monitoring of Embodied Skills for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at the IROS 2026 Workshop on Full-Shift Robot Co-Workers: Active Perception and Interaction for Human Environments
summary: Large language model (LLM) planners can decompose natural-language instructions and select reusable robot skills, but choosing the correct skill does not guarantee successful physical execution. This gap is especially important in humanoid loco-manipulation, where errors during approach, grasping, transport, or placement can invalidate the remainder of a long-horizon plan. We present FRAMES, a failure-aware supervisory framework for the Unitree G1 humanoid that operates above the CEER whole-body controller. A Planner Agent selects subtasks through parameterized mid-level skills, while a vision-language-model-based Monitor Agent evaluates each skill using temporal multi-view observations and structured robot and contact evidence. Detected failures stop the active skill and provide grounded feedback to a Recovery Agent. The framework further includes a Memory Module for reusing prior skill experience, and geometric grounding via depth and segmentation. We independently evaluate the monitoring module of the framework in MuJoCo using 100 trials comprising 50 failed and 50 successful executions across five tasks. The monitor detects 48 of 50 failures, correctly accepts 46 of 50 successful executions, and achieves 94.0% overall accuracy. These results provide initial evidence for the monitoring component, while end-to-end evaluation of the complete recovery loop remains ongoing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FRAMES，一个面向Unitree G1人形机器人的故障感知监督框架，在CEER全身控制器之上运行，包含规划、监控、恢复和记忆模块。初步在MuJoCo中评估监控模块，100次试验下总体准确率达94.0%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型规划器能分解自然语言指令并选择可复用机器人技能，但选择正确技能并不保证物理执行成功。在人形机器人长时程移动操作中，接近、抓取、运输或放置阶段的错误会使后续长时程计划失效，因此需要故障感知的监督机制。
AI.method: FRAMES框架包含：规划智能体通过参数化中层技能选择子任务；基于视觉语言模型的监控智能体利用多视角时序观测及结构化机器人/接触证据评估每个技能；检测到故障后停止当前技能并向恢复智能体提供接地反馈；记忆模块复用先前技能经验；通过深度和分割实现几何接地。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo中对监控模块进行独立评估，使用100次试验（50次失败、50次成功），覆盖五个任务。监控器检测出48/50次失败，正确接受46/50次成功，总体准确率为94.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果为监控组件提供了初步证据，而完整恢复闭环的端到端评估仍在进行中。

title: Distributed Cooperative Control with Prescribed Performance of BESSs with A Unified Discharge Constrain for Power Allocation under Dynamic Load
summary: Battery energy storage system (BESS) is integrated into the smart grid to enhance scalability, economy, and greenery. And the State-of-Charge (SoC) balance is one of the basic problems of BESSs, which can maximize the utilization of capacity. BESSs with a unified relative variation rate for SoC can be simultaneously filled or empty, while real-time estimation schemes of SoC balance and power sharing states are required in this power allocation scheme. Therefore, the prescribed performance control (PPC) method is applied in this paper to design two distributed estimators based on multi-agent systems (MASs), in order to estimate the power sharing and SoC balance states in real-time under dynamic load driving. In this way, these two average values can ultimately be well estimated with almost zero error performance, and dynamic performance and steady-state performance of the two estimators can be adjusted by different parameters. Similarly, consensus performance and dynamic tracking performance are decoupled. These results provide a broader range for the selection of gains. To verify the effectiveness, robustness and progressiveness of the designed estimators, some cases with a resistance network containing 4 BESSs as load distribution are designed and discussed. Further more, to test scalability, a large-scale system containing 12 BESSs is conducted to the designed scheme.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对智能电网中电池储能系统（BESS）的SoC均衡与功率分配状态实时估计问题，基于多智能体系统和预设性能控制设计两种分布式估计器，并在4节点和12节点BESS系统中验证有效性、鲁棒性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: BESS并网可提升可扩展性、经济性和绿色性，而SoC均衡可最大化容量利用；采用统一相对变化率的SoC均衡方案需要实时估计SoC均衡与功率分配状态。
AI.method: 采用预设性能控制（PPC）方法，基于多智能体系统（MAS）设计两个分布式估计器，用于动态负载驱动下实时估计功率分配和SoC均衡状态。
AI.result: 两个平均值估计最终可实现几乎零误差性能；估计器的动态性能与稳态性能可由不同参数调节，一致性与动态跟踪性能解耦，从而拓宽增益选择范围。通过含4个BESS的电阻网络算例验证有效性、鲁棒性和先进性，并通过含12个BESS的大规模系统测试可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 所设计的分布式估计器能够有效、鲁棒地实现BESS功率分配与SoC均衡状态的实时估计，并具备良好的可扩展性。

title: Generative Embodied Multiple Behavior Control Systems for Human-like Agents
summary: An enduring and richly elaborated dichotomy in cognitive neuroscience is that of human behavior control mechanisms, divided into habitual versus goal-directed. While existing human-like agent frameworks primarily focus on modeling goal- directed behavior, habitual behavior has been largely overlooked, though it plays a crucial role in human daily life. In this paper, we address this gap by studying multiple behavior control systems that jointly model goal-directed and habitual behaviors. We propose a human behavior control mechanism-inspired framework which the Habitual Controller retrieves cue-triggered behaviors from personal- ized habit memory, while the Goal-directed Controller employs a context-aware world model to predict action consequences and estimate their values. The Arbiter dynamically balances the influence of both systems according to individual differ- ences and momentary internal states. To reconstruct diverse human-level behavior instructions in 3D environments, we further develop a keyframe-guided 3D mo- tion generation module. Through extensive evaluation methods, human studies, and ablations studies, experimental results demonstrate that human-likeness per- formance is significantly improved by our approach. The efficacy of our approach indicates the benefits of leveraging habitual behavior and multiple behavior con- trol system coordination for believable embodied human-like agents.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有类人智能体主要建模目标导向行为、忽视习惯行为的问题，提出受人类行为控制机制启发的多行为控制系统，联合建模目标导向与习惯行为，并开发关键帧引导的3D动作生成模块，以提升3D环境中类人智能体的行为真实感。
AI.motivation: 认知神经科学将人类行为控制分为习惯性与目标导向两类，但现有类人智能体框架大多只关注目标导向行为，忽略了在日常生活中同样关键的习惯行为。
AI.method: 提出多行为控制框架：习惯控制器从个性化习惯记忆中检索线索触发行为；目标导向控制器利用情境感知世界模型预测动作后果并估计价值；仲裁器根据个体差异和瞬时内部状态动态平衡两者。同时开发关键帧引导的3D动作生成模块，以重建多样的人类级3D行为指令。
AI.result: 通过广泛评估、人类研究和消融实验，结果表明该方法显著提升了类人真实感表现。
AI.conclusion: 利用习惯行为和多行为控制系统协调，有助于构建更可信的具身类人智能体。

title: React When You Need To: Event-Triggered Asynchronous Inference for VLA Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly predict action chunks, limiting their ability to react to environmental changes during execution. Existing asynchronous inference methods improve reactivity but typically rely on a fixed inference gap. In this paper, we propose an event-guided dynamic inference strategy that adapts the inference gap according to scene changes observed since the previous inference. Thereby, it simultaneously preserves motion consistency and prompt reactivity. Across static and dynamic real-world settings, our method consistently performs best, averaging 95% success and exceeding the strongest baseline by 55 percentage points. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance. The project page is available at https://react-when-you-need-to.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出事件引导的动态推理策略，根据场景变化自适应调整推理间隔，兼顾运动一致性与响应性，在真实环境中平均成功率达95%，超最强基线55个百分点。
AI.motivation: VLA模型预测动作块导致执行中对环境变化响应差；现有异步推理方法使用固定推理间隔，难以适应动态场景。
AI.method: 基于自上次推理以来观察到的场景变化，设计事件引导的动态推理策略，自适应调整推理间隔。
AI.result: 在静态和动态真实环境中均表现最佳，平均成功率95%，比最强基线高55个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能同时保持运动一致性和快速响应，显著提升VLA模型在动态环境中的性能。

title: On a Closed-Loop Controller for the Coevolutionary Model of Actions and Opinions via Broadcasting Information
comment: 6 pages. Accepted for presentation at the IEEE CDC 2026
summary: We deal with controlling a complex social network in which agents have actions and opinions that coevolve, mutually influencing one another. We consider an input consisting in broadcasting information to a target set of agents with the objective of steering the population, initially at a consensus, to a different consensus. For a constant input, we derive a monotone convergence result, building on which we design an algorithm that determines whether a target set is sufficient to achieve the objective and an effective heuristic to optimize the target set. Then, we introduce a feedback control law that, using information on the state of the system, dynamically revises the target set, reducing the effort needed to achieve the objective while guaranteeing convergence to the desired consensus state.

AI.tldr: 研究在行动与观点共同演化的复杂社交网络中，通过向目标节点集广播信息，将群体从一个共识状态引导到另一个共识状态。
AI.motivation: 社交网络中个体的行动和观点会相互影响并共同演化，如何有效控制这类网络并使其达到期望共识，是一个重要问题。
AI.method: 针对恒定输入，先建立单调收敛结果；据此设计算法判断给定目标集是否足以实现控制目标，并提出优化目标集的启发式方法；进一步引入反馈控制律，利用系统状态信息动态调整目标集。
AI.result: 证明了恒定输入下的单调收敛性；算法可判断目标集是否充分，启发式方法可优化目标集；反馈控制律能动态修正目标集，在保证收敛到期望共识的同时减少控制努力。
AI.conclusion: 通过目标集选择与反馈控制，可以有效引导社交网络从初始共识转向期望共识，并降低实现该目标所需的干预成本。

title: Evaluating Fine-Tuned and Base Language Models in Maternal and Vaccination Healthcare for African Settings
summary: Background: Large language models (LLMs) can improve healthcare information delivery in low-resource settings but may produce inaccurate or culturally inappropriate advice. This study evaluated domain-specific fine-tuning for maternal health and vaccination in Nigeria. Objective: To compare HelpMum's MamaBot-Llama and Vax-Llama with Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for accuracy, safety, clarity, contextual appropriateness, and trustworthiness. Methods: We evaluated 200 healthcare questions, 100 each for maternal health and vaccination, across five subdomains per domain. MamaBot-Llama and Vax-Llama were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation on over 36,000 maternal health and 9,000 vaccination question-answer pairs, respectively. Two Nigerian licensed physicians independently rated responses using a 5-point Likert scale. Paired comparisons used Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Results: Performance varied by domain. MamaBot-Llama significantly outperformed the base model across all criteria, with a 4.9% overall improvement (p < .001), including gains in clinical trustworthiness (+7%) and medical accuracy (+5%). Critical issues decreased by 50%, and clinicians preferred it in 78% of cases. In contrast, Vax-Llama showed a 5.2% overall decline (p < .001), with critical issues increasing by 192% and safety concerns by 400%. Conclusions: Domain-specific fine-tuning can improve healthcare LLM performance when based on high-quality, clinician-curated data, but may also degrade performance when dataset quality is inadequate. Rigorous domain-specific validation is essential before clinical deployment. Physician evaluators provided informed consent, and chatbot logs were anonymized. Keywords: Large language models; Fine-tuning; Maternal health; Vaccination; Healthcare AI; Low-resource settings; Nigeria; Model evaluation; LoRA; Medical accuracy

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了针对尼日利亚孕产妇健康和疫苗接种领域的大语言模型微调效果，比较了MamaBot-Llama和Vax-Llama与基础Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。结果显示，孕产妇健康模型显著提升，而疫苗接种模型表现下降，强调了数据质量的重要性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可改善低资源环境下的医疗信息传递，但可能产生不准确或文化不适的建议。因此需要评估特定领域的微调效果。
AI.method: 评估了200个医疗问题（孕产妇健康和疫苗接种各100个，每个领域5个子领域）。使用LoRA对36,000多个孕产妇健康和9,000个疫苗接种问答对进行微调。两名尼日利亚执业医师独立使用5点李克特量表评分，采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行配对比较。
AI.result: MamaBot-Llama在所有标准上显著优于基础模型，总体提升4.9%（p<.001），临床可信度+7%，医学准确性+5%，关键问题减少50%，78%的案例中医师更偏好。相反，Vax-Llama总体下降5.2%（p<.001），关键问题增加192%，安全问题增加400%。
AI.conclusion: 基于高质量、临床医生整理的数据进行领域特定微调可提升医疗大语言模型性能，但数据质量不足时可能导致性能下降。临床部署前必须进行严格的领域特定验证。

title: Beyond the Text: Verifying That Agent-Written Papers Are Backed by Their Artifacts
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly capable of conducting research autonomously, producing research documents alongside the code and experiments that ostensibly support them. Yet whether the reported findings are consistently supported by corresponding implementations and execution evidence remains largely unexplored: existing review practices primarily assess textual quality and cannot reliably identify inconsistencies such as hard-coded metrics, unimplemented methods, or unsupported experimental results. We present ReAgent, an automated auditing framework for assessing the consistency between agent-generated research documents and their associated repositories. ReAgent constructs structured representations of scientific claims from research documents and uses them to guide repository analysis and evidence collection. Static auditing examines whether claimed methodologies, implementations, and experimental configurations are consistently reflected in the repository, while dynamic auditing executes relevant experiments and collects execution evidence to assess empirical findings. By combining static analysis with dynamic evidence, ReAgent identifies inconsistencies that may remain hidden under either perspective alone, such as experiments that reproduce reported numbers while deviating from the claimed methodology. The collected evidence and audit decisions are organized into a structured repository-level audit report, enabling transparent evidence traceability. We evaluate ReAgent on a manually curated benchmark of agent-generated research document--repository pairs and compare it against representative static and reproduction-based baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that ReAgent effectively identifies inconsistencies between reported research findings and their supporting repository evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReAgent，一个自动化审计框架，用于评估LLM智能体生成的研究文档与其关联代码仓库之间的一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体自主研究日益普遍，但报告结果是否被实现与执行证据支持尚不清楚。现有评审主要关注文本质量，无法识别硬编码指标、未实现方法或缺乏支持的实验结果等不一致。
AI.method: ReAgent从研究文档中构建科学主张的结构化表示，指导仓库分析与证据收集。静态审计检查声称的方法、实现和实验配置是否一致反映在仓库中；动态审计执行相关实验并收集执行证据以评估实证发现。结合静态与动态证据，识别单一视角下隐藏的不一致，并生成结构化的仓库级审计报告。
AI.result: 在人工整理的智能体生成研究文档-仓库对基准上评估，与代表性静态和复现基线相比，ReAgent能有效识别报告发现与支持仓库证据之间的不一致。
AI.conclusion: ReAgent可有效审计智能体生成研究文档与仓库证据的一致性，提升研究可信度与可追溯性。

title: Recurrent Convolutional Neural Networks for LiDAR-Based Attitude Initialization of Rotating Spacecraft
summary: Accurate attitude estimation is essential for autonomous in-orbit servicing and proximity operations. This work proposes a Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network (RCNN) used in coarse attitude initialization of known, possibly tumbling spacecraft using LiDAR-derived depth images. By processing temporal sequences of 2D point-cloud projections, the RCNN effectively handles symmetries, occlusions, and degraded sensing. Simulations across various spacecraft geometries, angular velocities, and ranges show that the RCNN yields lower initialization errors and higher convergence rates than conventional CNN baseline within the adopted experimental framework, with performance varying across angular velocity conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种循环卷积神经网络（RCNN），用于已知且可能翻滚航天器的粗姿态初始化，通过处理LiDAR深度图像的2D点云投影时间序列，提升初始化精度与收敛率。
AI.motivation: 自主在轨服务与接近操作需要精确的姿态估计，但传统方法在航天器对称性、遮挡和传感退化等情况下效果受限，因此需要更鲁棒的粗姿态初始化方法。
AI.method: 采用RCNN处理2D点云投影的时间序列，利用循环卷积结构融合时序信息；在不同航天器几何、角速度和距离条件下进行仿真，并与传统CNN基线对比。
AI.result: 仿真表明，RCNN的初始化误差更低、收敛率更高，优于CNN基线，但性能随角速度条件而变化。
AI.conclusion: RCNN能有效应对对称性、遮挡和传感退化，适用于已知翻滚航天器的粗姿态初始化，但性能受角速度影响。

title: JEVQA - Video Quality from Metadata, Bitstream, and Pixel Features with a General-Purpose Decision Model
summary: Instrumental quality models for video quality prediction are usually trained for a fixed set of codecs or other input features, and every new input variable requires retraining. Novel, general-purpose decision models can answer questions without task-specific training, but it is unclear whether they can judge video quality. We evaluate Jev, a commercial ``System One'' model that returns probability distributions over a provided answer scale, as a zero-shot video quality model. We call the resulting method JEVQA. In a first study on 1,936 AV1, H.264, HEVC, and VP9 encodes of 22 sources, scored against VMAF as ground truth, using encoding metadata only, JEVQA reached a Pearson correlation of 0.737, on par with the standardized ITU-T P.1204.1 model (0.733). Giving the model bitstream data raised the accuracy to 0.797, and combined pixel-based and bitstream features raised it to 0.824. A pixel-only variant failed in our tests. In a second study, using H.264, HEVC, and VP9 encodes in the AVT-VQDB-UHD-1 database, the metadata-only model reached a correlation of 0.879 with MOS, close to P.1204.1 (0.898). Bitstream statistics did not help there. Our results show that trained models on the same features remain clearly ahead in both studies, but that zero-shot classifiers are promising.

AI.tldr: 评估了Jev（System One）模型作为零样本视频质量预测模型JEVQA的性能，并与ITU-T P.1204.1等模型对比。
AI.motivation: 传统视频质量预测模型需要针对固定编解码器或输入特征训练，新增变量需重新训练；通用决策模型无需任务特定训练，但其视频质量判断能力尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用Jev模型（输出答案尺度上的概率分布）进行零样本视频质量预测，称为JEVQA。研究一：1936个AV1/H.264/HEVC/VP9编码（22个源），以VMAF为真值，分别使用编码元数据、比特流数据、像素+比特流特征。研究二：在AVT-VQDB-UHD-1数据库上使用H.264/HEVC/VP9编码，与MOS对比。
AI.result: 研究一：仅元数据Pearson相关系数0.737，与P.1204.1（0.733）相当；加入比特流数据提升至0.797；像素+比特流提升至0.824；仅像素变体失败。研究二：仅元数据与MOS相关0.879，接近P.1204.1（0.898）；比特流统计无帮助。训练模型在相同特征上仍明显领先，但零样本分类器有前景。
AI.conclusion: 零样本分类器在视频质量评估中展现出潜力，但当前基于相同特征训练的传统模型仍更优。

title: Analysis and Design of Desaturation Short-Circuit Protection for SiC MOSFET Under High Switching Voltage Transients
summary: Short-circuit protection is vital for ensuring the safe operation of high-power-density power converters using Silicon Carbide (SiC) MOSFETs. However, adapting conventional desaturation (DESAT) protection, originally designed for Silicon (Si) IGBTs, is challenging due to the significantly shorter shortcircuit withstand time of SiC devices, typically less than 3μs. Nevertheless, DESAT protection can be adapted for SiC MOSFETs through certain circuit modifications. This article provides a comprehensive analysis and design guidelines for the three architectural variants of DESAT protection circuits, specifically for adjusting the short-circuit detection time suitable for SiC MOSFETs. Further, this article establishes a quantitative framework to evaluate the noise induced into the DESAT protection circuits during turn-off dv/dt switching transients. From this analysis, a design methodology and safe operating boundary are derived for each DESAT configuration, guiding the systematic selection of component values to balance dv/dt noise margin and short-circuit detection speed for SiC MOSFETs. Experimental results are presented to validate the analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文针对SiC MOSFET短路耐受时间短的问题，分析并设计三种DESAT保护电路架构，建立dv/dt噪声量化框架，提出元件选型与安全边界设计方法，并通过实验验证。
AI.motivation: 传统DESAT保护主要面向Si IGBT，而SiC MOSFET短路耐受时间通常小于3μs，直接沿用难以满足快速检测与可靠保护需求，因此需要改造和系统化设计DESAT电路。
AI.method: 全面分析三种DESAT保护架构，给出调整短路检测时间的设计指南；建立关断dv/dt瞬态期间DESAT电路噪声的定量评估框架；针对每种配置推导设计方法和安全工作边界；开展实验验证。
AI.result: 得到了不同DESAT配置下兼顾dv/dt噪声裕度与短路检测速度的元件取值选择方法，并明确了相应的安全运行边界，实验结果验证了分析的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DESAT保护经过电路修改可适用于SiC MOSFET；所提分析框架、设计方法和安全边界可为SiC MOSFET短路保护的系统化设计提供指导。

title: Dimensionality reduction for AI based hyperspectral image classification based on XAI
comment: The paper has been presented at the Annual Workshop of the Austrian Association for Pattern Recognition (OAGM) 2023 - Patterns in One Health - Oct 24-25, 2023, Vienna, Austria
summary: This research addresses the challenge of limited material recycling in wood recycling processes by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI)-based dimensionality reduction. Our study explores the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in multi-channel hyperspectral imaging (HSI), extending beyond RGB channels to over 200 spectral channels. Dimensionality reduction within this context involves streamlining the feature space for AI system training and inference. Focusing on explainable AI (XAI) methods, this paper contributes to a broader research initiative, presenting a solution framework that enhances the sustainability and efficiency of wood recycling processes.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用基于人工智能的降维方法，探索CNN在多通道高光谱成像中的应用，以提升木材回收过程的可持续性与效率。
AI.motivation: 木材回收过程中材料循环利用率有限，需要更有效的技术手段来改进回收工艺。
AI.method: 采用卷积神经网络（CNN）处理多通道高光谱成像数据，将光谱通道从RGB扩展到200多个通道，并进行特征空间降维，同时关注可解释AI（XAI）方法。
AI.result: 研究属于更广泛的研究计划，提出了一个解决方案框架，用于增强木材回收过程的可持续性和效率，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 基于AI的降维与多通道高光谱成像相结合，有望改进木材回收中的材料识别与回收效率，并为可持续木材回收提供可行框架。

title: ALPINE: Adaptive Localization for Parameter- and Sample-Efficient Few-Shot Learning
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code, checkpoints, and reproduction manifests available at https://github.com/NeerajYadav-coder/alpine-fewshot
summary: Few-shot learning research is predominantly evaluated on accuracy alone, with limited attention to the parameter and training-sample budgets required to reach that accuracy - a real constraint for practitioners without large-scale compute. We present an ultra-lightweight (22,249-34,917 parameter) spatial-relational architecture for few-shot image classification that combines fixed Gabor edge-energy guidance with a windowed, content-adaptive patch locator. Under a strictly matched, iso-episode-budget protocol (250 meta-training episodes, 5 canonical seeds, 600 evaluation episodes per seed), our architecture achieves 5-shot accuracy gains, consistent across all five seeds, over Prototypical Networks, Relation Networks, and MAML on both CIFAR-FS and MiniImageNet, while using 27-53% fewer parameters than any baseline. It also converges in fewer training episodes, generalizes better to an unseen fine-grained domain (CUB-200-2011 birds, zero retraining), and is more robust to 50% occlusion and 25% spatial translation than all three baselines. A series of falsification ablations - zeroing relational tokens at inference and retraining without them entirely - shows that the architecture's pairwise relational computation, while present, is not the primary driver of its performance; the content-adaptive patch locator is. We report this honestly, together with a capacity sweep showing a genuine accuracy plateau near 22-35k parameters, and release full seed-level results and checkpoint hashes for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种超轻量（22,249–34,917 参数）的空间关系架构，用于少样本图像分类，结合固定 Gabor 边缘能量引导与窗口化内容自适应图块定位器。在严格匹配的 iso-episode 预算下，该方法在 CIFAR-FS 和 MiniImageNet 上稳定优于 Prototypical Networks、Relation Networks 和 MAML，且参数更少、收敛更快、泛化与鲁棒性更好。消融显示成对关系计算并非主要性能来源，内容自适应图块定位器才是关键。
AI.motivation: 少样本学习研究主要只评估准确率，较少关注达到该准确率所需的参数预算和训练样本预算；这对没有大规模算力的实践者构成现实约束。因此，本文关注在严格预算下实现高效少样本分类。
AI.method: 提出超轻量空间关系架构，融合固定 Gabor 边缘能量引导和窗口化内容自适应图块定位器。采用严格匹配的 iso-episode 预算协议：250 个元训练 episode、5 个标准随机种子、每个种子 600 个评估 episode。在 CIFAR-FS 和 MiniImageNet 上与 Prototypical Networks、Relation Networks、MAML 对比。进行证伪消融：推理时置零关系 token，以及完全去除关系 token 后重训练；并进行容量扫描。发布种子级结果和检查点哈希。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-FS 和 MiniImageNet 上，5-shot 准确率在全部五个种子上稳定优于三个基线，同时参数比任何基线少 27–53%。训练收敛所需 episode 更少；零重训练泛化到未见细粒度域 CUB-200-2011 鸟类更好；对 50% 遮挡和 25% 空间平移更鲁棒。消融表明成对关系计算虽存在，但不是性能主要驱动因素，内容自适应图块定位器才是。容量扫描显示在约 22–35k 参数附近存在真实准确率平台。
AI.conclusion: 在严格参数和训练样本预算下，超轻量空间关系架构结合内容自适应图块定位器可实现强少样本分类性能。成对关系计算并非主要收益来源，定位器更关键；作者如实报告这一点，并提供完整种子级结果与检查点哈希以支持可复现性。

title: Privacy Personalization Trade offs in LLMs: The Impact of Stylometric Signal Reduction on User-Specific Text Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the ability to generate user-specific text with high stylistic fidelity. However, the personal data that enables such personalization frequently embeds demographic, cultural, and stylistic markers that raises concerns about stylometric re- identification. This paper investigates whether reducing identifiable stylistic signals affects personalization in text generation by LLMs. We introduce a controlled framework to isolate stylometric signals in LLM personalization using the LaMP-7 Twitter benchmark. Experiments on 250 sampled users compare two settings: paraphrasing conditioned on the original profile and paraphrasing conditioned on an anonymized converted profile in which demographic identifiers, cultural references, personal details, and informal linguistic cues have been systematically neutralized. Outputs are assessed by two independent LLM judges and a complementary human evaluation. Our pairwise evaluation shows that outputs conditioned on original profiles are nearly indistinguishable from human-authored ground truth, indicating that modern LLMs can closely reproduce an author's writing style with sufficient fidelity. In contrast, preference for model outputs with anonymized profiles drops to 13.0% on average, while semantic context preservation remains high at 94.8%. A study with human evaluators confirms the same pattern. These findings reveal a clear privacy-personalization trade-off and highlight the need for privacy-aware personalization methods that retain meaning while suppressing identifying stylistic signals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究降低可识别文体信号对LLM个性化文本生成的影响，基于LaMP-7 Twitter基准构建受控框架，比较原始画像与匿名化画像条件下的改写效果。
AI.motivation: LLM个性化生成依赖个人数据，但其中常含人口、文化、文体等可识别标记，引发文体计量重识别隐私担忧，因此需探究隐私与个性化之间的权衡。
AI.method: 使用LaMP-7 Twitter基准，抽取250名用户，设置两种条件：基于原始画像改写，以及基于系统中性化人口标识、文化引用、个人细节和非正式语言线索后的匿名画像改写；由两个独立LLM评判器和人工评估进行成对比较。
AI.result: 基于原始画像的输出与人类真实文本几乎难以区分，说明LLM能高保真复现作者风格；匿名画像下模型输出偏好平均降至13.0%，但语义上下文保持率仍达94.8%，人工评估结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示明显的隐私-个性化权衡，表明需要兼顾语义保持与抑制可识别文体信号的隐私感知个性化方法。

title: Toward Auditable and Calibrated AI for Dementia-Related Crash Severity Prediction: A Selective Deferral Framework to Support Human Review
comment: This is the author's preprint version of a paper accepted for presentation at HICSS 60 (Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences), 2027, Hawaii, USA. The final published version will appear in the official conference proceedings. Conference site: https://hicss.hawaii.edu/
summary: Public crash databases increasingly support automated safety analysis, but crash severity prediction remains difficult to translate into public-sector decision workflows when models are evaluated primarily as ordinary classifiers. This study reframes dementia-related crash severity modeling as a decision-aware triage problem in which a system must classify crashes into no-injury/property-damage-only (O), minor or moderate injury (BC), and fatal or severe injury (KA), while also controlling outcome leakage, reporting severe under-triage, calibrating confidence, and preserving every raw prediction for audit. Using 4,781 Texas crash records with structured fields and police narratives, we evaluate structured, narrative, fusion, calibrated fusion, BERT-family, and local large-language-model baselines under a stratified 70/15/15 split. In the reported split, leakage-controlled Gemma obtains the highest observed macro-F1 (0.545; 95% bootstrap CI [0.507, 0.583]). The best calibrated fusion model obtains macro-F1 of 0.522 and expected calibration error of 0.033. Selective deferral improves performance among cases retained for automatic classification. At 70% coverage, macro-F1 rises to 0.573 and severity cost falls to 0.577, while deferred cases are treated as candidates for a proposed human-review process and are not further evaluated in the present experiment. The study contributes a reproducible, leakage-controlled, and uncertainty-aware evaluation framework for crash AI systems, emphasizing auditability and selective deferral rather than accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究将痴呆相关交通事故严重程度预测重构为决策感知的分诊问题，在控制结局泄漏、校准置信度并保留所有原始预测以供审计的前提下，将事故分为O、BC、KA三类，并评估多种模型。
AI.motivation: 公共碰撞数据库日益支持自动化安全分析，但若模型仅按普通分类器评估，事故严重程度预测难以转化为公共部门决策流程；同时还需应对结局泄漏、严重漏诊、置信校准和可审计性等问题。
AI.method: 使用4,781条得州事故记录，结合结构化字段与警方叙述，按分层70/15/15划分数据，比较结构化、叙述、融合、校准融合、BERT族和本地大语言模型基线；引入泄漏控制、选择性推迟和不确定性感知评估。
AI.result: 在报告划分中，泄漏控制的Gemma取得最高宏观F1为0.545（95% bootstrap CI [0.507, 0.583]）；最佳校准融合模型宏观F1为0.522，期望校准误差为0.033。70%覆盖率时，宏观F1升至0.573，严重度成本降至0.577；被推迟案例作为人工复核候选，本实验未进一步评估。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了可复现、控制泄漏且不确定性感知的碰撞AI评估框架，强调可审计性和选择性推迟，而非仅追求准确率。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Surrogates with Polynomial Chaos-Based Uncertainty Propagation for Stochastic Model Predictive Control
summary: Stochastic partial differential equations (PDEs) govern critical engineering and geophysical systems but are challenging to use for real-time control under parametric uncertainty. We present a unified framework that couples Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) with Polynomial Chaos Expansion (PCE) to construct a fast and differentiable surrogate. The PCE representation enables analytical propagation of parametric uncertainty and computation of the corresponding moments without requiring Monte Carlo sampling. We provide an error decomposition for the PINN-PCE surrogate that separates PCE truncation, stochastic quadrature, and PINN approximation errors. Embedding this surrogate into a stochastic model predictive control (SMPC) scheme enables finite-horizon control updates based on analytic mean and covariance predictions. We further show how the surrogate approximation error can be incorporated into tightened probabilistic constraints. The approach is validated on three benchmarks: the Korteweg-de Vries equation, Burgers' equation, and the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, representing dispersive, convective, and convective-diffusive dynamics. Across all cases, the surrogate enables real-time control updates while maintaining prescribed risk levels and closely matching the corresponding high-fidelity solvers at substantially lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将物理信息神经网络（PINN）与多项式混沌展开（PCE）耦合，构建快速且可微的随机偏微分方程代理模型，并嵌入随机模型预测控制（SMPC）中，实现参数不确定性下的实时控制。
AI.motivation: 随机偏微分方程在工程与地球物理系统中很重要，但在参数不确定性下进行实时控制仍很困难，传统方法计算成本高且难以满足实时性要求。
AI.method: 构建PINN-PCE统一代理框架：PCE用于解析传播参数不确定性并计算矩，无需蒙特卡洛采样；给出误差分解，分离PCE截断、随机求积和PINN近似误差；将代理嵌入SMPC，基于解析均值和协方差预测进行有限时域控制更新，并将代理误差纳入收紧的概率约束。
AI.result: 在Korteweg-de Vries方程、Burgers方程和二维不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程三个基准上验证，涵盖色散、对流和对流扩散动力学。代理模型能实现实时控制更新，保持规定风险水平，并以显著更低计算成本接近高保真求解器结果。
AI.conclusion: PINN与PCE耦合的代理模型为随机PDE的参数不确定性传播和实时控制提供了统一、高效且可微的框架，并可通过误差感知的概率约束保证控制安全性。

title: A Survey on the Linear Representation Hypothesis
summary: The term "linear representation hypothesis" (LRH) has appeared across diverse subfields of artificial intelligence, neuroscience, and cognitive science. But previous works have not consistently treated the LRH as a falsifiable scientific hypothesis; we analyze these inconsistencies and examine their implications for how prior theoretical and methodological results should be interpreted. Based on this analysis, we argue that claims regarding linear representations become well-defined only through careful examination of the model, representation location, feature definition, and evaluation dataset. We therefore propose a more rigorous formalization of the LRH that makes these dependencies explicit and allows the hypothesis to be evaluated as a falsifiable scientific claim. Finally, we identify some non-trivial open problems that warrant further attention from the research community.

AI.tldr: 本文分析“线性表示假说”（LRH）在不同领域中的不一致用法，主张只有明确模型、表示位置、特征定义和评估数据集后，该假说才可被检验，并提出更严格的LRH形式化。
AI.motivation: LRH在人工智能、神经科学和认知科学中广泛出现，但既有工作未一致地将其作为可证伪的科学假说来处理，导致理论和方法的解释存在混乱。
AI.method: 通过分析先前工作中对LRH的不一致处理及其影响，提出一个显式包含模型、表示位置、特征定义和评估数据集等依赖条件的严格形式化框架。
AI.result: 论文指出线性表示相关主张只有在明确上述四个要素时才定义良好，并给出了使LRH可作为可证伪科学主张进行评估的形式化方案，同时识别出若干非平凡开放问题。
AI.conclusion: LRH需要更严谨的表述和检验标准；未来研究应关注其依赖条件及所提出的开放问题，以推动该假说的科学评估。

title: Disparity Estimation of Planar Reflective Surfaces Using Specular Reflections From a Single Light Source
summary: Multi-camera imaging and camera arrays have become ubiquitous in many applications, such as autonomous driving, robot control, or virtual reality, and accurate disparity maps of objects and their environment are essential for reliable operation. Despite recent advances in neural networks, correctly estimating the disparity of flat and textureless objects remains challenging. In particular, we consider a scenario defined by flat, textureless surfaces illuminated by a single fixed light source, resulting in one dominant specular reflection visible on the object surface. Under these conditions, reliable geometric and photometric cues are missing, and the specular reflection often causes mispredictions, especially when using conventional methods that rely on texture information to match corresponding pixels. To address this issue, the novel Specular Reflection Disparity Estimation SRDE algorithm is introduced, which is specifically designed for the constrained scenario of planar, textureless objects and single-source illumination. Unlike conventional stereo matching methods, SRDE ignores texture and instead leverages the geometric properties of specular reflections by incorporating the position information of the reflective region, the light source, and the camera setup. We show that SRDE outperforms existing methods by a notable margin, achieving more than a 52% improvement in End Point Error on synthetic images. Further tests demonstrate superior performance on real-world data. Furthermore, we integrate SRDE into existing neural disparity estimation pipelines by selectively replacing predictions in specular regions without modifying the backbone model. This hybrid strategy enables additional performance gains without requiring network retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文针对平面、无纹理且在单光源下产生主导镜面反射的物体，提出SRDE算法来估计视差，并在合成和真实数据上取得优于现有方法的效果，还可嵌入现有神经视差估计流程以进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 多相机成像和相机阵列在自动驾驶、机器人控制、虚拟现实等应用中很常见，准确视差图对可靠运行至关重要。但在平面、无纹理表面且仅由单一固定光源照明时，纹理和光度线索缺失，镜面反射会导致传统依赖纹理匹配的方法出现误预测。
AI.method: 提出Specular Reflection Disparity Estimation（SRDE）算法，专门针对平面、无纹理物体和单光源照明场景。与常规立体匹配不同，SRDE忽略纹理，利用镜面反射的几何特性，结合反射区域、光源和相机设置的位置信息进行视差估计。此外，将SRDE集成到现有神经视差估计流程中，在不修改主干网络的情况下选择性替换镜面区域的预测。
AI.result: SRDE在合成图像上的端点误差（EPE）相比现有方法提升超过52%，在真实数据上也表现更优。将其嵌入现有神经视差估计流程后，无需重新训练网络即可获得额外性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 对于平面、无纹理且存在单光源镜面反射的场景，利用反射几何信息而非纹理可以有效且准确地估计视差；SRDE不仅能独立取得领先性能，还能作为即插即用模块增强现有神经视差估计方法。

title: REBOOT: From Failure to Recovery - A Dataset and Benchmark for Precision Assembly
summary: Robot learning policies fail in characteristic ways: they stall in uncertain states, drift during contact-rich alignment, and miss targets by millimetres in precision tasks. Yet training datasets consist largely of successful demonstrations, while real-world benchmarks often reduce performance to binary success. This limits both supervision for recovery and analysis of where failures occur. We introduce REBOOT (Recovery Episode Benchmark for Off-nominal Trajectories), the first robot manipulation benchmark designed around failure as a first-class signal. REBOOT contains 2,160 demonstrations across 18 precision assembly tasks, each decomposed into five shared phases: Align(pick), Engage(pick), Transport, Align(place), and Engage(place), enabling phase-level evaluation beyond terminal success. Failures are introduced across phases and paired with expert recovery trajectories that return the system to a valid continuation state. Tasks are annotated with rotational symmetry, engagement-clearance precision tier, and assembly direction through matched install-remove pairs. Failure episodes are labeled by phase and categorical failure mode, enabling attribution to kinematic stage and tolerance violation. Data includes synchronized RGB-D observations from four viewpoints and grounded natural-language descriptions of phase-level success and failure conditions. Half the dataset contains expert demonstrations; the other half contains recovery demonstrations sampled to reflect failures observed in imitation-learned policy rollouts. We benchmark action-chunked transformer, diffusion, and $π_0$-FAST policies using phase-level completion rates, revealing model-specific failure points hidden by binary evaluation. Dataset and code: https://nanayawoa.github.io/REBOOT

AI.tldr: 本文提出了REBOOT，首个以失败为一等信号的机器人操作基准，包含2160个演示、18个精密装配任务，每个任务分解为五个阶段，并引入失败与专家恢复轨迹，用于阶段级评估。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习策略在不确定状态停滞、接触对齐漂移、精密任务中毫米级偏差等典型失败，但训练数据多为成功演示，基准也常仅以二元成功评估，限制了对恢复的监督和失败分析。
AI.method: 构建REBOOT基准，包含18个精密装配任务，每个任务分解为Align(pick)、Engage(pick)、Transport、Align(place)、Engage(place)五个阶段；在阶段中注入失败并配对专家恢复轨迹；标注旋转对称性、啮合间隙精度等级、安装-移除方向；失败按阶段和类别模式标注；收集四视角同步RGB-D和自然语言描述；数据集一半为专家演示，一半为从模仿学习策略rollout中采样的恢复演示；在阶段级完成率上评估action-chunked transformer、diffusion和π0-FAST策略。
AI.result: REBOOT包含2160个演示，覆盖18个任务；通过阶段级完成率评估，揭示了二元评估所隐藏的模型特定失败点。
AI.conclusion: 以失败为一等信号并采用阶段级评估，能更好地分析机器人操作失败并监督恢复，REBOOT基准为超越终端成功率的评估提供了新范式。

title: Characterizing Wildlife Response to Biomimetic and Conventional Underwater Vehicles
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) are a promising alternative to divers for scalable collection of natural ocean ecology data. However, these robots may disturb local fauna and cause drastic behavioral differences compared to other monitoring techniques, decreasing their value as scientific tools. A promising prospect is to make AUVs that are more biomimetic, with the hope that taking on the form and behavior of a non-predatory animal may reduce adverse responses. We present the first dataset comparing fish disturbance in response to a conventional thruster-driven AUV, a sea turtle inspired flipper-driven AUV, and a diver. Experiments were conducted at a biodiversity hotspot in a Caribbean reef, and images of the scene were analyzed using computer vision to localize and study fish behavior change. Both AUVs cause measurable changes in fish behavior. Although no between-robot differences remain significant after correction for multiple comparisons, point estimates generally favor the biomimetic AUV, motivating larger studies capable of resolving modest effects and further design changes to optimize for disturbance. We also observe larger responses during diver transects than during AUV transects, although this exploratory comparison is based on a small diver sample with several confounds. While conclusions must be taken as preliminary due to operational and experimental limitations, this study provides the community with a first known dataset and benchmarks to quantify the behavioral impacts of biomimetic robots for ecological monitoring in the wild.

AI.tldr: 首次比较传统推进器AUV、仿海龟鳍肢驱动AUV和潜水员对鱼类行为的扰动，并用计算机视觉分析加勒比珊瑚礁中的鱼类行为变化。两种AUV均引起可测行为改变；校正多重比较后机器人间差异不显著，但点估计总体偏向仿生AUV；潜水员样带反应更大，但样本小且存在混杂。结论属初步。
AI.motivation: AUV有望替代潜水员规模化采集海洋生态数据，但可能干扰当地鱼类并造成显著行为差异，降低其作为科学工具的价值。仿生外形与行为或可减少不利反应，因此需要量化比较不同监测方式对鱼类的扰动。
AI.method: 在加勒比珊瑚礁生物多样性热点开展实验，对比常规推进器驱动AUV、海龟启发扑翼驱动AUV和潜水员；采集场景图像并用计算机视觉定位和分析鱼类行为变化。
AI.result: 两种AUV均导致可测量的鱼类行为变化。虽然多重比较校正后，两机器人之间的差异不再显著，但点估计总体更支持仿生AUV。潜水员样带中的反应更大，但该探索性比较样本量小且存在若干混杂因素。
AI.conclusion: 受操作与实验限制，结论应视为初步。该研究提供了首个已知数据集和基准，用于量化仿生机器人在野外生态监测中对行为的影响，并推动更大规模研究和进一步优化设计以减少扰动。

title: Composite Adaptive Higher-Order Control Barrier Functions for Joint Frequency-RoCoF Safety in Low-Inertia SIDS Microgrids
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, code available at https://github.com/sramharack/caribcon26-joint-safety-vsg. Accepted to 2026 IEEE Caribbean Conference (CaribCon) - Track 3 - Smart Systems, Robotics, and Automation
summary: Small Island Developing States (SIDS) face simultaneous frequency nadir and rate-of-change-of-frequency (RoCoF) violations under high renewable penetration. This paper proposes a \emph{Composite Adaptive Higher-Order Control Barrier Function} (CA-HOCBF) for BESS-coupled virtual synchronous generators that jointly enforces IEEE~1547 frequency ($\pm0.8$\,Hz) and ENTSO-E RoCoF ($\pm1$\,Hz/s) limits as hard safety constraints under parametric uncertainty. The method unifies three tools: (i)~a dual barrier architecture with a zeroing CBF for frequency and an algebraic RoCoF constraint with a robust inertia-floor fallback; (ii)~a composite energy function coupling logarithmic safety barriers with quadratic parameter and disturbance error terms, which drives safety-weighted adaptation; and (iii)~a disturbance observer integrated into the barrier dynamics. We prove that the closed-form QP is always feasible under a BESS capacity condition and, under explicitly stated assumptions, that the composite energy remains finite along trajectories, rendering the joint safe set forward invariant \emph{without requiring parameter convergence}. Simulation on a 10\,MW Caribbean microgrid ($H=2$\,s, 70\% renewables) shows the CA-HOCBF eliminates all frequency and RoCoF violations under a compound disturbance, achieving steady-state error of 0.001\,Hz and RoCoF of 0.50\,Hz/s, where fixed-gain VSGs suffer a 0.62\,Hz offset with 2.25\,Hz/s RoCoF violations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对小岛屿发展中国家高比例可再生能源下频率最低点与RoCoF越限问题，提出一种用于BESS耦合虚拟同步发电机的复合自适应高阶控制屏障函数（CA-HOCBF），将IEEE 1547频率约束和ENTSO-E RoCoF约束作为硬安全约束，并在参数不确定性下保证联合安全集前向不变。
AI.motivation: 小岛屿发展中国家电网规模小、惯量低，高可再生能源渗透率下易同时出现频率最低点和RoCoF越限，传统固定增益虚拟同步机难以在参数不确定性下同时硬约束频率与RoCoF。
AI.method: 提出CA-HOCBF，统一三项工具：双屏障架构，频率采用归零CBF，RoCoF采用代数约束并配备鲁棒惯量下限回退；构造复合能量函数，将对数安全屏障与二次参数/扰动误差项耦合，实现安全加权自适应；引入扰动观测器并嵌入屏障动态。同时证明在BESS容量条件下QP始终可行，并在给定假设下复合能量沿轨迹有限，从而无需参数收敛即可保证联合安全集前向不变。
AI.result: 在10 MW加勒比微电网（H=2 s，70%可再生能源）仿真中，CA-HOCBF在复合扰动下消除所有频率和RoCoF越限，稳态误差0.001 Hz、RoCoF为0.50 Hz/s；固定增益VSG则出现0.62 Hz偏移和2.25 Hz/s的RoCoF越限。
AI.conclusion: CA-HOCBF能够在不要求参数收敛的情况下，将频率和RoCoF约束作为硬安全约束同时满足，显著优于固定增益VSG，适用于高可再生能源渗透的小岛屿微电网频率安全控制。

title: Hierarchical Aggregation of Semantic Uncertainty in 3D Scene Graphs
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) ground each object node in a vision-language embedding, yet they record every entry as equally certain, so a robot querying the map cannot tell which of its entries are unreliable. Estimators of semantic uncertainty could supply that distinction, but they require repeated sampling of a model, training, or held-out labels, none of which are available to a deployed system at query time. We present a framework that exploits the detector confidence and the embeddings a 3DSG already stores, converts them into a probability that an entry is correct, and propagates that probability through the containment hierarchy into a belief that a room contains a queried class. Four signals, each paired with the object-level error it indicates, are converted to probabilities at the logit scale learned by the vision-language model and combined in closed form with no additional perception or training. Objects sharing a detector and a vocabulary fail together, so the framework aggregates them in the fully correlated limit, where an aggregation under independence would treat one repeated error as repeated evidence. Evaluated on HM3DSem against a state-of-the-art 3DSG system, the framework improves object retrieval and lowers the error of the room-level assertions of the graph it reads.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需额外训练或采样的框架，利用3DSG已有的检测器置信度和视觉语言嵌入，估计条目正确概率并沿包含层次传播，从而判断房间是否包含查询类别，提升检索并降低房间级断言错误。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇3D场景图将所有条目视为同等确定，机器人无法区分不可靠条目；而语义不确定性估计方法需要重复采样、训练或留出标签，部署时不可用。
AI.method: 利用检测器置信度和VLM嵌入，将四种信号转换为logit尺度上的正确概率，在完全相关极限下聚合（因共享检测器和词汇的对象会同时失败），并通过包含层次传播概率。
AI.result: 在HM3DSem数据集上对比最先进的3DSG系统，改进了对象检索性能，并降低了所读取图在房间级断言上的错误。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效估计3DSG条目的可靠性，无需额外感知或训练，提升了下游查询任务的准确性。

title: VT-Bridge: Bridging Pretrained Foundation VLAs to VTLAs via Lightweight Residual Adaptation
summary: Vision-Tactile-Language-Action (VTLA) models have demonstrated clear advantages over Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in contact-rich manipulation. However, developing VTLA models is severely constrained by the massive amounts of vision-tactile data and computational resources required. To address this bottleneck, we propose VT-Bridge, a lightweight residual adaptation strategy that bridges pretrained foundation VLAs to VTLAs. Rather than training a VTLA model from scratch or modifying the original architecture of a pretrained VLA, VT-Bridge employs an identical lightweight residual-adapter architecture across VLA backbones and uses backbone-specific weights to refine actions at the robot execution frequency. This design substantially lowers the data and training barriers. Specifically, it requires up to 50 vision-tactile demonstrations per task to fine-tune a VLA backbone and train a 0.98M-parameter residual adapter. Experiments with three representative VLA backbones ($π_0$, $π_{0.5}$, and SmolVLA) across four contact-rich manipulation tasks further demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across VLA architectures. On average, VT-Bridge raises the task completion rate from 11.7% with task-level VLA fine-tuning alone to 62.9%. Together, these findings demonstrate the broad applicability, effectiveness, and accessibility of VT-Bridge for contact-rich manipulation. The project page is available at https://hoxnocha.github.io/vt-bridge-web/.

AI.tldr: VT-Bridge 是一种轻量级残差适配策略，可将预训练的基础 VLA 模型桥接为 VTLA 模型，仅需少量视觉-触觉演示和 0.98M 参数适配器，就能显著提升接触丰富操作任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: VTLA 模型在接触丰富操作中明显优于 VLA 模型，但开发 VTLA 需要大量视觉-触觉数据和计算资源，存在严重瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 VT-Bridge，在不同 VLA 主干上采用相同的轻量级残差适配器架构，并使用主干特定权重以机器人执行频率细化动作。每个任务仅需最多 50 个视觉-触觉演示来微调 VLA 主干并训练 0.98M 参数的残差适配器。在 π0、π0.5 和 SmolVLA 三个代表性 VLA 主干及四个接触丰富操作任务上进行了实验。
AI.result: 平均任务完成率从仅任务级 VLA 微调的 11.7% 提升至 62.9%，并在不同 VLA 架构上表现一致有效。
AI.conclusion: VT-Bridge 在接触丰富操作中具有广泛的适用性、有效性和可及性。

title: Evaluation Awareness Shifts from Format to Context with Model Scale
summary: Evaluation awareness poses an unprecedented threat to model evaluation, but the mechanisms by which models detect it remain unknown. This study focuses on determining this and identifying contrasting mechanisms between smaller and larger models. While smaller models use the prompt's format sensitivity to detect evaluation, larger models often rely on higher-order reasoning to detect it. We evaluated Gemma 3 (1B, 4B, and 12B), Phi-3 (Mini and Medium), and Llama-3 8B using Chain-of-Thought analysis, representation probing, and Integrated Gradients attribution. Motivated by these findings, we propose a dual-pathway intervention that combines prompt sanitization with activation counter-steering to suppress both external evaluation triggers and their internal representations. Across 200 highly evaluation-aware prompts, our method achieves an average behavioral flip rate of 70.58\%, consistently outperforming either intervention alone. These results provide new insights into how evaluation awareness develops in compact language models and suggest that effective mitigation requires jointly addressing both prompt-level and representation-level signals.Datasets and codebase can be found in this \href{https://github.com/chahal-navi/Evaluation-Awareness-Compact-LLMs/tree/main}{Github Repository.}

AI.tldr: 该研究探究紧凑型语言模型如何检测评估情境，发现小模型与大模型采用不同机制，并提出结合提示清洗与激活反引导的双路径干预方法。
AI.motivation: 评估意识对模型评测构成前所未有的威胁，但模型检测评估的机制尚不清楚，尤其是较小与较大模型之间机制差异未知。
AI.method: 评估 Gemma 3（1B、4B、12B）、Phi-3（Mini、Medium）和 Llama-3 8B，使用思维链分析、表征探针和 Integrated Gradients 归因；并提出结合提示清洗与激活反引导的双路径干预。
AI.result: 较小模型常依赖提示格式敏感性检测评估，较大模型更多依赖高阶推理；在 200 个高评估意识提示上，干预方法平均行为翻转率达 70.58%，持续优于单一干预。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了紧凑型语言模型中评估意识的发展机制，并表明有效缓解需同时处理提示层与表征层信号。

title: An Empirical Cost Attribution of Context-Compression Gateways in Multi-Turn Coding Agents
summary: Context compression is widely proposed as a way to cut the token bill of LLM coding agents, and public benchmarks report that aggressive compression preserves task-solving quality. These two facts do not imply the third one commonly assumed: that compressing file reads saves money in a real multi-turn agent. We instrument a production compression gateway (Paritok) between coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet, GPT-5), and decompose the token bill of real sessions into three independent levers: tool-schema filtering, content compression of file reads and tool output, and history summarization. Measured in isolation under controlled A/B runs, the three save at fundamentally different rates. Tool-schema filtering removes a fixed block every turn, roughly 21K-57K tokens on a typical turn; it is linear in the turn count N and the only unambiguously and reproducibly positive lever. Content compression saves only about 2% of the cache-priced prefix per turn, but compressed reads accumulate in history and are re-sent on every later turn, so its cumulative saving grows quadratically, about 3350*N^2 tokens (measured), overtaking the fixed tool-filter saving within roughly 6 turns until the context window caps it. A non-destructive gateway lets the agent pull original bytes back on demand; each recall re-sends exactly the one segment just compressed away, so its cost is fixed and bounded rather than a multiplicative blowup, and heavy recall spends the accumulated saving back one segment at a time. Finally, a strong single-shot compression benchmark - 86.5% of SWE-bench quality retained at a 25.7% compression rate, achieved by the model this gateway deploys (Paritok-4B, reported separately) - is orthogonal to multi-turn agent cost and must not be cited as a cost-saving argument. We distill the results into an actionable recipe for where token-saving effort pays off.

AI.tldr: 论文通过生产级压缩网关Paritok，在编码代理与前沿LLM之间测量真实多轮会话的token账单，分解工具schema过滤、内容压缩、历史摘要三种独立节省杠杆，发现其节省速率完全不同，并指出单次压缩基准与多轮代理成本正交。
AI.motivation: 公共基准常声称激进上下文压缩能保持任务质量，但这不能推出“压缩文件读取就能在真实多轮代理中省钱”。研究旨在澄清并量化真实多轮编码代理场景下的token成本节省来源。
