AI.result: 近期LLM与专家编码者的一致率与专家彼此之间相当，二者在标注质量上可视为观察等价；当LLM与专家分歧时，专家彼此也更易分歧；澄清编码规则可同时减少专家和有足够能力LLM的分歧。因此仅以标注质量为由偏好人类编码缺乏实证依据，而LLM在速度和成本上有明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 文本标注的核心挑战已从选择人类还是机器编码者，转为制定最小化模糊性的编码规则并处理不可避免的残余模糊性；应利用多LLM分歧辅助识别困难案例、优化码本，并在无法为每段文本定义唯一标注时采用模糊性感知的下游推断边界。

title: Partial-Scan-and-Move Source Seeking for Mobile Robots
summary: This paper presents a partial-scan-and-move strategy for source seeking with a mobile robot equipped with an offset scalar sensor. At each robot position, the sensor collects source field measurements while the robot rotates. Instead of requiring a complete circular scan before every move, we ask when the measurements collected over only part of the circle are already sufficient to determine the next action. We develop a gradient estimation method for partial scans together with a confidence set that accounts for measurement noise and local field variation. The robot uses this confidence set to decide whether it is close enough to the source or has enough information to move in a descent direction. We show that, under suitable conditions, each decision can be made within a prescribed partial scan and that the robot reaches a desired neighborhood of the source in finitely many moves with high probability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种部分扫描并移动的源搜寻策略，使搭载偏移标量传感器的移动机器人无需每次完整圆周扫描即可判断下一步动作，并最终以高概率到达源附近。
AI.motivation: 传统源搜寻通常需要机器人每次移动前完成完整圆周扫描以获取足够信息，效率较低。本文旨在研究仅利用部分圆周测量是否已足以确定下一步动作。
AI.method: 针对部分扫描开发了梯度估计方法，并构建置信集以处理测量噪声和局部场变化；机器人利用该置信集判断是否已接近源，或是否已有足够信息沿下降方向移动。
AI.result: 在适当条件下，每次决策可在规定的部分扫描范围内完成，并且机器人能在有限步移动内以高概率到达源的目标邻域。
AI.conclusion: 部分扫描结合置信集决策可有效替代完整圆周扫描，实现高效且具有概率保证的源搜寻。

title: ISA-Bench: A Benchmark for Computational Reasoning Across Instruction Set Architectures
summary: Large language model code generation benchmarks primarily evaluate well-resourced languages like Python and Java, where models benefit from abundant training data. They provide limited evidence about reasoning in unfamiliar computational models: deriving arithmetic from a single subtract instruction, coordinating parallel programs across communicating nodes, or wiring logic gates into circuits. We present ISA-Bench, a benchmark of programming games with constrained instruction sets. For each game we provide a full execution stack (parser, VM, and verifier), enabling automated evaluation with structured feedback for iterative refinement. Reasoning models achieve higher average solve rates than code-specialized and general-purpose models, but unfamiliar syntax remains a major source of failure. Models solve more tasks with iterative feedback, though the gains vary substantially across architectures. We introduce a reasoning--execution gap (REG) analysis that reveals a recurring disconnect between identifying a plausible computational strategy and expressing it as a correct program in the target ISA. Code is open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了ISA-Bench，一个基于受限指令集的编程游戏基准，用于评估大语言模型在陌生计算模型中的代码生成与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准主要评估Python、Java等资源丰富语言，模型受益于大量训练数据，无法提供在陌生计算模型中推理的证据，如从单条减法指令推导算术、协调并行程序、将逻辑门连接成电路。
AI.method: 构建ISA-Bench基准，包含受限指令集的编程游戏；为每个游戏提供完整执行栈（解析器、虚拟机、验证器），支持自动化评估和迭代优化的结构化反馈；引入推理-执行差距（REG）分析。
AI.result: 推理模型平均解决率高于代码专用和通用模型，但陌生语法仍是主要失败来源；迭代反馈能提升模型解决任务数量，但不同架构提升幅度差异大；REG分析揭示了识别可行计算策略与将其表达为目标ISA正确程序之间的脱节。
AI.conclusion: ISA-Bench为评估模型在陌生计算模型中的推理提供新基准，表明模型在策略识别与程序表达间存在持续差距，代码已开源。

title: DiFA: Dual Evidence Fusion and Aggregation for Token-Level Text Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted by ICDM 2026. 10 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables
summary: Text anomaly detection, the task of identifying text instances that deviate from normal language patterns, is crucial for language-driven applications. However, most existing methods can only perform document-level anomaly detection, making it hard to locate harmful phrases or support targeted prevention. Recently, there has been an emerging trend toward token-level text anomaly detection, which aims to address the above limitation by identifying anomalous words or fragments within a document. Nevertheless, one representative method mainly relies on representation-space distance measurement, neglecting the complementary roles of different anomaly cues in capturing diverse abnormal patterns. To bridge the gaps, we propose a Dual-evidence framework with adaptive Fusion and Aggregation (DiFA) for token-level anomaly detection. DiFA derives anomaly scores from form-structural and semantic views to capture visible structural abnormality and contextual inconsistency, respectively, thereby providing complementary evidence for identifying diverse anomalies. To combine these two scores with varying numerical scales, DiFA incorporates a calibration and fusion mechanism to adaptively balance the two views. Moreover, to obtain a discriminative document-level score, a multivariate aggregation method is designed to summarize token-level anomaly scores from multiple perspectives, preventing rare anomalous tokens from being diluted. Extensive experiments across various text anomaly detection benchmarks demonstrate that DiFA consistently achieves top performance while maintaining strong efficiency, robustness, and interpretability. The code and scripts are available at: https://github.com/qyy11-com/DiFA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用于 token 级文本异常检测的双证据框架 DiFA，通过形式结构和语义两种视角生成异常分数，并自适应融合与多变量聚合，以提升检测性能和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本异常检测大多只能进行文档级检测，难以定位有害短语或支持针对性预防。新兴的 token 级检测方法多依赖表示空间距离，忽略了不同异常线索在捕捉多样异常模式中的互补作用。
AI.method: 提出 DiFA 框架：从形式结构视角和语义视角分别导出异常分数，捕捉可见结构异常与上下文不一致；设计校准与融合机制，自适应平衡两种不同数值尺度的分数；采用多变量聚合方法，从多个角度汇总 token 级异常分数，得到具有判别力的文档级分数，避免稀有异常 token 被稀释。
AI.result: 在多个文本异常检测基准上，DiFA 持续取得最优性能，同时保持较强的效率、鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: DiFA 通过双证据融合与聚合有效提升了 token 级文本异常检测能力，并能兼顾文档级判别，为文本异常检测提供了更全面且可解释的方案。

title: Seeing is not Enough: Vision-Language Models Perceive Evidence but Fail to Act
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) perform strongly on visual question answering benchmarks, yet often make decisions that contradict visual evidence they have already identified correctly. We distinguish perceptual failure, where relevant evidence is not recognized, from process failure, where recognized evidence fails to constrain the final decision. We introduce VPAC-Bench, a benchmark spanning nine real-image process families, with each image annotated by its current activity stage and nearby stage transition. We also propose State-Relevance-Target (SRT), a family of structured process-prior interventions that requires models to connect visible evidence to the relevant process state before answering. Across multiple VLMs, process failure is widespread: models that correctly enumerate visual candidates still over-commit to a single answer in more than 95% of ambiguous cases. An explicit process-structured intervention reduces this rate to below 13% without degrading performance on unambiguous cases. However, the transfer of process priors is model-dependent, and generic SRT does not consistently outperform strong chain-of-thought baselines. When the relevant stage transition is known, boundary-aligned SRT substantially outperforms generic process prompting and all tested chain-of-thought baselines across assembly, physical state transition, navigation and traffic, and object-use affordance tasks. These results show that process priors are most useful when aligned with the scene's specific decision boundary, motivating boundary-aware prior selection for process-grounded visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文区分了视觉语言模型在视觉问答中的感知失败与过程失败，并提出 VPAC-Bench 基准和 State-Relevance-Target (SRT) 过程先验干预方法。结果表明过程失败普遍存在，显式过程结构化干预能大幅降低过度承诺，但过程先验的迁移依赖模型，且只有当先验与具体决策边界对齐时效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在视觉问答基准上表现很强，但常做出与其已正确识别出的视觉证据相矛盾的决策。作者将这种失败区分为感知失败（未识别相关证据）和过程失败（已识别证据未能约束最终决策），并希望针对后者展开研究。
AI.method: 提出 VPAC-Bench，覆盖九个真实图像过程家族，每张图标注当前活动阶段及邻近阶段转换；提出 State-Relevance-Target (SRT) 系列结构化过程先验干预，要求模型在回答前将可见证据与相关过程状态联系起来；并进一步提出 boundary-aligned SRT，在已知相关阶段转换时进行边界对齐干预。
AI.result: 在多个 VLM 上，过程失败广泛存在：即便正确枚举视觉候选，模型在超过 95% 的模糊案例中仍过度承诺单一答案。显式过程结构化干预将该比例降至 13% 以下，且不损害非模糊案例性能。但过程先验迁移依赖模型，通用 SRT 未稳定优于强链式思考基线。当相关阶段转换已知时，边界对齐 SRT 在装配、物理状态转换、导航与交通、物体使用可供性等任务上显著优于通用过程提示和所有测试的链式思考基线。
AI.conclusion: 过程先验在与场景特定决策边界对齐时最有用，因此应推动边界感知的先验选择，以实现基于过程的视觉推理。

title: X-Beat: An Explainable Framework for ECG Image Classification
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Data Quality Aware, High-Performance, and Trustworthy AI Systems for Healthcare at IEEE/ACM CHASE 2026
summary: Accurate automated interpretation of electrocardio- grams (ECGs) is essential for early detection of cardiac condi- tions such as myocardial infarction and rhythm abnormalities. However, many high-performing deep learning models remain difficult to deploy in clinical settings due to limited transparency and lack of reliability validation. In this work, we present X- Beat, an explainable and reliability-aware benchmark framework for ECG image classification designed to support trustworthy AI systems in healthcare. The proposed framework combines transfer learning with post-hoc explainability and systematic reliability evaluation across four cardiac classes: Abnormal Heartbeat, History of Myocardial Infarction, Myocardial In- farction, and Normal Heartbeat. Multiple ImageNet-pretrained CNN backbones, including EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50, DenseNet- 121, and MobileNetV3-Large, are evaluated under a unified training protocol. Beyond standard performance metrics, we incorporate Grad-CAM-based visual explanations together with additional analyses, including explanation stability, regional sen- sitivity, and confidence-based reliability assessment, to examine whether model predictions are supported by clinically meaningful evidence. Experimental results show that ResNet-50 achieves the best performance, reaching 91.94% accuracy and a macro F1- score of 0.9098, with strong class separability (AUC up to 0.995). Explanation analyses indicate that the model primarily focuses on waveform-relevant regions, while reliability evaluation suggests that most incorrect predictions occur with lower confidence. Overall, this work provides a structured and reproducible bench- mark for evaluating both predictive performance and explanation reliability in ECG image classification, contributing toward the development of trustworthy and interpretable AI components for clinical decision support systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 X-Beat，一个面向 ECG 图像分类的可解释且可靠性感知的基准框架，结合迁移学习、Grad-CAM 事后解释和系统性可靠性评估，在四类心脏状态上比较多种 CNN 主干，并验证 ResNet-50 的性能与解释可靠性。
AI.motivation: 自动 ECG 解读对心肌梗死和心律异常等心脏疾病的早期检测很重要，但许多高性能深度学习模型因透明度不足和缺乏可靠性验证而难以在临床部署，因此需要可信、可解释且可复现的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建 X-Beat 基准框架：采用 ImageNet 预训练的 EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50、DenseNet-121、MobileNetV3-Large，在统一训练协议下进行迁移学习；针对 Abnormal Heartbeat、History of Myocardial Infarction、Myocardial Infarction、Normal Heartbeat 四类进行分类；除标准性能指标外，引入 Grad-CAM 视觉解释，并分析解释稳定性、区域敏感性和基于置信度的可靠性。
AI.result: ResNet-50 表现最佳，达到 91.94% 准确率和 0.9098 的 macro F1 分数，类别可分性强，AUC 最高达 0.995；解释分析显示模型主要关注波形相关区域；可靠性评估表明多数错误预测发生在较低置信度下。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 ECG 图像分类提供了一个结构化、可复现的基准，可同时评估预测性能与解释可靠性，有助于推动临床决策支持系统中可信且可解释的 AI 组件发展。

title: A Direct Rigid Transmission 2-DoF Wrist Extension for Tendon-Driven Hand
comment: Accepted at "IROS 2026 Sensors and Actuators for Dexterous Manipulation Workshop"
summary: Dexterous manipulation in confined spaces requires local control of hand orientation. Without a wrist, a dexterous hand must obtain this local orientation through coordinated motion of the robot arm, often involving several joints and a more complex end-effector path. We present CRAFT-Wrist, a concentric 2-DoF wrist extension that mounts between a robot arm and the CRAFT Hand without modifying the hand. Two XC430-T240BB-T servos drive sideways and front-back rotation through short rigid transmissions. Our initial hardware prototype actuates both axes under load, achieving a demonstrated workspace of $\pm20^{\circ}$ in radial--ulnar deviation (left--right) and a front-back range of $+80^{\circ}$ in flexion and $-18^{\circ}$ in extension. We characterize the resulting finger-motor loading across several wrist postures and demonstrate how the wrist supplies local orientation in grasping, nail hammering, and blackboard wiping. Demonstrations and assembly instructions are available at https://craft-wrist.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出CRAFT-Wrist，一种安装在机械臂与CRAFT Hand之间的同心2自由度腕部扩展，无需修改手部即可为灵巧手提供局部姿态控制，并展示其在抓取、钉钉子和擦黑板等任务中的应用。
AI.motivation: 在受限空间中进行灵巧操作需要局部控制手部朝向；若没有腕部，灵巧手必须依赖机械臂多关节协调运动来获得局部朝向，导致末端执行器路径更复杂。
AI.method: 设计并制作CRAFT-Wrist硬件原型：同心2自由度腕部扩展，安装在机械臂与CRAFT Hand之间，不修改手部；由两个XC430-T240BB-T伺服电机通过短刚性传动驱动左右和前后旋转；在负载下驱动两轴，并表征不同腕部姿态下的手指-电机负载；演示抓取、钉钉子和擦黑板任务。
AI.result: 原型实现两轴带载驱动，工作空间为径向-尺偏（左右）±20°，前后范围为屈曲+80°、伸展-18°；完成手指-电机负载表征；在抓取、钉钉子和擦黑板中展示了腕部提供局部朝向的能力。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT-Wrist可在不修改CRAFT Hand的情况下为其提供局部手部朝向控制，有助于受限空间中的灵巧操作；演示与组装说明已公开。

title: Does the Truthfulness Signal Survive Code-Mixing? Probing Hidden States for Hallucination Detection in Hinglish
summary: Hidden-state hallucination probing - training a linear classifier on an LLM's internal activations to detect whether a generated answer is faithful to the input - is an active area of 2026 research, with recent work reporting 0.90-1.00 AUROC across several benchmarks and languages. However, none of this work has tested probes on code-mixed input, despite the fact that a huge population of chatbot users write in Hindi-English code-mixed text ("Hinglish"). We address this gap directly: does a hallucination probe trained on clean-language hidden states transfer to Hinglish, or does the signal degrade under code-mixing? We construct a 5,674-item Hindi/English/Hinglish QA benchmark, generate and label 17,022 model responses across three open-weight 7-8B LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B), extract per-layer hidden states at two token positions, and train linear and MLP probes for in-distribution detection and cross-lingual transfer. We find that the hallucination signal survives code-mixing well: transfer AUROC ranges from 0.88 to 0.99, with gaps of mostly under 0.05 AUROC relative to in-distribution performance, and that Hindi-trained probes transfer to Hinglish more reliably than English-trained probes. As an independent, practically motivated finding, all three models hallucinate substantially more on Hindi and Hinglish than on English for matched facts. We release our code and synthetic Hinglish QA dataset to support further work on code-mixed hallucination detection.

AI.tldr: 该研究将基于LLM隐藏状态的幻觉探针扩展到Hinglish代码混合输入，发现幻觉信号在跨语言迁移中保持稳健，且模型在印地语和Hinglish上比英语更容易产生幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有隐藏状态幻觉探测研究多在干净语言上报告高AUROC，但尚未测试代码混合输入；而大量聊天机器人用户使用Hindi-English混合的Hinglish，因此需要验证探针能否迁移到此类场景。
AI.method: 构建5,674条Hindi/English/Hinglish QA基准；使用Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B生成并标注17,022条模型响应；提取两个token位置的分层隐藏状态；训练线性和MLP探针，进行同分布检测与跨语言迁移评估。
AI.result: 幻觉信号在代码混合下仍可迁移，迁移AUROC为0.88至0.99，相比同分布性能差距大多低于0.05；Hindi训练的探针比English训练的探针更可靠地迁移到Hinglish；三个模型在Hindi和Hinglish上对匹配事实的幻觉均显著多于English。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏状态幻觉探针在Hinglish代码混合场景中具有较好的跨语言鲁棒性，支持进一步开展代码混合幻觉检测研究；作者发布了代码和合成Hinglish QA数据集。

title: When Should a VLM Look? Paying Only for Visual Calls That Were Needed and Used
comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Preprint under review
summary: Vision-language agents that crop and zoom are trained with rewards that credit a successful tool call, yet a successful call does not show that the model needed to look or used the pixels it received. On our cold-start checkpoint only 10% to 12% of visual calls were both needed and used, and released agents make spurious calls 36% to 87% of the time on individual benchmarks. Outcome rewards, judge rewards, and branch probes each observe one side of this failure, and about two thirds of what an outcome reward pays goes to calls that were neither needed nor used. CounterCredit asks both questions of every image-returning call at its realized pre-call state, using the policy's own gold-answer score. A decision value compares the realized visual branch with answering immediately; an evidence value compares the returned crop with random same-size patches substituted into the same call. A call verified on both earns cashback and every other executed call pays rent; the price is bounded so that every correct trajectory outranks every wrong one, and a dual-channel GRPO advantage keeps the price in its own units. From the same cold start, prompt pool, and budget, CounterCredit reaches 89.5% on V*, 80.2% on HR-Bench-4K, and 76.4% on HR-Bench-8K, 6.3 to 9.4 points above outcome-only GRPO at 1.78 against 1.84 calls per question, and lowers the spurious-call rate to 31% to 36%, the lowest among the agents evaluated. The same recipe lifts a Qwen3-VL-8B base from 75.4 to 80.8 on average.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CounterCredit，一种针对视觉语言智能体工具调用（裁剪、缩放）的信用分配方法，通过同时判断视觉调用是否必要以及返回图像是否被有效利用来训练智能体，从而提升准确率并显著降低虚假调用率。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励机制只奖励成功的工具调用，却无法说明模型是否真的需要看图像，以及是否利用了返回的像素。冷启动检查点中仅10%至12%的视觉调用既必要又被使用，而已发布智能体在部分基准上的虚假调用率高达36%至87%。结果奖励、评判奖励和分支探测都只能观察到该失败的一个侧面，且约三分之二的结果奖励被支付给了既不必要也未被使用的调用。
AI.method: CounterCredit 对每个返回图像的调用，在其真实的调用前状态上，使用策略自身的金答案分数同时回答两个问题：1）决策价值，比较执行视觉分支与立即回答；2）证据价值，比较返回的裁剪图像与随机同尺寸图像块替换到同一调用中的效果。只有同时通过两项验证的调用才能获得返现，其他已执行调用则需支付租金。租金价格被限制，使得所有正确轨迹的排名高于所有错误轨迹，并通过双通道 GRPO 优势保持价格在自身量纲内。
AI.result: 从相同冷启动、提示池和预算出发，CounterCredit 在 V* 上达到89.5%，在 HR-Bench-4K 上达到80.2%，在 HR-Bench-8K 上达到76.4%，比仅用结果奖励的 GRPO 高6.3至9.4个百分点，同时每问题调用数分别为1.78与1.84。虚假调用率降至31%至36%，在评估的智能体中最低。相同方法还将 Qwen3-VL-8B 基座模型的平均成绩从75.4提升至80.8。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭结果奖励无法区分必要且有效的视觉调用与虚假调用。CounterCredit 通过同时验证调用的必要性和证据使用情况，并进行有界定价与双通道优势优化，能够在几乎不增加调用次数的前提下显著提升视觉语言智能体的准确率，并有效抑制虚假工具调用。

title: StateMem: Single-State Residual Memory with Adaptive Inference for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Memory-dependent robotic manipulation often requires later actions to use information from earlier interactions. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies primarily rely on current observations, limiting historical information retention. Memory-augmented VLAs, such as MemoryVLA, address this limitation with external memory banks but require explicit storage and retrieval. To address these limitations, we propose StateMem, a single-state residual memory framework for VLA policies that uses prediction error to update a persistent memory token through low-rank residuals and to adaptively route cached prefixes. A training-free controller adjusts the routing threshold online, while fast correction compensates for stale prefix features during cache reuse. We evaluate StateMem on LIBERO, RoboMemArena, and real-world manipulation tasks. On LIBERO, StateMem achieves an average success rate of 97.6% and reduces the average VLM prefix refresh rate by 20.25% relative to full refresh. In the Occlusion category of RoboMemArena, StateMem achieves the best performance among single-VLA methods, reaching 21.8% Task Success Rate (TSR) and 44.3% Cumulative Success Rate (CSR). Across six real-world manipulation tasks, it achieves +21% in average success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出StateMem，一种用于VLA策略的单状态残差记忆框架，通过预测误差更新持久记忆令牌，并自适应路由缓存前缀，在多个基准和真实任务上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略主要依赖当前观测，限制了历史信息保留；记忆增强VLA（如MemoryVLA）使用外部记忆库但需要显式存储和检索，存在局限性。
AI.method: StateMem使用预测误差通过低秩残差更新持久记忆令牌，并自适应路由缓存前缀；训练无关控制器在线调整路由阈值；快速校正补偿缓存重用时的陈旧前缀特征。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上平均成功率97.6%，VLM前缀刷新率降低20.25%；在RoboMemArena的Occlusion类别中，单VLA方法最佳，TSR 21.8%，CSR 44.3%；在六个真实世界操作任务中平均成功率提升21%。
AI.conclusion: StateMem有效解决了记忆依赖操作中的历史信息保留问题，减少了计算开销，并在模拟和真实环境中表现出优越性能。

title: ConsistWorld: Evidence Routing for Consistent Multi-Agent World Models
summary: Autoregressive video world models enable temporally coherent generation for a single observer. Extending them to multiple agents requires consistency across independently controlled views and temporal gaps under causal streaming. We present ConsistWorld, a multi-agent world model that generates camera-controlled video streams of a static scene from one shared image. We formulate consistency as routing evidence from committed multi-agent history and concurrently generated peer views to the tokens being generated. Pose Conditioned Memory Retrieval selects relevant historical observations from all agents, recovering evidence beyond the recent context window. Visibility-Gated Peer Sharing regulates current peer information according to estimated historical coverage and current-view overlap. Together, they determine which historical observations enter the context and where concurrent peer information contributes, supporting long-term recall and coordinated exploration. Both mechanisms use camera geometry and maintain a bounded active context for a fixed agent count and retrieval budget. Experiments on evidence sharing cases and video length and agent number generalizations show that ConsistWorld achieves a strong cross-time and cross-agent consistency while preserving competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: ConsistWorld 是一个多智能体世界模型，可从一张共享图像生成多相机控制视频流，并在因果流式条件下保持跨时间与跨智能体的一致性。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频世界模型适合单观察者的时序连贯生成，但扩展到多智能体时，需要在独立控制的视图之间以及存在时间间隔时仍保持一致。
AI.method: 将一致性建模为从已提交的多智能体历史和并发生成的同伴视图中，向当前生成 token 路由证据。使用姿态条件记忆检索从所有智能体中选取相关历史观测，并用可见性门控同伴共享按历史覆盖率和当前视图重叠调节同伴信息。两者基于相机几何，并在固定智能体数和检索预算下维持有界活跃上下文。
AI.result: 在证据共享案例以及视频长度和智能体数量泛化实验中，ConsistWorld 实现了较强的跨时间和跨智能体一致性，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 该方法支持长期回忆和协同探索，为多智能体视频世界模型提供了一致性生成方案。

title: Beyond Linear Context: Graph-Guided Evidence Navigation for Long-Novel Reasoning with a Local 9B Language Model
comment: 10 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables. Code, graph data and an interactive demo: https://github.com/fuxiaoji/novel-graph-lab
summary: Long-context models read a novel the way a person reads a printout: one token after another, in narrative order, with the whole history competing for a fixed budget of attention. A detective does not work that way. They sort what happened when, and they keep a map of who relates to whom, so a clue from chapter one can meet a question asked at the end of the book. We test whether a frozen knowledge graph can give a small local model that same freedom. Thirty detective novels and 234 multiple-choice questions are answered by one fixed qwen3.5:9b reader under nine conditions: five graph routes, a recent-window baseline, whole-book compression, ordinary vector retrieval, and a question-only control. The strongest graph route reaches 53.85% (126/234) against 46.15% for the recent window, 51.28% for compression, 51.71% for vector retrieval and 40.17% for question-only. On the subset that no model can answer without the book, the graph route reaches 42.86%. None of the fifteen graph-baseline contrasts survives Holm correction, so we present the result as exploratory evidence about a design. Two structural findings survive scrutiny better than the headline number: annotated evidence concentrates in the topological core of these graphs (2.35x enrichment, pooled), and the two graph-building pipelines differ so much in annotation coverage (16% versus 73% of clue paragraphs) that pooled accuracy alone would hide which bottleneck is being measured.

AI.tldr: 本文测试冻结知识图谱能否让小规模本地模型像侦探一样跨章节关联线索，从而回答长篇侦探小说的问题。在30本小说、234道多选题上，用固定qwen3.5:9b阅读器比较九种条件，最强图路径准确率53.85%，高于近期窗口、全文压缩、向量检索和仅问题控制，但所有图与基线的对比均未通过Holm校正，因此仅作为探索性设计证据。
AI.motivation: 长上下文模型按叙事顺序逐词读取，全部历史争夺固定注意力预算；而侦探式阅读需要按时间排序、维护人物关系图，使第一章的线索能与书末的问题相遇。研究动机是检验冻结知识图谱能否为小型本地模型提供这种自由。
AI.method: 使用30本侦探小说和234道多选题，由同一个固定的qwen3.5:9b阅读器在九种条件下作答：五种图路径、近期窗口基线、整书压缩、普通向量检索、仅问题控制。另比较两个图构建流程，并考察标注证据在图拓扑核心中的分布。
AI.result: 最强图路径达53.85%（126/234），近期窗口46.15%，压缩51.28%，向量检索51.71%，仅问题40.17%；在必须依赖原书才能回答的子集上，图路径为42.86%。十五个图-基线对比无一通过Holm校正。两项结构性发现更稳健：标注证据集中于图拓扑核心（合并后富集2.35倍）；两个图构建流程的标注覆盖率差异大（16%对73%的线索段落），仅看合并准确率会掩盖所测量的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 结果仅为关于该设计的探索性证据，不能宣称图方法显著优于基线。更可靠的结论是：证据集中在图拓扑核心，且不同图构建流程的标注覆盖差异极大，会影响准确率所反映的瓶颈。

title: Minimax-Optimal Robust Identification of Continuous-Time Systems: Handling Narrow-Band Disturbances in the Frequency Domain
summary: The high-frequency spectral roll-off of continuous-time ARMA (CARMA) models can magnify the effect of narrow-band disturbances when aliasing is weak, making standard maximum-likelihood Whittle estimation sensitive to affected ordinates. We show that a logarithmic transformation $r_k = \log ρ_k$ converts the Whittle scale problem into a Gumbel location problem, connecting robust spectral estimation to the classical minimax theory of Huber and Rieder. A piecewise centering correction---closed-form for small $b$, implicit closed-form for the practitioner range---preserves Fisher consistency for any clipping level without numerical optimisation. Clipping the Gumbel score symmetrically and transforming back yields a two-sided clipped Gumbel score (the standard Rieder--Hampel bounded-influence form) whose normalised influence curve is proved locally asymptotically minimax under shrinking gross-error contamination. The efficiency loss is quantified by a single scalar $K(b)$: at $b = 1.5$, only $16\%$ nominal asymptotic variance overhead. In the stated AR(2) Monte Carlo design, the sample-size trends are compatible with the asymptotic rate, and at $b=1.5$ the bias reductions are about $40\%$, $90\%$, and $96\%$ for $a_1$, $a_2$, and $λ$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 论文针对CARMA模型Whittle估计对窄带干扰敏感的问题，提出基于对数变换和Gumbel位置模型的稳健谱估计方法，并证明其渐近minimax性质。
AI.motivation: CARMA模型的高频谱滚降在弱混叠时会放大窄带扰动的影响，使标准Whittle极大似然估计对受影响的频率坐标敏感。
AI.method: 通过对数变换 r_k = log ρ_k 将Whittle尺度问题转化为Gumbel位置问题；引入分段中心化校正以保持Fisher一致性；对称截断Gumbel得分并反变换，得到双侧截断Gumbel得分（Rieder--Hampel有界影响形式）；证明归一化影响曲线在收缩严重误差污染下局部渐近minimax。
AI.result: 效率损失由标量 K(b) 量化，b=1.5时渐近方差仅增加16%；在AR(2) Monte Carlo设计中，样本量趋势符合渐近速率，b=1.5时 a1、a2、λ 的偏差分别降低约40%、90%、96%。
AI.conclusion: 该稳健估计方法保持Fisher一致性且无需数值优化，在弱混叠窄带干扰下能有效降低偏差，并具有渐近最优性和可量化的效率权衡。

title: Using Composition Operators to Linearize LLM Semantic Transformations
summary: Machine learning learns functions: prompt to response, image to caption. What these functions are mathematically remains hard to say. We present a method to approximate these kinds of transformations using techniques from dynamical systems that fall under the umbrella of Koopmanism. We introduce the use of composition operators, which generalize the Koopman operator and, crucially, can map between distinct spaces, motivating the perspective that LLM transformations are rectangular infinite-dimensional operators. This formalism reveals useful structure: under natural assumptions on the prompt and response distributions, the LLM operator is an isometry, and misalignment between learned representations manifests as spectral pollution of its finite sections. We then outline a method of constructing finite-dimensional approximations of an LLM operator, and demonstrate how the singular value spectrum can be used to compare tasks and models.

AI.tldr: 本文用Koopmanism和复合算子将LLM等机器学习变换建模为矩形无穷维算子，并提出有限维逼近方法，通过奇异值谱比较任务与模型。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型学习的是从提示到响应、图像到描述等函数，但这些函数的数学本质尚不清晰，尤其是LLM变换的结构缺乏统一描述。
AI.method: 引入动力系统视角下的Koopmanism，使用复合算子推广Koopman算子，使其可在不同空间之间映射；将LLM变换视为矩形无穷维算子，并构造其有限维近似。
AI.result: 在提示与响应分布的自然假设下，LLM算子是一个等距算子；学习表示之间的错位表现为有限截断的谱污染；有限维逼近的奇异值谱可用于比较任务和模型。
AI.conclusion: 该形式化揭示了LLM变换的有用结构，为理解和比较不同任务与模型提供了一种基于算子谱的分析框架。

title: AgentRouter: Heterogeneous Model Routing for Cost-Optimal Multi-Step Agentic Workflows
comment: Accepted at the AgenticUQ Workshop, ICML 2026. Camera-ready version
summary: Enterprise agentic systems that route every trajectory step to a frontier model waste 60-80% of their inference budget on subtasks that smaller models handle equally well. Existing routing solutions optimize single-turn query assignment but ignore a property unique to agentic workflows: subtask complexity varies widely within a single trajectory. A planning step may require frontier-class reasoning while a subsequent formatting step needs only a 7B model. We formalize step-level model routing as a sequential assignment problem over agent trajectories and propose AgentRouter, a lightweight classifier (12M parameters, <5ms overhead per step on an A100 GPU) that maps each trajectory step to one of four model tiers using five features extractable at routing time. Trained on 50,000 annotated agent trajectory steps spanning planning, coding, research, and data analysis tasks, AgentRouter achieves 72% cost reduction relative to frontier-only baselines, retaining 97.3% of frontier-only quality (less than 3% degradation in end-to-end task completion); per-step routing accuracy reaches 91% on minimal-complexity steps and 85% on efficient-tier steps, with 76-82% on the harder mid-range and frontier tiers. On the same benchmarks, RouteLLM and FrugalGPT (applied per-step) achieve only 31% and 44% cost reduction respectively, because their single-turn training signal misses trajectory-level quality dependencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentRouter，将智能体轨迹中的每一步视为序贯模型分配问题，用12M参数轻量分类器把每步路由到四个模型层级，在保持97.3%前沿模型质量的同时降低72%推理成本。
AI.motivation: 企业级智能体系统将每个轨迹步骤都交给前沿大模型处理，导致60-80%的推理预算浪费在较小模型即可胜任的子任务上。现有路由方案只优化单轮查询分配，忽略了智能体工作流的独特性——同一轨迹内子任务复杂度差异巨大（如规划步骤需前沿级推理，而后续格式化步骤只需7B模型）。
AI.method: 将步骤级模型路由形式化为智能体轨迹上的序贯分配问题；提出 AgentRouter 轻量分类器（12M参数，A100上每步开销<5ms），利用路由时可提取的五个特征，将每个轨迹步骤映射到四个模型层级之一；在涵盖规划、编程、研究、数据分析的50,000条已标注智能体轨迹步骤上训练。
AI.result: 相比仅用前沿模型的基线，实现72%成本降低，保留97.3%的质量（端到端任务完成度下降<3%）；步骤级路由准确率在最低复杂度步骤上达91%、高效层级达85%、较难的中间与前沿层级为76-82%。相同基准下，逐步应用的 RouteLLM 与 FrugalGPT 仅分别降低31%和44%成本。
AI.conclusion: 步骤级路由能显著优于单轮路由方案，因为后者因单轮训练信号而忽略轨迹级质量依赖；AgentRouter 证明以极低开销实现高成本节省与质量保持是可行的。

title: Math2Visual-X: A Modular Framework for Pedagogically Aligned Lower-Primary Math Visuals Generation
summary: Visual representations can help lower-primary learners understand Math Word Problems, but generating classroom-usable visuals remains difficult. Existing symbolic systems are controllable but limited in coverage, while end-to-end text-to-image systems often fail to satisfy exact mathematical constraints. This paper presents a symbolic visual generation framework for lower-primary MWP generation with broader problem coverage and more scalable asset generation. The framework includes an LLM-based routing layer, three worksheet-oriented generation modules, and two fallback mechanisms for open-world SVG asset acquisition. A human evaluation comparing Math2Visual-X with Stable Diffusion XL, Nano Banana, and GPT Image showed that the proposed method achieved the strongest overall performance. The results indicate that the framework offers a scalable and pedagogically grounded approach for automatic MWP visual generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向小学数学应用题（MWP）的符号化视觉生成框架 Math2Visual-X，旨在扩大题目覆盖范围并更可扩展地生成课堂可用配图。
AI.motivation: 视觉表征有助于低年级学生理解数学应用题，但生成课堂可用视觉仍很困难：符号系统可控但覆盖有限，端到端文生图系统常无法满足精确数学约束。
AI.method: 提出符号化视觉生成框架，包括基于LLM的路由层、三个面向练习册的生成模块，以及两个用于开放世界SVG素材获取的兜底机制。通过人工评估将 Math2Visual-X 与 Stable Diffusion XL、Nano Banana 和 GPT Image 进行比较。
AI.result: 人工评估显示，所提方法在总体表现上最强，优于 Stable Diffusion XL、Nano Banana 和 GPT Image。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为自动数学应用题视觉生成提供了一种可扩展且具有教学依据的方法。

title: Stability of Slow-Fast Nonlinear Dynamics: Moving Equilibrium Case
comment: 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC), Honolulu, HI, USA, Dec. 2026
summary: We study the stability of nonlinear systems subject to both slow and fast time variations. Both can have discontinuities, covering switched systems as a special case. The fast variation is assumed to be periodic; thus, we rely on averaging to construct an average system. Importantly, the equilibrium of the average system depends on the slow variation and is assumed to be exponentially stable when this slow input is frozen. Using perturbation and Lyapunov analyses, we establish a practical stability result showing that the system state remains within a neighborhood of the moving equilibrium when the total variation (flows and jumps) of the slow variation is appropriately bounded and the fast input varies sufficiently fast. The result is illustrated via a nonlinear switched system with slow-fast switching and a mode-dependent equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 研究同时具有慢变和快变（可含不连续）的非线性系统稳定性，利用平均化构造平均系统，并证明在慢变总变差有界、快变足够快时，原系统状态保持在移动平衡点邻域内。
AI.motivation: 许多实际系统同时存在慢变和快变动态，且可能发生切换或跳变；已有稳定性结果难以直接处理平均系统平衡点随慢变移动的情形。
AI.method: 对周期快变输入采用平均化方法构造平均系统；假设慢输入冻结时平均系统平衡点指数稳定；结合扰动分析和Lyapunov分析证明实际稳定性。
AI.result: 得到实际稳定性结果：当慢变的总变差（流与跳变）适当有界且快变输入足够快时，系统状态保持在移动平衡点的邻域内；并用具有慢-快切换和模式相关平衡点的非线性切换系统示例说明。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将切换系统作为特例，适用于慢/快不连续变化下的非线性系统，表明可通过平均化与Lyapunov/扰动分析保证移动平衡点附近的实际稳定性。

title: Decentralized Multi-Robot Exploration with Probabilistic Peer Intent and Multi-hop Plan Propagation
summary: Efficient coordination under limited communication remains a key challenge in decentralized multi-robot exploration. While centralized approaches benefit from global information sharing, they are often impractical in large-scale or communication-constrained environments. Existing Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based approaches, such as Decentralized Monte Carlo Exploration (DMCE), enable decentralized planning by taking peer intent into account. This peer intent is obtained by communicating sequences of planned waypoints with robots within direct communication range. In this work, we extend this idea by introducing Probabilistic Peer Intent (PPI), which converts peer trajectories into a continuous spatial representation of predicted intent and incorporates it into local MCTS action evaluation. We additionally study the effects of sharing peer intent beyond direct communication range by propagating plans over multiple hops. Experiments across multiple simulated environments and team sizes show that PPI and Multi-hop propagation can each improve decentralized exploration, with their relative benefits depending on environment structure and team size. We also demonstrate the real-world deployment of our method on three robots operating in different environment types.

AI.tldr: 本文针对通信受限下的去中心化多机器人探索协调问题，提出概率同伴意图（PPI）与多跳传播方法，并通过仿真和真实机器人实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 集中式方法依赖全局信息共享，在大规模或通信受限环境中不实用；现有DMCE仅通过直接通信范围共享路点序列，协调效率有限。
AI.method: 扩展DMCE，提出PPI将同伴轨迹转化为连续空间意图表示，融入局部MCTS动作评估；并研究通过多跳传播共享同伴意图。
AI.result: 多环境多团队规模实验表明，PPI与多跳传播均可提升去中心化探索性能，相对收益取决于环境结构与团队规模；并在三台机器人不同环境中完成真实部署。
AI.conclusion: PPI和多跳传播能有效改善通信受限下的去中心化多机器人探索，但需根据场景选择。

title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Evaluation of Game-Theoretic Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper evaluates Nash- and Stackelberg-based decision-making controllers for autonomous intersection crossing using a three-stage evaluation pipeline culminating in physical Quanser QCar 2 experiments with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) execution. The controllers are implemented in MATLAB/Simulink, deployed through Quanser Real-Time Control (QUARC) software, and executed on the onboard NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin processor. The evaluation includes MATLAB numerical simulation, qualitative validation in Quanser Interactive Labs (QLabs), and physical QCar 2 experiments. The experiments consider symmetric and asymmetric intersection approaches, leader-follower interactions, conflicting Stackelberg role assignments, and non-cooperative obstacle-vehicle behaviors. The results characterize the effects of hierarchy assignment, obstacle-vehicle behavior, and physical implementation on the considered game-theoretic autonomous driving controllers. Comparison between software simulations and hardware experiments further highlights the importance of accounting for sensing and state-estimation uncertainty when translating game-theoretic controllers from simulation to physical systems. A video demonstration of the QLabs simulations and physical QCar 2 hardware experiments is available at https://youtu.be/gkV6lz0twRk.

AI.tldr: 本文通过仿真、QLabs 验证和 QCar 2 硬件实验三阶段流程，评估基于 Nash 与 Stackelberg 博弈的自动驾驶交叉口决策控制器。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶交叉口决策中，博弈论控制器从仿真迁移到物理系统时，层级角色分配、障碍车辆行为及感知与状态估计不确定性会影响实际表现，因此需要系统评估。
AI.method: 在 MATLAB/Simulink 中实现 Nash 与 Stackelberg 控制器，通过 QUARC 部署到 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上的 Quanser QCar 2，并结合数值仿真、QLabs 定性验证和硬件在环物理实验。实验涵盖对称/非对称交叉口、领航-跟随交互、冲突的 Stackelberg 角色分配及非合作障碍车辆行为。
AI.result: 结果刻画了层级分配、障碍车辆行为和物理实现对博弈论自动驾驶控制器的影响；软件仿真与硬件实验对比表明，从仿真迁移到物理系统时需考虑感知与状态估计不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 基于 Nash 和 Stackelberg 的控制器在自动驾驶交叉口场景中具有可行性，但其实际部署效果受博弈层级、交互对象行为及感知估计误差显著影响，仿真到实物的迁移需纳入不确定性因素。

title: Multilingual Safety Signals Are Multi-Layered: Filtering Safety-Degrading Data for Safer LLMs
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 16 pages, 11 figures
summary: Preserving safety alignment during large language models fine-tuning is critical, however, recent studies have demonstrated that even benign fine-tuning data may contain safety-degrading samples that silently undermine safety alignment. Existing approaches typically identify such samples using representations from a single safety-sensitive layer. While this assumption has shown effectiveness in monolingual settings, its validity for multilingual models remains unclear due to potential cross-lingual differences in representation patterns. Through a cross-lingual analysis, we show that sensitive layers are only partially shared across languages, with safety-relevant signals often distributed across multiple layers. Motivated by these observations, we propose MMSAFE, a multi-layer framework for multilingual safety-degrading data identification that captures both shared and language-specific safety signals. Extensive experiments across multiple models, languages, and safety benchmarks demonstrate that MMSAFE reduces the average harmful-response ratio by 60% compared with random filtering and achieves stronger average performance than the strongest single-layer baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-layer modeling for robust multilingual safety alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多语言大模型微调中的安全对齐退化问题，提出多层框架MMSAFE来识别会 silently 破坏安全性的微调样本，并在多模型、多语言和多安全基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常仅依赖单一安全敏感层的表示来识别有害微调样本，这在单语言场景中有效；但在多语言模型中，由于跨语言表示模式可能存在差异，该假设是否成立尚不明确。跨语言分析发现，安全敏感层仅部分共享，安全相关信号常分布在多个层中。
AI.method: 作者提出MMSAFE，一种多层的多语言安全退化数据识别框架，用于同时捕捉跨语言共享的安全信号和语言特有的安全信号。
AI.result: 在多个模型、语言和安全基准上的实验表明，MMSAFE相比随机过滤将平均有害回复率降低60%，并优于最强的单层基线。
AI.conclusion: 多层建模对于稳健的多语言安全对齐是有效的，能够更好识别多语言微调中的安全退化样本。

title: PanoSeg3R: Feed-Forward 3D Semantic Segmentation for Panoramic Images with an Automatic Data Curation Pipeline
summary: We present PanoSeg3R, a feed-forward framework for 3D panoramic semantic segmentation. Unlike existing methods designed for perspective inputs, PanoSeg3R jointly predicts 3D geometry and multi-view semantic segmentation in one single forward pass. Built upon a pretrained reconstruction backbone that supports panoramic images, our approach extends feed-forward 3D reconstruction with a query-based mask decoder. Furthermore, we introduce an automatic panorama data curation pipeline that leverages the complementary strengths of off-the-shelf foundation models to generate reliable pseudo semantic annotations, substantially expanding the training data and improving zero-shot generalization. PanoSeg3R achieves state-of-the-art performance on panoramic 3D semantic segmentation, improving 3D mIoU by up to 16.02 on ScanNet++, while the curated training data further improves zero-shot performance by up to 4.26 and 43.28 mIoU on Stanford2D3D and ToF-360, respectively. Website: https://harryyoon777.github.io/PanoSeg3R/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PanoSeg3R，一个面向3D全景语义分割的前馈框架，可在单次前向传播中联合预测3D几何与多视角语义分割，并通过自动全景数据策展提升零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多面向透视输入，难以直接处理全景图像，且全景3D语义分割训练数据不足，限制了模型性能与零样本泛化能力。
AI.method: 基于支持全景图像的预训练重建骨干网络，将前馈3D重建扩展为带查询式掩码解码器的框架，实现3D几何与多视角语义联合预测；同时设计自动全景数据策展流程，利用现成基础模型生成可靠伪语义标注以扩充训练数据。
AI.result: 在ScanNet++上3D mIoU最高提升16.02，达到全景3D语义分割最优性能；策展训练数据在Stanford2D3D和ToF-360上分别将零样本性能最高提升4.26和43.28 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: PanoSeg3R验证了前馈全景3D重建与语义分割联合建模的有效性，并表明自动数据策展可显著增强全景3D语义分割的零样本泛化能力。

title: BEACON: Belief-Enabled Adaptive CONtrol for Imitation Learning under Uncertainty
summary: Robot manipulation tasks often involve hidden state information that cannot be directly observed and must be inferred through sequential physical interactions. In such partially observable settings, conditioning an imitation learning policy directly on the recent raw observation history leads to poor performance. This is due to state aliasing, wherein identical observations may arise from different hidden states, and the policy receives conflicting action labels for the same input. To enable history-aware disambiguation capability, we propose conditioning a diffusion policy on a structured representation of the hidden states using Bayesian belief that exposes both the current most likely state estimate and the remaining uncertainty. This representation replaces raw history with a structured, compact input, enabling the policy to implicitly modulate between exploratory and exploitative behaviors based on belief uncertainty, without explicit mode switching or reward shaping. We evaluate across two domains with qualitatively different belief representations: a continuous belief for cornstalk gripper alignment via tactile sensing, and a discrete categorical distribution for latched door opening. In both domains, the belief-conditioned policy substantially outperforms the observation-only baseline and approaches privileged ground-truth performance, with ablations illustrating that the policy adapts its exploration behavior depending on the belief uncertainty at inference time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于贝叶斯信念的条件扩散策略，用结构化隐藏状态表示替代原始观测历史，以解决部分可观测机器人操作中的状态混叠问题。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习策略若直接依赖最近原始观测历史，在隐藏状态不可直接观测时会因状态混叠而性能不佳：相同观测可能来自不同隐藏状态，导致策略对同一输入收到冲突的动作标签。
AI.method: 将扩散策略条件化于隐藏状态的贝叶斯信念表示，该表示同时给出当前最可能状态估计和剩余不确定性；用该结构化紧凑输入替代原始历史。在连续信念的触觉玉米秆夹爪对齐任务和离散类别分布的门闩开启任务上进行评估。
AI.result: 在两个任务中，信念条件策略均显著优于仅观测基线，并接近使用特权真实状态信息的性能；消融实验表明策略能在推理时根据信念不确定性调整探索行为。
AI.conclusion: 结构化贝叶斯信念表示能够赋予策略历史感知和消歧能力，使其在无需显式模式切换或奖励塑形的情况下，在探索与利用行为之间隐式调节，适用于部分可观测的机器人操作任务。

title: Quasi-Static Fault-Tolerant Feedback Control of a Quadrotor under Rotor Failure with Provable Safety Guarantees
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures (14 panels). Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE Conference on Control Technology and Applications (CCTA)
summary: This paper presents a nonlinear control law for a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) under single-rotor failure that guarantees set stabilization via quasi-static feedback (QSF). Given a geometric curve in three-dimensional space, we characterize and stabilize the zero-dynamics manifold, also known as the path-following manifold, which represents all feasible motions along the path. Stabilizing this manifold ensures path-invariance: a UAV with a failed rotor initialized on the path with an appropriate orientation remains on the path for all future time. Furthermore, local exponential convergence to the manifold is guaranteed under certain conditions, implying that, under the stated assumptions, rotor failure during flight does not cause transverse deviation from the path. The proposed controller thus provides theoretical safety guarantees, which are validated through numerical experiments in the Drake physics-based simulation engine. The code is publicly available at https://gradslab.github.io/quasistatic-ftc/.

AI.tldr: 本文针对单旋翼故障的四旋翼无人机，提出一种基于准静态反馈的非线性控制律，实现路径跟随流形的集合镇定，保证故障后无人机仍能沿预定路径飞行。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼在单旋翼故障下飞行安全性至关重要，需要理论保证故障后不偏离预定路径。
AI.method: 采用准静态反馈（QSF）设计非线性控制律，刻画并镇定零动态流形（即路径跟随流形），并分析局部指数收敛条件，最后在Drake物理仿真引擎中进行数值实验验证。
AI.result: 镇定该流形可保证路径不变性：若故障无人机初始位于路径上且姿态合适，则未来始终在路径上；在特定条件下实现局部指数收敛，意味着转子故障不会导致横向路径偏差。数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 该控制器为单旋翼故障下的四旋翼路径跟随提供了理论安全保证，代码已公开。

title: Rapidly-Iterating Grid-Based Near-Optimal Kinodynamic Motion Planning
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics
summary: This paper develops the Rapidly-iterating kinoDynamic Grid (RDG) algorithm, an asymptotically near-optimal kinodynamic motion planning algorithm that produces high quality solutions through rapid iteration. The algorithm leverages a state space grid decomposition to perform node selection, dynamics propagation, and graph revision in constant time complexity with respect to the number of nodes in the trajectory tree. Through a covering ball sequence induction proof, the algorithm is shown to be asymptotically near-optimal and probabilistically complete. Different subsystems of the algorithm are evaluated against common nearest-neighbor search-based methods at generating exploration bias. The RDG algorithm is evaluated through simulated trials in complex, kinodynamic motion planning problem environments up to 10 DOF relative to similar sparse, kinodynamic planning algorithms with optimality guarantees, SST and DIRT. The RDG algorithm outperforms both SST and DIRT in mean final solution quality by up to 104% and 40% respectively. Additionally, RDG maintained a 100% success rate, even on a 10-DOF test case where both SST and DIRT did not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RDG算法，一种通过快速迭代实现渐近近优的动力学运动规划算法，并在复杂环境中优于SST和DIRT。
AI.motivation: 动力学运动规划中，如何在复杂高维环境下高效生成高质量且具最优性保证的解仍具挑战。
AI.method: 利用状态空间网格分解，以常数时间复杂度进行节点选择、动力学传播和图修订；通过覆盖球序列归纳证明其渐近近优性和概率完备性；并与基于最近邻搜索的方法及SST、DIRT在仿真环境中对比。
AI.result: RDG在平均最终解质量上分别比SST和DIRT提升最高104%和40%；在10自由度测试中保持100%成功率，而SST和DIRT均失败。
AI.conclusion: RDG是一种高效、稳健且具渐近近优保证的动力学运动规划算法，适合复杂高维规划问题。

title: A Compact Stance-Indexed Anterior-Posterior COP Representation for Parkinson's Disease Classification from Plantar VGRF
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures; supplementary material is included in the same PDF
summary: Parkinson's disease alters gait and bilateral coordination, but machine-learning performance also depends on how continuous gait signals are represented. This study investigates whether preserving anterior-posterior center-of-pressure (AP-COP) information at fixed locations across normalized stance provides a compact and informative representation of plantar-force gait signals. Bilateral vertical ground reaction force recordings from 165 participants in the Gait in Parkinson's Disease Database were evaluated using repeated fully nested participant-level cross-validation. We propose AP-COP10, comprising AP-COP position and bilateral asymmetry across five stance windows. AP-COP10 achieved an AUC of 0.894 and outperformed three harmonized literature-derived COP representations under the same evaluation pipeline. The complementary 25 non-AP-COP descriptors alone achieved an AUC of 0.856, while the complete 35-feature representation achieved 0.908. Removing AP-COP10 from the complete representation produced a statistically supported loss in discrimination, whereas adding the complementary descriptors to AP-COP10 yielded only a small, unsupported improvement. Feature competition indicated that the most informative stance-indexed descriptors were concentrated in early and early-mid stance, while source-study holdout and sensor-perturbation analyses supported the robustness of the representation. These findings indicate that stance-indexed AP-COP retains discriminative information that is not readily recovered by broader engineered gait descriptors, supporting compact and interpretable representations for machine-learning analysis of pathological gait.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于归一化支撑期固定位置的AP-COP步态表征AP-COP10，用于区分帕金森病与对照，并在165名参与者的双侧垂直地面反作用力数据上验证其紧凑性、判别性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病会改变步态和双侧协调，但机器学习性能高度依赖连续步态信号的表示方式；研究希望探索在归一化支撑期固定位置保留前后方向压力中心（AP-COP）信息，能否形成紧凑且信息丰富的足底力步态信号表征。
AI.method: 使用Gait in Parkinson's Disease Database中165名参与者的双侧垂直地面反作用力记录，采用重复的完全嵌套参与者级交叉验证。提出AP-COP10，包含五个支撑期窗口中的AP-COP位置及双侧不对称性，并与三种统一的文献来源COP表征在相同评估流程下比较；同时评估25个非AP-COP描述子及完整35特征表示，并进行特征竞争、源研究留出和传感器扰动分析。
AI.result: AP-COP10取得AUC 0.894，优于三种文献来源COP表征；仅25个非AP-COP描述子AUC为0.856，完整35特征表示AUC为0.908。从完整表示中移除AP-COP10会导致统计支持的判别性能下降，而在AP-COP10上加入补充描述子仅带来小幅且统计不支持的提升。特征竞争显示最有信息量的支撑期索引描述子集中在支撑早期和早中期，源研究留出与传感器扰动分析支持该表征的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 按支撑期索引的AP-COP保留了较广泛工程化步态描述子难以恢复的判别信息，支持将紧凑且可解释的表征用于病理性步态的机器学习分析。

title: Beyond the Stitching Assumption: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Synthetic Data Evaluation via Semantic Quantization
comment: 10 Pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, accepted to PST 2026
summary: Multimodal synthetic datasets combine structured attributes with free text, but are often evaluated separately. Such metrics can remain high after tabular--text pairings are disrupted. We present a projection-based evaluator for tabular--text synthetic data. A fixed sentence encoder maps text to embeddings, \(k\)-means converts them to cluster states, and tabular variables are represented as categorical or quantile-binned states. Real and synthetic contingency tables are compared using Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD), normalized mutual information (NMI), conditional JSD (cJSD), and joint-state entropy. We also report text-to-attribute (T2A) utility and a holdout-calibrated proximity flag rate (PFR) as a representation-level diagnostic. A text-permutation control preserves both marginal distributions while disrupting their pairing. Experiments on Amazon Reviews, Kiva Loans, and the Employment Scam Aegean Dataset show that modality-specific scores remain high under this control. The projection diagnostics detect disruption when real projected dependence exceeds a permutation baseline, but are less informative for weak or sparse projections. Some conditioned LLM baselines also exhibit stronger measured dependence than the corresponding real-data projections. These results support explicit cross-modal evaluation with permutation baselines and coverage reporting.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于投影的表格-文本合成数据评估方法，用JSD、NMI、条件JSD和联合状态熵比较真实与合成的跨模态列联表，并引入文本置换对照。实验表明，单独评估各模态的分数在配对被破坏后仍可能很高，而投影诊断能在真实依赖强于置换基线时检测出配对破坏。
AI.motivation: 多模态合成数据集常将结构化属性与自由文本结合，但现有评估多分别针对表格或文本进行，导致表格-文本配对被打乱后，模态特定指标仍可能保持较高，无法反映跨模态依赖是否真实。
AI.method: 用固定句子编码器将文本映射为嵌入，再用k-means转为聚类状态；表格变量表示为类别状态或分位数分箱状态。比较真实与合成列联表，使用Jensen-Shannon散度、归一化互信息、条件JSD和联合状态熵，并报告文本到属性效用及基于留出校准的近距标志率。设置文本置换对照，在保持边缘分布的同时破坏配对关系。
AI.result: 在Amazon Reviews、Kiva Loans和Employment Scam Aegean数据集上，模态特定分数在文本置换控制下仍保持较高。投影诊断在真实投影依赖超过置换基线时能检测出配对破坏，但对弱或稀疏投影信息有限。部分条件LLM基线也表现出比对应真实数据投影更强的测量依赖。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对表格-文本合成数据进行显式跨模态评估，并应使用置换基线及覆盖率报告，以避免仅凭模态特定指标得出误导性结论。

title: On sparsity and directional forgetting in adaptive control
summary: This paper develops a sparsity-promoting memory regressor extension (MRE) adaptation law with directional forgetting for nonlinear control-affine systems with linearly parameterized uncertainty. The objective is to use directional forgetting to selectively discount obsolete information and leverage $\ell_1$ regularization to promote sparsity of the parameter estimates. While $\ell_1$ regularization has been applied to the system identification problem in an offline setting, a contribution of this paper is to develop a recursive least squares update law to implement $\ell_1$ regularization in online adaptive control. In particular, we show that $\ell_1$-regularized recursive least squares is realized via a sliding mode update law. A nonsmooth Lyapunov-based stability analysis is then used to show that the tracking and parameter estimation errors are ultimately bounded under a subspace excitation condition. Simulation results on a Van der Pol oscillator demonstrate the ability of the developed sparsity-promoting MRE controller to recover sparse dynamics while maintaining stable tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种具有方向遗忘的稀疏促进记忆回归器扩展（MRE）自适应律，用于具有线性参数化不确定性的非线性控制仿射系统，并实现了在线自适应控制中的ℓ1正则化递归最小二乘。
AI.motivation: 现有ℓ1正则化多用于离线系统辨识，缺乏在线自适应控制中的递归实现；同时需要选择性地遗忘过时信息并促进参数估计稀疏化。
AI.method: 采用方向遗忘选择性折扣过时信息，利用ℓ1正则化促进参数稀疏；将ℓ1正则化递归最小二乘实现为滑模更新律；通过非光滑Lyapunov稳定性分析证明跟踪与参数估计误差的最终有界性。
AI.result: 在子空间激励条件下，跟踪误差和参数估计误差最终有界；Van der Pol振荡器仿真表明该方法能恢复稀疏动态并保持稳定跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的稀疏促进MRE控制器可在线实现ℓ1正则化自适应控制，在保证稳定跟踪的同时有效恢复稀疏系统动态。

title: Vision2CAD: A Visual Agent Harness for Explicit Geometry Referencing and Localization in Parametric CAD Modeling
summary: Generating parametric CAD models requires accurate geometry and stable feature dependencies. Existing methods face challenges in selecting geometric references, interpreting sketch-plane local coordinates, and establishing sketch constraints to projected external geometry. We present Vision2CAD, a visual agent harness that combines vision-language model (VLM) reasoning with deterministic CAD kernel operations. An ID-based interface supports explicit geometry selection, a local-coordinate bridge converts view coordinates into sketch coordinates, and projected-edge localization supports external sketch constraints. These mechanisms establish feature dependencies within the supported modeling operations and constraint types. We also introduce the Geometry Explicit Reference Dataset (GERD), which aligned commands, geometry states and IDs at every modeling step. On GERD-EVL and a DeepCAD test subset, Vision2CAD improves mIoU by 11.1\% and 5.6\% and reduces Chamfer distance by 17.3\% and 41.8\%, respectively. Parameter-editing experiments and ablation studies further proved the preservation of parametric dependencies.

AI.tldr: Vision2CAD 是一种结合视觉语言模型推理与确定性 CAD 内核操作的视觉智能体框架，用于生成参数化 CAD 模型；它通过基于 ID 的接口、局部坐标桥接和投影边定位解决几何选择与约束问题，并发布 GERD 数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在参数化 CAD 生成中面临几何参考选择困难、草图平面局部坐标解释困难，以及难以建立投影外部几何的草图约束等问题。
AI.method: 提出 Vision2CAD，将 VLM 推理与确定性 CAD 内核操作结合；采用基于 ID 的接口实现显式几何选择，使用局部坐标桥接将视图坐标转换为草图坐标，并通过投影边定位支持外部草图约束；同时构建 GERD 数据集，对齐每个建模步骤的命令、几何状态和 ID。
AI.result: 在 GERD-EVL 和 DeepCAD 测试子集上，mIoU 分别提升 11.1% 和 5.6%，Chamfer 距离分别降低 17.3% 和 41.8%；参数编辑实验和消融研究进一步证明了参数依赖关系的保持。
AI.conclusion: Vision2CAD 能在支持的建模操作和约束类型中建立特征依赖，并有效保持参数化依赖关系。

title: R-GEAN: Regimen-Guided Edit Action Network for Within-Admission Medication Change Prediction
summary: The medications prescribed to a patient often change during a hospital admission as clinicians start, stop, or continue therapies. We study whether models can predict which medication classes are added or removed between 24 hours after admission and discharge. Metrics that compare the complete discharge regimen can reward models for copying medications that remain unchanged, even when they identify no actual changes. We therefore introduce a leakage-controlled benchmark that predicts net ATC3 additions and removals using only prior completed admissions and information available within the first 24 hours of the current admission. Addition candidates are classes not active at 24 hours, whereas removal candidates are classes active at that time. We also introduce R-GEAN, an asymmetric candidate-scoring network with independent addition and removal predictors. Across 240,480 admissions from 82,286 patients, R-GEAN achieves the highest predefined summary of addition, removal, changed-regimen, and action-pattern performance, termed the edit composite (0.464), compared with 0.435 for the strongest primary comparator. Reimplemented RETAIN, GAMENet, and MICRON baselines obtain 0.428, 0.420, and 0.288, respectively. R-GEAN's advantage is concentrated in correctly identifying medication classes no longer active at discharge, while rare additions and admissions with multiple medication changes remain difficult. Rankings based on micro-F1 over the reconstructed discharge regimen and the edit composite correlate weakly across the evaluated models (Spearman r = 0.20). The continuation baseline achieves the highest complete-regimen score despite predicting no additions or removals. These results show that complete-regimen and edit-level evaluation measure different aspects of medication prediction. The benchmark evaluates observed prescribing changes, not treatment appropriateness

AI.tldr: 研究提出一个防泄漏基准，仅利用既往完整住院记录和本次入院24小时内信息，预测入院24小时后至出院期间药物ATC3类别的净新增与停用，并提出R-GEAN模型；在240,480次住院中取得最高编辑综合得分0.464。
AI.motivation: 住院期间用药常发生开始、停止或继续治疗的变化，而比较完整出院方案的指标可能奖励模型复制未变药物，即使未识别任何实际用药变更，因此需要能评估真实处方增减的基准。
AI.method: 构建防泄漏基准：新增候选为24小时未活跃类别，移除候选为24小时活跃类别；提出R-GEAN非对称候选评分网络，含独立的增加预测器和移除预测器；与重实现的RETAIN、GAMENet、MICRON及continuation baseline等比较。
AI.result: 在82,286名患者的240,480次住院中，R-GEAN编辑综合得分0.464，高于最强主要比较器0.435、RETAIN 0.428、GAMENet 0.420和MICRON 0.288；其优势主要在识别出院时不再活跃的药物类别，但罕见新增及多次用药变更仍困难；重构出院方案的micro-F1与编辑综合得分排名仅弱相关（Spearman r=0.20），continuation baseline完整方案得分最高却未预测任何增减。
AI.conclusion: 完整方案评估与编辑级评估测量药物预测的不同方面；该基准评估观察到的处方变化，而非治疗适宜性。

title: OptiSkill: A Hierarchical and Evolving SkillBank for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
summary: Automated operations research (OR) modeling requires LLMs to translate natural-language decision problems into correct mathematical programs. Existing methods can improve individual formulations, but they often solve problems in isolation, retaining little reusable experience and repeating similar formulation errors. Prior memory-based approaches store examples, thoughts, or insights as references, while OR modeling requires reusable formulation skills that transfer across problem narratives and guide concrete modeling decisions. We propose OptiSkill, a skill-augmented framework that builds a hierarchical and evolving SkillBank for LLM-based OR modeling. SkillBank stores solver-verified experience as reusable skills, with Global Strategies for problem-level formulation skeletons and Step Experiences for local error-prevention rules. It is further refined through stable batch-level test-time evolution, where candidate skills are incorporated only after validation. Experiments on eight OR modeling benchmarks show that OptiSkill improves formulation accuracy across LLM backbones, outperforms strong agentic baselines, and gains further by expanding SkillBank coverage and reliability. Code and data are available at https://github.com/rachhhhing/OptiSkill

AI.tldr: 提出OptiSkill，一种技能增强框架，为基于LLM的运筹学建模构建分层且持续演化的SkillBank，存储经求解器验证的可复用技能，从而提升数学规划形式化准确性。
AI.motivation: 自动化运筹学建模需要LLM将自然语言决策问题转化为正确的数学规划，但现有方法孤立求解问题，难以复用经验且重复类似建模错误；已有记忆方法存储示例、思路或见解，而运筹学建模更需要可跨问题叙述迁移并指导具体建模决策的可复用形式化技能。
AI.method: OptiSkill构建分层且演化的SkillBank，包含问题级形式化骨架的全局策略和局部防错规则的步骤经验；通过稳定的批级测试时演化，仅在验证后纳入候选技能。
AI.result: 在八个运筹学建模基准上，OptiSkill提升了不同LLM骨干的形式化准确率，优于强智能体基线，并随SkillBank覆盖面和可靠性扩大而进一步获益。
AI.conclusion: OptiSkill通过可复用、可验证和持续演化的技能库，有效改善了LLM在运筹学建模中的形式化表现。

title: Distributed Infrastructure Sensors and Cues for Robotic Fire-Fighting and Safety System on a Lunar Base
summary: There are renewed efforts to build a lunar base and house a team of astronauts on the Moon for extended periods. However, important challenges remain, such as a rapid-response fire-hazard management system. In the event of a fire or toxic leak inside an early crewed lunar habitat, a single pressurized cylinder must be handled within minutes. However, suited astronauts and radio-delayed support from Earth cannot guarantee such response times. We describe a prototype fire-fighting and emergency response safety technology that embeds intelligence in the habitat itself: using thin ceramic QR codes affixed every few meters, each carries a local floor map, safe sensor limits, and step-by-step hazard responses. A low-power rover decodes a plate in a matter of seconds, polls the adjoining temperature-gas sensor cluster, and acts immediately, eliminating the need for a global map . In a representative layout, the interior is divided into roughly one code per two square meters. Simulations show that rapid-response firefighting both simplifies the task and avoids costly resource use and indeterminate outcomes. Because knowledge is spread across passive plates, damage is localized, procedures can be updated by replacing a single code, and processor demands remain minimal. However, important challenges remain, such as a rapid-response fire-hazard management system. In the event of a fire or toxic leak inside an early crewed lunar habitat, a single pressurized cylinder must be handled within minutes. However, suited astronauts and radio-delayed support from Earth cannot guarantee such response times. We describe a prototype fire-fighting and emergency response safety technology that embeds intelligence in the habitat itself: using thin ceramic QR codes affixed every few meters, each carries a local floor map, safe sensor limits, and step-by-step hazard responses.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向早期月球栖息地的嵌入式智能消防与应急响应原型技术，利用陶瓷二维码和低功耗漫游车实现快速局部危险处置。
AI.motivation: 月球基地需要长期驻留宇航员，但火灾或有毒泄漏时，宇航员穿着舱外服且地球支持存在通信延迟，无法保证数分钟内响应，因此需要快速、自主的火灾风险管理方案。
AI.method: 在栖息地内每几米粘贴薄陶瓷二维码，每个码携带局部楼层图、安全传感器阈值和分步危险响应流程；低功耗漫游车数秒内解码二维码，轮询邻近温度-气体传感器簇，并立即行动，无需全局地图。典型布局约每两平方米一个码。
AI.result: 仿真表明，快速响应消防既能简化任务，又能避免昂贵资源消耗和不确定结果；由于知识分布在被动码板上，损坏可局部化，程序可通过更换单个码更新，且处理器需求极低。
AI.conclusion: 将智能嵌入栖息地本身，结合陶瓷二维码与低功耗漫游车，可为月球基地提供快速、分布式、低计算需求的应急响应能力，但该技术仍为原型，快速火灾风险管理等挑战依然存在。

title: Do Language Models Know Their Own Constraints?
summary: We ask whether behavioral constraints acquired through post training remain explicitly reportable. Using constrained recipe generation as a testbed, five banned ingredients enforced via LoRA fine tuning of Llama 3.1 8B Instruct we compare supervised fine tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) against an untrained baseline on a four tier Constraint Awareness Benchmark. Averaged over three seeds, both methods raise behavioral compliance from 4% to about 90% while reducing explicit constraint reporting below the untrained model (0.48/5 to 0.16/5 for SFT, 0.07/5 for GRPO) and eroding retained third person knowledge (93% to 36% for SFT, 14% for GRPO; p less than 0.01 between methods). Contrary to our initial hypothesis, the reward based signal is the more destructive of the two: a reward that penalizes banned ingredient tokens regardless of framing learns a context independent suppression rather than a self directed constraint. A context conditioned reward designed to teach the self to other distinction fails, collapsing toward inclusion in both framings. Probing prompt time hidden states recovers per ingredient avoidance at 83.8% (layer 24 MLP), but only 6.4 points above a per ingredient base rate predictor (77.4%), and the model's own verbal self report is more accurate still (87.8%). A positive control adding explicit self description examples does not restore reporting. The failure is therefore specific to enumerating constraints on request, not a general loss of access to them.

AI.tldr: 论文探究后训练获得的行为约束是否仍可被显式报告。以受限食谱生成为测试平台，对 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 用 LoRA 微调植入 5 种禁用食材，比较 SFT、GRPO 与未训练基线在四级约束意识基准上的表现。
AI.motivation: 希望判断后训练习得的约束究竟是可显式访问的自指约束，还是仅表现为行为层面的抑制；并比较监督微调与奖励优化对约束可报告性的不同影响。
AI.method: 通过 LoRA 微调 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct，加入 5 种禁用食材约束；比较 SFT、GRPO 和未训练基线；使用四级 Constraint Awareness Benchmark，运行 3 个随机种子；评估行为合规、显式约束报告、第三人称知识保留、隐藏状态探测（第 24 层 MLP）、模型自述报告，并设置上下文条件奖励与正控制实验。
AI.result: 两种方法均将行为合规率从 4% 提升至约 90%，但显式约束报告低于未训练模型（0.48/5 降至 SFT 0.16/5、GRPO 0.07/5）；第三人称知识从 93% 降至 SFT 36%、GRPO 14%（两方法间 p<0.01）。奖励方法破坏性更强：惩罚禁用词奖励学成上下文无关抑制；上下文条件奖励失败并趋向两种框架下都包含。隐藏状态探测仅 83.8%，比每食材基率预测器 77.4% 高 6.4 个百分点，而模型自述 87.8% 更准确；正控制未恢复报告。
AI.conclusion: 后训练约束可带来高行为合规，却不保证能按请求显式枚举约束；这种失败特异于按要求报告约束，而非普遍丧失对约束的访问。基于奖励的惩罚尤其容易退化为上下文无关的抑制。

title: Is Imagination Derived from Hallucination? A Cross-Taxonomy Evaluation of Imagination and Hallucination in Large Language Models
summary: Imagination performs as a high-level function of large language models (LLMs) which determines the potential of how an LLM creates unseen or creative content. While existing works have built a rich family of creativity benchmarks for this ability, they only measure how far an output departs from common answers and never check whether the departure is licensed by the prompt. Moreover, hallucination, the closest neighbor of imagination, is always measured in a separate pipeline on different generations, so the influential claim that imagination and hallucination stem from the same generative mechanism has never been directly testable. In this paper, we propose Whiteboard, the first LLM imagination evaluation benchmark. Its design follows the authoritative cognitive instruments developed to measure human imagination: seven mechanism-grounded imagination subtypes are adapted from classic paradigms, then crossed with ten support-boundary hallucination subtypes and scored jointly on the same generation. Different from previous creativity or hallucination benchmarks, Whiteboard gates every imagination score with an explicit support check and computes both axes deterministically through an auditable atom matrix, with no LLM judge on the primary path. The full Whiteboard item bank contains 1,660 prompts; on its shared 80-item anchor set, we evaluate 79 state-of-the-art LLMs and validate the instrument against 13,280 human judgments. Additionally, we further explore whether imagination derives from the same generative tendency as hallucination and what key factors shape it. Our analysis indicates a counterintuitive correlation between hallucination and imagination: Most of the subtype couplings are negative, every one of the anchor items reproduces the negative coupling on its own.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个LLM想象力评测基准Whiteboard，将7种机制驱动的想象力子类型与10种支持边界幻觉子类型交叉，在同一生成上联合评分，并对79个先进LLM进行评测与人类判断验证。
AI.motivation: 现有创造力基准只衡量输出偏离常见答案的程度，却不检查这种偏离是否被提示词许可；幻觉常在不同生成和独立流程中测量，因此“想象力与幻觉源自同一生成机制”这一说法无法被直接检验。
AI.method: Whiteboard借鉴测量人类想象力的权威认知工具，设计7种想象力子类型，并与10种支持边界幻觉子类型交叉；每个想象力得分都经过显式支持检查，并通过可审计的原子矩阵确定性计算，主路径不使用LLM评判。完整题库含1660个提示，在80项锚点集上评测79个先进LLM，并用13280条人类判断验证。
AI.result: 评测与分析显示幻觉与想象力之间存在反直觉相关：大多数子类型耦合为负，且每个锚点项目单独复现负耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明想象力与幻觉未必共享同一生成倾向，二者可能呈负向耦合；Whiteboard为联合、可审计地评估想象力与支持边界幻觉提供了新工具。

title: Sufficient and Necessary Continuous Barrier-like Conditions for Discrete-Time Stochastic Reach-Avoid Verification
summary: This paper develops necessary and sufficient barrier-like characterizations using continuous barrier functions for infinite-horizon reach-avoid verification of discrete-time stochastic systems. Existing results establish necessary and sufficient conditions in terms of functional inequalities involving measurable or lower semicontinuous barrier functions. However, the limited regularity of such functions may hinder their numerical approximation and computational synthesis. Building on our previous barrier-like condition for finite-horizon reach-avoid verification, we show that this condition can also be used for infinite-horizon reach-avoid verification and, under a uniform absolute continuity condition on the transition kernels, admits a continuous barrier function whenever the exact reach-avoid probability is strictly larger than the prescribed threshold for every state in the initial set. We further show that the resulting continuous barrier function can be uniformly approximated by a polynomial one while preserving the required barrier-like conditions. For polynomial systems, we formulate these conditions as polynomial positivity constraints over compact basic semialgebraic sets. Putinar's Positivstellensatz then converts the positivity conditions into sum-of-squares (SOS) certificates, yielding semidefinite programming (SDP) formulations for synthesizing polynomial barrier functions. We establish both soundness and completeness of the resulting SOS-based procedure. Finally, two numerical examples illustrate the theoretical results and demonstrate the resulting SDP approach.

AI.tldr: 本文为离散时间随机系统的无限时域到达-规避验证，建立了基于连续障碍函数的必要且充分类障碍刻画，并进一步给出可计算的多项式障碍函数SOS/SDP合成方法。
AI.motivation: 现有必要且充分条件多使用可测或下半连续障碍函数，其正则性不足，可能妨碍数值近似和计算合成。
AI.method: 在作者此前有限时域类障碍条件基础上，证明该条件也适用于无限时域到达-规避验证；在转移核满足一致绝对连续条件下，若初始集内每个状态的精确到达-规避概率严格大于给定阈值，则存在连续障碍函数。进一步证明该连续障碍函数可被多项式一致逼近并保持类障碍条件。对多项式系统，将条件转化为紧基本半代数集上的多项式正性约束，利用Putinar Positivstellensatz转化为平方和(SOS)证书，从而得到半定规划(SDP)合成公式。
AI.result: 得到无限时域到达-规避验证的必要且充分连续障碍刻画；连续障碍函数可由多项式一致逼近；对多项式系统建立SOS-based合成流程，并证明该流程的可靠性与完备性；两个数值例子验证理论结果并展示SDP方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提升了无限时域随机系统到达-规避验证中障碍函数的正则性与可计算性，为多项式系统提供了基于SOS/SDP的屏障函数合成途径。

title: DOA-SORT: Directional Occlusion-Aware Multi-Object Tracking with Distributional Observations
summary: Identity association in multi-object tracking (MOT) is vulnerable to partial occlusion, truncated detections, and fluctuating confidence scores. Existing motion-dominant trackers commonly represent occlusion as a scalar penalty. This treatment misses the directional observation bias caused by occlusion: left, right, top, and bottom occlusions distort the location and shape of a detection in different ways. We propose \ours{} (Directional Occlusion-Aware SORT), an online and training-free tracker that models these biases explicitly. First, it infers a soft front--back ordering from box overlap and relative bottom positions, and estimates directional occlusion coverage and depth. It then constructs a mixture of one clean and four directional occlusion observation components. The model uses a five-dimensional observation comprising box center, area, confidence, and aspect ratio, and adapts observation noise to predicted occlusion and detection confidence. The directional mixture likelihood is used in high-confidence association, low-confidence association, and track recovery; ambiguity penalties and local order-consistency swaps further reduce identity errors among nearby objects. On the DanceTrack validation split, \ours{} improves HOTA from 63.00 to 66.34, AssA from 45.10 to 49.57, and IDF1 from 62.19 to 65.28 over OA-SORT with the same detector and evaluation protocol. The gains are concentrated in association quality while detection accuracy remains stable. Additional local evaluations on MOT17 and MOT20 train splits characterize cross-dataset behavior under the same no-ReID tracking protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出方向性遮挡感知的在线免训练跟踪器 DOA-SORT，通过显式建模不同方向遮挡造成的观测偏差，提升多目标跟踪中的身份关联质量。
AI.motivation: 多目标跟踪的身份关联易受部分遮挡、检测截断和置信度波动影响。现有以运动为主导的跟踪器通常将遮挡表示为标量惩罚，忽略了左、右、上、下不同方向遮挡对检测框位置和形状造成的方向性观测偏差。
AI.method: DOA-SORT 从框重叠和相对底部位置推断软的前后排序，并估计方向性遮挡覆盖与深度；构建一个干净观测分量和四个方向性遮挡观测分量的混合模型。观测向量为五维：框中心、面积、置信度和宽高比，并根据预测遮挡与检测置信度自适应调整观测噪声。方向性混合似然用于高置信关联、低置信关联和轨迹恢复，同时引入歧义惩罚和局部顺序一致性交换以减少邻近目标间的身份错误。
AI.result: 在 DanceTrack 验证集上，相同检测器和评估协议下，DOA-SORT 相比 OA-SORT 将 HOTA 从 63.00 提升到 66.34，AssA 从 45.10 提升到 49.57，IDF1 从 62.19 提升到 65.28。提升主要集中在关联质量，检测精度保持稳定。在 MOT17 和 MOT20 训练集上的额外本地评估刻画了相同无 ReID 跟踪协议下的跨数据集表现。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模方向性遮挡偏差可有效改善多目标跟踪的身份关联，且该方法在线、免训练，在关联指标上取得显著提升，同时保持检测性能稳定。

title: PINNForge: Execution-Grounded Evolutionary Design of Physics-Informed Neural Networks for PDE Solving via Large Language Models
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) require coordinated choices over network representation, sampling, loss construction, and optimization, while effective configurations often vary substantially across partial differential equations (PDEs). Existing automated PINN design methods can search candidate configurations, but information revealed during actual training is still used mainly for evaluation rather than to improve subsequent design, leading to repeated trial-and-error and inefficient use of training budget. We propose PINNsForge, an LLM-driven evolutionary framework for execution-feedback-based automated PINN design. PINNsForge generates diverse candidate configurations from PDE-related prior knowledge, evaluates them through actual training, and feeds high-performing designs together with accumulated execution evidence back to the LLM. Guided by observed optimization behavior, the LLM then refines, recombines, and explores coupled PINN design components, forming a continual cycle of generation, execution, feedback, and evolution. Unlike one-shot search or evaluation-only feedback, PINNsForge progressively converts training experience into improved design decisions for the target PDE. Across 25 PDE benchmarks, PINNsForge achieves the lowest mean MSE on 24 tasks compared with RoPINN, PINNsFormer, and PINNsAgent. Ablation studies further confirm the importance of the PDE knowledge base, execution feedback, and evolutionary search: removing these components increases the mean MSE to 3.74$\times$, 12.10$\times$, and 10.10$\times$ that of the full PINNsForge, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出PINNsForge，一种基于LLM驱动进化与执行反馈的PINN自动化设计框架，在25个PDE基准中的24个上取得最低平均MSE。
AI.motivation: PINN设计需要协同选择网络表示、采样、损失构造和优化方法，且有效配置常因PDE而异。现有自动化方法虽能搜索候选配置，但训练中产生的信息主要用于评估，而非改进后续设计，导致重复试错和训练预算低效。
AI.method: PINNsForge利用PDE先验知识生成多样化候选配置，通过实际训练进行评估，并将高性能设计与累积执行证据反馈给LLM。LLM根据观察到的优化行为，对耦合的PINN设计组件进行细化、重组和探索，形成生成、执行、反馈、进化的持续循环。
AI.result: 在25个PDE基准上，与RoPINN、PINNsFormer和PINNsAgent相比，PINNsForge在24个任务上取得最低平均MSE。消融实验表明PDE知识库、执行反馈和进化搜索均重要：移除这些组件后，平均MSE分别增至完整PINNsForge的3.74倍、12.10倍和10.10倍。
AI.conclusion: PINNsForge不同于一次性搜索或仅用于评估的反馈，能够逐步将训练经验转化为针对目标PDE的更好设计决策，并验证了PDE知识、执行反馈与进化搜索的关键作用。

title: Task-Oriented Co-Design and Optimization of Geared Actuators for Robotic Applications
summary: Different tasks performed by legged robots impose distinct torque and speed requirements on actuators. Existing robotic actuators are generally optimized at the component level for metrics such as torque or power density, without explicit task guidance. System-level optimization across components such as motors, gearboxes, and sensors is challenging because of the high computational cost and coupling among mechanical, electrical, and electromagnetic behaviors. Consequently, improvements in individual components may not translate into better robot performance in a specific task. To this end, we present a systematic optimization framework for task-oriented co-design of actuator hardware and control. First, surrogate models are employed to accelerate motor evaluation and support global exploration of the coupled design space. Then, a hierarchical mixed-variable optimization strategy is adopted, combining discrete enumeration with continuous search over dimensions and real-valued indices. These indices are rounded to select admissible values for the remaining discrete choices before each evaluation. Within this search, rated output torque density and task performance are jointly optimized, with Bezier-parameterized joint torque profiles determined for each hardware candidate. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated through actuator fabrication and experiments on a two-degree-of-freedom jumping leg. Based on its measured mass, the fabricated prototype achieves a nominal rated output torque density of 35.7 N m/kg, approximately 60% higher than that of a widely used commercial geared joint actuator, while being 18.6% lighter. Under matched bench conditions, it achieves 12.0% greater jump height at twice-rated torque. Together, these results demonstrate a systematic route from task requirements to actuator design and control.

AI.tldr: 提出一种任务导向的执行器硬件与控制协同设计优化框架，并通过二自由度跳跃腿的制造与实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 不同任务对执行器扭矩和速度需求不同，现有执行器多在组件层面优化，缺乏任务指导；系统级协同设计因计算成本高及机械、电气、电磁耦合而困难，单个组件改进未必提升机器人任务性能。
AI.method: 采用代理模型加速电机评估并全局探索耦合设计空间；采用分层混合变量优化，结合离散枚举与连续搜索（尺寸和实值索引），索引取整选择离散值；联合优化额定输出扭矩密度和任务性能，并用Bezier参数化关节扭矩曲线。
AI.result: 制作样机额定输出扭矩密度35.7 Nm/kg，比商用齿轮关节执行器高约60%，重量轻18.6%；在匹配台架条件下，两倍额定扭矩时跳跃高度提高12.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该框架能实现从任务需求到执行器设计与控制的系统化路径。

title: ZIL: Zero-shot Image-to-LiDAR Registration
summary: Image-to-LiDAR registration estimates the camera pose of an image with respect to a LiDAR point cloud. It has diverse applications in autonomous driving, robot navigation etc. However, state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods still 1) mostly assume same-frame inputs, struggling with the image and point cloud from distant frames; 2) rely on domain-specific training, failing to generalize to unseen scenarios. We propose ZIL, the first foundation model for zero-shot non-synchronized image-to-LiDAR registration. ZIL encodes the input image and point cloud with the Vision and Point Transformers. In addition to regressing the relative pose, ZIL also learns to predict 3D coordinates, which substantially improves the pose accuracy without additional annotations. Interestingly, naive mix-data training cannot enable zero-shot generalization, which requires normalization on both camera intrinsics and the LiDAR vertical-axis origin. Trained on 7 public datasets with 1.4M LiDAR frames, ZIL consistently and significantly outperforms previous SOTA with a single model across 5 in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, reducing the translation and rotation errors by up to 87% and 76% (shown in Fig. 1). Code and models are available at https://github.com/ZijunLi7/ZIL.

AI.tldr: 提出ZIL，首个用于零样本、非同步图像到LiDAR配准的基础模型，在7个数据集上训练，跨域泛化能力显著。
AI.motivation: 现有SOTA方法多假设图像与点云同帧输入，难以处理远帧数据；且依赖领域特定训练，无法泛化到未见场景。
AI.method: 使用Vision Transformer和Point Transformer分别编码图像与点云；在回归相对位姿的同时学习预测3D坐标以提升精度；通过相机内参和LiDAR垂直轴原点归一化实现零样本泛化；在7个公开数据集共140万LiDAR帧上训练。
AI.result: 单一模型在5个域内和零样本基准上持续显著超越先前SOTA，平移和旋转误差最多降低87%和76%。
AI.conclusion: ZIL验证了归一化与辅助3D坐标预测对零样本非同步图像-LiDAR配准的有效性，并提供了代码与模型。

title: Beyond Raw Context Transfer: Representation-based Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) by grounding generation in external knowledge. However, most existing RAG frameworks assume a centralized retrieval corpus, which is often impractical in sensitive domains such as healthcare, where data are inherently distributed and raw content cannot be directly shared across institutions. Recent efforts on decentralized RAG primarily follow prompt-based paradigms that exchange raw, human-readable retrieved content, leading to substantial inference-time computational overhead and direct exposure of retrieved information. To address these limitations, we propose Representation-based Federated RAG (FedRepRAG), a decentralized RAG framework that keeps raw documents at their owning clients and exchanges only compact latent representations during cross-client retrieval. To integrate retrieved knowledge, we introduce a collaboratively trained projector that converts retrieval embeddings into generator-compatible representation tokens for a frozen LLM/VLM backbone. Experiments across decentralized visual question answering (VQA) and question answering (QA) benchmarks show that FedRepRAG consistently outperforms direct inference and local retrieval baselines while substantially reducing retrieval-context length and inference-time computational overhead compared with raw-context transfer. Further analyses confirm the importance of query-relevant retrieved representations and characterize the residual representation-level leakage associated with representation exchange. Overall, FedRepRAG provides an effective and efficient framework for federated RAG without transferring raw retrieved content.

AI.tldr: 提出 FedRepRAG，一种基于表示交换的联邦 RAG 框架，在跨客户端检索时仅交换紧凑潜在表示而非原始文档，以提升效率并降低隐私暴露。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 多假设集中式检索语料，在医疗等敏感且数据分布式场景中不现实；已有去中心化 RAG 多采用提示范式交换原始可读检索内容，导致推理开销大且直接暴露检索信息。
AI.method: FedRepRAG 将原始文档保留在所属客户端，跨客户端检索时只交换紧凑的潜在表示；引入协同训练投影器，将检索嵌入转换为冻结 LLM/VLM 主干可用的表示 token，以整合检索知识。
AI.result: 在去中心化 VQA 和 QA 基准上，FedRepRAG 持续优于直接推理与本地检索基线，并较原始上下文传输显著缩短检索上下文长度、降低推理计算开销；分析验证了查询相关检索表示的重要性，并刻画了表示交换带来的残余表示级泄漏。
AI.conclusion: FedRepRAG 为联邦 RAG 提供了一种有效且高效的框架，无需传输原始检索内容。

title: Expert-Play Contouring Control: Faster-than-Demonstration Planning from Slow Expert and Fast Play
summary: Expert demonstrations often specify what a robot should do, but not how fast it can do it. Imitation Learning (IL) inherits demonstration timing, while directly accelerating the learned motion can fail when faster execution changes the robot-object dynamics. We study faster-than-demonstration execution as a dynamics-aware control problem and introduce Expert-Play Contouring Control (EPCC), which combines slow expert demonstrations with fast, non-expert play. Expert demonstrations train a latent trajectory generator whose predictions are reparameterized into a time-independent contour of successful task progression, while play trains a world model (WM) of fast-action outcomes. At deployment, our proposed planner uses the WM to optimize actions that makes maximize progress along the expert-derived contour while penalizing deviation from the intended task evolution. Averaged across three visuomotor manipulation tasks, EPCC achieves a $2.0\times$ the throughput of the IL baseline, including $2.2\times$ that of the throughput of the strongest acceleration baseline on a task with interaction-sensitive object dynamics. Our analysis shows that the gains concentrate where faster execution changes robot-object evolution. Together, our results highlight a simple yet effective principle: demonstrations provide task intent, while play data provides the dynamic coverage needed to execute that intent faster.

AI.tldr: 研究比专家示范更快的执行问题，提出EPCC方法，结合慢速专家示范与快速非专家玩耍数据，在三个视觉运动操作任务上平均达到IL基线2.0倍吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习继承示范速度，但直接加速学习到的动作可能因机器人-物体动力学变化而失败，因此需要将更快执行视为动力学感知的控制问题。
AI.method: EPCC结合慢专家示范与快速非专家玩耍：专家示范训练潜在轨迹生成器，其预测重参数化为时间无关的成功任务进展轮廓；玩耍数据训练快速动作结果的世界模型。部署时规划器利用世界模型优化动作，使其沿专家轮廓最大化进展，同时惩罚偏离预期任务演化。
AI.result: 在三个视觉运动操作任务上平均吞吐量为IL基线的2.0倍；在交互敏感物体动力学任务上为最强加速基线的2.2倍。增益集中在快速执行改变机器人-物体演化的场景。
AI.conclusion: 示范提供任务意图，玩耍数据提供更快执行该意图所需的动态覆盖，这一原则简单而有效。
