title: Towards Robust Classroom Attendance: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Face Detection and Recognition Models
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the International Conference on Converging Intelligence (CICON 2026), Track 1: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
summary: Manual attendance methods, such as paper or register-based systems, take a lot of time, can lead to errors, and are easy to falsify. Face recognition is more reliable, but it frequently struggles in classrooms because lighting and other conditions can vary. Face recognition datasets are designed for regulated environments and do not capture the actual challenges found in classrooms. To address this, a new face detection and recognition dataset, the Visage Face dataset, comprising 16,234 face samples, is proposed for the task of face detection and recognition. The photos are taken from different angles and under varying lighting conditions, with students showing a range of expressions, and some faces partly covered to reflect real-life situations. A YOLO-based system is used to detect faces and tested seven advanced face recognition models with thirteen configurations: LVFace, QCFace, FaceLiVTv2, TopoFR, EdgeFace, TransFace, and GhostFaceNets. Of these, FaceLiVTv2-M performed best, with 99.75% Top-1/Top-5 accuracy and an inference time of 6.459 ms. These results show that the Visage Face Dataset is a realistic and challenging benchmark for face recognition in classroom attendance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用于课堂考勤的人脸检测与识别数据集 Visage Face，包含16,234个人脸样本，并基于YOLO检测和多种先进人脸识别模型进行评测。
AI.motivation: 传统人工考勤耗时、易出错且易造假；人脸识别虽更可靠，但在教室中受光照和条件变化影响大，且现有数据集无法反映真实课堂挑战。
AI.method: 构建 Visage Face 数据集，采集不同角度、光照、表情及部分遮挡的人脸图像；使用基于YOLO的系统进行人脸检测；评测7种先进人脸识别模型（LVFace、QCFace、FaceLiVTv2、TopoFR、EdgeFace、TransFace、GhostFaceNets）的13种配置。
AI.result: FaceLiVTv2-M表现最佳，Top-1/Top-5准确率达99.75%，推理时间为6.459 ms。
AI.conclusion: Visage Face 数据集可作为课堂考勤人脸识别中现实且具有挑战性的基准。

title: MechaTerp-TRACE: A Novel Approach for Component Ablation Analysis in Language Models
summary: Interpretability research on large language models has produced accounts of factual recall in feed-forward layers and of token relationships in self-attention, but little work offers a unified way to compare the causal contribution of different architecture components to a model's output. We introduce MechaTerp (the Mechanistic Interpretability suite) -TRACE (subset for Teacher-forced Registry of Ablated Component Effects), an architecture and study that measures how much each registered component of a language model supports the production of a named entity. TRACE ablates one component at a time and measures the resulting change in the output distribution at a fixed answer token, so component types from whole transformer blocks down to individual neurons and output logits can be compared on a common scale. We apply it to thirteen instruction-tuned dense decoder models spanning five families and one to thirty billion parameters, ablating 49,656 components across 48 medical and 42 general-knowledge prompts. We find that the components carrying the most effect are the same few, positionally fixed components in every model, regardless of which entity a prompt asks about, and that once these are removed, the remaining support is close to evenly spread in eleven of the thirteen models. Apparent localisation of entity knowledge is therefore largely attributable to generic generation machinery, which has direct consequences for methods that assume entity knowledge sits in a findable place, including targeted knowledge editing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MechaTerp-TRACE，用于在统一尺度上比较语言模型不同架构组件对命名实体输出的因果贡献，并发现实体知识定位主要来自通用生成机制而非实体专属存储。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型可解释性研究分别描述了前馈层中的事实回忆和自注意力中的词元关系，但缺少统一方法比较不同架构组件对模型输出的因果贡献，尤其是实体知识是否存在于可定位位置这一问题。
AI.method: 提出 TRACE，一次消融一个已注册组件，并在固定答案词元处测量输出分布变化，从而比较从整个 Transformer 块到单个神经元和输出 logits 等组件类型。应用于 13 个指令微调稠密解码器模型、5 个模型家族、1B 到 30B 参数，覆盖 48 个医学提示和 42 个常识提示，共消融 49,656 个组件。
AI.result: 承载最大效应的组件在所有模型中都是少数位置固定的组件，且与提示询问的具体实体无关；移除这些组件后，在 13 个模型中的 11 个里，剩余支持近乎均匀分布。
AI.conclusion: 实体知识表面上的局部化很大程度上归因于通用生成机制，这对假设实体知识位于可发现位置的方法（包括定向知识编辑）有直接影响。

title: Sufficient and Necessary Smooth Barrier-like Conditions for Continuous-Time Stochastic Reach-Avoid Verification
summary: In this paper, we study infinite-horizon reach-avoid verification for continuous-time stochastic systems modeled by stochastic differential equations (SDEs). We formulate this problem within a barrier-function-based framework, which transforms the verification problem into an existence problem for barrier functions satisfying barrier-like conditions expressed as functional inequalities. We provide sufficient and necessary barrier-like conditions in terms of polynomial barrier functions for infinite-horizon reach-avoid verification under suitable regularity and uniform ellipticity assumptions. We first construct a discounted value function that characterizes lower bounds on the reach-avoid probability. We then show that it is the unique classical solution of an associated elliptic Dirichlet problem. Based on this characterization, we further show that the barrier-like condition proposed in our previous work on finite-horizon reach-avoid verification is not only sufficient for infinite-horizon reach-avoid verification but also necessary whenever the reach-avoid probability is strictly larger than the specified threshold. In particular, whenever the reach-avoid probability is strictly larger than the specified threshold fro every state in the initial set, polynomial barrier functions satisfying this barrier-like condition exist. Furthermore, when the system dynamics are polynomial, we formulate the problem of finding polynomial barrier functions satisfying this barrier-like condition as sum-of-squares (SOS) programs, which are shown to be sound and complete. Finally, we demonstrate the theoretical results on two numerical examples.

AI.tldr: 本文研究连续时间随机系统在无限时间范围下的到达-规避验证问题，基于障碍函数框架，给出了多项式障碍函数的充分必要条件，并将其转化为平方和（SOS）程序进行求解。
AI.motivation: 无限时间范围下随机系统的到达-规避验证需要更严格的数学工具；已有有限时间范围的障碍函数条件是否适用于无限时间范围、以及如何计算多项式障碍函数尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用障碍函数框架，将验证问题转化为满足函数不等式的障碍函数存在性问题；构造折扣值函数，证明其是相关椭圆Dirichlet问题的唯一经典解；在正则性和一致椭圆性假设下，建立多项式障碍函数的充分必要条什；当系统动态为多项式时，将寻找障碍函数的问题建模为SOS程序。
AI.result: 证明了先前有限时间范围到达-规避验证中的障碍函数条件在无限时间范围下不仅是充分的，而且在到达-规避概率严格大于给定阈值时也是必要的；只要初始集中每个状态的到达-规避概率严格大于阈值，就存在满足该条件的多项式障碍函数；SOS程序被证明是可靠且完备的；通过两个数值例子验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文为连续时间随机系统的无限时间范围到达-规避验证提供了基于障碍函数的理论框架，将有限时间范围的充分条件扩展为无限时间范围下的充分必要条件，并给出了多项式动态下可计算且完备的SOS求解方法。

title: Spatial-Interactor: Learning Spatial Reasoning through Interaction with the Observable Physical World
summary: Spatial reasoning is essential for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand and act in the physical world. Reasoning in dynamic environments requires VLMs to perceive local state transitions caused by object motion and viewpoint changes and integrate them over long trajectories to maintain an updated spatial state, yet existing VLMs remain limited in both capabilities. Current spatial training primarily focuses on static questions about object attributes and spatial relations, providing limited direct supervision for state transitions; in contrast, interaction trajectories naturally connect a preceding observation, an action, and a subsequent observation, offering direct supervision for local state transitions, while complete trajectories reveal dependencies among consecutive transitions. We therefore introduce Spatial-Interactor, a framework that trains VLMs to model physical-world state transitions through interaction, organizing this learning process into a three-level curriculum covering L1 passive world-state transitions, L2 active self-state transitions, and L3 long-horizon interaction trajectories. Accordingly, we construct the Learning from Spatial Interaction dataset (LSI-108K) from simulated and real interaction trajectories, with tasks aligned with the objective of each level. Our two-stage training strategy applies Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to L1 and L2 for local transition modeling, and On-Policy Distillation (OPD) then uses privileged self-distillation: a teacher branch given segment-level transition descriptions supervises the student's on-policy CoT, helping the student learn to integrate consecutive transitions over L3 long trajectories. Experiments across multiple VLMs and spatial benchmarks show consistent gains in local transition modeling and long-horizon integration.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spatial-Interactor 框架，通过交互轨迹三级课程训练视觉语言模型建模物理世界状态转移，并构建 LSI-108K 数据集，以提升局部状态转移建模和长时程空间整合能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 空间推理主要关注静态物体属性与空间关系，缺乏对物体运动、视角变化引起的局部状态转移及长轨迹依赖的直接监督，难以在动态环境中维持更新空间状态。
AI.method: 设计三级课程：L1 被动世界状态转移、L2 主动自状态转移、L3 长时程交互轨迹；构建 LSI-108K 仿真与真实交互轨迹数据集；采用两阶段训练：先对 L1/L2 进行 SFT 学习局部转移，再用 On-Policy Distillation 和特权自蒸馏，由教师分支基于片段级转移描述监督学生 on-policy CoT，以整合 L3 连续转移。
AI.result: 在多个 VLM 和空间基准上取得一致性能提升，尤其在局部状态转移建模和长时程整合方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 利用交互轨迹与分级课程可有效增强 VLM 对动态空间状态转移的建模能力，并提升长时程空间推理表现。

title: Enforcing Narrative Reliability and Epistemic Pacing in LLM-Driven Detective Games via Structured Knowledge Trees
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable open-ended dialogue in interactive games, but their non-deterministic outputs make it difficult to preserve authorial control, factual consistency, and the intended sequence of information disclosure. These challenges are particularly significant in detective games, where premature revelation or fabricated details can undermine the logic of player progression. We present a Structured Knowledge Tree architecture coupled with a tri-agent LLM pipeline for controlling dialogue in an open-ended interrogation game. The system separates knowledge retrieval, dialogue generation, and response verification to ensure that the virtual suspect reveals only information permitted by the current narrative state. We evaluate the approach through The Interrogation of Adrian Gale, a playable detective-game testbed, and a formal user study examining hallucination reduction, adherence to authored disclosure sequences, and perceived logical progression. Our results demonstrate that the structured architecture reduces critical hallucinations by 64.78% and entirely prevents premature narrative disclosure. While the strict mechanical constraints introduced usability trade-offs regarding forced conversational reveals, the system successfully enforces rigorous epistemic pacing and provides players with a clear, subjective sense of progression toward solving the case.

AI.tldr: 论文提出结构化知识树架构与三智能体LLM流水线，用于侦探审讯游戏的开放式对话控制，防止幻觉和过早披露剧情信息，并通过可玩测试床和用户研究验证效果。
AI.motivation: LLM虽能支持交互游戏开放对话，但其非确定性输出难以维持作者控制、事实一致性和预设信息披露顺序。在侦探游戏中，过早揭示或编造细节会破坏玩家推理进程和游戏逻辑。
AI.method: 构建结构化知识树架构，结合三智能体LLM流水线，将知识检索、对话生成和响应验证分离，确保虚拟嫌疑人只披露当前叙事状态允许的信息。通过《The Interrogation of Adrian Gale》可玩测试床和正式用户研究，评估幻觉减少、作者披露顺序遵循及逻辑推进感知。
AI.result: 结构化架构将关键幻觉减少64.78%，并完全防止过早叙事披露。严格机械约束带来可用性权衡，例如强制对话揭示，但系统成功实现严格的认知节奏控制，并让玩家对破案进展有清晰的主观感受。
AI.conclusion: 结构化知识树与多智能体LLM流水线能有效控制侦探游戏开放对话中的幻觉和披露顺序，维护作者意图与推理体验，但需在自然对话和机械约束之间进行权衡。

title: DriveReferee: Geometric Safety Verdicts Need Not Be Learned for Driving World-Action Models
summary: Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and vehicle actions, while their action branches remain primarily optimized by expert imitation. Yet imitation provides no explicit closed-loop geometric verdict for generated trajectories, making verification important during both training and deployment. Closed-loop evaluators can check collision and drivable-area violations, but require privileged scene state unavailable at deployment. Existing approaches often close this gap by learning a verifier from sensor features. For these geometric checks, the rule itself is explicit. For example, collision is determined by whether the rolled-out ego footprint overlaps occupied vehicle space. What is unavailable at deployment is the scene state needed to apply the rule. We introduce DriveReferee, which uses a learned geometry readout to predict the scene representation from camera observations and executes the geometric safety rule directly rather than learning it. The resulting analytic referee evaluates collision and drivable-area safety from a scene state and candidate trajectory. During training, it scores self-sampled trajectories on ground-truth state and distills the resulting preferences into the WAM policy. At deployment, the same referee evaluates generated trajectories on this predicted state and selects a safer alternative when needed. The analytic referee requires no verdict-specific training, and its decisions follow an explicit geometric rule. Under matched candidates and inference budgets, it matches or outperforms all learned-verifier and heuristic baselines. Given the same predicted state and trajectory, learning the verdict provides no measurable downstream gain despite requiring tens of thousands of evaluator-labeled training examples. On the full NAVSIM navtest, DriveReferee reaches 92.02 PDMS with single-camera visual input and no external training data.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DriveReferee，一种面向生成式世界-动作模型的解析式几何裁判：它从相机观测预测场景表示，并直接执行碰撞与可行驶区域等显式几何规则，用于训练时偏好蒸馏和部署时轨迹安全筛选。
AI.motivation: 生成式世界-动作模型主要依赖专家模仿优化动作分支，缺乏对生成轨迹的闭环几何验证；现有闭环评估器虽能检查碰撞和可行驶区域违规，但需要部署时不可用的特权场景状态，而从传感器特征学习验证器又不如显式规则直接。
AI.method: DriveReferee 使用学习到的几何读出从相机观测预测场景表示，然后直接执行显式几何安全规则，而非学习规则本身。训练时，它在真实场景状态上对自采样轨迹评分，并将偏好蒸馏到 WAM 策略；部署时，它在预测状态上评估生成轨迹，并在需要时选择更安全的替代轨迹。
AI.result: 在匹配候选轨迹和推理预算下，DriveReferee 达到或超过所有学习验证器和启发式基线；给定相同预测状态与轨迹，学习判定结果即使需要数万条评估器标注训练样本，也没有可测量的下游收益。在完整 NAVSIM navtest 上，仅用单相机视觉输入且无外部训练数据，DriveReferee 达到 92.02 PDMS。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何规则可直接用于生成轨迹的安全验证，无需针对判定结果进行训练；DriveReferee 能有效弥合训练与部署中的闭环几何验证缺口，并在 NAVSIM 上取得强性能。

title: The Operational Value of Spatial Dependence in Renewable Forecast Scenarios for Single-Period Economic Dispatch: A Controlled Ablation Study
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible. 10 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
summary: Renewable forecasts are evaluated by statistical skill (e.g., CRPS), but grid operators pay for realized dispatch cost. We diagnose what drives dispatch value in a single-period newsvendor-style economic dispatch using real public data from two European transmission systems (CWE, DE-4TSO). Spatial coherence across forecast sites falls below the pre-specified 1% practical-significance threshold: a controlled ablation holding per-zone marginal forecasts bit-identical and varying only cross-zone dependence (10 configurations, 3 seeds, paired-bootstrap confidence intervals) shows a coherence gain of at most 0.64% of dispatch cost, indistinguishable from zero in 3 of 10 configurations, reached only under an unrealistic 8-fold forecast-error stress test. Decision-focused training, an established paradigm in this venue, delivers a robust 2.82-5.19% gain. A parametric Gaussian-copula approximation matches the empirical copula at realistic error magnitudes but performs worse than no dependence under extreme stress. A single-seed sweep shows that a 12% energy-score gain changes cost by less than 0.1%. Results characterize this single-period dispatch class; a lightweight four-period extension supports the same conclusion. For this dispatch class, spatially-correlated scenario generation provides limited operational value on its own; grid operators and forecast vendors should instead evaluate dependence models by downstream decision value and prioritize decision-focused training.

AI.tldr: 论文诊断可再生能源预测中空间相关性对单时段报童式经济调度价值的影响，基于欧洲两个输电系统真实数据，发现空间相干性带来的调度成本增益极小，而决策导向训练的收益稳健且显著。
AI.motivation: 可再生能源预测通常以CRPS等统计技能评估，但电网运营商真正关心的是实际调度成本；因此需要弄清空间相关情景生成或依赖模型是否具有下游运营价值。
AI.method: 使用CWE和DE-4TSO真实公共数据，构建单时段newsvendor式经济调度；通过控制消融保持各分区边际预测完全一致，仅改变跨区依赖，设置10种配置、3个随机种子并计算配对自助置信区间；对比决策导向训练、高斯copula近似、能量分数等指标，并做四时段轻量扩展。
AI.result: 空间相干增益最多仅占调度成本的0.64%，10个配置中3个与零无法区分，且仅在不现实的8倍预测误差压力测试下才出现；决策导向训练带来2.82%-5.19%的稳健增益；高斯copula近似在现实误差下匹配经验copula，但在极端压力下不如无依赖；能量分数提升12%时成本变化小于0.1%。
AI.conclusion: 对该单时段经济调度类问题，空间相关情景生成本身提供的运营价值有限；电网运营商和预测供应商应按下游决策价值评估依赖模型，并优先采用决策导向训练；四时段扩展支持相同结论。

title: ARCGym: Benchmarking Deep Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Robotic Colonoscopy
summary: Simulations for learning-based autonomous colonoscopic navigation focus mainly on fully actuated capsule robots, failing to capture the contact-rich navigation of long and flexible clinical colonoscopes. We present the Autonomous Robotic Colonoscopy Gym (ARCGym), an open-source reinforcement learning environment and benchmark for image-based navigation in clinically derived deformable colon anatomies. ARCGym supports multiple types of colonoscope robots, spanning capsule robots and flexible endoscopes, with this work focusing on flexible endoscopes including magnetic-driven tip actuation and clinically used proximally translational actuation. This work includes five CT-reconstructed colons representing typical clinical scenarios, a set of clinically meaningful navigation subtasks, and unified success metrics. We introduce a reward combining depth-based lumen alignment with a lumen-visibility score to improve learning under occlusions. Experiments across tasks, robots, and anatomies show that autonomous navigation remains challenging for both magnetic-driven and proximal-insertion flexible robots, with proximal-insertion actuation remaining an open problem.

AI.tldr: 提出ARCGym：一个面向临床衍生可变形结肠解剖、基于图像的自主结肠镜导航开源强化学习环境与基准，支持胶囊机器人和柔性内窥镜，聚焦磁驱动尖端驱动与临床近端平移插入。包含5个CT重建结肠、临床相关子任务和统一成功指标。实验表明自主导航仍具挑战，近端插入驱动仍是未解决问题。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型自主结肠镜导航仿真主要关注全驱动胶囊机器人，无法捕捉长而柔性的临床结肠镜在接触丰富环境中的导航特性。因此，需要一个更贴近临床、支持多类结肠镜机器人、可变形解剖和统一评估的强化学习基准。
AI.method: 构建ARCGym开源强化学习环境与基准，支持胶囊机器人和柔性内窥镜，重点研究磁驱动尖端驱动和临床使用的近端平移插入驱动。使用5个CT重建结肠代表典型临床场景，设计临床相关导航子任务和统一成功指标。提出结合深度基腔对齐与腔可见性评分的奖励函数，以改善遮挡下的学习。跨任务、机器人和解剖结构进行实验。
AI.result: 实验显示，自主导航对磁驱动柔性机器人和近端插入柔性机器人都仍然困难，其中近端插入驱动仍是未解决问题。
AI.conclusion: ARCGym为临床相关柔性结肠镜自主导航提供了开源仿真与评估基准，并表明该领域仍面临显著挑战，尤其是近端插入驱动需要进一步研究。

title: Remote State Estimation with Unreliable Communication: Information Asymmetry and Belief Structure
summary: In this paper, we study remote state estimation under unreliable forward and feedback communication between a smart sensor and a remote estimator. When the sensor cannot perfectly reconstruct the filtering state maintained by the remote estimator, an information asymmetry arises between the two sides of the network. To analyze this asymmetry, we first characterize the internal state maintained by the remote estimator and its evolution under the packet reception process. The sensor's uncertainty about this state is then captured through a belief conditioned on its information set, and we derive a recursive update under noisy acknowledgment feedback. Finally, we show that the resulting belief admits a finite Gaussian mixture representation whose number of components grows at most linearly over time, ensuring computational tractability. Simulation results illustrate the impact of information asymmetry on the estimation performance and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在正向与反馈通信均不可靠的情况下，智能传感器与远程估计器之间的远程状态估计问题，重点分析由信息不对称引起的传感器信念更新，并证明该信念可用有限高斯混合表示。
AI.motivation: 当传感器无法准确重建远程估计器维护的滤波状态时，网络两端会出现信息不对称，这会直接影响远程状态估计性能，因此需要对此进行建模与分析。
AI.method: 首先刻画远程估计器内部状态及其在数据包接收过程中的演化；然后将传感器对该状态的不确定性建模为基于其信息集的信念，并在含噪确认反馈下推导递归更新；最后分析该信念的有限高斯混合表示及计算可处理性。
AI.result: 证明了所得信念具有有限高斯混合形式，且混合分量数量随时间最多线性增长，从而保证计算可处理性；仿真结果展示了信息不对称对估计性能的影响以及所提框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 信息不对称会影响远程状态估计性能，而基于信念递归更新和高斯混合表示的方法能够有效刻画该问题并保持计算可行性。

title: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for Source-Grounded Synthetic Note Generation from Longitudinal Structured EHR
comment: Accepted at the FMSD Workshop, ICML 2026
summary: Structured EHR is abundant but sparse, coded, and difficult to use directly for note-centric clinical modeling. We present MedNotes, a multi-agent synthetic data generation pipeline that converts longitudinal structured EHR into source-grounded clinical note representations under explicit quality control. MedNotes treats structured-data-to-text synthesis as a closed-loop agentic process: a generator proposes a note, evaluator agents diagnose factual, coverage, structural, and hallucination-related failures, and a router accepts, revises, or rejects the draft. On 1,485 EHRSHOT encounters, MedNotes achieves a 91.4% pass rate, with mean factual accuracy of 0.980, completeness of 99.1%, structural fidelity of 0.761, and 0.028 critical hallucinations per encounter. Iterative refinement improves acceptance from 69.4% to 91.4%. The resulting synthetic corpus improves downstream CPT prediction and paragraph-level section prediction when combined with limited real data.

AI.tldr: MedNotes 是一个多智能体合成数据生成流程，可将纵向结构化电子健康记录（EHR）转化为有来源依据的临床笔记，并带有明确质量控制；在 EHRSHOT 数据上表现良好，且合成语料能提升下游任务。
AI.motivation: 结构化 EHR 丰富但稀疏、编码化，难以直接用于以笔记为中心的临床建模，因此需要将结构化数据转化为高质量临床笔记。
AI.method: 提出 MedNotes 多智能体合成数据生成流程，将结构化数据到文本的合成视为闭环智能体过程：生成器提出笔记草稿，评估智能体诊断事实、覆盖、结构及幻觉相关失败，路由器决定接受、修订或拒绝。
AI.result: 在 1,485 个 EHRSHOT 就诊 encounter 上，MedNotes 通过率为 91.4%，平均事实准确率 0.980，完整性 99.1%，结构保真度 0.761，每 encounter 关键幻觉 0.028 次；迭代优化将接受率从 69.4% 提升至 91.4%；合成语料与少量真实数据结合可提升下游 CPT 预测和段落级章节预测。
AI.conclusion: MedNotes 能有效将结构化 EHR 转化为有依据的临床笔记，并通过迭代优化提高质量，生成的合成数据可增强下游临床预测任务。

title: LazyAgent: Demand-Driven Materialization and Physical Optimization of Agentic Programs
summary: Current agent runtimes that plan before acting generally execute a step once it becomes ready. We present LazyAgent, a unified execution framework for agent-authored programs organized around a live, goal-derived demanded set. LazyAgent refreshes a backward closure from requested outputs as execution state changes and materializes a ready node only when the active goal requires it. This replaces repeated local judgments with one linear-time graph analysis followed by constant-time membership tests, allowing programs to remain broad while execution stays request-specific. On programs that describe more than the current request needs, LazyAgent consistently outperforms the strongest goal-stopping eager baseline by refusing unrelated work before it starts. Adding one unrelated product raises the eager bill by 22.5% and LazyAgent's by 0.0%. LazyAgent saves 42.0% of measured CPU on production scientific workflows and 51.7% of container time on a live release gate spanning four repositories. We also prove and verify exact equivalence when the request reaches the whole graph, leaving no unrelated work to avoid. Beyond permission, goal-relative output projection saves up to approximately 90% of a shared step on two third-party test suites while the identical eager control saves 0.0%; the advantage disappears when the omitted output has no other consumer or the request needs it. Ordering, reuse, and pruning can also save cost, but do not replace permission. Finally, we show that current public benchmarks are eager-shaped and contain almost no unrequested work. A pre-registered planning intervention did not broaden them. These findings motivate benchmarks built from standing programs and sequences.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LazyAgent——一个面向智能体自生成程序的统一执行框架，它围绕由目标推导出的「需求集」（demanded set）进行惰性执行：随执行状态变化从被请求的输出反向闭包刷新，仅当活跃目标需要时才物化就绪节点。
AI.motivation: 当前在行动前先规划的智能体运行时，只要某步骤变为就绪就立即执行，导致程序中大量与当前请求无关的工作被提前触发、浪费算力。作者希望让程序保持宽泛表达能力，而执行严格限定于当前请求所需。
AI.method: 用一次线性时间的图分析替代反复的局部判断，之后仅做常数时间的成员关系测试；从请求输出出发维护反向闭包，随状态变化刷新，并仅在活跃目标要求时物化就绪节点。作者还在生产科学工作流、跨四仓库的实时发布门禁以及两个第三方测试套件上做了评测，并给出请求覆盖全图时精确等价的证明与验证，另做了一项预注册的规划干预实验。
AI.result: 在程序描述超出当前请求的场景下，LazyAgent 持续优于最强的「目标停止式」急切基线：新增一个无关产物使急切方案开销上涨 22.5%，而 LazyAgent 为 0.0%；在生产科学工作流中节省 42.0% 的实测 CPU，在覆盖四个仓库的实时发布门禁上节省 51.7% 的容器时间。目标相对的输出投影在两个第三方测试套件上最多节省约 90% 的共享步骤（相同急切对照为 0.0%），但当被省略的输出无其他消费者或请求本身需要它时优势消失。顺序、复用与剪枝也能省成本，但不能替代这种「许可」（permission）。此外，当前公开基准基本都是急切形态、几乎不含未被请求的工作，且预注册的规划干预未能使其变宽。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠调度顺序、复用和剪枝不足以避免无关工作，关键机制是基于目标需求集的执行「许可」。LazyAgent 在请求只覆盖部分程序时能显著节省资源，并在请求覆盖全图时与急切执行精确等价。现有公开基准无法体现这一需求，未来应基于长期存在的程序与序列来构建新基准。

title: FireWorldBench: Benchmarking Complex Physical World Intelligence through Coupled-Field Fire Dynamics
summary: Understanding the physical world requires more than object recognition, scene description, and short-term visual prediction, as real-world physical systems involve multiple continuous fields, latent causal mechanisms, partial observations, and intervention-sensitive dynamics. We propose FireWorldBench, a benchmark for evaluating complex physical world intelligence in multimodal large language models and agents through coupled-field fire dynamics. Fire provides a canonical stress-test environment, where multiple interacting physical fields jointly shape observable states and temporal dynamics. FireWorldBench is organized along two complementary axes, a physical capability axis and a fire scenario task axis, jointly covering physical-state understanding, temporal dynamics, causal mechanisms, and intervention reasoning. The benchmark comprises 520 fire-world entries, including 494 controlled simulation worlds and 26 real-world-aligned event groups, spanning 47 scene archetypes across 7 environment families. These entries combine structured textual observations, multiple 2D physical-field visualizations, and 3D event-level scene modeling, yielding 9,074 text-image interleaved question-answer pairs across choice-based and open-ended report-generation formats. FireWorldBench evaluates whether models can infer latent physical states, explain underlying mechanisms, forecast coupled-field evolution, and assess intervention consequences from multimodal partial observations, providing a challenging testbed for complex physical world intelligence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FireWorldBench，一个通过耦合场火灾动力学评估多模态大模型与智能体复杂物理世界智能的基准。
AI.motivation: 现实物理世界包含多个连续场、潜在因果机制、部分观测和干预敏感动态，仅靠物体识别、场景描述和短期视觉预测不足以理解。
AI.method: 构建 FireWorldBench，围绕物理能力轴和火灾场景任务轴组织，覆盖物理状态理解、时间动态、因果机制和干预推理；包含文本观测、多种2D物理场可视化和3D事件级场景建模。
AI.result: 基准含520个火灾世界条目，包括494个受控仿真世界和26个真实世界对齐事件组，覆盖7个环境家族、47类场景，生成9,074个文本-图像交错问答对，含选择题和开放式报告生成。
AI.conclusion: FireWorldBench 可评估模型从多模态部分观测中推断潜在物理状态、解释机制、预测耦合场演化并评估干预后果，是复杂物理世界智能的挑战性测试平台。

title: Human-Level Accuracy, Non-Human Strategies: Revealing Model-Human Divergence in Video Physical Reasoning
summary: Video foundation models now reach human-level accuracy on physical-reasoning benchmarks, yet such tasks require predicting unobserved physical outcomes. Do these models perform human-like forward simulation, or do they exploit statistical regularities in visible scenes? Accuracy alone cannot distinguish these strategies. We introduce a distributional evaluation framework that treats model seeds and human raters as populations, enabling comparison of consensus, uncertainty, and strategy. On the Physion benchmark, we evaluate three ViT-L architectures (V-JEPA2, VideoMAEv2, DINOv2). V-JEPA2 narrows the accuracy gap to ~1 percentage point (73.2% vs. 74.2%), yet model-human disagreement reaches 26.4%, far exceeding human-human disagreement (4.8%), with substantially lower agreement (kappa ~ 0.48 vs. 0.91). The divergence follows forward-simulation demands: models outperform humans on geometric reasoning (linking, +11.8 pp) but underperform on gravitational dynamics (rolling, -11.8 pp) and causal chains (dominoes, -10.5 pp). Strategy fingerprinting confirms all three architectures share non-human strategies while none aligns with humans. Attribution analysis suggests that unobservable outcome features, rather than visible scene properties, predict this divergence, consistent with models relying more on scene-level statistical regularities than on explicit forward simulation, a systematic divergence that accuracy alone cannot reveal. Code is available at https://github.com/fanhong-li/model-human-divergence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出分布化评估框架，发现视频基础模型虽在物理推理基准上接近人类准确率，但其共识、不确定性和策略与人类存在显著差异，表明模型更依赖可见场景的统计规律而非显式前向模拟。
AI.motivation: 视频基础模型在物理推理基准上已达到人类水平准确率，但这类任务需要预测未观察到的物理结果。仅凭准确率无法区分模型是在进行类人前向模拟，还是在利用可见场景中的统计规律。
AI.method: 提出分布化评估框架，将模型种子和人类评分者视为群体，比较共识、不确定性和策略。在Physion基准上评估三种ViT-L架构：V-JEPA2、VideoMAEv2和DINOv2，并进行策略指纹分析和归因分析。
AI.result: V-JEPA2将准确率差距缩小至约1个百分点（73.2% vs 74.2%），但模型-人类分歧达26.4%，远高于人类-人类分歧4.8%，一致性kappa约0.48 vs 0.91。模型在几何推理（连接，+11.8个百分点）上优于人类，但在重力动力学（滚动，-11.8个百分点）和因果链（多米诺，-10.5个百分点）上表现更差。策略指纹确认三种架构均采用非人类策略，且无一与人类对齐。归因分析表明，不可观察的结果特征而非可见场景属性更能预测这种分歧。
AI.conclusion: 模型更依赖场景级统计规律，而非显式前向模拟，准确率本身无法揭示这种系统性分歧。

title: Kinematic Interface for the Wild: Modular Bimanual Loco-Manipulation Capture from 360$^{\circ}$ Cameras Alone
summary: A wrist-mounted camera for UMI-style data collection must do two jobs: record the manipulation and localize in the scene. Most handheld devices localize online from workspace-facing views crowded by hands and objects, or add dedicated tracking hardware. Room-scale bimanual capture therefore still tends to instrument the operator or the scene for accurate localization. We present KIWI (Kinematic Interface for the Wild), a capture kit whose only electronics are off-the-shelf cameras. Our core system splits the two jobs across the two lenses of a 360-degree camera. The rear lens faces the room and builds a shared metric map that registers both hands, and an optional head camera, in one frame without workspace co-visibility; the front lens records the manipulation, and offline IMU fusion bridges front-lens tracking loss. Through our quick-release plate, the camera module attaches to chopstick grippers, parallel-jaw grippers, hand-wrist mounts, or robot flanges. Across six bimanual recordings, combining the rear and front lenses failed to localize only 0.1% of query frames, whereas front-only bimanual feature alignment failed on 24.8% of frames and lost one recording entirely; against evaluation fiducials, localization error stayed within 4.5 mm. KIWI's recovered poses were sufficiently consistent for the four wrist streams alone to reconstruct the scene as a 3D Gaussian splat.

AI.tldr: KIWI 是一种仅使用现成相机的采集套件，通过 360 度相机的后镜头面向房间构建共享度量地图并配准双手及可选头显相机，前镜头记录操作过程，离线 IMU 融合弥补前镜头跟踪丢失，从而实现房间尺度的双臂数据采集与定位。
AI.motivation: 现有 UMI 风格腕戴相机需同时记录操作并在场景中定位，但多数手持设备依赖被手和物体遮挡的工作区视角进行在线定位，或需额外专用跟踪硬件；房间尺度双臂采集通常仍需对操作者或场景进行额外布置，定位精度和便利性受限。
AI.method: 核心系统将记录与定位任务拆分到 360 度相机的两个镜头：后镜头朝向房间，构建共享度量地图，将双手和可选头相机配准到同一坐标系，无需工作区共视；前镜头记录操作，离线 IMU 融合用于桥接前镜头跟踪丢失。通过快拆板，相机模块可安装到筷子夹爪、平行夹爪、手腕支架或机器人法兰上。
AI.result: 在六段双臂录制中，结合后镜头与前镜头仅未能定位 0.1% 的查询帧；仅前镜头的双臂特征对齐在 24.8% 的帧上失败，并完全丢失一段录制。与评估基准标记相比，定位误差保持在 4.5 mm 以内。仅用四个腕部流恢复的位姿即可重建 3D Gaussian splat 场景。
AI.conclusion: KIWI 证明仅用现成相机即可实现房间尺度双臂 UMI 风格数据采集，并获得高精度、足够一致的定位结果，支持后续三维场景重建。

title: Commonsense-Grounded Path Planning from Abstract Instructions
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: We present \emph{commonsense ranked search} (CoRS), a novel path planner that turns an abstract instruction into a route that follows commonsense. While existing methods respect the considerations written down in advance, a robot working among people must follow those left unstated too, as with a wet floor that a worker avoids without being told. CoRS leverages large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) as commonsense knowledge to reason about these latent considerations in its planning. Given an abstract instruction (\emph{e.g.}, ``move carefully'') and visual observations of each region in the environment, CoRS derives a consideration for each region, as in ``this wet floor is slippery and worth a detour.'' It then compares the considerations between regions to see which of the two the robot should avoid more, as in ``the crowd is worse than the wet floor.'' These judgments sort the regions into a commonsense ranking, whose costs drive a conventional search that always returns a valid route. We build a benchmark for planning under latent considerations, with three environments, 1350 problems, and five instructions at three levels of abstraction. Experiments show that CoRS discovers the unstated considerations and goes around the ones worth a detour while crossing the rest, a behavior that recent LLM-based planners do not achieve.

AI.tldr: 提出CoRS路径规划器，将抽象指令转化为符合常识的路线，利用LLM和VLM推理环境中未明示的隐性考虑，并通过区域常识排序驱动传统搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有方法只遵守预先写明的约束，但机器人在人群中工作还需遵循未言明的常识，例如避开湿滑地面。
AI.method: 给定抽象指令和每个区域的视觉观察，用LLM/VLM为各区域推导考虑，比较区域间考虑并生成常识排序，其代价驱动传统搜索以获得有效路径；同时构建包含3个环境、1350个问题和5种指令（3个抽象层级）的基准。
AI.result: 实验表明CoRS能发现未明示的考虑，绕过值得绕行的区域并穿过其余区域，而近期基于LLM的规划器无法实现该行为。
AI.conclusion: 将常识推理与经典搜索结合，可让机器人在抽象指令下生成既符合常识又保证有效性的路线。

title: Monocultural Biases: Correlated biases in large language models lead to unequal systemic exclusion rates in hiring
summary: Employers are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to automate their hiring process. This paper investigates the risk of monocultural biases, in which the widespread deployment of large language models homogenizes biases across the labor market, leading to greater systemic exclusion for certain demographic groups. For ten LLMs, we measure hiring biases across their base and post-trained versions to identify which stage, pre-training or post-training, lead to monocultural biases. We find that, compared to their base models, post-trained models are 3.6% less likely to callback older applicants. This negative shift occurs in eight of the ten models that we evaluate. Post-trained models have much more correlated decisions than base models which is likely driven by human capital traits like skills or college major. However, greater consensus among models increases global systemic exclusion rates from 5.6% to 17.3% and exacerbates demographic inequalities, with intersectional systemic exclusion rates ranging from 12.2% to 21.7% for post-trained models. We find that this inequality is primarily driven by age-based discrimination that is exacerbated in post-training. These results indicate that while post-training techniques may improve models' abilities to select the best applicants, they may raise systemic inequality risks for those at the margin by uniformly introducing new biases.

AI.tldr: 论文研究大语言模型在招聘中因广泛部署而导致的单一文化偏见风险，比较十个LLM的基础版与后训练版，发现后训练模型对老年申请者回调率降低，模型间决策更一致，加剧系统性排斥和人口统计不平等。
AI.motivation: 雇主日益使用LLM自动化招聘，担忧广泛部署会 homogenize biases 导致对某些人口群体的系统性排斥。
AI.method: 对十个LLM的基础版和后训练版测量招聘偏见，分析预训练和后训练阶段对单一文化偏见的贡献。
AI.result: 后训练模型比基础模型对老年申请者回调率低3.6%，在10个模型中有8个出现此负面转变；后训练模型决策相关性更高，受人力资本特征驱动；模型共识增加使全球系统性排斥率从5.6%升至17.3%，交叉性排斥率12.2%到21.7%；不平等主要由年龄歧视驱动，后训练加剧。
AI.conclusion: 后训练技术虽可提升模型选择最佳申请者的能力，但可能通过统一引入新偏见而增加边缘群体的系统性不平等风险。

title: Quantifying Hidden Salt for Precision Healthcare: Sodium Assessment via Joint-Factor Retrieval and Chain-of-Thought Inference
comment: Accepted in EMNLP 2026 Main Conference; 16 pages, 7 figures
summary: Precision healthcare, particularly for conditions like hypertension and cardiovascular disease, necessitates monitoring of dietary sodium intake. However, tracking this is hindered by the prevalence of hidden salt in cooking, such as sodium in soy sauce and ketchup. While recipes offer a valuable data source for dietary analysis, sodium-rich seasonings are frequently omitted or described ambiguously in instructions. To solve this issue, we propose SALT, a Sodium Assessing & Level Tracking framework adopting an RAG framework to assess sodium content in recipes. Our framework first introduces a Joint-Factor Embedding Retrieval module to locate similar recipes with specified sodium content for addressing the lack of contextual references. These retrieved samples provide contexts for subsequent inference. Then we design a structured 4-hop Chain-of-Thought inference module to refine the vague estimation from language models through a multi-step sodium estimation. To facilitate our study, we further construct a recipe dataset SALT54k with $54,151$ entries labeled with sodium quantities across $11$ common seasonings. Results on SALT54k demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in sodium estimation. Additional real-world validations confirm the effectiveness of our method, demonstrating its potential as a practical solution for AI-assisted precision healthcare.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SALT框架，利用RAG、联合因子嵌入检索和结构化4跳思维链推理，从食谱中评估钠含量，并构建了包含54,151条、覆盖11种常见调味料的SALT54k数据集，在钠含量估计上达到当前最优。
AI.motivation: 精准医疗（如高血压和心血管疾病）需要监测膳食钠摄入，但烹饪中酱油、番茄酱等隐藏盐普遍存在；食谱虽可用于饮食分析，却常遗漏或模糊描述高钠调味料，导致钠含量难以准确追踪。
AI.method: 提出SALT（Sodium Assessing & Level Tracking）框架，采用RAG框架评估食谱钠含量。首先用Joint-Factor Embedding Retrieval模块检索具有指定钠含量的相似食谱，为后续推理提供上下文；然后设计结构化4-hop Chain-of-Thought推理模块，通过多步钠估计改进语言模型的模糊估计。同时构建SALT54k数据集，含54,151条食谱，标注11种常见调味料的钠含量。
AI.result: 在SALT54k数据集上，该方法在钠含量估计方面取得当前最优性能；额外的真实世界验证也证实了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: SALT可作为AI辅助精准医疗的实用解决方案，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Equivalent Modeling of Load-Side Systems With Distributed Renewable Generation Considering Fault Responses and Nodal Voltage Coherence
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Power Systems
summary: Operating conditions and fault severity change both the initial states and control modes of active distribution networks. Direct capacity aggregation can therefore lose the power responses required for transmission-system dynamic analysis. This paper develops a procedure for generating low-order physical electromagnetic transient equivalents from a small set of representative operating conditions. Device power, ride-through states, load mechanical states, and local sequence voltages are combined with electrical distance to form response families. Response reconstruction and terminal simulation errors determine the retained architecture, after which bounded sensitivity calculations determine effective dynamic coefficients. The architecture and coefficients are then fixed. For a new operating condition, capacity and power balances, voltage-dependent load relations, and an initialization correction generate the model parameters from static inputs and power-flow results. A representative severe fault establishes a template for each fault type, which is reused across fault depths. Aggregation and switching-time bounds explain the roles of voltage coherence and state separation. Comparisons with direct aggregation show improved terminal responses across operating conditions and several fault types, with the largest gains under severe unbalanced faults. The method provides a reusable physical equivalent for operating-condition studies and fault-depth screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从少量代表性运行条件生成低阶物理电磁暂态等值模型的方法，用于主动配电网在运行条件和故障严重程度变化下的动态分析。
AI.motivation: 运行条件和故障严重程度会改变主动配电网的初始状态与控制模式，直接进行容量聚合会丢失输电系统动态分析所需的功率响应。
AI.method: 从少量代表性运行条件出发，将设备功率、穿越状态、负荷机械状态和本地序电压与电气距离结合形成响应族；通过响应重构和端部仿真误差确定保留结构，以有界灵敏度计算有效动态系数并固定；新运行条件下利用容量与功率平衡、电压相关负荷关系及初始化修正，由静态输入和潮流结果生成模型参数；对每类故障用代表性严重故障建立模板并在不同故障深度下复用。
AI.result: 与直接聚合相比，该方法在多种运行条件和故障类型下改善了终端响应，其中在严重不平衡故障下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了可复用的物理等值模型，适用于运行条件研究和故障深度筛选。

title: PixelART: Image-to-Layer Decomposition without Latents or Text-to-Image Pretraining
summary: Image-to-layer decomposition converts a flattened image into editable RGBA layers, enabling element-level editing in design workflows. Existing diffusion-based systems typically adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) models and introduce RGBA autoencoders or variable-layer architectural modules. We revisit this design choice and ask whether layer decomposition truly requires these heavyweight components. We introduce PixelART, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer trained from scratch for image-to-layer (I2L) decomposition. PixelART directly denoises regional RGBA pixel patches using a single-stream multi-modal diffusion Transformer, avoiding RGBA-VAEs, pretrained T2I backbones, and layer-specific decoders. We identify a key property of the task: high-noise timesteps determine layer assignment and coarse layer organization, while low-noise timesteps mainly refine color, alpha, texture, and boundaries. Based on this observation, we propose a terminal-boosted timestep sampling strategy to increase training coverage in the high-noise layer assignment regime. Trained on 4M multi-layer design templates, PixelART achieves state-of-the-art layer decomposition and composite reconstruction on Design-Multi-Layer-Bench and LICA with over 80% fewer parameters, 98% lower latency, and 85% lower memory than the recent Qwen-Image-Layered model. Ablation experiments show that pixel-space $\mathbf{x}$-prediction, terminal-boosted timestep sampling, and data/model scaling are critical, while T2I pretraining brings marginal benefits to the I2L task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PixelART，一个从零训练的像素空间整流流（rectified-flow）Transformer，用于图像到图层（I2L）分解。它用单流多模态 DiT 直接对区域 RGBA 像素块去噪，无需 RGBA-VAE、预训练 T2I 主干或专用图层解码器，在更少参数、更低延迟和内存下取得 SOTA 效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的 I2L 系统通常改造大型预训练 T2I 模型并引入 RGBA 自编码器或可变图层架构模块，设计沉重。作者质疑图层分解是否真需要这些重组件，希望探索更轻量的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出 PixelART：从零训练的像素空间整流流 Transformer。采用单流多模态扩散 Transformer 直接对区域 RGBA 像素块去噪，避免 RGBA-VAE、预训练 T2I 主干与图层专用解码器。基于“高噪声时刻决定图层分配与粗组织、低噪声时刻精修颜色/alpha/纹理/边界”的观察，设计 terminal-boosted 时间步采样策略以增强高噪声图层分配区域的训练覆盖。在 4M 多图层设计模板上训练。
AI.result: 在 Design-Multi-Layer-Bench 和 LICA 上取得 SOTA 的图层分解与合成重建效果，相比 Qwen-Image-Layered 参数量减少 80% 以上、延迟降低 98%、内存降低 85%。消融显示像素空间 x-prediction、terminal-boosted 时间步采样、数据/模型扩展至关重要，而 T2I 预训练对 I2L 任务收益甚微。
AI.conclusion: 图层分解并不依赖重型组件；像素空间、从零训练的单流 DiT 配合合理的采样策略即可高效完成 I2L 任务，T2I 预训练对该任务边际收益有限，为轻量化可编辑图层生成提供了新方向。

title: Whole-Body UMI: Transferring UMI Manipulation Skills to Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation via Real-Time Motion Generation
summary: Collecting whole-body demonstrations for humanoid manipulation mostly relies on teleoperation, which is costly and hard to scale up. The Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) provides a scalable data collection paradigm, but end-effector trajectories alone underdetermine humanoid whole-body coordination, which is insufficient for whole-body demonstration collection. Therefore, we introduce Whole-Body UMI (WB-UMI), a task-agnostic, real-time and end-effector conditioned motion generator that decouples whole-body coordination learning from task semantics learning through a shared end-effector interface. A diffusion policy learns from native UMI demonstrations, while WB-UMI learns independently from retargeted motion capture, requiring no body trackers or paired image--whole-body demonstrations during task-specific data collection. In real deployment, an asynchronous hierarchy integrates the diffusion policy, motion generator, and a whole-body controller with latency compensation and measured-state feedback. Real-robot experiments on G1 support real-time closed-loop transfer across four tasks, achieving 90% success in drawer closing, 80% in shelf pick-and-place, 30% in ball toss, and 40% in Loco-PnP, which shows the effectiveness of this hierarchy in transferring native UMI skills to humanoid whole-body manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 WB-UMI，将全身协调学习与任务语义学习解耦，通过共享末端执行器接口，把 UMI 数据采集范式扩展到人形机器人全身操作，并在 G1 真机上验证闭环迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身操作示范数据主要依赖遥操作，成本高且难以规模化。UMI 虽可扩展，但仅有末端执行器轨迹不足以确定全身协调，因此难以直接用于全身示范采集。
AI.method: WB-UMI 是一个任务无关、实时且以末端执行器为条件的运动生成器，通过共享末端执行器接口解耦全身协调与任务语义。扩散策略从原生 UMI 示范中学习，WB-UMI 则独立从重定向运动捕捉中学习，任务数据采集时无需穿戴式动捕或成对的图像-全身示范。部署时采用异步分层架构，集成扩散策略、运动生成器与全身控制器，并加入延迟补偿和实测状态反馈。
AI.result: 在 G1 真机上进行四类任务闭环实验，抽屉关闭成功率 90%，货架取放 80%，抛球 30%，Loco-PnP 40%。
AI.conclusion: 该分层架构能够有效将原生 UMI 技能迁移到人形机器人全身操作中，验证了 WB-UMI 在真实闭环任务中的可行性。

title: Tutoring Large Language Models to be Domain-adaptive, Precise and Safe
comment: This is a preprint of a PhD thesis submitted to IIT KGP. The final, official version of record is available through the university's institutional repository
summary: This thesis proposes a framework for "responsible intelligence" to address AI's critical challenges in safety, ethics, and cultural sensitivity. It advances three core areas: First, it improves domain adaptation in specialized fields using active learning and graph-based knowledge to reduce hallucinations. Second, it enhances ethical rigor via a novel decoding-time alignment mechanism that proactively blocks harmful text generation in real-time. Finally, it ensures cultural and multilingual safety through language-specific steering that respects diverse linguistic and social norms. Ultimately, this work provides a blueprint for building next-generation AI that is contextually knowledgeable, ethically sound, and culturally adaptable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“负责任智能”框架，从领域适应、伦理对齐和文化/多语言安全三方面应对AI在安全、伦理与文化敏感性上的关键挑战。
AI.motivation: AI在安全、伦理和文化敏感性方面面临严峻问题，亟需构建更负责任、更可信的智能系统。
AI.method: 提出三项核心方法：利用主动学习和图知识改进领域适应以减少幻觉；设计解码时对齐机制，实时阻止有害文本生成；通过语言特定引导保障文化多样性和多语言安全。
AI.result: 形成了一套涵盖领域知识增强、伦理实时对齐和文化多语言适配的“负责任智能”框架。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为构建下一代上下文知识丰富、伦理健全且文化适应性强的AI提供了蓝图。

title: C$^{2}$-INR: Customized Convolutional Implicit Neural Representation
summary: Implicit Neural Representation (INR) leverages neural networks to represent discrete signals such as images as continuous ones, where the network weights serve as a compact form of the signal itself. Most existing INR methods adopt Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) as their backbone. Since these models render each pixel independently, they inherently fail to exploit the spatial correlations that exist between neighboring pixels. In contrast,convolutional INRs can process pixels in parallel while inherently accounting for inter-pixel dependencies, making them a more natural fit for representing images. Nevertheless, convolutional INRs remain relatively underexplored, and the majority of them rely on fixed architectural settings, leaving little room for image-specific adaptation. In this paper, we investigate network customization for convolutional INRs. We replace conventional filters with irregular directional kernels, whose allocation is guided by the directional energy in the image spectrum, i.e., directions exhibiting stronger energy are assigned a larger number of kernels, enabling content-tailored convolution settings. These kernels are further reformulated via an orthogonal basis to achieve a superior sparse representation. Moreover, we introduce an annealed Gumbel-Softmax-based mechanism for kernel-level activation function selection, which gives the most suitable activation function for each convolution kernel. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method, namely C$^{2}$-INR, achieves superior performance against state-of-the-art approaches under comparable parameter budgets across a wide range of image processing tasks, including representation, inpainting, and super-resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 C²-INR，一种面向卷积隐式神经表示（INR）的网络定制方法，通过方向性核分配、正交基重参数化和核级激活函数选择，提升图像表示与处理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 INR 多基于 MLP，逐像素渲染，未利用相邻像素的空间相关性；卷积 INR 可并行处理并建模像素依赖，但研究较少且多采用固定架构，缺乏针对图像内容的自适应能力。
AI.method: 用不规则方向核替代传统卷积核，依据图像频谱中的方向能量分配核数量：能量更强的方向分配更多核；将核通过正交基重参数化以获得更优稀疏表示；引入退火 Gumbel-Softmax 机制进行核级激活函数选择，为每个卷积核自动选择最合适的激活函数。
AI.result: 在图像表示、修复和超分辨率等广泛任务上，与参数量相当的最先进方法相比，C²-INR 均取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 针对卷积 INR 进行网络定制是有效方向；C²-INR 通过内容自适应的方向核与核级激活选择，在可比参数预算下显著优于现有方法。

title: Nonlinear Dynamic Modeling and Receding-Horizon NMPC of an Electric Unicycle on a Tensioned Cable
summary: Traversing flexible slender structures involves strong bidirectional coupling between vehicle motion and structural vibration caused by a moving contact point. This paper presents a nonlinear modeling-and-control framework for an electric unicycle traversing a tensioned flexible cable. The cable is modeled using a tension-dominated finite-element formulation retaining vertical and lateral transverse dynamics, and is coupled to the unicycle roll and pitch dynamics through moving-contact kinematics. A modal truncation yields a control-oriented reduced-order model that preserves the nonlinear vehicle--cable coupling. Based on this model, a constrained nonlinear model predictive controller is formulated to regulate traversal, balance, actuator limits, and cable-span constraints. To reduce the computational burden associated with moving-contact interpolation, a frozen spatial contact-point interpolation strategy is introduced for the NMPC prediction model. Numerical studies under nominal, disturbed, constrained, and model-mismatch scenarios show accurate traversal, roll and pitch stabilization, attenuation of cable vibrations, and constraint-consistent closed-loop behavior. The frozen-interpolation formulation reduces and regularizes NMPC computation times relative to the non-frozen formulation, supporting its use as a computationally tractable approach for finite-element-based moving-contact vehicle--structure interaction systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于电动独轮车穿越张紧柔性缆索的非线性建模与控制框架，通过缆索有限元模型、降阶模型和约束非线性模型预测控制实现稳定穿越与振动抑制。
AI.motivation: 柔性细长结构上的移动接触点会导致车辆运动与结构振动之间存在强双向耦合，因此需要面向电动独轮车穿越张紧缆索的建模与控制方法。
AI.method: 采用以张力为主的有限元缆索模型，保留竖向和侧向横向动力学，并通过移动接触运动学与独轮车侧倾和俯仰动力学耦合；利用模态截断获得保留非线性车-缆耦合的降阶控制模型；设计约束NMPC以调节穿越、平衡、执行器限制和缆索跨度约束；引入冻结空间接触点插值策略降低预测模型计算负担。
AI.result: 在标称、扰动、约束和模型失配场景下的数值研究表明：可实现准确穿越、侧倾与俯仰稳定、缆索振动衰减以及满足约束的闭环行为；相比非冻结形式，冻结插值可减少并正则化NMPC计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架对基于有限元的移动接触车-结构交互系统有效，冻结插值NMPC是一种计算上可行的控制方法。

title: An Algebraic Observer for State-Affine Systems
summary: We present a new systematic method to design an algebraic swapping lemma observer for nonlinear systems which are affine in the state. Four are the main features of the new observer: (i) Far superior transient performance compared to standard asymptotically convergent observers; (ii) structural simplicity - its construction relies solely on basic linear filtering and a single matrix inversion; (iii) applicability to non-uniformly-completely-observable systems, for which classical methods are not applicable; (iv) straightforward extension to the cases of unknown time-varying parameters and measurement delay. The core idea exploited in the paper is to combine the construction of a generalized parameter estimation-based observer with a simple filtering technique to derive the algebraic observer. The resulting design is shown to apply to a class of state-affine systems satisfying a weak generic condition. Moreover, it is established that for time-invariant systems, this condition is always satisfied globally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于代数交换引理的观测器系统设计方法，用于状态仿射非线性系统，具有暂态性能优越、结构简单、适用范围更广以及易于扩展等优点。
AI.motivation: 传统渐近收敛观测器暂态性能较差、构造复杂，且不适用于非一致完全可观测系统，也难以直接处理未知时变参数和测量延迟等问题。
AI.method: 将广义参数估计型观测器与简单滤波技术相结合，构造代数交换引理观测器；设计仅依赖基本线性滤波和一次矩阵求逆，并针对满足弱泛型条件的状态仿射系统进行分析。
AI.result: 新观测器具备四项主要特点：暂态性能远优于标准渐近观测器；结构简单；可用于经典方法不适用的非一致完全可观测系统；可扩展至未知时变参数和测量延迟情形；对满足弱泛型条件的状态仿射系统有效，且对时不变系统该条件全局成立。
AI.conclusion: 该代数观测器为状态仿射非线性系统提供了一种系统化、简洁且适用范围更广的设计方案，并在暂态性能与扩展性方面优于传统方法。

title: SatOV: Restoring Spatial Priors for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation in Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVS) of remote sensing imagery is a challenging pixel-level task requiring strong generalization and adaptation to the spatial characteristics of remote sensing data. Although existing vision-language foundation models perform well in general domains, their image-level classification design weakens the spatial priors needed for high-resolution remote sensing segmentation: structural spatial relations are degraded during deep feature transformation, and fine-grained spatial details are lost during downsampling. To address these complementary deficiencies, we propose SatOV, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary remote sensing segmentation that restores spatial priors at two stages of the representation pipeline. Specifically, Residual QQ Attention (ResQQ) extracts Query-Key self-attention from an intermediate CLIP layer and fuses it with final-layer Query-Query attention via a residual combination, restoring structural spatial priors suppressed by the final-layer representation. Spatially Modulated Upsampling (SatUp) uses the original high-resolution RGB image as spatial guidance, combining spatial feature modulation with guided cross-attention to reconstruct pixel-level textures and boundaries. Extensive experiments on DOTA, UDD, LoveDA, and Vaihingen show that SatOV consistently improves training-free OVS and achieves competitive quantitative and qualitative results against state-of-the-art methods. These results validate the effectiveness of restoring spatial priors at both the representation and spatial-resolution stages for remote sensing open-vocabulary segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出 SatOV，一种无需训练的开词汇遥感影像语义分割框架，通过恢复空间先验提升分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言基础模型在通用领域表现良好，但其图像级分类设计削弱了高分辨率遥感分割所需的空间先验：深层特征变换中结构空间关系退化，下采样过程中细粒度空间细节丢失。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的 SatOV 框架，在两阶段恢复空间先验：ResQQ 从 CLIP 中间层提取 Query-Key 自注意力，并与最终层 Query-Query 注意力残差融合，恢复结构空间先验；SatUp 以原始高分辨率 RGB 图像为空间引导，结合空间特征调制与引导交叉注意力，重建像素级纹理和边界。
AI.result: 在 DOTA、UDD、LoveDA 和 Vaihingen 上的大量实验表明，SatOV 持续提升无需训练的开放词汇语义分割性能，并在定量和定性结果上达到与最先进方法相比有竞争力的水平。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了在表示阶段和空间分辨率阶段恢复空间先验对遥感开放词汇分割的有效性。

title: SCoR: A Hierarchical Framework for Forecasting Relations Between Scientific Concepts
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables; includes supplementary material. Jingze Wang and Fred Sun contributed equally; Shangqi Guo is the corresponding author
summary: Anticipating emerging research directions is a critical goal of AI-assisted science. Existing methods mainly predict which concepts will co-occur in future papers, but co-occurrence captures shared attention rather than the scientific meaning of a connection, such as whether one method uses, combines, replaces, or contradicts another. We formulate research-direction discovery as hierarchical scientific-relation forecasting over a shared candidate-pair space, comprising three temporally aligned tasks: first co-occurrence, first scientific-relation formation, and relation type at formation. We construct SCoR-Graph from 187,848 cs.CV papers published between 2017 and 2026, yielding 270,687 consolidated concepts, 7.45 million co-occurrence edges, and 615,036 typed, directed relation edges. From cutoff-specific graph snapshots, we derive SCoR-Bench, a leakage-audited benchmark for these three capabilities, with expert-verified gold labels for the entire relation-type test set. We further introduce HiSCoR, a task-adapted model family that models relation emergence as a temporally evolving, hierarchically constrained process by encoding pre-cutoff event histories and conditioning relation formation on future co-occurrence. On the held-out 2025-2026 window, HiSCoR achieves an AUROC of 0.9515, a 2.4% relative improvement over the strongest temporal-graph baseline, and improves population-AUPRC by 14.0%; its relation-type variant achieves a Macro-AUROC of 0.7795. Ablations show that semantic, co-occurrence, and typed-relation views provide complementary predictive evidence. SCoR advances research-direction forecasting from predicting which concepts will co-occur to anticipating whether and how evidence-backed scientific relations will emerge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将新兴研究方向发现建模为分层科学关系预测，构建SCoR-Graph与SCoR-Bench，并提出HiSCoR模型，预测概念是否及如何形成有证据支持的科学关系。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要预测未来论文中概念是否共现，但共现只反映共同关注，无法刻画一个方法使用、组合、替代或反驳另一个方法等科学关系的语义。因此需要从共现预测转向对科学关系形成及其类型的预测。
AI.method: 构建SCoR-Graph，基于2017—2026年187,848篇cs.CV论文，包含270,687个概念、745万共现边和615,036条有类型的有向关系边；从不同时间截断快照构建防泄漏的SCoR-Bench，覆盖首次共现、首次科学关系形成、关系类型三个任务，关系类型测试集有专家标注金标签；提出HiSCoR模型族，将关系涌现建模为时间演化且分层约束的过程，编码截断前事件历史，并以未来共现为条件预测关系形成。
AI.result: 在2025—2026留出窗口上，HiSCoR达到AUROC 0.9515，相比最强时序图基线相对提升2.4%，population-AUPRC提升14.0%；关系类型变体达到Macro-AUROC 0.7795。消融实验表明语义、共现和类型化关系视图提供互补预测证据。
AI.conclusion: SCoR将研究方向预测从“哪些概念会共现”推进到“是否以及如何出现有证据支持的科学关系”，为科学关系层面的研究方向发现提供了新基准与方法。

title: ForceRFT: Refining VLA Actions through Force-Guided Residual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Force-conditioned vision-language-action (VLA) policies can respond to contact, but when trained solely on demonstrations, their recovery behavior may be limited by demonstration coverage, and they do not learn from deployment outcomes. Human corrective imitation provides additional recovery examples, but its objective matches local action targets without explicitly optimizing task return. We present ForceRFT, a force-guided residual reinforcement learning framework that learns contact-dependent corrections from human supervision and autonomous task outcomes. A frozen, demonstration-trained SmolVLA-based prior generates force-conditioned action chunks, while a lightweight residual actor refines individual end-effector pose commands using wrist feedback acquired during chunk execution. The decision-time wrist wrench, its temporal change, and the selected base motion condition both residual correction and value estimation. Human corrections supervise the residual actor, while verified autonomous transitions train the twin critics and support value-guided updates to the same actor. Bootstrapping is restricted to autonomous segments, preventing TD credit from crossing human-intervention boundaries. Real-robot experiments on plug insertion, ring-on-peg assembly, and whiteboard wiping show higher autonomous success rates than the evaluated demonstration-trained and residual-imitation baselines. Comparisons with residual imitation support value-guided residual optimization, while plug-insertion ablations indicate the benefit of direct execution-time wrist feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出ForceRFT，一种力引导的残差强化学习框架，结合人类纠正监督与自主任务结果，学习接触相关的残差修正，在多种真实机器人接触任务中取得更高自主成功率。
AI.motivation: 仅用演示训练的力条件VLA策略恢复行为受演示覆盖限制，且无法从部署结果中学习；人类纠正模仿虽提供恢复示例，但只匹配局部动作目标，未显式优化任务回报。
AI.method: 使用冻结的、基于SmolVLA的演示训练先验生成力条件动作块；轻量残差actor利用执行期间腕部反馈修正末端位姿命令。决策时腕部力/力矩、其时序变化和所选基础运动共同条件化残差修正与价值估计。人类纠正监督残差actor，验证后的自主过渡训练双critic并支持价值引导更新；TD自举仅限自主片段，避免跨越人类干预边界。
AI.result: 在插头插入、环上钉装配和白板擦拭真实机器人实验中，自主成功率高于所评估的演示训练基线和残差模仿基线；与残差模仿的对比支持价值引导残差优化，插头插入消融表明直接使用执行时腕部反馈的收益。
AI.conclusion: ForceRFT通过结合人类监督和自主任务结果进行价值引导的残差优化，有效提升了接触丰富操作任务的自主恢复与成功率。

title: Event Signature Transfer: Model-Agnostic Forecast Scenario Construction from Historical Events
summary: Forecasters often know an event is imminent but not the shape, size, or timing of its effect. We introduce Event Signature Transfer (EST), a training-free, model-agnostic operator that turns a completed past event into an explicit forecast scenario. EST removes a source event's own trend and seasonality, then scales and retimes the remaining event signature onto a native forecast, preserving the forecast's linked structure and reducing to it exactly at zero strength. Because it reads only output quantiles, EST applies to any quantile forecaster, with no training, no model internals, at transfer time. Across twelve real episodes and ten synthetic scenarios on Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and Toto-2.0, manually configured EST reduces real-episode WQL by 21.7-90\% in-sample. On Chronos-2, it leads eleven of twelve matched comparisons against covariate conditioning, activation editing and raw replay. The operator builds a scenario; it does not estimate its likelihood.

AI.tldr: 提出事件签名迁移（EST），一种免训练、模型无关的操作器，可将过去完整事件转化为显式预测情景；在多个时间序列基础模型上测试并显著改善分位数预测。
AI.motivation: 预测者常知道事件即将发生，但不知道其影响的形态、大小或时间，因此需要一种方法将过去事件知识转化为可操作预测情景，并适用于任意分位数预测器，无需训练或访问模型内部。
AI.method: EST是免训练、模型无关的操作器：去除源事件自身的趋势与季节性，将剩余事件签名缩放并重定时叠加到原生预测上，保持预测的联动结构，并在零强度时精确退化为原预测。它只读取输出分位数，因此适用于任何分位数预测器。
AI.result: 在Chronos-2、TimesFM-2.5和Toto-2.0上，针对12个真实事件和10个合成场景，人工配置的EST在样本内将真实事件WQL降低21.7%至90%。在Chronos-2上，12个匹配比较中有11个优于协变量条件、激活编辑和原始重放。
AI.conclusion: EST能有效将过去事件签名迁移为预测情景，显著提升分位数预测表现，且模型无关、无需训练；但该操作器只构建情景，不估计其似然。

title: Assessment of the N-1 voltage security of a future Nordic energy system
comment: 17 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to the International Journal of Electrical Power and Energy Systems
summary: Capacity Expansion - Energy System Models (CE-ESMs) have been widely used to optimize the decarbonization of future energy systems on national and continental scales. To capture the limitations in electricity trade between different parts of the system investigated, CE-ESMs often include a representation of the transmission grid. However, CE-ESMs usually only include linearized representations of the grid and omit or strongly simplify grid stability requirements. In this work, we evaluate the N-1 voltage security of the electricity system results obtained from a CE-ESM of a decarbonized Nordic energy system in Year 2050, and analyze the effects of different grid code requirements and shunt capacitor and reactor automation on voltage security. For comparison, we evaluate a Year 2022 system based on ENTSO-E data.We show that the CE-ESM results for the Nordic countries are not N-1 voltage-secure and that, depending on the grid code and shunt automation requirements, the contingencies with voltage violations range from 1.1% to 17.4%. Furthermore, the results indicate that both Power Park Module voltage control and shunt extreme voltage automation have strong positive effects on voltage security in the modeled future system. Grid regions with low levels generation, and thus little dynamic reactive power from generators, are found to be the most at risk of being voltage-insecure.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了一个用于2050年脱碳北欧能源系统的容量扩展-能源系统模型（CE-ESM）结果的N-1电压安全性，并与2022年ENTSO-E系统对比，分析了不同并网规则和并联电容器/电抗器自动化对电压安全的影响。
AI.motivation: CE-ESM广泛用于国家及大陆尺度未来能源系统脱碳优化，但通常仅采用线性化电网表示，忽略或极大简化电网稳定性要求。因此，需要评估这类模型结果是否满足实际N-1电压安全要求。
AI.method: 基于一个2050年脱碳北欧能源系统的CE-ESM结果进行N-1电压安全评估；设置不同并网规则要求以及并联电容器和电抗器自动化场景；并以基于ENTSO-E数据的2022年系统作为对比。
AI.result: CE-ESM给出的北欧国家结果并非N-1电压安全；根据并网规则和并联自动化要求不同，存在电压违规的故障占比在1.1%至17.4%之间。Power Park Module电压控制和并联极端电压自动化对未来系统电压安全有显著正面作用；发电量低、因而发电机动态无功支撑少的电网区域最易出现电压不安全。
AI.conclusion: CE-ESM的线性化电网表示不足以保证N-1电压安全，未来脱碳能源系统规划需考虑并网规则、动态无功支持和并联自动化等因素；低发电区域应重点关注电压安全风险。

title: Fairness Beyond Anonymization? Demographic Leakage in German LLM-Generated Resumes
comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026 Workshop on Bias and Fairness in AI [BIAS 2026@ ECML/PKDD]
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into AI-assisted hiring pipelines, including automated resume generation and screening. Under the EU AI Act, the hiring domain is classified as high-risk, making fairness and transparency critical requirements. Existing work has primarily focused on explicit hiring decisions, while less attention has been paid to whether generated resumes themselves encode recoverable demographic information. In this work, we conduct a two-stage audit of demographic leakage in German-language LLM-generated resumes. First, we use ChatGPT (GPT-4o-mini), Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, and multiple scales of the open-weight Qwen 3 model family (4B, 8B, and 14B) to generate resumes from real anonymized job-matching profiles, systematically varying gender- and ethnicity-associated names while holding qualifications constant. Second, we simulate a downstream resume screening scenario, where the generated resumes are first anonymized and gender-neutralized, before demographic leakage classifiers are trained on the resulting texts. We find that, despite these interventions, classifiers reliably distinguish between resumes generated with male and female names. This leakage is not driven by overtly gendered wording, but by subtle differences in the usage of semantically equivalent, formally gender-neutral terms in German. In contrast, ethnicity-related leakage remains comparatively weak across models. Our findings demonstrate that apparently neutral resume generation can still preserve highly predictive demographic signals, raising concerns about anonymization-based fairness interventions in multilingual AI hiring pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该论文对德语LLM生成简历中的人口统计信息泄露进行两阶段审计，发现即使经过匿名化和性别中性化处理，分类器仍能可靠区分基于男性与女性名字生成的简历，而族裔泄露相对较弱。
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案将招聘列为高风险领域，公平性与透明度至关重要；现有研究多关注显式招聘决策，较少探究生成的简历本身是否编码了可恢复的人口统计信息。
AI.method: 两阶段审计：第一阶段用GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite及Qwen 3（4B/8B/14B）从真实匿名化求职匹配档案生成简历，系统变化与性别和族裔相关的名字而保持资质不变；第二阶段模拟下游筛选，先对生成简历进行匿名化和性别中性化，再训练人口统计泄露分类器。
AI.result: 尽管有匿名化和性别中性化干预，分类器仍能可靠区分男性和女性名字生成的简历；泄露并非源于明显的性别化措辞，而是德语中语义等价、形式上性别中性的术语使用差异；族裔相关泄露在各模型中相对较弱。
AI.conclusion: 看似中性的简历生成仍可保留高度可预测的人口统计信号，对多语言AI招聘流程中基于匿名化的公平性干预提出了担忧。

title: From Inference Engine to Inference Control Plane: Connecting vLLM, llm-d, and the Evolution of Efficient Distributed LLM Serving
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Systems synthesis and research agenda on vLLM, llm-d, distributed inference control, KV-state management, routing, disaggregation, heterogeneous accelerators, reliability, and agentic/multimodal serving. No new experimental measurements are claimed; empirical and organization-reported results are attributed to the cited sources
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference is evolving from an engine-local optimization problem into a distributed control problem involving reusable state, phase placement, heterogeneous accelerators, networking, autoscaling, reliability, and service-level objectives. This paper connects that transition across peer-reviewed systems research, open-source implementations, and documented production studies. It treats vLLM and llm-d as complementary layers: model-serving engines optimize execution through mechanisms such as PagedAttention, continuous batching, kernels, quantization, and parallelism, while an inference control plane can optimize where, when, and under what policy execution occurs across a fleet. The contribution is synthesis rather than a new benchmark; all reported performance and deployment results remain attributed to their original sources. The combined evidence suggests that the scarce resource in modern inference is shifting from raw FLOPs alone toward managed state, placement, network movement, reliability, and decision quality. We propose an Inference Execution Planner that selects feasible execution plans rather than only endpoints, including aggregated versus disaggregated topology, KV source and transfer action, hardware variant, routing/admission policy, and slower scaling decisions. We also provide a source-local benchmark atlas, a bottleneck-migration taxonomy, practical deployment guidance, an evaluation framework based on SLO-goodput, and research questions for agentic, multimodal, heterogeneous, and resilient inference.

AI.tldr: 该文综述大语言模型推理从引擎局部优化转向分布式控制问题的趋势，综合系统研究、开源实现和生产实践，提出以vLLM/llm-d为互补层次的推理控制平面与Inference Execution Planner。
AI.motivation: LLM推理不再只是单引擎性能优化，而是涉及可复用状态、阶段放置、异构加速器、网络、自动扩缩容、可靠性和SLO的分布式控制问题，需要跨层视角来理解稀缺资源和瓶颈迁移。
AI.method: 采用综合而非新基准的方法，连接同行评审系统研究、开源实现和有记录的生产研究；将模型服务引擎与推理控制平面分层分析，并归因原始来源的性能与部署结果。
AI.result: 证据表明现代推理的稀缺资源正从单纯FLOPs转向受管状态、放置、网络移动、可靠性和决策质量；提出Inference Execution Planner选择可行执行计划，并提供基准图谱、瓶颈迁移分类、部署指南、基于SLO-goodput的评估框架及研究问题。
AI.conclusion: 推理系统优化需同时关注引擎执行与控制平面决策，执行计划应涵盖聚合/解聚拓扑、KV来源与传输、硬件变体、路由/准入策略和扩缩容决策，以应对智能体、多模态、异构和弹性推理挑战。

title: LINGO: Latent Initialization and Gradient Optimization for Sparse-view X-ray Novel View Synthesis and CT Reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: In novel view synthesis and Computed Tomography (CT) reconstruction with sparse-view X-ray imaging, insufficient angular coverage leads to structural ambiguity and accumulated noise. Integrating 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with X-ray absorption physics can achieve promising results, but it suffers from noisy initialization, positional insensitivity, and weak gradients in low-density regions. In this paper, we propose a unified Latent Initialization and Gradient Optimization (LINGO) framework to address these issues. LINGO combines latent mask-space initialization with dynamic gradient optimization to improve point cloud structural completeness while accelerating training. It constructs voxel-level 3D filters from X-ray masks to robustly suppress background noise and provide reliable geometric priors. By employing an adaptive voxel scaling strategy and dynamically scaling loss, LINGO can adjust spatial resolution and explicitly amplify gradients in low-density structures. To evaluate the quality of initialization, we introduce the Initialization Point Cloud Structural Deviation (IPSD) metric. Experiments on the X3D dataset indicate that for the novel view synthesis task, LINGO improves the Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) by an average of 0.72 and 0.0039, respectively, over baselines under identical sparse-view settings, achieving comparable reconstruction quality within 5k steps to state-of-the-art models typically trained with 30k iterations. For the CT reconstruction task, LINGO also demonstrates consistent improvements, with average PSNR and SSIM gains of 0.36 and 0.0134. These results highlight LINGO's effectiveness in both accelerating training and enhancing reconstruction quality across different sparse-view imaging scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LINGO框架，用于稀疏视角X射线新视角合成与CT重建，通过潜在初始化与动态梯度优化提升3D高斯泼溅的重建质量与训练速度。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角X射线成像中角度覆盖不足会导致结构模糊和噪声累积。3DGS结合X射线吸收物理虽有潜力，但存在初始化噪声大、位置不敏感以及低密度区域梯度弱等问题。
AI.method: 提出统一的LINGO框架，结合潜在掩码空间初始化与动态梯度优化；利用X射线掩码构建体素级3D滤波器以抑制背景噪声并提供几何先验；采用自适应体素缩放策略和动态损失缩放来调整空间分辨率并增强低密度结构梯度；同时引入IPSD指标评估初始化点云的结构偏差。
AI.result: 在X3D数据集上，新视角合成任务中，相同稀疏视角设置下，LINGO相比基线平均提升PSNR 0.72、SSIM 0.0039，并在5k步内达到通常需30k迭代训练的SOTA模型相当的重建质量；CT重建任务中，PSNR和SSIM平均分别提升0.36和0.0134。
AI.conclusion: LINGO在稀疏视角成像场景中既能加速训练，又能提升重建质量，验证了其在跨任务中的有效性。

title: Physical-Touch Observability from Wrist Wrench in Granular Scooping
summary: Mining and earthmoving are important real-world deployment settings for embodied intelligence. Autonomous transport and driving systems have improved substantially, but loading and scooping still often depend on skilled human operators, exposing personnel and equipment to operational risk. For robotic scooping, pre-contact RGB-D sensing reveals surface geometry but not the resistance, compaction, tool engagement, or load transfer that emerge during interaction. We test whether the current scoop's six-axis wrist force/torque (F/T), or wrist wrench, contains information about final collected volume, and whether that information depends on the correctly paired action-terrain interaction. We call this property physical-touch observability. Using 6,700 real-robot scoops across 67 terrains, we evaluate correctly paired current-scoop F/T against pre-contact prediction and correspondence-breaking controls under terrain-held-out testing. At the retrospective 60% sequence boundary, correctly paired F/T reduces mean absolute error by 14.2% relative to Action-only and by 21.9% relative to cross-terrain mismatched F/T. Engineered signal summaries reproduce the result across model architectures. Together, these findings position wrist wrench not merely as a low-level feedback signal, but as a task-level perceptual modality through which embodied robots can infer hidden physical states during interaction, providing a foundation for response-aware autonomy in mining and other contact-rich tasks.

AI.tldr: 研究机器人铲掘中腕部力/扭矩能否提供最终收集体积信息，称为物理触觉可观测性。基于6700次真实机器人铲掘、67种地形，正确配对的当前铲斗六轴力/扭矩比仅动作预测和跨地形错配F/T误差更低，表明腕部力/扭矩可作为任务级感知模态。
AI.motivation: 采矿和土方工程中，装载与铲掘仍依赖熟练人工，风险高。预接触RGB-D只能感知表面几何，无法获取交互中的阻力、压实、工具啮合和载荷转移等信息。因此，研究腕部力/扭矩是否包含最终收集体积信息，以及该信息是否依赖正确配对的行动-地形交互。
AI.method: 使用6700次真实机器人铲掘、覆盖67种地形。比较正确配对的当前铲斗腕部六轴F/T、预接触预测和打破对应关系的控制（仅动作、跨地形错配F/T）。在地形留出测试下评估，采用回顾性60%序列边界，并用工程化信号摘要跨模型架构验证。
AI.result: 在回顾性60%序列边界，正确配对F/T相对Action-only将平均绝对误差降低14.2%，相对跨地形错配F/T降低21.9%。工程化信号摘要可在不同模型架构中复现该结果。
AI.conclusion: 腕部力/扭矩不仅是低层反馈信号，更是任务级感知模态，使具身机器人能在交互中推断隐藏物理状态，为采矿等接触丰富任务的响应感知自主性提供基础。

title: Optimal Allocation of Grid-Forming Frequency Shaping Control
summary: Various inverter-based control strategies have been proposed to improve frequency security for power systems with high renewable penetration. Among them, the grid-forming frequency shaping control is particularly promising due to its ability to shape the post-contingency aggregate system frequency dynamics into first-order with prescribed rate of change of frequency (RoCoF) and steady-state frequency deviation. Moreover, the shaped aggregate dynamics depends on the harmonic sum of all inverter transfer functions rather than on their distribution. In light of this, here we explore how to allocate shaping control resources to minimize the transient control effort needed to achieve ideal coherent dynamics. We formulate it as a constrained optimization problem by tackling two main difficulties. First, we make the squared $\mathcal{H}_2$ norm legitimate quantification of transient control cost under step power imbalances through a system transformation. Second, we simplify the $s$-domain constraint for Nadir elimination into a standard constraint that is easy to implement in optimization. The resulting non-convex optimization problem can be solved by existing successive convexification method. The effectiveness of the allocation has been verified on the modified Icelandic Power Network test case.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在高可再生能源渗透电力系统中分配构网型频率整形控制资源，以最小化实现理想一致频率动态所需的暂态控制代价，并在修改后的冰岛电网算例上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 构网型频率整形控制可将故障后系统聚合频率动态整形为一阶响应，并指定RoCoF和稳态频率偏差；且整形后的聚合动态取决于所有逆变器传递函数的谐波和而非其分布，因此有必要研究如何最优分配控制资源。
AI.method: 将其建模为约束优化问题：通过系统变换使平方H2范数可合法量化阶跃功率不平衡下的暂态控制成本；将用于消除Nadir的s域约束简化为易于优化实现的标准约束；所得非凸问题采用逐次凸化方法求解；在修改后的冰岛电网算例上验证。
AI.result: 所提出的控制资源分配方法能够有效实现理想一致动态，并最小化所需暂态控制努力；在修改后的冰岛电网测试算例上验证了分配方案的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过合理的构网型频率整形控制资源分配，可以在满足频率安全与Nadir消除要求的同时降低暂态控制成本，为高可再生能源电力系统频率支撑提供优化分配思路。

title: The Situated Identity Test: Distinguishing Persistent Cognitive Identity from Persona Imitation
comment: 28 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables; open-source benchmark and reference implementation available at https://github.com/openkedge/sitbench
summary: Large language models can convincingly adopt personas, recall past dialogues, and weave rich autobiographies. Yet this conversational eloquence conceals a fundamental attribution problem: looking the part does not mean having lived the life. Two individuals can share identical public profiles--the same age, hometown, occupation, and personality traits--while possessing entirely distinct private histories, relationships, and acquired skills. When conditioned solely on that shared profile, an agent lacks the information required to determine which lineage is correct. We introduce the Situated Identity Test (SIT), an architecture-independent framework that evaluates whether an agent's behavior is functionally attributable to a specific developmental lineage. Grounded identity requires both appropriate knowledge of recorded experiences and appropriate ignorance of ungrounded ones, bounded by what the identity has actually acquired rather than what its underlying foundation model knows. We prove that any policy conditioned solely on a compressed profile is bounded by an average situated validity of at most 1/m across m colliding life histories on lineage-discriminative queries (at most 50% for paired lineages). We instantiate this framework in SITBench, an evaluation suite designed for 25 profile-collision pairs (50 distinct lineages) across 10,000 planned probes and nine architectural configurations. Supported by an open-source reference implementation, deterministic test fixtures, and empirical pilot evaluations on frontier foundation models (GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5), we formalize the failure modes of persona prompting under profile collision and provide an assurance harness for evaluating episodic continuity, structured state, and epistemic boundaries.

AI.tldr: 论文提出情境身份测试（SIT）与评测套件 SITBench，用于检验语言模型代理的行为是否能功能性归因于特定成长谱系，而非仅靠公开人设资料伪装身份。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能逼真扮演人设、回忆对话并编织自传，但“像”不等于“经历过”。当两个体拥有相同公开资料却具有不同私人历史、关系和技能时，仅依据压缩人设条件的代理无法判断哪条谱系才是真实的。
AI.method: 提出架构无关的 Situated Identity Test 框架，要求代理既知道已记录经历，又对未扎根经历保持恰当无知；证明仅依赖压缩人设的策略在 m 条碰撞人生历史上平均情境有效性至多 1/m，成对谱系至多 50%。并构建 SITBench：25 对资料碰撞、50 条谱系、计划 10,000 个探针、9 种架构配置，附开源参考实现、确定性测试夹具，并在前沿基础模型 GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Claude Opus 5 上进行试点评估。
AI.result: 形式化了资料碰撞下人设提示的失败模式，给出仅靠人设条件时的性能上界，并提供用于评估情节连续性、结构化状态与认知边界的保障性测试框架。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭公开资料无法支撑真实情境身份，代理必须与其特定发展谱系功能性对齐；SIT/SITBench 为评估和保障这种扎根身份提供了可操作框架。

title: Image Frame Dynamic Object Segmentation and Ego Motion Estimation using Radar Image Fusion
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE IROS 2026 Workshop LTP
summary: Dynamic object segmentation and ego-motion estimation are closely coupled problems in autonomous driving, as accurate ego-motion estimation typically requires static scene observations, while identifying static observations requires knowledge of the ego motion. We present Radar-Dot, a radar--RGB framework that exploits radar Doppler measurements to address this coupling. Radar returns are first used to estimate ego velocity through a linear Doppler constraint, with residual-based static/dynamic segmentation and robust estimation used to reduce the influence of moving objects. The estimated motion is then combined with metric depth and dense optical flow to identify image regions whose observed motion is inconsistent with the rigid scene motion. Experiments on 10 nuScenes scenes (part of nuscenes-mini) demonstrate that the resulting geometric pipeline achieves 20.24% dynamic IoU and 33.67% F1-score over 394 frame pairs, while radar-based static-point filtering improves ego-velocity estimation compared with using all radar returns. These results demonstrate the potential of radar as a modality for jointly improving ego-motion estimation and dynamic object segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出Radar-Dot雷达- RGB框架，利用雷达多普勒测量联合解决动态物体分割与自运动估计的耦合问题。
AI.motivation: 动态物体分割与自运动估计紧密耦合：精确自运动估计需要静态场景观测，而识别静态观测又需要自运动信息。
AI.method: 先用雷达回波通过线性多普勒约束估计自速度，并基于残差进行静态/动态分割与鲁棒估计以抑制运动物体影响；再将估计运动与度量深度、稠密光流结合，识别图像中与刚性场景运动不一致的区域。
AI.result: 在nuScenes的10个场景（nuscenes-mini部分）的394对帧上，几何流水线达到20.24%动态IoU和33.67% F1分数；基于雷达的静态点滤波相比使用全部雷达回波提升了自速度估计。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明雷达有潜力作为联合提升自运动估计与动态物体分割的模态。

title: CraftBench-UE: Deterministic Evaluation for Coding Agents in Unreal Engine
summary: Building gameplay features in a game engine requires more than code, as code that compiles and runs does not necessarily implement the requested gameplay. We introduce CraftBenchUE, an evaluation harness that runs agents in an isolated Unreal Engine environment, reconstructs their saved submissions in fresh projects, and applies deterministic build, asset, and runtime checks without an LLM judge. Based on the harness, we built a benchmark consisting of 70 tasks spanning C++ source, Blueprint assets, and editor scripting. We evaluate seven models under two editor-tool configurations, with a file-and-shell baseline on C++ tasks. We further pair tasks that specify the same gameplay and use the same runtime tests, but require C++ and Blueprint as the deliverables. Across the 10 paired tasks, C++ completion rates exceed Blueprint by 30.0 and 42.9 percentage points in the two tool configurations. Among on-time Blueprint submissions in this paired set that pass asset checks, 42.2% and 50.0% fail explicit runtime assertions. These submissions satisfy asset requirements but fail the required gameplay tests. We will release the harness, task benchmark, and our trajectory findings with the report.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CraftBenchUE，一个在隔离Unreal Engine环境中运行智能体、重建提交并执行确定性构建/资源/运行时检查的评测框架，包含70个任务（C++、蓝图、编辑器脚本），评测7个模型；发现C++任务完成率显著高于蓝图，且许多通过资源检查的蓝图提交仍无法通过运行时断言。
AI.motivation: 在游戏引擎中实现玩法功能仅靠代码编译运行不够，因为能编译运行的代码不一定实现了所要求的玩法，需要更严格的评测方式。
AI.method: 构建CraftBenchUE评测框架：在隔离的UE环境中运行智能体，在新工程中重建其保存的提交，执行确定性的构建、资源与运行时检查（无需LLM评判）；基于此设计70个任务，涵盖C++源码、蓝图资源和编辑器脚本；在两种编辑器工具配置下评测7个模型，并在C++任务上设文件与shell基线；还配对设计10组要求相同玩法、使用相同运行时测试但分别要求C++和蓝图交付的任务。
AI.result: 在10组配对任务中，C++完成率在两种工具配置下分别比蓝图高30.0和42.9个百分点；在通过资源检查的按时蓝图提交中，分别有42.2%和50.0%未通过显式运行时断言。
AI.conclusion: 满足资源要求不等于实现所需玩法；作者将发布评测框架、任务基准及轨迹发现。

title: SmoLSTM: A Compact Vision-Language-Action Model with Recurrent Memory that Persists
summary: Vision-language-action models often predict actions from only the current observation, which can leave tasks involving object occlusion or visually identical objects ambiguous without episode history. The usual countermeasure, widening the observation window, turns the horizon into a hyperparameter and lets per-step cost grow with it. We instead capture the episode in a recurrent state. SmoLSTM couples a frozen 256M-parameter SmolVLM backbone to a matrix-memory LSTM control layer in which observation tokens and action queries are unified in a single causal stream that is never reset throughout the entire episode. Recurrent-state storage is therefore O(1) in episode length. A flow-matching action head predicts chunks of 10 end-effector pose deltas and gripper commands at each control step. Our single policy, trained jointly on 7,461 demonstrations across 140 tasks and evaluated on held-out initial states, performs best, reaching 85.1% subgoal coverage and 77.5% full-task success on LIBERO-Mem with 0.04B trainable parameters, surpassing both the benchmark's own object-centric baseline and recent memory-based approaches.
