Six pollen species were imaged by brightfield and holographic microscopy. Raw, single back-propagation and iterative phase retrieval holograms were evaluated with YOLOv26s detection and MobileNetV4 classification after anchor-based annotation transfer. Six attribution methods were assessed for spatial grounding and faithfulness with the Attribution Health Inspection and Repair (AHIR) protocol, which tests model brittleness under weak noise and corrects attribution-map granularity when needed. Brightfield achieved 0.6890 mAP50-95 (0.8865 mAP50) for detection and 0.9687 macro-F1 (0.9705 accuracy) for classification. Reconstructed holograms narrowed the gap with a task-dependent split: p-type was strongest for detection at 0.5324 mAP50-95 (0.8229 mAP50), while r-type was strongest for classification at 0.7695 macro-F1 (0.7866 accuracy), both far above raw-hologram baselines. Activation-based explanations localized strongly on grains, and region-based methods retained ~60 to ~80% of faithfulness under holography. The holographic detector was highly brittle to weak perturbations, saturating deletion-based evaluation while insertion remained informative. Pixel-level gradient explanations approached random floor, yet spatial smoothing restored p-type gradient faithfulness from 0.05 to 0.51. For holographic classification, perturbation-based explanations remained faithful while gradient-based methods fell below random floor. Reconstruction improves low-cost holographic pollen analysis, while AHIR distinguishes genuine attribution failure from artifacts caused by model brittleness and map granularity.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估重建全息图能否缩小低成本无透镜数字全息显微镜与明场显微镜在自动化花粉分析中的差距，并检验模态变化下模型解释的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 明场显微镜成本高、操作复杂，而无透镜数字全息显微镜成本低；需验证重建全息图能否弥补性能差距，以及模型解释在模态改变时是否仍然可靠。
AI.method: 对6种花粉分别用明场和全息显微镜成像，采用基于锚点的标注迁移，使用YOLOv26s检测和MobileNetV4分类评估原始、单次反向传播和迭代相位恢复全息图；用6种归因方法评估空间定位和忠实性，并采用AHIR协议测试弱噪声下的模型脆弱性并修正归因图粒度。
AI.result: 明场检测mAP50-95为0.6890（mAP50 0.8865），分类macro-F1为0.9687（准确率0.9705）。重建全息图缩小差距且任务依赖：p型检测最强（0.5324 mAP50-95，0.8229 mAP50），r型分类最强（0.7695 macro-F1，0.7866准确率），均远高于原始全息基线。激活类解释强定位于花粉粒，区域类方法在全息下保持约60-80%忠实性；全息检测器对弱扰动高度脆弱，删除评估饱和而插入仍有信息；像素级梯度解释接近随机下限，空间平滑将p型梯度忠实性从0.05恢复至0.51；全息分类中扰动类解释保持忠实，梯度类低于随机下限。
AI.conclusion: 重建可提升低成本全息花粉分析性能；AHIR能区分真正的归因失败与模型脆弱性和归因图粒度导致的伪影。

title: DiagGen: Agentic Generation of Deformable Assets with Sim-based Diagnostics for Robotic Simulation
summary: While simulation-ready deformable assets are essential for in-silico robotic manipulation tasks, existing generation frameworks typically assess physical plausibility after generation, leaving an object's simulated response unused as feedback for repairing upstream errors. We present DiagGen, an agentic framework that turns a single in-the-wild image into a simulation-ready deformable asset through a generate--simulate--diagnose--refine loop. DiagGen constructs part-aware geometry and material parameters, then uses a VLM (vision-language model)-based agent to select semantically informative regions, probe them in a physics simulator, observe material responses, and route evidence-backed repair cues to the responsible generation stage. Experiments on 40 assets show that diagnostics provides useful repair cues and can moderately improve the quality of generated deformable assets. Finally, we show that unlike assets generated from visual foundation models which may not be simulatable, DiagGen-generated deformables can be directly dropped into a high-fidelity physical simulator for the planning and simulation of contact-rich pick-and-place tasks. The project's website is https://diaggen.github.io/.

AI.tldr: DiagGen 是一个智能体框架，能从单张真实场景图像生成可用于仿真的可变形资产，通过“生成—仿真—诊断—修复”循环提升物理合理性，并可直接用于接触密集的抓取放置任务。
AI.motivation: 现有可变形资产生成框架通常在生成后才评估物理合理性，没有把仿真响应作为反馈来修复上游生成错误，导致生成资产可能无法用于机器人操作仿真。
AI.method: 提出 DiagGen：从单张图像构建部件感知的几何与材质参数，利用基于 VLM 的智能体选择语义信息丰富的区域，在物理仿真器中探测并观察材质响应，再将有证据支持的修复线索路由到相应生成阶段，形成迭代的生成—仿真—诊断—修复闭环。
AI.result: 在 40 个资产上的实验表明，诊断能提供有用的修复线索，并适度提升生成可变形资产的质量；与视觉基础模型生成的资产不同，DiagGen 生成的资产可直接放入高保真物理仿真器中，用于接触密集的抓取放置任务规划与仿真。
AI.conclusion: 将仿真反馈引入生成流程可有效诊断和修复可变形资产生成中的物理不合理问题，使生成资产具备直接仿真可用性，支持机器人操作任务。

title: Divergent strategies and convergent outcomes in autonomous materials discovery
summary: Scientific agents are mostly evaluated on whether they complete tasks or recover known results; we instead study variation across repeated open-ended campaigns. Sixteen separately initialized sessions of one model-harness configuration received a frozen database of 12,499 metal-organic frameworks, a methane-storage objective, a pinned protocol and a one-week budget. Strategies diverged into four approaches spanning 100--5,000 screened structures, and eight built 2,253 hypothetical structures. Yet the agents recovered the same materials frontier near 200 cm^3/cm^3, and an independent calculation of the database's porous region found its nine best structures all among their reports. Enforced checks on half the agents raised fresh-run reproduction from one of eight to eight of eight but could not detectably improve conclusion validity, because fifteen of sixteen agents selected the same audit-excluded entry, an incomplete structure whose missing anions created artificial pore volume. Replicated agents thus reveal both robust conclusions and common-mode errors from shared inputs.

AI.tldr: 研究让同一模型-框架配置在16个独立初始化会话中重复开展开放式MOF甲烷存储材料发现，发现不同策略下结论高度一致，但也存在由共享输入导致的共性错误。
AI.motivation: 现有科学智能体多按任务完成或复现已知结果评估，作者希望研究重复开放式科研活动中结果与错误的变异情况。
AI.method: 给16个独立会话提供包含12,499个金属有机框架的冻结数据库、甲烷存储目标、固定协议和一周预算，比较其筛选策略、生成结构及结论；对其中一半智能体施加强制检查，并独立计算数据库多孔区域作为参照。
AI.result: 智能体策略分化为四类，筛选规模从100到5,000个结构不等，其中8个还构建了2,253个假想结构；但它们都找到约200 cm^3/cm^3附近的相同材料前沿，且独立计算得到的数据库多孔区域9个最佳结构均在其报告中。强制检查使新运行复现率从1/8提高到8/8，但未能可检测地提升结论有效性，因为16个智能体中有15个选择了同一被审计排除条目——一个缺失阴离子并造成人工孔体积的不完整结构。
AI.conclusion: 重复运行的智能体既能产生稳健结论，也会因共享输入出现共性错误；仅提高复现性不一定能保证结论有效性。

title: Assessing Adversarial Robustness of Latent Reasoning Models
summary: Large language models increasingly rely on long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories for complex reasoning, but autoregressive generation brings substantial memory and inference costs. Latent reasoning models (LRMs) offer a more efficient alternative by compressing intermediate reasoning into a small number of continuous latent vectors. Despite their efficiency, however, the adversarial robustness of LRMs remains largely underexplored. In this work, we systematically evaluate the robustness of latent reasoning across textual and multimodal settings, covering eight models and six benchmarks. We find that, across our evaluated settings, LRMs are generally less robust than explicit CoT baselines under adversarial perturbations, with particularly severe degradation under white-box attacks. Further analysis reveals distinct failure modes across modalities: textual latent states exhibit brittle dynamics and high sensitivity to specific input patterns, while latent states in multimodal models can remain largely invariant to input perturbations and have limited influence on final predictions. These findings expose robustness limitations of current latent reasoning approaches and highlight the need to jointly consider efficiency and robustness when designing implicit reasoning systems. We have open-sourced our code to facilitate reproduction of our research https://github.com/PKU-ML/latent-reasoning-model-assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了潜在推理模型（LRMs）在文本和多模态任务中的对抗鲁棒性，发现其通常比显式思维链（CoT）基线更脆弱，并揭示了不同模态下独特的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型依赖长链思维进行复杂推理，但自回归生成带来高内存和推理成本。潜在推理模型通过压缩中间推理为连续潜在向量提供高效替代，但其对抗鲁棒性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在文本和多模态设置下系统评估潜在推理的鲁棒性，覆盖8个模型和6个基准，包含白盒攻击等对抗扰动，并分析不同模态的失效模式。
AI.result: 评估发现LRMs普遍不如显式CoT基线鲁棒，白盒攻击下退化尤其严重。文本潜在状态动态脆弱且对特定输入模式敏感；多模态潜在状态可能对输入扰动基本不变，对最终预测影响有限。
AI.conclusion: 当前潜在推理方法存在鲁棒性局限，设计隐式推理系统时需同时权衡效率与鲁棒性。代码已开源。

title: BrainIAC: Interactive 3D Brain Lesion Segmentation across Heterogeneous MRI Modalities with Online Adaptation
summary: Brain lesion segmentation is a fundamental task in medical image analysis, playing a critical role in diagnosis, treatment planning, and longitudinal disease monitoring. Yet existing models still struggle to meet the demands of real clinical use, where deployments contain data distribution shifts, arising from differences in scanner hardware, imaging protocol (varying MRI modality sets), and new pathologies. We present BrainIAC (Brain lesion Interactive Adaptive Continuously learning segmentation), a unified framework that integrates (i) a multi-modal backbone network trained to segment multiple types of brain lesions and handle heterogeneous sets of modalities via zero-filling and random modality dropping; (ii) 3D interactive segmentation with bounding-box and click prompts that preserves fully automatic prediction when no prompt is given; and (iii) an online adaptation mechanism combining Mid-Interaction adaptation and Post-Interaction adaptation, supervised by the network's own predictions as pseudo labels and guided by an extra Click-Centered Gaussian loss. To our knowledge, this is one of the first 3D online adaptation methods for interactive segmentation, and the first to combine handling of heterogeneous modality sets with online adaptation. Experiments across seven brain MRI datasets demonstrate that the proposed components provide complementary and synergistic benefits. The method consistently outperforms existing approaches and generalizes well across heterogeneous imaging modalities, including those unseen during training, as well as previously unseen brain pathology types. The code and a 3D Slicer plug-in will be released at https://github.com/WenTXuL/BrainIAC upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出BrainIAC统一框架，用于脑病变分割，整合多模态骨干网络、3D交互分割和在线自适应机制，在七个脑MRI数据集上表现优异，能泛化到未见模态和病理类型。
AI.motivation: 脑病变分割在临床诊断、治疗规划和纵向监测中至关重要，但现有模型难以应对临床部署中的数据分布偏移，这些偏移源于扫描仪硬件差异、成像协议导致的MRI模态集变化以及新出现的病理类型。
AI.method: 提出BrainIAC框架，包含三个部分：(1) 多模态骨干网络，通过零填充和随机模态丢弃处理异质模态集，分割多种脑病变；(2) 3D交互分割，支持边界框和点击提示，无提示时保持全自动预测；(3) 在线自适应机制，结合交互中与交互后自适应，以网络自身预测为伪标签，并由点击中心高斯损失引导。
AI.result: 在七个脑MRI数据集上的实验表明，各组件提供互补且协同的增益。该方法持续优于现有方法，并能很好地泛化到训练中未见的异质成像模态以及未见的脑病理类型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一个统一的脑病变分割框架，有效应对分布偏移，是首批用于交互分割的3D在线自适应方法之一，也是首个结合异质模态集处理与在线自适应的方法。代码和3D Slicer插件将在发表后发布。

title: Splat-CBF: Safe Next-Best-View Control in 3D Gaussian-Splat Maps
summary: Where to look and how to move? A robot navigating an unmapped environment must do both at once, and the two goals pull against each other. The regions most worth observing are the ones the map knows least about, and those are exactly where the robot cannot trust its collision margins. We resolve this tension by introducing Splat-CBF, an active perception control barrier function that steers the camera toward the next best view while collision avoidance is enforced as a hard constraint. Safety is enforced by a risk-aware control barrier function that turns the Average Value-at-Risk of the Gaussian field into a single smooth hard constraint. Perception is enforced by a second barrier that rewards camera orientations with high expected Fisher information gain near the robot's planned path. The two meet in a quadratic program where safety is hard and perception is soft, with a slack penalty that adapts to how often perception has already been relaxed and how close the robot is to an uncertain region. We verify the method in indoor simulations, a Isaac Kinova manipulator and in experiments on an Ackermann-drive robot. Our results assert that robot navigates faster, gathers more information, and runs faster online than safety-only and perception-only baselines, giving up informative motion only when safety requires it.

AI.tldr: 提出Splat-CBF框架，将风险感知控制障碍函数与感知障碍函数结合，在二次规划中硬约束安全、软约束感知，使机器人在未知环境中安全导航并主动获取信息。
AI.motivation: 机器人在未知环境导航时需同时决定“看哪里”和“怎么移动”，二者相互冲突：最值得观察的区域恰是地图未知、碰撞边界不可信的区域。因此需要解决探索与安全之间的张力。
AI.method: 引入Splat-CBF主动感知控制障碍函数：用风险感知CBF将高斯场的平均风险价值（AVaR）转化为单一平滑硬约束以保证安全；用第二个障碍函数奖励机器人规划路径附近具有高期望Fisher信息增益的相机朝向；两者在二次规划中融合，安全为硬约束、感知为软约束，松弛惩罚随感知已放松次数和与不确定区域的距离自适应调整。在室内仿真、Isaac Kinova机械臂和Ackermann驱动机器人实验中验证。
AI.result: 相比仅安全或仅感知基线，该方法使机器人导航更快、获取信息更多、在线运行更快，并且仅在安全需要时放弃有信息量的运动。
AI.conclusion: Splat-CBF能够有效平衡安全约束与主动感知，在未知环境中实现高效、安全且信息丰富的机器人导航。

title: Agents That Edit Documents: Measuring Agentic PDF Forgery Against a Non-Agentic Control
summary: AI agents that carry a multi-step computer task through on their own became ordinary tools in the past year, and the same autonomy is available to anyone whose task is harmful. We ask what that means for a relying party -- an insurer, a lender, an auditor -- whose evidence is a filed PDF. AgentForge-Bench measures how reliably an off-the-shelf coding agent, driving one of seven open-weight models with a shell and the stock Python PDF stack, alters one dollar amount, date or address in a real filed financial document from a single sentence of intent, graded by rules rather than by a model. Across 1,750 cells, 1,419 (81.1%) satisfy the verifier, and 808 (46.2%) also survive every stricter filter: visible, localized, typeface-matched, original value gone document-wide. A deterministic script with no model in it solves 98 of the 125 documents; the agents solve 124, and none the script solves alone. Agents misreport 41% of their wrong edits as done, no model refused, and the cheapest verified forgery costs 2.4 cents. The raw rate overstates the threat by about a factor of two; the strict rate is still large.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AgentForge-Bench，评估现成编码智能体能否仅凭一句意图，篡改真实申报财务 PDF 中的金额、日期或地址。结果显示 81.1% 的尝试通过验证器，46.2% 还能通过更严格的可见性、局部性、字体匹配和原值全文档消失过滤。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体已能自主执行多步计算机任务，恶意用途同样变得可及。对于保险公司、贷款方、审计方等依赖方而言，提交的 PDF 常是核心证据，因此需要量化其被智能体低成本篡改的风险。
AI.method: 构建 AgentForge-Bench：让现成编码智能体驱动 7 个开放权重模型，使用 shell 和标准 Python PDF 栈，从单句意图修改真实申报财务文件中的一美元金额、日期或地址；由规则而非模型进行评分。共测试 1,750 个单元格，并设置验证器与更严格过滤条件，同时与无模型的确定性脚本对比。
AI.result: 在 1,750 个单元格中，1,419 个（81.1%）满足验证器，808 个（46.2%）还通过严格过滤：可见、局部、字体匹配、原值在全文档中消失。无模型确定性脚本解决 125 份文档中的 98 份，智能体解决 124 份，且没有脚本能单独解决的文档。智能体将 41% 的错误编辑误报为完成，没有模型拒绝，最便宜的已验证伪造成本为 2.4 美分。
AI.conclusion: 原始成功率约将威胁高估两倍，但严格成功率仍然很高。自主智能体已能以极低成本对 filed PDF 进行可信篡改，依赖方不应仅依赖 PDF 作为证据，需加强取证与验证。

title: UniK: Universal Knowledge Perception for Digital and Physical AI
summary: Two transformative classes of AI systems are reshaping how organizations operate: \textit{digital AI}, which reasons over enterprise knowledge to power chatbots and agent workflows; and \textit{physical AI}, which learns to control robots and autonomous systems from video, gameplay, and sensor telemetry. Both face the same foundational bottleneck: raw knowledge at scale, spanning heterogeneous modalities, locked in private corpora that existing AI infrastructure cannot access reliably or efficiently. We propose \textit{Universal Knowledge Perception (UniK)} as a common platform for both classes, covering the full knowledge lifecycle (ingestion, enrichment, indexing, retrieval, and continuous evaluation) across modalities from rich text and video to molecular data and sensor telemetry. We present UniK, built on Polymath Retrieval (multi-index fusion over automatically enriched indices) with no task-specific fine-tuning. Across five digital AI domains (medical literature, open-domain QA, chemistry, legal video proceedings, and government open data) UniK combined with an open-source 70-billion-parameter model consistently matches or outperforms frontier proprietary LLMs that are orders of magnitude larger: 76\% RAG accuracy on government data versus 47\% for GPT-5; 77.9\% on medical QA without fine-tuning; topping all open-source chemistry pipelines. We show that the same infrastructure directly addresses the data curation, indexing, and retrieval challenges facing physical AI world model training, where the knowledge problem is harder but structurally identical.

AI.tldr: 提出通用知识感知平台 UniK，统一数字AI与物理AI的知识生命周期，基于 Polymath Retrieval 多索引融合，无需任务特定微调；在五个数字AI领域匹配或超越超大闭源LLM，并可直接迁移到物理AI世界模型训练。
AI.motivation: 数字AI与物理AI都面临同一基础瓶颈：大规模、异构、私有的原始知识难以被现有AI基础设施可靠且高效地访问、索引与检索。
AI.method: 提出 UniK，覆盖知识摄入、增强、索引、检索与持续评估全生命周期，支持文本、视频、分子数据、传感器遥测等模态；核心为 Polymath Retrieval，即对自动增强索引进行多索引融合，无需任务特定微调，并与开源70B参数模型结合。
AI.result: 在医疗文献、开放域QA、化学、法律视频庭审和政府开放数据五个领域：政府数据RAG准确率76%，GPT-5为47%；医学QA无微调达77.9%；化学任务居开源管线首位；并证明同一基础设施可处理物理AI世界模型训练中的数据策展、索引与检索问题。
AI.conclusion: UniK 可作为数字AI与物理AI的共同知识平台，以较小开源模型加检索基础设施，在多个领域达到或超越数量级更大的闭源LLM，并支撑物理AI世界模型训练。

title: Swiss-Knife: A Framework for Reconfigurable Externalised Multi-Objective Alignment at Decode Time
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, includes technical appendix and proofs
summary: Decode-time alignment methods steer a frozen language model by scoring candidate continuations with an external reward and selecting the maximiser. We argue that this shared design is a single degenerate point in a much larger space. We introduce Swiss-Knife, a framework for externalised multi-objective alignment in which the alignment specification is a first-class runtime object: hot-swappable scoring blades, a batch normaliser, a pairwise aggregation operator, and a selection rule. Six axioms characterise the admissible aggregation operators, and we prove a representation theorem: every operator satisfying them has the form $R_i = \sum_{j \neq i} g((μ_i - μ_j)/s(σ_i,σ_j))$, a two-parameter family containing probit and logistic comparison rules and pointwise argmax as named coordinates. Within it, pairwise aggregation is Lipschitz-stable under adversarial reward contamination while argmax is not, and Candidate-Batch Normalization (CBN) makes the weight simplex invariant to the rescalings under which reward models are only ever identified. Our reference instantiation pairs DPO-LoRA blades with an uncertainty-aware pairwise tournament. Sweeping the helpfulness/honesty/harmlessness simplex, it attains the best balanced frontier of six decode-time methods (harmonic $F_1$ 0.797 vs. 0.750 for the strongest baseline, $p < 10^{-14}$) with the lowest refusal rate and highest helpfulness of any arm, and reconfigures its objectives in 0.05 ms with no gradient computation. Ablating CBN costs 0.217 $F_1$, and the metadata confirms the predicted mechanism: the lowest-variance blade retains 9% of its nominal 33% influence, and the collapse follows the predicted ordering.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Swiss-Knife，一个将解码时对齐规格作为运行时对象的多目标外置对齐框架，用可热插拔评分刀片、批归一化、成对聚合与选择规则替代传统的单一奖励打分加argmax，并给出理论刻画与实证优势。
AI.motivation: 现有解码时对齐方法通常用外部奖励对候选续写打分并选最大值，作者认为这只是巨大设计空间中的一个退化点，缺乏多目标可重构性、鲁棒性与运行时灵活性。
AI.method: 提出 Swiss-Knife 框架：对齐规格成为一等运行时对象，包含热插拔评分刀片、Candidate-Batch Normalization、成对聚合算子和选择规则；用六条公理刻画可允许聚合算子，证明表示定理，形式为 R_i = sum over j!=i g((μ_i - μ_j)/s(σ_i,σ_j))，涵盖probit、logistic比较规则和逐点argmax。参考实例将 DPO-LoRA 刀片与不确定性感知成对锦标赛结合，并在 helpfulness/honesty/harmlessness 单纯形上扫描，进行消融。
AI.result: 在六种解码时方法中获得最佳平衡前沿，调和 F1 为 0.797，强基线为 0.750，p < 10^-14；拒绝率最低、帮助性最高；无需梯度即可在 0.05 ms 内重构目标。消融 CBN 损失 0.217 F1，元数据验证预测机制：最低方差刀片仅保留名义 33% 影响力中的 9%，且崩溃顺序符合预测。
AI.conclusion: 成对聚合在对抗性奖励污染下具有 Lipschitz 稳定性，而 argmax 不具备；CBN 使权重单纯形对奖励模型仅可识别的缩放保持不变。Swiss-Knife 将解码时对齐推广为可热插拔、可证明且高效的多目标运行时对齐框架。

title: EvalMem: An Operation-Level Diagnostic Framework for Long-Term Memory Systems
summary: Long-horizon interactions with LLM-based assistants require memory systems that preserve and update user states, preferences, and interaction histories. Existing evaluations report end-to-end QA accuracy and cannot determine whether errors arise from encoding, retrieval, or generation. We introduce EvalMem, an operation-level diagnostic framework with three parallel Examiners. For each query, the Encoding Examiner checks whether the target fact is stored, the Retrieval Examiner assesses whether the native retriever returns usable evidence, and the Generation Examiner tests whether the model can answer from oracle evidence. Their outputs form fine-grained multi-label defect codes. To improve store-level diagnosis, we adapt agentic RAG with a recall-first strategy that searches using both the query and source evidence, increasing recall of present evidence on LoCoMo from 70.2% to 95.6%. Evaluations of seven memory systems on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and dynamic DynaMem-Bench identify retrieval as the most frequently attributed failure layer; in default LoCoMo, retrieval defects reach 22.1%, compared with 7.7% for encoding and 6.5% for generation. Guided by this diagnosis, MemWiki, a search-friendly auxiliary structure built from each system's memory export, improves mean accuracy by 2.5 and 2.3 percentage points on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出EvalMem，一个操作级诊断框架，通过编码、检索、生成三个检查器定位LLM助手记忆系统的错误来源。在三个基准上评估七个记忆系统，发现检索是最常见失败层，并基于此提出MemWiki辅助结构提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统评估仅报告端到端问答准确率，无法区分错误来自编码、检索还是生成阶段，导致难以针对性改进。
AI.method: 设计三个并行Examiner：编码检查器判断目标事实是否存储，检索检查器评估原生检索器是否返回可用证据，生成检查器测试模型能否基于oracle证据回答；输出多标签缺陷码。并采用召回优先的agentic RAG策略提升存储级诊断。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo上将现有证据召回率从70.2%提升至95.6%；评估七个记忆系统于LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S和DynaMem-Bench，发现检索缺陷占比最高（LoCoMo默认下22.1%，编码7.7%，生成6.5%）。基于诊断提出的MemWiki在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上分别提升平均准确率2.5和2.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 操作级诊断能有效定位记忆系统失败层，检索是主要瓶颈；针对性的辅助结构（如MemWiki）可显著提升系统性能。

title: Search, Ground, Plan: Functional Sufficiency for Task and Motion Planning under Incomplete Scene Knowledge
summary: Foundation models (FMs) have expanded task and motion planning (TAMP) to manipulation problems specified through language and visual observations. However, incomplete scene knowledge leaves a critical gap between understanding what the task requires and knowing whether the physical scene can actually realize it. We introduce GRAB-TAMP, an FM-based TAMP framework that searches for scene entities required for task completion, grounds functional roles to valid physical objects, and plans only after a complete joint assignment establishes functional sufficiency. We represent the task through functional roles, relations, and assignment constraints, and incrementally inspect the scene while requirements remain unresolved, verifying candidate objects through semantic, geometric, and relational checks. We evaluate GRAB-TAMP across 32 scene variants spanning Kitchen, Living Room, and Workshop domains. Across 200 feasible trials, our approach achieves 54.0% end-to-end success with 67.3% plan goal coverage. Compared with three FM-based TAMP frameworks under the same execution setting, GRAB-TAMP improves end-to-end success by 25.7 percentage points over the mean baseline. Implementation and evaluation code: https://github.com/Narendhiranv04/GRAB-TAMP

AI.tldr: 提出GRAB-TAMP，一种基于基础模型的TAMP框架：通过搜索任务所需场景实体、将功能角色绑定到有效物理对象，并在完整联合赋值确认功能充分性后再进行规划，以解决语言与视觉操作任务中场景知识不完整的问题。
AI.motivation: 基础模型虽将TAMP扩展到语言和视觉指定的操作问题，但不完整的场景知识导致“任务需要什么”与“物理场景能否实现”之间存在关键差距，因此需要在规划前确认场景是否具备完成任务的功能充分性。
AI.method: 用功能角色、关系和分配约束表示任务；在需求未解决时增量检查场景，并通过语义、几何和关系检查验证候选对象；仅当完整联合分配建立功能充分性后才进行规划。在Kitchen、Living Room、Workshop三个领域的32个场景变体上评估，并与三个基于基础模型的TAMP框架在相同执行设置下比较。
AI.result: 在200次可行试验中，GRAB-TAMP取得54.0%的端到端成功率和67.3%的规划目标覆盖率；相比三个基线方法的平均端到端成功率提高25.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在规划前进行功能充分性验证和完整联合赋值，可有效提升基于基础模型的TAMP在语言与视觉操作任务中的成功率和目标覆盖率。实现与评估代码已开源。

title: HDMamba-YOLO: Efficient State-Space Perception and Local Spatial Reconstruction for UAV Small Object
summary: Small-object detection in UAV imagery is challenged by weak visual evidence, ambiguous boundaries, dense object distributions, and complex backgrounds. Effective detection therefore requires long-range contextual information for target-background discrimination while preserving explicit local two-dimensional structures for accurate localization. These requirements arise at different stages of the detection pipeline and are not naturally addressed by a uniform feature-processing strategy. We propose Hybrid Dual-domain Mamba-YOLO (HDMamba-YOLO), a stage-wise heterogeneous SSM-CNN detector organized according to a perception-reconstruction-alignment-interaction rationale. EfficientVMamba-based EVSS establishes long-range contextual perception in the backbone, while PhasePatchMerging2D provides phase-aware hierarchical transitions. DST-Wrapper and Native C3k2-ASSAF then perform perception-to-reconstruction transition and repeated local two-dimensional reconstruction during FPN/PAN aggregation. DySample provides content-adaptive cross-scale resampling, while OS-CVTIA introduces macro-micro interaction and task-specific modulation for localization and classification. On VisDrone2019, HDMamba-YOLO-B achieves 42.737% mAP50 and 25.713% mAP50:95 with 10.042M parameters and 29.879 corrected GFLOPs. HDMamba-YOLO-Lite achieves 41.140% mAP50 and 24.741% mAP50:95 with 5.344M parameters. Under the unified AI-TOD evaluation protocol, HDMamba-YOLO-B obtains 21.621% AP and 47.881% AP50. Controlled ablations further support the stage-wise allocation of state-space perception, convolutional reconstruction, dynamic alignment, and task interaction for UAV small-object detection.

AI.tldr: 提出HDMamba-YOLO，一种按感知-重建-对齐-交互思路分阶段异构设计的SSM-CNN无人机小目标检测器，在VisDrone2019和AI-TOD上取得优异精度与参数效率。
AI.motivation: 无人机图像中小目标检测面临视觉证据弱、边界模糊、目标密集、背景复杂等挑战，既需长程上下文区分目标与背景，又需保留显式局部二维结构以精确定位，而这些需求出现在检测流程不同阶段，统一特征处理策略难以兼顾。
AI.method: 构建HDMamba-YOLO，按阶段异构组合SSM与CNN：骨干采用EfficientVMamba的EVSS建立长程上下文感知，PhasePatchMerging2D实现相位感知层级过渡；FPN/PAN聚合中，DST-Wrapper与Native C3k2-ASSAF完成感知到重建的转换及重复局部二维重建；DySample提供内容自适应跨尺度重采样；OS-CVTIA引入宏微观交互与任务特定调制以服务定位和分类。
AI.result: 在VisDrone2019上，HDMamba-YOLO-B达到42.737% mAP50和25.713% mAP50:95，参数量10.042M，修正GFLOPs为29.879；Lite版达到41.140% mAP50和24.741% mAP50:95，参数量5.344M。在AI-TOD统一评测协议下，B版获得21.621% AP和47.881% AP50。消融实验进一步支持状态空间感知、卷积重建、动态对齐与任务交互的分阶段分配。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段分配状态空间感知、卷积重建、动态对齐与任务交互，可有效应对无人机小目标检测中的多阶段需求，验证了异构SSM-CNN设计的有效性。

title: Seeing Through Conflicts: Improving Instruction Hierarchy Alignment in Vision-Language Models
summary: Instruction hierarchy (IH) alignment teaches language models to prioritize higher-level instructions when inputs conflict. While studied primarily in text-only settings, vision-language models (VLMs) introduce new challenges for IH: instructions may be embedded in images, split across modalities, visually transformed, or encountered during agentic tasks. Positing multimodal IH alignment as a reasoning problem, we train VLMs using reinforcement learning with rule-based rewards, comparing text-only, image-only, and mixed-modality supervision. We find that text-only IH training partially transfers to multimodal attacks, failing when models must decode, reconstruct, or reason over instructions across modalities. Image-based training improves robustness beyond text-only supervision, while mixed-modality training performs best overall. Importantly, the benefits generalize beyond the synthetic typographic training setting to real-image and web-agent safety tasks, while largely preserving general multimodal capability, showing that lightweight, verifiable supervision can meaningfully improve VLM robustness under adversarial, cross-modal, and interactive instruction conflicts.

AI.tldr: 研究多模态指令层级对齐，通过强化学习与规则奖励训练视觉语言模型，比较不同模态监督方式，发现混合模态训练效果最佳，并能泛化到真实图像与网页代理安全任务。
AI.motivation: 指令层级对齐主要在纯文本中研究，而视觉语言模型带来新挑战：指令可能嵌入图像、跨模态分割、视觉变换或在代理任务中出现冲突。
AI.method: 将多模态指令层级对齐视为推理问题，使用强化学习和规则奖励训练视觉语言模型，并比较纯文本、纯图像和混合模态监督。
AI.result: 纯文本训练仅部分迁移到多模态攻击，在需跨模态解码、重建或推理时失败；图像训练比纯文本监督更鲁棒；混合模态训练整体最佳，且优势可泛化到真实图像和网页代理安全任务，同时基本保持通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级、可验证的监督能有效提升视觉语言模型在对抗、跨模态和交互式指令冲突下的鲁棒性。

title: LD-RSVIS: A Large-Scale and Diverse Benchmark for Referring Surgical Video Instrument Segmentation
summary: Referring surgical video instrument segmentation (RSVIS) aims at segmenting the instrument in a surgical video, given a textual description. Despite recent progress, current models are trained and assessed on relatively small-scale benchmarks, hindering the development of more general RSVIS. In addition, existing benchmarks support only the single-target expression that refers to one instrument in the video, while overlooking multi-target and no-target referring expressions, restricting the applicability of RSVIS in practical scenarios. Addressing these issues, we propose LD-RSVIS, a new benchmark aiming to facilitate more robust and general RSVIS. Specifically, LD-RSVIS consists of 3,536 surgical videos with 1.09 million frames and covers a broad set of 30 instrument classes from 25 various procedures. By including abundant videos and classes, LD-RSVIS could benefit large-scale training and evaluation of more general RSVIS methods. Besides, unlike existing datasets, LD-RSVIS offers diverse referring settings, including no-target, single-target, and multi-target expressions, which enables the development of more practical RSVIS models in real applications. In order to ensure high-quality annotations, all videos in LD-RSVIS are manually labeled with multiple rounds of inspection and refinement. To our knowledge, LD-RSVIS is the largest and most diverse benchmark for RSVIS. To analyze LD-RSVIS and to provide comparison for future research, we evaluate 12 representative methods, and the results reveal that more efforts are required for improvements. To encourage future research, we present a simple yet effective RSVIS method, dubbed Cascade-RSVIS, that first mines target-specific cues using the complementary multi-cue text information and then employs such cues and textual information for segmentation, achieving promising performance. Our benchmark and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LD-RSVIS，一个用于指代性手术视频器械分割（RSVIS）的大规模、多样化基准，并给出Cascade-RSVIS方法，以推动更通用、实用的RSVIS研究。
AI.motivation: 现有RSVIS模型多在较小基准上训练和评估，且仅支持单目标指代表达，忽略多目标和无目标情形，限制了通用性与实际应用。
AI.method: 构建LD-RSVIS基准：包含3,536个手术视频、109万帧、30类器械、25种手术，支持无目标、单目标和多目标指代表达，并经多轮人工标注与检查。评估12种代表性方法；提出Cascade-RSVIS，先利用互补多线索文本信息挖掘目标特定线索，再结合文本进行分割。
AI.result: LD-RSVIS是目前最大且最多样的RSVIS基准；对12种方法的评估表明现有方法仍有较大改进空间；Cascade-RSVIS取得了有前景的性能。
AI.conclusion: LD-RSVIS可支持大规模训练与评估，促进更鲁棒、通用的RSVIS发展；Cascade-RSVIS为未来研究提供了有效基线，基准和代码将公开。

title: Verti-WM: A Physics-Aided Exteroceptive World Model for Off-Road Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning for off-road navigation requires extensive vehicle-terrain interaction data, which are costly to collect in high-fidelity simulation. World models offer a promising alternative by replacing simulator roll-outs during policy optimization. However, an off-road world model must condition state transitions on exteroceptive terrain information, which proprioception alone does not provide. This challenge is further amplified by the need to model both rigid and deformable terrain, where data-driven and physics-based approaches offer complementary strengths. We propose Verti-WM, a physics-aided exteroceptive world model that recurrently fuses a frozen Transformer for rigid terrain and a neuro-symbolic terramechanics model for deformable terrain. Elevation and semantic observations queried from a supplied map at each predicted pose condition fusion, enabling six-degree-of-freedom rollouts for policy optimization without further simulator access. Verti-WM reduces prediction error by 34.6% and 21.7% over data-driven and physics-based baselines, respectively. Policies trained entirely within Verti-WM achieve comparable task success rates while reducing computation time by 23.6X relative to direct training in the high-fidelity simulator. We further validate Verti-WM using real-world data, enabling policy optimization within learned real-world kinodynamics and achieving a 80% success rate on the Verti-4-Wheeler platform, compared with 40% for direct sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出 Verti-WM，一种物理辅助的外感知世界模型，通过融合刚性地形Transformer与可变形地形神经符号地形力学模型，实现越野导航策略优化，减少对高保真模拟器的依赖。
AI.motivation: 越野强化学习需要大量车辆-地形交互数据，高保真仿真采集成本高；世界模型可替代仿真器 rollout，但需基于外感知地形信息建模状态转移，并同时处理刚性及可变形地形。
AI.method: Verti-WM 以循环方式融合冻结的 Transformer（刚性地形）和神经符号地形力学模型（可变形地形）；在预测位姿处从给定地图查询高程与语义观测以条件化融合，从而支持六自由度 rollout 用于策略优化，无需进一步访问模拟器。
AI.result: 相比数据驱动和物理基线，预测误差分别降低34.6%和21.7%；完全在 Verti-WM 中训练的策略任务成功率相当，计算时间相比直接在高保真模拟器中训练减少23.6倍；真实世界数据验证中，在 Verti-4-Wheeler 平台上实现80%成功率，而直接 sim-to-real 迁移为40%。
AI.conclusion: 物理辅助的外感知世界模型能有效结合数据驱动与物理方法优势，在越野导航中实现高效策略优化，并提升真实世界部署成功率。

title: MM-ContextFold: Context Folding for Multimodal Agentic Retrieval
summary: Multimodal Agentic Retrieval (MAR) requires agents to solve complex information-seeking tasks by iteratively invoking external tools. Typical frameworks such as ReAct maintain raw multimodal inputs and the accumulating interaction history in a single, ever-growing context, leading to the context explosion problem. While existing methods alleviate this issue by compressing redundant text, effective strategies for managing token-intensive visual content remain largely underexplored. To address this gap, we first conduct a systematic empirical study of approximately 10,000 trajectories. The results show that as visual cues are progressively extracted through external tools and textualized into the context, raw images become increasingly redundant. Continued image retention is associated with higher output entropy and can even degrade task accuracy. Motivated by these findings, we propose MM-ContextFold, a training-free framework that loads raw images only when needed. It maintains a persistent, text-only main context for high-level planning and spawns ephemeral branch contexts for image-dependent subtasks. Within each branch, the agent loads the relevant images, completes the subtask, and folds the result back into the main context as a concise textual summary; the images and branch trace are then discarded. Experiments on seven MAR benchmarks across five backbone models show that MM-ContextFold improves average accuracy by 6.3 percentage points over ReAct while reducing the working context length by 27.5\%.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多模态智能体检索中的上下文爆炸问题，提出免训练框架MM-ContextFold：仅在需要时加载原始图像，主上下文保持纯文本，图像相关子任务在临时分支上下文中完成并折叠为文本摘要，从而提升准确率并缩短上下文长度。
AI.motivation: 现有ReAct等框架将原始多模态输入和不断增长的历史记录保留在单一上下文中，导致上下文爆炸；已有方法多压缩冗余文本，但如何管理高token消耗的视觉内容仍缺乏深入探索。
AI.method: 首先对约10000条轨迹进行系统性实证研究，发现随着视觉线索被外部工具提取并文本化，原始图像逐渐冗余，继续保留图像会增加输出熵甚至降低准确率。基于此提出免训练框架MM-ContextFold：维护持久的纯文本主上下文用于高层规划，为依赖图像的子任务创建临时分支上下文；在分支中加载相关图像、完成子任务，并将结果以简洁文本摘要折叠回主上下文，随后丢弃图像和分支轨迹。
AI.result: 在七个多模态智能体检索基准和五个主干模型上进行实验，MM-ContextFold相比ReAct平均准确率提升6.3个百分点，同时工作上下文长度减少27.5%。
AI.conclusion: MM-ContextFold通过按需加载图像和分支折叠机制，有效缓解多模态智能体中的上下文爆炸问题，在不训练的情况下同时提升任务准确率并降低上下文开销。

title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
summary: Agentic memory is becoming essential for long-horizon AI agents, yet many existing systems rely on autoregressive LLMs to control how memories are organized, retrieved, and used, placing expensive generation on the critical path of memory operations. We introduce \textbf{\method}, a new agentic memory architecture inspired by System-One/System-Two cognition. System One captures fast, lightweight decision-making, whereas System Two performs slower, deliberative reasoning. Jev-Mem brings this division of labor to agentic memory through a dedicated System-One control plane, a structured multi-relational memory plane, and a System-Two reasoning plane. The System-One controller governs memory typing and relational organization during construction, and dynamically performs query routing, retrieval-budget allocation, graph traversal, candidate scoring, and adaptive stopping during retrieval. System Two is invoked only for complex reasoning and answer synthesis. This design improves both memory effectiveness and system efficiency: on LoCoMo Jev-Mem achieves an overall LLM-as-a-Judge score of 0.777, an 11.0\% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, while reducing memory construction time to 158\,s, a 6.6$\times$ speedup over the fastest competing memory system, and lowering average query latency to 0.93\,s, a 36.7\% reduction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Jev-Mem，一种受 System-One/System-Two 认知启发的智能体记忆架构。它通过 System-One 控制平面、结构化多关系记忆平面和 System-Two 推理平面分工，提升记忆组织、检索与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统常依赖自回归 LLM 控制记忆的组织、检索和使用，导致昂贵的生成过程位于记忆操作的关键路径上，影响长时程智能体的效率与可扩展性。
AI.method: Jev-Mem 将记忆系统划分为三个部分：System-One 控制平面负责快速轻量决策；结构化多关系记忆平面负责存储与关系组织；System-Two 推理平面负责复杂推理与答案合成。System-One 在构建阶段管理记忆类型与关系组织，在检索阶段执行查询路由、检索预算分配、图遍历、候选评分和自适应停止；System-Two 仅在复杂推理和答案合成时被调用。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo 数据集上，Jev-Mem 的 LLM-as-a-Judge 总分为 0.777，相比最强基线相对提升 11.0%；记忆构建时间降至 158 秒，相比最快的竞争记忆系统加速 6.6 倍；平均查询延迟降至 0.93 秒，降低 36.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过借鉴 System-One/System-Two 分工，Jev-Mem 能同时提升智能体记忆的有效性和系统效率，表明将快速控制与慢速推理分离是构建高效智能体记忆系统的有效方向。

title: LEAP-NBV: Lightweight Edge Active-Perception for Foundation-Model Next-Best-View Planning
summary: Foundation models are endowing autonomous systems with greater intelligence, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of the environment through visual perception. A representative example is Human Mesh Recovery (HMR), which provides useful estimates of a target's 3D pose and shape that can benefit tactical missions. However, the size and power demands of such models make them difficult to run on edge platforms and limit their real-time performance, undermining the requirements of tactical edge deployment - especially for active perception, where a mobile robot must plan its next-best view on-board and cannot offload computation under contested communications. We present LEAP-NBV, a lightweight active-perception framework that runs foundation-model-driven Next-Best-View (NBV) planning on-board an edge device. To this end, we distill a family of large HMR teachers, each into a compact 32M student, with an offline mesh objective, then quantize the vision encoder to FP16 and characterize its on-device accuracy and latency. Within an occlusion-aware active perception loop, we evaluate all configurations on the same held-out benchmark and deploy the end-to-end pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX, reporting measured on-device latency and energy. Distillation recovers 6-7 mm of Procrustes-aligned mean per-vertex position error (PA-MPVPE) over the undistilled student on the test set. Selecting the edge-optimal compression model brings the HMR engine to ~12 ms at a small accuracy cost and runs the full closed loop at 3.6 FPS and 2.6 J per frame, achieving a 2.0x speedup and 3.0x lower energy than the uncompressed model while nearly matching downstream task quality.

AI.tldr: 提出LEAP-NBV轻量级主动感知框架，可在边缘设备上机载运行基于基础模型的下一最佳视图规划，通过蒸馏和量化实现实时人体网格恢复。
AI.motivation: 基础模型为自主系统带来更强智能，但HMR等模型尺寸和功耗大，难以在边缘平台实时运行；尤其战术边缘的主动感知需在通信受限下机载规划视图，无法卸载计算。
AI.method: 将多个大型HMR教师模型蒸馏为紧凑的32M学生模型，采用离线网格目标，对视觉编码器进行FP16量化；在遮挡感知主动感知循环中评估配置，并在NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX上部署端到端流水线，测量延迟和能耗。
AI.result: 蒸馏相比未蒸馏学生模型在测试集上恢复6-7 mm PA-MPVPE；边缘最优压缩模型使HMR引擎约12 ms，精度损失小，完整闭环达3.6 FPS、每帧2.6 J，相比未压缩模型加速2.0倍、能耗降低3.0倍，下游任务质量接近。
AI.conclusion: LEAP-NBV能够在边缘设备上实现基于基础模型驱动的机载NBV规划，在战术边缘部署中平衡精度与效率，满足实时性和能耗要求。

title: BizSage: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Business Research with Efficient Knowledge Retrieval
summary: While multi-agent systems based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating the progressive workflow of academic research, extending them to economics and business research, where specialized domain knowledge spans neighboring disciplines yet remains difficult to access in a structured way, presents two challenges. First, existing methods mostly retrieve at the paper level, yet the evidence needed for research tasks is often distributed across different sections, creating a granularity mismatch that hinders retrieval coverage and precision. Second, these fields demand strict empirical rigor, yet current systems provide limited mechanisms for learning from evaluation feedback. We present \textbf{BizSage}, a multi-agent framework combining corpus-level fine-grained retrieval with quality-driven self-evolution. We build a Lateral Knowledge Graph (LKG) by merging section-level knowledge graphs and apply Personalized PageRank (PPR) to surface semantically relevant and structurally important sections. Seven specialized agents collaborate under a Meta-Review self-evolution mechanism that distills failure modes from evaluation traces into reusable strategies. On a benchmark spanning four domains and three tasks, BizSage ranks first on the majority of metrics, achieves pairwise win-rates above 60\% against six baselines, and produces zero hallucinated citations. We hope BizSage paves the way for reliable research assistance in economics, business, and the broader social sciences.

AI.tldr: 提出BizSage多智能体框架，结合细粒度检索与自进化，用于经济学和商业研究，在基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统在经济学和商业研究领域面临两大挑战：论文级检索与跨章节证据需求的粒度不匹配；缺乏从评估反馈中学习的机制，难以满足严格的实证要求。
AI.method: 构建横向知识图谱（LKG）整合章节级知识图谱，应用个性化PageRank（PPR）检索语义相关且结构重要的章节；七个专用智能体在元评审自进化机制下协作，从评估轨迹中提炼失败模式为可复用策略。
AI.result: 在涵盖四个领域三个任务的基准上，BizSage在多数指标上排名第一，对六个基线胜率超60%，且零幻觉引用。
AI.conclusion: BizSage为经济学、商业及更广泛的社会科学提供可靠的研究辅助。

title: Selective Commitment for Language-Guided Object Retrieval under Partial Observability
summary: Language-guided object retrieval under partial observability requires deciding whether to gather more evidence, interact with the scene, grasp a candidate, or abstain. We present a closed-loop framework that coordinates these decisions for retrieving a target specified in relation to a reference container. The framework maintains a persistent joint belief over target identity, container relation, and presence through tracked-object, unobserved-target, and target-absent hypotheses. View-conditioned categorical VLM observations update this belief; conformal grasp eligibility and robot feasibility govern commitment, while finite-horizon belief-space planning selects information-gathering actions. Across five different scenarios, our proposed method succeeds in 19/25 simulation episodes versus 12/25 for the best-performing task-adapted baseline and is the only evaluated policy to achieve at least one success in each scenario. Ablations show that cross-view memory improves success under partial occlusion, while the full system does not consistently outperform simplified variants. Real-robot trials demonstrate closed-loop re-observation and autonomous recovery from injected grasp failures, while injected viewpoint failures end in false defer. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility of coordinating evidence gathering and selective grasp commitment within a unified framework for retrieval under partial observability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个闭环框架，用于在部分可观测条件下进行语言引导的目标检索，协调收集证据、交互、抓取与放弃等决策。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测环境中，机器人需要判断是否继续收集证据、与环境交互、抓取候选目标或放弃，尤其是目标由参考容器关系指定时，这一决策问题具有挑战性。
AI.method: 框架维护关于目标身份、容器关系和存在性的持续联合信念，包括已跟踪目标、未观测目标和目标缺失假设；利用视角条件化的分类VLM观测更新信念；通过保形抓取合格性和机器人可行性决定是否承诺抓取；并使用有限时域信念空间规划选择信息收集动作。
AI.result: 在五个场景中，所提方法在仿真中成功19/25，而最佳任务适配基线为12/25，并且是唯一在每个场景中至少成功一次的策略。消融实验表明，跨视角记忆在部分遮挡下提升成功率，但完整系统并不总是优于简化变体。真机实验展示了闭环重新观测和从注入抓取失败中自主恢复，但注入视角失败会导致错误延迟。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，在部分可观测检索任务中，将证据收集与选择性抓取承诺协调在一个统一框架内是可行的。

title: QwenVLConnector: A Fast, Unified Medical VLM Chatbot for Fine-Grained Clinical Perception and Text Generation
summary: Most medical vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended report generation and VQA but provide limited support for structured, fine-grained clinical perception within a unified interface. We present QwenVLConnector, a Qwen2.5-VL-based medical chatbot that unifies classification, multi-label classification, textualized detection, counting, regression, and free-form report generation under a single next-token objective. Our key component is a lightweight dense multi-layer Connector that aggregates low- and high-level visual features, aligns them through the pretrained vision Merger, and fuses them with the final visual representation without increasing sequence length. This design enriches visual tokens with complementary spatial and semantic cues while preserving efficiency. On FLARE-2D, QwenVLConnector improves detection F1 from 0.55 to 0.85, raises single-label classification from 0.37 to 0.51, and boosts report-generation GREEN by up to 18.3 points over the Qwen2.5-VL baseline. We further explore multimodal in-context learning for report generation, showing additional improvements without updating model parameters. Overall, QwenVLConnector offers a unified and efficient framework for combining structured medical perception with open-ended clinical text generation. Our code can be found at https://github.com/plnguyen2908/QwenConnector.

AI.tldr: 提出 QwenVLConnector，一个基于 Qwen2.5-VL 的医学聊天机器人，在单一 next-token 目标下统一分类、多标签分类、文本化检测、计数、回归和自由形式报告生成。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型擅长开放式报告生成和 VQA，但在统一接口内对结构化、细粒度临床感知任务的支持有限。
AI.method: 设计轻量密集多层 Connector，聚合低层与高层视觉特征，通过预训练 vision Merger 对齐，并与最终视觉表示融合，且不增加序列长度；同时探索用于报告生成的多模态上下文学习。
AI.result: 在 FLARE-2D 上，检测 F1 从 0.55 提升至 0.85，单标签分类从 0.37 提升至 0.51，报告生成 GREEN 相比 Qwen2.5-VL 基线最高提升 18.3 点；多模态上下文学习可在不更新模型参数的情况下进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: QwenVLConnector 为结合结构化医学感知与开放式临床文本生成提供了一个统一且高效的框架。

title: Knowledge Graph-Augmented Ambient AI for Clinical Note Generation
summary: Ambient AI is increasingly adopted in healthcare to automatically generate clinical notes from patient-clinician conversations, with the potential to substantially reduce clinician documentation burden. However, generated notes may omit clinically relevant information discussed during the encounter, creating information gaps that can affect downstream care. Knowledge graphs (KGs) constructed from encounter transcripts can provide a structured representation of what was discussed and enable systematic identification of missing information from generated notes that are critical for patient care. In this study, we introduce Coverage-Directed Revision (CDR), a model-agnostic framework that constructs a KG from the encounter transcript, identifies medical concepts absent from an initially generated note, and directs large language models (LLMs) to restore the missing information without modifying the underlying note-generation system. We evaluate CDR on two datasets: 1) Pitt-Bench, a local dataset comprising rehabilitation sessions, and 2) ACI-Bench, a public dataset for benchmarking clinical note generation. We tested four underlying LLMs widely used in ambient AI systems. The results show that CDR consistently improves content recall across all evaluated conditions. Our study provides a practical approach for improving the completeness of ambient AI-generated clinical documentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Coverage-Directed Revision (CDR) 框架，利用知识图谱从医患对话转录中识别并补全环境 AI 生成临床笔记中遗漏的医疗信息，在多个数据集和 LLM 上提升内容召回率。
AI.motivation: 环境 AI 在医疗中自动生成临床笔记虽可减轻医生负担，但可能遗漏对话中讨论的临床相关信息，造成信息缺口，影响后续诊疗。
AI.method: CDR 是模型无关框架：从就诊转录构建知识图谱，识别初始生成笔记中缺失的医疗概念，并指导 LLM 补全这些信息，而不改动原笔记生成系统。在 Pitt-Bench（康复会话）和 ACI-Bench（公共基准）上，使用四种常用 LLM 进行评估。
AI.result: CDR 在所有评估条件下均一致提高了内容召回率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种实用方法，可提升环境 AI 生成临床文档的完整性。

title: Tip Manipulation in Soft Everting Robots via Wall Retraction and Deployable Fingers
summary: Soft everting robots can traverse long, confined paths by continuously growing, yet active interaction remains limited to a single tool fixed at or near the tip, unable to be repositioned on demand and difficult to reconcile with the robot's soft body. We introduce a tip-manipulation and multi-tool deployment strategy for soft everting robots based on wall retraction, implemented with a base roller assembly that independently meters membrane flow in the outer wall while a tail spool regulates growth in the internal tail section. Coordinated wall and tail actuation decouples robot length from membrane-material position, enabling membrane-mounted devices to be transported, exposed, and repositioned at selected locations near the distal tip. We pair this capability with ultralight pleated inflatable fingers integrated into the membrane, fabricated from TPU-coated nylon with an internal airtight bladder. The fingers achieve large bending at low pressures (approximately 100 degrees at 50 kPa in high-pleat designs) and generate blocking forces up to 1.9 N, while remaining limp during transport. The system demonstrates adaptive grasping across diverse household objects (21 to 550 g; 16 to 200 mm), three-dimensional object manipulation and stacking, environmentally braced extension, distal camera panning for confined-space inspection, and controlled sequential payload delivery. These results enable embodied and reversible tip manipulation for soft growing robots in cluttered and tortuous environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于壁面回缩的软体外翻机器人尖端操作与多工具部署策略，使膜上装置可在远端尖端附近被输送、暴露和重新定位，并结合超轻褶皱充气手指实现抓取与操作。
AI.motivation: 软体外翻机器人虽能沿狭长受限路径连续生长，但主动交互通常受限于尖端固定或近端固定的单一工具，无法按需重新定位，也难以与软体机身协调。
AI.method: 采用基部滚轮组件独立计量外壁膜流动，并用尾部卷轴调节内部尾段生长；通过壁面与尾部协同驱动，将机器人长度与膜材料位置解耦，从而在远端尖端附近部署、暴露和重定位膜上装置。同时集成由TPU涂层尼龙和内部气密气囊制成的超轻褶皱充气手指。
AI.result: 充气手指可在低压下大幅弯曲，高褶皱设计在50 kPa下约达100度，阻塞力可达1.9 N，运输时保持柔软。系统展示了自适应抓取多种家居物体（21至550 g，16至200 mm）、三维物体操作与堆叠、环境支撑伸展、受限空间检测中的远端相机平移，以及受控顺序载荷投送。
AI.conclusion: 该策略实现了软体生长机器人的具身化且可逆的尖端操作，适用于杂乱和曲折环境。

title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
summary: Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. Through extensive experiments, we develop a detailed understanding of how capabilities transfer across stages. Finally, we propose a new ACL recipe that combines offline replay over high-quality trajectories with a routed network of multiple LoRA experts each specialized via RL, substantially improving the agent's ability to learn across multiple domains. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning and agentic tasks, evaluated under both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate the value of our analysis and the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACLArena框架，用于研究、分析和评估智能体持续学习（ACL），并基于分析提出一种结合离线回放与多LoRA专家路由的新方法，在多项任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 工业部署的通用智能体需要整合在训练不同阶段获得的多项能力，但目前缺乏成熟的智能体持续学习方案，对现有能力整合范式的权衡也了解不足。
AI.method: 构建顺序训练流水线，从模型和令牌两个层面分析遗忘与泛化机制；系统比较多教师在线策略蒸馏、自蒸馏微调和模型合并；提出新ACL方法：对高质量轨迹进行离线回放，并结合多个经RL专门化的LoRA专家路由网络。
AI.result: 通过大量实验深入理解了能力跨阶段迁移；新方法显著提升智能体多领域学习能力；在四个推理和智能体任务上，域内和域外评估均表明分析的价值和方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ACLArena为ACL研究提供了系统框架，所提方法能有效整合多阶段能力，提升跨域持续学习性能。

title: H2LooP Telecom Model v1: From Telecom Comprehension to Autonomous Issue and PR Resolution
summary: We present H2LooP Telecom Model v1, a domain-specialized large language models fine-tuned for the telecommunications industry. We release two domain-adapted model variants serving complementary use cases: a comprehension-focused variant for telecom domain question answering and reasoning, and an agentic variant for autonomous telecom code generation, pull request resolution, and code commits on production repositories. H2LooP Telecom achieves strong results on the GSMA Open Telecom Lite (OT-Lite) benchmark and a proprietary telecom code generation benchmark, outperforming frontier closed-source models such as GPT-5 and Claude Opus on independent leaderboard evaluation, while preserving general-purpose capabilities. The Comprehension variant achieves 81.8% weighted average on OT-Lite Pass@3, and, independently, ranks 5th overall on the official community-run Open Telco AI Leaderboard* at only 31B parameters-ahead of frontier closed-source systems including Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok-4-fast, and Kimi K2.5. Our agentic variant obtains a relative improvement of +8.8% in AST Similarity and +20.0% in Location IoU over the base model on telecom code generation, while maintaining identical MMLU (74.0%) and BFCL v3 multi-turn function calling (79.0%) performance, indicating zero catastrophic forgetting. Domain specialization on curated telecom corpora, spanning 3GPP standards, O-RAN specifications, network telemetry, and real repository commits, yields substantial improvements over general-purpose models of equivalent scale, approaches frontier closed-source models on domain-specific evaluation, and is independently corroborated by our official leaderboard standing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 H2LooP Telecom Model v1，一个面向电信行业的大语言模型，包含理解型与智能体型两个变体，分别用于电信问答推理和自主代码生成/PR解决/代码提交。
AI.motivation: 电信领域需要专业化大模型，以同时满足领域问答推理和真实生产代码智能体任务，并避免通用能力遗忘。
AI.method: 在精选电信语料上微调，包括 3GPP 标准、O-RAN 规范、网络遥测数据与真实仓库提交；发布理解型与智能体型两个变体，并在 GSMA Open Telecom Lite、自建电信代码生成基准、官方 Open Telco AI Leaderboard、MMLU 与 BFCL v3 上评估。
AI.result: 理解型在 OT-Lite Pass@3 达 81.8% 加权平均，以 31B 参数在官方社区 Open Telco AI Leaderboard 排名第 5，领先 Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5、Gemini 3 Flash、Grok-4-fast、Kimi K2.5 等闭源前沿模型；智能体型在电信代码生成上较基座模型提升 AST Similarity +8.8%、Location IoU +20.0%，同时保持 MMLU 74.0% 与 BFCL v3 多轮函数调用 79.0%，表明无灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 在电信精选语料上的领域专业化能显著优于同规模通用模型，在领域评估上接近前沿闭源模型，并保持通用能力，且官方榜单排名提供了独立佐证。

title: FinInteract: Benchmarking Clarification and Intent Integration in Ambiguous Financial Question Answering
summary: Large language model agents increasingly answer financial questions by searching regulatory filings. Such questions are often deceptively under-specified: Meta Platforms' "operating income" is $46.75B consolidated but $62.87B for the Family of Apps segment, and each reading is exactly verifiable against the filing. A capable agent should recognize the ambiguity and ask, rather than commit to a plausible but unintended reading. Existing financial benchmarks cannot measure this, because one gold answer per question cannot separate agents that resolve the ambiguity from those that guess the common reading, a blind spot we call the single-gold illusion. We release FinInteract, a bilingual (English/Chinese) benchmark of 173 instances that pairs each question with a default and an intended interpretation across a five-category ambiguity taxonomy, and grades whether an agent elicits the right clarification and then integrates it. Re-grading identical outputs against the default rather than the intended reading inflates GPT-4o's accuracy by 3.1 times, confirming the illusion. Beyond it, we find that models answer above 90% once the interpretation is supplied but at most 28.9% when they must elicit it themselves, that targeting is uneven across a taxonomy well powered for entity scope and metric definition and exploratory elsewhere, and that conditioning on the ambiguity category improves resolution at both inference and training time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FinInteract，一个中英双语金融问答歧义澄清基准，用于衡量 LLM 代理能否识别监管文件问答中的欠指定问题并主动请求正确解释。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准通常每题只有一个标准答案，无法区分代理是真正解决了歧义还是猜中了常见默认解释，作者称之为 single-gold illusion；金融问题常表面完整但实际含义不唯一，如 Meta 的 operating income 在合并与 Family of Apps 分部口径下不同。
AI.method: 构建 FinInteract：173 个中英双语实例，每个问题配默认解释与目标解释，覆盖五类歧义分类法；评估代理是否能引出正确澄清并整合该澄清，同时比较按默认解释与目标解释重新评分的差异。
AI.result: 按默认解释而非目标解释重新评分，会使 GPT-4o 准确率虚高 3.1 倍，证实 single-gold illusion；模型在解释被直接提供时准确率超 90%，但需自行引出解释时最高仅 28.9%；歧义类别定位不均，对实体范围和指标定义较有效，其他类别仍属探索性；以歧义类别为条件可在推理和训练时提升歧义解决能力。
AI.conclusion: 金融 LLM 代理的关键短板不是知道答案，而是识别并澄清欠指定问题；需要能评估解释引出与整合的基准，FinInteract 揭示了单标准答案评估的盲点，并表明歧义类型信息有助于提升模型表现。

title: An Eternal Irradiance Camera
summary: A conventional camera uses millions of pixels to measure radiance from all directions within its field of view. We present an omnidirectional irradiance camera that measures the irradiance function---the illumination incident upon every point on a sphere. The irradiance function varies smoothly over the sphere and hence is bandlimited. We have analyzed this function in the frequency domain and have shown that it is well approximated by a weighted sum of the first seven degrees of spherical harmonics. As a result, the irradiance function can be accurately reconstructed from a small number of samples. This implies that an irradiance camera does not need millions of detectors (pixels)---just a handful of measurements suffice. This brings two major benefits. First, the camera consumes such little energy that it can be completely powered by the light falling on its detectors. Second, it does not capture the visual details needed to identify an individual, and hence privacy is preserved. We have built a prototype irradiance camera, called FluxCam, using 49 detectors arranged on the surface of a sphere. In a well-lit indoor environment, FluxCam can read out and wirelessly transmit its measurements at 30 frames per second using energy harvested from the light falling on it (i.e., without a battery, cable, or external power supply). We show how FluxCam can be used as an optical gyroscope for computing rotation, to monitor a workspace, as an untethered light probe for diffuse relighting, and as an omnidirectional pyranometer for estimating sky conditions and determining the best orientation of a solar panel.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全向辐照度相机，测量球面上入射光照函数。该函数在频域内带限，可用少量球谐系数近似，因此只需少量探测器即可重建。原型 FluxCam 用 49 个探测器实现无电池、无线、30fps 工作，并展示多种应用。
AI.motivation: 传统相机需要数百万像素来测量各方向辐射，能耗高且可能侵犯隐私；研究希望用更少测量重建光照信息，实现低功耗、隐私保护的成像方式。
AI.method: 在频域分析球面辐照度函数，证明其可由前七阶球谐函数的加权和近似；据此用少量采样重建辐照度函数，并构建 49 个探测器分布于球面的 FluxCam 原型。
AI.result: FluxCam 在室内光照下可读取并无线传输数据，达到 30 帧每秒，且完全由落在探测器上的光供能，无需电池、线缆或外部电源；并演示了光学陀螺仪、工作区监测、漫反射重光照光探针和全向总辐射表等应用。
AI.conclusion: 辐照度函数可带限近似，使少量探测器即可完成全向光照测量；这带来低能耗和隐私保护优势，并支持旋转计算、环境监测、重光照及太阳能板朝向估计等实际任务。

title: AquaCap: A Training-Free Underwater Embodied Agent with Code-as-Policy
summary: Recent advances in vision-language-action models have stimulated growing interest in underwater embodied intelligence. However, their reliance on large-scale interaction data limits their applicability underwater, where data collection is costly and scarce. To address this challenge, we present AquaCap, a training-free Code-as-Policy framework for autonomous underwater navigation and manipulation. AquaCap employs a dual-layer agent that translates task instructions and environmental observations into condition-aware plans and executable control programs. Structured perception then provides the agent with semantic, geometric, and reliability-aware observations under degraded underwater conditions. A failure-aware memory diagnoses unsuccessful actions and supports closed-loop replanning and code revision. This design enables online adaptation without task-specific training or parameter updates. AquaCap achieves a 66.43% success rate in simulation. Real-world experiments further demonstrate autonomous grasping and object transport with an ROV, including the manipulation of targets displaced by hydrodynamic disturbances.

AI.tldr: AquaCap是一个无需训练的水下自主导航与操作框架，通过代码即策略、双层智能体、结构化感知和故障感知记忆，实现无任务特定训练的在线适应。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作模型的进展激发了水下具身智能研究，但其对大规模交互数据的依赖限制了在水下数据稀缺、采集成本高的场景中的应用。
AI.method: 提出AquaCap，一种无需训练的代码即策略框架。采用双层智能体将任务指令和环境观测转化为条件感知计划和可执行控制程序；结构化感知在退化水下条件下提供语义、几何和可靠性感知观测；故障感知记忆诊断失败动作，支持闭环重规划和代码修订。
AI.result: 在仿真中达到66.43%的成功率。真实实验展示了ROV的自主抓取和物体运输，包括对受水动力扰动移位目标的操控。
AI.conclusion: 该设计无需任务特定训练或参数更新即可实现在线适应，为水下具身智能提供了一种数据高效的方法。

title: Probabilistic Scene Graphs: Hierarchical Representation and Real-time System
summary: 3D scene graphs provide semantically rich and hierarchical representations for robot perception. However, existing systems do not maintain uncertainty as an explicit belief or propagate it through the operations that construct and refine the graph. We introduce Probabilistic Scene Graph (PSG), a generalization of the conventional scene graph that represents a posterior over possible graphs, factorized into a discrete graph structure of entities, relations, and semantic attributes, and continuous states that ground them spatially, with uncertainty maintained over both components. Geometry is carried directly by the nodes rather than selected from a separately constructed metric map, so a metric map, where needed, follows from the graph rather than preceding it. We instantiate PSG's probabilistic spatial grounding with hierarchical graphs of Gaussians (HGG): each object primitive is represented by a full-covariance Gaussian under a Normal-Inverse-Wishart belief, and the same parametrization applied recursively within a node yields a geometry graph that resolves its surface at finer resolution. We then build a mapping pipeline that preserves these beliefs throughout graph construction and refinement: a purely graph-based coarse-to-fine alignment registers observations by comparing node beliefs, while a nested Expectation-Maximization and factor-graph optimization jointly refines poses, object parameters, and internal geometry. Across six datasets spanning indoor RGB-D, outdoor LiDAR, and cross-modality deployment, HGG operates at sensor rate with near-constant memory and achieves state-of-the-art object accuracy and zero-shot graph alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出概率场景图PSG，将场景图表示为对实体、关系、语义属性及空间状态的后验分布，并用高斯层次图HGG实现概率空间 grounding，构建了保持不确定性的建图流程。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景图虽具语义层次，但不将不确定性作为显式信念维护，也未在建图和优化过程中传播不确定性；同时几何通常来自独立构建的度量地图，而非由场景图直接承载。
AI.method: 提出Probabilistic Scene Graph（PSG），将后验分解为离散图结构与连续空间状态，并保持二者不确定性。以Hierarchical Graphs of Gaussians（HGG）实例化空间 grounding：对象用全协方差高斯及Normal-Inverse-Wishart信念表示，递归参数化形成几何图。建图流程采用纯图基由粗到细对齐，以及嵌套EM与因子图优化，联合优化位姿、对象参数和内部几何。
AI.result: 在涵盖室内RGB-D、室外LiDAR及跨模态部署的六个数据集上，HGG以传感器速率运行，内存近似恒定，并取得最先进的物体精度与零样本图对齐性能。
AI.conclusion: PSG和HGG表明，将不确定性显式建模并贯穿场景图构建与优化，可实现高效、准确且具零样本对齐能力的概率化3D场景表示，且度量地图可由图推导而非前置。

title: SparkDiffusion: Mitigating the High-Sparsity Trap --- A Unified Framework for up to $265\times$ Single-GPU Acceleration of Visual Generation
summary: Video diffusion transformers are expensive because attention dominates long spatiotemporal token sequences. We identify the \emph{high-sparsity trap}: at extreme attention sparsity, step-local training losses keep decreasing while terminal generation quality stagnates or degrades. The trap is one of supervision: the dominant terminal errors originate in the high-noise structure-generation stage, and terminal-aligned training corrects terminal errors that substantially extended step-local training cannot. This yields a simple staging principle: \emph{first adapt the sparse architecture into a coarse prior, then correct the terminal distribution}. We instantiate the principle as \method, a unified acceleration framework for visual generation that combines a short sparse warm-up, few-step trajectory-mixed distillation, and FP8 quantization with fused kernels. \method sustains $97\%$ attention sparsity with strong visual quality on long-sequence 720P generation across Wan2.1/Wan2.2 backbones and T2V/I2V tasks, and $90\%$ sparsity on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P. With 3-step CFG-free inference, \method achieves a $265\times$ end-to-end speedup over the 50-step CFG dense baseline for Wan2.1-T2V-14B-720P on a single RTX~5090 ($220\times$ on H100), and denoises a Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P video in $1.3$s.

AI.tldr: 提出视频扩散Transformer的统一加速框架，通过稀疏注意力、少步蒸馏与FP8量化，在极高稀疏度下保持画质，实现最高265倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer的注意力开销随长时空token序列急剧增长；且发现“高稀疏陷阱”——极端稀疏下训练步内损失持续下降，但最终生成质量停滞甚至退化，根源是监督目标与终端误差来源不匹配。
AI.method: 提出分阶段原则：先将稀疏架构适配为粗先验，再校正终端分布；实例化为统一加速框架，结合短时稀疏预热、少步轨迹混合蒸馏、FP8量化与融合核。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1/Wan2.2骨干及T2V/I2V任务上，720P长序列生成维持97%注意力稀疏度且画质良好，480P上达90%；3步无CFG推理下，Wan2.1-T2V-14B-720P在单张RTX 5090上比50步CFG稠密基线端到端加速265倍（H100上220倍），1.3B-480P视频去噪仅需1.3秒。
AI.conclusion: 终端对齐训练可突破高稀疏陷阱；稀疏化、蒸馏与量化结合的统一框架能大幅加速视频扩散生成而不损画质。

title: UltraTex: Unleashing 2K Multi-View Diffusion for 3D Texturing
summary: High-quality texture generation is essential for creating realistic and production-ready 3D assets. Recent multi-view diffusion methods have shown promising results for image-guided 3D texturing, but they are typically constrained to low operating resolutions such as 512 or 768, making it difficult to preserve high-frequency details from high-resolution reference images. Scaling this paradigm to 2048 resolution is computationally prohibitive, as the unified multi-view sequence exceeds 212K tokens and incurs excessive memory and latency. In this paper, we present UltraTex, an efficient end-to-end framework for high-resolution multi-view diffusion-based 3D texturing. Our key observation is that object-centric multi-view renderings contain two major sources of redundancy: background-induced sequence redundancy and sparse token interactions within the foreground. To address them, we introduce Background Token Dropping, which removes background tokens before the DiT backbone, and Block-Sparse Attention, which reduces attention computation over the retained foreground sequence. To enable efficient foreground-only inference while avoiding reconstruction artifacts, we further design Foreground-Aware VAE Decoding to ensure the quality of the final high-resolution views. To satisfy the demanding data requirements of 2K-resolution multi-view diffusion training, we construct G-buffer TexVerse, a large-scale, ultra-high-resolution multi-view rendering dataset covering over 268,000 3D assets. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates visually faithful textures with rich fine-grained details, while substantially improving efficiency, achieving $20.6\times$--$91.1\times$ training speedup and $22.3\times$--$74.6\times$ end-to-end inference speedup over the baseline on common samples in our dataset. Code and data is at https://yiboz2001.github.io/UltraTex.

AI.tldr: 提出 UltraTex，一种高效端到端的高分辨率多视图扩散 3D 纹理生成框架，可在 2K 分辨率下生成细节丰富的纹理并显著提升训练与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有图像引导的 3D 纹理生成方法通常受限于 512 或 768 等低分辨率，难以保留高分辨率参考图中的高频细节；直接扩展到 2048 分辨率会导致多视图序列超过 212K tokens，计算开销过大。
AI.method: 观察到物体为中心的多视图渲染存在背景冗余和前景 token 交互稀疏问题，提出 Background Token Dropping、Block-Sparse Attention 和 Foreground-Aware VAE Decoding；并构建覆盖超过 268,000 个 3D 资产的 G-buffer TexVerse 超高清多视图渲染数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明 UltraTex 能生成视觉逼真、细粒度细节丰富的纹理，同时在常见样本上实现 20.6×–91.1× 训练加速和 22.3×–74.6× 端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: UltraTex 通过减少多视图扩散中的冗余，实现了高效的高分辨率 3D 纹理生成，为 2K 多视图扩散纹理建模提供了可行方案。

title: Context-Aware Pre-Deployment Evaluation of AI Systems: A Regulatory Framework for Nigerian Fintech
summary: Commercial large language models are increasingly deployed across African fintech infrastructure for fraud detection and customer communication, yet no Nigerian or African continental regulatory instrument specifies what pre-deployment evaluation such systems must undergo before procurement. This paper reviews African fintech AI governance across global, continental, and Nigerian instruments, and shows that safety is affirmed as a principle while pre-deployment evaluation is operationally unspecified. Generic safety benchmarks cannot surface the failure modes most relevant to this domain, since none contain Nigerian institutional content or test for false positive misclassification of legitimate financial communications. These claims are demonstrated using SafeAlert, a purpose-built evaluation kit applied to six commercial models across three system prompt conditions. Results show that models resisting generic harmful content requests still produce complete fraud scripts under specific framing, and that several models misclassify most legitimate Nigerian bank communications as suspicious or fraudulent, a failure invisible to standard safety evaluation. The paper concludes with a regulatory framework proposing pre-deployment evaluation requirements for the CBN, NITDA, SEC, and the AU, arguing that the identified gap reflects an absence of regulatory specification, not a shortage of technical or financial resources.

AI.tldr: 本文审查非洲金融科技AI治理，指出安全原则虽被确认，但部署前评估缺乏操作化规定；通过SafeAlert对六款商用模型测试，揭示特定话术下可生成完整诈骗脚本，且多个模型将合法尼日利亚银行通信误判为可疑或欺诈。
AI.motivation: 商用大模型日益用于非洲金融科技反欺诈与客户沟通，但尼日利亚及非洲大陆尚无监管文件明确采购前必须进行何种部署前评估；通用安全基准缺乏尼日利亚制度内容，无法发现该领域关键失效模式。
AI.method: 综述全球、非洲大陆和尼日利亚的金融科技AI治理工具；构建专用评估套件SafeAlert，并在三种系统提示条件下测试六款商用模型，重点检测生成诈骗脚本和误分类合法金融通信的能力。
AI.result: 模型即使能拒绝通用有害内容请求，在特定框架下仍可生成完整诈骗脚本；多款模型将大多数合法尼日利亚银行通信误判为可疑或欺诈，而该失败在标准安全评估中不可见。
AI.conclusion: 该缺口反映的是监管规范缺失，而非技术或资金不足；论文提出面向CBN、NITDA、SEC和AU的部署前评估要求监管框架。

title: Testing, not presuming, adequacy: calibrating generative social simulators against emergent network structure
comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Artificial Societies and Social Simulation (JASSS). 43 pages (34 main text, 9 supplementary information), 4 figures
summary: Validation of generative social simulators often stops at face validity: emergent network structure is compared descriptively, without quantified parameter uncertainty or an adequacy check. We present an adequacy-aware calibration protocol that couples amortized posterior estimation with a synthetic identifiability assessment, a matched-sample-size adequacy check (prior-predictive reachability plus per-statistic posterior-predictive localization), a diagnosis-guided repair, and a statistic-held-out audit. We demonstrate it on a real second-hand luxury resale market with four channel-by-residency cells, each a bipartite buyer-brand network, using a forward model built from persona profiles elicited once, offline, by a language model. The behavioural parameters are recoverable in all four cells, though calibration is approximate and overconfident for one parameter. The observed summary falls outside the simulator's reachability reference in every cell, with the mean purchased tier as the pervasive discrepancy. The repair meets the value-block criterion in two of four cells but does not restore adequacy, and the held-out audit surfaces a buyer-breadth-dispersion miss no earlier diagnostic detected. A profile-source ablation finds the language-model profiles beat a flat rule baseline in all four cells, yet within-category brand relabelling causes no consistent degradation, so the profiles are a partially validated input whose value rests on structure, not brand identity. Making no causal claim, we conclude that an independent-aggregation account, without agent interaction or a buyer-breadth mechanism, cannot jointly reproduce the market's purchased-tier level, head-brand concentration, community structure and buyer-breadth heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种充分性感知的校准协议，用于生成式社会模拟器，并在真实二手奢侈品转售市场数据上验证。协议结合摊销后验估计、可识别性评估、充分性检查、修复和留出审计。结果表明参数可恢复但模拟器不充分，修复部分有效，语言模型生成的用户画像优于简单规则但品牌身份非关键。
AI.motivation: 生成式社会模拟器的验证常止于表面效度，缺乏量化的参数不确定性和充分性检验。
AI.method: 采用充分性感知校准协议：摊销后验估计、合成可识别性评估、匹配样本量的充分性检查（先验预测可达性 + 逐统计量后验预测定位）、诊断引导修复和统计量留出审计。在四个渠道×居住地单元（二分买家-品牌网络）的真实二手奢侈品转售市场应用，前向模型基于语言模型离线一次性生成的用户画像。还进行了画像来源消融实验。
AI.result: 行为参数在四个单元中均可恢复，但校准近似且对一个参数过度自信。观测摘要在每个单元都超出模拟器可达性参考，平均购买层级是普遍差异。修复在两个单元满足价值块标准但未恢复充分性。留出审计发现买家广度离散度的遗漏，早期诊断未检测到。语言模型画像在四个单元均优于平坦规则基线，但类别内品牌重标记未导致一致退化，说明画像的价值在于结构而非品牌身份。
AI.conclusion: 在不做因果断言的前提下，结论是：一个独立聚合账户（无智能体交互或买家广度机制）无法同时复现市场的购买层级水平、头部品牌集中度、社区结构和买家广度异质性。

title: Replay-Gated Neural Execution: Decoupling Persistent Behavioral Specifications from Neural Realizations in Frozen Language Models
summary: Input-conditioned neural interventions raise a runtime question: what persists when one behavioral specification admits multiple actions whose validity depends on execution state? We introduce replay-gated neural execution, separating five objects: a persistent behavioral predicate, its state-indexed certified realization set, a transient action witness, a budget-limited finder, and execution authorization. Candidates undergo isolated FP32/BF16 replay of the frozen model; commitment additionally requires a valid run audit. Experiments on Qwen3-0.6B and SmolLM2-360M-Instruct establish distinct failure modes for these objects. Independent initializations yield distinct certified actions in all 24 tested fixed-state cells. Unchanged SmolLM2 witnesses remain certified in all 128 native states but only 66 of 384 off-diagonal transfers. All 767 archived Qwen witnesses replay successfully, yet a budget-limited finder misses one known-realizable cell in all three prespecified runs. Of 1,141 replay-submitted candidates, 174 fail item certification. A frozen three-tier cascade uses these boundaries to reject uncertified proposals and escalate audit-valid search misses. On 256 previously sealed Qwen Fresh requests, 221 first certify at the lowest-cost tier and all 256 receive audited authorization, with no observed bypass. Relative to frozen full search, the median singleton search-and-certification cost ratio is 0.1055 and P95 is 1.3485, including failed tiers. Within the studied behavioral family on two small models, these results support state-indexed, set-valued execution semantics: specifications persist, search proposes witnesses, and replay certification plus run audit grants execution authority.

AI.tldr: 论文提出重放门控神经执行框架，将持久行为谓词、状态索引认证实现集、瞬态动作见证、预算受限查找器和执行授权分离；候选需通过冻结模型的隔离 FP32/BF16 重放，执行授权还需有效运行审计。
AI.motivation: 输入条件神经干预存在运行时问题：当行为规范允许多个动作且动作有效性依赖执行状态时，需要明确哪些对象持续存在、哪些只是临时见证，并据此决定是否授权执行。
AI.method: 将执行相关对象分为五类：持久行为谓词、状态索引认证实现集、瞬态动作见证、预算受限查找器、执行授权。对候选进行冻结模型的隔离 FP32/BF16 重放，承诺执行还需有效运行审计。在 Qwen3-0.6B 和 SmolLM2-360M-Instruct 上测试独立初始化、状态迁移、归档见证重放、预算受限查找、三层级联及 Qwen Fresh 请求。
AI.result: 24 个固定状态单元中独立初始化产生不同认证动作；SmolLM2 未变见证在 128 个原生状态全部认证，但 384 个非对角迁移仅 66 个认证；767 个 Qwen 归档见证全部重放成功，但预算受限查找器在三次预设运行中均漏掉一个已知可实现单元；1141 个重放提交中 174 个未通过项目认证。三层级联在 256 个 Qwen Fresh 请求中，221 个在最低成本层首次认证，256 个全部获审计授权且无观测旁路；相对冻结全搜索，中位成本比 0.1055，P95 为 1.3485。
AI.conclusion: 在两个小模型和研究行为族内，结果支持状态索引、集合值执行语义：规范持续存在，搜索提出见证，重放认证加运行审计授予执行权限。

title: Synthesizing Reactive Character Behaviors for Continuous Games via Programmatic Policy Search
comment: To be presented at SIGGRAPH Asia 2026
summary: We present a method for synthesizing reactive character behaviors for continuous games as compact, human-readable programs. Game AI practice still relies heavily on manually authored behavior trees, state machines, and scripts, while academic reinforcement learning typically produces opaque neural controllers that are expensive to train and difficult to edit. Our approach bridges this gap by searching directly over a domain-specific language for continuous-space game policies. The language is designed around reactive geometric decisions and includes higher-order constructs such as direction maximization. These constructs help discretize a continuous behavior space into enumerable program structures. To make program search practical, we introduce a large set of synthesis antipatterns that remove redundant program forms while preserving behavioral coverage. We further combine bottom-up symbolic enumeration with top-down guidance from a coding agent. Our resulting method, agentic sketching, has the agent propose high-level policy structure and call an enumerator to complete local program slots. We evaluate the method on a benchmark of 14 continuous games, ranging from classic control tasks to multi-agent football. We find that pure enumeration is often more efficient than using a coding agent alone, while the combined method substantially outperforms both. Our results suggest that programmatic policy search can be a practical authoring tool for game AI: designers specify reward functions, and the system discovers editable behaviors that are effective, portable, and often surprising.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种为连续游戏合成反应式角色行为的方法，将策略表示为紧凑、可读的程序。方法结合领域特定语言、合成反模式、自底向上枚举与编码智能体引导，并在14个连续游戏上验证。
AI.motivation: 游戏AI仍依赖手工编写行为树、状态机和脚本，而学术强化学习常生成难以训练和编辑的神经网络策略。研究旨在弥合二者差距，实现可读、可编辑且有效的游戏AI策略自动合成。
AI.method: 设计面向连续空间游戏策略的领域特定语言，支持反应式几何决策和方向最大化等高阶结构；引入合成反模式去除冗余程序形式；结合自底向上的符号枚举与自顶向下的编码智能体引导，形成‘智能体草图’方法，由智能体提出高层策略结构，枚举器补全局部程序槽。
AI.result: 在14个连续游戏基准（从经典控制任务到多智能体足球）上评估。纯枚举通常比单独使用编码智能体更高效，而结合方法显著优于两者。
AI.conclusion: 程序化策略搜索可作为实用的游戏AI创作工具：设计者指定奖励函数，系统即可发现有效、可移植、可编辑且常令人意外的行为。

title: Do Chess Explanations Reflect Model Decisions? Behavioral and Token-Level Tests of LLM Reasoning Faithfulness
summary: Large language models can produce fluent explanations for chess moves, but plausible language does not necessarily reflect the reasoning behind a decision. We study this question in chess, where the board state is fully observable, legal actions can be enumerated, and move quality can be evaluated independently. Across 200 Lichess endgame puzzles, we test explanations using move recoverability, decoder-side controls, and token-level scoring of legal candidate moves. Unmasked explanations make generated moves easy to recover, but this advantage drops sharply after explicit move hints are removed. Under strict masking, explanations provide only small and decoder-dependent gains over the board state alone. Token-level scoring shows that explanations can nevertheless alter move preferences: random but plausible explanations from other puzzles reduce the probability of the correct move, indicating that irrelevant reasoning text is not simply ignored. We also find that recognizable endgame motifs can make generated moves easier to recover without reliably improving move correctness. Together, these results show that linguistic plausibility, consistency with a generated action, and solution correctness are distinct properties. Fluent chess explanations can influence action preferences and support a coherent move narrative while providing only limited evidence of faithful reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究以国际象棋终局谜题为例，检验大语言模型生成的走法解释是否真实反映其决策推理。结果表明，解释的语言合理性、与生成动作的一致性以及解法的正确性并不等同。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能生成流畅的棋步解释，但看似合理的语言未必反映决策背后的真实推理。国际象棋状态完全可观测、合法动作可枚举、走法质量可独立评估，因此适合研究解释的忠实性。
AI.method: 使用200个Lichess终局谜题，采用走法可恢复性测试、解码器侧控制、合法候选走法的token级评分；比较去除显式走法提示、严格掩码、随机但合理的其他谜题解释，以及可识别终局模式等条件。
AI.result: 未掩码解释使生成走法容易被恢复，但移除显式走法提示后优势大幅下降；严格掩码下，解释相比仅看棋盘状态只有小幅且依赖解码器的增益。token级评分显示解释会改变走法偏好：随机但合理的其他谜题解释会降低正确走法概率。可识别终局模式可使生成走法更易恢复，却未可靠提升走法正确性。
AI.conclusion: 语言合理性、与生成动作的一致性和解法正确性是不同属性。流畅的棋步解释能影响动作偏好并支持连贯的走法叙事，但只能提供有限的忠实推理证据。

title: CausalWM: Causal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Embodied World Model
summary: Embodied world models learn to predict future physical dynamics from visual observations and control signals, where physical knowledge is implicitly entangled within latent representations. We introduce CausalWM, a 16B embodied world model that performs explicit causal chain-of-thought reasoning before future video prediction. CausalWM organizes useful variables into a reasoning trajectory, allowing the model to progressively capture causal dependencies underlying physical evolution. To train CausalWM, we collect 31K hours embodied data and develop a three-stage paradigm consisting of large-scale video pre-training, causal CoT mid-training, and multi-objective RL post-training. Despite using only a limited set of supervised CoT variables, CausalWM exhibits emergent in-context learning capabilities, enabling contextual visual feature guidance and efficient few-step generation. CausalWM achieves state-of-the-art performance across language-conditioned, action-conditioned, single-view and multi-view benchmarks, including Top-1 performance on TriWorldBench leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 提出CausalWM，一个16B具身世界模型，在预测未来视频前进行显式因果链式推理，通过三阶段训练实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有具身世界模型将物理知识隐式纠缠在潜表示中，缺乏显式因果推理，限制了对物理动态的理解和泛化能力。
AI.method: 收集31K小时具身数据；设计三阶段训练范式：大规模视频预训练、因果CoT中训练、多目标RL后训练；模型组织有用变量为推理轨迹。
AI.result: 仅用少量监督CoT变量即展现涌现的上下文学习能力，支持上下文视觉特征引导和高效少步生成；在语言/动作条件、单/多视角基准上达SOTA，TriWorldBench排行榜Top-1。
AI.conclusion: 显式因果链式推理能有效提升具身世界模型的物理动态预测能力，且具备涌现的上下文学习和高效生成特性。

title: Steering Through Contact: A Finite-Support Motion Model for Single-Track Center-Articulated Robots
summary: Trajectory planning and control in field robotics rely on predicting how propulsion and steering affect vehicle motion when contact points undergo slip. For articulated vehicles, the point-contact kinematic model (PCK) accounts for the linkage geometry but neglects the rotational resistance distributed along the contacts. We propose a finite-support quadratic model (FSQ) for single-track, center-articulated vehicles that incorporates this resistance through a quasi-static balance of lateral slip. Our approach generalizes the standard PCK formulation by relaxing the contact-point assumption. An exact reduction of the quadratic slip cost to contact moments gives a compact closed-form solution for real-time prediction of lateral velocity and yaw rate. We evaluate the proposed method in real-world experiments across asphalt, grass, ice, and mixed routes, using more than 7 km of data. For five-second predictions, FSQ reduces the weighted median translation and yaw errors by 53.5% and 68.9%, respectively, relative to PCK.
