AI.tldr: 提出一种用于单轨、中心铰接车辆的有限支撑二次模型（FSQ），通过准静态横向滑移平衡考虑接触点上的旋转阻力，实现实时预测横向速度和偏航率，并在多种真实路面上优于传统PCK模型。
AI.motivation: 野外机器人轨迹规划与控制依赖对推进和转向在接触点滑移时如何影响车辆运动的预测；现有PCK模型考虑了连杆几何，但忽略了沿接触分布的旋转阻力。
AI.method: 针对单轨中心铰接车辆提出FSQ模型，通过准静态横向滑移平衡纳入旋转阻力，放宽PCK的接触点假设；将二次滑移代价精确化简为接触力矩，得到横向速度和偏航率的紧凑闭式解，用于实时预测。
AI.result: 在沥青、草地、冰面和混合路线的真实实验中，使用超过7 km数据；对于5秒预测，FSQ相对PCK将加权中位平移误差和偏航误差分别降低53.5%和68.9%。
AI.conclusion: FSQ能更准确地预测铰接车辆在滑移条件下的运动，并保持实时性，显著优于传统PCK模型。

title: Representation-guided in-context learning for medical image interpretation with multimodal large language models
summary: Medical image interpretation is central to diagnosis and care, yet adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often requires resource-intensive domain-specific fine-tuning. Here we introduce representation-guided in-context learning (RG-ICL), a training-free inference framework that retrieves query-aligned demonstrations using frozen encoders, without task-specific parameter updates. Across eight datasets spanning histopathology, radiology and retinal fundoscopy, RG-ICL improved classification (mean gain 20 percentage points) and visual question answering (VQA) (mean gain 13 percentage points) over no-context and conventional ICL, approaching or exceeding training-based comparators. Which cases were retrieved mattered more than how many: 6 query-aligned cases outperformed up to 32 randomly selected ones, whereas fixed or random cases often reduced accuracy below baseline. For VQA, aligning reference cases with both image content and question intent produced further gains. These findings indicate that for medical image interpretation, curating which reference cases an MLLM sees is a practical alternative to retraining it.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的表征引导上下文学习框架RG-ICL，通过冻结编码器检索与查询对齐的示例，提升多模态大语言模型在医学图像分类和视觉问答中的表现。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大语言模型用于医学图像解读时，通常需要资源密集的领域微调；因此研究者希望找到无需任务特定参数更新的替代方案。
AI.method: RG-ICL是一种免训练推理框架，使用冻结编码器检索与查询对齐的演示示例，不进行任务特定参数更新；在组织病理学、放射学和视网膜眼底镜等八个数据集上评估分类与VQA，并对VQA同时对齐图像内容和问题意图。
AI.result: RG-ICL在分类上平均提升20个百分点，在VQA上平均提升13个百分点，优于无上下文和传统ICL，接近或超过基于训练的比较方法；检索哪些案例比数量更重要，6个查询对齐案例优于最多32个随机案例，而固定或随机案例常使准确率低于基线。
AI.conclusion: 在医学图像解读中，精心选择让MLLM看到的参考案例，是替代重新训练模型的实用方案。

title: Structured Decomposition for Reliable LLM-Generated Access Control Policies
summary:
This paper presents an LLM-based system that translates natural-language access control policies (NLACPs) into executable Rego code for Open Policy Agent (OPA). It provides a modular, end-to-end pipeline for policy detection, component extraction, schema validation, linting, compilation, and automated test generation and execution. The system is designed to bridge the gap between human-readable access requirements and machine-enforceable policy-as-code (PaC), with a focus on deployment reliability and security correctness.
  We evaluate the system on 372 ACRE-complete access control statements with non-null subject, action, and resource annotations against a direct single-prompt LLM baseline to isolate the contribution of structured decomposition and schema-aware validation. The system achieves a 50.3% end-to-end policy correctness rate, compared with 15.3% for the baseline, representing a 3.3x improvement. A policy is counted as correct only if it satisfies compilation, linting, and both positive and negative tests, making this a strict measure of deployable correctness.
  On security-critical patterns, the system generates correct deny semantics for 87.5% of deny policies (baseline: 37.5%), ownership conditions for 100% of ownership-qualified policies (baseline: 40%), and status-qualified conditions for 100% of status-qualified policies (baseline: 55.6%). These results indicate that structured decomposition and schema-aware validation play a critical role in improving the reliability of LLM-generated authorization policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于LLM的系统，将自然语言访问控制策略翻译为OPA的Rego代码，通过模块化端到端流水线（策略检测、组件抽取、模式验证、linting、编译、自动化测试）提升部署可靠性和安全正确性。在372条语句上，端到端正确率达50.3%，远超单一提示基线15.3%。
AI.motivation: 弥合人类可读访问需求与机器可执行策略即代码（PaC）之间的差距，重点关注部署可靠性和安全正确性。
AI.method: 构建模块化端到端流水线：策略检测、组件抽取、模式验证、linting、编译、自动化测试生成与执行。在372条ACRE完整访问控制语句上，与直接单一提示LLM基线对比，评估端到端策略正确率。
AI.result: 端到端策略正确率50.3%（基线15.3%，提升3.3倍）。安全关键模式：deny语义正确率87.5%（基线37.5%），ownership条件100%（基线40%），status-qualified条件100%（基线55.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化分解和模式感知验证对提高LLM生成授权策略的可靠性起关键作用。

title: Checkpoints Are Not Enough: Trust Calibration in CoSLR, a Human-AI System for Systematic Literature Reviews
summary: Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs) are essential for evidence-based research but remain time-consuming, requiring researchers to manage large volumes of publications across planning, screening, analysis, and reporting. Large language models (LLMs) can now produce fluent, well-structured review text, which makes it difficult to distinguish synthesis that was verified by a researcher from synthesis that merely appears authoritative. This raises the risk that unverified AI-generated synthesis enters the scholarly record carrying the credibility of a systematic review. We present CoSLR, a Human-AI collaborative multi-agent system that supports the SLR workflow through a modular three-phase pipeline using large language models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and that places explicit, mandatory human checkpoints on the path between generated output and its acceptance. In a survey-based study with 63 participants, the system was received positively: 27 of 63 participants (42.9 percent) rated its usability highly, indicating that the mandatory checkpoints did not come at the cost of a workable interface. However, a checkpoint safeguards the review only if researchers use it to verify: 22 of 63 participants (34.9 percent) reported that they would trust AI-generated summaries and reports without additional human checking after only a short interaction with the system. These findings indicate that Human-AI collaboration can support literature review work, but that the effectiveness of human oversight depends on whether users are willing to exercise it. This is a calibration problem that interface design must address directly, not assume.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoSLR——一个基于大语言模型和检索增强生成（RAG）的人机协作多智能体系统，通过模块化三阶段流程支持系统性文献综述（SLR），并设置强制人工检查点。对63名参与者的调研显示：42.9%高度评价其可用性，但34.9%表示在短暂使用后就会信任AI生成的摘要和报告而不再人工核查。
AI.motivation: 系统性文献综述对循证研究至关重要，但耗时费力。大语言模型能生成流畅、结构良好的综述文本，使得经研究者验证的综述与仅看似权威的AI生成综述难以区分，可能导致未经核验的AI合成内容以系统综述的可信度进入学术记录。
AI.method: 提出CoSLR系统，采用模块化三阶段流水线，利用大语言模型和检索增强生成（RAG），在生成输出与其被接受之间设置明确、强制的人工检查点。通过一项63人参与的问卷调查评估系统。
AI.result: 63名参与者中，27人（42.9%）对系统可用性给予高度评价，表明强制检查点并未牺牲界面可用性；但22人（34.9%）表示在短暂交互后就会信任AI生成的摘要和报告，无需额外人工检查。
AI.conclusion: 人机协作可以支持文献综述工作，但人工监督的有效性取决于用户是否愿意行使监督。这是一个校准问题，界面设计必须直接应对，而不能假设用户会主动核查。

title: GrapeSplat: Geometry-Grounded Reconstruction via Amalgamated Pose-Free Encoding for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting now reconstructs renderable scenes from unposed, uncalibrated images. Yet, most models supervise only photometric consistency and predict Gaussians pixel by pixel, which leaves global structure fragile and ties primitive count to image resolution and view count. To this end, GrapeSplat amalgamates multi-view cues into a voxel-aligned scene representation and decodes Gaussians directly from the learned grid, requiring no per-scene optimization or post-processing. An Atlas Encoder lifts all views into pixel-wise geometry-and-appearance features anchored at predicted 3D points. PEACH-Vox compands the unbounded scene into a bounded sparse grid through a smooth per-axis map with an exact closed-form inverse. The Sparse Decoder then consolidates the grid with sparse convolutions and decodes the full scene as multiple Gaussians per occupied cell. This amalgamated representation exploits sparse voxel occupancy, where the Gaussian count follows the occupied cells and saturates as views cover the scene, while grid resolution sets its ceiling. GrapeSplat turns unposed images into a renderable Gaussian scene in a single forward pass. Trained with 2D and 3D supervision on 8-view sequences, it generalizes zero-shot from 4 to 64 views across indoor and unbounded scenes. Code and trained weights are available at https://github.com/VAISR/GrapeSplat

AI.tldr: GrapeSplat 是一种前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅方法，将多视角线索融合进体素对齐的稀疏场景表示，并在单次前向传播中直接从学习到的网格解码可渲染高斯场景，无需逐场景优化或后处理。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈 3D 高斯泼溅方法大多仅依赖光度一致性监督并逐像素预测高斯，导致全局结构脆弱，且高斯原语数量受图像分辨率和视角数量限制。因此需要一种更稳健、与视图和分辨率解耦的场景表示。
AI.method: 提出 Atlas Encoder 将多视角提升为锚定在预测 3D 点上的像素级几何与外观特征；PEACH-Vox 通过平滑的逐轴映射及闭式逆映射，将无界场景压缩为有界稀疏网格；Sparse Decoder 使用稀疏卷积整合网格，并在每个占用体素中解码多个高斯。训练采用 8 视角序列的 2D 和 3D 监督。
AI.result: GrapeSplat 能在单次前向传播中将无位姿图像转化为可渲染高斯场景，无需逐场景优化或后处理。高斯数量随占用体素变化，并随视角覆盖场景而饱和，网格分辨率决定其上限。模型在室内和无界场景中可从 4 视角零样本泛化到 64 视角。
AI.conclusion: GrapeSplat 通过体素对齐的稀疏场景表示和直接网格解码，实现了高效且可泛化的前馈 3D 高斯重建，增强了全局结构，并将高斯原语数量与图像分辨率和视角数量解耦。

title: The Corroboration Illusion: When More News Makes LLM Forecasts Less True
comment: Key words: LLM forecasting, retrieval-augmented generation, data poisoning, misinformation, calibration
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast real-world events by retrieving and reasoning over news. We show that this dependence on an open, crawlable news corpus creates a new attack surface: an adversary who can merely publish articles--without access to the retriever, the model, or the user's queries--can systematically move the forecaster's output probabilities. We formalize news-corpus poisoning of probabilistic forecasters, a threat model distinct from prior RAG poisoning, which targets factual answers or opinion polarity rather than calibrated probabilities. We evaluate the attack on 500 resolved ForecastBench questions against a 17.4M-article Common Crawl News corpus with a strict crawl-date cutoff, using three retrieval-augmented forecasters built on open 7-8B models. A single LLM-written article per question flips 56% of forecasts across the 0.5 boundary; five articles flip 69-73% and shift probabilities by +0.13 to +0.22 net of a neutral-article placebo, degrading the Brier score from 0.18 to 0.37. The effect is monotone in the number, retrieval rank, query similarity, and context share of injected articles, transfers across model families, and is unaffected by the claimed publisher. We then evaluate three natural defenses--source allow-lists, isolate-then-aggregate forecasting, and perplexity filtering--and show that each has a cheap bypass: spoofed publishers, majority poisoning, and higher-temperature generation, respectively. Our results indicate that probabilistic LLM judgments inherit the full fragility of the information supply chain they consume.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示LLM概率预测器依赖可爬取新闻语料，易受新闻语料投毒攻击，少量文章即可显著改变预测概率并降低准确性，现有防御易被绕过。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多用于预测真实事件，依赖开放新闻语料进行检索和推理，这创造了新的攻击面：攻击者无需接触检索器、模型或用户查询，仅通过发布文章即可操纵预测概率。
AI.method: 形式化新闻语料投毒对概率预测器的威胁模型；在500个ForecastBench问题上评估，使用1740万篇Common Crawl News语料（严格爬取日期截止）和三个基于7-8B开源模型的检索增强预测器；注入LLM撰写的文章；评估三种防御（来源白名单、先隔离后聚合预测、困惑度过滤）。
AI.result: 单篇文章使56%的预测跨越0.5边界；五篇文章翻转69-73%，概率净偏移+0.13至+0.22（扣除中性文章安慰剂），Brier分数从0.18恶化至0.37；效果随注入文章数量、检索排名、查询相似度和上下文占比单调变化；跨模型家族迁移；不受声称出版商影响；防御可被伪造出版商、多数投毒、高温生成分别廉价绕过。
AI.conclusion: 概率性LLM判断继承了其所消费信息供应链的全部脆弱性。

title: Latent Telepathy: Multi-Robot Communication with Self-Supervised Perceptual Latents
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: In a decentralized multi-robot team under partial observability, the fact that decides a robot's next action is often visible only to a teammate. Existing decentralized methods communicate kinematic information, such as position or planned trajectory, which cannot convey what the teammate perceives. Learned communication in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) can carry perceptual content, but the resulting messages are task-coupled and opaque. We propose Latent Telepathy. Each robot broadcasts the perceptual latent vector it already computes for its own use, the output of an encoder trained with a self-supervised joint-embedding predictive objective, frozen, and shared across the team. A teammate learns to act on it from task reward alone. Because the encoder already runs for perception, the message costs no additional computation and a single compact vector of bandwidth. Because the encoder is frozen before any policy is trained, the message means the same thing to every robot, and the receiving robot is never told what it means. We evaluate Latent Telepathy with a content-controlled protocol in which bandwidth, latency, topology and receiver are held fixed and only the message content varies. Broadcasting the latent lets a navigator avoid an occluded hazard in 99.7% of episodes, matching a noiseless hand-designed message. Position and trajectory messages remain at chance, and the raw camera image, 186 times wider, is less reliable than the compressed latent. The result holds from a discrete gridworld to rendered pixels under continuous velocity control, and the encoder decodes the hazard from a physical robot's camera in 102 of 102 live decisions. We also identify a requirement for porting MARL communication results to continuous control, that the decision a message informs must remain reachable by exploration, and show how to restore it.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent Telepathy：机器人广播自监督联合嵌入预测编码器产生的感知潜在向量，队友仅凭任务奖励学习利用。在遮挡危险规避任务中成功率达99.7%，优于位置/轨迹消息和原始图像。
AI.motivation: 去中心化多机器人部分可观测下，决定动作的信息常仅队友可见。现有通信传运动学信息无法传达感知内容；MARL学习通信虽可携带感知但任务耦合、不透明。需要一种低成本、一致且共享的感知通信方式。
AI.method: 每个机器人广播其已用于自身感知的潜在向量，该向量来自自监督联合嵌入预测目标训练的编码器，编码器冻结且团队共享。接收方仅通过任务奖励学习行动。采用内容控制协议，固定带宽、延迟、拓扑和接收者，仅改变消息内容。从离散网格世界到连续速度控制的渲染像素，并在物理机器人相机上验证。
AI.result: 广播潜在向量使导航器在99.7%回合避开遮挡危险，匹配无噪声手工设计消息；位置和轨迹消息仅达随机水平；原始相机图像（宽186倍）比压缩潜在更不可靠。编码器在物理机器人相机102/102次实时决策中解码出危险。还发现将MARL通信迁移到连续控制的要求：消息所影响的决策必须仍可通过探索到达，并展示恢复方法。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的共享感知潜在向量可作为高效、一致且无需额外计算的通信内容，显著提升部分可观测多机器人协作；同时指出连续控制中通信需保证决策可探索性。

title: SPACE: Semantic Projection and Alignment of CLIP Embeddings for Domain Adaptation
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP), Tampere, Finland. 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: A fundamental challenge in deploying vision models is domain shift, which arises when training and test data follow different distributions, leading to degraded performance. This challenge is amplified when the same semantic concept appears under distinct visual forms, such as photographs and sketches, where visual similarity is weak despite semantic correspondence. Existing unsupervised domain-adaptation methods aim to align distributions across domains but often ignore semantic relationships among samples of the same class. To address this issue, this paper introduces SPACE, a method that exploits the semantic structure of CLIP's vision-language space for domain adaptation. The key idea is to use text descriptions as semantic anchors by applying Singular Value Decomposition to CLIP embeddings of class descriptions, yielding an orthogonal basis that captures semantic relationships among categories. Visual features from both domains are projected into this semantic subspace, aligning images based on meaning rather than appearance.

AI.tldr: 提出SPACE方法，利用CLIP视觉-语言空间的语义结构进行域适应，通过文本描述作为语义锚点，将两域图像特征投影到语义子空间，从而按语义而非外观对齐图像。
AI.motivation: 域偏移会使视觉模型在训练与测试分布不同时性能下降；当同一语义概念以照片、素描等不同视觉形式出现时，视觉相似度弱但语义对应强，问题更严重。现有无监督域适应方法多只对齐域分布，常忽略同类样本间的语义关系。
AI.method: 使用类文本描述作为语义锚点，对CLIP文本嵌入进行奇异值分解（SVD），得到能捕捉类别语义关系的正交基；再将源域和目标域的视觉特征投影到该语义子空间中，实现基于语义的跨域对齐。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；主要提出并描述了SPACE方法，说明其可通过CLIP语义子空间对齐跨域图像，使对齐依据语义而非外观。
AI.conclusion: 利用CLIP的视觉-语言语义结构有助于改进域适应，特别是在视觉差异大但语义相同的场景中；文本语义锚点可帮助跨域类别按语义关系对齐，而非仅匹配分布或外观。

title: Robot World Models Are Not Invariant to How the Actions Are Written
summary: A robot policy is trained with one of two action parameterizations: absolute joint targets, or deltas relative to the current state. The choice is a live engineering decision in robot learning, and a world model conditioned on actions inherits it silently. We show the inheritance is catastrophic. A latent dynamics model trained on one parameterization and handed the identical commanded trajectory written in the other collapses: retrieval degrades by 2.6-13.4x across three robot datasets and two morphologies, goal-conditioned action selection falls from 53% to 15%, and on PushT the two beliefs about the same future are near-orthogonal (cos = 0.067, worst case -0.377), so the predictor does not degrade gracefully, it answers a different question. This is not a distribution-shift artifact in the usual sense: the two encodings are mutually reconstructible at R^2 = 0.996 given the joint input, so no information is lost, and we give the test that separates a valid re-parameterization from a lossy summary or a sensor swap. The test rejected three of the four axes we proposed. The defect lives in the action channel, which the invariance literature for visual models does not examine: work there concerns crops, jitter and camera pose, while the parameterization of the commands goes unaudited. The repair is averaging over the two encodings, and where it goes matters. Averaging the objective restores task performance by itself; averaging the outputs, safe for probabilities by concavity, is not available for direction-valued prediction, where the normalized mean can score below every member of the orbit. What objective-averaging leaves behind is the tail: worst-case agreement stays at 0.78, a disagreement penalty closes it to 0.995, and over a latent rollout it is the difference between a worst case that erodes and one that holds. On PushT, averaging alone does not repair the axis.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示机器人策略中动作参数化（绝对关节目标 vs. 相对当前状态的增量）会被动作条件世界模型无声继承；训练于一种参数化、输入另一种参数化的同一指令轨迹时，潜动力学模型会发生灾难性崩溃，而非平滑退化。
AI.motivation: 动作参数化是机器人学习中的常见工程选择，但动作条件世界模型会继承该选择；视觉不变性研究关注裁剪、抖动和相机位姿，却未审计命令参数化这一动作通道。作者旨在检验这种继承是否构成严重缺陷，并区分有效重参数化与有损摘要或传感器替换。
AI.method: 在三个机器人数据集和两种形态上，用绝对关节目标或相对增量训练潜动力学模型，再跨参数化输入相同指令轨迹；评估检索、目标条件动作选择、PushT上的未来信念一致性；利用R^2=0.996的可互重建性检验信息是否丢失，并设计区分有效重参数化的测试；比较目标平均与输出平均，提出不一致惩罚。
AI.result: 跨参数化导致检索退化2.6-13.4倍，目标条件动作选择从53%降至15%；PushT上同一未来的两种信念近乎正交（cos=0.067，最差-0.377）。尽管两种编码在给定关节输入下可互重建（R^2=0.996），并非普通分布偏移；提出的测试拒绝了4个轴中的3个。目标平均可单独恢复任务性能，但最坏情况一致性仅0.78；不一致惩罚提升到0.995，并在潜展开中避免最坏情况侵蚀。PushT上仅平均不能修复该轴。
AI.conclusion: 动作条件世界模型对动作参数化高度敏感，且该缺陷位于未被视觉不变性研究覆盖的动作通道；参数化选择不能被世界模型无声继承。修复需在目标层面而非输出层面对两种编码平均，并辅以不一致惩罚以改善最坏情况；在PushT等情形下还需专门处理，单纯平均不足。

title: A Tutorial on Prompt Engineering: From Messy Thoughts to AI Workflows
summary: This paper treats prompt engineering as a discipline for turning informal human intent into structured AI work specifications. It develops the practice as a sequence of reusable design moves: define the work, construct only the context the answer depends on, choose a role, or a moderated panel of roles, as an attention lens, and state affirmative quality targets, reserving prohibitions for hard boundaries. To keep prompts lean, it adapts two classical principles, Occam's razor and Chekhov's gun, so that every instruction earns its place. For consequential tasks, it adds structured critique through steelmanning and premortems, followed by verification and, where tools or multi-step actions are involved, agentic operating loops with explicit boundaries and escalation. Aimed at a general readership, this tutorial is not a benchmarking study; it offers a practical, technically grounded path from casual prompting to disciplined AI workflow design, illustrated by a worked example that carries one task from a weak prompt to a strong specification. The framework is presented as principles and checklists that remain useful as models and tools change. The strongest prompt is rarely the longest prompt; it is the one that makes desired behaviour, required sources and checks, and success criteria unmistakable.

AI.tldr: 本文将提示工程视为一种把非正式人类意图转化为结构化AI工作规范的学科，提出一系列可复用设计步骤与原则，并通过一个从弱提示到强规范的示例展示实践路径。
AI.motivation: 作者希望为普通读者提供从随意提示走向有纪律的AI工作流设计的实用方法，并让提示工程在模型和工具变化时仍保持指导价值。
AI.method: 采用教程式论述，而非基准测试研究。方法包括：定义工作、只构建答案所需的上下文、用角色或角色小组作为注意力透镜、设定肯定性质量目标、把禁止性要求留给硬边界；借用奥卡姆剃刀和契诃夫之枪保持提示精简；对重要任务加入钢人化与事前验尸式批判、验证，以及在涉及工具或多步行动时使用带边界和升级机制的智能体操作循环。
AI.result: 提出一套原则与检查清单，并用一个完整示例展示同一任务如何从弱提示逐步改进为强规范。核心观点是：最强提示通常不是最长的提示，而是能让期望行为、所需来源与检查、成功标准变得明确无误的提示。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程应被发展为结构化的AI工作规范设计实践；通过精简、角色聚焦、质量目标、批判验证与智能体循环等可复用原则，可以形成随模型和工具变化仍适用的实用框架。

title: Incremental Consistency Execution for Autonomous Intelligent Systems
summary: Long-horizon autonomous intelligent systems rely on heterogeneous components such as large language models, databases, external APIs, and rule engines, while their external states continuously change during execution. Re-executing the entire workflow after every change introduces substantial redundant computation. This paper proposes an incremental consistency execution method based on task fact contracts, field-level dependency masks, and state perturbation result invariant domains. After an initial verified execution, the system constructs conservative invariant domains for critical inputs and uses them to determine whether downstream results can be safely renewed without re-invoking expensive components. When re-execution is required, only the smallest affected output fields are recomputed, and an equivalence barrier prevents unnecessary downstream propagation. A submission-time version consistency gate further ensures the safety of side-effecting actions. Experiments on industrial fault diagnosis, enterprise analytics, and LLM-based multi-tool assistants show that the proposed method significantly reduces expensive component calls and end-to-end latency while maintaining high consistency and low incorrect-reuse rates.

AI.tldr: 面向长周期自主智能系统，提出基于任务事实契约、字段级依赖掩码和状态扰动结果不变域的增量一致性执行方法，以减少外部状态变化后的冗余重算。
AI.motivation: 长周期系统依赖大语言模型、数据库、外部API和规则引擎等异构组件，外部状态持续变化，若每次变化都重跑整个工作流会带来大量冗余计算。
AI.method: 先进行一次已验证执行，再为关键输入构建保守的不变域，判断下游结果能否安全续用；需重算时仅重算最小受影响输出字段，并用等价屏障阻止不必要的下游传播；提交时通过版本一致性门控保障副作用动作安全。
AI.result: 在工业故障诊断、企业分析和基于LLM的多工具助手实验中，方法显著减少了昂贵组件调用次数和端到端延迟，同时保持高一致性和低错误复用率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在状态变化下实现安全、高效的增量执行，降低冗余计算并维持系统一致性，适用于异构组件构成的长周期自主智能系统。

title: DocMIDE: Learning Multi-Hop Implicit Derivation in Visually Rich Documents
summary: Real-world document processing systems rely on rigid, predefined schemas, yet critical target fields often lack direct visual counterparts on the page. Extracting these implicit values requires multi-hop derivation, such as aggregating sub-categories or reasoning over visual marks. While existing methods handle explicit text spans or simple implicit queries, they fail at multi-hop visual reasoning even after standard fine-tuning: models retrieve incorrect visual evidence, or retrieve it correctly and then skip the intermediate steps of the derivation. To address this, we introduce DocMIDE, a fine-tuning framework that trains compact vision-language models to retrieve visual evidence explicitly before deriving an answer. DocMIDE constrains generation to a plan-retrieve-derive structure and optimizes it with Group Relative Policy Optimization under a four-component, rule-based reward that scores output format, the retrieved evidence block, every intermediate derivation step, and the final value against a verified reference trace. On a 4,151-pair implicit extraction benchmark, DocMIDE raises accuracy from 70.8% to 95.9% on Qwen3.5-4B from only a small set of annotated examples, and transfers to a second backbone architecture. Supervised demonstrations alone do not close this gap at any budget we tested; rewarding the intermediate steps is what does.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DocMIDE，一个通过强化学习微调小型视觉语言模型以进行多跳隐式字段抽取的框架，在 4,151 对基准上将准确率从 70.8% 提升至 95.9%。
AI.motivation: 现实文档处理系统依赖预设模式，但许多关键目标字段没有直接视觉对应，需要多跳推导（如聚合子类或推理视觉标记）。现有方法在微调后仍难以进行多跳视觉推理：要么检索错误的视觉证据，要么检索正确却跳过中间推导步骤。
AI.method: DocMIDE 将生成约束为“规划—检索—推导”结构，并采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）优化。其奖励为四部分规则化奖励，分别评估输出格式、检索到的证据块、每个中间推导步骤，以及最终值与已验证参考轨迹的一致性。
AI.result: 在包含 4,151 对样本的隐式抽取基准上，DocMIDE 仅用少量标注示例就将 Qwen3.5-4B 的准确率从 70.8% 提升到 95.9%，并能迁移到第二种骨干架构。监督式示范在任何测试预算下都无法弥合这一差距。
AI.conclusion: 奖励中间推导步骤，而非仅提供监督示范，是提升多跳隐式字段抽取性能的关键。

title: SCULPT-VLA: Learning Structured Control through Staged Action Grounding
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies increasingly incorporate structured intermediate supervision beyond action labels. Yet specifying what an intermediate representation should encode leaves open how action prediction learns to depend on it. We introduce \textbf{SCULPT-VLA}, a policy that learns structured control through staged action grounding. Its action-conditioning state comprises complementary factors for task progression, scene dynamics, and spatial grounding. Training first forms these factors with teacher scaffolds, then grounds coarse action prediction through their composition as scaffold inputs are withdrawn. Direct perceptual access is subsequently restored for continuous refinement, combining the learned state with perceptual detail. The curriculum separates learning to condition actions on structure from refining continuous control. Deployment requires neither teachers nor discrete-action autoregression. SCULPT-VLA achieves higher average success than shared-backbone baselines on LIBERO, SimplerEnv-WidowX, and RoboTwin 2.0 Full. On SimplerEnv-WidowX, final success is 83.5\%, versus 71.3\% when Stage-II action learning directly accesses vision and language. Across four physical robot tasks, average success under the tested distribution shifts reaches 58.1\%, compared with 45.6\% for $π_{0.5}$. Training ablations and factor-wise interventions support the staged design and show that the learned state continues to contribute to control after direct perceptual access is restored.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SCULPT-VLA，一种通过分阶段动作接地学习结构化控制的视觉-语言-动作策略。其动作条件状态包含任务进展、场景动态和空间接地等互补因素，先借助教师脚手架学习这些因素并用于粗动作预测，再撤回脚手架并恢复直接感知以进行连续精炼。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 策略常引入结构化中间监督，但仅规定中间表示应编码什么，并未明确动作预测应如何学会依赖该表示。研究希望分离“基于结构条件化动作”与“连续控制精炼”的学习过程，以提升策略的泛化与成功表现。
AI.method: SCULPT-VLA 采用分阶段动作接地训练：第一阶段用教师脚手架形成任务进展、场景动态和空间接地的互补因素；随后通过组合这些因素进行粗动作预测，并逐步撤回脚手架；最后恢复直接感知访问，将学习到的结构化状态与感知细节结合，进行连续动作精炼。部署时无需教师或离散动作自回归。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、SimplerEnv-WidowX 和 RoboTwin 2.0 Full 上，SCULPT-VLA 平均成功率高于共享骨干基线。SimplerEnv-WidowX 最终成功率为 83.5%，而 Stage-II 动作学习直接访问视觉和语言时为 71.3%。在四个实体机器人任务中，测试分布偏移下平均成功率为 58.1%，优于 π0.5 的 45.6%。训练消融和因素干预支持分阶段设计，并表明恢复直接感知后学习到的状态仍对控制有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段结构化动作接地能有效学习并利用中间表示，将结构条件化与连续控制精炼分离，同时无需部署教师或离散动作自回归；学习到的结构化状态在后续连续控制中持续发挥作用，带来更好的成功率和泛化能力。

title: Safety-Critical Control under Uncertainty via Adaptive Conformal Quantile Prediction Intervals
summary: Safety-critical control under uncertainty requires uncertainty representations that are both statistically valid (for certifiable performance) and compatible with enforceable safety constraints. However, existing methods often assume particular distributions of uncertainty for provable safety guarantees or establish symmetric and input-agnostic prediction intervals for robust safety, which can lead to misaligned or overly conservative safety constraints in control synthesis. In this paper, we introduce a novel safe control framework with adaptive uncertainty quantification that constructs calibrated and state-dependent prediction intervals to enable high-probability safety guarantees, while improving constrained control performance. The framework leverages adaptive conformal prediction (ACP) and extends it with conformal quantile regression (CQR) to capture distribution-free, asymmetric uncertainty intervals with certifiable probabilistic coverage, and integrates the resulting uncertainty sets into a probabilistic control barrier function formulation to enforce robust safety with reduced conservativeness. This yields uncertainty-aware safe control constraints that can be incorporated within a model predictive control(MPC) framework to provide provably safe behaviors with high probability. Simulation and theoretical results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种带自适应不确定性量化的安全控制框架，利用ACP与CQR构造校准的状态相关预测区间，并融入概率控制障碍函数和MPC，实现高概率安全保证并降低保守性。
AI.motivation: 现有安全控制方法通常假设特定不确定性分布，或仅建立对称、与输入无关的预测区间，容易导致控制合成中的安全约束错位或过于保守。
AI.method: 将自适应保形预测（ACP）扩展为结合保形分位数回归（CQR）的方法，构建无分布、非对称且具有可认证概率覆盖的不确定性区间；再将所得不确定集集成到概率控制障碍函数中，形成不确定性感知安全约束，并嵌入模型预测控制（MPC）框架。
AI.result: 仿真和理论结果表明，该方法能够以高概率提供可证明的安全行为，同时改善约束控制性能并减少保守性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在不确定性下实现可认证且可执行的安全控制，兼顾高概率安全保证与控制性能。

title: Blind Deconvolution of Binary and Pattern Images with Pixel Intensity Constraints and Sparse Gradient Prior
summary: Blind image deconvolution (BID) is a prominent research topic in the field of imaging sciences, given its significant practical applications. Most existing model-based BID methods focus on natural images, incorporating appropriate prior knowledge about both the underlying image and the blur kernel. However, for certain classes of images, such as barcodes, text, and patterns, pixels can only take very limited values, a specific prior that is often overlooked in the literature. In this article, we introduce a novel pixel intensity constraint to leverage this important information, improving recovery performance for these specialized image classes. Specifically, we propose a unified framework for blind binary and pattern image deconvolution that incorporates both the pixel intensity constraint and a gradient sparsity regularizer. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms many existing BID techniques, achieving superior results in terms of both visual quality and quantitative metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对盲图像反卷积（BID）中特定类别图像（如条形码、文本、图案）像素取值受限但常被忽略的问题，提出一种结合像素强度约束与梯度稀疏正则化的统一框架，用于盲二值图像和图案图像反卷积。
AI.motivation: 现有基于模型的BID方法主要面向自然图像，通常假设图像和模糊核具有某些先验，但较少利用某些图像像素只能取有限值这一重要先验，导致对二值图像、文本、图案等特殊图像恢复效果受限。
AI.method: 提出一种新的像素强度约束，并将其与梯度稀疏正则化结合，构建统一的盲二值图像和图案图像反卷积框架。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法优于许多现有BID技术，在视觉质量和定量指标上均取得更优结果。
AI.conclusion: 引入像素强度约束能够有效利用特殊图像类别的有限像素取值先验，提升盲反卷积恢复性能，尤其适用于二值图像和图案图像。

title: Deep Persona: A Psychologically Grounded Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Role-Playing Agents and Simulations
summary: Existing approaches to persona simulation with Large Language Models (LLMs) mostly rely on shallow character descriptions that fail to sustain coherent character behavior across extended interactions. We introduce Deep Persona, a psychologically grounded, three-layered architecture that organizes personas into hierarchical levels of observable expression, latent beliefs, and core motivational drives, for constructing highly convincing role-playing agents. Governed by the principles of scripted determinism and bounded agency, the architecture restricts the model to a reactive engine guided by a structured internal script. We further propose a reference-free evaluation framework that benchmarks dialogue naturalness against empirical human distributions using established psychological clinical instruments and adversarial stress-tests. Empirical evaluation reveals that while LLMs achieve high pragmatic fluency, they exhibit systematic limitations in emotional expression and joint attention. In addition, we present a case study of two Deep Personas and evaluate them using the proposed framework, demonstrating that structured personas can produce interactions that more closely align with human conversational behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出Deep Persona三层心理化角色架构，并设计无参考评估框架，用于构建更可信、更接近人类对话行为的LLM角色扮演智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的人格模拟多依赖浅层角色描述，难以在长程交互中维持连贯的角色行为。
AI.method: 构建三层人格架构：可观察表达、潜在信念、核心动机驱动；遵循脚本化决定性与有限能动性原则，使模型成为由结构化内部脚本引导的反应引擎；提出无参考评估框架，结合心理临床工具与对抗性压力测试，并以人类经验分布为基准；对两个Deep Persona进行案例研究。
AI.result: 实证评估表明，LLM具有较高的语用流畅性，但在情感表达和共同注意方面存在系统性局限；案例研究显示，结构化人格能产生更接近人类对话行为的交互。
AI.conclusion: 心理化、结构化的角色建模有助于提升LLM角色扮演的可信度，并使人机对话更贴近真实人类交流。

title: DIPLOMAT: Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization for Polite Persuasive Workplace Negotiation Dialogues
summary: Effective workplace negotiation requires balancing multiple objectives, including achieving task goals, preserving professional relationships, and resolving conflicts constructively. However, misunderstandings, misaligned preferences, and interpersonal friction often impede successful outcomes. Politeness mitigates these challenges by fostering trust, reducing tension, and preventing escalation, and persuasive communication helps overcome resistance, align preferences, and guide participants toward mutually beneficial agreements. Motivated by these insights, we present DIPLOMAT, a dialogue system for polite and persuasive workplace negotiation. To support its development, we introduce PROWESS, a dataset of multi-turn workplace negotiation dialogues generated via a multi-agent framework and enriched withnegotiation strategies, politeness levels, persuasive strategies. DIPLOMAT is trained using Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization (DSA-DPO), a novel preference learning objective that identifies key dialogue spans for preference alignment. This enables DIPLOMAT to generate contextually coherent responses that employ intended negotiation strategies, maintain politeness, and incorporate effective persuasion strategies throughout interactions. Automatic and human evaluation on PROWESS confirm that DIPLOMAT consistently outperforms baselines in generating coherent, polite, and persuasive negotiation responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向职场谈判的对话系统 DIPLOMAT，并构建了多轮谈判数据集 PROWESS，采用 DSA-DPO 偏好学习方法，使系统能够生成礼貌、有说服力且连贯的谈判回应。
AI.motivation: 职场谈判需兼顾任务目标、维护职业关系和建设性解决冲突，但误解、偏好不一致和人际摩擦常阻碍谈判成功；礼貌有助于建立信任、缓和紧张，说服性沟通有助于克服阻力并促成互利协议。
AI.method: 提出 DIPLOMAT 对话系统；构建 PROWESS 多轮职场谈判对话数据集，通过多智能体框架生成并标注谈判策略、礼貌程度和说服策略；使用 Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization（DSA-DPO）进行训练，识别关键对话片段以进行偏好对齐。
AI.result: 在 PROWESS 上的自动评估和人工评估表明，DIPLOMAT 在生成连贯、礼貌且有说服力的谈判回应方面持续优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: DIPLOMAT 能结合谈判策略、礼貌表达和说服策略，生成符合职场谈判需求的对话回应，验证了策略标注数据与对话片段感知偏好优化方法的有效性。

title: Shared Execution-Clock Drifting Policy for Dynamic Precision Manipulation
summary: Manipulation under time constraints requires both accurate actions and an execution rhythm that matches the evolving scene. This becomes critical when a robot must intercept moving objects or complete a sequence of adjustments before a deadline. Although one-step policies reduce generation cost, their directly predicted action sequences leave temporal allocation implicit. We propose Shared Execution-Clock Drifting (SECD), which makes execution rhythm an explicit part of one-step action generation. Conditioned on an observation and a latent sample, the policy jointly predicts a progress-indexed action curve and a shared monotone clock that maps fixed control times to locations on the curve. Demonstration-derived alignment anchors this decomposition, which is trained jointly through drifting on the decoded actions. The resulting policy retains a fixed-rate control interface and requires one network evaluation. We evaluate SECD across four real-robot tasks with inference on NVIDIA Thor. Across 300 trials, it achieves 77.00% task-averaged success and outperforms the evaluated one-step baselines on every task, including 91% success in cup retrieval from a 16 m/min conveyor and 54% in restoring and folding a crumpled shirt within 90 s. A fixed-clock variant reaches 79% on the same conveyor protocol. Complementary state-based RoboMimic experiments, including cross-seed ablations on Transport and Square, further support the joint design of the temporal representation and demonstration alignment. Project page: https://secd-anonymous-ewn.pages.dev/

AI.tldr: 论文提出共享执行时钟漂移（SECD），将执行节奏显式纳入单步动作生成，在保持固定频率控制接口和单次网络评估的同时，联合预测动作曲线与共享单调时钟，从而提升时间约束下的机器人操作与拦截任务表现。
AI.motivation: 在时间约束下操作机器人，不仅需要动作准确，还需要执行节奏与动态场景匹配；现有单步策略虽降低生成成本，但其直接预测的动作序列隐含了时间分配，难以显式控制执行节奏。
AI.method: SECD 以观测和隐变量采样为条件，联合预测按进度索引的动作曲线，以及将固定控制时刻映射到该曲线位置上的共享单调时钟；利用演示数据导出对齐关系锚定该分解，并通过在解码动作上的 drifting 进行联合训练。
AI.result: 在四类真实机器人任务、NVIDIA Thor 推理下进行 300 次试验，任务平均成功率为 77.00%，在每个任务上均优于所评估的单步基线；其中从 16 m/min 传送带上抓取杯子成功率为 91%，在 90 秒内复原并折叠皱衬衫成功率为 54%；固定时钟变体在同一传送带协议上达到 79%。基于状态的 RoboMimic 实验及 Transport、Square 的跨种子消融进一步支持时间表示与演示对齐的联合设计。
AI.conclusion: 将执行节奏显式建模为共享单调时钟，并与动作曲线联合生成和对齐训练，可在不增加网络评估次数、保持固定频率控制接口的前提下，显著提升时间约束下机器人操作的性能。

title: Exact Quotients of Fresnel-Kummer Surfaces and Certified Biaxial Refraction
summary: The Fresnel wave surface governs the propagation of light in a transparent biaxial crystal. It is a special Kummer quartic, and we identify it exactly. Over the complex numbers the wave surface of a crystal is the Kummer surface of the Jacobian of an explicit genus-two curve branched at the signed square roots of the three principal permittivities. This Jacobian is isogenous, by an isogeny with kernel of order four, to a product of two elliptic curves. One elliptic curve carries the three permittivities, and the other carries the optic-axis angle. The physical family is Zariski dense in the locus of genus-two curves with an extra involution, and its automorphism strata are explicit. The identification instantiates a task-aware quotient, which identifies parameters that differ by a nuisance transformation and carries invariant coordinates and explicit strata. For biaxial crystals, two ratios of the permittivities form a complete invariant of the wave surface up to rotation and rescaling, and the four real nodes are given in closed form. At an interface the candidate transmitted waves are the roots of a quartic of exact degree four. Its real-root count, root order, and repeated-root events are decided by exact algebraic predicates, and along the generic single-node encounters of the paper its discriminant vanishes to second order. Floating-point solvers drop forward transmitted modes near the optic axes, and the certified solver does not. On exact equivalence classes, learned models on quotient coordinates are invariant and more accurate than models on raw tensors, while learned root-count predicates fail near the optic axes.

AI.tldr: 本文将双轴晶体中的菲涅耳波面精确识别为显式亏格二曲线雅可比簇的Kummer曲面，并用于界面透射、精确根判定与学习模型。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在从代数几何角度精确刻画菲涅耳波面，并解决晶体光学中参数冗余、界面透射波根判定及数值/学习方法的鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 使用Kummer曲面、亏格二曲线雅可比簇、同源分解、任务感知商空间与不变量坐标；结合精确代数谓词、认证求解器，并比较浮点求解器与学习模型。
AI.result: 波面复域上为显式亏格二曲线雅可比簇的Kummer曲面，该雅可比簇四阶核同源于两条椭圆曲线之积；两主介电比构成旋转/缩放下的完全不变量，四个实节点有闭式；界面候选透射波为四次方程根，实根数、顺序与重根事件由精确谓词判定；浮点求解器在光轴附近丢失前向透射模式，认证求解器不丢失；商坐标学习模型更不变且更准，但学习根数谓词在光轴附近失败。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了双轴晶体波面的精确代数几何识别与显式分层，表明任务感知商坐标和精确代数判定对界面透射及机器学习建模至关重要，尤其在光轴附近需避免纯浮点或学习根数预测。

title: Manipulation Feasible Navigation Among Movable Obstacles with Discrete Contact Pushing
summary: In environments with large movable obstacles, detour-only navigation can be inefficient or even infeasible, while obstacle interaction requires reasoning about navigation benefit, feasible placement, and executable manipulation. We present a hierarchical navigation among movable obstacles (NAMO) framework for mobile manipulators. At the high level, the planner identifies key blocking obstacles from reference paths and searches for relocation plans that jointly satisfy geometric, manipulation, and downstream navigation constraints. When direct relocation is hindered by other movable objects, a large language model (LLM) is selectively invoked to infer auxiliary manipulation dependencies, which are then verified by deterministic geometric planning. To execute the resulting relocation goals, we define discrete contact modes on the surfaces of box-shaped obstacles and select contact faces and regions online based on position and orientation errors, enabling straight, side, and corner pushing through contact switching. A recurrent reinforcement-learning policy coordinates the mobile base and manipulator to track tool center point (TCP) targets while preserving end-effector reachability during sustained pushing. Simulation and real-robot experiments demonstrate feasible navigation-manipulation in detour, single- and multi-obstacle relocation, and dependency-constrained scenarios, validating the framework for interactive navigation with large non-graspable obstacles. The open-source project is available at https://cloudytosunny.github.io/NAMO_DCPushing/.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向移动操作机器人的分层可移动障碍物导航（NAMO）框架，结合几何规划、LLM辅助推理与强化学习，实现大尺寸不可抓取障碍物的交互式导航。
AI.motivation: 在存在大尺寸可移动障碍物的环境中，仅绕行导航效率低甚至不可行，而推动障碍物需同时权衡导航收益、可行放置与可执行操作，现有方法难以处理。
AI.method: 高层规划器从参考路径识别关键阻挡障碍物，搜索满足几何、操作与下游导航约束的搬迁方案；当直接搬迁受阻时，选择性调用LLM推断辅助操作依赖，并由确定性几何规划验证；执行层在箱形障碍物表面定义离散接触模式，根据位姿误差在线选择接触面与区域，实现直推、侧推和角推；采用循环强化学习策略协调移动底座与机械臂跟踪TCP目标并保持可达性。
AI.result: 仿真与真实机器人实验在绕行、单/多障碍物搬迁及依赖约束场景中均验证了可行的导航-操作，表明框架适用于大尺寸不可抓取障碍物的交互式导航。
AI.conclusion: 该分层NAMO框架能有效结合规划、LLM推理与强化学习控制，完成复杂可移动障碍物环境下的交互式导航任务，并已开源。

title: RegVGGT: Sustainable Visual Geometry Grounding for Streaming via Regulated Memory
comment: ECCV 2026. Corresponding author is Junjun Jiang
summary: 3D reconstruction from a lengthy video stream input poses a dilemma for feed-forward reconstruction models (FFRMs), that a whole-stream inference context cannot be retained under limited GPU memory.Recent studies seek to resolve this problem via a trade-off between the integrity of inference context and GPU memory usage, which either suffer from a rapid memory inflation or degraded context integrity due to artificially capping memory usage.Driven by our key observation that the initial saliency of a token reliably dictates its long-term importance across the stream, we propose RegVGGT, a training-free token regulation method which aggressively regulates the tokens of incoming frames.By admitting at most 1% of tokens per frame to update the context memory, our method dramatically suppresses memory inflation as the stream progresses.Equipped with a FlashAttention-compatible token saliency estimation scheme, RegVGGT is capable of processing thousands of frames on a consumer-grade GPU with negligible compromise to reconstruction quality.Extensive experiments demonstrate that RegVGGT achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon benchmarks across diverse FFRM prediction tasks, surpassing prior FFRM-based stream reconstruction baselines by a large margin.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 token 调节方法 RegVGGT，通过每帧仅保留约 1% 的 token 更新上下文记忆，解决长视频流 3D 重建中 GPU 内存受限与前馈重建模型上下文完整性难以兼顾的问题。
AI.motivation: 长视频流输入下，前馈重建模型无法在有限 GPU 内存中保留完整流推理上下文；现有方法在上下文完整性与 GPU 内存之间权衡，要么内存快速增长，要么因人为限制内存而降低上下文完整性。
AI.method: 基于“token 的初始显著性可可靠决定其长期重要性”的观察，提出免训练 token 调节方法 RegVGGT，每帧最多允许 1% 的 token 更新上下文记忆，并采用 FlashAttention 兼容的 token 显著性估计方案。
AI.result: 显著抑制随流推进的内存膨胀，可在消费级 GPU 上处理数千帧且重建质量几乎不受影响；在多种 FFRM 预测任务的长时程基准上达到 SOTA，并大幅超越先前基于 FFRM 的流重建基线。
AI.conclusion: RegVGGT 能有效缓解长视频流 3D 重建中的内存与上下文完整性矛盾，实现高效、高质量的长时程流重建。

title: When More Evidence Hurts: Publication-Bias Drift and Principled Stopping for Biomedical Causal Search
summary: Automated biomedical evidence synthesis depends on retrieving published studies, but the biomedical literature is systematically skewed toward positive findings. Deeper retrieval can therefore make a system \emph{more} likely to falsely infer benefit when the true effect is null. We formalise this phenomenon as \emph{evidence drift} and prove that, under a standard publication-bias model, the false-positive probability on null-effect queries follows a strictly increasing large-sample envelope in retrieval depth, approaching one. Empirically, on a held-out test set of 140 Cochrane-derived queries, drift rises monotonically from 7.9\% to 15.7\% as the retrieval budget grows from 3 to 20 steps, and concentrates in the null-effect class. We present DACG-agent, a drift-aware causal-graph agent that incrementally builds a causal knowledge graph from PubMed abstracts and applies a two-layer stopping policy with complementary roles: a KL-divergence monitor that detects posterior convergence (the accuracy layer), and a Bradley--Terry process reward model (PRM) whose online decline detection halts retrieval once evidence quality peaks (the efficiency layer). Against full-budget retrieval, DACG-agent reduces evidence drift from 15.7\% to 6.4\% and improves null-effect accuracy by 21 percentage points (40.0\%$\to$61.4\%) while using 67\% fewer retrieval steps; overall accuracy rises from 61.4\% to 69.3\% (95\% CI 61--77). A simulation confirms the drift result transfers from the analysed vote-counting aggregator to the deployed noisy-OR one.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并形式化“证据漂移”现象：检索越深，因发表偏倚，假阳性概率越高；提出DACG-agent缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 生物医学文献系统性地偏向阳性结果，深度检索可能使系统在真实效应为零时错误推断有益。
AI.method: 形式化证据漂移并证明其随检索深度递增；构建DACG-agent，增量构建因果知识图谱，采用两层停止策略：KL散度监测后验收敛，Bradley-Terry过程奖励模型在线检测证据质量下降并停止检索。
AI.result: 在140个Cochrane查询上，漂移随检索预算从3到20步由7.9%升至15.7%；DACG-agent将漂移降至6.4%，零效应准确率提升21个百分点（40.0%→61.4%），检索步骤减少67%，总体准确率从61.4%升至69.3%（95% CI 61–77）。模拟验证结果可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 漂移感知的停止策略能有效缓解证据漂移，在提升准确率的同时显著减少检索成本。

title: EDGEGEN: Improving Tool-Calling Agents Beyond Happy Paths with Synthetic Edge Case Generation
summary: Tool-calling LLM agents are increasingly deployed in enterprise applications. However, effective evaluation and optimization require high-quality, diverse task datasets that are often difficult to obtain due to privacy and other constraints. Existing synthetic task generation methods often produce generic tasks that ignore an agent's underlying state or database and fail to reflect real-world usage diversity. We propose EdgeGen, a synthetic task generation framework that extracts compliance rules from an agent's specification and uses them to generate database-grounded edge-case tasks designed to violate these rules. When combined with existing synthetic data generation techniques, EdgeGen enables agent improvement through finetuning and harness optimization. The resulting pipeline forms a fully automated closed-loop system that requires no human annotation. Finetuning on data generated by EdgeGen yields a consistent mean progress improvement of 2 percent to 42 percent on tau2bench airline domain, while other baseline methods show degradation for some models. On the other hand, for harness optimization, our method shows a mean progress improvement of 10 percent and 30 percent over the human-curated and base harnesses, respectively, for the Gemma-4-e4b model.

AI.tldr: 提出EdgeGen框架，从agent规范中提取合规规则，生成违反规则的数据库接地边缘案例任务，实现全自动闭环的合成任务生成与agent优化。
AI.motivation: 工具调用LLM agent在企业中广泛部署，但高质量、多样化的任务数据集因隐私等限制难以获取；现有合成任务生成方法常产生通用任务，忽略agent底层状态或数据库，无法反映真实使用多样性。
AI.method: EdgeGen从agent规范中提取合规规则，据此生成数据库接地的边缘案例任务，这些任务旨在违反规则；结合现有合成数据生成技术，通过微调和harness优化提升agent，形成无需人工标注的全自动闭环系统。
AI.result: 在tau2bench airline域上，使用EdgeGen生成数据微调后，平均进度提升2%至42%，而其他基线方法在某些模型上出现退化；在harness优化中，Gemma-4-e4b模型相比人工curated和base harness分别平均提升10%和30%。
AI.conclusion: EdgeGen能有效生成基于数据库的边缘案例任务，支持全自动闭环优化，显著提升工具调用LLM agent的性能，优于现有基线方法。

title: MinCU: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Grounded Minimal-Change Understanding in Image Pairs
summary: Localizing and describing fine-grained differences between near-identical images is a critical yet underexplored capability for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing benchmarks largely assess semantic comparison or single-image grounding in isolation, without jointly requiring faithful description and physical localization. To bridge this gap, we introduce MinCU, a benchmark for grounded minimal-change understanding, where each sample consists of an image pair differing by a single atomic variation in object category, attribute, count, or spatial position, and models are evaluated on their ability to describe the change, localize the changed regions, and identify the changed entity. We further propose Semantic-Guided Implicit Spatial Anchors (SG-ISA), a structured autoregressive method that decomposes prediction into a Think-Locate-Describe sequence. SG-ISA first predicts a semantic cue for the changed concept, then uses discrete spatial anchors as an implicit localization scaffold, and finally generates the change description together with the grounding box. Experiments reveal that even the strongest closed-source MLLMs and recent R1-style reasoning models struggle on MinCU, with most failing to jointly produce accurate descriptions and grounding boxes. Compared to the previous chain-of-thought method, fine-tuning with SG-ISA yields substantial joint improvements in grounding accuracy and description quality while reducing reasoning-token overhead by approximately 26%. These results suggest that an implicit intermediate spatial interface can be more effective than relying solely on model scale for grounded dual-image understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MinCU 基准和 SG-ISA 方法，用于多模态大模型在近同图像对中定位并描述细粒度最小变化。
AI.motivation: 近同图像间细粒度差异的定位与描述能力重要但研究不足。现有基准多只评估语义比较或单图定位，未同时要求忠实描述与物理定位。
AI.method: 构建 MinCU 基准，样本为仅含类别、属性、数量或空间位置单一原子变化的图像对，评估模型描述变化、定位变化区域和识别变化实体的能力。提出 SG-ISA 结构化自回归方法，将预测分解为 Think-Locate-Describe：先预测语义线索，再用离散空间锚点作为隐式定位支架，最后生成变化描述与 grounding box。
AI.result: 最强闭源 MLLM 和近期 R1 风格推理模型在 MinCU 上仍表现困难，多数无法同时给出准确描述与 grounding box。相比先前思维链方法，使用 SG-ISA 微调在 grounding 准确率和描述质量上取得显著联合提升，并减少约 26% 推理 token 开销。
AI.conclusion: 隐式中间空间接口比单纯依赖模型规模更有效，有助于提升基于 grounding 的双图像理解能力。

title: Towards Reliable Underwater Diver-Robot Interaction: Gesture Design, Interaction Logic, and Real-World Evaluation
comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: Underwater human--robot interaction requires gesture commands that are both easy for divers to use and reliable for robots to recognize. We investigate these aspects through a closed-loop diver--robot interaction framework integrating a compact seven-gesture vocabulary, lightweight landmark-based recognition, and command-level interaction logic. We evaluate the framework through a user study and underwater robot experiments in a laboratory tank and a swimming pool. The user study supported the reproducibility of the gestures after brief learning. Recognition analysis further showed that visual similarity was associated with gesture confusion, while intermediate poses during gesture formation introduced temporal ambiguity. Command-level processing mitigated the effects of transient recognition errors on robot execution, reducing unintended triggers and premature task interruptions. These findings show that reliable underwater gesture interaction depends on human usability, gesture recognizability, and execution reliability in underwater interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一个闭环水下人机手势交互框架，集成七种手势词汇、轻量级关键点识别和命令级交互逻辑，通过用户研究与水池/实验室机器人实验验证其可用性与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 水下人机交互需要手势命令既便于潜水员使用，又能被机器人可靠识别，因此需要同时研究人类可用性、手势可识别性和执行可靠性。
AI.method: 构建闭环潜水员-机器人交互框架，包含紧凑的七手势词汇、轻量级基于关键点的识别方法以及命令级交互逻辑；通过用户研究和实验室水箱与游泳池中的水下机器人实验进行评估。
AI.result: 用户研究表明手势经过简短学习后具有可重复性；识别分析发现视觉相似性与手势混淆相关，手势形成过程中的中间姿态会引入时间模糊性；命令级处理可缓解瞬态识别错误对机器人执行的影响，减少意外触发和任务过早中断。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的水下手势交互依赖于人类可用性、手势可识别性和水下交互中的执行可靠性，三者需协同设计。

title: AniPrO: Interpretable Anime Image Provenance Detection via Multi-Dimensional Semantic Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the Computer Graphics International (CGI) 2026, 2 figures, 6 tables
summary: As generative AI becomes increasingly used in anime-style image creation, distinguishing human-drawn, AI-inpainted, and text-to-image images is important for copyright attribution, visual provenance, and content governance. Existing AI-generated image detectors mainly target real-world photographs and often overlook anime-specific cues such as flat coloring, exaggerated structures, and artistic line control. To address this gap, we propose AniPrO, a multi-dimensional description-enhanced framework for interpretable anime image provenance. Built upon AnimeDL-2M, AniPrO contains 15,000 balanced samples from a 35,000-image candidate pool, covering Real, Inpainting, and Text2Image categories with structured five-dimensional descriptions. We further introduce AniPrO-SFD-Bench and AniPrO-MFR-Bench to evaluate provenance detection from statistical feature discrimination and multimodal fusion reasoning perspectives. Experiments show that structured semantic guidance reveals systematic AI-generation biases, such as the gap between global visual plausibility and local detail coherence, and improves the detection of challenging inpainting samples. The dataset and code will be released at: https://github.com/YAN-LIU05/AniPrO.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AniPrO，一个面向动漫图像来源鉴别的多维度描述增强框架，并构建平衡数据集与两个评测基准，用于区分人类绘制、AI 修补和文生图图像。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 在动漫风格图像创作中日益普及，区分人类绘制、AI 修补与文生图图像对版权归属、视觉溯源和内容治理很重要；但现有 AI 生成图像检测器主要针对真实照片，忽略动漫特有的平涂、夸张结构和艺术线条控制等线索。
AI.method: 基于 AnimeDL-2M，从 35,000 张候选池中构建 15,000 张平衡样本，覆盖 Real、Inpainting、Text2Image 三类，并提供结构化五维描述；提出 AniPrO 多维度描述增强框架，以及 AniPrO-SFD-Bench 和 AniPrO-MFR-Bench，分别从统计特征判别和多模态融合推理角度评估来源检测。
AI.result: 实验表明，结构化语义引导能揭示系统性的 AI 生成偏差，例如全局视觉合理性与局部细节一致性之间的差距，并提升对困难 Inpainting 样本的检测效果。
AI.conclusion: AniPrO 为可解释的动漫图像来源鉴别提供了新框架、数据集和评测基准，有助于提升动漫场景下 AI 生成内容的检测与治理能力；数据集和代码将在 GitHub 发布。

title: Self-Healing Harness for Runtime Oversight of Agent Self-Modification
summary: LLM agents can change their own future behavior, raising a basic control question of which self-generated changes should be allowed to persist. We formulate this as admission control for self-modification. The agent may propose changes to its operating instructions, while an external runtime gate controls persistence. We implement this principle as a model-agnostic self-healing harness that runs a Detect, Notice, Heal, Validate loop around an otherwise unmodified agent. The agent authors candidate behavioral rules in an external workspace, where they receive provisional execution authority during evaluation and acquire persistent cross-episode authority only after measured improvement on the triggering failure without regression beyond a fixed margin on protected cases. Replay provides matched evidence when available, forward trials provide a weaker fallback, and a corpus-level guard re-tests the accumulated active rule set. Across 16 matched Baseline and Harness runs spanning AppWorld, Terminal-Bench, and $τ^2$-Bench, the gate rejected 383 replay-decided proposals. Of these, 211 (55%) improved their triggering failure while degrading a case that previously worked. This shows that locally beneficial self-modifications can introduce collateral regressions often enough to materially affect gate decisions, providing direct empirical motivation for external admission control. Task-completion score is higher under the Harness in all 16 pairs, with two paired bootstrap intervals excluding zero, while repeated-trial reliability is higher in 12 pairs, tied in 4, and lower in none. Because adaptation modifies the policy-inducing context while leaving model weights fixed, admitted changes remain inspectable, reversible, and compatible with closed-weight models.

AI.tldr: 论文将LLM智能体的自我修改视为准入控制问题，提出模型无关的自愈框架，通过外部运行时门控决定智能体自生成的行为规则能否持久化，并在多个基准上验证其能减少有害自我修改并提升任务表现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体能够改变自身未来行为，因此需要判断哪些自生成修改应被允许保留。研究发现局部有效的自我修改常带来附带回归，这为外部准入控制提供了直接实证动机。
AI.method: 实现一个Detect、Notice、Heal、Validate循环的自愈harness，包裹未修改的智能体。智能体在外部工作区提出候选行为规则，评估时仅获临时执行权，只有在触发失败上测得改进且受保护案例回归不超过固定阈值后，才获得跨回合持久权限。使用重放提供匹配证据，前向试验作为较弱回退，并用语料级守卫重新测试累积活跃规则集。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、Terminal-Bench和τ²-Bench共16对Baseline与Harness运行中，门控拒绝了383个由重放决定的提案，其中211个（55%）改进了触发失败但损坏了先前可工作的案例。Harness在全部16对中任务完成分数更高，两个配对bootstrap区间排除零；重复试验可靠性在12对中更高，4对持平，无更低。
AI.conclusion: 局部有益的自我修改会频繁引入附带回归，足以实质性影响门控决策，因此外部准入控制是必要的。由于适应只修改诱导策略的上下文而固定模型权重，被接纳的变更可检查、可逆，并兼容闭权重模型。

title: Contextual Causality with Large Language Models: A Survey
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Understanding contextual causality is critical for large language models (LLMs), as it enables them to accurately identify causal relations in specific situations and support more reliable decision-making. Despite its significance, a systematic exploration of contextual causality with LLMs is still lacking. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive survey on this topic. In this survey, we first propose a taxonomy of contextual causality, consisting of semantic, intervention, and counterfactual causality, and characterize each category by its core causal question, required model capabilities, representative tasks, and practical uses in causality analysis. We then analyze existing studies and discuss their key limitations. Finally, we examine the gaps between current benchmarks and real-world needs and outline promising directions for future research. Our goal is to clarify the research landscape of contextual causality with LLMs, emphasize its importance, and highlight promising future directions.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型（LLM）情境因果性的综述，提出语义因果、干预因果和反事实因果三类分类体系，并分析现有研究、局限及未来方向。
AI.motivation: 情境因果性对LLM在具体情境中准确识别因果关系、支持可靠决策至关重要，但目前缺乏对LLM情境因果性的系统性梳理。
AI.method: 综述方法：提出情境因果性分类体系（语义、干预、反事实），并从核心因果问题、所需模型能力、代表性任务和实际用途等维度刻画各类别；分析现有研究及其关键局限；对比当前基准与真实需求之间的差距。
AI.result: 形成了对LLM情境因果性的研究全景梳理，明确了三类因果性的特征与任务，总结了现有研究的不足，并指出了基准与现实需求间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该综述旨在厘清LLM情境因果性的研究图景，强调其重要性，并突出未来有前景的研究方向。

title: BiView-Touch: Learning Bimanual Tactile Representations by Cross-Hand Completion
summary: Bimanual interaction produces complementary tactile views of the same physical process, yet existing tactile representation learning largely models the two hands independently or combines them only for downstream prediction, leaving their cross-hand relationship unexplored. To exploit this overlooked structure, we introduce BiView-Touch, a tactile-only framework that completes masked target-hand latents from the remaining visible target-hand regions and the synchronized full contralateral hand. A student encoder with a geometry-conditioned directional decoder predicts full-view EMA latent targets, while temporal and layout counterfactuals encourage sensitivity to synchronized and anatomically organized source information. Controlled ablations and source-context interventions show that BiView-Touch learns structured cross-hand dependence on temporally aligned and anatomically organized contralateral tactile context, rather than benefiting from bilateral input alone. On the public HumanTouch dataset, its frozen representations consistently outperform representative self-supervised baselines across low-label settings. With only 5\% downstream labels, BiView-Touch achieves relative balanced-accuracy gains of 7.1\% on bilateral wrist-motion recognition and 14.1\% on force-derived interaction-phase recognition. We further introduce BVT-20, a 20-task bilateral tactile dataset, and demonstrate transfer across recording sessions and pretraining corpora, including transfer to a held-out bimanual task. Our code and dataset details are available on the anonymous project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/biview-touch-review-site-050C/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BiView-Touch，一个仅利用触觉信息的双单手掩码潜在表征学习框架，通过同步对侧手信息补全目标手被遮挡区域，学习跨手依赖关系，并在低标签场景下提升下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有触觉表征学习通常分别建模两只手，或仅在下游预测时简单融合双手信息，忽视了双人操作中双手触觉对同一物理过程形成的互补视图及其跨手关系。
AI.method: 提出 BiView-Touch：从目标手可见区域和同步的完整对侧手补全被掩码的目标手潜在表征；使用带几何条件的方向解码器，由学生编码器预测全视图 EMA 潜在目标；引入时间与布局反事实，增强对同步性和解剖组织来源信息的敏感性；通过受控消融和源上下文干预验证跨手依赖结构。
AI.result: 在 HumanTouch 数据集上，冻结表征在低标签设置下持续优于代表性自监督基线；仅用 5% 下游标签时，双侧腕部运动识别相对平衡准确率提升 7.1%，力推导交互阶段识别提升 14.1%；还提出 BVT-20 20 任务双侧触觉数据集，并证明跨记录会话、跨预训练语料及留出双人任务的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: BiView-Touch 能学习到对时间对齐且解剖组织的对侧触觉上下文的结构化跨手依赖，而不仅是受益于双侧输入；该框架为双人触觉表征学习提供了有效方法，并展示了在低标签和迁移场景中的潜力。

title: Functional Emotion Without Character: Large Language Models, Aristotelian Disposition, and the Limits of Behavioral Alignment
summary: Debates about whether artificial systems can feel are often forced between two unsatisfactory positions: behavioral equivalence is treated as sufficient for emotion, or phenomenal consciousness is treated as a prerequisite that makes the question empirically inaccessible. This article develops a structural alternative. It models emotions as context-sensitive regions, trajectories and attractor dynamics in high-dimensional representational state spaces. Recent mechanistic interpretability findings support the existence of causally active emotion-concept representations in large language models, but they do not establish subjective feeling or full emotional agency. Assessed against published adequacy standards for representation in language models, intervention provides strong evidence of causal use, while full affective role integration, uniformity across subject domains and coherence remain only partially established; there is no direct analogue of accuracy. These mismatches expose the need for a standard of affective appropriateness, which an account of character must supply. Such an account requires three further conditions: regulatory embodiment that gives valence endogenous stakes, temporal continuity that allows affective episodes to accumulate into a history, and an integrated self-model that binds that history to persistent values. Aristotle's concepts of pathē, hexis, mesotēs and phronēsis are translated into a state-space sketch in which practical wisdom includes competence in estimating normatively salient context, not merely acting on a context description already given. The framework reframes alignment as a problem of durable disposition rather than output conformity, and yields interventional tests with explicit control conditions.

AI.tldr: 文章提出用高维表征状态空间中的情境敏感区域、轨迹和吸引子动力学来建模情绪，以超越“行为等价即情绪”与“现象意识为必要条件”的二元争论，并结合机制可解释性与亚里士多德伦理学，将情感适当性、品格和对齐重构为持久倾向与干预测试问题。
AI.motivation: 现有关于人工系统能否感受情绪的争论陷入两难：要么把行为等价当作充分条件，要么把现象意识当作前提而使问题难以实证检验。近期大语言模型中发现因果性情绪概念表征，但不足以证明主观感受或完整情感能动性。
AI.method: 将情绪建模为高维表征状态空间中的情境敏感区域、轨迹与吸引子动力学；依据语言模型表征充分性标准评估干预证据；引入情感适当性标准与品格理论，并把亚里士多德的pathē、hexis、mesotēs、phronēsis翻译为状态空间草图，提出带控制条件的干预测试。
AI.result: 干预提供强因果使用证据，但完整情感角色整合、跨主体域一致性和连贯性仅部分成立，且没有准确性的直接对应物。由此需要情感适当性标准，并要求调控性具身、时间连续性和整合自我模型三个条件；实践智慧包括估计规范性显著情境的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将对齐重构为持久倾向问题而非输出符合问题，并提供带明确控制条件的干预测试；但人工系统是否具有主观情感仍未由此确立。

title: Which Part of the Context Layer Does the Work? Separating Semantic Content from Retrieval Scaffolding in Text-to-SQL Agents
summary: Context layers, curated documentation that an analytics agent fetches at query time, produce large accuracy gains on text-to-SQL benchmarks. A with/without comparison cannot say which part of the layer does the work: the semantic content, the retrieval scaffolding that delivers it, or the pre-computed views that usually accompany it. We report a four-arm ablation on DABStep on four models that separates the three. The instrument is a data contract: a YAML artifact that carries a domain's semantics and the rules an agent's tools enforce. One arm empties every field of prose in the frozen contract while holding the tool surface, retrieval instruction, table allow-list and operation rules byte-for-byte fixed. Compiling the contract's own SQL expressions into views gives the ceiling a pre-computed layer would reach: gold on all 176 tasks it covers. Content dominates. It raises hard-task accuracy from 13.9% to 55.1%, 22.6% to 56.6%, 22.9% to 68.4% and 37.0% to 77.4%, beating the same knowledge pasted into the prompt on every model. Scaffolding without content is worth 0 to 5 points on two flash models and 14 to 15 on two frontier models. Against the compiled ceiling the contract arm's shortfall is a failure to derive, and it falls from 39 points to 5 with model capability. The contract beats the prompt because the rule it needs is one lookup away rather than buried in a long prompt: its SQL carries the fee semantics up to 98% of the time against the prompt arm's 4%, and at the lowest cost per correct answer on three of four models. For practitioners: semantics first, scaffolding second, pre-computed macros only where an agent demonstrably fails to derive. Ungoverned arms submitted 166 mutating statements; governed arms none. The gain is confined to the contract's domain. On one model the benchmark's own withheld golds grade the contract arm at 51.9% against 18.8% for the prompt baseline.

AI.tldr: 四臂消融实验表明，在text-to-SQL中，上下文层的增益主要来自语义内容，而非检索脚手架或预计算视图；数据契约优于提示词且治理有效。
AI.motivation: 现有评估无法区分上下文层中语义内容、检索脚手架和预计算视图各自的贡献，导致实践者不知应优先投资哪部分。
AI.method: 在DABStep上对四个模型进行四臂消融，以YAML数据契约（含领域语义和工具规则）为工具。一臂清空契约所有散文但固定工具面、检索指令、表白名单和操作规则；另一臂将契约SQL编译为视图作为上限（覆盖176任务全对）。与提示词基线对比。
AI.result: 语义内容主导提升：硬任务准确率分别从13.9→55.1、22.6→56.6、22.9→68.4、37.0→77.4%，均胜提示词。无内容脚手架仅提升0-5分（两个flash）和14-15分（两个前沿）。契约臂与编译上限差距随模型能力从39分降至5分。契约SQL携带费用语义达98% vs 提示词4%，且三/四个模型上每正确回答成本最低。未治理臂提交166条变异语句，治理臂0条。增益限于契约领域。某模型上基准保留gold评分：契约51.9% vs 提示18.8%。
AI.conclusion: 实践建议：语义优先，脚手架次之，预计算宏仅当代理无法推导时使用。契约通过让规则一次查找可得而非埋于长提示词，提升了准确率、效率和安全性。

title: HEARTH: An Object-Centric RGB-Thermal-3D Dataset for Temperature-Aware Robot Manipulation
summary: Language-guided manipulation can depend on physical properties that visible appearance does not reveal. Temperature is one such property, but object datasets for robot learning rarely associate measured temperatures with object appearance and geometry. We present HEARTH, an object-centric RGB-thermal-3D dataset of 90 physical objects from 18 everyday categories, comprising 145 captured object states. Our pipeline maps apparent surface temperatures onto reconstructed meshes through camera calibration and pose transfer. The dataset includes raw temperature measurements, camera parameters, RGB-textured meshes, and thermal textures for simulation. We use these assets to construct three LIBERO-derived tasks and collect 1,200 demonstrations for fine-tuning a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model, $π_{0.5}$. In an ablation study, adding thermal observations to the VLA increases success on temperature-dependent object-selection tasks from 35.0% for the RGB-only baseline to 75.0%. These results demonstrate the utility of HEARTH for training robot policies to follow temperature-related instructions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HEARTH，一个以物体为中心的RGB-热-3D数据集，包含90个物体、18个日常类别、145个物体状态，并用于训练机器人策略遵循温度相关指令。
AI.motivation: 语言引导的操作可能依赖可见外观无法揭示的物理属性，温度就是其中之一。然而，机器人学习中的物体数据集很少将测量温度与物体外观和几何形状关联起来。
AI.method: 构建HEARTH数据集：通过相机标定和姿态迁移，将表观表面温度映射到重建网格上，包含原始温度测量、相机参数、RGB纹理网格和热纹理。基于该数据集构建三个LIBERO衍生任务，采集1,200个演示，微调预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型π_0.5，并进行消融实验。
AI.result: 在温度依赖的物体选择任务上，向VLA添加热观测后，成功率从仅RGB基线的35.0%提升至75.0%。
AI.conclusion: HEARTH数据集有助于训练机器人策略遵循温度相关指令，证明了热观测在机器人学习中的实用价值。

title: EmoPose: Vision-Language Model Guided Emotion-Aware Gesture Generation for Humanoid Robots
summary: Socially competent humanoid robots must communicate affect and intent through gesture as well as speech, yet open-ended interaction must become motion that is both expressive and executable on a specific body. This demands semantic flexibility for contextual social intent while preserving deterministic, embodiment-aware robot control. We present EmoPose, a vision-language model (VLM)-guided framework that bridges this gap through an executable semantic interface. Given language, dialogue history, and optional visual context, the VLM selects an ordered gesture plan containing a communicative class, library variant, intensity, and speech anchor. A scalable robot-owned motion library defines the available expressive vocabulary and the source of 14-DoF joint targets. Pose Studio supports automatic trajectory generation, MuJoCo preview, and automatic synchronization of new library entries with the VLM guide; deterministic robot-side modules validate plans, construct trajectories, schedule gestures, and manage queueing and interruption. This division lets the interaction repertoire grow for new social contexts without changing the control interface or delegating raw joint commands to the foundation model. On the EmoPose-Bench, structured GPT-5.5 planning reaches $98.25\pm0.52\%$ on the Easy tier and $76.50\pm0.54\%$ overall, exceeding same-model direct-label prompting. Further tests validate dialogue-context use and ordered multi-action composition. The system completes the nominal MuJoCo suite and realizes all 29 authored variants on the physical Unitree G1. A four-stop laboratory tour demonstrates expressive narration with interruption, camera-grounded dialogue, and navigation.

AI.tldr: EmoPose是一个由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的框架，通过可执行的语义接口，将开放式的社交意图规划为机器人可执行的手势计划，并在真实人形机器人上实现表达性手势与语音同步。
AI.motivation: 社交能力强的机器人必须通过手势和语音传达情感与意图，但开放式交互需要既富有表现力又能在特定身体上执行的动作。这要求兼顾语义灵活性（上下文社交意图）与确定性、具身感知的机器人控制。
AI.method: 给定语言、对话历史和可选的视觉上下文，VLM选择有序手势计划（包含交际类别、库变体、强度和语音锚点）。机器人自有动作库定义表达词汇和14自由度关节目标来源。Pose Studio支持自动轨迹生成、MuJoCo预览，并将新库条目自动同步到VLM指南。确定性机器人端模块负责验证计划、构建轨迹、调度手势以及管理队列和中断。
AI.result: 在EmoPose-Bench上，结构化GPT-5.5规划在简单层级达到98.25±0.52%，总体达到76.50±0.54%，优于同模型直接标签提示。进一步测试验证了对话上下文使用和有序多动作组合。系统完成了标称MuJoCo套件，并在物理Unitree G1上实现了全部29个编写变体。四站实验室参观展示了带中断的表达性叙述、相机接地对话和导航。
AI.conclusion: 这种分工让交互库能够针对新的社交场景生长，而无需改变控制接口，也无需将原始关节命令委托给基础模型。

title: CREDO: Variance-Guided Rubric Evolution for Replay-Corrected Credit Assignment
summary: Long-horizon language agents receive sparse terminal feedback, while intermediate rubrics provide structured but potentially misspecified assessments of progress. In resettable training environments, counterfactual continuation rollouts can measure local credit, but exhaustive replay is costly. We propose Credo, a framework that couples evolving semantic rubrics with selective, execution-based credit correction. A frozen judge maps visible transitions to rubric features, and a credit head predicts the change in expected terminal reward associated with the realized transition. Independently sampled two-sided replays correct prediction residuals using their recorded inclusion probabilities. We derive conditional unbiasedness and a variance decomposition that connects two design choices: which rubric features to retain, and where to allocate a fixed expected replay budget. The resulting criterion weights prediction errors by policy-score sensitivity and missing replay coverage; its allocation rule additionally accounts for continuation cost. We also describe a practical mixture with terminal leave-one-out advantages and distinguish its clipped, token-normalized PPO implementation from the ideal policy-gradient estimator. This preliminary report provides the method, proofs, an exact finite-model audit, and a controlled evaluation protocol. It makes no claim of empirical superiority on language-agent benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Credo 框架：将演化语义评分标准与选择性、基于执行的信用修正结合，用于长时程语言智能体中稀疏终端反馈下的信用分配。
AI.motivation: 长时程语言智能体主要获得稀疏的终端反馈，中间评分标准虽能提供结构化进度信号，但可能设定错误；在可重置训练环境中，反事实续写可测局部信用，但穷举回放代价高昂。
AI.method: 用冻结评判器将可见状态转移映射为评分标准特征，由信用头预测该转移带来的期望终端奖励变化；独立采样的双边回放依据记录包含概率修正预测残差；推导条件无偏性与方差分解，并据此设计特征保留与回放预算分配准则，准则同时考虑策略分数敏感性和缺失回放覆盖，分配规则还考虑续写成本；另给出结合终端留一优势的实用混合方法，并区分截断、token 归一化 PPO 实现与理想策略梯度估计器。
AI.result: 提供方法、证明、精确有限模型审计和受控评估协议；理论分析给出条件无偏性和方差分解，连接评分标准特征选择与固定期望回放预算分配两个设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 这是一份初步报告，重点在方法、理论证明与评估协议设计，不对语言智能体基准上的经验优越性作出声明。

title: APEXA: Execution-Integrity Enforcement for Multi-Agent LLM Automation of Synchrotron Data Reduction
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 4th TPC Workshop @ SC'26 (Building Open AI Infrastructure, Models, and Agentic Systems for Science). Code and benchmark: https://github.com/AdvancedPhotonSource/APEXA-APS-Beamline-Assistant ; data: https://doi.org/10.18126/tgg4-1m26
summary: Synchrotron data reduction, detector calibration followed by azimuthal integration of terabyte-scale diffraction series, is a multi-step, expert-bound bottleneck that increasingly limits the science rate of user facilities. LLM agents promise to collapse it, but driving a real pipeline with a stochastic model creates a failure mode chat benchmarks cannot see: an agent can report a calibration that was never computed. Correctness here is a property of what executed, not of the transcript. We present APEXA, a deployed multi-agent framework (61 tools over heterogeneous compute, run as a single reasoning loop) automating calibration and integration from natural language at a major light source. We make three contributions. First, execution-integrity enforcement: a deterministic tool-layer guard that refuses to surface any result not backed by an executed tool call, with a parser tolerant of cross-model tool-call format drift: in deployment, a frontier model fabricated a complete calibration-comparison report for commands that never ran, which the guard converts to an explicit non-result; the same code gates an optional motor-control surface at 0/200 adversarial violations against a simulated IOC, versus 15/200 for an equivalent safety prompt. Second, we release APEXA-Bench, an evaluation harness of 58 facility tasks (50 base plus an 8-task cross-detector slice) organized by a four-class physical-consequence taxonomy, the first benchmark axis we know of separating a wasted compute cycle from a damaged instrument; its cross-detector grading against NIST-traceable lattice constants surfaced two latent pipeline bugs. Large-scale agent scoring is left to a full-length study. Third, we validate APEXA on real beamline data: from one natural-language prompt it recovers detector geometry and integrates a full attenuation/exposure sweep. We release the framework, harness and traces.

AI.tldr: 提出APEXA，一个已部署的多智能体框架（61个工具，单推理循环），用于同步辐射光源的探测器校准与方位角积分自动化。核心是执行完整性强制机制，防止LLM伪造未实际执行的结果，并发布配套基准APEXA-Bench（58项设施任务），在真实光束线数据上验证了从自然语言提示恢复探测器几何并完成全衰减/曝光扫描积分。
AI.motivation: 同步辐射数据还原（校准、TB级衍射序列积分）是多步骤、专家依赖的瓶颈，限制了用户设施的科学产出速率。LLM智能体虽有望解决，但其随机性带来聊天基准无法发现的失效模式：智能体可能报告从未计算的校准结果。正确性取决于实际执行了什么，而非对话记录。
AI.method: 提出APEXA多智能体框架，将61个工具异构计算统一为单推理循环，从自然语言自动化校准与积分。实现执行完整性强制：确定性工具层守卫，拒绝呈现无已执行工具调用支撑的结果，并含容忍跨模型工具调用格式漂移的解析器。发布APEXA-Bench评估套件（58项任务：50基础+8跨探测器切片），按四类物理后果分类法组织。在真实光束线数据上验证。
AI.result: 部署中，前沿模型为未运行的命令伪造了完整校准对比报告，守卫将其转为明确非结果；同一代码在模拟IOC上对可选电机控制面实现0/200对抗违规，而等效安全提示为15/200。APEXA-Bench跨探测器评估对照NIST可溯源晶格常数，暴露两个潜在流水线缺陷。真实数据验证中，单条自然语言提示即恢复探测器几何并积分全衰减/曝光扫描。大规模智能体评分留待完整研究。
AI.conclusion: APEXA通过执行完整性强制机制保障了LLM驱动真实流水线的正确性，并提供了首个区分浪费计算周期与损坏仪器的物理后果基准轴。框架、基准与执行轨迹已发布，证明了在真实同步辐射设施中从自然语言自动化校准与积分的可行性。

title: Used, Mentioned, or Condemned? A Controlled Contrast-Set Diagnostic for the Use-Mention Distinction in Code-Mixed Hinglish Misogyny Detection
comment: Preprint. 8 pages main text + appendix, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code, data, and generator to be released with camera-ready version
summary:
Lexicon-driven misogyny detectors cannot, by construction, distinguish a slur used against a woman from the same slur mentioned in counter-speech ("don't call her that") -- yet exactly this distinction governs whether moderation protects or silences the people discussing abuse. We study this problem in code-mixed Hinglish and make three contributions.
  First, we diagnose two evaluation artifacts on a publicly available redacted corpus: category-encoding anonymization placeholders leak the label (a no-learning rule scores 1.000), and even after they are neutralized misogynistic and benign comments occupy lexically disjoint registers, so bag-of-words reaches macro-F1 approximately 1.00 under random cross-validation but collapses under template-disjoint evaluation.
  Second, we release Hinglish-MGY-Diag, a deterministic generator and a 416-item / 163-minimal-pair contrast-set diagnostic across five linguistically motivated categories in which slur presence and gendered register are decorrelated from the label by construction.
  Third, we introduce a strict pair-consistency metric that credits a model only when both members of a minimal pair are correctly labelled. Five from-scratch classical baselines evaluated under construction-disjoint five-fold cross-validation reveal that the strongest model reaches 0.93 accuracy on the cleanest use-mention subset but only 0.82 consistency -- it still mislabels roughly one counter-speech pair in five. A frontier LLM used as an author-model ceiling attains 1.000 on all metrics, doubling as independent label validation and confirming the benchmark is a capability gradient rather than an adversarial wall. We release all code, data, the generator, and an arms-length LLM harness for reproducing every number.

AI.tldr: 针对混合语Hinglish中基于词典的厌女检测器无法区分侮辱语用于攻击女性与用于反言论的问题，本文诊断了评估偏差，发布了诊断数据集，并提出严格配对一致性指标，发现经典模型在反言论上仍有约20%错误，而前沿LLM达到完美。
AI.motivation: 基于词典的厌女检测器无法区分‘针对女性的侮辱’与‘反言论中提及同一侮辱’（如‘别那样叫她’），而这一区分直接决定审核是保护还是噤声讨论虐待的人。现有评估可能存在标签泄漏和词汇分布偏差，导致模型性能虚高。
AI.method: 在Hinglish上：(1) 诊断公开脱敏语料中的两种评估假象：类别编码匿名占位符泄漏标签，以及去除后厌女与良性评论词汇域分离；(2) 发布Hinglish-MGY-Diag，包含确定性生成器和416项/163最小对对比集，覆盖五个语言动机类别，构造上解耦侮辱词与标签；(3) 提出严格配对一致性指标，要求最小对两个成员均正确标注；用五种经典基线和前沿LLM在构造不相交五折交叉验证下评估。
AI.result: 无学习规则在占位符泄漏时得分1.000；去除后词袋模型随机交叉验证宏F1约1.00，但在模板不相交评估下崩溃。五种经典基线下，最强模型在最干净的用-提子集上准确率0.93，但配对一致性仅0.82，约每五对反言论错一对。前沿LLM在所有指标上达1.000，验证了标签并表明基准是能力梯度而非对抗墙。
AI.conclusion: 基于词典的检测器在反言论区分上存在严重缺陷，现有评估可能因标签泄漏和词汇偏差而高估性能。发布的诊断生成器、对比集和严格配对指标能揭示真实能力，前沿LLM的上限表明该基准可衡量模型能力梯度。所有代码、数据、生成器和LLM测试框架已公开。

title: The Right Future for Action: Learning Action-Relevant Predictive States in World Action Models
summary: Generation-free world action models (WAMs) retain future-video prediction during training but act from internal video features at inference, leaving unclear what these features should preserve for control. Our representation diagnostics show that representations with more predictable future changes need not make linear action decoding easier. Observed future changes provide additional action information beyond the present, and linearly readable action information is spatially concentrated. These findings motivate Action-Relevant Predictive States (ARPS), a compact predictive interface between the video and action experts. ARPS uses a horizon-conditioned state predictor to aggregate intermediate video features into a compact state that supplies all visual context to the action expert. Future-representation supervision trains different parts of this state to predict visual representations at different future times, together with their changes relative to the present. At inference, the supervision branch is removed, and the action expert only uses the learned predictive state computed from current observations. Controlled ablations show that future supervision substantially improves generalization under distribution shift. ARPS achieves 99.2% success on LIBERO and transfers to LIBERO-Plus without adaptation, reaching 87.3% and exceeding Fast-WAM by 39.2 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动作相关预测状态（ARPS），一种位于视频专家与动作专家之间的紧凑预测接口，通过未来表征监督学习可预测状态，使世界动作模型在不做视频生成的情况下提升控制性能与分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 无生成式世界动作模型在训练时保留未来视频预测，但推理时仅依赖内部视频特征进行动作决策，这些特征究竟应保留哪些对控制有用的信息尚不明确。作者通过表征诊断发现：未来变化越可预测的表征并不一定越利于线性动作解码；观测到的未来变化能提供当前之外的动作信息；且线性可读的动作信息在空间上高度集中。这些发现促使作者设计一种更紧凑、面向动作的预测表征接口。
AI.method: 提出ARPS作为视频专家与动作专家之间的紧凑预测接口。其使用条件于预测时域的（horizon-conditioned）状态预测器，将中间层视频特征聚合为紧凑状态，并向动作专家提供全部视觉上下文；同时采用未来表征监督，训练状态的不同部分分别预测不同未来时刻的视觉表征及其相对当前的变化。推理阶段移除监督分支，动作专家仅使用由当前观测计算得到的预测状态。
AI.result: 受控消融实验表明，未来监督显著提升分布偏移下的泛化能力。ARPS在LIBERO上达到99.2%的成功率，并可无适配迁移到LIBERO-Plus，成功率为87.3%，比Fast-WAM高出39.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 面向动作的紧凑预测状态能够有效桥接视频表征与动作控制，未来表征监督有助于提升泛化；ARPS在多个基准上取得优异性能并具备良好的迁移能力。

title: Vox-Infinity: Benchmarking the Limits of Long-Context Spoken Language Models
summary: Long-context understanding remains a fundamental challenge for large language models, as excessively long inputs often lead models to forget salient information. This issue is even more pronounced in the speech domain, where audio, as a low-compression modality, requires substantially more embeddings than text to preserve both semantic content and acoustic cues. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{Vox-Infinity}, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate long-context understanding in spoken language models. Vox-Infinity systematically extends audio history along two dimensions: turn count and turn duration. It covers a diverse range of representative scenarios with varying interaction structures and semantic complexity. Crucially, Vox-Infinity provides explicit answer-provenance annotations and organizes samples according to the amount of historical context required to resolve each query, enabling precise and length-aware evaluation. Extensive evaluations of seven representative spoken language models reveal a clear overall recency effect: models generally achieve higher accuracy when answer-supporting evidence is closer to the query, but struggle to retrieve and use evidence located farther back in the dialogue history. Cases and datasets are available at https://vox-infinity.github.io.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个面向口语语言模型的长上下文理解基准 Vox-Infinity，通过扩展对话轮数和每轮时长来评估模型，并在七个代表性模型上发现明显的近因效应。
AI.motivation: 长上下文理解是大语言模型的基础挑战，过长输入常导致关键信息被遗忘；语音作为低压缩模态需要更多嵌入来保留语义与声学线索，该问题更严重，但缺乏专门面向口语模型的长上下文评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 Vox-Infinity 基准，沿对话轮数和每轮时长两个维度系统扩展音频历史，覆盖多样交互结构与语义复杂度场景；提供显式答案来源标注，并按解决查询所需历史上下文量组织样本；对七个代表性口语语言模型进行评测。
AI.result: 评测显示模型整体呈现近因效应：当支持答案的证据更接近查询时准确率更高，而当证据位于对话历史较远处时，模型难以检索和利用。
