AI.conclusion: Vox-Infinity 支持精确且长度感知的口语长上下文理解评估，揭示当前口语语言模型在长程证据利用上的不足；案例与数据集见 https://vox-infinity.github.io。

title: Vision-Wireless Fusion for Multi-User Localization: A Cross-Modal Transformer Approach
summary: Accurate multi-user localization is challenging in complex urban environments, where wireless measurements can become ambiguous under noise, blockage, and multipath, while visual observations provide complementary spatial context. This paper presents a vision-wireless fusion framework for multi-user localization using pilot-indexed channel state information (CSI). Orthogonal pilot indices preserve the identities of the communicating UEs in the CSI token sequence and localization outputs. The model encodes each pilot-indexed CSI observation as a query token and uses cross-attention to retrieve user-specific information from spatial visual memory. Self-attention among CSI tokens further captures inter-user interactions, while the resulting multimodal representations are used for user-wise localization. Experiments on different datasets show consistent improvements over model-based, CSI-only, and multimodal-fusion baselines. Further experiments evaluate the model under different wireless and visual conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于导频索引CSI的视觉-无线融合多用户定位框架，通过跨注意力从视觉空间记忆中检索用户特定信息，并利用CSI令牌自注意力建模用户间交互，实现多用户定位。
AI.motivation: 复杂城市环境中，无线测量受噪声、遮挡和多径影响而模糊，仅靠无线难以准确多用户定位；视觉观测可提供互补的空间上下文。
AI.method: 使用正交导频索引在CSI令牌序列和定位输出中保留通信UE身份；将每个导频索引CSI观测编码为查询令牌，通过跨注意力从空间视觉记忆中检索用户特定信息；通过CSI令牌间自注意力捕获用户间交互；融合多模态表示进行逐用户定位。
AI.result: 在不同数据集上相比基于模型、仅CSI和多模态融合基线均取得一致提升；进一步实验评估了模型在不同无线与视觉条件下的性能。
AI.conclusion: 导频索引CSI与视觉融合的框架能够有效支持复杂环境下的多用户定位，并优于现有基线，在不同无线和视觉条件下具有鲁棒性。

title: SKstars at SHROOM: Visions Agreement-Guided Ensembling of Zero-Shot and LoRA-Adapted Vision--Language Models
comment: This paper has been accepted at the SHROOM-Visions 2026 Shared Task, co-located with EMNLP2026
summary: This paper describes the SKstars submission to SHROOM-Visions 2026, a shared task on fine-grained hallucination detection in large vision-language model outputs. The task requires systems to identify hallucinated character spans, assign hallucination categories, and provide confidence estimates for their predictions. Our approach combines zero-shot predictions from Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct with those of a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model. The outputs of the two models are integrated through a lightweight ensemble procedure, followed by span refinement and confidence adjustment. We evaluate the main system components on a small internal development subset and report the performance of the submitted system on the official English test set. SKstars achieved a Cor+Lbl score of 0.2902, ranking 15th among 29 teams, and obtained Cor and IoU scores of 0.3642 and 0.3151, respectively, ranking 18th on both metrics. The results show that combining a large zero-shot model with a smaller adapted model provides a practical framework for multilingual and fine-grained hallucination localization, while also highlighting the difficulty of transferring development-set improvements to hidden test data. Code and predictions: https://github.com/aliathar1401/SK-Stars-shroom-visions-2026

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SKstars团队参加SHROOM-Visions 2026细粒度幻觉检测任务的系统，通过结合Qwen2.5-VL-72B零样本预测与LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型，并经轻量集成、片段精炼和置信度调整，最终在官方测试集上取得一定排名。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型输出中常出现细粒度幻觉，需要检测幻觉字符片段、分类幻觉类型并给出置信度，而该任务具有多语言和细粒度定位的挑战。
AI.method: 采用零样本Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct与LoRA适配的Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct两个模型，通过轻量级集成流程融合输出，再进行字符片段精炼与置信度调整，并在内部开发子集上评估主要组件。
AI.result: 在官方英文测试集上，系统Cor+Lbl得分为0.2902，在29支队伍中排名第15；Cor和IoU得分分别为0.3642和0.3151，两项均排名第18。
AI.conclusion: 将大型零样本模型与较小适配模型结合，可为多语言细粒度幻觉定位提供实用框架，但也表明开发集上的改进难以迁移到隐藏测试数据。

title: LIMIT: Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL
summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable progress on Text-to-SQL through reasoning-enhanced fine-tuning, yet existing approaches predominantly rely on massive instruction corpora under the assumption that scale drives performance. We challenge this paradigm by investigating a fundamental question: what is the minimal data requirement for effective Text-to-SQL instruction tuning? We propose LIMIT(Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL), a data-centric framework that demonstrates strong database reasoning can emerge from an extremely compact training set when examples are strategically selected. LIMIT operates through four stages: difficulty-aware filtering that identifies samples within the model's learning frontier, chain-of-thought synthesis with consistency-based selection, multi-dimensional quality scoring via LLM-as-judge, and genetic algorithm optimization that jointly maximizes schema coverage and sample quality. On the BIRD and Spider benchmark, LIMIT selects only 796 and 863 samples while achieving 100% table coverage, enabling Qwen3-8B to reach 69.1% and 88.9% execution accuracy.This result surpasses methods trained on 20 times more data and establishes a new state-of-the-art among open-source approaches. Our findings suggest that careful data curation, rather than scale, is the key to efficient Text-to-SQL learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LIMIT框架，通过数据选择而非大规模数据来提升Text-to-SQL指令微调效率，仅用数百条样本即在BIRD和Spider基准上达到开源最优。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法依赖大规模指令语料，假设数据规模驱动性能，但本文质疑这一范式，探究有效指令微调所需的最小数据量。
AI.method: LIMIT包含四个阶段：难度感知过滤（筛选位于模型学习前沿的样本）、一致性选择下的思维链合成、基于LLM作为评判者的多维质量评分、以及联合最大化模式覆盖与样本质量的遗传算法优化。
AI.result: 在BIRD和Spider基准上分别仅选择796和863个样本，实现100%表覆盖，使Qwen3-8B达到69.1%和88.9%的执行准确率，超越使用20倍数据训练的方法，并创下开源方法的新最优。
AI.conclusion: 精心数据策展而非数据规模是高效Text-to-SQL学习的关键。

title: Toward Personalized Sleep Guidance from Wearable Data Using Language Models
summary: Sleep monitoring using wearable data has shown promise for personal health, yet large language model (LLM)-based summarization and question answering remain insufficient for personalized sleep guidance. Training specialized models, however, often requires costly expert annotation. Moreover, privacy and accessibility concerns motivate lightweight, local deployment for end users. We present a two-stage framework to address these challenges. Specifically, in Stage~1, a multi-agent LLM pipeline reasons structured sleep guidance from unannotated wearable records, enabling scalable dataset construction. Stage~2 distills guidance reasoning trajectories into small language models (SLMs) through supervised fine-tuning and integrates a training-free Best-of-$N$ selection strategy to enhance inference. Experimental results demonstrate our method outperforms commercial general and medical LLMs and open-source models. Human evaluation further supports the quality of the generated guidance and the feasibility of personalized sleep guidance with SLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个两阶段框架，利用多智能体LLM从无标注可穿戴睡眠数据中生成结构化睡眠指导，再通过监督微调将推理轨迹蒸馏到小型语言模型，并结合Best-of-N选择提升推理，实现个性化睡眠指导的轻量本地部署。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴睡眠监测有个人健康潜力，但基于LLM的摘要和问答仍不足以提供个性化睡眠指导；训练专用模型通常需要昂贵专家标注，且隐私与可访问性要求推动轻量本地部署。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：Stage 1使用多智能体LLM流水线，从无标注可穿戴记录中推理出结构化睡眠指导，用于可扩展数据集构建；Stage 2通过监督微调将指导推理轨迹蒸馏到小型语言模型，并集成无需训练的Best-of-N选择策略增强推理。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法优于商业通用和医疗LLM以及开源模型；人工评估进一步支持生成指导的质量，以及用SLM实现个性化睡眠指导的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在无需昂贵专家标注的情况下构建数据，并将个性化睡眠指导能力蒸馏至小型语言模型，验证了轻量、本地化个性化睡眠指导的可行性。

title: RiverVLN: Phase-Grounded Temporal Vision--Language Navigation for Unmanned Surface Vehicles
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) has largely been developed for indoor and terrestrial robots, where language can often be treated as a static goal and motion is approximated by discrete or near-instantaneous actions. These assumptions break down for unmanned surface vehicles (USVs): river navigation requires continuous motion under inertia and limited maneuverability, while long-horizon instructions must be executed through sparse and visually ambiguous maritime landmarks. We introduce RiverVLN, to our knowledge the first benchmark designed for long-horizon USV VLN under continuous riverine motion, and PGT-NAV, a phase-grounded temporal navigation framework for USVs. Rather than directly mapping an entire instruction to motion, PGT-NAV converts it into an ordered sequence of visually verifiable semantic phases and maintains the active phase online through grounded visual and motion evidence. This explicit semantic progress state is fused with visual-motion history and phase-specific grounding to predict six local SE(2) pose increments. The resulting trajectory is executed in a predict-execute-re-observe loop, where the vessel executes toward W3, updates phase and grounding, and replans through a map-based safety layer. Experiments show that PGT-NAV substantially reduces recursive position and heading drift relative to GNM-style and ViNT-style baselines and achieves an average success rate of 0.79 in Unity-ROS closed-loop navigation. Unseen bridge-opening trials and real-world USV experiments further demonstrate that the phase-grounded representation transfers from controlled evaluation to physical USV deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RiverVLN，首个面向内河无人水面艇（USV）连续运动、长时程视觉语言导航的基准，并提出 PGT-NAV 相位接地时序导航框架，通过语义阶段、闭环重规划与地图安全层实现从仿真到真实USV部署。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言导航多面向室内和地面机器人，通常将语言视为静态目标，并将动作近似为离散或近瞬时动作。但USV内河导航需要在惯性下连续运动、机动性受限，且长时程指令依赖稀疏且视觉歧义的水上地标，这些假设不再成立。
AI.method: PGT-NAV 不直接将整条指令映射为运动，而是将其转换为有序且视觉可验证的语义阶段。系统在线利用视觉与运动证据维持当前活动阶段，将该语义进度状态与视觉-运动历史和阶段特定接地图融合，预测6个局部 SE(2) 位姿增量。轨迹通过“预测-执行-重观测”闭环执行：USV朝 W3 运动，更新阶段与接地，并通过基于地图的安全层重新规划。
AI.result: 实验表明，PGT-NAV 相比 GNM 风格和 ViNT 风格基线显著降低递归位置与航向漂移，在 Unity-ROS 闭环导航中平均成功率达到 0.79。未见过的桥开合试验和真实USV实验进一步表明，阶段接地表示可从受控评估迁移到物理USV部署。
AI.conclusion: 相位接地的时序导航框架适合USV在内河连续运动下的长时程视觉语言导航，能有效减少漂移，并具备从仿真评估向真实USV部署迁移的能力。

title: RopeFormer: Cross-Trial Adaptation from Interaction History for Dynamic Rope Manipulation
summary: Dynamic rope manipulation is highly sensitive to unknown object dynamics: the same robot motion can produce substantially different responses across ropes, while explicitly identifying the relevant physical properties is difficult. We present RopeFormer, a history-conditioned framework that uses prior task interaction as context for subsequent control. The policy retains cross-trial action-response history while keeping its weights fixed and requires no explicit online rope-parameter estimation. In matched simulation evaluations across sustained single-arm rotation, bimanual rotation, and transient whipping, retaining context improves subsequent control relative to resetting the same checkpoint, with the benefit varying across rope dynamics and observation settings. We further deploy the frozen policies on a Unitree H1-2 with previously unseen physical ropes. From T1 to T3, target-acquisition time decreases by 30.9% for Rope Swing and 33.9% for Rope Twirl, while mean Rope Whip target hits increase from 0.2 to 2.3 out of three. These results show that prior interaction can provide effective control context for dynamic deformable-object manipulation. Robot videos, code, and data are available at https://ropeformer.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出RopeFormer，一种以历史交互为条件、无需在线估计绳索参数的动态绳索操作框架；在仿真和真实Unitree H1-2上验证其能利用先前交互上下文提升后续控制性能。
AI.motivation: 动态绳索操作对未知物体动力学高度敏感：相同机器人动作在不同绳索上可能产生显著不同响应，而显式辨识相关物理属性又很困难。
AI.method: RopeFormer保留跨试验的动作-响应历史作为后续控制上下文，策略权重固定，无需显式在线绳索参数估计。在仿真中比较保留上下文与重置同一检查点，任务包括持续单臂旋转、双臂旋转和瞬态鞭打；并将冻结策略部署到Unitree H1-2上操作未见过物理绳索。
AI.result: 保留上下文相对重置检查点能改善后续控制，且收益随绳索动力学和观测设置变化。真实部署中，T1到T3目标获取时间在Rope Swing上降低30.9%，Rope Twirl降低33.9%；Rope Whip平均命中数从0.2提升到2.3（满分3次）。
AI.conclusion: 先前交互可为动态可变形物体操作提供有效的控制上下文，表明历史条件化策略在未知绳索动力学下具有实用价值。

title: Apollo Restore: A Foundation LLM for Historical Greek Optimized for Fill-in-the-Middle Restoration of Ancient Greek Texts
summary: We present Apollo Restore, a 24-billion-parameter large language model for restoring lacunae---physical gaps---in fragmentary Ancient Greek texts. Fine-tuned from Mistral Small with a fill-in-the-middle objective, Apollo Restore reconstructs missing spans without requiring oracle knowledge of their length. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale decoder model for historical Greek, and the first for any ancient Mediterranean language. Evaluated as in prior work, on short gaps of up to ten characters, Apollo Restore places the correct restoration among its top twenty candidates for 80.6%/54.6%/61.0% of documentary-papyrus, literary-papyrus, and stone-inscription lacunae, exceeding the strongest published models by $1.6\times$/$2.6\times$/$1.4\times$. Prior evaluation protocols, however, inflate scores through a bias toward trivially short gaps; under a length-balanced metric Apollo Restore's advantage over the strongest published models grows to $2.3\times$/$3.5\times$/$1.6\times$ and degrades gracefully, even given incorrect length hints. In a blind study, 20 expert papyrologists, epigraphists, and philologists strongly preferred Apollo Restore to the strongest baseline and judged its performance at least as good as human restorations in 77% of cases. Apollo Restore also improves the published reading of P.Herc. 1667---a papyrus roll carbonised in the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 CE and digitally unrolled and edited after Apollo Restore's training data was compiled. Apollo Restore is an output of the Decoding Antiquity initiative to build specialized LLMs for historical languages and manuscripts, led by the Austrian Academy of Sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Apollo Restore，一个 240 亿参数的大语言模型，用于修复古希腊残缺文本中的物理空缺（lacunae）。它基于 Mistral Small 微调，采用 fill-in-the-middle 目标，可在不依赖已知缺失长度的情况下重建缺失文本。
AI.motivation: 古希腊纸草、铭文等文献常因物理损坏而残缺，传统修复依赖专家知识且困难。作者希望构建面向历史语言和古代地中海语言的专用大模型，以辅助甚至提升残缺文本的修复。
AI.method: Apollo Restore 从 Mistral Small 微调，使用 fill-in-the-middle 目标训练，无需 oracle 长度信息即可填补缺失片段。评估涵盖 documentary papyrus、literary papyrus 和 stone inscription 三类短空缺（最多 10 字符），并采用此前协议、长度平衡指标和盲测专家研究。
AI.result: 在最多 10 字符空缺上，Apollo Restore 将正确修复放入 top-20 候选的比例分别为 80.6%、54.6%、61.0%，比最强已发表模型高 1.6 倍、2.6 倍、1.4 倍。长度平衡指标下优势增至 2.3 倍、3.5 倍、1.6 倍，且即使长度提示错误也能平稳退化。20 位专家盲测中，专家强烈偏好 Apollo Restore，并在 77% 案例中认为其表现至少与人类修复相当。它还能改进 P.Herc. 1667 的已发表释读。
AI.conclusion: Apollo Restore 是首个面向历史希腊语及古代地中海语言的大规模解码器模型，证明专用 LLM 能有效且稳健地修复古代文本空缺，并获得专家认可，可作为纸草学和铭文学研究的辅助工具。

title: LiteTex-GS: Fast and Lightweight Texturing for Gaussian Splatting
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to Pacific Graphics 2026 (Journal Track)
summary: Gaussian Splatting has enabled real-time novel view synthesis, but its tightly coupled geometry and appearance representation often require a large number of primitives to reproduce high-frequency texture details, leading to substantial memory and optimization costs. Recent textured 2D Gaussian methods alleviate this limitation by attaching texture maps to Gaussian primitives. However, bridging the fundamental structural gap between discrete Gaussians and continuous 2D grids requires complex parameterizations that introduce severe computational overhead. This overhead fundamentally compromises the original efficiency of Gaussian Splatting, making the balance between detailed texturing and computational agility an unresolved challenge. To address these challenges, we propose LiteTex-GS, a fast and lightweight texturing framework for Gaussian Splatting. Our method initializes an extremely compact representation, assigning minimal local texture to each Gaussian and progressively allocates higher resolution only to primitives with significant reconstruction errors. To maintain a streamlined geometric scaffold, we introduce a contribution- and area-aware pruning strategy that eliminates low-utility Gaussians. Furthermore, to mitigate the gradient dilution caused by texture upsampling, we design a resolution-aware update rule that preserves rapid and stable convergence. Extensive experiments on standard novel view synthesis benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive or superior rendering quality while using substantially fewer parameters and less training time than existing textured Gaussian baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出LiteTex-GS，一种快速轻量级纹理化高斯泼溅框架，通过渐进式纹理分辨率和剪枝策略，在保持渲染质量的同时减少参数和训练时间。
AI.motivation: 高斯泼溅中几何与外观耦合导致大量基元和高频纹理细节的存储与优化成本；现有纹理2D高斯方法因离散高斯与连续2D网格间的结构差异引入复杂参数化和计算开销，损害效率，需平衡细节纹理与计算敏捷性。
AI.method: 初始化极紧凑表示，为每个高斯分配最小局部纹理；根据重建误差渐进分配更高分辨率；引入贡献和面积感知剪枝去除低效用高斯；设计分辨率感知更新规则缓解纹理上采样导致的梯度稀释。
AI.result: 在标准新视角合成基准上，与现有纹理高斯基线相比，使用更少参数和训练时间，达到竞争或更优的渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: LiteTex-GS有效解决了纹理细节与计算效率的平衡问题，实现了高效的高质量新视角合成。

title: CultureMINE: Datasets and Methods for Improving the Cultural Capabilities of NLP Systems
summary: In recent years, there has been a surge of interest in Cultural NLP, with substantial efforts to create globally inclusive NLP systems. The rapid growth of literature in this field makes it difficult to track trends in methods and data resources. To address this, we analyze over 375 papers to answer three complementary questions: (1) What Cultural Capabilities (CCs) are being targeted in NLP systems? (2) How are cultural data resources being created? and (3) What methods are being used to improve the CCs of those systems? We discuss trends observed across the three questions, and identify relevant research gaps. To facilitate further research in this field, we release our full list of analyzed papers in the form of an interactive web interface, which includes a feature to allow researchers to add their work; we hope this facilitates future research and proves to be a valuable resource for the Cultural NLP community.

AI.tldr: 本文对文化自然语言处理（Cultural NLP）领域的超过375篇论文进行了系统分析，围绕文化能力目标、文化数据资源构建方法以及提升文化能力的方法三个问题总结趋势并指出研究空白，同时发布交互式网页资源以方便后续研究。
AI.motivation: 近年来Cultural NLP研究兴趣激增，相关文献快速增多，导致研究方法和数据资源的趋势难以追踪，因此需要系统梳理该领域现状。
AI.method: 分析超过375篇论文，回答三个互补问题：（1）NLP系统针对哪些文化能力（CCs）；（2）文化数据资源如何创建；（3）使用哪些方法提升系统的文化能力。并发布可交互网页界面，支持研究者添加自己的工作。
AI.result: 归纳了三个问题上的研究趋势，识别了相关研究空白，并公开了所分析论文的完整列表及交互式网络界面。
AI.conclusion: 该工作有助于促进Cultural NLP领域的后续研究，并为社区提供有价值的资源。

title: Recovering Lost Details: Multi-Scale Frequency Compensation for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Long-term time series forecasting has made significant progress by leveraging multi-scale information to capture hierarchical temporal patterns and model long-range dependencies. However, temporal downsampling in existing multi-scale methods inevitably smooths detailed temporal fluctuations, and this information loss is further aggravated by their emphasis on dominant trends across scales, resulting in insufficiently expressive representations. To address this, we propose a Multi-Scale Wavelet Mixing (MWMixer) model, which incorporates a Bidirectional Frequency-Bands Mixing strategy to recover lost temporal details across scales, enabling complementary cross-scale information interactions. Then, a Dynamic Scale-Adaptive Fusion module learns time-varying weights for each scale to fuse multi-scale forecasts into the final prediction, enhancing the flexibility of multi-scale aggregation. In addition, a cross-scale consistency loss aligns each coarse-scale prediction with the interval-averaged fine-scale outputs, while a multi-scale supervision loss enforces prediction accuracy at each scale, promoting consistent learning across scales. Extensive experiments on seven real-world datasets demonstrate that MWMixer achieves competitive performance in long-term forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出MWMixer模型，通过双向频带混合和动态尺度自适应融合等策略，解决多尺度时间序列预测中的信息损失问题，在七个真实数据集上取得有竞争力的长期预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多尺度方法通过时间下采样捕获层次模式，但会平滑细节波动，且过度强调跨尺度主导趋势，导致信息损失和表示表达能力不足。
AI.method: 提出MWMixer，包含双向频带混合策略以恢复跨尺度丢失的时序细节，实现互补的跨尺度信息交互；动态尺度自适应融合模块学习时变权重融合多尺度预测；并引入跨尺度一致性损失和多尺度监督损失促进各尺度一致学习。
AI.result: 在七个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，MWMixer在长期时间序列预测中取得了有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: MWMixer能有效缓解现有多尺度方法的信息损失问题，提升长期时间序列预测的表示能力和预测效果。

title: ProxyBuild: Text-Guided Structured 3D Building Generation with Mesh-Anchored Procedural Proxies
summary: Text-guided 3D building generation holds tremendous application potential, yet existing generative models typically output inseparable single meshes or non-interactive rendered representations. While procedural modeling can generate editable buildings with hierarchical structures, rule authoring is laborious, and even with the aid of large language models (LLMs), it remains challenging to effectively solve procedural rules under geometric constraints. In this paper, we propose ProxyBuild, a novel hybrid framework for structured building generation. We introduce the Mesh-Anchored Procedural Proxy (MAPP) as a novel intermediate representation, which tightly anchors building components onto geometric shells, thereby decoupling the generation task into two phases: proxy prediction and proxy-to-asset instantiation. First, we construct a building dataset with MAPP annotations to train our designed face-edge bigraph encoder. By explicitly modeling the feature interactions of topological elements on heterogeneous mesh graphs, this encoder accurately infers the semantic roles of faces and edges. Subsequently, conditioned on textual styles and attribute parameters parsed by LLMs, we accomplish high-precision asset retrieval and assembly by integrating a spatial placement logic with hard constraints. Extensive experiments show that ProxyBuild not only significantly mitigates common issues in building generation such as over-smoothing, component collisions, and structural corruptions, but also accurately parses semantic-free shells from diverse sources. Outperforming prior baselines across various metrics, our method can robustly generate structurally clear, detail-rich, and post-editable 3D buildings from text, thereby providing a reliable and interactive content foundation for downstream applications such as virtual reality and digital twins.

AI.tldr: 提出 ProxyBuild，一种混合式结构化建筑生成框架，通过 Mesh-Anchored Procedural Proxy（MAPP）中间表示，将生成拆解为代理预测与代理到资产实例化两阶段，实现文本驱动、可编辑、结构清晰的 3D 建筑生成。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导 3D 建筑生成模型通常输出不可分离的单网格或不可交互的渲染表示；程序化建模虽可生成可编辑层级建筑，但规则编写费时，且即使借助 LLM 也难以在几何约束下有效求解程序规则。
AI.method: 构建带 MAPP 标注的建筑数据集，训练面-边二部图编码器，在异质网格图上显式建模拓扑元素特征交互以推断面与边的语义角色；再以 LLM 解析文本风格和属性参数为条件，结合空间放置逻辑与硬约束完成高精度资产检索与装配。
AI.result: 实验表明 ProxyBuild 显著缓解过平滑、组件碰撞和结构损坏等常见问题，能准确解析多来源的语义无关外壳，并在多项指标上优于已有基线，稳健生成结构清晰、细节丰富且可后编辑的 3D 建筑。
AI.conclusion: ProxyBuild 为文本到可编辑 3D 建筑生成提供了可靠且可交互的内容基础，可服务虚拟现实、数字孪生等下游应用。

title: Receding-Horizon Pushing with Composable Object-Centric Policies
summary: Non-prehensile manipulation is practical for relocating large, heavy, or geometrically ungraspable objects. Yet, long-horizon pushing of arbitrarily-shaped 3D objects couples three problems: 1) where to push the object so as to approach the target pose, 2) whether each push is stable and reachable, 3) whether subsequent actions remain feasible. We present an object-centric pushing policy within a feedback-guided hierarchical framework. At the low level, a learning-based policy predicts contact actions from a pose- and scale-normalized point cloud, conditioned on a near single-step subgoal. A stability score is applied to evaluate the predicted contacts by a quasi-static sliding-versus-tipping analysis. At the high level, BIT$^*$ first searches for an object path, and the next several subgoals are checked by contact prediction and robot motion planning for future feasibility. Failed motion plans, as feedback, change the local path costs and trigger re-planning. During execution, only the first feasible action is executed. In simulation, we evaluate 22 objects in six different scenes, upon which we also conduct comprehensive ablation studies. Results demonstrate that our method outperforms baselines with a clear margin and can reliably achieve long-horizon object pushing tasks under different situations. We also report quantitative real-robot experiments with a Franka arm and qualitative demonstrations with a mobile manipulator for large and heavy objects, with directly zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出一种反馈引导的分层框架下的物体中心推动策略，用于长时程非抓取操作任意形状3D物体。
AI.motivation: 大、重或几何上不可抓取物体的搬运需要非抓取操作，但长时程推动耦合了三个难题：推哪里以接近目标位姿、每次推动是否稳定可达、以及后续动作是否仍然可行。
AI.method: 低层使用学习策略，从位姿和尺度归一化的点云预测接触动作，并以近单步子目标为条件；通过准静态滑动与倾倒分析计算稳定性分数。高层使用BIT*搜索物体路径，并用接触预测和机器人运动规划检查未来若干子目标的可行性；运动规划失败作为反馈调整局部路径成本并触发重规划。执行时只执行第一个可行动作。
AI.result: 在仿真中对22个物体、6个场景进行评估和消融实验，方法明显优于基线，能可靠完成不同情况下的长时程物体推动任务。还使用Franka机械臂进行了真实机器人定量实验，并在移动操作臂上对大而重物体进行了定性演示，实现了零样本仿真到现实迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该分层反馈引导框架结合学习接触预测、稳定性评估和未来可行性检查，能有效处理任意形状3D物体的长时程非抓取推动，并具备零样本迁移到真实机器人的能力。

title: Enhancing Shrimp Disease Detection via Deep Learning and Data Refinement for Resilient Aquaculture
comment: This paper has been accepted at the International Conference on Multidisciplinary Research (ICMR 2025)
summary: Shrimp diseases continue to cause devastating losses in the aquaculture industry, driving a critical need for robust, automated detection. This work contributes the first application of Vision Transformers (ViT) and Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) to the shrimp farming domain, addressing both performance bottlenecks and data labeling challenges. We propose two deep learning pipelines to classify four key diseases: Healthy, Black Gill (BG), White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV), and a co-infection of both using a dataset of 4,348 images. First, our supervised transfer-learning approach leverages ImageNet-pretrained ViT-Small/16 and EfficientNet backbones. Second, we introduce a contrastive learning framework (SimCLR) with a ViT-Small encoder to extract robust representations from unlabeled images prior to fine-tuning. Our results establish strong new baselines for sustainable aquaculture monitoring. The supervised approach achieves an outstanding 96% accuracy with fast convergence, outperforming traditional generic models, while the label-efficient SSL approach reaches a highly competitive 85% validation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次将Vision Transformers（ViT）与自监督学习（SSL）应用于虾类疾病检测，基于4,348张图像对健康、黑鳃病、白斑综合征病毒及两者共感染进行分类，并建立新的性能基线。
AI.motivation: 虾病持续给水产养殖业造成严重损失，亟需稳健、自动化的检测方法；同时，该领域存在性能瓶颈和数据标注困难，ViT与SSL尚未被应用。
AI.method: 提出两种深度学习流程：一是监督式迁移学习，使用ImageNet预训练的ViT-Small/16和EfficientNet骨干网络；二是自监督对比学习框架SimCLR，以ViT-Small编码器从未标注图像中提取表示，再进行微调。
AI.result: 监督式方法取得96%的准确率且收敛快，优于传统通用模型；标签高效的自监督方法达到85%的验证准确率，表现具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可持续水产养殖监测建立了强的新基线，并证明ViT与SSL在虾病自动检测中兼具高性能与标签效率潜力。

title: Taming CoT Obfuscation in VLMs: From Mechanistic Evidence to Activation Enforcement
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) but can induce chain-of-thought (CoT) obfuscation: an operational, non-intentional outcome where task reward or accuracy rises while traces become less grounded and monitorable. Prior work largely documents this decay behaviorally, leaving its representation-level correlates and actionable controls unclear. We find that template- and ground-associated activations become less separable during RL; matched interventions support the contribution of selected features to monitorability degradation. Guided by this evidence, we propose Targeted Anti-obfuscation with Mechanistic Enforcement (TAME), which uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to combine behavioral feedback with targeted suppression of template-associated activations during RL. Its asymmetric constraint penalizes template activations only above their pre-RL baseline, anchoring the localized features while behavioral feedback promotes grounded refinements. Across VIRL-39k, SPA-VL, and two model families, TAME improves CoT monitorability by up to 30.9 and 16.7 percentage points over Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), respectively. Blinded human evaluation finds higher human monitorability on both datasets, and two held-out monitor families reproduce the monitorability gains. Task accuracy changes are small and mixed, and general-capability benchmarks show task-specific trade-offs. These results provide a path from behavioral monitoring to representation-level oversight for more auditable RL-trained multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究强化学习提升视觉语言模型推理时出现的思维链混淆问题，并提出基于稀疏自编码器的TAME方法，在训练中抑制模板相关激活，从而提升思维链可监控性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽能提升VLM推理能力，但会导致思维链可监控性下降：任务奖励或准确率上升，而推理轨迹变得更不接地、更难监控。已有工作多停留在行为层面，缺乏表征层面的机制解释和可操作控制方法。
AI.method: 作者发现RL训练中模板相关激活与接地相关激活的可分离性降低，并通过干预验证这些特征对可监控性退化的作用。据此提出TAME，利用稀疏自编码器将行为反馈与对模板相关激活的定向抑制结合；其非对称约束仅惩罚超过RL前基线的模板激活，同时通过行为反馈促进接地推理。
AI.result: 在VIRL-39k、SPA-VL及两个模型家族上，TAME相比GRPO分别最多提升思维链可监控性30.9和16.7个百分点。盲法人工评估显示两个数据集上人类可监控性更高，两个留出监控器家族也复现了提升。任务准确率变化较小且方向不一，通用能力基准显示任务特定权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，从行为监控走向表征层面的监督是可行的，为构建更可审计的强化学习训练多模态系统提供了路径。

title: BiRoAD: Learning Shared and Role-Adaptive Representations for Bimanual Manipulation
summary: Bimanual manipulation requires policies that coordinate two arms while adapting their functional roles to scene geometry, object configuration, and task context. Learning such scene-conditioned role adaptation remains challenging, as demonstrations may contain uneven role distributions that limit generalization to underrepresented arm--role configurations. In addition, many bimanual policies predict actions in fixed left- and right-arm action spaces. While this provides a natural parameterization for robot control, it does not explicitly specify how behaviors should transform when functional roles are exchanged across arms. Across different scene initializations, the two arms may follow a similar coordination pattern, but the role-specific behavior assigned to each arm should change with the scene. Therefore, we propose BiRoAD, a Bimanual Role-Adaptive Decomposition framework for learning shared and role-adaptive representations in bimanual policies. Given bimanual trajectory or action-token features, BiRoAD decomposes these features into swap--symmetric and swap--antisymmetric components: the former captures coordination structure invariant to arm exchange, and the latter captures role-specific distinctions that vary consistently with functional role assignment. The two components are then recomposed as residual updates to the original paired arm representations, allowing BiRoAD to serve as a modular feature transformation without changing the policy inputs, imitation-learning objective, or requiring manually defined role labels. Across multiple bimanual manipulation tasks with balanced and imbalanced role distributions, BiRoAD improves robustness across role configurations over corresponding base policies, with notable gains on underrepresented role configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出 BiRoAD，一种双臂角色自适应分解框架，通过将双臂轨迹或动作 token 特征分解为交换对称与交换反对称分量，学习共享协调结构与角色特定表示，从而提升双臂策略在不同角色配置下的泛化与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 双臂操作需要两条手臂协调，并根据场景几何、物体配置和任务上下文自适应调整功能角色。现有方法面临两个问题：示范数据中角色分布不均，导致对未充分表示的手臂-角色组合泛化差；许多策略在固定左右臂动作空间预测动作，未显式建模功能角色交换时行为应如何变化。
AI.method: BiRoAD 对双臂轨迹或动作 token 特征进行分解：交换对称分量捕捉与手臂交换无关的协调结构，交换反对称分量捕捉随功能角色分配一致变化的角色特定差异。随后将两部分重组为对原始成对手臂表示的残差更新。该方法作为模块化特征变换，不改变策略输入、模仿学习目标，也不需要人工定义角色标签。
AI.result: 在多个具有平衡和不平衡角色分布的双臂操作任务中，BiRoAD 相比对应基础策略提升了跨角色配置的鲁棒性，并在角色表示不足的配置上取得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: BiRoAD 通过共享与角色自适应表示解耦，使双臂策略能够更好地进行场景条件下的角色适应，并改善对不平衡角色分布和不同角色配置的泛化能力。

title: Smartphone GNSS Booster: Centimeter-Level Pedestrian Positioning Using a Portable Signal Re-Radiator
comment: Accepted to the ION 2026 Pacific PNT Meeting
summary: High-precision positioning using the global navigation satellite system (GNSS) embedded in smartphones is demanded for sidewalk-level pedestrian navigation and pinpoint location-based applications. However, current smartphone positioning accuracy for pedestrians remains at the meter level. This is mainly because limitations of the compact linearly polarized (LP) antenna in smartphones increase GNSS observation noise and hinder stable carrier phase tracking. In this paper, we propose an external GNSS signal re-radiation system that boosts smartphone GNSS observation quality while still using the smartphone's built-in GNSS receiver and antenna. The system directly connects a compact active helical antenna and a thin passive patch antenna for re-radiation, and is designed to be attached directly to the smartphone. The proposed GNSS booster achieves (1) reduced thermal noise and stable signal tracking via increased received signal strength, (2) improved multipath robustness compared with a LP antenna, and (3) stabilization of antenna phase center variation. Static experiments confirm a substantial improvement in the observation quality of GNSS carrier phase measurements compared with standard smartphone positioning. Furthermore, in pedestrian experiments, the proposed booster enabled stable carrier phase integer ambiguity resolutions, achieving centimeter-level positioning using a smartphone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种外置GNSS信号再辐射系统，通过连接有源螺旋天线和无源贴片天线并附着于智能手机，提升智能手机GNSS观测质量，实现厘米级行人定位。
AI.motivation: 智能手机内置线性极化天线限制导致GNSS观测噪声大、载波相位跟踪不稳定，现有行人定位精度仅达米级，难以满足人行道级导航和高精度位置服务需求。
AI.method: 设计外置GNSS信号再辐射系统，直接连接紧凑有源螺旋天线和薄型无源贴片天线，附着在智能手机上，仍使用手机内置GNSS接收机和天线。该系统旨在增强接收信号强度、降低热噪声、稳定信号跟踪、改善多径鲁棒性并稳定天线相位中心变化。
AI.result: 静态实验证实载波相位观测质量较标准智能手机定位显著提升；行人实验中实现了稳定的载波相位整周模糊度固定，达到厘米级定位精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的GNSS增强器能够利用智能手机实现厘米级定位，为高精度行人导航提供了可行方案。

title: When Cosine Similarity Fails to Reflect Linearly Accessible Structure in Dialogue Models
summary: Cosine similarity is widely used to analyze transformer representations, implicitly assuming that similarity reflects task-relevant structure. We study when this assumption fails in dialogue-conditioned large language models. Across three 7-8B chat-tuned models, ambient cosine similarity substantially underestimates linearly decodable persona structure on the same hidden states; numerically, linear probe AUC is in the 0.73-0.97 range while cosine kNN is in the 0.56-0.77 range on a 30-class task. A low-dimensional supervised subspace recovers much of this gap, whereas a matched-rank PCA subspace does not and in some cases degrades performance. This mismatch is regime-dependent: it is absent in single-sentence sentiment classification (SST-5), and a matched-cardinality control rules out attribute cardinality as a confound. The gap does not systematically increase across dialogue turns, and the task-aligned subspace remains stable over time. However, two of three models violate a pre-registered within-subspace separability invariance criterion (|Delta AUC| <= 0.03), and one model violates a pre-registered turn-invariance criterion (|Delta L| <= 0.05). These results show that cosine similarity can fail to reflect task-aligned structure in dialogue representations even when that structure is linearly accessible.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在对话条件下的大语言模型中，余弦相似度何时无法反映任务相关结构：即使人格特征在隐藏状态中线性可分，余弦相似度仍会显著低估该结构，且这种偏差具有任务/机制依赖性。
AI.motivation: 余弦相似度被广泛用于分析Transformer表示，研究者往往隐含假设相似度能够反映任务相关结构；本文旨在检验这一假设在对话条件下的大语言模型表示中是否成立。
AI.method: 在三个7-8B聊天微调模型上，对同一隐藏状态分别使用线性探针与余弦kNN比较人格结构可解码性；引入低维监督子空间与匹配秩的PCA子空间作对照；在SST-5单句情感分类上做机制依赖性检验，并进行属性基数匹配对照；跨对话轮次考察差距与子空间稳定性，并进行预注册的类内子空间可分性不变性与轮次不变性检验。
AI.result: 在30类任务上，线性探针AUC为0.73-0.97，而余弦kNN仅0.56-0.77，余弦相似度显著低估线性可解码的人格结构；低维监督子空间可弥补大部分差距，而匹配秩PCA不能、有时甚至使性能下降；该不匹配在SST-5上不存在，基数匹配对照排除了属性基数混淆；差距不随对话轮次系统性增大，任务对齐子空间随时间保持稳定；但三个模型中有两个违反预注册的类内子空间可分性不变性判据（|Delta AUC| <= 0.03），一个模型违反轮次不变性判据（|Delta L| <= 0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 在对话表示中，余弦相似度可能无法反映任务对齐结构，即使该结构是线性可访问的；因此仅依赖余弦相似度分析对话LLM表示可能产生误导。

title: Cross-Dialect NER for Bangla Regional Dialects Using Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation and Explainable AI
comment: Accepted for Publication in IEEE 3rd INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON COMPUTING, APPLICATIONS AND SYSTEMS (COMPAS 2026)
summary: Bangla, the seventh most spoken language in the world, exhibits significant regional dialectal diversity, with dialects such as Barishal, Chattogram, Sylhet, Noakhali, and Mymensingh differing in lexical, morphological, and syntactic characteristics. These variations pose substantial challenges for Named Entity Recognition (NER), limiting the generalization of models trained on Standard Bangla or a single regional dialect. This paper presents a cross-dialect Bangla NER framework using the publicly available ANCHOLIK-NER dataset, comprising 17,405 annotated sentences and 101,817 tokens across five major Bangla regional dialects. A Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation (LODOCV) strategy is adopted, training models on four dialects and evaluating on the remaining unseen dialect. Eight pretrained transformer-based models, including BanglaBERT, MuRIL, XLM-RoBERTa, and Multilingual-E5, are evaluated under identical experimental settings. Multilingual-E5 Large achieves the highest F1-score in every fold, peaking at 97.26% on Mymensingh and reaching its lowest, 82.38%, on Chattogram, the most challenging target dialect. To improve interpretability, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) are applied to word-level predictions, revealing that the model's decisions are driven primarily by the surface form of the target entity word itself rather than by surrounding sentence context. These findings establish a benchmark for cross-dialect Bangla NER and demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based transfer learning for low-resource regional dialects, while highlighting the surface-form dependence of current models as a direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨方言孟加拉语命名实体识别框架，基于ANCHOLIK-NER数据集，采用留一方言交叉验证评估八种预训练Transformer模型，并利用LIME分析模型可解释性。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语存在显著的区域方言差异，如Barishal、Chattogram、Sylhet、Noakhali和Mymensingh等方言在词汇、形态和句法上各不相同，这给命名实体识别带来挑战，限制了在标准孟加拉语或单一方言上训练模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: 使用公开的ANCHOLIK-NER数据集，包含五种主要孟加拉语方言的17,405个标注句子和101,817个词元；采用留一方言交叉验证策略，在四种方言上训练并在未见方言上评估；在相同实验设置下评估八种预训练Transformer模型，包括BanglaBERT、MuRIL、XLM-RoBERTa和Multilingual-E5；并应用LIME对词级预测进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: Multilingual-E5 Large在每个折中均取得最高F1分数，在Mymensingh上达到峰值97.26%，在最具挑战性的目标方言Chattogram上最低为82.38%；LIME分析表明，模型决策主要依赖于目标实体词本身的表面形式，而非周围句子上下文。
AI.conclusion: 研究为跨方言孟加拉语NER建立了基准，证明了基于Transformer的迁移学习对低资源区域方言的有效性，同时指出当前模型对表面形式的依赖是未来工作的方向。

title: Unsupervised Brain Anomaly Detection as a Bayesian Inverse Problem with Diffusion Prior
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) aims to localize abnormal regions in medical scans without pixel-level annotations. A typical strategy seeks to reconstruct a pseudo-healthy image that preserves subject-specific anatomy. Recently, diffusion models have been proposed to perform UAD. However, these methods rely on heuristic noise schedules or synthetic corruptions to balance subject-specificity and anomaly removal. In this work, we propose an alternative formulation of UAD as a Bayesian inverse problem under a diffusion prior. First, we introduce a latent spatial anomaly mask that models pixel-wise consistency between a test image and its latent corresponding pseudo-healthy image. Then, we propose an approximation of the unknown generation process that links healthy anatomy, anomalies, and the observed image, enabling a well-defined likelihood within the Bayesian framework. Building on recent advances in diffusion-based inverse problem methods, we jointly infer the pseudo-healthy image and the anomaly mask via annealed posterior sampling. We evaluate our approach on FDG PET (ADNI) and FLAIR MRI (BraTS 2021), demonstrating improved anomaly localization performance compared to other diffusion-based approaches and validating the contribution of our introduced model. Our code is available at https://github.com/HuguesRoy/UAD_DAPS.

AI.tldr: 该论文将无监督医学异常检测（UAD）重新表述为扩散先验下的贝叶斯逆问题，联合推断伪健康图像和潜在异常掩膜。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的UAD方法依赖启发式噪声调度或合成损坏来平衡受试者特异性与异常去除，缺乏原则性。
AI.method: 引入潜在空间异常掩膜来建模测试图像与其伪健康图像之间的像素一致性；提出未知生成过程的近似，将健康解剖、异常和观测图像联系起来，从而在贝叶斯框架内定义似然；利用退火后验采样联合推断伪健康图像和异常掩膜。
AI.result: 在FDG PET（ADNI）和FLAIR MRI（BraTS 2021）上评估，异常定位性能优于其他基于扩散的方法，并验证了所提模型的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 表明将UAD作为扩散先验下的贝叶斯逆问题可提供更原则性的异常检测与定位框架，并取得更好性能。

title: STRIDER: Stepping-Enabled Multi-Gait Hierarchical 3D Loco-Manipulation Framework for Humanoid Robots
comment: 9 pages. Submitted to ICRA 2027. Video: https://youtu.be/gf5RWjCZXtA
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation faces two prominent limitations: controllers using continuous velocity commands cannot precisely regulate individual footholds, while specialized foothold-tracking modules are difficult to integrate with whole-body manipulation. Furthermore, standard action-based imitation distillation primarily transfers expert actions, without explicitly encouraging a shared representation of heterogeneous skills. This paper introduces STRIDER, a hierarchical multi-gait framework to bridge these gaps. The framework integrates terrain-aware 3D stepping logic, Adversarial Motion Priors (AMP)-based natural walking, and Cartesian upper-body control: its stepping expert selects feasible footholds in the stance-foot frame and generates clearance-aware swing trajectories. To fuse distinct walking and stepping experts into one executable student policy, we propose Latent Distillation Proximal Policy Optimization (LD-PPO), a distillation algorithm augmented with teacher-conditioned latent alignment. By jointly optimizing on-policy reinforcement learning, DAgger-based action reconstruction, and latent alignment, LD-PPO transfers expert actions while encouraging a shared skill representation across heterogeneous modes. Simulation and real-robot evaluations on the TianGong Omni humanoid show that LD-PPO outperforms vanilla distillation-PPO in foothold-tracking and posture-tracking accuracy. Deployed on hardware, STRIDER realizes multi-gait loco-manipulation with accurate foothold and end-effector tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRIDER分层多步态框架，用于人形机器人的移动操作，通过地形感知3D落脚点规划、AMP自然行走和Cartesian上半身控制，并结合LD-PPO蒸馏算法融合不同行走与踏步专家策略，实现精确落脚与末端执行器跟踪。
AI.motivation: 现有人形移动操作存在两个问题：连续速度命令控制器难以精确调节单个落脚点，专用落脚点跟踪模块难以与全身操作集成；同时标准动作模仿蒸馏主要迁移专家动作，未显式促进异构技能共享表示。
AI.method: 提出STRIDER框架：集成地形感知3D踏步逻辑、基于Adversarial Motion Priors的自然行走、笛卡尔上半身控制；踏步专家在支撑脚坐标系中选择可行落脚点并生成考虑离地间隙的摆动轨迹。提出LD-PPO蒸馏算法，通过教师条件潜在对齐，联合优化在线强化学习、DAgger动作重建和潜在对齐，将行走与踏步专家融合为可执行学生策略。
AI.result: 在TianGong Omni人形机器人仿真与真机评估中，LD-PPO在落脚点跟踪和姿态跟踪精度上优于普通蒸馏PPO；硬件部署后，STRIDER实现了多步态移动操作，并具备精确的落脚点和末端执行器跟踪能力。
AI.conclusion: STRIDER与LD-PPO能够有效桥接异构专家技能，实现人形机器人多步态移动操作中的精确落脚与全身操作协同，提升跟踪性能并成功部署于真实硬件。

title: Accurate Motion Estimation with Bézier Control Point for Efficient Frame Interpolation
comment: Accepted by IEEE TIP. Code: https://github.com/SHH-Han/ABC-Inter
summary: In frame interpolation tasks, motion ambiguity in the training set causes models to generate blurry intermediate frames. Moreover, the assumption of uniform motion between frames during inference further leads to inaccuracies in the generated intermediate frames. To tackle these challenges, we propose an Accurate motion estimation algorithm with Bézier Control point, ABC-Inter, for efficient frame Interpolation. Specifically, ABC-Inter designs an Accurate Flow estimation Module (AFM) by decoupling two-frame features and mapping to corresponding coordinates to better estimate the optical flow between the two frames. Furthermore, ABC-Inter eliminates motion ambiguity in the training set by introducing Bézier control points that are computed using the input frames and the intermediate ground-truth (gt) frames. This allows the model to estimate accurate optical flow between two frames during the training process, thereby solving the blurriness problem in the generated intermediate frames during inference. Benefiting from the more accurate flow estimation between two frames, we can introduce additional frames and directly use multiple flows to calculate Bézier control points for modeling non-uniform motion without retraining the model. Simultaneously, to realize the estimation of non-linear motion using only two frames, we also introduce a new Bézier control point estimation module which achieves better motion estimation between the two frames by performing fine-tuning on the model in the second stage. Experimental results demonstrate that our ABC-Inter achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmark datasets and exhibits excellent visual perception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ABC-Inter，一种基于贝塞尔控制点的精确运动估计帧插值方法，通过改进光流估计和消除运动模糊，实现高效且高质量的中间帧生成。
AI.motivation: 帧插值训练集中运动模糊会导致模型生成模糊中间帧，且推理阶段假设帧间匀速运动会造成中间帧不准确。
AI.method: 设计精确光流估计模块AFM，解耦两帧特征并映射到对应坐标以更好估计光流；引入由输入帧和中间真值帧计算的贝塞尔控制点，消除训练集运动模糊；利用更准确光流，可引入额外帧并用多光流计算贝塞尔控制点以建模非匀速运动而无需重训练；还提出新的贝塞尔控制点估计模块，通过第二阶段微调仅用两帧估计非线性运动。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上达到最先进性能，并具有优秀的视觉感知效果。
AI.conclusion: ABC-Inter能有效解决运动模糊和非匀速运动问题，提升帧插值的准确性与视觉效果。

title: ScaleBlind: Point Cloud Completion under Unknown Scale
summary: Point cloud completion aims to infer a complete 3D shape from a partial point cloud and serves as a fundamental building block for downstream tasks such as reconstruction, editing, and simulation. Despite the recent progress, existing learning-based methods often implicitly rely on access to the ground-truth shape scale (GT-scale) during both training- and testing-time normalization, assuming privileged information that is unavailable in real-world inference. This hidden assumption limits practical deployment and can lead to severe completion artifacts, e.g., over- or under-completion and nested shells, once the oracle GT-scale cue is removed. We observe that the recent foundation image generation models exhibit a strong capability of understanding objects and geometries, and producing multi-view consistent renderings, making them promising priors for GT-scale-free 3D completion. Motivated by this insight, we propose ScaleBlind, a novel framework that leverages foundation-model-based image completion to recover global scale directly from partial inputs and then faithfully produces the 3D completion. Specifically, ScaleBlind dreams out complete multi-view appearances from rendered partial views, lifts the inferred missing regions back into 3D to obtain a geometry-aware coarse completion, and further refines it via a powerful cross-modal fusion network with the original partial point cloud. By harnessing 2D foundation priors, our method eliminates the need for accessing GT-scale information at inference. Moreover, it provides a principled bridge between 2D generative priors and 3D point cloud completion. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our framework, making ScaleBlind the new state-of-the-art for the point cloud completion task.

AI.tldr: 点云补全旨在从部分点云推断完整3D形状。现有方法隐含依赖真实尺度(GT-scale)进行归一化，限制了实际部署。本文提出ScaleBlind，利用基础图像生成模型从部分输入恢复全局尺度并生成3D补全，无需GT-scale，实验证明达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的点云补全方法在训练和测试归一化中隐含依赖真实形状尺度(GT-scale)，假设了实际推理中不可用的特权信息。这种隐藏假设限制了实际部署，一旦移除GT-scale线索会导致严重补全伪影（如过度/不足补全、嵌套壳）。观察到近期基础图像生成模型具有强大的对象和几何理解能力，并能生成多视图一致渲染，可作为无GT-scale的3D补全先验。
AI.method: 提出ScaleBlind框架，利用基于基础模型的图像补全从部分输入直接恢复全局尺度，然后忠实生成3D补全。具体包括：从渲染的部分视图“幻想”出完整多视图外观，将推断的缺失区域提升回3D得到几何感知的粗补全，再通过强大的跨模态融合网络与原始部分点云进行细化。利用2D基础先验，在推理时无需GT-scale信息。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该框架的优越性，使ScaleBlind成为点云补全任务的新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 该方法消除了推理时对GT-scale信息的需求，并在2D生成先验与3D点云补全之间提供了有原则的桥梁。实验证明其优越性，成为新SOTA。

title: How Many Pixels Is a Digit Worth? Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy for GUI Agent Confidence Estimation
summary: GUI agents predict click coordinates as digit-token sequences, but standard text-LLM confidence estimation methods rank correct clicks from wrong ones only weakly. GUI-specific alternatives use K samples or new supervision, but still leave room for improvement. We trace part of this to place-value asymmetry: bounding-box correctness often makes higher-place digits more important than lower-place digits, so uniform aggregation weakens the signal that determines correctness. The fix is to weight each digit's Shannon entropy by its place value. We call this Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy (PACE). Across fixed-scale agents on ScreenSpot-Pro and ScreenSpot-v2, PACE wins both AUROC and selective accuracy on all primary comparisons in a single forward pass, matching or outperforming K-sample baselines at a fraction of the cost. PACE provides a per-click confidence estimate that turns coordinate-token internals into a practical confidence signal for GUI agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 针对GUI智能体将点击坐标预测为数字token序列的置信度估计问题，提出PACE方法，通过按位值加权数字的Shannon熵，实现单次前向传播的逐点击置信度估计。
AI.motivation: 标准文本LLM置信度估计对GUI点击正确性区分能力弱；GUI专用方法需K次采样或额外监督，效果仍有提升空间。作者发现边界框正确性存在位值不对称，高位数字比低位数字更重要，均匀聚合削弱了决定正确性的信号。
AI.method: 提出Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy (PACE)，对坐标数字token序列中每个数字的Shannon熵按其位值（place value）加权，聚合为逐点击置信度，无需K次采样或额外监督，单次前向传播即可。
AI.result: 在ScreenSpot-Pro和ScreenSpot-v2上，对固定规模智能体，PACE在所有主要比较中AUROC和选择性准确率均胜出，单次前向传播即可匹配或超越K样本基线，且成本仅为后者一小部分。
AI.conclusion: PACE将坐标token内部信息转化为实用的逐点击置信度信号，为GUI智能体部署提供高效可靠的置信度估计方法。

title: Correct Diagnosis, Better Feedback: A Symbolic-Verifier for Faithful LLM Tutoring Feedback in Logic Proofs
summary: Effective LLM tutoring depends on correctly identifying the specific error in a student's reasoning before generating feedback. We study this problem in propositional-logic proof tutoring, where student actions can be checked against formal inference rules. We introduce a verifier-grounded architecture that separates diagnosis from language generation. Using 600 balanced student actions, we compare a zero-shot LLM detector, a fine-tuned detector, and a symbolic verifier. Each diagnosis is processed by shared rationale and feedback agents, isolating the effect of the initial diagnosis. The zero-shot detector achieves a macro-F1 of 0.191; fine-tuning raises this to 0.709 but retains systematic errors between structurally related classes. Rationales generally preserve the diagnosis supplied to them, showing that an incorrect diagnosis can be faithfully propagated through the pipeline. Feedback can likewise remain faithful to its rationale, non-revealing, and pedagogically appropriate while addressing the wrong error. Verifier-grounded feedback achieves the highest diagnostic correctness, and expert ratings largely uneven with the automatic feedback evaluations. These findings show that apparent feedback quality can conceal upstream diagnostic errors and that faithfulness must be evaluated separately from correctness. Our code is publicly available

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM辅导中先诊断学生推理错误再生成反馈的问题。在命题逻辑证明辅导中，提出验证器基座架构，分离诊断与语言生成。使用600个学生动作比较零样本LLM、微调检测器和符号验证器。零样本宏F1为0.191，微调提升至0.709但有系统性错误。理由和反馈能忠实传播诊断，却可能针对错误。验证器基座反馈诊断正确率最高，专家评分与自动评估不一致。表明表面反馈质量可掩盖上游诊断错误，忠实性需与正确性分开评估。
AI.motivation: 有效LLM辅导依赖于在生成反馈前正确识别学生推理中的具体错误。现有方法可能只关注反馈质量而忽视诊断准确性，且错误诊断会被后续理由和反馈忠实传播，导致反馈看似合理却针对错误错误。
AI.method: 在命题逻辑证明辅导中，引入验证器基座架构，将诊断与语言生成分离。使用600个平衡学生动作，比较零样本LLM检测器、微调检测器和符号验证器。每个诊断由共享的理由和反馈代理处理，以隔离初始诊断的影响。
AI.result: 零样本检测器宏F1仅0.191；微调提升至0.709，但在结构相关类别间仍存在系统性错误。理由通常保留输入的诊断，说明错误诊断可被忠实传播。反馈可忠实于理由、非揭示且教学适当，却针对错误错误。验证器基座反馈诊断正确率最高，专家评分与自动反馈评估大多不一致。
AI.conclusion: 表面反馈质量可能掩盖上游诊断错误，因此忠实性必须与正确性分开评估。验证器基座方法在诊断正确性上最优，但自动评估与专家判断存在偏差。代码已公开。

title: Do Student LLMs Inherit OOD Robustness? Invariance-Weighted Distillation for Reliable Knowledge Transfer
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims to compress high-performance teacher LLMs into lightweight students. However, distilled students often exhibit substantial performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, a critical gap that remains underexplored. We identify two compounding mechanisms causing OOD performance degradation: (1) data spuriousness: students can learn spurious correlations in the distillation dataset over genuine causal relationships; and (2) teacher capability: standard KD treats all samples uniformly, ignoring whether the teacher is guided by causal features or misled by spurious shortcuts on a given sample. To address these challenges, we propose Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD), a theoretically grounded framework that dynamically reweights training samples using an estimate of the teacher's causal reliance derived from prediction invariance across multiple synthetic environments. IWD perturbs spurious cues while preserving core semantics, assigning higher distillation weights to samples whose teacher predictions remain invariant, indicating greater reliance on causal rather than spurious features. We theoretically show that IWD reduces the student's Spurious-to-Causal (S2C) gradient ratio compared to standard uniformly weighted KD, driving the student toward more invariant representations. Experiments on four NLP benchmarks (MNLI, SQuAD-v2, CoNLL-2003 NER, and SST-2) across two model families (DeBERTa-v3 and Qwen-2.5) demonstrate that IWD consistently outperforms strong KD baselines on OOD evaluations while maintaining competitive in-distribution (ID) performance. Specifically, IWD achieves the highest accuracy in 15 out of 16 OOD benchmarks and improves average OOD performance over standard KD by 4.34 percentage points on NLI and 14.94 percentage points on QA.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD)，通过根据教师预测在多个合成环境中的不变性动态加权蒸馏样本，缓解知识蒸馏学生在分布外（OOD）场景下的性能下降。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏虽能将强教师LLM压缩为轻量学生，但学生在OOD设置中常显著退化，且该问题未被充分探索。作者识别出两个复合机制：蒸馏数据中的虚假相关会被学生学到；标准KD统一对待样本，忽视教师在具体样本上依赖因果特征还是虚假捷径。
AI.method: 提出IWD框架：基于教师在多种合成环境下的预测不变性估计其因果依赖程度；通过扰动虚假线索同时保留核心语义，对预测更不变的样本赋予更高蒸馏权重。理论上证明IWD相比均匀加权KD能降低学生的Spurious-to-Causal (S2C)梯度比，促使学生学习更不变的表征。
AI.result: 在四个NLP基准（MNLI、SQuAD-v2、CoNLL-2003 NER、SST-2）和两个模型系列（DeBERTa-v3、Qwen-2.5）上，IWD在OOD评估中持续优于强KD基线，同时在ID性能上保持竞争力。IWD在16个OOD基准中的15个取得最高准确率，NLI平均OOD性能较标准KD提升4.34个百分点，QA提升14.94个百分点。
AI.conclusion: IWD通过动态重加权强调教师因果依赖的样本，有效减少学生对虚假相关的依赖，提升OOD泛化能力，同时保持分布内性能，是一种理论上有依据且实验有效的知识蒸馏改进框架。

title: Retrieval Geometry Shapes Cache-Based Clip Adaptation
summary: Cache-based test-time adaptation improves CLIP predictions by storing and retrieving examples from the target stream while keeping the model frozen. However, existing methods largely treat the feature space used for image-image retrieval as fixed, leaving open how much adaptation depends on the retrieval space itself. We study this question by fixing the memory and changing only the retrieval encoder, finding that the same memory can yield very different gains: across sixteen retrieval spaces, ImageNet-A cache gain ranges from at most +0.44 points for CLIP and MAE to +19.7 +/- 0.4 for DINOv2-L, while label-free retrieval-space selection retains 98% of oracle gain on ImageNet-V2. These results show that memory quality depends not only on which examples are stored, but also on how they are retrieved. Motivated by this finding, we propose MARC (Memory Augmented Retrieval for CLIP), a training-free system that uses frozen CLIP for prediction and DINOv2-B for retrieval with a single fusion weight. A single-view cache repairs 1074 +/- 21 baseline errors, compared with 878 +/- 4 for a 64-view ensemble, at roughly one seventh of the cost. Across four ImageNet distribution shifts, MARC reaches a 67.91% OOD average and, at matched DINOv2-B scale and eight views, achieves 64.17 +/- 0.31% versus 62.75 +/- 0.15% for a graph-based cache system while running 2.6 times faster. Overall, our results establish retrieval space as a first-order design choice for robust cache-based adaptation in remote sensing, scientific imaging, and changing visual environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究缓存式测试时适应中检索空间的影响，并提出无需训练的 MARC：用冻结 CLIP 做预测、DINOv2-B 做检索，以单融合权重提升 OOD 鲁棒性并降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有缓存方法通常固定图像-图像检索的特征空间，尚不清楚适应增益在多大程度上依赖检索空间本身。
AI.method: 固定记忆库、仅替换检索编码器，比较 16 种检索空间；提出 MARC，使用冻结 CLIP 预测、DINOv2-B 检索和单一融合权重，并进行单视图缓存、多视图集成及与图缓存系统的对比。
AI.result: ImageNet-A 缓存增益从 CLIP/MAE 的最多 +0.44 到 DINOv2-L 的 +19.7±0.4；无标签检索空间选择在 ImageNet-V2 上保留 98% oracle 增益。MARC 单视图缓存修复 1074±21 个基线错误，优于 64 视图集成的 878±4，成本约其 1/7；四个 ImageNet 分布偏移上 OOD 平均达 67.91%，同 DINOv2-B 规模 8 视图下为 64.17±0.31%，优于图缓存系统的 62.75±0.15%，且快 2.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: 检索空间是鲁棒缓存式适应的首要设计选择，对遥感、科学成像和变化视觉环境中的适应具有重要意义。

title: When and How Should an Agent Clarify? CIGAsk: Teaching LLMs to Clarify via Counterfactual Information Gain
summary: Instruction-tuned LLMs faced with underspecified queries often commit to a single interpretation rather than ask for clarification, producing confidently wrong answers. In our experiments, prompting alone is insufficient: models either ask for clarification on every query or ask vague questions that fail to recover the missing information. Addressing this failure requires learning two coupled skills: when to ask rather than answer and how to ask a question that recovers the disambiguating information. Existing recipes either address only one of these skills or require a separately trained critic. We propose CIGAsk, an RL recipe that teaches both skills through two complementary reward signals within a multi-turn GRPO loop. Counterfactual Information Gain (CIG) compares the gold-answer log-likelihood under a frozen reference model with and without the user response, providing per-turn credit that guides how to ask. The Asymmetric Ambiguity Bonus assigns a signed reward at the terminal token based on the gold ambiguity label, guiding when to ask. Across three clarification benchmarks spanning table, passage, and open-domain QA, CIGAsk-7B outperforms the strongest external baseline despite using a smaller backbone. It also transfers across datasets without per-dataset tuning while preserving single-turn QA performance on out-of-distribution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CIGAsk，一种基于多轮 GRPO 的强化学习训练方法，让指令微调 LLM 同时学会何时请求澄清以及如何提出能获取消歧信息的问题，在多个澄清基准上以 7B 模型超越更强基线并具备跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 指令微调 LLM 面对信息不足的查询时倾向于强行给出单一解释并自信地答错；仅靠提示无法解决，模型要么对每个查询都请求澄清，要么提出无法恢复缺失信息的模糊问题。现有方法通常只解决“何时问”或“如何问”中的一个，或依赖单独训练的 critic。
AI.method: 提出 CIGAsk，在多轮 GRPO 循环中用两个互补奖励信号联合训练两种技能：Counterfactual Information Gain（CIG）通过比较冻结参考模型在有无用户回复时对 gold answer 的对数似然，提供逐轮信用以指导如何提问；Asymmetric Ambiguity Bonus 根据 gold ambiguity label 在终止 token 上给出带符号奖励，以指导何时提问。
AI.result: 在表格、段落和开放域 QA 三个澄清基准上，CIGAsk-7B 尽管使用更小的骨干模型，仍优于最强的外部基线；无需按数据集调参即可跨数据集迁移，并在分布外基准上保持单轮 QA 性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过多轮 RL 与互补奖励设计，可以同时学习澄清决策与提问策略，从而提升 LLM 在欠指定查询下的可靠性，并兼顾泛化与原有单轮问答能力。

title: FeasibleFlow: One-Step Joint Transport of Configuration Feasibility and Trajectories for End-to-End Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving maps current observations directly to future trajectories, yet those trajectories must remain valid as the scene evolves. Future state modeling aims to address this temporal mismatch, but general representations often contain information unrelated to ego planning and affect trajectory generation only through auxiliary supervision, static conditioning, or proposal evaluation. We propose FeasibleFlow, a one-step end-to-end generative framework that jointly transports a configuration-space feasibility field and multimodal ego trajectories. Our Asymmetric Joint MeanFlow uses the pathwise Jacobian-vector product in the MeanFlow identity to incorporate field evolution into trajectory transport. Because safety feedback is sparser than progress feedback, we further introduce the Anchor-relative ranker (ARR) and Pareto-ReinFlow to balance safety and progress in candidate selection and generation, respectively. Experiments on the NAVSIM benchmark demonstrate the strong performance of FeasibleFlow and validate both the joint transport of feasibility and trajectories and the proposed safety-first mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出FeasibleFlow，一种一步式端到端生成框架，联合传输配置空间可行性场和多模态自车轨迹，在NAVSIM基准上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶直接预测轨迹，但需随场景演变保持有效；现有未来状态建模表示常含无关信息，且仅通过辅助监督、静态条件或提案评估影响轨迹生成。
AI.method: FeasibleFlow框架，采用非对称联合MeanFlow，利用路径雅可比-向量积将场演化融入轨迹传输；引入Anchor-relative ranker和Pareto-ReinFlow平衡安全与进度。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM基准上表现强劲，验证了可行性与轨迹的联合传输以及安全优先机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: FeasibleFlow能有效联合建模可行性与轨迹，安全优先机制有助于平衡安全与进度。

title: Brain-Token Learning: Microstate-Based Tokenization and Multi-Scale Interaction for Long-Horizon EEG Sequence Modeling
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive window into dynamic brain activity, yet modeling long-horizon EEG sequences remains challenging due to their high temporal complexity, substantial variability across subjects, and the lack of biologically meaningful sequence representations. Existing tokenization strategies, such as fixed-window and patch-based representations, discretize EEG signals according to artificial temporal boundaries, which may disrupt intrinsic brain-state dynamics. In this work, we propose Brain-Token Learning, a neuroscience-inspired framework that introduces Brain Tokenization for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling. Instead of partitioning EEG signals into predefined temporal segments, Brain Tokenization represents EEG as sequences of recurrent microstate-derived brain tokens, where each token corresponds to a quasi-stable large-scale brain state with variable temporal duration. Based on these biologically grounded tokens, we further develop a multi-scale token interaction module consisting of Latent State Aggregation and State Transition Modeling to jointly capture global brain-state context and local microstate transitions. We evaluate Brain-Token on five heterogeneous EEG datasets, including the newly collected long-horizon NeuroLong dataset and four affective or clinical EEG datasets (SEED, DEAP, MDD, and NSSI). Extensive experiments demonstrate that Brain-Token consistently outperforms conventional CNN/LSTM architectures, Transformer-based models, and domain adaptation methods across diverse EEG scenarios. Further analysis verifies the effectiveness of microstate-based tokenization and multi-scale interaction for learning robust and interpretable EEG representations. These results establish Brain-Token as a biologically grounded tokenization paradigm for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Brain-Token Learning框架，用基于微状态的脑令牌对长时程EEG序列进行建模，并设计多尺度令牌交互模块，在多个EEG数据集上取得优于CNN/LSTM、Transformer和域适应方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 长时程EEG序列建模面临高时间复杂性、跨被试差异大以及缺乏生物意义序列表示等挑战；现有固定窗口或分块令牌化按人工时间边界离散化，可能破坏内在脑状态动态。
AI.method: 提出神经科学启发的Brain Tokenization，将EEG表示为重复出现的微状态衍生脑令牌序列，每个令牌对应可变时长、准稳定的大尺度脑状态；并构建多尺度令牌交互模块，包括潜在状态聚合和状态转移建模，以联合捕捉全局脑状态上下文与局部微状态转换。
AI.result: 在五个异构EEG数据集（新采集的长时程NeuroLong及SEED、DEAP、MDD、NSSI）上，Brain-Token一致优于传统CNN/LSTM、Transformer模型和域适应方法；分析验证了微状态令牌化和多尺度交互对学习鲁棒且可解释EEG表示的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明Brain-Token是一种面向长时程EEG序列建模的、具有生物学基础的令牌化范式。

title: LADDER: Graph-Guided Diffusion Language Models for Efficient Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) has remarkably enhanced large language models on complex reasoning by leveraging structured entity topologies. However, existing frameworks heavily rely on standard autoregressive language models where the nature of inherent sequential generation severely hinders overall inference efficiency. Inspired by Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) that offer massive parallelism via continuous refine-in-parallel decoding, we aim to accelerate GraphRAG in the discrete space. However, it remains non-trivial for two challenges. First, partially denoised drafts are highly dynamic and uncertain, making dynamic graph grounding non-trivial. Second, raw denoising states are inherently noisy and unstable, making synchronous graph retrieval and multi-hop aggregation computationally prohibitive. To this end, we present LADDER, a novel framework that bridges diffusion language modeling with GraphRAG through graph-guided parallel decoding. Specifically, (i) we propose an event-driven self-clocking retrieval, inspired by our key insight that 88% of target entities emerge early in the partially denoised state, leading final commitment by an average of 5.7-9.6 steps. This mechanism dynamically triggers graph retrieval only when the set of graph-linkable entities expands, yielding an asynchronous self-clocking policy that bypasses learned gates or heuristic thresholds. (ii) An incomplete-query graph propagation module is designed to process the newly emerging entity queries using a specialized graph foundation model, continuously aggregating multi-hop evidence to sharpen parallel predictions and accelerate overall decoding convergence. Extensive experiments on three challenging multi-hop QA benchmarks show that LADDER raises average exact match from 39.6% to 45.2% while achieving a 4.1x latency reduction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LADDER 框架，将扩散语言模型与 GraphRAG 结合，通过图引导的并行解码加速多跳问答，在提升准确率的同时显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有 GraphRAG 依赖标准自回归语言模型，其顺序生成特性严重限制推理效率；扩散语言模型虽可并行解码，但直接用于 GraphRAG 面临部分去噪草稿动态不确定、原始去噪状态噪声大导致动态图接地与多跳聚合困难等挑战。
AI.method: LADDER 包含两个核心机制：(i) 事件驱动的自时钟检索，基于目标实体在部分去噪状态早期出现的洞察，仅在可链接图实体集合扩展时动态触发图检索，避免学习门控或启发式阈值；(ii) 不完整查询图传播模块，利用专用图基础模型处理新出现的实体查询，持续聚合多跳证据以锐化并行预测并加速解码收敛。
AI.result: 在三个具有挑战性的多跳问答基准上，LADDER 将平均精确匹配率从 39.6% 提升至 45.2%，同时实现 4.1 倍延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: LADDER 通过图引导并行解码有效桥接扩散语言模型与 GraphRAG，在离散空间中实现更高效且更准确的多跳推理。

title: Preserving What Matters: Semantic Scaffolds Beyond Saturation in Summarization Evaluation
comment: Accepted at the AIMS Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: Summarization ships in countless production systems, making model selection a routine decision that depends on measuring summary quality. Existing metrics struggle to support this: ROUGE captures only surface overlap, while LLM-as-judge scores saturate to near-identical values that fail to rank models effectively. We observe this saturation across three public datasets, two proprietary datasets, and multilingual settings. Motivated by this, we introduce Semantic Scaffold, an evaluation framework that extracts a hierarchical representation of facts, questions, and entity attributes from a source text, labeling each as a main point or supporting detail, and reusing this structure as a fixed reference for scoring summaries. From this representation, we derive three diagnostic metrics: Fact Preservation Score (FPS), Question Preservation Score (QPS), and Entity Preservation Score (EPS), designed to reward the preservation of essential information while penalizing detail overload, and position them as interpretable diagnostics that remain informative where holistic axes collapse. Finally, we analyze four recurring failure modes of ROUGE and LLM-as-judge scores, demonstrating that scaffold-based evaluation remains informative where conventional metrics collapse.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Semantic Scaffold 摘要评估框架，通过从源文本抽取事实、问题和实体属性的层次化表示，并生成 FPS、QPS、EPS 三个诊断指标，以缓解 ROUGE 和 LLM-as-judge 在摘要模型选择中的局限与饱和问题。
AI.motivation: 现有摘要评估指标难以支持模型选择：ROUGE 仅衡量表层重叠，LLM-as-judge 分数容易饱和到近乎相同的值，无法有效排序模型；这种饱和现象在多个公开数据集、专有数据集和多语言设置中均存在。
AI.method: 提出 Semantic Scaffold 评估框架，从源文本中抽取由事实、问题和实体属性构成的分层表示，并将每个要素标注为主要观点或支撑细节，再将该结构作为固定参考来评分。基于此得到三个诊断指标：Fact Preservation Score (FPS)、Question Preservation Score (QPS) 和 Entity Preservation Score (EPS)，用于奖励关键信息保留并惩罚细节过载。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集、两个专有数据集和多语言设置中观察到 ROUGE 与 LLM-as-judge 的饱和问题；分析并总结其四类反复出现的失败模式，表明基于 scaffold 的评估在传统指标失效时仍具信息量。
AI.conclusion: Semantic Scaffold 及其 FPS、QPS、EPS 可作为可解释的诊断指标，在整体性评估轴崩溃或传统指标失效的场景下仍能提供有效信息，从而更好支持摘要模型选择。

title: Cognitive Action Reasoning for Proactive Robots from Human-Centered Multimodal Observations
summary: Robots operating in human-centered environments are typically designed to execute explicit instructions, and most robot-learning datasets likewise pair observations with task instructions or low-level actions. Although recent work has begun to explore proactive embodied assistance, existing resources target different settings and action levels, leaving real-world human-centered multimodal decision-making underexplored. We formulate this problem as \textit{Proactive Robot Action Reasoning} (\textit{ProRobo}), an upstream cognitive decision problem in which a robot must determine which action to take based on multimodal human and environmental cues without explicit action instructions. To support ProRobo, we introduce \textit{ProAction}, a real-world multimodal dataset containing 10K samples of visual observations, audio signals, and text inputs across 12 daily-life scenarios in five common scenes. To construct cognitively grounded high-level action supervision, we develop a two-stage human-in-the-loop pipeline that combines appraisal-guided candidate generation with Affective Theory-of-Mind-guided human refinement, explicitly incorporating contextual judgment about human states, urgency, feasibility, and potential risk into action annotation. Based on this supervision, we benchmark representative Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and introduce \textit{MMC2Act}, a reference model that implicitly learns the mapping from multimodal observations to cognitively grounded high-level actions. Experiments across modality settings, subject-disjoint generalization, cross-dataset transfer, and human evaluation show that general-purpose MLLMs struggle with proactively reasoning high-level actions from multimodal cues, whereas training on \textit{ProAction} substantially improves performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出主动机器人动作推理（ProRobo）问题，并构建真实世界多模态数据集ProAction（10K样本，涵盖12个日常场景），通过两阶段人在环标注流程生成认知基础的高层动作监督。基于此对MLLMs进行基准测试，并提出参考模型MMC2Act，实验表明通用MLLMs难以主动推理高层动作，而基于ProAction训练能显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人通常执行明确指令，多数机器人学习数据集将观察与任务指令或低级动作配对。尽管近期开始探索主动具身辅助，但现有资源针对不同设置和动作级别，真实世界人类中心的多模态决策仍未被充分探索。因此需要研究机器人如何在没有明确动作指令的情况下，基于多模态人类和环境线索决定采取何种行动。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为主动机器人动作推理（ProRobo）。构建ProAction数据集，包含10K样本的视觉、音频和文本输入，覆盖5个常见场景中的12个日常场景。采用两阶段人在环标注流程：评价引导的候选生成与情感心理理论引导的人类精炼，融入对人类状态、紧急程度、可行性和潜在风险的上下文判断。基于该监督对代表性MLLMs进行基准测试，并提出参考模型MMC2Act，隐式学习从多模态观察到认知基础高层动作的映射。
AI.result: 在多种模态设置、主体分离泛化、跨数据集迁移和人类评估实验中，通用MLLMs难以从多模态线索主动推理高层动作，而在ProAction上训练可显著提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 通用MLLMs在主动高层动作推理方面存在不足，而ProAction数据集提供的认知基础高层动作监督能有效改善模型性能，突显了该数据集和ProRobo问题的重要性。

title: Elevator-VIGS: Separating Elevator Motion from Robot Motion in Visual-Inertial Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary: We present Elevator-VIGS, a visual-inertial 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM system that keeps tracking and mapping through elevator rides. Inside a moving elevator, the two sensors are in conflict. The camera sees only the robot's motion relative to the elevator, while the IMU senses that motion plus the elevator's motion relative to the world. This conflict is challenging for existing visual-inertial estimators. If vision dominates, the estimator tracks only the robot's motion within the elevator and misses the elevator's rise, and if the conflict remains, the estimator diverges. We observe that the conflict comes from forcing both observations into a single coordinate frame. We instead estimate the robot's pose in the elevator's coordinate frame, and the elevator's motion relative to the world as a per-keyframe transport state, the elevator's rise and vertical velocity, within dense visual-inertial bundle adjustment. Elevator-VIGS detects rides zero-shot with a vision-language model and a depth network, and constrains the transport state at the departure and the arrival. We record real-world and simulated elevator sequences. On these sequences, Elevator-VIGS achieves state-of-the-art tracking and rendering performance. On four elevator-free public benchmarks it keeps the state-of-the-art performance of VIGS-SLAM. Project page: https://ruizhou-cn.github.io/elevator-vigs/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Elevator-VIGS——一种可在电梯运行期间持续跟踪与建图的视觉惯性 3D 高斯泼溅 SLAM 系统。
AI.motivation: 电梯内相机仅观测机器人相对电梯的运动，而 IMU 观测到该运动与电梯相对世界运动的叠加，二者冲突。现有视觉惯性估计器若以视觉为主会忽略电梯上升，若冲突持续则导致发散；其根源是强制将两种观测置于同一坐标系。
AI.method: 在电梯坐标系下估计机器人位姿，并将电梯相对世界的运动建模为每关键帧的传输状态（电梯上升量与垂直速度），在稠密视觉惯性光束法平差中联合优化；利用视觉语言模型与深度网络零样本检测乘梯过程，并在出发与到达时对传输状态施加约束。
AI.result: 在真实与仿真电梯序列上取得最优的跟踪与渲染性能；在四个无电梯公开基准上保持 VIGS-SLAM 的最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离机器人与电梯坐标系可化解视觉-惯性冲突，实现电梯场景下鲁棒的视觉惯性 SLAM，同时不影响一般场景性能。

title: Few-Shot Demonstrations Elicit the Use of In-Context World Representations in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs), when acting as agents, are expected to take observed data in context, infer the latent state space underlying the world, and leverage it for downstream prediction. However, prior work demonstrated that LLMs struggle to use representations learned in context on a graph tracking task, where the model needs to construct a representation of the graph governing data generation process and use it for subsequent predictions. In this paper, we show that extending this to few-shot settings, where each demonstration is generated from a different world with either the same or different graph topologies, enhances its prediction on 6 models from 4 model families. To understand this improvement, we linearly probe a low-dimensional world representation that encodes graph information in the hidden states. Notably, we find that few-shot demonstrations relocate the world representation and increase its predictive use. Specifically, for each model, these world representations shift in directions nearly orthogonal to their original subspace, and interventions on these representations selectively impair performance more than interventions on other subspaces. Consistent with this insight, we show that few-shot demonstrations with observations from different worlds improve performance on ARC-AGI-1&2, web agent tasks, and Othello. Our findings elucidate the role and internal mechanisms of few-shot demonstrations in in-context world modeling. More broadly, our work advances our understanding of how LLM agents learn from in-context observations and provides implications for their further improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM作为智能体时的上下文世界建模能力，发现少量示例（few-shot）能显著提升图跟踪任务预测，并揭示其通过改变隐藏状态中的世界表示来发挥作用。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明，LLM在需要从上下文中推断潜在状态空间并用于后续预测的图跟踪任务上表现不佳，因此作者希望探究few-shot演示是否能改善这种世界建模能力及其内部机制。
AI.method: 在6个模型、4个模型家族上测试few-shot设置，其中每个演示来自不同世界，图拓扑可相同或不同；通过线性探针分析隐藏状态中的低维世界表示，并进行表示干预实验；同时在ARC-AGI-1&2、网页智能体任务和Othello上验证。
AI.result: few-shot演示提升了所有测试模型的预测表现；它使世界表示发生迁移，且迁移方向几乎与原子空间正交，并增强该表示的预测用途；对这些表示进行干预会比干预其他子空间更显著地损害性能；来自不同世界的few-shot观察还能提升ARC-AGI-1&2、网页智能体任务和Othello表现。
AI.conclusion: few-shot演示在上下文世界建模中具有关键作用，其机制是重新定位并增强隐藏状态中的世界表示；这加深了对LLM智能体如何从上下文观察中学习的理解，并为其改进提供了启示。

title: Semi-automated reconstruction of indoor geometry from 360-degree video for CFD-based airflow analysis in classrooms
summary: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is widely used to evaluate ventilation and contaminant transport in occupied buildings, but deployment at scale is limited by three bottlenecks: acquiring room geometry without costly scanning hardware or manual CAD modeling, decomposing the scene into individually manipulable objects, and reconfiguring those objects for alternative layouts without re-capturing the room. We present a semi-automated workflow that converts a single 360-degree video of a room into individually editable, simulation-ready geometry assets. A dense point cloud is reconstructed using Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), and 2D instance masks from text-prompted SAM 3 segmentation are lifted to 3D using multi-view consensus and depth-band filtering. Points are separated into object instances with an octree, and occlusion gaps are healed with a connectivity graph. Chair templates are fitted by Iterative Closest Point (ICP) alignment, and table geometry is generated procedurally. A browser-based editor supports quality assurance and rapid construction of alternative layout configurations. A steady Reynolds-averaged OpenFOAM solution then drives transient passive-scalar transport; the setup is verified using a mesh-sensitivity study and validated against an IEA Annex 20 benchmark. We apply the workflow to two university classrooms and a tiered lecture-hall auditorium. The capture-to-geometry pass takes two to five hours per room on a consumer workstation. In a controlled obstruction sequence in one classroom, the modeled half-clearance time varies non-monotonically as furniture is added, and a cross-room comparison indicates that clearance behavior cannot be reliably extrapolated between rooms, motivating per-room geometry acquisition. By making that acquisition low-cost, the workflow makes geometry-resolved comparative ventilation studies practical for spaces such as classrooms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种半自动化工作流，可将房间的单张360度视频转换为可单独编辑、可直接用于仿真的几何资产，并应用于教室通风研究，大幅降低几何获取成本。
AI.motivation: CFD广泛用于评估建筑通风和污染物输运，但大规模部署受限于三个瓶颈：无需昂贵扫描或手动CAD即可获取房间几何、将场景分解为可操作对象、以及在不重新采集房间的情况下重配置对象以形成替代布局。
AI.method: 使用NeRF重建稠密点云；用文本提示的SAM 3分割生成2D实例掩码，并通过多视图一致性和深度带滤波提升到3D；用八叉树分离物体实例，用连通图修补遮挡间隙；用ICP拟合椅子模板，程序化生成桌子几何；浏览器编辑器支持质量保证和替代布局构建；用稳态RANS OpenFOAM求解驱动瞬态被动标量输运，并通过网格敏感性研究和IEA Annex 20基准验证。
AI.result: 工作流应用于两个大学教室和一个阶梯报告厅。单房间从采集到几何生成在消费级工作站上耗时2-5小时。在一个教室的受控障碍序列中，模拟的半清除时间随家具增加呈非单调变化；跨房间比较表明清除行为无法可靠外推，因此需要逐房间获取几何。
AI.conclusion: 通过使几何获取低成本，该工作流使教室等空间的几何分辨比较通风研究变得实用。

title: RSPDBench: Benchmarking Vision Foundation Models on Earth Observation Tasks Under Physically Grounded Remote-Sensing Product Degradations
summary: Vision foundation models targeting Earth observation (EO) tasks are commonly evaluated on clean downstream benchmarks, but operational EO products can already contain spatial, radiometric, alignment, noise, and harmonization defects before reaching the model. Existing robustness evaluations often use generic image corruptions or broad domain shifts, which do not isolate these product-level failure modes. We introduce \textbf{RSPDBench}, a physically grounded \textbf{r}emote-\textbf{s}ensing-\textbf{p}roduct \textbf{d}egradation \textbf{b}enchmark for vision foundation models. RSPDBench evaluates five EO datasets, seven foundation-model entries, and two supervised baselines under audited primitive degradations and compound product chains. Each model is evaluated under its clean-selected native protocol, with robustness measured as the drop from its own clean baseline. Our analysis reveals that degradation sensitivity is strongly structured: resolution-conditioned and channel-grouped encoders protect different failure axes, and the same physical defect can hurt one model while helping another. Compound chains expose failures that isolated degradations do not predict, with model-dependent amplification, saturation, or component dominance, and excess drops up to $38$ percentage points beyond the strongest component. These results show that EO robustness cannot be characterized by clean accuracy or generic perturbation tests alone; it must also be measured against the structured defects that remote-sensing products carry into deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RSPDBench，一个针对视觉基础模型的物理接地遥感产品退化基准，用于评估模型在真实遥感产品缺陷下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感视觉基础模型的鲁棒性评估多使用通用图像损坏或宽泛域偏移，无法隔离遥感产品级别的失效模式，而实际遥感产品在到达模型前已包含空间、辐射、对齐、噪声和协调等缺陷。
AI.method: 构建RSPDBench基准，包含五种遥感数据集、七个基础模型条目和两个监督基线，在审计的原始退化和复合产品链下评估。每个模型在其清洁选择的原生协议下评估，鲁棒性以相对于自身清洁基线的下降衡量。
AI.result: 退化敏感性具有强结构性：分辨率条件和通道分组编码器保护不同的失效轴，同一物理缺陷可能损害一个模型而帮助另一个。复合链暴露了孤立退化无法预测的失效，具有模型依赖的放大、饱和或组件主导，超额下降高达38个百分点，超过最强组件。
AI.conclusion: 遥感鲁棒性不能仅通过清洁准确率或通用扰动测试来表征，还必须针对遥感产品带入部署的结构化缺陷进行测量。

title: VLM-in-Sandbox: Visual Workspaces for Agentic Visual Reasoning
summary: Sandboxed computer environments support multi-step reasoning with tools, executable programs, and persistent files, yet their extension from language models to vision-language models (VLMs) introduces a distinct state-management problem. Visual reasoning produces intermediate image-valued evidence---crops, masks, overlays, zoomed regions, and analytic renderings---that must remain addressable without accumulating unboundedly in multimodal context. We introduce VLM-in-Sandbox, a training-free framework for agentic multimodal reasoning in controlled computer environments. Its Visual Workspace registers generated artifacts in an image ledger, maintains a bounded active visual context, and lets the model explicitly promote selected evidence for subsequent inspection. This separates visual evidence generation, performed by sandbox tools, from visual evidence management. Across seven benchmarks and four base VLMs, VLM-in-Sandbox achieves the highest sample-weighted average accuracy among Vanilla VLM, Append-only Sandbox, and the proposed method. A compiler-matched $2\times2$ study on 1,260 examples further separates model-directed visibility from bounded retention: VLM-in-Sandbox reaches 66.27% accuracy with 18.6% fewer total tokens than the automatic, retain-all control. Over all 6,350 submitted GPT-4.1-mini examples, it produces 302 rescues and 142 regressions relative to Original Append-only. A local vLLM study with prefix caching confirms that the smaller request workload also reduces uncached tokens, time to first token, and end-to-end latency. These results identify explicit visual evidence state as a central abstraction for sandboxed VLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VLM-in-Sandbox，一种无需训练的框架，用于在沙箱式计算机环境中进行多模态智能体推理。其核心是 Visual Workspace，通过图像账本、有界活跃视觉上下文和显式证据提升机制，管理视觉推理产生的裁剪、掩码、叠加图等中间图像证据，避免多模态上下文无界增长。
AI.motivation: 现有沙箱环境支持语言模型的多步工具推理，但扩展到视觉语言模型时，视觉推理会产生大量图像形式的中间证据，如裁剪、掩码、叠加和缩放区域。这些证据需要保持可访问，又不能无限累积到多模态上下文中，因此带来独特的状态管理问题。
AI.method: 提出 VLM-in-Sandbox 训练无关框架。其 Visual Workspace 将生成的视觉产物注册到图像账本中，维护有界的活跃视觉上下文，并允许模型显式提升选定证据以供后续检查。该方法将视觉证据生成（由沙箱工具完成）与视觉证据管理分离。实验覆盖七个基准和四个基础 VLM，并进行编译器匹配的 2×2 研究、GPT-4.1-mini 示例分析及本地 vLLM 前缀缓存测试。
