title: AlexandriaX 2026: The First Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation
comment: To Appear in ArabicNLP 2026, resources available in the following project page: https://alexandriax.dlnlp.ai
summary: Dialectal Arabic machine translation (MT) remains challenging despite recent progress in Arabic language technologies, particularly because effective translation requires modeling not only semantic content but also dialectal variation, conversational context, speaker and addressee characteristics, and sociolinguistic appropriateness. Moreover, conventional MT metrics provide limited insight into the linguistic errors produced by dialectal systems. We present the AlexandriaX 2026 Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic MT, which addresses these challenges through three complementary subtasks: (1) context-aware English-to-Dialectal Arabic dialogue translation across 13 Arabic varieties, (2) cross-dialect Arabic translation in the financial domain covering six Arabic dialects, and (3) span-level MT error detection and classification using linguistically motivated error categories across five Arabic varieties. The shared task attracted 38 registrations for Subtask 1, 33 for Subtask 2, and 35 for Subtask 3. Twelve unique teams submitted their system description papers, all of which we accepted for publication. The best system on Subtask 1 achieved 30.42 spBLEU in the constrained track and 33.49 spBLEU in the unconstrained track. On Subtask 2, the top system obtained 28.40 spBLEU. On Subtask 3, the best system achieved an overall score of 49.82, outperforming the 24.29 baseline. Taken together, the results of the leading systems across the three subtasks highlight the benefits of explicit dialect modeling, context-aware generation, retrieval and reranking, and specialized approaches to interpretable MT error analysis. All the resources of AlexandriaX 2026 shared task are publicly available, including data, baselines, and evaluation code on our project page: https://alexandriax.dlnlp.ai.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 AlexandriaX 2026 方言阿拉伯语机器翻译共享任务，包含三个子任务：面向13种阿拉伯方言的上下文感知英译方言阿语对话翻译、金融领域六种方言间的跨方言翻译，以及五种方言上的片段级机器翻译错误检测与分类。
AI.motivation: 方言阿拉伯语机器翻译仍具挑战，因为翻译不仅需要建模语义，还需处理方言变异、会话上下文、说话人与受话人特征及社会语言学适切性；同时，传统机器翻译指标难以揭示方言系统产生的具体语言错误。
AI.method: 该共享任务设置三个互补子任务：1）上下文感知的英语到方言阿拉伯语对话翻译，覆盖13种阿拉伯变体；2）金融领域跨方言阿拉伯语翻译，覆盖6种方言；3）基于语言学错误类别的片段级机器翻译错误检测与分类，覆盖5种阿拉伯变体。任务共收到子任务1、2、3分别38、33、35个注册，12个团队提交系统描述论文并全部录用。
AI.result: 子任务1最佳系统在受限赛道达到30.42 spBLEU，在非受限赛道达到33.49 spBLEU；子任务2最佳系统达到28.40 spBLEU；子任务3最佳系统总体得分为49.82，显著优于24.29的基线。
AI.conclusion: 三个子任务领先系统的结果表明，显式方言建模、上下文感知生成、检索与重排序，以及面向可解释机器翻译错误分析的专业方法均能带来收益。AlexandriaX 2026共享任务的数据、基线和评估代码等资源已公开。

title: To Consolidate or not to Consolidate? Evaluating the Impact of Consolidation in Multi-Reference Training using Peer Reviews
summary: Natural language generation (NLG) tasks span the spectrum of conditional entropy, ranging from highly constrained machine translation to open-ended dialogue generation. Structured tasks like automated peer-review generation occupy the intermediate region, where a single input admits multiple valid, overlapping outputs. In this work, we demonstrate that traditional single- and multi-reference training paradigms are suboptimal for these intermediary tasks. We provide empirical evidence that consolidating diverse references into a unified training signal is crucial for developing effective systems. To facilitate this, we introduce MERC-36K, a large-scale corpus of over 36,000 papers paired with original and consolidated peer reviews. Using this dataset, we train specific architectures to isolate the impact of different reference paradigms and benchmark against existing state-of-the-art systems. Through extensive automatic and human evaluation, we demonstrate that models trained on consolidated references significantly outperform those trained on unconsolidated references. Dataset and code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动同行评审生成这类具有多个有效且重叠输出的中间型自然语言生成任务，提出将多样参考合并为统一训练信号，并发布MERC-36K数据集；实验表明基于合并参考训练的模型显著优于基于未合并参考的模型。
AI.motivation: 传统单参考和多参考训练范式对于条件熵处于中间区域的任务（如自动同行评审生成）并非最优，因为一个输入可对应多个有效且重叠的输出；因此需要探索如何整合多样参考以形成统一训练信号。
AI.method: 构建MERC-36K大规模语料库，包含超过36,000篇论文及其原始与合并后的同行评审；使用该数据集训练特定架构以隔离不同参考范式的影响，并与现有最先进系统进行基准比较；通过自动评估和人工评估验证效果。
AI.result: 在合并参考上训练的模型显著优于在未合并参考上训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 对于自动同行评审生成等中间型自然语言生成任务，将多样参考整合为统一训练信号至关重要；数据集和代码将在论文被接收后发布。

title: TimeLitmus: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Cross-Modal Understanding and Explanation Faithfulness in Event-Conditioned Time-Series Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make predictions from numerical time-series histories and textual events. Yet accuracy alone cannot reveal whether correct answers reflect effective integration of the two inputs or instead arise from event polarity, unimodal priors, or superficial cues. Likewise, plausible explanations may rationalize predictions without faithfully reflecting the evidence that drives model behavior. We introduce TimeLitmus, a diagnostic benchmark for cross-modal understanding and explanation faithfulness in event-conditioned time-series prediction. TimeLitmus contains 4,856 evaluation records across Finance and Traffic, combining natural prediction with controlled counterfactual and contrastive interventions, explanation-targeted faithfulness tests, and systematic shortcut controls. Across ten representative LLMs, standard prediction accuracy substantially overstates reliable cross-modal understanding: Hard Paired Contrast (HPC) pair correctness peaks at only 19.2% in Finance and 11.7% in Traffic, and all ten models show lower-than-expected consistency on Finance series-side controls. Models often recognize scenario relations explicitly yet fail to apply them during independent prediction. Explanation faithfulness shows a similar gap: in Traffic, most models cite the manipulated temporal factor in over 90% of cases, while behavioral support remains below 22%. Human annotators outperform LLMs on matched controlled and hard-pair diagnostics, confirming that these distinctions are recoverable from the inputs. Natural-only adaptation yields selective gains in evidence selection and input sensitivity, but not consistent gains in controlled or hard-pair behavior. The benchmark, evaluation suite, and supervised adaptation data will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出TimeLitmus诊断基准，用于评估大语言模型在事件条件时间序列预测中的跨模态理解与解释忠实性，发现标准准确率严重高估了模型的真实能力。
AI.motivation: 仅凭预测准确率无法判断模型是否正确整合了数值时间序列与文本事件，还是依赖事件极性、单模态先验或表面线索；同时模型给出的合理解释可能只是合理化预测，并未忠实反映证据。因此需要一个能区分真实跨模态理解与捷径行为的诊断基准。
AI.method: 构建TimeLitmus基准，包含Finance和Traffic两个领域的4,856条评估记录，结合自然预测、受控反事实与对比干预、面向解释的忠实性测试以及系统性捷径控制；对10个代表性LLM进行评估，并引入人类标注者和自然数据适应实验。
AI.result: 标准预测准确率显著高估了可靠跨模态理解：Hard Paired Contrast配对正确率在Finance最高仅19.2%、Traffic仅11.7%；十个模型在Finance序列侧控制上一致性均低于预期。模型常能显式识别场景关系，却在独立预测中无法应用。解释忠实性同样存在差距：Traffic中多数模型在超90%的情况下提及被操纵的时间因素，但行为支持率低于22%。人类标注者在匹配的受控和困难配对诊断上优于LLM。仅用自然数据适应只在证据选择和输入敏感性上带来选择性提升，未在受控或困难配对行为上取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: TimeLitmus表明，高准确率不等于真正的跨模态理解与忠实的解释；模型在受控和困难配对场景下存在显著短板，且解释与行为脱节。该基准、评估套件和监督适应数据将公开发布，以推动更可靠的诊断与改进。

title: FlockDiffusion: Assignment-Conditioned Diffusion for Multi-Drone Task Allocation and Completion
summary: Autonomous multi-drone navigation requires fleets to service distributed objectives in cluttered environments under tight computational budgets. Efficient coordination depends on task bundling, where each drone visits multiple objectives along its route. Separate solvers for cost estimation, assignment, and execution incur redundant graph search and produce long, abrupt paths. We propose FlockDiffusion, a learned framework combining a scene graph encoder, an explicit allocation head, an assignment conditioned diffusion transformer, and a closed form trajectory decoder. An autoregressive teacher provides offline supervision for parallel fleet trajectory generation. PyBullet ablations show that bundling increases task completion from 50% to 100%, while our complete teacher further reduces route cost by 8.4% relative to MAGNNET with bundling. In the optimized scalability benchmark, evaluated on 100 scenes per density with ten drones, FlockDiffusion achieves 6.2 to 7.6 times faster inference and approximately 37% shorter routes than the classical pipeline. As nominal task counts increase from 20 to 40, latency rises from 7.8 to 11.1 ms, compared with 48.0 to 75.8 ms for the baseline. In a separate evaluation across five Gazebo environments, FlockDiffusion achieves 100% planner coverage and reduces planned route cost by 15.4% relative to the baseline with bundling. These results demonstrate efficient planning under increasing task density in configurations that are demanding to reproduce with physical drone fleets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlockDiffusion，一种用于多无人机自主导航的学习型规划框架，通过任务捆绑和扩散模型实现高效协同路径生成，并在仿真中显著提升任务完成率、缩短路径并降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 多无人机在复杂环境中服务分布式目标时，计算预算紧张，传统将成本估计、任务分配和执行分开求解的方法会导致冗余图搜索以及路径冗长、突变，因此需要一种高效的联合规划框架。
AI.method: FlockDiffusion 结合场景图编码器、显式分配头、分配条件扩散 Transformer 和闭式轨迹解码器，并使用自回归教师模型提供离线监督，以并行生成舰队轨迹。
AI.result: PyBullet 消融显示，任务捆绑将任务完成率从 50% 提升到 100%，完整教师模型相比带捆绑的 MAGNNET 降低路线成本 8.4%。在每密度 100 个场景、10 架无人机的可扩展性基准中，推理速度比经典流程快 6.2 至 7.6 倍，路径缩短约 37%；任务数从 20 增至 40 时，延迟从 7.8 升至 11.1 ms，而基线为 48.0 至 75.8 ms。在五个 Gazebo 环境中，规划器覆盖率达 100%，规划路线成本比带捆绑基线降低 15.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，FlockDiffusion 能在任务密度增加时保持高效规划，并适用于难以用物理无人机集群复现的配置。

title: Towards robust multimodal 3D object detection via visual foundation models
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures. Bilingual English-Chinese manuscript; the complete English version appears first, followed by the complete Chinese version
summary: Multimodal 3D object detection is fundamental to robust perception in autonomous driving because it integrates complementary information from LiDAR and camera sensors. However, existing methods often fail to maintain robustness under out-of-distribution (OOD) corruptions caused by sensor noise, adverse weather, and environmental changes. To address this problem, we propose RoboDistill, a robust and generalizable multimodal 3D object detection framework that leverages visual foundation models (VFMs), such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM). First, we introduce SAM-AD, a domain-specific pretraining strategy that fine-tunes SAM on autonomous-driving imagery to extract feature representations with rich semantic information. Second, we design the AD Feature Pyramid Network (AD-FPN) to refine and upsample SAM features at multiple scales for seamless fusion with LiDAR features. Third, we develop the Depth-Guided Wavelet Attention (DGWA) module, which suppresses high-frequency sensor noise while preserving critical contextual information. Finally, we introduce KD Fusion, in which the pretrained SAM-AD serves as a teacher that distills high-quality visual knowledge into a lightweight point-cloud network, thereby improving robustness under noisy conditions. Extensive experiments across 27 challenging OOD corruption settings show that RoboDistill generally delivers stronger or competitive detection performance and robustness relative to representative state-of-the-art methods. This work bridges the gap between VFMs and 3D object detection and advances robust multimodal perception for real-world autonomous-driving applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboDistill，一个利用视觉基础模型（如SAM）的鲁棒且可泛化的多模态3D目标检测框架，旨在提升自动驾驶在OOD损坏下的感知鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态3D目标检测方法在传感器噪声、恶劣天气和环境变化引起的分布外（OOD）损坏下往往难以保持鲁棒性，因此需要更鲁棒、可泛化的检测框架。
AI.method: 提出RoboDistill框架：1）SAM-AD，在自动驾驶图像上微调SAM以提取丰富语义特征；2）AD-FPN，多尺度细化并上采样SAM特征，以便与LiDAR特征融合；3）DGWA，深度引导小波注意力模块，抑制高频传感器噪声并保留上下文信息；4）KD Fusion，以预训练SAM-AD为教师，将高质量视觉知识蒸馏到轻量点云网络，提升噪声条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在27种具有挑战性的OOD损坏设置下进行大量实验，RoboDistill相较代表性SOTA方法通常取得更强或具有竞争力的检测性能与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了视觉基础模型与3D目标检测之间的差距，推动了面向真实自动驾驶应用的鲁棒多模态感知。

title: UniPoint: Unified Point-Level Sensor Fusion for Humanoid Locomotion Across Challenging Terrains
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Video: https://youtu.be/Rd9YyfOxvmY
summary: Open-world deployment requires humanoid robots to cross highly heterogeneous terrain safely, with perception that simultaneously provides wide coverage, local accuracy, and redundancy against sensor failure. Existing approaches struggle to satisfy all three: one forward depth camera or nearby height sampling covers too little; odometry-corrected elevation maps drift under aggressive motion and miss thin vertical structures; image-level encoding costs grow with camera count. We present UniPoint, a humanoid whole-body locomotion framework built on multi-source point-level sensor fusion. Measurements from a 360° light detection and ranging (LiDAR) sensor and two depth cameras are early-fused into one base-frame point set. Voxelization resamples it to a fixed number of tokens encoded by linear self-attention and proprioception-queried cross-attention, decoupling forward cost from sensor count. The point set retains standing thin barriers; a single-modality failure removes only part of the tokens, so the policy degrades gracefully. A single training run with terrain-aware rewards, perception-degradation injection, and domain randomization produces one policy for all eight terrain types, deployed on an onboard RK3588 without fine-tuning. On a DR02 humanoid, 20 trials at each of nine real-world settings over seven terrain types validate the policy on 70-cm-high platforms, 100-cm gaps, thin barriers, and sparse or narrow footholds; it also generalizes zero-shot outdoors.

AI.tldr: 提出UniPoint，一种基于多源点级传感器融合的人形机器人全身运动框架，实现复杂地形安全行走，对传感器故障鲁棒，并可在嵌入式平台部署。
AI.motivation: 开放世界部署要求人形机器人安全穿越高度异质地形，感知需同时具备广覆盖、局部精度和冗余。现有方法难以兼顾：单前向深度相机或近处高度采样覆盖不足；里程计校正的高程图在剧烈运动下漂移且漏检细垂直结构；图像级编码成本随相机数量增长。
AI.method: 将360° LiDAR与两个深度相机测量早期融合为基座坐标系点集；体素化重采样为固定数量token，经线性自注意力与本体感知查询交叉注意力编码，使前向成本与传感器数量解耦。训练中采用地形感知奖励、感知退化注入和域随机化，单次训练得到适用于八种地形的单一策略，无需微调部署于RK3588。
AI.result: 在DR02人形机器人上，于七种地形、九个真实场景各进行20次试验，验证了70厘米高平台、100厘米沟壑、细障碍物及稀疏或狭窄落脚点等场景。室外零样本泛化。单模态故障仅移除部分token，策略性能优雅退化。
AI.conclusion: UniPoint通过多源点级融合与高效注意力编码，实现了广覆盖、高精度且冗余的感知，使单一策略能在多种复杂地形上安全行走，并具备对传感器故障的鲁棒性和嵌入式实时部署能力。

title: EgoWild2Dex: Learning Dexterous Robotic Manipulation from In-the-Wild Human Experience
summary: Egocentric human data provide a principled source of supervision for learning dexterous robot manipulation. Unlike prior approaches that often collect such data in constrained or specially constructed environments, we collect in-the-wild egocentric demonstrations in real-world settings, including homes, factories, and pharmacies, etc., where people perform their ordinary tasks while wearing head-mounted cameras. This collection protocol captures diverse workflows and hand-object interactions across long-tailed object and skill distributions, but also yields visually challenging observations due to scene clutter and head-motion-induced viewpoint changes (a mean cumulative rotation of $15.93^{\circ}$/s). To address these issues, we introduce EgoWild2Dex, which transfers in-the-wild ego-human experience to dual-arm robots with dexterous hands by jointly aligning unstable egocentric views and human motions with robot observations and actions, respectively. This work offers three benefits. First, we introduce GeoFormer, a differentiable geometric transformer that warps noisy human observations toward robot observations. Second, we design a human-robot training scheme to bridge the embodiment gap, enabling high task success with limited robot supervision. Third, we release EgoWild, a 538.9-hour in-the-wild egocentric human dataset comprising 179,049 episodes, 125,961 unique task descriptions, and 1,282 object categories. On real robots, EgoWild2Dex achieves an average success rate of 96.7% across three long-horizon bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks and an average object-level zero-shot success rate of 33.3%. The data, models, and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 EgoWild2Dex，利用真实场景中采集的第一人称人类演示数据，通过联合对齐视角与动作，将人类操作经验迁移到双臂灵巧机器人上，并发布大规模数据集 EgoWild。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多在受限或专门构建环境中采集第一人称数据，而真实场景中的第一人称演示更具多样性和长尾分布，但存在场景杂乱、头部运动导致视角不稳定等视觉挑战，难以直接用于机器人学习。
AI.method: 提出 EgoWild2Dex，将野外第一人称人类经验迁移到双臂灵巧手机器人：使用可微分几何变换器 GeoFormer 将噪声人类观测对齐到机器人观测，并设计人-机器人训练方案以弥合具身差距，在有限机器人监督下实现高任务成功率。
AI.result: 发布 EgoWild 数据集，包含 538.9 小时野外第一人称人类数据、179,049 个片段、125,961 个独特任务描述和 1,282 个物体类别。真实机器人上，在三个长时程双臂灵巧操作任务中平均成功率为 96.7%，物体级零样本平均成功率为 33.3%。
AI.conclusion: 在真实场景中采集的第一人称人类演示数据可有效迁移到双臂灵巧机器人操作中；通过视角与动作对齐及人-机器人训练，可在有限机器人监督下取得较高成功率。数据、模型和代码将公开。

title: PackLab: A Comprehensive Framework for Developing, Training, and Evaluating MLLMs in Robotic Bin Packing
comment: The code, model, dataset, and benchmark are available at https://github.com/Correr-Zhou/PackLab
summary: Robotic bin packing requires long-horizon sequential decision-making, as each object placement affects the available space for subsequent packing. Existing methods primarily rely on hand-crafted geometric heuristics that optimize predefined objectives or reinforcement learning policies learned through trial and error over predefined training configurations. Despite recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for this task, their potential for closed-loop sequential decisions across heterogeneous packing configurations remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce PackLab, a comprehensive framework for developing, training, and evaluating MLLMs for closed-loop robotic bin packing. PackLab-Suite provides a physics-based simulation platform for scalable generation of diverse training packing trajectories and evaluation of their physical outcomes. PackLab-VLM is a packing-specialized MLLM that understands the evolving object and container states to jointly select objects and predict placements in a closed-loop manner. PackLab-Bench provides standardized packing scenarios at multiple difficulty levels for systematic evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, on average, PackLab-VLM outperforms conventional packing heuristics, traditional reinforcement learning methods, and general-purpose MLLMs across object sets and container configurations, highlighting the potential of MLLMs for long-horizon robotic packing. The code, model, dataset, and benchmark are available at https://github.com/Correr-Zhou/PackLab .

AI.tldr: 本文提出PackLab框架，用于开发、训练和评估面向闭环机器人装箱的多模态大语言模型，包含物理仿真平台PackLab-Suite、专用模型PackLab-VLM和多难度基准PackLab-Bench。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人装箱方法主要依赖手工几何启发式或强化学习，虽有多模态大语言模型尝试，但其在异构装箱配置下进行闭环顺序决策的潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: PackLab-Suite提供基于物理的仿真平台，可扩展生成多样化装箱轨迹并评估物理结果；PackLab-VLM是装箱专用MLLM，能理解物体与容器动态状态，闭环联合选择物体并预测放置；PackLab-Bench提供多难度标准装箱场景用于系统评估。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PackLab-VLM在不同物体集和容器配置上平均优于传统装箱启发式、传统强化学习方法和通用MLLM。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了MLLM在长时程机器人装箱任务中的潜力，代码、模型、数据集和基准均已开源。

title: Block-Sparse Attention with Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing
comment: Technical report; Submitted to ACL ARR 2026 May
summary: Long-context inference has become a defining capability of large language models, but exact dense attention remains costly due to its quadratic scaling with sequence length. Block-sparse attention offers a hardware-friendly alternative by routing each query block to a small set of relevant key blocks, yet accurate training-free block routing remains difficult. Existing routers often pool post-RoPE token representations, which entangles semantic aggregation with RoPE-induced geometry and attenuates local positional cues through high-frequency phase cancellation. To resolve this mismatch, we propose \textbf{Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing}, a training-free block routing framework that shifts semantic aggregation to the pre-RoPE space and reconstructs geometric bias with an offline structural prior and relative block distances. This decomposition yields an explicit closed-form block routing score without token-level search or post-hoc calibration. Experiments on long-context text and video tasks show that our method approaches full-attention accuracy across 4K--128K contexts, keeps routing overhead below 3.4 ms, and achieves a 5.03$\times$ speedup over FlashAttn at a 128K context length.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种免训练的分块稀疏注意力路由框架“语义-几何解耦路由”，通过将语义聚合移至RoPE前空间并利用离线结构先验和相对块距离重建几何偏置，实现了长上下文的高效准确推理。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中，精确密集注意力因二次复杂度而代价高昂；分块稀疏注意力虽硬件友好，但免训练的准确块路由仍具挑战。现有路由器池化RoPE后的token表示，导致语义聚合与RoPE几何纠缠，且高频相位抵消削弱局部位置线索。
AI.method: 提出语义-几何解耦路由（Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing），将语义聚合移至RoPE前空间，并用离线结构先验和相对块距离重建几何偏置；得到显式闭式块路由分数，无需token级搜索或事后校准。
AI.result: 在长上下文文本和视频任务上，4K-128K上下文下接近全注意力精度，路由开销低于3.4毫秒，128K上下文比FlashAttn加速5.03倍。
AI.conclusion: 该解耦路由方法能有效实现免训练、高精度且高效的块稀疏长上下文推理。

title: SewFusion: Tailored Generation of Topology and Panel-Level Geometry for Sewing Patterns
summary: Generating sewing patterns from images and text requires modeling a heterogeneous representation composed of discrete topology and continuous geometry. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: diffusion-based methods enable holistic geometry generation by converting the entire pattern into a continuous representation, but weaken discrete topology modeling; in contrast, autoregressive methods preserve discrete topology through next-token prediction, but tie continuous geometry regression to token-level hidden states with limited panel-level context. To bridge this gap, we propose SewFusion, a unified autoregressive framework that adopts tailored generation mechanisms for discrete topology and panel-level continuous geometry, using next-token prediction for the former and flow matching for the latter. To support panel-level continuous geometry generation, we introduce a Panel Geometry VAE that learns a fixed-size latent space for variable-length panel geometry, together with Panel Geometry Flow for latent generation. We further propose Panel-Forcing to reduce the training--inference mismatch in topology context and improve robustness to topology prediction errors. Extensive experiments on SewFactory and GCD-MM demonstrate that SewFusion consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods across various settings, achieving +6.36% Panel Accuracy, +11.30% Stitch Accuracy, and -1.90 Vertex L2 error in the image-text-based generation setting.

AI.tldr: 提出SewFusion统一自回归框架，从图像和文本生成缝纫纸样，对离散拓扑采用下一token预测，对裁片级连续几何采用流匹配生成。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散方法将纸样整体转为连续表示，弱化了离散拓扑建模；自回归方法虽保留离散拓扑，但连续几何回归依赖token级隐状态，缺乏裁片级上下文。
AI.method: SewFusion统一自回归框架；提出Panel Geometry VAE为变长裁片几何学习固定大小隐空间；提出Panel Geometry Flow进行隐空间生成；提出Panel-Forcing减少训练与推理的拓扑上下文不匹配，并提升对拓扑预测错误的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在SewFactory和GCD-MM数据集上持续超越此前最优方法，在图像-文本生成设置下取得Panel Accuracy +6.36%、Stitch Accuracy +11.30%、Vertex L2误差 -1.90。
AI.conclusion: SewFusion有效桥接了离散拓扑与连续几何生成，验证了统一自回归框架在缝纫纸样生成任务中的优越性。

title: Epi-Logic: A Conceptual Framework for Epistemic Runtime Control, Schema Validity Checking, and Controlled Accommodation in Autonomous AI Agents
summary:
Autonomous AI agents are increasingly deployed in areas where wrong decisions are hard to reverse. This paper examines schema mismatch: the condition in which an agent operates within an interpretive frame that no longer applies to the current context. Outputs produced under such a mismatch can appear internally consistent, linguistically plausible, and largely factually correct; output-quality metrics alone therefore capture the underlying loss of validity only partially.
  The paper introduces Epi-Logic, a conceptual framework for epistemic runtime control. It couples the detection of schema dissonance, a graduated reduction of autonomy, and the auditable switch to a validated schema. A schema is formalised as a tuple of variable space, expectation model, validity conditions, axioms, and metadata. The Epi-Score aggregates seven graded dimensions of epistemic dissonance; the temporal validity dimension D8, violations of the validity conditions G, and axiom violations are carried as separate categorical paths that are not offset against the aggregate.
  The architecture rests on a checking asymmetry: formalised validity conditions can be checked at runtime, whereas the correctness of many actions is established only ex post. The paper separates two architectural properties, a conditional result from sequential changepoint detection, and an empirical remainder. Eight falsifiable propositions with named baselines describe the transition to empirical validation. All propositions are empirically testable hypotheses, not established results.

AI.tldr: 论文关注自主 AI 智能体在高风险场景中的模式错配问题，提出 Epi-Logic 这一面向运行时认知控制的概念框架，用于检测模式失调、逐步降低自主性并切换到经验证的模式。
AI.motivation: 自主 AI 智能体越来越多地部署于错误决策难以逆转的领域，而模式错配下的输出可能内部一致、语言合理且大体符合事实，因此仅靠输出质量指标无法充分捕捉有效性的丧失。
AI.method: 将模式形式化为变量空间、期望模型、有效性条件、公理和元数据构成的元组；提出 Epi-Score 聚合七个认知失调维度，并将时间有效性 D8、有效性条件 G 的违反和公理违反作为单独分类路径处理；基于运行时检查不对称性，结合顺序变点检测的条件性结果与经验剩余部分，提出八个可证伪命题及命名基线。
AI.result: 论文给出 Epi-Logic 的概念框架和架构属性，并明确八个命题均为可经验检验的假设，而非已确立结果；同时指出输出质量指标只能部分反映模式错配带来的有效性损失。
AI.conclusion: Epi-Logic 为自主 AI 提供一种认知运行时控制思路，通过检测模式失调、降低自主性和可审计切换来应对模式错配；但所提命题仍需后续实证验证。

title: World State Generator
summary: Language agents solve complex tasks through plans and actions. A single step the world refuses puts the goal out of reach, and what the agent does next decides the task. Prompted planners fail at exactly this point, rewriting the refused step in new words, meeting the same refusal, and burning the attempt budget without moving. They fail because the plan was never tied to the world, so a refusal has nothing in the plan to attach to. A world is where a task runs, and it has its own rules, its own admissible actions, and its own constraints. We build synthetic worlds across 7 domains and extract training data from them. A program enforces each world's rules and grades its goal, and every world is admitted only if its goal is reachable from its initial state. Agents run inside and leave verified failures paired with repairs that carried the run to a state the world certified, a record of about 226K trajectories. On this record we train the World State Generator, a model that writes a plan as checkable states of the world and keeps that plan aligned with the world it runs in. That alignment is what a plan written in language lacks, since the world it runs in has physical limits, logical dependencies, and required orders the language never states, and the plan encounters these rules only when a state fails. WSG takes that failure as the rule the world has stated and rewrites the remaining states to obey it, so the plan bends to the world as the run goes on. Across 7 public benchmarks, WSG raises end-to-end success for two open models near 30B parameters over prompting and brings to the level of proprietary model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出世界状态生成器（WSG），利用7个合成世界生成的约22.6万条轨迹训练，使语言智能体的计划与世界规则对齐；在7个公开基准上，两个约300亿参数的开源模型端到端成功率超过提示方法，并达到专有模型水平。
AI.motivation: 提示规划器在步骤被世界拒绝时，只会换词重写、反复碰壁并耗尽尝试预算，因为计划从未与世界绑定，拒绝无处附着；世界有其规则、可行动作与约束，语言计划缺少这种对齐。
AI.method: 构建7个领域的合成世界，用程序执行规则并评分，仅保留目标可达的世界；智能体运行留下已验证失败与修复轨迹（约226K）。训练WSG，将计划写成可检查的世界状态，并把失败视为世界给出的规则，重写剩余状态以遵守规则，使计划随运行与世界对齐。
AI.result: 在7个公开基准上，WSG使两个约300亿参数的开源模型端到端成功率超过提示方法，并达到专有模型水平。
AI.conclusion: 将计划表示为可检查的世界状态并与世界规则对齐，能有效克服提示规划在拒绝点上的失败，提升语言智能体在复杂任务中的成功率。

title: Construting Reverse Thinking: Developing Large Language Models' Reverse Thingking Ability
summary: When facing complex problems, humans tend to try various ideas for different issues. Human thinking patterns exhibit remarkable flexibility in adapting to diverse scenarios. GPT-o1, GPT-o3, and DeepSeek-R1 adopt long chain-of-thought models to address complex problems by increasing reasoning depth, which default to a forward reasoning mode. We conducted statistical analysis on the accuracy of different mathematical problem datasets on models of different scales, and found five reasons for errors: Insufficient solution-space coverage, Computational mistakes, Unverified assumptions, Ignoring constraint conditions, Maximum response length limitation. To address the above issues, we proposed a backward reasoning pattern construction method aimed at enhancing the model's reverse thinking ability and dynamic adaptability. First, we constructed an easy-hard two-stage Math dataset for training large models and gradually improving their inference ability at different difficulty levels. The dataset contains forward reasoning paths as well as backward reasoning paths. And a two-stage supervised fine-tuning process is applied to progressively train the model's backward reasoning capability. Furthermore, a fine-grained reward mechanism is developed, employing smoothed reward signals to strengthen the model's ability to autonomously select thinking modes during the reasoning process, thereby avoiding reward hacking. A linear-decay balanced sampling strategy is designed to maintain a balance between forward and backward reasoning path samples during training, enabling the model to converge quickly and stably. Experimental results show that our method significantly improves reasoning efficiency and accuracy in tasks such as mathematical proofs, offering a flexible and efficient reasoning paradigm for solving complex problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对当前长链思维模型默认采用前向推理的局限，提出一种后向推理模式构建方法，通过两阶段数学数据集、两阶段监督微调、细粒度奖励和平衡采样策略，提升模型在复杂数学问题中的推理效率与准确率。
AI.motivation: 人类思维具有灵活适应性，而GPT-o1、GPT-o3、DeepSeek-R1等模型主要依赖增加推理深度的前向推理。统计分析发现模型在数学问题上出错主要有五类原因：解空间覆盖不足、计算错误、未验证假设、忽略约束条件、最大响应长度限制。
AI.method: 构建易到难两阶段数学数据集，包含前向与后向推理路径；采用两阶段监督微调逐步训练后向推理能力；设计细粒度奖励机制，使用平滑奖励信号增强模型自主选择思维模式的能力并避免奖励黑客；采用线性衰减平衡采样策略，维持训练中前向与后向推理路径样本的平衡。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在数学证明等任务中显著提升了推理效率和准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为复杂问题求解提供了一种灵活且高效的推理范式，增强了模型的逆向思维能力和动态适应性。

title: LLMs Anchor on Chief Complaint and Fail to Integrate Evidence in Sequential Clinical Triage
summary: Triage in the emergency department (ED) is a sequential decision process that unfolds turn by turn. Existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) for triage use completed retrospective records and report performance close to that of physicians. We implement a methodology for evaluating LLMs on sequential triage, the task of predicting a triage acuity label from a growing prefix of a nurse-patient conversation. We evaluate six LLMs at five sequential checkpoints on two corpora: 425 LLM-generated (SIMULATED) and 50 physician-authored (CLINICIAN) conversations, both labelled under the Emergency Severity Index (ESI). Every model, measured by quadratic weighted kappa (QWK), degrades from moderate-to-substantial agreement on completed records to fair-to-moderate agreement at every sequential checkpoint. Controlled perturbations show that the label at every checkpoint is anchored on the chief complaint exchanges, and prompting interventions fail to lift this plateau. Models extract clinically relevant content from later turns, yet the surprisal of the true label rises across the checkpoints. So the model fails to integrate the evidence. Three expert clinicians on the same conversations reach a QWK of 0.887-0.929, while the best model reaches 0.295. Predictions concentrate at ESI-2 and ESI-3, and models agree with each other more than with the ground truth, so ensembling worsens the failure. Deploying LLMs for ED triage based on offline benchmarks alone misses this sequential failure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出按急诊分诊的逐步顺序决策过程评估大语言模型：仅根据护士-患者对话的逐步增长前缀预测ESI分诊等级。结果显示，模型在完整记录上表现尚可，但在顺序检查点上显著退化，且无法整合后续证据，远逊于临床专家。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM分诊评估多使用已完成的回顾性记录，并报告接近医生的表现，但这忽略了真实急诊分诊是逐轮展开的顺序决策过程。作者希望检验LLM在序贯分诊场景下是否仍然可靠。
AI.method: 在两种语料上评估六个LLM，设置五个顺序检查点：425段LLM生成的模拟护士-患者对话和50段医生撰写的临床对话，均按急诊严重指数（ESI）标注。使用二次加权kappa（QWK）衡量与真实分诊标签的一致性，并进行受控扰动和提示干预实验，同时与三位临床专家比较。
AI.result: 所有模型从完整记录上的中等至较高一致性，下降到各顺序检查点上的一般至中等一致性。扰动实验表明各检查点标签主要锚定在主诉交流上，提示干预无法提升表现。模型虽能从后续轮次提取临床相关内容，但真实标签的surprisal上升，说明未能整合证据。专家QWK为0.887-0.929，最佳模型仅0.295。预测集中在ESI-2和ESI-3，模型彼此之间比与真实标签更一致，因此集成反而更差。
AI.conclusion: 仅依据离线基准评估来部署LLM进行急诊分诊，会遗漏这种顺序决策失败。LLM当前不适合直接用于真实急诊分诊中的序贯 acuity 判断。

title: ContactDP: Contact-Guided Diffusion Policy for Tight Insertion Tasks
summary: High-precision connector insertion remains challenging for robotic systems due to tight mechanical tolerances, partial observability during contact, and multimodal uncertainty arising from occlusion and contact ambiguity. Successful insertion requires closed-loop contact guidance that continuously integrates global alignment cues with local contact feedback to produce stable corrective actions under interaction. In this work, we present ContactDP (Contact-Guided Diffusion Policy for Tight Insertion Tasks), a multimodal diffusion-policy framework for contact-rich insertion. ContactDP jointly integrates wrist RGB observations, fingertip tactile sensing, and wrist-mounted force-torque measurements to infer contact state and generate temporally consistent corrective motions during insertion. To ensure stable execution under contact, the learned policy operates together with a hybrid position-force controller that provides compliant low-level interaction. We evaluate our approach on a suite of industrial-grade connector insertion tasks with varying connector geometries, grasp conditions, and initial misalignment. Across all tasks, ContactDP significantly outperforms vision-only diffusion policies for performance, reliability and generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContactDP，一种用于紧密连接器插入任务的多模态扩散策略框架，融合视觉、触觉和力/力矩信息，并结合混合位置-力控制器，实现高精度接触丰富的插入。
AI.motivation: 机器人连接器插入面临严格机械公差、接触过程中部分可观测性、遮挡与接触歧义带来的多模态不确定性，需要闭环接触引导来持续融合全局对齐线索与局部接触反馈。
AI.method: 提出ContactDP（Contact-Guided Diffusion Policy），联合使用腕部RGB观测、指尖触觉传感和腕部力/力矩测量，推断接触状态并生成时序一致的纠正动作；同时配合混合位置-力控制器提供柔顺底层交互。
AI.result: 在多种工业级连接器插入任务中评估，涵盖不同连接器几何、抓取条件和初始错位；ContactDP在性能、可靠性和泛化能力上显著优于仅视觉的扩散策略。
AI.conclusion: 融合接触引导的多模态扩散策略与柔顺位置-力控制，能有效应对紧密插入任务中的多模态不确定性，并提升实际插入性能与泛化性。

title: Modeling Clinical Workflow for SYNTAX Scoring from Coronary Angiography Videos
summary: The SYNTAX score is a clinically established tool for assessing anatomical lesion complexity in coronary artery disease and guiding subsequent treatment. However, automated SYNTAX scoring is commonly formulated as a direct regression problem from coronary angiography videos to patient-level scores. In this work, we reformulate SYNTAX scoring as a vessel segment identity-preserving anatomical reasoning problem and propose a hierarchical modeling framework that explicitly aligns learning with the clinical workflow. Our approach maintains vessel segment identity across frames and views, estimates stenosis severity at the segment level, and aggregates evidence hierarchically according to coronary anatomy. Simultaneously, to address the scarcity of domain-specific data, we integrate and complete multiple public coronary angiography datasets, constructing a large-scale resource featuring completed vessel segmentation and derived structural annotations. Experiments demonstrate that vessel segment-level stenosis embedding enhances explanatory power and reduces prediction variability compared to baseline models, with the R^2 score improving by 0.201 and dev STD decreasing by 18.4%. These results highlight the necessity of structure-aligned modeling for reliable and stable automated SYNTAX scoring from multi-view coronary angiography videos. The GitHub link is https://github.com/VersaceSu7/SYNTAX_score_777.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将SYNTAX评分从直接回归重构为保持血管段身份的解剖推理问题，并设计分层建模框架，同时整合公开数据集构建大规模资源，实验表明该方法提升了预测性能与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 自动SYNTAX评分通常被简化为从冠脉造影视频直接回归患者级评分，忽略了血管段身份和临床工作流程中的解剖结构，且领域数据稀缺，导致解释性差和预测波动大。
AI.method: 1) 将SYNTAX评分重构成血管段身份保持的解剖推理问题；2) 提出分层建模框架，跨帧和视图保持血管段身份，在段级别估计狭窄严重程度，并根据冠脉解剖分层聚合证据；3) 整合并补全多个公开冠脉造影数据集，构建包含完整血管分割和衍生结构标注的大规模资源。
AI.result: 血管段级狭窄嵌入增强了模型解释力并降低了预测变异性；与基线相比，R^2提升0.201，预测标准差降低18.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结构对齐建模对于从多视角冠脉造影视频中实现可靠且稳定的自动SYNTAX评分是必要的。

title: Measuring Behavioural Signatures of Large Language Models through Psychometric Profiling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate human decisions and communication, yet their behavioural regularities remain difficult to characterize systematically. We develop a cross-linguistic psychometric profiling framework and evaluate nine LLMs using seven psychological instruments, with five repeated administrations per model and language in Chinese and English. Items unresolved after a prespecified retry procedure are retained as NA. Joint analysis of scored and NA responses captures response tendencies and boundaries of self-report applicability. LLMs exhibit structured, model-specific profiles despite a shared alignment-shaped pattern of higher prosocial and self-regulatory responses and lower dominance, disengagement and harmful-intent endorsement. NA responses are structured rather than uniformly distributed, indicating where outputs are treated as inapplicable, refused or cannot be mapped to valid response options. Language condition and provider origin are associated with profile configuration and answerability, whereas repeated administrations show high reproducibility and permit recovery of model identity. Human-reference and prompt-robustness analyses further indicate that these signatures are context dependent. Joint analysis of psychometric profiling and answerability offers a framework for quantifying deployment-level behavioural signatures.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建跨语言心理测量画像框架，用七种心理量表和五次重复施测评估九个大语言模型在中英文下的行为规律，并联合分析有效作答与NA作答。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益介入人类决策与交流，但其行为规律仍难以系统刻画，因此需要可量化的心理测量与跨语言评估框架。
AI.method: 对九个LLM使用七种心理学工具，在中英文两种语言条件下各重复施测五次；按预设重试流程仍无法解决的条目保留为NA；联合分析计分反应与NA反应，并进行人类参照和提示稳健性分析。
AI.result: LLM呈现结构化且模型特异的心理画像，同时共享一种由对齐塑造的模式：亲社会与自我调节反应较高，支配、脱离和有害意图认同较低。NA反应呈结构化分布，反映不适用、拒答或无法映射到有效选项。语言条件和提供者来源与画像配置及可作答性相关；重复施测显示高可重复性，并可恢复模型身份；人类参照和提示稳健性分析表明这些特征依赖语境。
AI.conclusion: 联合心理测量画像与可作答性分析，为量化模型在部署层面的行为特征提供了框架。

title: An Iterative LangGraph Agent for Text-to-SQL: Natural Language Access to the Chicago Crime Database
summary: Non-technical stakeholders frequently cannot write the SQL needed to extract insights from operational databases. We built and evaluated a Text-to-SQL agent that closes this gap end to end: a six-node LangGraph StateGraph checks question relevance, fetches the live schema, generates PostgreSQL, validates it with a dry run, retries on failure, executes the query, and narrates the result set in plain English. The agent uses prompt engineering only; no model was fine-tuned. We evaluated it on the Chicago Crime dataset (approximately 8.5 million records, 22 attributes) against a hand-built benchmark of 100 natural language questions with ground-truth SQL, stratified into 30 Easy, 40 Medium and 30 Hard items. Comparing two prompt revisions of the same agent, the revised system (V2) reached a Valid SQL Rate of 93% (from 87%), an Execution Accuracy of 60% under a hybrid relational equivalence metric (from 47%; 19% from 12% under strict JSON matching), and a mean Synthesis Quality of 4.34 out of 5 (from 3.91). The single largest driver was removing a LIMIT 10 instruction from the system prompt, which had been truncating multi-row answers. Error analysis attributes the residual failures to relevance-checker false rejections, ambiguous question semantics, and free-tier API rate limits rather than to the language generation step. We report no comparison against an external baseline system or a public benchmark; the study is a single-model engineering evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并评估了一个端到端 Text-to-SQL 智能体，基于六节点 LangGraph StateGraph，仅使用提示工程，在 Chicago Crime 大规模数据集上测试，并通过两版提示对比显示 V2 显著提升 SQL 有效率和执行准确率。
AI.motivation: 非技术利益相关者通常无法编写 SQL 从业务数据库中提取洞察，因此需要一种能自动将自然语言问题转换为 SQL、执行查询并用通俗语言解释结果的端到端工具。
AI.method: 系统采用六节点 LangGraph StateGraph：问题相关性检查、获取实时 schema、生成 PostgreSQL、dry run 验证、失败重试、执行查询、用英文叙述结果。仅使用提示工程，未微调模型。在 Chicago Crime 数据集（约 850 万条记录、22 个属性）上，用 100 个自然语言问题及真实 SQL 构建基准，分为 Easy 30、Medium 40、Hard 30，并比较同一智能体的两版提示 V1 与 V2。
AI.result: V2 相比 V1：Valid SQL Rate 从 87% 提升至 93%；在混合关系等价指标下 Execution Accuracy 从 47% 提升至 60%，在严格 JSON 匹配下从 12% 提升至 19%；平均 Synthesis Quality 从 3.91/5 提升至 4.34/5。最大改进来自从系统提示中移除 LIMIT 10 指令，该指令曾截断多行答案。残余失败主要归因于相关性检查器误拒、问题语义歧义和免费 API 速率限制，而非语言生成步骤。
AI.conclusion: 该智能体能够端到端支持非技术用户查询数据库并生成自然语言解释，提示工程优化带来明显收益；但研究未与外部基线系统或公共基准比较，属于单模型工程评估，且仍受相关性判断、问题歧义和 API 限制影响。

title: GRUET: Quantifying Uncertainty of Agentic Reasoning-and-Acting Processes
summary: Agents have attracted considerably increasing attention due to the power of executing both Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) in open and dynamic environments. The ReAct process typically exhibits a multi-turn trajectory in which one drives Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate both reasoning chains and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner. However, agents often suffer from significant uncertainty, where identical tasks yield divergent trajectories; trajectories with higher uncertainty often produce incomprehensible behaviors, severely undermining agent credibility. This work conjectures that such trajectory-level uncertainty frequently stems from cumulative turn-level reasoning uncertainty induced by LLMs; the latter often exhibits a collection of branches of divergent reasoning chains and their resulting actions. Built upon this, we present the Graph-based Reasoning UncErtainty in Trajectories (GRUET) method for the uncertainty quantification of ReAct, comprising turn-level reasoning uncertainty quantification and trajectory-level uncertainty aggregation; the former precisely quantifies reasoning uncertainty via modeling the reasoning space spanned by potential reasoning branches as a graph and then approximating the reasoning space complexity with graph complexity, while the latter employs simple aggregation strategies for quantifying the overall trajectory credibility. Empirical evaluations across nine LLMs and five benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our proposed GRUET in terms of selective generation performance, measured by AUROC, AUPRC, and AUARC.

AI.tldr: 论文针对ReAct智能体轨迹不确定性，提出GRUET方法，从轮级推理不确定性量化到轨迹级不确定性聚合，并在9个LLM和5个基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: ReAct智能体在多轮轨迹中常出现相同任务轨迹发散的问题，高不确定性会导致难以理解的行为并严重削弱智能体可信度；作者推测轨迹级不确定性源于LLM轮级推理不确定性及其多个分支推理链和动作。
AI.method: 提出GRUET方法，包括轮级推理不确定性量化和轨迹级不确定性聚合。轮级通过将潜在推理分支构成的推理空间建模为图，并用图复杂度近似推理空间复杂度来精确量化推理不确定性；轨迹级采用简单聚合策略量化整体轨迹可信度。
AI.result: 在九个LLM和五个基准上进行实证评估，以AUROC、AUPRC和AUARC衡量的选择性生成性能验证了GRUET的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRUET能够有效量化ReAct轨迹不确定性，从而提升智能体的选择性生成表现与可信度。

title: Transferring Visual Explanations: How Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation Affects Model Interpretability
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to AJOSR
summary: Deploying efficient neural networks is essential in resource-constrained environments, yet compact models often sacrifice interpretability - a critical in safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving and medicine. This study investigates whether Knowledge Distillation transfers the spatial feature attribution of a large teacher network to a compact student. To assess the influence of the KD scheme on interpretability, we distill a ResNet-152 teacher into a ResNet-34 student on ImageNet-1K across five configurations by systematically varying the distillation temperature and soft-label loss weight. Models are evaluated on top-1 accuracy, along with two interpretability metrics: Relevance Mass Accuracy and Relevance Rank Accuracy. These metrics are computed via Grad-CAM heatmaps benchmarked against ground-truth object masks. Our results show that top-1 accuracy ranges from 71.6% to 74.0%. For Grad-CAM, RMA ranges from 7.7% to 9.7% and RRA from 7.3% to 10.1%; for Guided Grad-CAM, RMA ranges from 16.1% to 18.6% and RRA from 15.9% to 21.5%. Interpretability proves far more sensitive to the soft-label weight than to the temperature: keeping the student anchored to hard labels preserves both accuracy and coarse localization, whereas weighting the teacher heavily degrades both. Fine-grained attribution, however, fell below the undistilled baseline in every configuration tested, indicating that logit distillation transmits where a model attends more readily than the pixel-level structure of that attention. We evaluate 12 cross-architecture combinations of convolutional and transformer-based models, revealing that the inheritance of fine-grained spatial reasoning is fundamentally bottlenecked by the student's intrinsic structural biases. To our knowledge, this is the first application of this interpretability-aware evaluation framework - previously used for neural network pruning - to KD.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨知识蒸馏能否将大教师网络的空间特征归因迁移给紧凑学生网络，并通过ImageNet-1K上的ResNet-152到ResNet-34实验，结合准确率与Grad-CAM可解释性指标进行评估。
AI.motivation: 资源受限环境中需要高效紧凑神经网络，但紧凑模型往往牺牲可解释性，这在自动驾驶、医学等安全关键领域至关重要，因此需要研究知识蒸馏对可解释性的影响。
AI.method: 将ResNet-152教师蒸馏到ResNet-34学生，在ImageNet-1K上系统改变蒸馏温度和软标签损失权重，形成五种配置；评估top-1准确率以及Relevance Mass Accuracy和Relevance Rank Accuracy两个可解释性指标，并用Grad-CAM热图与真实目标掩码对比；另评估12种卷积与Transformer跨架构组合。
AI.result: top-1准确率为71.6%至74.0%。Grad-CAM的RMA为7.7%至9.7%，RRA为7.3%至10.1%；Guided Grad-CAM的RMA为16.1%至18.6%，RRA为15.9%至21.5%。可解释性对软标签权重的敏感性远高于温度：保留硬标签锚定可维持准确率和粗粒度定位，而过度加权教师会同时损害二者。细粒度归因在所有配置中均低于未蒸馏基线，说明logit蒸馏更易传递“模型关注何处”，而非该关注的像素级结构。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏可以一定程度上迁移空间注意力位置，但细粒度空间推理的继承受学生网络固有结构偏差的根本限制；这也是该可解释性感知评估框架首次从神经网络剪枝应用到知识蒸馏。

title: Automatic multimodal UX improvement recommendations from LLM agent user simulations
summary: Evaluating user experience (UX) on live websites through user testing is expensive, subjective, and difficult to scale. LLM agents offer a promising route to automating UX testing by simulating realistic user behaviour. However, existing simulation approaches typically lack multimodality and require time-consuming manual review to extract actionable insights. We formalise UX improvement recommendation from simulation data as a structured natural language generation and ranking problem, and establish an evaluation protocol using expert annotation and LLM-as-a-Judge. We present AMUSER, a multimodal framework which simulates user behaviour and automatically generates prioritised UX improvement recommendations from resulting data. We evaluate AMUSER on commercial websites and show that its recommendations substantially outperform those from text-only simulation (NDCG@3 = 0.758 versus 0.359) at an 89% lower simulation cost. Our results suggest an asymmetric role of multimodality: visual access during simulation improves recommendations through richer traces, while providing visual inputs during recommendation generation can modestly degrade quality. We also discuss practical deployment lessons from applying AMUSER to commercial websites.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AMUSER，一个多模态框架，通过模拟用户行为并自动生成优先级 UX 改进建议，在商业网站上优于纯文本模拟，且模拟成本降低 89%。
AI.motivation: 在真实网站上评估用户体验成本高、主观性强且难以规模化。LLM 智能体有潜力自动化 UX 测试，但现有模拟方法通常缺乏多模态能力，且需要耗时的人工审阅来提取可执行洞见。
AI.method: 将基于模拟数据的 UX 改进建议形式化为结构化自然语言生成与排序问题，并建立基于专家标注和 LLM-as-a-Judge 的评估协议。提出 AMUSER 多模态框架，模拟用户行为并自动生成按优先级排序的 UX 改进建议，并在商业网站上评估。
AI.result: AMUSER 的建议显著优于纯文本模拟，NDCG@3 为 0.758 对比 0.359，同时模拟成本降低 89%。结果还显示多模态作用不对称：模拟阶段提供视觉访问可通过更丰富轨迹提升建议质量，而生成建议阶段提供视觉输入可能适度降低质量。
AI.conclusion: 多模态在 UX 模拟与建议生成中具有不对称作用，视觉信息更适合用于模拟而非建议生成。论文还讨论了将 AMUSER 应用于商业网站的实际部署经验。

title: Convex AI Compositionality and the Governance of AI System Populations
summary: AI governance increasingly requires providers and public authorities to reason about multiple AI instantiations, alternative versions, and deployment configurations of multiple AI systems. Yet current regulation remains predominantly single-system-centric, acknowledging such multiplicity only sparsely without treating collections of related AI systems as governance objects. This creates an AI population governance problem: determining which instantiations can be meaningfully considered together and how their changing configurations can be represented and monitored. The first requirement has recently been addressed through trustworthiness-based accounts of AI identity. We address the second by introducing convex AI compositionality: a formal representation of the configurations generated by finite AI system populations that uses convex spaces. The core idea is that convex compositions of the operational states that a population of AI system instantiations may occupy over time are compatible with lifecycle reachability across the population and can preserve the formal identity relations between these systems. Well-known statistical and geometric constructions, such as weighted state distributions and convex hulls, become AI governance tools for distinguishing operational states, population weights, heterogeneity, and AI configuration change across different governance modes while remaining compatible, under stated conditions, with lifecycle reachability and AI identity. We illustrate our AI population governance framework through distributed healthcare deployments and controlled deployment of recruitment AI variants.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“凸AI组合性”框架，用凸空间形式表示有限AI系统群体随时间产生的配置，以支持对多实例、多版本、多部署配置的AI群体治理。
AI.motivation: 当前AI监管仍以单系统为中心，难以处理多个AI实例、替代版本和部署配置构成的系统群体，导致AI群体治理问题：哪些实例可被有意义地归为一组，以及如何表示和监测其不断变化的配置。
AI.method: 在基于可信度的AI身份研究基础上，引入凸AI组合性；用凸空间建模有限AI系统群体生成的配置，并将加权状态分布、凸包等统计与几何构造转化为治理工具，分析运行状态、群体权重、异质性和AI配置变化，同时考察其与生命周期可达性和AI身份的形式关系。
AI.result: 该框架能够区分不同治理模式下的运行状态、群体权重、异质性和AI配置变化，并在特定条件下与生命周期可达性及AI身份保持兼容；论文通过分布式医疗部署和招聘AI变体的受控部署进行说明。
AI.conclusion: 凸AI组合性为AI群体治理提供了形式化表示与监测工具，使监管对象从单个AI系统扩展到相关AI系统群体，从而支持对多实例、多版本和多配置AI的治理。

title: MaskVLA: Visual Masking Against Trajectory Overfitting of Vision-Language-Action Model
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate vision-language understanding with executable robot actions, enabling end-to-end learning for robot control. However, our empirical analysis reveals that existing models exhibit severe trajectory overfitting when finetuned on limited datasets. To guide the model in effectively utilizing wrist camera information, we propose MaskVLA, a masking-based fine-tuning strategy. By randomly masking a small portion of the main camera's visual information, the model is guided to autonomously learn more fine-grained, task-relevant, and effective visual features. This process leads to the emergence of robust policies, thereby enhancing the model's capability to tackle complex manipulation tasks and improving its generalization performance. Our method has been comprehensively evaluated on RoboTwin 2.0, achieving an average success rate improvement of 23.2% and 16.8% compared to $π_0$ and OpenVLA-OFT, respectively. Furthermore, experiments on real-world ALOHA robots also demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MaskVLA，一种基于掩码的微调策略，通过随机掩码主相机部分视觉信息，引导视觉-语言-动作模型有效利用腕部相机信息，提升复杂操作任务能力和泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在有限数据上微调时存在严重轨迹过拟合，且腕部相机信息利用不充分。为引导模型有效利用腕部相机信息，提升泛化性能，提出该方法。
AI.method: 提出MaskVLA，一种基于掩码的微调策略。在微调时随机掩码主相机的一小部分视觉信息，促使模型自主学习更细粒度、任务相关且有效的视觉特征，从而产生鲁棒策略。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0上全面评估，相比π0和OpenVLA-OFT平均成功率分别提升23.2%和16.8%。在真实ALOHA机器人上的实验也证明了有效性。
AI.conclusion: MaskVLA能有效缓解过拟合，增强模型处理复杂操作任务的能力和泛化性能，在仿真和真实环境中均有效。

title: MedRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Medical Agents via Clinically Aligned Self-Evolution
summary: Medical agents increasingly combine general reasoning models with specialized clinical tools, yet their capabilities remain largely fixed by what clinicians and engineers design before deployment. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a different paradigm in which agents learn from their own failures and autonomously expand their capabilities, but directly applying RSI to medicine introduces fundamental safety challenges. We introduce MedRSI, the first recursive self-improvement framework for medicine, which continuously transforms diagnostic failures into new clinical capabilities through tool composition and task-specific model training. Inspired by clinical practice, MedRSI introduces two mechanisms for clinically aligned self-evolution. Clinical-cost-aware failure prioritization directs improvement toward errors according to their potential clinical consequences rather than frequency alone. Fast discovery with slow registration separates rapid capability invention from conservative adoption, allowing new tools to enter the persistent agent only after demonstrating sustained benefit across subsequent patient cohorts. Across public glaucoma and heart disease benchmarks and two private clinical tasks, MedRSI progressively develops segmentation, measurement, prediction, multimodal reasoning, and generative capabilities, surpasses manually engineered medical agents, and autonomously discovers solutions to clinical problems not anticipated by its original designers. Our results show that medical agents need not remain constrained by capabilities specified before deployment: with clinically grounded mechanisms governing what to improve and what to retain, they can continuously construct, validate, and accumulate new capabilities from diagnostic experience. Code is available at https://github.com/ImprintLab/MedRSI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MedRSI，首个面向医学的递归自我改进（RSI）框架，使医疗智能体能够从自身诊断失败中持续学习，通过工具组合与任务专用模型训练自主扩展临床能力。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗智能体的能力在部署前即被临床医生和工程师固定，无法随诊断经验自我进化；而直接套用通用 RSI 到医学场景又存在根本性安全风险。
AI.method: MedRSI 引入两种临床对齐的自我进化机制：(1) 临床成本感知的失败优先级排序，根据错误的潜在临床后果而非出现频率决定改进方向；(2) 快速发现与缓慢注册分离，将能力快速发明与保守采纳分离，新工具须在后续患者队列中持续证明有效才能进入持久化智能体。
AI.result: 在公开的青光眼与心脏病基准以及两项私有临床任务上，MedRSI 逐步发展出分割、测量、预测、多模态推理和生成等能力，超越人工设计的医疗智能体，并能自主发现原始设计者未预见的临床问题解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 医疗智能体无需受限于部署前设定的能力边界；在临床依据驱动的机制决定“改进什么”和“保留什么”的前提下，它们可以持续从诊断经验中构建、验证并积累新能力。

title: Structured World-State Reasoning for Agentic Robotic Search
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, Submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: Long-horizon robotic search must resolve natural language against heterogeneous, incomplete, and often ambiguous evidence: textual information, prior maps, and observations arriving over time. The core challenge is to contextualize these streams and decide where to gather evidence before selecting a target. We present WORLDS: World-state Observation and Reasoning for Language-guided Discovery and Search, a framework that grounds reasoning in a persistent graph initialized from geospatial priors and updated by perception. Parallel Reasoners maintain competing candidate interpretations and request evidence to distinguish between them. We collect and process the requested observations with a multimodal Examiner, after which a Judge selects a grounded target or requests another pass. WORLDS achieves 51.8% navigation success across all 5,311 CityNav test episodes, the highest reported success rate, exceeding the previous published best by 15.7 percentage points under an OSM-only, high-resolution orthographic protocol. On 1,000 shared episodes, it achieves 50.0% versus 27.9% for the strongest adapted baseline using the same model, prior, sensing stack, and movement budget. Observation-based verification by the Examiner contributes 5.9 points of this success, and at a reduced reasoning-effort setting WORLDS still exceeds the adapted GeoNav baseline by 18.8 points while generating fewer tokens. We also demonstrate WORLDS on a quadrotor, which flies the generated sensing waypoints and grounds three language targets, including a vehicle absent from the map, from its onboard imagery.

AI.tldr: WORLDS框架通过持久图、并行推理器、多模态检验器和裁判，解决语言引导的长期机器人搜索，在CityNav上达到51.8%成功率，超越先前最佳15.7个百分点，并在四旋翼上验证。
AI.motivation: 长期机器人搜索需将自然语言与异构、不完整且模糊的证据（文本、先验地图、时序观测）对齐，核心挑战是在选择目标前决定何处收集证据。
AI.method: 提出WORLDS框架：基于地理空间先验初始化持久图，由感知更新；并行推理器维护竞争性候选解释并请求证据；多模态检验器处理观测；裁判选择目标或请求下一轮。在四旋翼上演示。
AI.result: 在5311个CityNav测试回合中达51.8%导航成功率，最高，超先前最佳15.7个百分点。在1000个共享回合中，50.0% vs 最强适配基线27.9%。检验器验证贡献5.9个百分点。降低推理努力下仍超GeoNav基线18.8个百分点且token更少。四旋翼成功定位三个语言目标，包括地图中缺失的车辆。
AI.conclusion: WORLDS通过维护竞争解释、主动收集证据和基于观测验证，有效提升语言引导搜索性能，并具备实际机器人部署能力。

title: G6D: Geometric Learning-Free RGB-D 6D Pose Solver for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Corresponding author: Chuxiong Hu. Project page: https://ai4control.github.io/G6D-Project-Page
summary: 6D object pose estimation is fundamental to robotic manipulation and automation. Recent zero-shot methods have significantly improved generalization to unseen objects, but most still rely on large-scale pretrained models with substantial GPU computation and memory demands. These requirements complicate deployment on robotic platforms where perception, planning, and control share limited computational resources, while learned intermediate representations offer limited geometric interpretability for task-specific adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose G6D, a learning-free, geometry-driven RGB-D 6D pose solver. Given an RGB-D observation, an object instance mask, camera intrinsics, and a CAD model, G6D generates pose hypotheses through template-based geometric matching and refines them using silhouette and depth consistency, forming a purely geometry-driven pose estimation paradigm. This paradigm requires neither pretrained visual models nor target-specific training and preserves interpretable geometric representations throughout pose estimation. Moreover, adjustable hypothesis counts provide flexible accuracy-computation trade-offs, while a CPU-only configuration supports deployment without GPU resources. Experiments on LineMOD and five BOP19 datasets demonstrate advanced performance. Real-world pick-and-place experiments further demonstrate G6D's applicability to robotic manipulation. The complete project is publicly available at https://ai4control.github.io/G6D-Project-Page .

AI.tldr: G6D 是一种无需学习、几何驱动的 RGB-D 6D 物体姿态估计求解器，可在不依赖预训练模型和目标特定训练的情况下实现姿态估计，并成功应用于机器人抓取放置。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本 6D 姿态估计方法虽提升了泛化能力，但大多依赖大规模预训练模型，GPU 计算与内存需求高，难以部署在计算资源受限且需共享感知、规划与控制的机器人平台；同时学习到的中间表示几何可解释性有限。
AI.method: 输入 RGB-D 观测、物体实例掩码、相机内参和 CAD 模型；通过基于模板的几何匹配生成姿态假设，并利用轮廓和深度一致性进行精化；形成纯几何驱动的姿态估计范式，无需预训练视觉模型和目标特定训练，保持可解释几何表示；可调假设数量以权衡精度与计算，并支持仅 CPU 配置。
AI.result: 在 LineMOD 和五个 BOP19 数据集上取得了先进性能；真实世界抓取放置实验进一步验证了 G6D 在机器人操作中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: G6D 提供了一种无需学习、几何可解释、资源友好且可灵活权衡精度与计算的 6D 姿态估计方案，适用于机器人操作，项目已公开。

title: Extracting Arguments, Not Just Classifying Them: Instruction-Tuned LLMs for Generative Component Detection
summary: Argumentative component detection (ACD) is a core subtask of Argument(ation) Mining (AM) and one of its most challenging aspects, as it requires jointly delimiting argumentative spans and classifying them into components such as claims and premises. While research on this subtask remains relatively limited compared to other AM tasks, most existing approaches formulate it as a simplified sequence labeling problem, component classification, or a pipeline of component segmentation followed by classification. In this paper, we propose ITFACD, a novel approach based on instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) using compact instruction-based prompts, and reframe ACD as a language generation task, enabling arguments to be identified directly from plain text without relying on pre-segmented components. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that our approach achieves higher performance compared to state-of-the-art systems. To the best of our knowledge, this is one of the first attempts to fully model ACD as a generative task, highlighting the potential of instruction tuning for complex AM problems. Our code and the datasets used are openly available in the following GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ITFACD，将论证组件检测（ACD）重构为语言生成任务，利用指令微调的大语言模型和紧凑的指令提示，直接从原始文本中识别并分类论证组件。
AI.motivation: ACD是论证挖掘中的核心且困难子任务，需要同时界定论证片段并将其分类为主张、前提等组件。现有研究相对有限，且多将其简化为序列标注、组件分类或“先分割再分类”的流水线方法。
AI.method: 提出基于指令微调大语言模型（LLMs）的ITFACD方法，使用紧凑的基于指令的提示，将ACD重新表述为语言生成任务，从而无需依赖预先分割的组件即可直接从纯文本中识别论证。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的实验表明，该方法相比当前最先进系统取得了更高性能。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首批将ACD完全建模为生成任务的工作之一，凸显了指令微调在复杂论证挖掘问题上的潜力。代码和所用数据集已在GitHub仓库公开。

title: Object-Centered Reconstruction for Vision-Based 3D Force Estimation
summary: Excessive force may damage tissue and increase the risk of anastomotic leakage in robotic colorectal surgery. Although the da Vinci 5 provides force sensing, this capability is unavailable on earlier da Vinci systems and many other surgical robotic platforms. In this work, we present a vision-based pipeline for estimating 3D interaction forces from soft-tissue deformation in stereo endoscopic video. We dynamically reconstruct the tissue point cloud in an object-centered coordinate frame, track tissue points with geometric constraints, and predict the 3D force vector with a neural network. We progressively evaluate the pipeline on rubber-glove phantoms, ex vivo porcine colons, and in vivo colorectal surgical video sequences. Under varying tissue orientations and positions within the endoscopic view, as well as different camera viewpoints, the proposed method achieves average root mean square error (RMSEs) of 0.77 N and 1.30 N on the phantom and porcine colon, respectively. Compared with the camera-frame representation, the object-centered representation reduces average RMSE by 51.3% and 56.7%, while geometry-constrained tracking reduces RMSE by 19.8% and 25.3% compared with CoTracker. We further qualitatively demonstrate the feasibility of vision-based force estimation on an in vivo colorectal surgical sequence, as a step toward clinical translation of vision-based, sensorless force estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于视觉的3D交互力估计流程，通过立体内窥镜视频中软组织变形预测力，在体模、离体猪结肠和体内手术视频上验证，RMSE较低，为无传感器力估计的临床转化迈出一步。
AI.motivation: 机器人结直肠手术中过大的力会损伤组织并增加吻合口漏风险；da Vinci 5具备力传感，但早期da Vinci系统及许多其他手术机器人平台缺乏此能力，因此需要基于视觉的无传感器力估计方法。
AI.method: 提出视觉流程：动态重建组织点云（物体中心坐标系），几何约束跟踪组织点，神经网络预测3D力向量；在橡胶手套体模、离体猪结肠和体内结直肠手术视频序列上逐步评估。
AI.result: 在不同组织方向、位置和相机视角下，体模和猪结肠的平均RMSE分别为0.77 N和1.30 N；物体中心表示比相机坐标系表示平均RMSE降低51.3%和56.7%；几何约束跟踪比CoTracker降低19.8%和25.3%；并在体内结直肠手术序列上定性验证可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法作为基于视觉、无传感器力估计临床转化的一步，展示了可行性。

title: Rethinking Pivot Programming Languages in Code Language Models
summary: Multilingual code language models transfer skills across programming languages (PLs), but whether any PL occupies a privileged pivot position remains contested: geometric analyses point to C-family languages and Go, while behavioral evidence highlights Python. We revisit this question under controls for representational anisotropy and length variation across PLs, two confounds that compromise prior cosine-based analyses. Across three code models on multilingual competitive-programming data, we study three views of cross-PL organization: pairwise PL geometry, PL-English alignment, and pivoted retrieval through candidate PL representation spaces. The results are relation-dependent. Code-code geometry reveals structured language regions but no universal center; code-English alignment favors high-level scripting languages; and pivoted retrieval favors different intermediate spaces for code-to-code and English-to-code transfer. These findings suggest that Python's special role is better understood as English-facing affinity than as universal geometric centrality.

AI.tldr: 本文在多语言代码模型中重新审视是否存在“特权枢纽”编程语言，并在控制表示各向异性和长度差异后，发现跨语言组织关系依赖于具体任务，Python 的特殊性更多体现在面向英语的亲和性，而非普遍的几何中心性。
AI.motivation: 已有研究对哪种编程语言在多语言代码模型中占据枢纽地位存在争议：几何分析指向 C 族语言和 Go，而行为证据强调 Python。同时，先前基于余弦相似度的分析可能受到表示各向异性和不同编程语言长度变化的干扰。
AI.method: 在三个代码模型和多语言竞赛编程数据上，控制表示各向异性与长度变化，从三个视角分析跨编程语言组织：编程语言两两几何关系、编程语言与英语的对齐、以及在候选编程语言表示空间中的枢纽检索。
AI.result: 结果依赖于具体关系：代码-代码几何显示存在结构化的语言区域，但没有普遍中心；代码-英语对齐更偏向高层脚本语言；枢纽检索表明代码到代码和英语到代码迁移偏好不同的中间表示空间。
AI.conclusion: Python 的特殊角色更适合理解为面向英语的亲和性，而不是在所有跨语言几何关系中的普遍中心性。

title: An Efficient and Effective Watermarking Scheme for the Protection of the Intellectual Property Rights of Video Generative Models
summary: The rapid development of video generative models (VGMs) has enabled the generation of highly realistic synthetic videos, raising concerns about the intellectual property rights (IPR) of these models. In particular, two closely related forensic tasks remain largely unaddressed: synthetic video verification (determining whether a video was generated by a protected VGM) and model ownership verification (determining whether a suspect VGM is an unauthorized copy of a protected VGM). In this paper, we propose a new in-generation watermarking scheme that can address the two verification tasks. First, a novel video watermarking network named VidMark is presented, which incorporates a two-scale discrete wavelet transform (DWT) decomposition and a global temporal attention block (GTAB) to enhance watermark robustness and imperceptibility. Second, we present a decoder-guided fine-tuning procedure. By leveraging the frozen VidMark decoder, this process enables VGMs to synthesize videos carrying an imperceptible, robust, and model-specific watermark. Finally, two verification frameworks are established to perform synthetic video verification and model ownership verification. Extensive experiments on representative VGMs demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves over 99% watermark extraction accuracy and 100% verification accuracy on both tasks, with negligible impact on video generation quality. Furthermore, the watermarks exhibit strong robustness against a comprehensive range of video-level and model-level attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的生成中水印方案，用于解决视频生成模型的合成视频验证和模型所有权验证两个取证任务。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型快速发展带来知识产权风险，但合成视频验证和模型所有权验证这两个密切相关的取证任务尚未得到充分解决。
AI.method: 提出VidMark视频水印网络，结合双尺度离散小波变换和全局时间注意力块；采用解码器引导的微调流程，利用冻结的VidMark解码器使视频生成模型合成带有不可感知、鲁棒且模型特定水印的视频；建立两个验证框架分别执行合成视频验证和模型所有权验证。
AI.result: 在代表性视频生成模型上的实验表明，水印提取准确率超过99%，两个任务的验证准确率均达100%，对视频生成质量影响可忽略，且水印对多种视频级和模型级攻击具有强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方案能有效完成合成视频验证和模型所有权验证任务，同时保持高视频生成质量和强鲁棒性。

title: Grounded Action Model: 3D Grounding as a Foundation for Robotics
summary: Manipulation policies must know which objects matter and where they are, yet the pretrained backbones that current robot foundation models build on, from language in vision-language-action models (VLAs) to video generation in world-action models (WAMs), do not directly require this metric grounding, leaving it to be learned implicitly from robot demonstrations. We propose Grounded Action Models (GAMs), a new paradigm of robot foundation models built with 3D grounding. GAM can be conditioned using language, points, or box prompts, which are first transformed into a shared object-centric representation of the selected objects. This representation captures target-focused visual features and metric object geometry, which is mixed with robot state history through a multi-stream transformer to predict action chunks. Although GAMs can be run autonomously, they can also serve as a low-level controller that a high-level planner controls using its various input modalities, allowing for long-horizon and memory-dependent manipulation. On RoboTwin 2.0, GAM achieves an average success rate of 55.3% across 50 tasks (vs. 52.0% for Spatial Forcing), including 47.6% under scene randomization (vs. 30.4% for Abot-M0), with its action policy trained only on clean-scene demonstrations. On LIBERO-PRO, it achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate of 61% (vs. 53% for $π_{0.5}$) across 16 perturbation settings, with the largest gains when targets are relocated or newly designated. On two real robots, GAM retains 17/20 successes under visual shift on a bimanual YAM versus 4/20 for $π_{0.5}$, while its composition with a Molmo2 planner on a Franka achieves 64.7% ID and 49.8% OOD step completion on long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Grounded Action Models (GAMs)，一种基于3D grounding的机器人基础模型新范式。GAM可将语言、点或框提示转化为共享的以对象为中心的表示，结合机器人状态历史预测动作块。它既能自主运行，也可作为高层规划器的低层控制器。实验表明GAM在多个基准和真实机器人上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人基础模型（如视觉-语言-动作模型VLA和世界动作模型WAM）所依赖的预训练骨干网络并不直接要求度量基础（metric grounding），导致对象重要性和位置信息只能从机器人演示中隐式学习，限制了泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出Grounded Action Models (GAMs)，以3D grounding构建。GAM可接受语言、点或框提示，并将其转化为共享的以对象为中心的表示。该表示捕捉目标聚焦的视觉特征和度量对象几何，并通过多流Transformer与机器人状态历史混合，预测动作块。GAM可自主运行，也可作为高层规划器的低层控制器，支持长时程和记忆依赖的操作。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0上，GAM在50个任务中平均成功率达55.3%（对比Spatial Forcing的52.0%），场景随机化下为47.6%（对比Abot-M0的30.4%），且动作策略仅在干净场景演示上训练。在LIBERO-PRO上，在16种扰动设置下取得61%的最优平均成功率（对比π0.5的53%），目标重定位或新指定时增益最大。在双机械臂YAM上，视觉偏移下GAM保持17/20成功（π0.5为4/20）；与Molmo2规划器结合在Franka上，长时程和记忆依赖任务中ID步完成率64.7%，OOD为49.8%。
AI.conclusion: GAM通过显式3D grounding提升了机器人基础模型的泛化性和鲁棒性，在模拟和真实环境中均优于现有方法，并可作为低层控制器与高层规划器组合，有效处理长时程和记忆依赖的复杂操作任务。

title: Partner-Specific Affective Precision in Social Active Inference
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures. Accepted as a full paper at the 7th International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI 2026). Code: https://github.com/har5h1l/affect_aif
summary: In multi-agent social settings, model reliability varies across relationships. Beyond inferring what others will do, an agent must calibrate how confidently those inferences should guide policy selection for each relationship. An agent may maintain a well-validated model of one partner, a fragile model of another, and a model under revision for a third; collapsing these into a single confidence estimate loses information relevant to policy selection. We therefore formalize affective precision as a relationship-specific metacognitive estimate of confidence in the current partner model. Each partner's behavioral evidence updates a local confidence estimate that modulates policy precision during selection, regulating how strongly current beliefs are expressed in policy rather than changing the content of those beliefs. Simulations in a multi-partner graded trust game show that partner-local affective precision influences behavior primarily through policy commitment rather than direct improvement of partner-state inference. Because the mechanism tracks partner-response predictability rather than realized payoff, greater confidence produces sharper policy commitment without necessarily producing higher rewards. Under abrupt shifts in social behavior, confidence accumulated from previously reliable predictions can remain behaviorally active after the relationship changes, showing that confidence revision can lag behind social change. Finally, varying precision gain and priors produce distinct trust-calibration dynamics, showing how confidence accumulation and revision depend on model parameters. Together, these results show how relationship-specific affective precision can distinguish social prediction from social policy commitment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“关系特异性情感精度”，即对每个伙伴模型信心的元认知估计，并用多伙伴分级信任博弈仿真表明，它主要通过调节策略承诺而非改变伙伴状态推断来影响社会行为。
AI.motivation: 多智能体社会关系中，模型可靠性因关系而异。仅推断他人行为不够，智能体还需校准这些推断在策略选择中的置信度。将不同伙伴的置信度合并为单一估计，会丢失与策略选择相关的信息。
AI.method: 形式化“情感精度”为关系特异性的元认知置信估计；每个伙伴的行为证据更新局部置信估计，并在策略选择中调制策略精度，从而调节当前信念在策略中的表达强度，而不改变信念内容。采用多伙伴分级信任博弈进行仿真，并考察精度增益、先验、社会行为突变等条件。
AI.result: 伙伴局部情感精度主要通过策略承诺影响行为，而非直接改善伙伴状态推断。机制追踪的是伙伴反应可预测性而非实际收益，因此更高置信带来更尖锐的策略承诺，但不必然带来更高奖励。社会行为突变时，基于先前可靠预测积累的置信仍可能在关系变化后继续影响行为，表明置信修正可能滞后于社会变化。不同精度增益和先验产生不同信任校准动态。
AI.conclusion: 关系特异性情感精度能区分社会预测与社会策略承诺，为理解多伙伴社会互动中的置信校准和策略选择提供机制解释。

title: StyleAT: Defending Face Recognition Against Semantic Attacks
comment: Accepted at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026), Lancaster, UK. 14 pages main text plus 13 pages of appendices, 15 figures, 12 tables
summary: With face-recognition models now embedded in everyday authentication and surveillance, recent works have pinpointed a critical weakness: these models remain acutely vulnerable to adversarial semantic edits. I.e., adversarially produced semantic alterations to the input, such as slight aging or pose changes, can induce misclassifications. Certain existing attacks are powerful, but they can be computationally costly, rendering them inadequate for developing defenses (e.g., through adversarial training). To fill the gap, we introduce BoundStyle, a potent semantic attack operating in StyleGAN's rich latent space to maximize misclassification rates. Notably, BoundStyle achieves high attack success rates while being ${\sim}{\times}9.5$ faster than existing state-of-the-art attacks, making it suitable for adversarial training. Building on BoundStyle, we develop StyleAT, an efficient adversarial training scheme that incorporates low-budget attack variants yet defends against stronger and unseen semantic attacks. We evaluate on two datasets unseen during training and seven models, and find that StyleAT boosts robust accuracy against state-of-the-art attacks and outperforms common defenses in various settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BoundStyle，一种在StyleGAN潜空间中高效生成语义对抗攻击的方法，并基于它设计StyleAT对抗训练方案，以提升人脸识别模型对语义编辑攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别模型广泛用于认证与监控，但现有研究表明其对语义对抗编辑（如轻微老化、姿态变化）非常脆弱。已有攻击虽强，但计算成本高，难以用于对抗训练等防御开发。
AI.method: 提出BoundStyle，在StyleGAN的丰富潜空间中操作，最大化误分类率；并基于BoundStyle开发StyleAT对抗训练方案，使用低预算攻击变体进行训练，以防御更强和未见过的语义攻击。
AI.result: BoundStyle在保持高攻击成功率的同时，比现有最先进攻击快约9.5倍，适合对抗训练。StyleAT在训练未见过的两个数据集和七个模型上评估，提升了对最先进攻击的鲁棒准确率，并在多种设置下优于常见防御方法。
AI.conclusion: BoundStyle弥补了高效语义对抗攻击的空白，StyleAT则证明利用低预算攻击变体进行对抗训练可有效防御更强和未见过的语义攻击，提升人脸识别模型鲁棒性。

title: Attributable Post-Rationalization in RAG Citations: A Controlled Reproduction and an RLVR Comparison
summary:
A RAG system can hand you the right answer and cite a source it did not actually use. Models output these unfaithful citations via post-rationalization: they write the answer first and then attach a citation to whatever passage looks close enough. Search agents are now trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), which pays them for getting the answer right. We asked whether that training also teaches them to cite honestly.
  Improving an existing methodology with a required control, we compared an instruction-tuned model against three RLVR agents trained from it, on four question-answering datasets, using only free-tier Kaggle GPUs. Post-rationalization is everywhere: on Wikipedia-based questions roughly one citation in seven is unfaithful. RLVR does not fix it. The agents post-rationalize at their base model's rate, and one lands slightly worse. Rewarding correct answers buys nothing in citation faithfulness, so faithfulness has to be trained and measured on its own terms.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验RLVR训练能否让RAG搜索智能体诚实引用来源，发现答案正确率奖励并不能改善引用忠实性，后合理化普遍存在。
AI.motivation: RAG系统常给出正确答案却引用未实际使用的来源，模型通过后合理化生成不忠实引用。RLVR只奖励答案正确，作者追问这种训练是否也能教会模型诚实引用。
AI.method: 在现有方法上加入必要控制，将指令微调模型与由其训练的3个RLVR智能体进行比较，在4个问答数据集上评估，仅使用Kaggle免费GPU。
AI.result: 后合理化普遍存在：在维基百科类问题上约七分之一引用不忠实。RLVR并未修复该问题，智能体后合理化率与基座模型相当，其中一个略差。奖励正确答案对引用忠实性没有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 引用忠实性不能靠答案正确性奖励自然获得，必须作为独立目标进行训练和评估。

title: Auditing Political Alignment in LLM Assistants: Engagement, Stance, and User Identity
comment: 51 pages, 6 figures. Preregistered; registration at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21135155
summary: LLM-based AI systems answer political questions for hundreds of millions of people. Current audits measure what they say to an average user, but their behavior is dynamic. I argue that their political behavior is a set of policies over whom to answer, what to say, and whether to engage at all, conditional on the topic and what the system knows about the user. I call these policies the system's speech regime, which is how a developer settles the tradeoff between answering, accommodating the user, and refusing, each of which carries a cost that varies by topic. I derive a typology of five regimes from two dimensions, engagement and stance. I test six AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek) in a preregistered experiment of 7,500 multi-turn conversations that randomly assign the user's political identity across five topics: abortion, Catalan independence, climate change, Nazism, and a zero-stakes control (pineapple on pizza). Two LLM judges from different developers score every answer, validated against human coding, and refusal is treated as an outcome rather than missing data. Every system accommodates the user on the control topic, showing that political restraint is a policy. On contested topics the systems fall into different regimes: on abortion, GPT engages and mirrors every user, Gemma refuses everyone, Claude answers strongly conservative users 35 percent of the time and almost no one else, and Grok accommodates conservatives only. On settled topics such as climate change and Nazism, five systems hold firm for every user. The systems also infer the user's overall ideology, so accommodation can spill over to topics not yet discussed. A comparison of two Grok releases shows the regime changing between versions in a way current audits miss. Speech regimes matter for alignment research and for polarization, political knowledge, and the quality of democracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“言论体制”（speech regime）概念，认为LLM的政治行为是对不同用户和议题的回答、迎合或拒绝策略。通过6个AI系统、7500段多轮对话的预注册实验，发现系统在低风险议题上普遍迎合，在争议议题上形成不同体制，并会推断用户意识形态导致迎合溢出。
AI.motivation: 现有审计通常只衡量AI对“平均用户”的回应，忽视其政治行为随用户身份和议题变化的动态性。作者希望揭示LLM如何在回答、迎合与拒绝之间取舍，以及这些策略如何影响对齐、极化和民主质量。
AI.method: 将系统政治行为概念化为“言论体制”，从参与和立场两个维度推导出五种类型。测试OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI、Google、Mistral、DeepSeek六类系统，开展7500段多轮对话的预注册实验，随机分配用户政治身份，覆盖堕胎、加泰罗尼亚独立、气候变化、纳粹和低风险控制议题（披萨加菠萝）。由来自不同开发者的两个LLM评委评分，并以人工编码验证，将拒绝视为结果而非缺失数据。
AI.result: 所有系统在控制议题上都迎合用户，说明政治克制是一种策略。在争议议题上系统分化：堕胎议题中，GPT参与并镜像所有用户，Gemma拒绝所有人，Claude仅对强保守用户约35%回答而几乎不回答其他人，Grok只迎合保守派。在气候变化和纳粹等较稳定议题上，五个系统对所有用户都保持坚定立场。系统还会推断用户整体意识形态，使迎合溢出到尚未讨论的议题。比较两个Grok版本显示，言论体制会在版本间变化，而现有审计难以捕捉。
AI.conclusion: 言论体制对对齐研究以及极化、政治知识和民主质量具有重要意义。当前审计方法会遗漏LLM政治行为的条件性、动态性和版本变化，需要新的评估框架。

title: Pinocchio: Fast Uncertainty Estimates for Black-Box Language Models
summary: In high-stakes decision-making applications of large language models (LLMs), practitioners require not only accurate LLMs but also uncertainty estimates for their predictions. Existing approaches to uncertainty estimation for LLMs require access to log-probabilities output by the model or require fine-tuning access. However, many industrial LLM products use closed-source API models, and many such API models like GPT do not return log-probabilities and may not allow fine-tuning. We introduce Pinocchio, an external calibrator that estimates the correctness of responses from black-box API models. Trained jointly on responses from seven LLMs, it achieves 0.862 AUROC predicting the correctness of held-out responses from those same models, and shows zero-shot transfer to thirteen unseen models across eight organizations. Our model needs only a single forward pass to generate an uncertainty estimate and requires no access to the target model's logits, weights, or internal states. A lightweight text only 0.8B checkpoint matches our largest model's AUROC. We release code for adding uncertainty estimation to existing repos in only two additional lines of code.

AI.tldr: 提出 Pinocchio，一种面向黑盒 API 大语言模型的外部校准器，可在不访问模型对数概率、权重或内部状态的情况下估计回答正确性。
AI.motivation: 高风险决策场景需要 LLM 不仅准确，还要提供不确定性估计；但现有方法依赖 log-probabilities 或微调权限，而许多闭源 API 模型（如 GPT）不返回 log-probabilities，也可能不允许微调。
AI.method: 训练一个外部校准器，联合使用来自 7 个 LLM 的响应进行训练；仅需一次前向传播即可生成不确定性估计，不访问目标模型的 logits、权重或内部状态；还提供轻量级纯文本 0.8B 检查点。
AI.result: 在同一批留出响应上达到 0.862 AUROC；零样本迁移到 8 个机构的 13 个未见模型；0.8B 小模型可匹配最大模型的 AUROC；只需额外两行代码即可为现有仓库加入不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: Pinocchio 为闭源黑盒 API 模型提供了一种实用、低成本的不确定性估计方案，有助于高风险场景下的 LLM 部署与决策。

title: Collapse, Not Complexity: Failure-Conditioned Decomposition Repair for End-to-End Document Parsing
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: End-to-end document parsers increasingly offer an optional reasoning mode for complex pages. On a 180-page entropy-stratified discovery sample with one frozen 4B checkpoint, complexity is the wrong decision variable. Reasoning lowers mean quality by 2.21 Overall at 1.54x tokens; a preregistered input-only model cannot predict its signed benefit (held-out AUROC 0.47, indistinguishable from chance). The benefit concentrates on pages whose ordinary pass has already collapsed, and they do not look complex: shared collapses have lower layout entropy than healthy ones yet consume 19x the tokens as degenerate repetition that doubling the budget does not cure. Switching modes rarely repairs them: 83% recur under reasoning. We instead detect collapse from the ordinary-pass trace, decompose the page by projection, and re-parse each region. Repair gains 1.40 Overall (95% CI [0.68, 2.16]) at 1.13x tokens, replicates across three checkpoints, and, with all parameters frozen, gains 2.41 (CI [1.64, 3.46]) on the remaining 1,175 benchmark pages.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究文档解析器的可选推理模式：在复杂页面上，推理并不按“复杂度”带来收益，反而平均降低质量并增加 token。更有效的策略是检测普通解析中的崩溃，并通过投影分解区域后重新解析。
AI.motivation: 端到端文档解析器常为复杂页面提供推理模式，但何时应启用推理、复杂度是否是正确的决策变量尚不明确。
AI.method: 在180页熵分层发现样本上使用冻结的4B检查点；检验预注册的仅输入预测模型；分析普通解析轨迹以检测崩溃；将页面按投影分解为区域并逐区域重新解析；在三个检查点和剩余1175页基准上验证。
