Existing approaches often directly fuse the image with other modalities to align different entities. Although simple, such strategies overlook the potential noise in the images and their semantic misalignment with corresponding entities, resulting in suboptimal fusion and degraded performance. Addressing this, we propose a novel Reliability-Aware framework for MMEA (RA-MMEA), which assesses visual reliability and adaptively improves unreliable visual representations for robust entity alignment. The core lies in two modules, including dependency-aware visual reliability prediction (DA-VRP) and stability-regularized visual embedding generation (SR-VEG). The former aims to estimate the reliability of an image by leveraging multi-modal dependency within the entity, while the latter focuses on producing alternative visual representation conditioned on semantics encoded in textual modalities for multi-modal fusion. Compared to current methods, RA-MMEA enables more reliable visual representations for modality fusion, thereby improving performance. In extensive experiments, RA-MMEA achieves state-of-the-art results, verifying the importance of reliable visual modality for entity alignment and the effectiveness of RA-MMEA. The code and results will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可靠性感知的多模态实体对齐框架RA-MMEA，通过评估视觉可靠性并自适应改进不可靠的视觉表示，实现更稳健的实体对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有方法直接融合图像与其他模态，但忽略了图像中的潜在噪声及其与对应实体的语义不对齐，导致融合效果不佳和性能下降。
AI.method: 提出RA-MMEA框架，包含两个核心模块：依赖感知的视觉可靠性预测（DA-VRP）和稳定性正则化的视觉嵌入生成（SR-VEG）。DA-VRP利用实体内的多模态依赖关系估计图像的可靠性；SR-VEG基于文本模态编码的语义生成替代视觉表示，用于多模态融合。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RA-MMEA达到了最先进的结果，验证了可靠视觉模态对于实体对齐的重要性以及RA-MMEA的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RA-MMEA能够为模态融合提供更可靠的视觉表示，从而提高性能。代码和结果将发布。

title: Propose, Verify, Commit: Evidence-Grounded Memory for Long-Horizon Multi-Actor Conversations
summary: Long-horizon conversational memory is especially challenging in multi-actor settings, where relevant evidence is distributed across participants and contexts and previously established information may later be revised. We introduce EGMEMORY, which formulates long-horizon multi-actor memory as a searchable state machine that separates persistent message-level evidence from an explicit active state. At write time, adaptive state resolution and an evidence-grounded propose-verify-commit protocol govern how this state evolves. At read time, adaptive evidence navigation iteratively resolves the state and supporting evidence required for a query, using conversational structure to narrow the search space and lexical-semantic relevance to rank candidates. The system operates through prompting and tool use without memory-specific policy training. EGMEMORY achieves 68.2% on GroupMemBench and 77.9% on EverMemBench, outperforming the strongest evaluated baselines by 22.7 and 21.4 percentage points, respectively. It further reaches 73.6% on the dyadic LoCoMo benchmark, demonstrating generalization beyond multi-actor conversations. We will release the codebase upon formal publication.

AI.tldr: 提出EGMEMORY，将长时程多参与者对话记忆建模为可搜索状态机，通过显式活动状态与消息级证据分离，在写入和读取阶段分别进行状态解析与证据导航，无需专门策略训练。
AI.motivation: 多参与者场景下的长时程对话记忆极具挑战：相关证据分散在不同参与者与上下文中，且先前信息可能被后续修订。
AI.method: EGMEMORY将记忆形式化为可搜索状态机，分离持久消息级证据与显式活动状态。写入时采用自适应状态解析和基于证据的propose-verify-commit协议；读取时采用自适应证据导航，利用对话结构缩小搜索空间，并用词汇-语义相关性排序候选。系统仅通过提示和工具使用运行，不训练记忆专用策略。
AI.result: 在GroupMemBench上达到68.2%，在EverMemBench上达到77.9%，分别超过最强基线22.7和21.4个百分点；在双人LoCoMo基准上达到73.6%，显示可泛化到多参与者对话之外。
AI.conclusion: EGMEMORY能有效处理长时程多参与者记忆，并具备跨场景泛化能力；代码将在正式发表后发布。

title: Toward Human-in-the-Loop Robot Failure Recovery: Bridging Communication Gaps in Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: Robots can recover from failures by asking bystanders for help, but effective human-in-the-loop recovery requires communication that accounts for differences in people's knowledge. Prior inverse-semantics work generates requests using a single listener model, leaving differences in listener knowledge untested. We introduce Listener Differences in Human-Robot Interaction (LD-HRI), a game, dataset, and benchmark that evaluates speakers through human listener performance. Our evaluation examines request properties, large language model (LLM) speakers, and inverse-semantics request-selection algorithms under controlled differences in listener information. The corpus contains 446 human-written requests and 1{,}302 listener trials. We additionally evaluated 24 frozen LLM-written requests with 70 human listeners across 560 trials. Novice success is descriptively higher with model-written requests across all four tasks, yet both request sources leave substantial expert--novice gaps, including 16 percentage points for LLM requests. LD-HRI makes these gaps measurable, providing a foundation for designing more robust communication in human-robot and human-agent interaction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LD-HRI（人机交互中的听者差异）游戏、数据集和基准，通过人类听者表现评估说话者，研究请求属性、LLM说话者和逆语义请求选择算法在受控听者信息差异下的表现。
AI.motivation: 机器人需通过向旁观者求助来从故障中恢复，但有效的人机回环恢复需要沟通考虑人们的知识差异；先前逆语义工作使用单一听者模型生成请求，未测试听者知识差异。
AI.method: 引入LD-HRI游戏、数据集和基准，以人类听者表现评估说话者；评估请求属性、LLM说话者、逆语义请求选择算法，并控制听者信息差异。语料库含446个人类请求和1302次听者试验；另评估24个LLM请求与70名人类听者的560次试验。
AI.result: 模型生成的请求在所有四个任务中新手成功率描述性更高，但两种请求来源均存在显著的专家-新手差距，LLM请求差距达16个百分点。
AI.conclusion: LD-HRI使这些差距可测量，为人机交互和人-智能体交互中设计更稳健的沟通提供了基础。

title: BindCLIP: One Balanced Coupling For Compositional Vision Language Scoring
summary: Global vision--language similarities compress an image and a caption into one vector, preserving semantics but not which word corresponds to which region or how those regions are arranged; a model can recognize every word and object yet prefer a compositionally incorrect caption. We argue that a frozen encoder retains this association structure, so the problem is to read it rather than to rebuild it beside the pretrained similarity. We introduce BindCLIP, a pairwise scorer built on one latent object: a balanced token--patch--depth optimal-transport coupling that places both candidate captions and several visual depths in a single plan. Semantic, entity, order, and spatial evidence are read as energies of this state, and exchanging the candidates permutes the plan, making the score exactly antisymmetric. A geometric refinement inside the coupling contracts moves that the candidates and the visual depths do not support. No task label, parser, relation inventory, or detector is used. One checkpoint and one inference path improve the official What'sUp, ARO, and SugarCrepe benchmarks over frozen global CLIP, with the strongest transfer on the relation splits. Controls rule out patch access and caption-length shortcuts, and an inference-time lesion localizes spatial arrangement to the coupling.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BindCLIP，利用冻结视觉-语言模型中隐含的 token-patch-depth 关联结构，通过最优传输耦合来评估图文对，从而提升组合式图文理解。
AI.motivation: 全局视觉-语言相似度将整张图与整句描述压缩为单一向量，虽保留语义，却丢失了词与图像区域对应关系及区域排列信息，导致模型能识别所有词和物体，却可能偏好组合错误的描述。作者认为冻结编码器中仍保留这种关联结构，关键是如何读取而非重建它。
AI.method: 提出 BindCLIP，一个基于单一隐变量的成对评分器：构建平衡的 token-patch-depth 最优传输耦合，将候选描述与多个视觉深度放入同一传输计划。语义、实体、顺序和空间证据被读取为该状态的能量；交换候选描述会置换该计划，使评分严格反对称。耦合内部还进行几何精炼，抑制候选与视觉深度不支持的移动。方法不使用任务标签、解析器、关系清单或检测器。
AI.result: 在 What'sUp、ARO 和 SugarCrepe 官方基准上，单个检查点和单条推理路径优于冻结的全局 CLIP，尤其在关系切分上迁移最强。控制实验排除了 patch 访问和描述长度捷径，推理时损伤实验将空间排列定位到该耦合中。
AI.conclusion: 从冻结的视觉-语言编码器中读取 token-patch-depth 关联结构，可在不额外监督和复杂组件的情况下有效提升组合式图文匹配，表明组合理解可通过对齐耦合能量实现。

title: Machine-Interpretable Information: Compiling Documents into Searchable and Readable Protocol States
summary: Long-context language models interface with external knowledge through raw natural language. In retrieval-augmented systems, this creates a persistent index-payload schism: dense vectors enable searchable routing, but models must re-ingest lengthy text payloads for reasoning at O(N^2) attention cost. Existing compression methods further produce private states tied to specific architectures. We introduce Machine-Interpretable Information (MII), the first agent-to-agent (A2A) document-to-state protocol. A dual-timescale state-space Writer compiles documents into a canonical, fixed-bandwidth state (56 tokens), and a lightweight Translator maps it into any frozen Reader's embedding space, reducing query-time cost to O(K). The resulting .mii artifact unifies Retrieval (searchable geometry), Reasoning (global memory), and Reconstruction (grounded details) in a single transferable medium. We demonstrate strong cross-model interoperability across heterogeneous LLMs (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral) -- despite the Writer using a legacy GPT-2 vocabulary, forcing genuine semantic translation rather than token-level memorization. Mechanistic probes reveal modular latent structure: entity representations can be causally traced and zero-shot transplanted between unrelated document states while remaining decodable. To address lexical reconstruction under fixed bandwidth, we propose Residual-MII, a cache hierarchy combining compiled global memory with sparse local evidence. On HotpotQA (7,405 queries), Residual-MII exceeds full-context Exact Match at approximately 7% of the attention FLOPs, suggesting a paradigm shift toward compiled, transferable neural document formats.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Machine-Interpretable Information（MII），一种智能体到智能体的文档到状态协议，将文档编译为固定带宽的规范化神经状态，并通过轻量 Translator 映射到任意冻结 Reader 的嵌入空间，从而统一检索、推理与重建，实现跨模型可迁移的压缩文档格式。
AI.motivation: 长上下文语言模型通过原始自然语言与外部知识交互，在检索增强系统中存在持久的“索引-载荷”割裂：稠密向量便于可搜索路由，但推理时仍需重新摄入长文本，带来 O(N^2) 注意力成本；现有压缩方法产生与特定架构绑定的私有状态，难以迁移。
AI.method: 提出 MII 协议：双时间尺度状态空间 Writer 将文档编译为规范化固定带宽状态（56 tokens）；轻量 Translator 将其映射到任意冻结 Reader 的嵌入空间，将查询时成本降至 O(K)。生成 .mii 工件统一检索（可搜索几何）、推理（全局记忆）与重建（有依据细节）。提出 Residual-MII，用缓存层级结合编译全局记忆与稀疏局部证据，解决固定带宽下的词汇重建。
AI.result: 在 Llama、Qwen、Mistral 等异构 LLM 间展现强跨模型互操作性，尽管 Writer 使用旧版 GPT-2 词表，仍迫使真实语义翻译而非词元级记忆。机制探针揭示模块化潜在结构：实体表示可因果追踪，并可在无关文档状态间零样本移植且保持可解码。在 HotpotQA（7,405 条查询）上，Residual-MII 以约 7% 的注意力 FLOPs 超过全上下文 Exact Match。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，编译式、可迁移的神经文档格式有望推动范式转变，缓解检索增强系统中的索引-载荷割裂与高注意力成本问题。

title: RPMem: Learning Long-Term Recurrent Parametric Memory Across Sessions for LLM Agents
summary: Long-running LLM agents require memory that persists and evolves across sessions. Text-based memory retrieves and reconstructs past interactions at every query, making long-horizon performance increasingly dependent on retrieval quality and contextual reasoning as histories grow. Parametric memory encodes experience directly into model computation, but existing approaches provide limited support for cross-session memory evolution. Their coupling to a specific backbone further restricts memory reuse after model replacement. We introduce RPMem, a two-stage architecture that compiles each session into a model-independent latent memory through forward computation and selectively integrates it with retained memory via a task-trained recurrent gate. The consolidated memory is then mapped to backbone-specific low-rank adaptation (LoRA) parameters, allowing the encoding capability to transfer when the backbone is replaced. Evaluation across three long-term memory benchmarks and five diverse backbones demonstrates broad generalization with near-constant update cost and memory footprint. With Qwen3-8B on PERMA, RPMem reaches 85.52%, outperforming the strongest parametric and text-based baselines by 5.32 and 12.98 percentage points, respectively. Ablations validate the complementary roles of session compilation and cross-session consolidation, while dynamics analyses reveal that the gate acquires task-specific memory integration strategies. These results establish RPMem as a lifecycle-independent parametric memory framework that maintains evolving cross-session memory that remains reusable across backbone replacements. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Quark-Medical/rpmem/tree/main.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RPMem，一种两阶段参数化记忆框架，可将每个会话编译为与模型无关的潜在记忆，并跨会话选择性整合后映射为骨干模型特定的 LoRA 参数，实现长期记忆的持久演化与复用。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的 LLM 智能体需要跨会话持久且演化的记忆。文本记忆每次查询都需检索和重建历史，性能依赖检索质量；现有参数化记忆对跨会话记忆演化支持有限，且与特定骨干模型耦合，模型替换后难以复用。
AI.method: RPMem 采用两阶段架构：第一阶段通过前向计算将每个会话编译为与模型无关的潜在记忆；第二阶段通过任务训练的循环门控，选择性地将其与保留记忆整合。整合后的记忆再映射为骨干模型特定的低秩适配（LoRA）参数，从而在替换骨干模型时仍可迁移记忆编码能力。
AI.result: 在三个长期记忆基准和五种不同骨干模型上验证了泛化能力，更新成本和内存占用近乎恒定。在 PERMA 上，Qwen3-8B 达到 85.52%，分别超过最强参数化基线和文本基线 5.32 和 12.98 个百分点。消融实验验证了会话编译与跨会话整合的互补作用，动态分析表明门控学习到任务特定的记忆整合策略。
AI.conclusion: RPMem 是一种生命周期无关的参数化记忆框架，能够维护不断演化的跨会话记忆，并支持在骨干模型替换后复用，为长期 LLM 智能体提供可扩展的记忆方案。

title: Perplexity Predicts Protection: Choosing Pretrained Backbones for Worst-Client Fairness in Federated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Federated learning lets multiple parties train a shared model without pooling their data, but a client with far less data than the others can end up poorly served even when the group's average accuracy looks fine. We ask whether the choice of pretrained backbone affects this under LoRA fine-tuning, and whether per-word perplexity on the target text predicts which backbone helps the worst-off client before federated training starts. We ran 313 experiments across three text-classification datasets and three similarly sized backbones (RoBERTa, BERTweet, PubMedBERT), each compared against a task-specific baseline on identical data splits. Lower-perplexity backbones consistently produced larger gains for the worst-performing client, with a rank correlation of -0.87 across nine dataset-backbone pairs; a backbone held out of the analysis confirmed the pattern. Personalization with Ditto recovered only 4-12% of the gap between training alone and full federation, and removing aggregation entirely erased the benefit. A client's update also showed no sign of conflicting with the group's update; the two are close to orthogonal, ruling out one proposed explanation for this failure. Practically: measure perplexity on a sample of task text before choosing a backbone, and do not rely on personalization to protect a data-poor client. We release our code, predictions, and full results for others to test.

AI.tldr: 研究联邦学习LoRA微调下，预训练骨干选择对数据稀缺客户端的影响，发现目标文本困惑度可预测最差客户端的收益，且个性化方法Ditto仅能恢复4-12%的差距。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中数据量少的客户端即使整体平均准确率良好也可能表现不佳，探究预训练骨干选择是否影响此问题，以及困惑度能否在训练前预测帮助最差客户端的骨干。
AI.method: 在三个文本分类数据集和三个规模相近的骨干（RoBERTa、BERTweet、PubMedBERT）上进行313次实验，使用LoRA微调并与任务特定基线对比；分析困惑度与最差客户端收益的相关性，测试Ditto个性化及去除聚合的影响。
AI.result: 低困惑度骨干持续为最差客户端带来更大收益，九个数据集-骨干对秩相关-0.87，留出骨干验证了模式；Ditto仅恢复4-12%的单独训练与完全联邦之间的差距，去除聚合则收益消失；客户端更新与组更新近似正交，排除了冲突解释。
AI.conclusion: 选择骨干前应在任务文本样本上测量困惑度，且不应依赖个性化保护数据稀缺客户端；发布代码、预测和完整结果供验证。

title: When Does Touch Matter? Charting the Vision-Interaction Gap in Cluttered Dexterous Grasping
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Project website: https://interaction-dex-grasp.github.io/
summary: Dexterous grasping in clutter poses a basic sensing question: when do tactile measurements and external wrench estimates improve on visual geometry? Occlusion and contact can obscure grasp quality, motivating a controlled evaluation of these interaction signals. We present a controlled real-world study over five tabletop scene conditions on a dexterous system that combines vision, per-finger and wrist wrench estimates, and distributed fingertip taxels. With demonstrations, visual observations, action space, and compliant control fixed, we compare vision-only, wrench, taxel, and combined policies plus representation and fusion baselines. The combined policy succeeds in 24/25 trials versus 14/25 for vision only, and 15/15 versus 6/15 across the three confined conditions. Ablations show that wrench and taxel feedback are complementary. Behavioral comparisons show that interaction feedback enables earlier rejection of inadequate contacts, regrasping before lift, and more stable grasps. To our knowledge, this is the first real-world study to combine and separately evaluate these interaction modalities for target-oriented dexterous grasping in clutter. These results chart a widening vision-interaction gap and position cluttered dexterous grasping as a benchmark for determining when the learned policy needs interaction sensing. Project website: https://interaction-dex-grasp.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该研究在真实世界中受控比较视觉、力/力矩和触觉阵列等交互传感对杂乱场景灵巧抓取的影响，发现融合交互反馈显著优于纯视觉。
AI.motivation: 杂乱环境中的遮挡与接触不确定性会掩盖抓取质量，需要明确触觉测量和外力/力矩估计何时能补充视觉几何信息，并系统评估各交互模态的作用。
AI.method: 在灵巧手系统上结合视觉、逐指与腕部力/力矩估计、分布式指尖触觉单元，固定演示、视觉观测、动作空间和柔顺控制，比较纯视觉、wrench、taxel、组合策略及表示与融合基线，并在五种桌面场景条件下开展真实世界受控实验和消融分析。
AI.result: 组合策略成功率为24/25，纯视觉为14/25；在三种受限条件下为15/15对6/15。消融表明wrench与taxel反馈互补，交互反馈使策略更早拒绝不当接触、在提离前重抓并实现更稳定抓取。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个在真实世界中结合并单独评估这些交互模态用于杂乱环境目标导向灵巧抓取的研究，结果揭示了视觉-交互差距，并将杂乱灵巧抓取作为判断学习策略何时需要交互传感的基准。

title: Safety Control of a Hyper-redundant Robot via Adaptive Weighted Control Barrier Functions
summary: Hyper-redundant robots are well suited for confined-space manipulation due to their high dexterity, but safe operation in cluttered environments remains challenging. In addition, their slender structures often lead to uneven load distributions and nonuniform tracking errors along the body. To address these issues, this work proposes a weighted control barrier functions (W-CBFs) framework that enforces safety constraints while reducing tracking errors caused by uneven loading. The proposed controller was first evaluated on a circular path-following task under different obstacle configurations. With fixed weights, compared to the non-weighted method, the maximum reduction in root-mean-square (RMS) tracking error was 59.6\% in simulation and 87.7\% in physical experiments. An adaptive weighting strategy was then investigated based on the discrepancy between simulated and experimental performance under different mapping functions. The RMS errors were further reduced by 21.9\% and 8.5\%, respectively, although the error increases when obstacles were located close to the robot body. Finally, the robot was evaluated in a cleaning task requiring coverage of a rectangular area and compared with manual teleoperation. Although the controller was not explicitly optimized for area coverage, the autonomous strategy achieved comparable or better coverage performance while avoiding collisions with the surrounding frame, whereas collisions occurred during manual operation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种加权控制屏障函数（W-CBFs）框架，用于超冗余机器人，在保证安全约束的同时减少因负载不均导致的跟踪误差。
AI.motivation: 超冗余机器人适用于受限空间操作，但在杂乱环境中安全运行仍具挑战性，且其细长结构常导致负载分布不均和沿身体的非均匀跟踪误差。
AI.method: 提出加权控制屏障函数（W-CBFs）框架，在安全约束下减少跟踪误差。首先在不同障碍配置下进行圆形路径跟踪任务评估，比较固定权重与非加权方法。然后研究基于仿真与实验差异的自适应权重策略，采用不同映射函数。最后在矩形区域覆盖清洁任务中与手动遥操作进行比较。
AI.result: 固定权重下，相比非加权方法，RMS跟踪误差在仿真中最大减少59.6%，在物理实验中减少87.7%。自适应权重策略进一步将RMS误差分别减少21.9%和8.5%，但当障碍物靠近机器人本体时误差增加。在清洁任务中，自主策略实现了与手动遥操作相当或更好的覆盖性能，同时避免了与周围框架的碰撞，而手动操作发生了碰撞。
AI.conclusion: W-CBFs框架能有效保证安全并减少跟踪误差，自适应权重策略可进一步改善性能，但在障碍物靠近时存在局限。自主策略在覆盖任务中安全有效。

title: Dexterous Robot Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Contact-Anchored Retargeting and Residual Policy Learning
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Technical report. Code: https://github.com/DexGEM-Lab/real2sim2real
summary: Learning dexterous manipulation from demonstrations is bottlenecked by data: the contact forces that determine whether a grasp succeeds are absent from every scalable source of human demonstrations. This paper builds on two observations. First, what survives the change from a human hand to a robot hand is the contact structure of a demonstration - which finger regions touch which object locations, and in what order - rather than its joint motion. Second, physical consistency need not be engineered per task: a single residual reinforcement learning (RL) policy, trained once across diverse demonstrations, can repair kinematic recordings into physically consistent, contact-annotated trajectories, and the same residual formulation restores dynamic feasibility after retargeting. These observations yield a three-stage pipeline that converts human motion-capture recordings into dexterous robot policies with no real-robot training data: physics refinement with a simulated MANO hand recovers contacts and forces, contact-anchored retargeting transfers the demonstrated contact structure through an objective independent of hand morphology, and residual policy learning adapts the result to robot actuation. The pipeline reconstructs 25,454 single-hand trajectories (success 7.3% -> 59.3%) and 25 dual-hand tasks (16.0% -> 62.4%) with one shared policy per setting, transfers one human dataset to four morphologically distinct robot hands (+62.4 pp), and executes four contact-rich bimanual tasks on physical hardware with zero real-robot training data.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个三阶段流水线，将人类动作捕捉数据转化为灵巧机器人操作策略，无需真实机器人训练数据。核心是保留演示中的接触结构而非关节运动，并用单一残差强化学习策略修复物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 从演示学习灵巧操作受限于数据：可扩展的人类演示中缺失决定抓取成败的接触力。同时，人手到机器人手的形态变化导致关节运动无法直接迁移。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：1）用模拟MANO手进行物理细化，恢复接触和力；2）接触锚定重定向，通过独立于手部形态的目标迁移接触结构；3）残差策略学习，适应机器人驱动。每类设置共享一个残差RL策略。
AI.result: 重建25,454条单手轨迹（成功率7.3%→59.3%）和25个双手任务（16.0%→62.4%）；将一个人类数据集迁移到四种形态不同的机器人手（+62.4个百分点）；在真实硬件上执行四个接触丰富的双臂任务，零真实机器人训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 接触结构在人手到机器人手的转换中得以保留，而非关节运动；单个残差RL策略可跨多样演示修复运动学记录为物理一致、带接触标注的轨迹，并在重定向后恢复动态可行性。该流水线无需真实机器人数据即可生成灵巧策略。

title: ARID: A Deployable Edge AI System for Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Maintenance Work Orders
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE IECON 2026. 5 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
summary: Maintenance work orders must often be processed offline on embedded hardware, yet downstream software requires predictable structured output. We present ARID (Aviation-inspired Routing for Industrial Deployment), which extracts component, failure mode, symptom, and maintenance action into fixed-schema JSON on an 8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. ARID combines conservative dual-teacher filtering, targeted noise-aware synthesis, one routing decision per work order, 4-bit inference, and grammar-constrained decoding. From 2,326 unlabeled OMIn records, it retains 716 training pairs and adds 99 topology-constrained records targeting action extraction. On 300 human-labeled records, ARID reaches 84.8% token-F1 on the reference stack and 82.9% on the deployed Jetson. Resident serving achieves 5,310/5,656 ms P50/P99 at 12.5 W. On zero-shot MaintNet transfer, semantic F1 falls to 46.4% while parser success remains at least 99.8%, showing that output validity transfers but field semantics do not.

AI.tldr: ARID 是一种面向工业维护工单的嵌入式结构化信息抽取方法，可在 8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上输出固定 JSON schema，但跨域时输出格式有效、字段语义迁移有限。
AI.motivation: 维护工单常需在嵌入式硬件上离线处理，同时下游软件要求可预测的结构化输出，因此需要兼顾本地部署、低资源推理与 schema 约束的抽取方案。
AI.method: ARID 结合保守双教师过滤、噪声感知的目标合成、每工单一次路由决策、4-bit 推理和语法约束解码；从 2,326 条无标注 OMIn 记录中保留 716 对训练数据，并加入 99 条拓扑约束记录用于维护动作抽取。
AI.result: 在 300 条人工标注记录上，ARID 在参考栈达到 84.8% token-F1，在部署的 Jetson 上为 82.9%；常驻服务 P50/P99 为 5,310/5,656 ms，功耗 12.5 W。零样本迁移到 MaintNet 时，语义 F1 降至 46.4%，但解析成功率仍至少为 99.8%。
AI.conclusion: ARID 能在嵌入式设备上生成 schema 有效的结构化输出，但跨域迁移时字段语义难以保持，说明输出合法性可迁移而语义理解不随域迁移。

title: OnlineWM: Causality-Aware Active Online Learning for Effective World Modeling
summary: Generative world models aim to predict future states conditioned on actions, where action controllability is fundamental for reliable dynamics modeling. While recent efforts leverage simulator-generated data to enhance this capability, existing training pipelines face two fundamental limitations. First, static offline data collection leads to a distribution misalignment between training sets and the model's evolving error patterns, failing to resolve critical long-tail scenarios where dynamics predictions remain unreliable. Second, the standard objective of minimizing observational discrepancy often encourages the model to exploit spurious correlations instead of capturing the underlying action-effect causality. To address these limitations, we propose OnlineWM, an online training framework that continuously improves world modeling through active simulator interaction and causality-aware optimization. OnlineWM introduces two key innovations: (1) Active Online Learning: Instead of using fixed datasets, OnlineWM adaptively queries the simulator for new interaction sequences that target the model's current predictive weaknesses, ensuring high-utility data acquisition. (2) Causality-Aware Fine-Tuning: We propose a counterfactual learning strategy that contrasts the outcomes of different actions from identical states, forcing the model to attribute state transitions to specific actions rather than ambient environmental evolution, thereby grounding its predictions in reliable causal mechanisms. By integrating active data acquisition with causal optimization, OnlineWM establishes a closed-loop refinement process that ensures the model is both robust to diverse scenarios and precise in its causal attribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OnlineWM significantly enhances action controllability and generalizes effectively to unseen domains.

AI.tldr: OnlineWM是一个在线训练框架，通过主动模拟器交互和因果感知优化来持续改进世界模型，从而提升动作可控性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式世界模型训练面临两个问题：静态离线数据导致训练集与模型演化错误模式分布不匹配，难以解决长尾场景；最小化观测差异的目标易使模型利用虚假相关而非捕捉动作-效果因果关系。
AI.method: 提出OnlineWM框架，包含两项创新：1）主动在线学习：自适应查询模拟器获取针对模型当前预测弱点的交互序列；2）因果感知微调：采用反事实学习策略，对比相同状态下不同动作的结果，迫使模型将状态转移归因于特定动作。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，OnlineWM显著增强了动作可控性，并能有效泛化到未见领域。
AI.conclusion: OnlineWM通过整合主动数据获取与因果优化，建立闭环细化过程，确保模型对多样场景鲁棒且因果归因精确。

title: Training-Free Spectral Transductive Refinement for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Classification
summary: Few-shot recognition with frozen visual features is especially fragile under domain shift and one-shot supervision, where a single labelled image is an unreliable estimate of its class. We ask how far this fragility can be reduced purely at test time, without retraining the encoder or augmenting the source domain. We present Spectral Transductive Refinement (STR), a training-free transductive inference rule that exploits the geometry of the complete support-query episode. Given frozen embeddings, STR builds a joint k-nearest-neighbour graph, maps the episode into a normalized-Laplacian spectral coordinate system, initializes class representatives from the labelled support, and iteratively refines them using pseudo-labelled queries. We evaluate STR under two protocols. A controlled component study with frozen ResNet-18 features shows that spectral refinement consistently improves over single-prototype spectral initialization across five shifted domains, with the largest gains in the one-shot regime where support estimates are weakest. We then benchmark STR against recent Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning (CD-FSL) methods using the standard miniImageNet-pretrained ResNet-10 backbone over eight established target domains. Operating entirely at inference time, STR attains the highest 1-shot average among compared methods and remains competitive at 5-shot, rivalling approaches relying on heavy source-domain meta-training augmentations. Because STR is transductive, we report its setting explicitly. Diagnostics attribute its gains to iterative refinement in spectral coordinates rather than added prototype capacity, which remains inactive in our configuration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的转导推理方法 STR，在测试阶段利用整个 support-query episode 的图谱几何结构进行谱域迭代 refinement，以缓解冻结特征在域偏移和 one-shot 场景下的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 冻结视觉特征在域偏移和 one-shot 监督下尤其脆弱，单个标注图像难以可靠代表其类别；作者希望在不重训练编码器、不扩充源域的前提下，仅通过测试时推理降低这种脆弱性。
AI.method: STR 构建联合 k 近邻图，将 episode 映射到归一化拉普拉斯谱坐标系统；用有标签 support 初始化类别代表，并通过伪标签 query 迭代 refinement。该方法完全在推理阶段运行，属于 transductive 设置。
AI.result: 在冻结 ResNet-18 的受控组件研究中，谱 refinement 在五个偏移域上一致优于单原型谱初始化，one-shot 下提升最大。在标准 miniImageNet 预训练 ResNet-10 上，对八个目标域的 CD-FSL 基准中，STR 取得对比方法中最高的 1-shot 平均性能，5-shot 也具竞争力，可媲美依赖大量源域元训练增强的方法。
AI.conclusion: STR 表明测试时谱域迭代 refinement 能有效提升跨域少样本识别，且增益来自谱坐标中的迭代 refinement，而非增加原型容量；该配置下额外原型容量并未激活。

title: On the Efficiency-Safety Dilemma in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) incur high inference costs, often mitigated by efficiency techniques like quantization and pruning. However, the impact of these techniques on model adversarial robustness remains largely unexplored. This study provides the first comprehensive analysis of the interplay between efficiency, jailbreak vulnerability, and reasoning in LRMs. We find that while efficiency methods seemingly reduce the success rate of jailbreak attacks, this improvement is often superficial. It largely arises from degraded reasoning capabilities leading to "attempted but failed" malicious responses, rather than an increase in genuine alignment. Mechanistic analysis of representational drift confirms this, revealing a strict coupling between reasoning capability loss and the model's inability to maintain malicious semantic trajectories. Additionally, we identify quantization with pruning as the optimal strategy to balance efficiency and robustness. These findings clarify the distinction between true safety alignment and capability-induced failure, providing an empirical foundation for LRM deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析大型推理模型（LRMs）中效率优化、越狱脆弱性与推理能力之间的相互关系，指出效率方法表面上降低越狱成功率，实则多因推理能力退化导致恶意响应“尝试但失败”，并非真正安全对齐提升。
AI.motivation: LRMs推理成本高，常采用量化和剪枝等效率技术，但这些技术对模型对抗鲁棒性，尤其是越狱攻击的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 综合分析效率技术、越狱漏洞与推理能力的关系，并进行表征漂移的机制分析，以区分真实安全对齐与能力下降导致的失败。
AI.result: 效率方法看似降低越狱攻击成功率，但这种改善通常是表面的，源于推理能力下降造成的恶意响应失败；机制分析证实推理能力损失与模型维持恶意语义轨迹的能力严格耦合；量化结合剪枝是平衡效率与鲁棒性的最优策略。
AI.conclusion: 研究澄清了真实安全对齐与能力诱导失败之间的区别，为LRM部署提供了实证基础。

title: CARE: Experience-Guided Atomic Corrective Execution for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation but remain brittle once execution deviates from nominal trajectories. We propose CARE (Corrective Atomic Robotic Execution), a framework that improves recovery by learning from failures encountered during execution. Instead of generating corrective data from manually designed or random perturbations, CARE collects failed rollouts, models stage-conditioned post-failure deviations, and uses the resulting empirical distributions to synthesize representative failure states and corrective demonstrations. At inference time, CARE combines stage-wise planning with physically grounded 3D monitoring to trigger atomic adjustments or re-operations while preserving task progress. We further introduce the Failure State Recovery Benchmark (FSR-Bench), which evaluates recovery from intermediate failure states under local deviations and structural anomalies. Experiments across multiple VLA backbones, simulation benchmarks, and real-world dual-arm tasks show consistent improvements, with average task-success gains of 14.5 points in simulation and 15.9 points in the real world. Code, models, and data are available at https://github.com/xiaojunlan/care

AI.tldr: 论文提出CARE框架，通过从执行失败中学习来提升VLA策略的恢复能力，并发布FSR-Bench基准，在仿真和真实双臂任务中均取得显著成功率提升。
AI.motivation: VLA策略在机器人操作中表现良好，但一旦执行偏离标称轨迹就变得脆弱，现有恢复方法多依赖人工设计或随机扰动生成纠正数据，难以覆盖真实失败状态。
AI.method: CARE收集失败轨迹，建模阶段条件下的失败后偏差，并利用经验分布合成代表性失败状态与纠正演示；推理时结合阶段规划和基于物理的3D监控，触发原子调整或重操作，同时保持任务进度。还提出FSR-Bench，用于评估局部偏差和结构异常下的中间失败状态恢复。
AI.result: 在多个VLA主干、仿真基准和真实双臂任务中，CARE均带来一致提升，仿真平均任务成功率提高14.5个百分点，真实世界提高15.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 从真实失败中学习并辅以阶段化监控与原子恢复，可有效增强VLA策略的鲁棒恢复能力，且代码、模型和数据已开源。

title: Ask Before It Tells: Benchmark-to-Robot Body-Cue Transfer for a Question-First Bedside Robot
comment: To appear in the 4th Workshop on Nonverbal Cues for Human-Robot Cooperative Intelligence (NOC), IROS 2026
summary: Body-cue recognition can support assistive robots, but benchmark accuracy does not guarantee reliable behavior under a robot-camera viewpoint. We present Nuni, a bedside robot prototype that treats a detected distress cue as a reason to ask rather than a reason to alert. We compare two X3D-UGT RGB appearance classifiers, which reach 97.7% and 94.8% six-way accuracy on NTU RGB+D, with a pose-centric hybrid pipeline on 28 single-actor scripted clips recorded from the robot camera. The hybrid path achieved 0.71 six-way macro recall, versus 0.25 and 0.29 for the fine-tuned and from-scratch RGB variants. More importantly for interaction, it produced a question-triggering distress cue in 12/16 distress clips and would have prompted unnecessarily in 2/8 normal clips; the RGB variants yielded a question-triggering cue in only 2/16 and 3/16 distress clips. We separately tested the question-first controller through event injection. All 13 state-transition trials passed: valid responses caused stand-down, two unanswered prompts produced one alert, and three boundary conditions were handled correctly. These results are a preliminary technical evaluation, not a user study or medical validation, but they show how interaction policy can limit the consequences of uncertain perception.

AI.tldr: 论文提出床边机器人原型Nuni，将检测到的痛苦线索作为询问理由而非直接报警理由，并比较RGB外观分类器与以姿态为中心的混合流水线在机器人视角下的可靠性和交互策略表现。
AI.motivation: 身体线索识别可支持辅助机器人，但基准准确率不能保证机器人在实际相机视角下可靠运行，且感知不确定可能带来误报后果。
AI.method: 比较两种X3D-UGT RGB外观分类器（在NTU RGB+D上六分类准确率分别为97.7%和94.8%）与一种姿态中心混合流水线，在机器人相机拍摄的28个单角色脚本视频上测试；并通过事件注入测试“先询问”控制器。
AI.result: 混合流水线六分类宏召回率为0.71，优于微调和从头训练RGB变体的0.25与0.29；混合方法在12/16痛苦片段中触发询问性痛苦线索，而RGB变体仅2/16和3/16；正常片段中混合方法2/8会不必要提示。事件注入的13次状态转换测试全部通过，有效回应会解除状态，两次未应答提示产生一次报警，三个边界条件处理正确。
AI.conclusion: 这是初步技术评估，而非用户研究或医学验证；结果表明交互策略可限制不确定感知带来的后果，支持机器人以询问优先的方式处理身体线索识别。

title: Error-Supervised Synthetic Learner Writing for Automated Essay Scoring
summary: Synthetic essays can help reduce dependence on human-written data in Automated Essay Scoring (AES). However, they often lack realistic errors, limiting their ability to represent authentic human writing, particularly when the target texts are intended to resemble those produced by language learners. In this study, we present a simple approach that introduces error supervision into synthetic essay generation. Specifically, we fine-tune an LLM generator on error-annotated texts of the kind commonly used in Grammatical Error Detection (GED). To assess the utility of the proposed approach, we fine-tune and evaluate AES scorers under three data conditions: authentic essays, synthetic essays generated conventionally, and synthetic essays generated using our proposed approach. The results show that in the larger-data settings, the proposed approach outperforms the conventional synthetic baseline in 11 out of 12 dataset-metric comparisons, with performance in some cases approaching that of models trained on authentic essays. Despite these gains, performance under extremely low-resource settings remains mixed, with advantages over the conventional baseline only becoming more apparent at 200 training essays, although not consistently across datasets. Qualitative and quantitative analyses further show that the proposed approach produces learner-like errors whose distributions broadly resemble those observed in authentic essays.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出在合成作文生成中引入错误监督，通过用错误标注文本微调LLM生成器，使合成作文更接近语言学习者写作，并评估其对自动作文评分（AES）的效用。
AI.motivation: 合成作文可减少AES对人类写作数据的依赖，但常缺乏真实错误，难以代表真实人类写作，尤其是语言学习者作文。
AI.method: 将错误监督引入合成作文生成：在常用于语法错误检测（GED）的错误标注文本上微调LLM生成器。随后在三种数据条件下微调并评估AES评分器：真实作文、常规合成作文、以及所提方法生成的合成作文。
AI.result: 在数据量较大的设置中，所提方法在12个数据集-指标比较中的11个优于常规合成基线，部分性能接近使用真实作文训练的模型。但在极低资源设置下结果不一，优势在200篇训练作文时更明显，且跨数据集并不稳定。定性与定量分析显示，所提方法能生成类似学习者的错误，其分布大体接近真实作文中的错误分布。
AI.conclusion: 引入错误监督可提升合成作文的真实感及其对AES训练的价值，尤其在中大数据量下效果较好，但极低资源场景仍有局限，尚不能稳定替代真实数据。

title: Paragraph Boundaries Are Not White Space:Compression Depth as the Signature of Hierarchical Structure
summary: Standard positional encodings represent position as a one-dimensional reading-order coordinate, but reading order alone does not determine hierarchical textual structure. We use a hierarchical rotary positional encoding (hRoPE) that represents paragraph, sentence, and token indices as separate channels, hold the token sequence fixed, intervene on the paragraph coordinate p1, and measure cross-paragraph attention with a token-distance-exact estimator. Attention is compressed relative to a token-distance-matched baseline in every corpus, but compression alone is not diagnostic of true structure: an architecturally identical channel with density-matched random labels is compressed too, more shallowly. What distinguishes real structure is the depth of compression, which is greater and corpus-dependent while the control's is not. Comparing eight corpus-only quantities across three constructs (lexical persistence, paragraph length, embedding-based coherence), none fully reproduces the cross-corpus ordering of depth, though embedding-based coherence comes closest. Compression depth, not its location, is the reproducible signature of genuine paragraph structure in our setting.

AI.tldr: 论文研究层级文本结构中段落结构是否被位置编码真实捕捉。使用分层旋转位置编码 hRoPE，将段落、句子、词符索引作为独立通道，固定词符序列并干预段落坐标 p1，测量跨段落注意力。发现真实段落结构导致注意力压缩，但压缩本身不充分；关键区分在于压缩深度：真实结构压缩更深且随语料变化，而随机标签控制也压缩但更浅。
AI.motivation: 标准位置编码只用一维阅读顺序坐标表示位置，但阅读顺序不能决定层级文本结构，因此需要检验段落层级结构是否真实影响注意力。
AI.method: 采用分层旋转位置编码（hRoPE），将段落、句子、词符索引编码为独立通道；固定词符序列，干预段落坐标 p1；用词符距离精确估计器测量跨段落注意力；并与词符距离匹配基线及密度匹配随机标签控制比较；再比较八种语料级指标（词汇持续性、段落长度、基于嵌入的连贯性等）与压缩深度排序。
AI.result: 所有语料中，相对词符距离匹配基线，跨段落注意力均被压缩；但随机标签控制也出现压缩，只是更浅。真实结构的压缩深度更大且随语料变化，控制则不然。三个构念下的八个语料级指标均不能完全复现跨语料的压缩深度排序，其中基于嵌入的连贯性最接近。
AI.conclusion: 在本文设置中，真正段落结构的可复现标志是压缩深度而非压缩位置；仅凭注意力压缩不足以证明结构真实性。

title: Mira-Scene: Pixel-Aligned Layouts for Generative 3D Scene
summary: Single-image 3D object generation can now produce high-fidelity assets, yet accurately placing them into a coherent scene layout remains an open challenge. A central difficulty lies in how object layout is represented. Holistic methods absorb placement into a scene-level generation process, sacrificing object-level detail. Compositional methods preserve object fidelity by decoupling geometry from layout, but typically parameterize layout as sparse, unbounded pose variables that are difficult to learn and generalize poorly under scarce scene-level supervision.We present Mira-Scene, a compositional 3D scene reconstruction framework that replaces sparse pose regression with dense, bounded correspondence recovery. At its core is the Canonical Coordinate Map (CCM), a pixel-aligned field that maps each visible object pixel to a surface coordinate in the object's bounded canonical space. When paired with a scene-space Point Cloud Map (PCM) from monocular geometry estimation, CCM induces dense canonical-to-scene correspondences from which object transformations are recovered through robust geometric alignment. Because CCM operates in bounded canonical space, it provides a stable prediction target that can be trained from scalable object-level 3D data without requiring scene-level layout annotations. Mira-Scene further introduces a multimodal diffusion transformer that jointly generates object geometry and CCMs, using modality-specific expert streams with shared attention and positional encoding to promote geometry-layout consistency. Experiments on indoor, outdoor, synthetic, and in-the-wild scenes show that Mira-Scene substantially outperforms strong baselines in layout accuracy, achieving relative gains of 39.8% in 3D-IoU and 16.5% in 2D-IoU over SAM3D, using limited open-source training data.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mira-Scene，一种组合式 3D 场景重建框架，用稠密且有界的对应关系恢复替代稀疏姿态回归，实现单图物体在场景中的精准布局，并在多类场景上显著超越 SAM3D。
AI.motivation: 单图 3D 物体生成已能产出高保真资产，但将其准确放入连贯场景布局仍是难题。整体式方法牺牲物体细节，组合式方法虽保真却把布局表示为稀疏无界姿态变量，难以学习且在场景级监督稀缺时泛化差。
AI.method: 核心是规范坐标图（CCM）：像素对齐场，将每个可见物体像素映射到物体有界规范空间的表面坐标。结合单目几何估计得到场景空间点云图（PCM），CCM 诱导稠密规范-场景对应，通过鲁棒几何对齐恢复物体变换。CCM 因处于有界规范空间，可仅用可扩展的物体级 3D 数据训练，无需场景级布局标注。还提出多模态扩散 Transformer，用模态专属专家流与共享注意力、位置编码联合生成物体几何与 CCM，促进几何-布局一致性。
AI.result: 在室内、室外、合成及真实场景中，Mira-Scene 的布局精度大幅优于强基线；相比 SAM3D，3D-IoU 相对提升 39.8%，2D-IoU 相对提升 16.5%，且仅使用有限开源训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 以稠密有界对应恢复替代稀疏姿态回归，可在无场景级布局标注下实现高质量组合式 3D 场景重建，验证了 CCM 与多模态扩散 Transformer 的有效性。

title: STEVE: Stabilizing Textual Gradient-Based Prompt Optimization via Error-Driven Refinement and Regularized Verification
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: AACL-IJCNLP 2026
summary: Textual-gradient methods automate prompt optimization through natural-language feedback, but their iterative updates can be unstable. We identify two sources of this instability: noisy gradients produced from already-correct examples and over-specialization to hard cases that degrades performance on simpler inputs. We introduce STEVE, a stabilization framework with two coupled mechanisms. Error-Driven Refinement generates gradients only from incorrectly handled examples, concentrating updates on informative failures. Regularized Verification treats every update as provisional and accepts it only when improvement on hard cases does not cause unacceptable regression on a preservation set. Across ten reasoning benchmarks, three evaluator/optimizer models, and established prompt-optimization baselines, STEVE reduces degradation and produces more robust prompts. Additional evaluations with gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4 on symbolic reasoning, GSM8K-Platinum, and DS-1000 show that these gains persist with newer models and larger test sets. STEVE therefore provides a practical way to improve the stability and effectiveness of textual-gradient prompt optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STEVE，一个用于文本梯度式提示优化的稳定化框架，通过只在错误样本上生成梯度并进行正则化验证，减少优化过程中的性能退化，生成更稳健的提示。
AI.motivation: 文本梯度方法利用自然语言反馈自动优化提示，但迭代更新不稳定。作者识别出两个不稳定来源：一是从已正确处理的样本中产生的噪声梯度，二是对困难样本的过度特化，导致在较简单输入上的性能下降。
AI.method: STEVE包含两个耦合机制：（1）Error-Driven Refinement，只从处理错误的样本生成梯度，使更新聚焦于有信息量的失败案例；（2）Regularized Verification，将每次更新视为临时性的，仅当在困难案例上的改进不会在保留集上造成不可接受的性能回退时才接受该更新。
AI.result: 在十个推理基准、三种评估/优化模型以及已有提示优化基线上，STEVE减少了性能退化并产生更稳健的提示。使用gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4在符号推理、GSM8K-Platinum和DS-1000上的额外评估表明，这些增益在新模型和更大测试集上依然保持。
AI.conclusion: STEVE为提升文本梯度式提示优化的稳定性和有效性提供了一种实用的方法。

title: BabelArena: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute multi-step workflows through tool use and interaction with users and environments. However, current agent evaluations are largely English-centric, limiting our understanding of agent capabilities in multilingual settings. We introduce BabelFlow, a benchmark-general agentic workflow that adapts existing agent benchmarks to new languages by analyzing runtime dependencies, coordinating structure-preserving translation, and combining multi-layer verification with human review to preserve task and evaluation semantics. Using BabelFlow, we construct BabelArena, a task-aligned benchmark comprising 16,146 instances derived from 702 canonical tasks across four benchmark families, 13 domains, and 23 languages. Experiments with five frontier models show that no single model dominates across benchmark families and that cross-language disparities extend well beyond task success. Lower-resource languages exhibit distinct failure patterns, with larger shares of tool-use and control-flow errors rather than answer-quality errors alone, pointing to gaps in reliable task execution across the resource levels of these languages. On the same tasks, agents in low-resource languages also consume substantially more tokens than in English (up to roughly twice the input) without proportional increases in interaction length, and language consistency degrades further on tasks requiring structured output, where switches are directed overwhelmingly toward English. We believe BabelArena provides a foundation for advancing research on reliable and efficient multilingual agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BabelFlow，一种将现有智能体基准适配到新语言的通用工作流，并构建了BabelArena多语言智能体基准，涵盖23种语言、16,146个实例。实验发现不同语言间性能差异显著，低资源语言中智能体更易出现工具使用和控制流错误，且消耗更多token，语言一致性下降。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体评估以英语为中心，限制了对多语言环境下智能体能力的理解，需要构建多语言基准来评估智能体在多种语言中的表现。
AI.method: 提出BabelFlow，通过分析运行时依赖、结构保持翻译、多层验证与人工审核，将现有基准适配到新语言。基于此构建BabelArena，包含4个基准系列、13个领域、23种语言的702个规范任务，共16,146个实例。对五个前沿模型进行实验。
AI.result: 实验显示没有单一模型在所有基准系列中占优；跨语言差异不仅体现在任务成功率上。低资源语言中，智能体表现出更多工具使用和控制流错误。在相同任务上，低资源语言消耗的token显著多于英语（输入最多约两倍），但交互长度未成比例增加。结构化输出任务上语言一致性进一步下降，切换绝大多数指向英语。
AI.conclusion: BabelArena为推进可靠且高效的多语言智能体研究提供了基础，揭示了多语言环境下智能体在任务执行和效率方面的差距。

title: Distill What You Trust: Reliability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation allows a student to learn from complementary specialists on its own trajectories. Domain-routed approaches, however, select one teacher per example and keep it fixed throughout the response. This design both depends on labels that mixed training corpora often lack and cannot adapt teacher selection when the expertise required changes within a trajectory. We propose \textbf{TrustMOPD}, which replaces example-level teacher selection with label-free, token-level supervision allocation. At each student-generated prefix, TrustMOPD uses each specialist's RL-induced displacement from a shared pre-RL reference as a proxy for local reliability, calibrates these scores across teachers, and constructs a weighted distillation target. Across mathematics, code, and instruction following, TrustMOPD outperforms the strongest label-free baseline, increasing the recovery ratio from $54.4\%$ to $91.5\%$ on \textsc{SingleCap} and from $54.5\%$ to $98.0\%$ on \textsc{MultiCap}, while approaching label-based MOPD on \textsc{SingleCap}. Randomizing token-level weights independently of the student-generated prefix performs no better than uniform weighting, supporting the importance of conditioning supervision on the evolving generation context.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TrustMOPD，一种无需标签的多教师在线策略蒸馏方法，用 token 级监督分配替代样本级教师选择，在数学、代码和指令遵循任务上显著优于最强的无标签基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多教师蒸馏常采用领域路由，即每个样本选择一个教师并在整个回答中固定不变。这既依赖混合训练语料中往往缺失的标签，也无法在一条轨迹内根据所需专长的变化动态调整教师选择。
AI.method: TrustMOPD 在生成过程中，对每个学生生成前缀，利用各领域专家相对于共享 RL 前参考模型的 RL 诱导位移作为局部可靠性代理，并对这些分数进行跨教师校准，从而构建加权的蒸馏目标，实现无标签、token 级的监督分配。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和指令遵循任务上，TrustMOPD 超过最强无标签基线：SingleCap 恢复率从 54.4% 提升至 91.5%，MultiCap 从 54.5% 提升至 98.0%，并在 SingleCap 上接近基于标签的 MOPD。此外，若将 token 级权重随机化且不依赖于学生生成前缀，其效果不比均匀加权更好。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，token 级、基于生成上下文动态分配教师监督能有效提升无标签多教师在线策略蒸馏，且监督信号必须与不断演化的学生生成前缀条件相关。

title: ActiveArena: Benchmarking and Understanding Active Perception in Robotic Manipulation
summary:
Active perception and manipulation are crucial for robots to interact with complex scenes. Existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate how robots effectively acquire and maintain information in memory in an active manner. To this end, we introduce ActiveArena-Sim, an active-perception simulator with controllable viewpoints and large-scale workspaces as the foundation. Built on this, we propose ActiveArena-Bench, which comprises 35 tasks across 5 fine-grained categories, covering visual exploration and interactive information acquisition. Each task is difficult to solve from passive observations alone, requiring multi-round evidence acquisition and memory-based reasoning. The benchmark provides rich memory annotations, standardized training data, and ID/OOD protocols featuring disjoint scenes, unseen distractor configurations, and novel backgrounds. Moreover, we present ActiveArena-VLA, a modular suite of 13 vision-language-action configurations for controlled studies of memory writing, memory capacity, proprioceptive state, subtask supervision, and high-level planning in active perception. Benchmark results reveal a substantial ID-OOD gap: uniform memory sampling, increased memory capacity under reliable write policies, proprioceptive inputs, and subtask supervision improve OOD generalization, while planner-guided memory management and decision-making achieve performance close to the best-performing configuration using only sparse memory.
  ActiveArena thus provides a unified testbed to develop and diagnose models for active perception and manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ActiveArena，包括ActiveArena-Sim仿真器、ActiveArena-Bench基准和ActiveArena-VLA模块化配置套件，用于统一评估和诊断机器人主动感知与操作中的信息获取与记忆推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准难以评估机器人如何主动获取并维持记忆中的信息，尤其是在需要多轮证据收集和基于记忆推理的复杂场景中。
AI.method: 构建了具有可控视角和大规模工作空间的主动感知仿真器ActiveArena-Sim；基于此提出包含5个细粒度类别、35个任务的ActiveArena-Bench，任务需多轮证据获取和记忆推理；提供记忆标注、标准化训练数据及ID/OOD协议；并提出包含13种视觉-语言-动作配置的ActiveArena-VLA，用于研究记忆写入、记忆容量、本体状态、子任务监督和高层规划。
AI.result: 基准结果显示出明显的ID-OOD差距：均匀记忆采样、可靠写入策略下增加记忆容量、本体感知输入和子任务监督可提升OOD泛化；规划器引导的记忆管理与决策在使用稀疏记忆时也能接近最佳配置的性能。
AI.conclusion: ActiveArena为主动感知与操作模型的开发和诊断提供了统一的测试平台。

title: Confidence-Aware Teacher-Student Distillation for 3D Medical Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation models typically rely on large amounts of densely annotated volumetric data, limiting their scalability across tasks and imaging modalities. This work addresses the challenge of predicting entire 3D anatomical structures from extreme annotation sparsity. An annotation-efficient student-teacher framework is proposed for automatic 3D medical segmentation that requires only a set of point prompts on a single 2D slice per volume, as input. A foundation model serves as an offline teacher, utilizing the provided point prompts from the selected slice to full-volume pseudo-annotations alongside their corresponding spatial confidence scores prior to student training. To mitigate the error propagation of noisy pseudo-annotations, a task-specific 3D student network is trained using a confidence-aware optimization strategy. By leveraging the teacher's pre-computed confidence scores, this strategy explicitly excludes statically uncertain regions of the pseudo-annotations from the loss calculation, while simultaneously emphasizing regions with higher confidence. Evaluated on 3D cardiac MRI datasets, our framework outperforms state-of-the-art semi-supervised methods, improving segmentation performance by up to 43.6%. Furthermore, it drastically reduces the manual annotation burden to just a few positive point prompts per volume, while improving surface boundary precision by up to 14.7% over the teacher and successfully recovering up to 34.1% of the performance gap toward the fully supervised upper bound.

AI.tldr: 提出一种标注高效的学生-教师框架，仅需每个3D体数据中单个2D切片上的少量点提示，即可自动分割完整3D医学解剖结构。
AI.motivation: 传统医学图像分割依赖大量密集标注的体数据，标注成本高、难以跨任务和成像模态扩展；本文旨在解决极端标注稀疏条件下的3D医学图像分割问题。
AI.method: 使用基础模型作为离线教师，根据选定切片上的点提示生成全容积伪标注及空间置信度分数；再训练任务特定的3D学生网络，并采用置信度感知优化策略，在损失计算中排除低置信区域、强调高置信区域，以减少噪声伪标注的错误传播。
AI.result: 在3D心脏MRI数据集上，该方法优于现有最先进半监督方法，分割性能最高提升43.6%；相比教师模型，表面边界精度最高提升14.7%；成功恢复至全监督上限性能差距的34.1%，并将人工标注负担降至每个体数据仅需少量正点提示。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够从极端稀疏标注中有效预测完整3D解剖结构，显著降低标注成本并提升分割精度与边界质量，具有较好的跨任务和跨模态扩展潜力。

title: Financial Language Models as Applied Artificial Intelligence Systems for News-Based Trading under Market Frictions
comment: 47 pages. Revise and resubmit at Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Financial language models can transform unstructured firm-specific news into structured decision signals, but financial AI research lacks an integrated deployment framework for evaluating whether those signals remain useful in financial decision systems. Computer science research has developed strong methods for time-series forecasting, text classification, multimodal stock prediction, graph-based market modeling, and machine-learning operations, yet these streams do not provide a domain-specific protocol that jointly tests financial language-model outputs under event-time observability, probability calibration, execution timing, transaction costs, liquidity constraints, capacity limits, operational diagnostics, and statistical inference. We introduce MFAST, a Market-Friction-Aware Sentiment-to-Trading framework that converts timestamped financial text into auditable, reproducible, and market-feasible trading decisions. The application is news-based trading, where firm-specific text must be linked to securities before portfolio decisions can be evaluated. The framework links Refinitiv News Analytics to Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP) equity data, restricts the primary out-of-sample evaluation to post-release news outside disclosed foundation-model data-freshness periods, and adds a public replication arm using open financial text and public price data. Results show that decoder-only language models outperform encoder baselines and dictionary sentiment in classification, calibration, return prediction, and net portfolio performance, while operational diagnostics reveal trade-offs among accuracy, latency, memory, throughput, and inference cost. The paper shows that credible evaluation of financial language models requires an end-to-end engineering approach combining language understanding, temporal discipline, market-friction-aware deployment, and reproducible validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MFAST框架，将带时间戳的金融文本转化为可审计、可复现且市场可行的交易决策，并强调对金融语言模型进行端到端、考虑市场摩擦的评估。
AI.motivation: 金融语言模型可将非结构化公司新闻转化为决策信号，但现有金融AI研究缺乏集成部署框架，无法联合评估这些信号在事件时间可观测性、概率校准、执行时机、交易成本、流动性约束、容量限制、运营诊断和统计推断等条件下的实用性。
AI.method: 提出MFAST（Market-Friction-Aware Sentiment-to-Trading）框架，将Refinitiv News Analytics与CRSP股票数据链接；主要样本外评估限定在发布后且不在基础模型数据新鲜期内的新闻；并设置使用公开金融文本和公开价格数据的复现实验分支。
AI.result: 解码器-only语言模型在分类、校准、收益预测和净组合表现上优于编码器基线和词典情感方法；运营诊断揭示准确率、延迟、内存、吞吐量和推理成本之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 金融语言模型的可靠评估需要端到端工程方法，结合语言理解、时间纪律、市场摩擦感知部署和可复现验证。

title: Phrase-Level Robotic Guqin Performance: Bimanual Motion Planning and Audio-Tactile Interaction Monitoring
summary: Recent advances in humanoid robotics and embodied intelligence have enabled robots to perform increasingly complex manipulation tasks. However, musical instrument performance remains a formidable benchmark, demanding not only collision-free trajectory execution but also precise contact timing, asymmetric bimanual coordination, and target acoustic outcomes on physical instruments. The guqin, a seven-string fretless zither, presents unique manipulation challenges due to its millimetric string spacing, transient right-hand plucking, and sustained left-hand harmonic contacts. In this work, we present a physical heterogeneous dual-arm robotic system for phrase-level autonomous guqin performance. We formulate guqin playing as a hybrid discrete--continuous execution problem and develop a hierarchical planning framework that coordinates working finger assignment, configuration continuity, obstacle avoidance, and tight bimanual contact schedules across consecutive musical events. The system integrates vision-guided instrument localization, tactile-based harmonic contact monitoring, and auditory feedback-informed plucking parameter calibration. Real-world experiments on a 25-event phrase demonstrate that the system reliably executes coordinated open-string and seventh-hui harmonic sequences on a physical guqin, achieving 93.6% and 96.8% event correctness across repeated trials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理异构双臂机器人系统，用于古琴乐句级自主演奏，通过分层规划与多模态反馈实现复杂离散-连续操作。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人与具身智能虽已进展显著，但乐器演奏仍是高难度基准，要求无碰撞轨迹、精确接触时序、非对称双臂协调及真实乐器上的目标音色；古琴因弦距极小、右手拨弦瞬态和左手按音持续接触而更具挑战。
AI.method: 将古琴演奏建模为混合离散-连续执行问题，设计分层规划框架，协调工作手指分配、构型连续性、避障及连续音乐事件间的紧密双臂接触时序；系统集成视觉引导乐器定位、触觉泛音接触监测和听觉反馈拨弦参数校准。
AI.result: 在真实古琴上对含25个事件的乐句进行实验，系统可靠执行空弦与七徽泛音序列，重复试验中事件正确率分别达到93.6%和96.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统验证了异构双臂机器人在古琴乐句级自主演奏中的可行性，表明其能够应对精确接触时序、双臂协调和物理乐器声学目标等复杂操作要求。

title: GRACE: Grounded Adversarial Reasoning over Canadian Law
summary: Large language models have shown strong performance across a range of legal tasks, but existing benchmarks rarely evaluate the ability to take and defend a legal position, reason under incomplete information, or synthesize multiple statutory provisions. This gap is particularly pronounced for Canadian law, which remains underrepresented in legal NLP. We introduce GRACE (Grounded Reasoning Adversarial Canadian LEgal examples), a dataset of 1,915 question-reasoning-answer instances grounded in Canadian federal legislation. GRACE covers three reasoning modes: adversarial advocacy, uncertainty, and applied reasoning. We develop a pipeline that partitions raw statutory text, generates scenario-based questions and reasoning, and filters examples through model-free citation verification and LLM-based quality auditing. As a proof of concept, we fine-tune CLeAR-4B (Canadian Legal Adversarial Reasoning), a lightweight model for grounded legal reasoning, and evaluate it against the unmodified Qwen3-4B base model in open- and closed-book settings. CLeAR-4B substantially improves agreement with teacher outputs and statutory citation behavior when the relevant act text is provided, while its grounding degrades sharply when the statute is withheld. These results suggest that GRACE can support the development of lightweight legal models that reason more effectively from supplied statutory text.

AI.tldr: 论文介绍了GRACE数据集，包含1915个基于加拿大联邦立法的问答推理实例，涵盖对抗性辩护、不确定性和应用推理三种模式，并微调了轻量级法律推理模型CLeAR-4B，验证了其在提供法条文本时的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有法律NLP基准很少评估模型采取和辩护法律立场、在信息不完整下推理以及综合多个法条的能力，且加拿大法律在此领域代表性不足。
AI.method: 构建GRACE数据集：分割原始法条文本，生成情景化问题和推理，并通过无模型引用验证和基于LLM的质量审计进行过滤。作为概念验证，微调CLeAR-4B模型，并与未修改的Qwen3-4B基座模型在开卷和闭卷设置下对比评估。
AI.result: CLeAR-4B在提供相关法条文本时，与教师输出的一致性和法条引用行为显著提升；但在不提供法条时，其依据法条推理的能力急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: GRACE数据集可支持开发轻量级法律模型，使其能更有效地基于提供的法条文本进行推理。

title: FLARE: A Full-Lifecycle Dense Supervision Paradigm for Long-Horizon Coding Agents via Generative Reward Model
summary: While test-time scaling enhances Large Language Model (LLM) agents in long-horizon software engineering (SWE), sparse binary rewards (Pass/Fail) create a severe credit assignment crisis and waste failed exploratory trajectories. Current trajectory optimization and scaling methods are costly and structurally limited, relying on heuristic state reuse without causal diagnosis or delayed scalar scoring without actionable online guidance. We propose FLARE (Full-Lifecycle Alignment and Reward Engine), a novel dense supervision paradigm driven by a lightweight Generative Reward Model (GRM). First, RADAR, an offline causal-aware diagnostic framework, extracts high-fidelity, hindsight-free supervision through causal-chain backtracking to distill a GRM providing real-time, step-level risk feedback. Second, FLARE uses this GRM to continuously optimize the agent across its entire lifecycle. During inference, FLARE acts as an Active Scaffold, autonomously intercepting high-risk generation steps for localized breakpoint re-execution, drastically reducing compute overhead. During post-training, the GRM's structured signals serve as process-supervised reranking scores for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and step-level dense rewards for Reinforcement Learning (RL), mitigating policy collapse in sparse environments. Extensive evaluations show that FLARE establishes a new Pareto frontier across the agent lifecycle: FLARE (N=1) outperforms Global Rollout (N=5) with a 5x reduction in token consumption. Extending FLARE to training overcomes the sparse reward problem in long-horizon interactive tasks, delivering relative performance gains of 19.13% in SFT through process-aware data curation and a consistent 9.19% improvement in RL.

AI.tldr: 提出FLARE，一种由轻量级生成式奖励模型驱动的全生命周期密集监督范式，在推理阶段通过主动支架实现断点重执行，在训练阶段提供过程监督信号，显著提升LLM智能体在长程软件工程任务中的效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展虽能增强LLM智能体在长程软件工程中的表现，但稀疏的二元奖励（通过/失败）导致严重的信用分配危机，浪费失败的探索轨迹；现有轨迹优化与扩展方法成本高且结构受限，依赖启发式状态复用而缺乏因果诊断，或仅延迟标量评分而无法在线指导。
AI.method: FLARE包含两部分：1）RADAR离线因果感知诊断框架，通过因果链回溯提取高保真、无后见之明的监督信号，蒸馏出轻量级生成式奖励模型（GRM），提供实时步级风险反馈；2）FLARE利用该GRM在智能体全生命周期持续优化——推理时作为主动支架，自动拦截高风险生成步骤进行局部断点重执行；后训练时，GRM的结构化信号用作SFT的过程监督重排序分数和RL的步级密集奖励，缓解稀疏环境下的策略崩溃。
AI.result: FLARE（N=1）以5倍更少的token消耗超越全局展开（N=5）；扩展到训练后，在SFT中通过过程感知数据整理获得19.13%的相对性能提升，在RL中取得持续9.19%的改进。
AI.conclusion: FLARE在智能体全生命周期中建立了新的帕累托前沿，有效克服了长程交互任务中的稀疏奖励问题，实现了高效且高性能的推理与训练。

title: Federated Multilingual Speech-LLMs: Architecture and Aggregation Strategy Benchmarking
summary: We present a comprehensive benchmark of Federated Learning (FL) for multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), evaluating four Speech-LLM architectures on the Multilingual LibriSpeech dataset. We compare FedAvg and FedProx across frozen and unfrozen encoder configurations, demonstrating that optimized learning rates are critical for performance. Specifically, independently tuning the learning rates for the speech encoder, connector, and decoder yields the lowest error rates, with full three-component adaptation (LoRA for encoder and decoder, full training for the connector) producing the best FL results. We observe that FedProx efficacy is architecture-dependent, providing notable advantages in multilingual pre-trained architectures (e.g., EuroLLM over TinyLlama when keeping the encoder fixed); this indicates that LLM backbone capacity plays a key role in mediating resilience to heterogeneous data distributions. These findings offer concrete design guidance for deploying multilingual Speech-LLMs in privacy-sensitive, distributed environments.

AI.tldr: 本文对多语言自动语音识别中的联邦学习进行了系统基准评测，在Multilingual LibriSpeech数据集上比较了四种Speech-LLM架构，并分析FedAvg与FedProx在编码器冻结/解冻、学习率调优及不同LLM骨干下的表现。
AI.motivation: 在隐私敏感的分布式环境中部署多语言Speech-LLM需要理解联邦学习策略与模型架构、参数更新方式之间的相互作用，尤其是异构数据分布下的鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 构建联邦学习基准，使用Multilingual LibriSpeech数据集，评估四种Speech-LLM架构；对比FedAvg和FedProx，在冻结与解冻编码器配置下测试；分别调优语音编码器、连接器和解码器的学习率；并采用三组件自适应训练（编码器和解码器用LoRA，连接器全量训练）。
AI.result: 独立调优语音编码器、连接器和解码器的学习率可获得最低错误率；三组件全自适应（编码器/解码器LoRA、连接器全量训练）取得最佳联邦学习结果；FedProx的效果依赖架构，在多语言预训练架构中优势明显（如固定编码器时EuroLLM优于TinyLlama），说明LLM骨干容量影响对异构数据分布的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在隐私敏感的分布式环境中部署多语言Speech-LLM提供了具体设计指导，强调学习率优化、组件自适应策略以及LLM骨干选择对联邦学习性能的重要性。

title: VISTA: Video-Injected Stylized Text-to-Animation
summary: We present VISTA, a two-stage framework for generating stylized 3D human motion by fusing structural content from text prompts with expressive style from reference videos, without requiring jointly paired (text, video, stylized motion) triplets. A Dual-channel Autoencoder first maps motion sequences and video clips into a shared latent manifold. A masked autoregressive diffusion backbone then operates within this manifold, injecting video-derived style through a dedicated late-fusion Dual-AdaLN pathway while preserving text-conditioned content structure. A cross-batch unpaired training protocol with latent cycle consistency enables joint learning across separate semantically rich and stylistically diverse datasets. As a proof-of-concept for controllable animation synthesis, we validate VISTA on rendered motion-capture references: it achieves the highest style recognition accuracy among video-conditioned methods while preserving competitive content alignment, and its decomposed 3-way classifier-free guidance provides independent, user-controllable calibration of the content--style balance at inference time.

AI.tldr: VISTA是一个两阶段框架，通过融合文本提示的结构内容和参考视频的表现风格，生成风格化3D人体动作，且无需配对的三元组数据。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常需要联合配对的（文本、视频、风格化动作）数据，这类数据获取困难。研究旨在不依赖配对数据的情况下，实现文本内容与视频风格的解耦与融合。
AI.method: 采用双通道自编码器将动作序列和视频片段映射到共享潜在空间；使用掩码自回归扩散骨干网络，通过后融合Dual-AdaLN注入视频风格，同时保持文本条件的内容结构；引入跨批次非配对训练协议与潜在循环一致性，实现不同数据集的联合学习；推理时采用分解的三路无分类器引导。
AI.result: 在渲染的动作捕捉参考上验证：在视频条件方法中取得最高的风格识别准确率，同时保持有竞争力的内容对齐；三路无分类器引导可在推理时独立、用户可控地调节内容与风格的平衡。
AI.conclusion: VISTA证明无需配对三元组即可实现可控的风格化3D人体动作合成，并支持推理时内容与风格的独立控制。

title: PRISM-RAG: Multimodal Hypergraph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Tobacco Product and Legislative Policy Reasoning
summary: The disambiguation of semantically similar statutory text across jurisdictions is a retrieval problem that existing methods do not solve. This inter-context conflict can steer generative models toward confidently produced answers grounded in topically relevant but jurisdictionally incorrect sources. Tobacco and nicotine regulations vary by US jurisdiction, often sharing similar language, thus, robust reasoning requires identifying which jurisdiction's law governs a given product, not merely retrieving relevant text. Emerging products (e.g., pouches) exploit ambiguous definitions to evade regulation. State-of-the-art (SOTA) document retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods struggle to address this inter-context conflict, and thus struggle to connect image attributes (e.g., rich attribute captions) to the set of similar legislation texts. We introduce NicoPRISM (Nicotine Product and Regulation Image-and-Text Surveillance Multimodal), comprising 161,563 images, attribute captions, a knowledge base of product, health, and legislative documents spanning 13 US jurisdictions, and 1,495 validated question-answer pairs across two tasks: policy compliance QA and product knowledge QA. We also propose PRISM-RAG, a multimodal hypergraph RAG framework built over images, captions, and entities without any LLM calls at index time, grounding every query in a product image and routes retrieval through a jurisdiction-aware context assembly mechanism guaranteeing that statutory text from the queried jurisdiction reaches the language model by construction. PRISM-RAG retrieves passages from the correct jurisdiction in 93.9% of policy compliance queries, a 48.6 percentage point advantage over standard RAG (p<0.001), using zero LLM calls at index time and one at query time, and is competitive with or outperforms SOTA RAG frameworks across keyword, semantic, jurisdiction-, and compliance-accuracy metrics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出NicoPRISM数据集和PRISM-RAG框架，解决跨司法管辖区语义相似法规文本的检索问题，通过多模态超图RAG和管辖权感知上下文组装，显著提升政策合规查询的准确率。
AI.motivation: 跨司法管辖区语义相似的法规文本消歧是现有方法未解决的检索问题。上下文冲突可能导致生成模型基于主题相关但管辖权错误的来源给出自信答案。烟草和尼古丁法规因美国司法管辖区而异，语言相似，稳健推理需识别管辖特定产品的法律，而非仅检索相关文本。新兴产品利用模糊定义规避监管。SOTA RAG方法难以解决这种冲突，也难以将图像属性与相似立法文本连接。
AI.method: 引入NicoPRISM，包含161,563张图像、属性描述、涵盖13个美国司法管辖区的产品、健康和立法文档知识库，以及两个任务（政策合规QA和产品知识QA）的1,495个验证问答对。提出PRISM-RAG，一种多模态超图RAG框架，基于图像、描述和实体构建，索引时无需LLM调用，每个查询以产品图像为基础，通过管辖权感知的上下文组装机制路由检索，确保所查询管辖区的法规文本按构造到达语言模型。
AI.result: PRISM-RAG在93.9%的政策合规查询中检索到正确管辖区的段落，比标准RAG高出48.6个百分点（p<0.001），索引时零LLM调用，查询时一次调用，并在关键词、语义、管辖权和合规准确性指标上与SOTA RAG框架竞争或超越。
AI.conclusion: PRISM-RAG有效解决了跨司法管辖区法规检索中的上下文冲突，通过多模态超图和管辖权感知机制，实现了高效准确的政策合规和产品知识问答，优于或媲美现有RAG框架。

title: Constrained Decoding Eliminates Structural Failures in Small LLMs but Reveals a Scale-Dependent Semantic Gap
comment: 6 pages, ACL format Code and task suite: https://github.com/CruiseDevice/small-llm-structured-benchmark (tag v1.0)
summary: Small open-source large language models (LLMs) in the 0.6B-4B parameter range are increasingly deployed for structured output generation (JSON, function calling, data extraction), yet little is known about how constrained decoding (CD) interacts with model scale in this regime. We benchmark five models from three families across 14 structured-output tasks under three decoding conditions (native, Outlines, XGrammar). We introduce a two-axis evaluation that separates structural correctness (schema validity) from semantic correctness (content accuracy). We find that CD eliminates all structural failures across all models (schema validity: 78.6-92.9% to 100%), but content accuracy reveals a persistent semantic gap that is scale-dependent: type coercion failures are fully CD-rescuable, while instruction-semantic failures (e.g., multi-step function calling) remain CD-resistant. Schema conformance is necessary but not sufficient for semantic correctness; CD's reach ends exactly where schema conformance ends.

AI.tldr: 本文研究0.6B-4B小型开源LLM在结构化输出生成中，约束解码（CD）与模型规模的交互。作者对3个家族5个模型、14个结构化输出任务、3种解码条件进行基准测试，并用结构正确性与语义正确性两轴评估。结果显示CD能消除所有结构失败，但语义差距仍存在且与规模相关。
AI.motivation: 小型开源LLM正越来越多用于JSON、函数调用、数据提取等结构化输出任务，但约束解码在这种小模型场景下如何与模型规模相互作用仍缺乏了解。现有评估常混淆结构正确性与语义正确性，因此需要区分二者来明确CD的能力边界。
AI.method: 对来自3个家族的5个模型，在14个结构化输出任务上，比较3种解码条件：native、Outlines、XGrammar。提出两轴评估框架：结构正确性（schema有效性）和语义正确性（内容准确性），以分析约束解码对结构和语义的不同影响。
AI.result: 约束解码在所有模型上消除了全部结构失败，schema有效性从78.6-92.9%提升到100%。但内容准确性显示持续存在的语义差距，且具有规模依赖性：类型强制转换失败可被CD完全挽救，而指令语义失败（如多步函数调用）则对CD具有抵抗性。schema符合是语义正确的必要条件但不充分，CD的作用范围恰好止于schema符合。
AI.conclusion: 约束解码能保证结构化输出的schema有效性，但不能保证语义正确性；其收益边界与结构约束一致。小型LLM在结构化输出中的语义错误，尤其是指令语义类错误，仍需其他方法解决，且语义能力与模型规模相关。

title: DFD-Lab: A Modular Audio-Visual Deepfake Detection Pipeline
summary: Comparing audio-visual deepfake detectors requires coordinating dataset adaptation, temporal input representation, model interfaces and experimental conditions. We present DFD-Lab, a modular pipeline that separates these responsibilities while supporting shared training and evaluation workflows. We integrate three implementations: Xception-based maximum-logit fusion, ResNet with temporal LSTM fusion, and our AVFF reimplementation. Experiments cover external testing, degradation-based training augmentation and evaluation-time corruption. On a filtered subset of Deepfake-Eval-2024, models trained on FakeAVCeleb attain baseline AUROC values of 0.504, 0.538 and 0.458. JPEG50 training augmentation raises these to 0.691, 0.605 and 0.570, respectively, while all three accuracies decrease. These results illustrate why training interventions, evaluation corruptions and metric-dependent outcomes should remain distinct within a common pipeline. The contribution is the integration of audio-visual processing, interchangeable detectors and configurable experimental workflows, supported by empirical case studies. The findings highlight the challenge of cross-dataset detection and the complementary information provided by ranking and classification metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出模块化音视频深度伪造检测流水线 DFD-Lab，统一数据适配、时序输入表示、模型接口与实验流程，并集成三种检测器进行跨数据集与退化实验。
AI.motivation: 音视频深度伪造检测器比较缺乏统一实验条件，数据集适配、输入表示、模型接口和评测设置差异导致结果难以公平对比。
AI.method: DFD-Lab 将各职责解耦，支持共享训练与评测工作流；集成基于 Xception 的最大 logit 融合、ResNet 加时序 LSTM 融合，以及作者复现的 AVFF；在 Deepfake-Eval-2024 过滤子集上做外部测试、退化训练增强和评测时损坏实验。
AI.result: 在 FakeAVCeleb 上训练的模型基线 AUROC 分别为 0.504、0.538、0.458；加入 JPEG50 训练增强后升至 0.691、0.605、0.570，但三者的准确率均下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明训练干预、评测损坏和指标依赖结果应在统一流水线中区分；跨数据集检测仍具挑战，排序指标与分类指标提供互补信息。DFD-Lab 的贡献在于集成音视频处理、可替换检测器与可配置实验流程，并以案例研究支持。

title: BayesianGS-SLAM: Uncertainty-Aware Neural Rendering SLAM via Probabilistic Formulation
summary: Neural-rendering-based SLAM relies on rendered RGB-D residuals for camera tracking and map optimization, but the reliability of these predictions can vary substantially because of sensor noise, limited observation coverage, and incomplete map representations. Without an explicit reliability estimate, unreliable residuals may adversely affect pose optimization, while frames already well explained by the current map may trigger redundant mapping updates. In this paper, we present BayesianGS-SLAM, an uncertainty-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM framework that estimates predictive color and depth uncertainty during mapping and consistently reuses it across the SLAM pipeline. Our tractable probabilistic formulation combines a sensor-noise uncertainty component with an opacity-induced map-representation component propagated through the rendering process. The resulting predictive uncertainty is used to augment mapping, normalize tracking residuals through a robust pose objective, and evaluate incoming frames using a predictive-surprise-based keyframe criterion. Unlike prior uncertainty-aware neural-rendering SLAM methods that primarily consider color uncertainty or use uncertainty only during mapping, our framework estimates predictive uncertainty for both color and depth and integrates it into mapping, tracking, and keyframe selection. Evaluations on real-world RGB-D datasets demonstrate substantially improved depth uncertainty-error ranking compared with existing uncertainty-aware SLAM methods. Moreover, the proposed keyframe-selection strategy reduces the number of selected keyframes and mapping calls while maintaining competitive tracking and rendering performance.

AI.tldr: 提出BayesianGS-SLAM，一种不确定性感知的3D高斯泼溅SLAM框架，估计颜色和深度的预测不确定性，并将其一致地用于建图、跟踪和关键帧选择。
AI.motivation: 神经渲染SLAM依赖渲染RGB-D残差进行相机跟踪和地图优化，但传感器噪声、观测覆盖有限和地图表示不完整导致残差可靠性变化。缺乏显式可靠性估计时，不可靠残差会损害位姿优化，而当前地图已充分解释的帧会触发冗余建图更新。
AI.method: 采用可处理的概率公式，结合传感器噪声不确定性分量和由不透明度引起的地图表示不确定性分量，并通过渲染过程传播。预测不确定性用于增强建图、通过鲁棒位姿目标归一化跟踪残差，以及使用基于预测惊讶的关键帧准则评估新帧。
AI.result: 在真实世界RGB-D数据集上，与现有不确定性感知SLAM方法相比，深度不确定性-误差排序显著改善。所提出的关键帧选择策略减少了关键帧数量和建图调用次数，同时保持有竞争力的跟踪和渲染性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架同时估计颜色和深度的预测不确定性，并将其集成到建图、跟踪和关键帧选择中，优于仅考虑颜色不确定性或仅在建图中使用不确定性的先前方法。

title: MimicAgent: Quadruped Skills via Prompt-to-Trajectory Generation
summary: We present MimicAgent, a prompt-to-trajectory generation framework for learning dynamic quadruped skills. Although reward shaping is extensively used when training quadruped policies, navigating the resulting reward landscape is notoriously difficult, requiring hours of "graduate student descent". Eureka attempts to automate reward design with LLMs, but we find that it struggles to generalize across diverse skills and morphologies. Our key observation is that it is far easier for a human - and by association, an LLM - to generate reference motions than to shape reward functions. Our hypothesis is motivated by the success of example-guided RL for humanoids, which exploits large-scale motion capture datasets as references for training locomotion policies. Unlike humanoids, quadrupeds lack such reference motion data. Towards this end, we propose MimicAgent, an agentic harness that, given a skill prompt, generates quadruped reference trajectories with coding agents. These coarse reference trajectories are then used to train example-guided RL policies that are deployable in simulation and in the real-world. Notably, we find that when prompting Claude Fable 5.1 within our agentic harness, 87% of prompts yield semantically aligned reference trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出 MimicAgent，一个根据技能提示词生成四足机器人参考轨迹的智能体框架，并利用这些轨迹通过示例引导强化学习训练可部署的动态四足技能。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人策略训练中奖励塑形极其困难，Eureka 等 LLM 自动奖励设计方法难以泛化到多样技能和形态。人类和 LLM 更容易生成参考动作而非设计奖励函数，且类人机器人已受益于大规模动作捕捉数据，但四足机器人缺乏此类参考运动数据。
AI.method: MimicAgent 是一个智能体化框架：给定技能提示词，利用编码智能体生成四足机器人参考轨迹；再将这些粗略参考轨迹用于示例引导强化学习，训练可在仿真和真实世界中部署的策略。
AI.result: 在智能体框架内使用 Claude Fable 5.1 时，87% 的提示词能够生成语义对齐的参考轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 通过 LLM 编码智能体生成参考运动，可绕开困难的奖励塑形，为四足机器人提供示例引导强化学习所需的数据，从而学习可部署的动态技能。

title: HaikuS2S: A Cascaded System For Responding In Verse
comment: Accepted to SLT 2026, Demo Track. 5 pages, 5 figures
summary: Expressive speech synthesis has advanced through prosody modeling, yet generating structured poetic speech, such as haiku, remains challenging. Prior work on prosody transfer improves expressiveness, and fine-tuned poetry TTS (text-to-speech) systems capture verse intonation. However, these models do not model haiku's 5-7-5 syllable structure or line-ending pauses. We present a cascaded system, HaikuS2S, combining ASR (automatic speech recognition), LLM (large language model)-generated haiku, and TTS fine-tuning on both prose and custom haiku datasets. Our evaluation focuses on emotion similarity, speech quality, and prosody alignment. In our experiments, we see that our prosody and tonal alignment improve significantly with our fine-tuned systems, particularly the one trained on both general poetry and haiku. We also see that we maintain similar emotion similarity scores across all systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出级联系统HaikuS2S，结合ASR、LLM生成俳句和TTS微调，以生成具有俳句5-7-5结构和行末停顿的诗歌语音。
AI.motivation: 现有韵律迁移和诗歌TTS系统虽能提升表现力，但未建模俳句特有的5-7-5音节结构和行末停顿，因此结构化诗歌语音合成仍具挑战。
AI.method: 采用级联式HaikuS2S系统：使用ASR、LLM生成俳句，并在散文数据集和自定义俳句数据集上对TTS进行微调。评估情感相似度、语音质量和韵律对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明，微调系统显著提升了韵律和声调对齐，尤其在通用诗歌与俳句数据上联合训练的模型表现最佳；各系统之间的情感相似度得分相近。
AI.conclusion: 结合LLM生成与诗歌/俳句数据微调的级联TTS方法，能有效改善俳句语音的韵律和声调对齐，同时保持情感相似度。

title: Q-TIE: A Lightweight and Generalizable Re-ranking Framework for Temporal Information Retrieval
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE
summary: Temporal Information Retrieval (TIR) has been increasingly critical given the rise of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Since temporally mismatched evidence can be highly misleading, TIR aims to retrieve documents that are both semantically and temporally relevant to a query. Two TIR paradigms have emerged - temporal retrievers and temporal re-rankers - differing in how temporal relevance is modeled. While these paradigms provide complementary strengths, our analysis reveals that each alone falls short of robust TIR: temporal retrievers provide flexible query understanding via learned representations, but often fail to explicitly account for temporal constraints; temporal re-rankers can enforce such constraints more explicitly, but often rely on predefined re-ranking rules. To address this, we propose Q-TIE, a re-ranking framework based on learned Temporal Intent Extraction (TIE). By introducing a TIE model that maps each query's temporal constraint into a unified interval representation (i.e., $\langle t_{start}, t_{end} \rangle$), Q-TIE generalizes beyond predefined rules via model-based learning while explicitly modeling temporal constraints as a separate signal - jointly achieving what each paradigm typically trades off. Experiments demonstrate that Q-TIE consistently outperforms existing TIR methods with stronger generalizability across temporal query types, and provides a lightweight yet effective add-on for temporally-aware RAG pipelines. Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Q-TIE，一个基于可学习时间意图抽取（TIE）的重排序框架，用于提升时间信息检索（TIR）的鲁棒性，并可作为时间感知RAG流程的轻量插件。
AI.motivation: 在RAG兴起的背景下，时间不匹配的证据会产生严重误导，因此TIR需同时检索语义和时间相关的文档。现有时间检索器与时间重排序器各有优势但互补不足：前者灵活但难以显式建模时间约束，后者能显式约束但常依赖预定义规则。
AI.method: 提出Q-TIE重排序框架，核心是TIE模型，将查询的时间约束映射为统一区间表示⟨t_start, t_end⟩。该方法通过基于模型的学习泛化预定义规则，并将时间约束作为独立信号显式建模，从而结合两类TIR范式的优势。
AI.result: 实验表明，Q-TIE持续优于现有TIR方法，在不同时间查询类型上具有更强泛化能力，同时作为轻量且有效的附加组件，可集成到时间感知的RAG流程中。
AI.conclusion: Q-TIE通过可学习的时间意图抽取与显式时间约束建模，弥补了时间检索器和时间重排序器各自的不足，实现了更鲁棒、可泛化的时间信息检索。

title: InterHier: Learning Interconnected Hierarchical Semantics for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. Published in IEEE Access
summary: In this paper, we investigate the limitations of fixed, hand-crafted connectors in hierarchical semantic representations for open-vocabulary object detection. Existing methods establish semantic relationships between base categories and unseen novel categories by placing a fixed connector between adjacent super-/sub-categories. However, such fixed connectors may not optimally capture the relationships within a semantic hierarchy. To address this limitation, we propose interconnected hierarchical semantic representations (InterHier), which utilize a prepended learnable context to globally guide the interpretation of prompts containing hierarchical relationships. InterHier operates in two main stages. First, it constructs a hierarchy-aware prompt by integrating super-/sub-categories and prepending a learnable context. Second, it optimizes this learnable context to align visual region embeddings and textual embeddings. InterHier consistently improves performance over methods that rely on fixed connectors and can be seamlessly integrated into existing open-vocabulary object detection models. Experiments on open-vocabulary object detection benchmarks demonstrate that InterHier achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出InterHier，用可学习的前置上下文替代固定手工连接器，改进开放词汇目标检测中的分层语义表示，并在基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在相邻上位/下位类别间使用固定、手工设计的连接器来建立基类与未见新类之间的语义关系，但这种固定连接器可能无法最优地捕捉语义层次中的关系。
AI.method: InterHier分为两阶段：首先将上位/下位类别与可学习上下文整合，构建层次感知提示；然后优化该可学习上下文，以对齐视觉区域嵌入和文本嵌入。该方法可无缝集成到现有开放词汇目标检测模型中。
AI.result: 实验表明，InterHier在开放词汇目标检测基准上持续优于依赖固定连接器的方法，并相比当前最优方法取得了有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 使用可学习上下文全局指导层次关系提示，能更有效地建模语义层次并提升开放词汇目标检测性能，且易于集成到现有模型中。

title: Comparative Performance and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of DINOv2 for Active Trachoma Classification
summary: Automated grading of conjunctival photographs could reduce the cost and variability of trachoma prevalence surveys, but the relative value of modern pretrained visual representations, lightweight feature adaptation, and training-objective design has not been established under a common protocol. This study presents a controlled evaluation for binary classification of Trachomatous Inflammation-Follicular (TF) versus Normal using 1,546 images from the public UCSF/Lietman collection. Images are processed using the OPTED pipeline for zero-shot tarsal-conjunctiva segmentation, alignment, cropping, and standardization. We first compare six pretrained backbones using a common classification pipeline and then evaluate four lightweight adaptation mechanisms on DINOv2 ViT-B/14. Under stratified five-fold cross-validation, DINOv2 with Efficient Channel Attention (ECA) and focal-plus-center loss achieved 91.66 +/- 0.97% accuracy, 90.69 +/- 1.10% macro-F1, and 96.06 +/- 0.71% AUC. ECA introduces only five learnable parameters while matching the performance of substantially larger alternatives. Objective ablation further showed that ECA did not consistently improve plain DINOv2 across loss functions; the lowest-variance 91.66% accuracy was obtained with cross-entropy plus center loss.
