Overall, the fine-tuned DINOv2 representation provided most of the predictive performance, while ECA offered a highly parameter-efficient refinement whose effect depended on the training objective. The resulting workflow provides a reproducible benchmark for active trachoma image classification.

AI.tldr: 该研究在统一协议下评估了自动化沙眼滤泡性炎症（TF）与正常结膜图像分类，比较多种预训练视觉骨干和轻量适配机制，发现微调DINOv2提供主要性能，ECA可在极少参数下提供依赖训练目标的精炼效果。
AI.motivation: 自动分级结膜照片有望降低沙眼患病率调查的成本和变异性，但现代预训练视觉表示、轻量特征适配机制以及训练目标设计在统一协议下的相对价值尚未明确。
AI.method: 使用UCSF/Lietman公开数据集中1,546张图像，经OPTED流程进行零样本睑结膜分割、对齐、裁剪和标准化；先以统一分类流程比较六种预训练骨干，再在DINOv2 ViT-B/14上评估四种轻量适配机制，并采用分层五折交叉验证和损失函数消融。
AI.result: DINOv2结合ECA和focal-plus-center loss达到91.66±0.97%准确率、90.69±1.10%宏F1和96.06±0.71% AUC；ECA仅增加5个可学习参数，却能匹敌更大替代方案。消融显示ECA并非在所有损失函数下都稳定提升plain DINOv2，最低方差的91.66%准确率由交叉熵加center loss取得。
AI.conclusion: 微调后的DINOv2表示贡献了大部分预测性能，ECA提供参数高效的细化作用，但其效果取决于训练目标；该工作流为活动性沙眼图像分类提供了可复现基准。

title: Object-Centric Conditioning for Visuomotor Flow Matching
comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Robot visuomotor policies are commonly formulated as autoregressive, diffusion-based, or more recently, flow matching models. Among them, Action-to-Action (A2A) flow matching improves inference efficiency by initializing generation from historical action priors rather than stochastic noise. However, stale historical motion patterns and entangled global visual representations can jointly reduce robustness under spatial out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts and visual distractors. In this work, we propose SlotFlow, an object-centric flow matching policy for robust visuomotor manipulation. SlotFlow decouples scene observations into semantic ("what") features and lightweight image-plane spatial ("where") cues to provide object-aware policy conditioning and current-state grounding. The semantic representation suppresses irrelevant background correlations, while the spatial cue improves adaptation to shifted object configurations. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved robustness under visual distractors and severe spatial perturbations while preserving the low-step inference efficiency of A2A. Controlled initialization and perception ablations further identify object-centric grounding as a major source of the gains and show that it complements, rather than replaces, useful historical motion priors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SlotFlow，一种面向对象的流匹配策略，用于提升机器人视觉运动操作在空间分布外偏移和视觉干扰下的鲁棒性，同时保持 A2A 流匹配的低步数推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人视觉运动策略常采用自回归、扩散或流匹配模型；其中 Action-to-Action（A2A）流匹配通过历史动作先验初始化生成以提升推理效率，但过时历史运动模式和纠缠的全局视觉表示会共同削弱其在空间 OOD 偏移和视觉干扰下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: SlotFlow 将场景观测解耦为语义“what”特征和轻量级图像平面空间“where”线索，以实现对象感知的策略条件和当前状态 grounding。语义表示抑制无关背景关联，空间线索增强对物体配置变化的适应能力。
AI.result: 大量仿真和真实世界实验表明，SlotFlow 在视觉干扰和严重空间扰动下具有更好的鲁棒性，同时保留 A2A 的低步数推理效率。受控初始化和感知消融进一步表明，对象中心 grounding 是主要增益来源，并且它补充而非替代有用的历史运动先验。
AI.conclusion: SlotFlow 通过对象中心流匹配提升视觉运动操作的鲁棒性与效率，说明对象级 grounding 与历史运动先验可互补结合，适用于存在视觉干扰和空间偏移的操作任务。

title: From UNDRR Reports to Event Records: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction of Georeferenced Disasters
summary: Disaster-risk-reduction archives describe hazard events in prose that databases such as EM-DAT (Delforge et al., 2025) cannot ingest directly. We present an LLM pipeline that generates candidate georeferenced event records using a controlled hazard vocabulary and fixed schema, retaining evidence for review. Applied to 10,000 documents from PreventionWeb, the knowledge hub managed by UNDRR, it produced 3,572 records from 1,913 documents across 24 hazard types and resolved 81% of location mentions to OpenStreetMap geometries. On 171 human-positive document windows from a stratified 217-document reference set, GPT-5 achieved 86.0% pooled attribute $F_1$, versus 44.2% for the spaCy-gazetteer baseline. Evaluation pools hazard families, location strings, and event years within documents, without assessing their assignment to individual events. GPT-5.4 ranked highest among ten LLMs (86.6% $F_1$). Verbatim evidence occurrence was 72.0% for GPT-5 and 47.2% for GPT-5.4, measuring textual traceability without establishing attribute support. We report production failure modes and automated label and location-rule compliance checks. Prompts, schema, and outputs will be released for adaptation to national reporting archives.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个LLM流水线，从灾害风险减少（DRR）档案文本中生成带地理参考的事件记录，使用受控灾害词表和固定模式，并保留证据供人工审核。应用于PreventionWeb的1万份文档，生成3572条记录，覆盖24种灾害类型，81%位置提及解析到OpenStreetMap几何。
AI.motivation: DRR档案以散文形式描述灾害事件，EM-DAT等数据库无法直接摄取，因此需要自动化方法从文本中提取结构化、可地理定位的事件记录。
AI.method: 构建LLM流水线，采用受控灾害词表和固定模式，生成候选地理参考事件记录并保留证据。在PreventionWeb的10,000份文档上运行，用217份文档分层参考集中的171个人工正样本窗口评估，比较GPT-5、GPT-5.4、spaCy-gazetteer基线及十种LLM。
AI.result: 生成3,572条记录（来自1,913份文档），覆盖24种灾害类型，81%位置提及解析到OSM。GPT-5池化属性F1为86.0%，远高于spaCy基线的44.2%；GPT-5.4在十种LLM中最高（86.6%）。逐字证据出现率：GPT-5为72.0%，GPT-5.4为47.2%。评估在文档内池化灾害族、位置字符串和事件年份，未评估其到单个事件的分配。报告了生产故障模式并做了自动标签和位置规则合规检查。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线能为人工审核生成带证据的候选事件记录，并推动将方法适配到国家报告档案；提示、模式与输出将公开释放。

title: MotionJEPA: Preventing Temporal Feature Collapse by Capturing Visual Changes in Latent Space
comment: *Equal contribution (Markus Karmann, Shile Li). Code available: https://github.com/mkarmann/motion-jepa
summary: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are a promising paradigm for learning task-agnostic latent world models without visual reconstruction. However, standard JEPA training exhibits a strong inductive bias towards slow features, causing feature suppression and the collapse of latent representation. While inverse dynamics provides temporal anti-collapse, it relies on action labels and offers little incentive to embed general, unlabeled dynamics. We introduce Difference Image and Single image embedding Regularization (DISReg), a novel regularizer that builds on an inverse-dynamics-style module that predicts temporal difference image embeddings without any pixel reconstruction loss, encouraging balanced static and dynamic feature learning. DISReg consists of a static term that shapes the distribution of the image embedding and encourages slow features, and a dynamic term, which, unlike direct regularization on the embedding, imposes no constraint on the image embedding's shape or distribution and instead only incentivizes that dynamic features be present. By integrating this regularizer into a standard JEPA, we establish our new architecture, MotionJEPA. Latent probing demonstrates that MotionJEPA produces more complete representations than other methods, and our trajectory analysis shows it maintains geometrically simple latent embeddings with low curvature. We further show that MotionJEPA improves downstream planning success under static-background distractors across four environments.

AI.tldr: 提出DISReg正则化方法，用于JEPA训练中平衡静态和动态特征学习，构建MotionJEPA，提升表示完整性和下游规划性能。
AI.motivation: 标准JEPA训练存在慢特征归纳偏置，导致特征抑制和潜在表示崩溃；逆动力学方法依赖动作标签，且缺乏嵌入通用无标签动态的激励。
AI.method: 提出DISReg正则化器，包含静态项（塑造图像嵌入分布，鼓励慢特征）和动态项（不约束嵌入形状，仅激励动态特征存在），并将其集成到标准JEPA中，形成MotionJEPA。
AI.result: 潜在探测表明MotionJEPA产生更完整的表示，轨迹分析显示其保持几何简单的潜在嵌入和低曲率；在四个环境中，MotionJEPA提高了静态背景干扰下的下游规划成功率。
AI.conclusion: MotionJEPA通过DISReg有效平衡静态和动态特征学习，提升表示质量和下游规划性能。

title: From Content Generation to Learning Support: Pedagogy-Guided Generative Video Tutors for STEM Learning
comment: accepted to EMNLP 2026, code available at GitHub
summary: Generative AI enables scalable production of educational videos, but current systems largely focus on producing visually coherent content rather than supporting learning. As a result, generated videos often lack explicit pedagogical structure, reliable quality control, and mechanisms for assessing learner understanding or addressing misconceptions. In this work, we introduce PIVOT (Pedagogy-guided Instructional VideO Tutoring), a generative video tutoring framework for STEM learning via learning-centered instructional support.1 Inspired by conventional teaching workflows, our framework integrates pedagogy into the full generation pipeline: it first uses instructional principles to guide storyboard generation, then produces verified multimodal videos through code-centric generation and a pedagogical verification harness, and finally connects videos with assessment and misconception-aware remediation. Experiments and expert evaluations across four STEM domains show that our framework produces educational videos with pedagogically aligned content, clear and engaging presentation, coherent instructional flow, and perceived effectiveness for learning. These findings suggest a human-centered perspective on educational content generation: generative systems should be evaluated and designed not only by what they produce, but also by how they support teaching practices, learner understanding, and corrective feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出PIVOT框架，将教学法融入生成式教学视频全流程，用于STEM学习，并通过实验和专家评估验证其教学有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式AI虽能规模化制作教育视频，但系统主要关注视觉连贯性，而非学习支持，导致视频缺乏明确教学结构、质量控制和评估理解/纠正误解的机制。
AI.method: PIVOT受传统教学工作流启发，将教学法整合到完整生成管线：先用教学原则指导故事板生成，再通过代码中心生成与教学验证机制产出经过验证的多模态视频，最后连接评估与误解感知的补救。
AI.result: 在四个STEM领域的实验和专家评估表明，该框架生成的视频教学内容与教学法一致、呈现清晰有吸引力、教学流程连贯，并被认为对学习有效。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持一种以人为本的教育内容生成视角：生成系统不仅应以其产出物来评估和设计，还应以其如何支持教学实践、学习者理解和纠正性反馈来评估和设计。

title: Time-Incremental Continued Pretraining of LLMs: Knowledge Updates Without Catastrophic Forgetting
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) drift out of date the moment their pretraining ends, yet retraining from scratch is prohibitively expensive. Continued pretraining (CPT) is the natural remedy, but it is typically evaluated through a continual learning lens that assumes disjoint data streams. This is a poor fit for time-incremental updates on web-scale crawls, where successive snapshots share substantial URL overlap by design. We study time-incremental CPT in this realistic regime: continued pretraining on FineWeb-Edu dumps drawn strictly from after each model's knowledge cutoff, evaluated across six open-weight models spanning three families (OLMo2, Llama-3.1/3.2, Gemma-3-1B) and four parameter scales (1B-3B-7B-8B).
  We organize our findings around four practical questions. (i) Is knowledge acquired? Yes, but heterogeneously, and without catastrophic forgetting: five of six models also improve on pre-cutoff factual recall, and the gains track pretraining saturation (driven primarily by token budget per parameter). (ii) What does it cost? Almost nothing: the macro-average across a thirteen-task suite stays within 0.01 of the base for every model. (iii) What is the recipe? Data quality dominates quantity (a curated 6B-token slice matches a broader 40B one); the optima for knowledge acquisition and general capability are separated by roughly an order of magnitude in learning rate; and LoRA at sufficient rank matches full CPT. (iv) Does it survive deployment? CPT gains transfer through SFT, while DPO's effect is family-dependent. Together, these results paint a more optimistic picture of time-incremental CPT than the prior continual learning literature suggests.

AI.tldr: 本文研究时间增量式持续预训练（CPT）在真实网页快照重叠场景下的效果，基于六个开源模型和FineWeb-Edu数据，发现CPT能有效获取新知识且几乎不损害通用能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型预训练后知识迅速过时，但从头重训成本过高；持续预训练虽自然，但以往从持续学习视角评估，假设数据流不相交，不适配网页级爬取中连续快照存在大量URL重叠的现实。
AI.method: 对六个开放权重模型（OLMo2、Llama-3.1/3.2、Gemma-3-1B，覆盖1B、3B、7B、8B）进行时间增量CPT，使用严格晚于各模型知识截止时间的FineWeb-Edu数据，并围绕知识获取、代价、配方和部署后保持性四个问题评估。
AI.result: 知识获取存在但异质，且无灾难性遗忘：六个模型中五个在截止前事实召回上也有提升，增益与预训练饱和度相关；十三项任务宏平均与基座差距在0.01内；数据质量重于数量（精选6B token可媲美更广的40B）；知识获取与通用能力的最优学习率相差约一个数量级；足够高秩的LoRA可匹配全量CPT；CPT增益可经SFT传递，而DPO影响因模型家族而异。
AI.conclusion: 时间增量式CPT比先前持续学习文献所暗示的更为乐观，能够以低成本获取新知识并基本保持通用能力，且可通过合适配方和后续训练阶段部分保留。

title: GraspTune: Tactile-Driven Execution Refinement for Robust Grasping
summary: Visual grasp proposal generation has advanced rapidly, yet converting a selected proposal into a stable physical grasp remains a central execution-stage challenge. This paper introduces GraspTune, a tactile-driven execution-stage refinement framework that starts from a nominal proposal and applies bounded residual TCP motions during approach, contact formation, and final grasp execution. GraspTune learns control-facing contact semantics from local depth, tactile signals, state, and history using state-conditioned expert contact queries and multi-task supervision for contact change, contact risk, and post-close readiness. The representation conditions a diffusion-pretrained residual policy and is aligned with PPO for closed-loop execution. Across more than 60,000 simulated executions over 20 object categories, GraspTune establishes an execution-layer benefit across four proposal generators, raising stable grasp success by +19.22, +9.55, +12.45, and +20.70 percentage points for GraspNet, Contact-GraspNet, AnyGrasp, and VGN. A four-fold held-out category study raises unseen-object execution from 54.58% to 70.33%, showing category-disjoint generalization of contact correction. Across more than 1,000 real-robot trials on a UR5e setup with Xense fingertip sensors, GraspTune raises GraspNet execution from 71.0% to 84.3%, validating direct transfer without realworld policy fine-tuning. Together, these results turn visually plausible proposals into stable physical grasps for downstream contact-rich manipulation. A supplementary video is available at https://youtu.be/kcq7fSLNtzU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GraspTune，一个触觉驱动的执行阶段细化框架，从视觉抓取提案出发，在接近、接触形成和最终抓取执行中应用有界残余TCP运动，将视觉上合理的提案转化为稳定物理抓取。
AI.motivation: 视觉抓取提案生成进展迅速，但将选定的提案转化为稳定的物理抓取仍是执行阶段的核心挑战。
AI.method: GraspTune利用局部深度、触觉信号、状态和历史，通过状态条件专家接触查询和多任务监督（接触变化、接触风险、闭合后准备度）学习面向控制的接触语义。该表示条件化一个扩散预训练残余策略，并与PPO对齐用于闭环执行。
AI.result: 在20个物体类别的60,000多次模拟执行中，GraspTune对GraspNet、Contact-GraspNet、AnyGrasp和VGN分别将稳定抓取成功率提升+19.22、+9.55、+12.45和+20.70个百分点。四折留出类别研究将未见物体执行率从54.58%提升至70.33%。在UR5e和Xense指尖传感器的1000多次真实机器人试验中，GraspNet执行率从71.0%提升至84.3%，无需真实世界策略微调。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果将视觉上合理的提案转化为稳定的物理抓取，可用于下游接触丰富的操作任务。

title: Colon3R: Cross-Domain 3D Reconstruction from Monocular Colonoscopic Video
summary: Monocular colonoscopic 3D reconstruction is important for surgical robotic colonoscopy, but remains challenging due to weak texture, specular reflections, limited view overlap, and non-rigid tissue motion. Conventional multi-view 3D reconstruction methods rely on stable correspondences and approximate rigidity, which are often violated in colonoscopy. Existing endoscopic methods often rely on domain-specific supervision, whereas there are not enough in-vivo labeled data available to adapt geometry foundation models to clinical colonoscopy. We present Colon3R, a cross-domain semi-supervised framework built on pretrained VGGT that transfers coupled camera, depth, and pointmap geometry from labeled phantom and simulated data to unlabeled in-vivo colonoscopy without requiring target-domain geometric annotations. Unlike source-only fine-tuning, which learns only from phantom and simulated data, Colon3R directly exploits unlabeled in-vivo video through teacher-derived cross-view supervision. Our proposed hierarchical quasi-rigid reliability selects reliable supervision at the sequence, directed-pair, and pixel levels, while source-preserving adaptation retains the learned coupled geometry during target-domain adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior overall performance over state-of-the-art approaches in depth, pointmap, and camera pose estimation. Qualitative comparisons on real in-vivo colonoscopy further show substantially more complete and geometrically consistent reconstructions than competing methods under clinical domain shift. The code will be public available after the paper is accepted.

AI.tldr: 提出 Colon3R，一个基于预训练 VGGT 的跨域半监督框架，将体模与模拟数据中的相机、深度和点图几何迁移到无标注的在体结肠镜数据，实现单目结肠镜 3D 重建。
AI.motivation: 单目结肠镜 3D 重建对机器人结肠镜很重要，但受弱纹理、镜面反射、视角重叠有限和非刚性组织运动影响；传统多视图方法依赖稳定对应和近似刚性假设，现有内镜方法又依赖域特定监督，且缺乏在体标注，难以将几何基础模型适配到临床结肠镜。
AI.method: 基于预训练 VGGT 构建跨域半监督框架，利用无标注在体视频通过教师模型提供跨视图监督；提出分层准刚性可靠性机制，在序列、有向图像对和像素三个层面筛选可靠监督；同时采用源域保持自适应，在目标域适配时保留已学习的耦合几何。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在深度、点图和相机位姿估计上总体优于现有最先进方法；真实在体结肠镜定性比较显示，在临床域偏移下能获得更完整、几何一致性更强的重建结果。
AI.conclusion: Colon3R 无需目标域几何标注即可完成跨域适应，有效提升临床结肠镜单目 3D 重建的鲁棒性与几何一致性。

title: this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent
summary: Software delegates more of its branches to models every year: which queue a ticket enters, whether a command is safe to run, whether a claim clears without a person. What the program needs back is not prose. It is one of n declared options and a number it can threshold. Today that costs a round trip to a frontier model -- hundreds of milliseconds, a per-token bill, and a parser -- for a question that is usually a conjunction of three clauses. this-that-model-1.0 is a 2B-parameter typed decision model. Its answer is read directly from the hidden state at a designated position and restricted to the option set the caller declared, so no text is generated, nothing can be malformed, and every question in a request is answered in the same forward pass. It decides in 30.9 ms on one laptop GPU and generates zero output tokens doing it, where a frontier API call costs 8758 ms and the hosted systems that answer these questions well spend between 21 and 212 generated tokens per question thinking first, billed for every one. It sustains 32 decisions per second on one consumer GPU and never lets the state leave the machine. On a third party's recorded cohort of 68 decision questions, on their inputs and their wording, it scores 0.941 with a Brier score of 0.042, against 0.765 and 0.133 for the hosted service Jev on the same items. One pass of our 42-family internal suite takes 32 seconds and 0.000217 USD of electricity; the most accurate hosted model we measured needs 155.2 minutes and 10.636 USD. We also report where it loses. On multi-step arithmetic, which a single forward pass cannot carry intermediate results through, it scores 0.560 against their 0.98 to 1.00, and a targeted second training round improved the five task families it was written for and transferred to none of the other 13. The model is open-sourced in https://huggingface.co/flock-io/this-that-model-1.0

AI.tldr: 本文提出 this-that-model-1.0，一个 2B 参数的类型化决策模型，直接从隐藏状态读取答案并限制在调用方声明的选项集合内，不生成文本，从而在单次前向传播中快速、低成本、可本地部署地完成多项声明式决策。
AI.motivation: 软件越来越多地把分支判断交给模型，例如票据进入哪个队列、命令是否安全、理赔是否自动通过。程序需要的不是自然语言，而是 n 个预设选项之一以及可阈值化的数值。当前做法通常要调用前沿模型，带来数百毫秒延迟、按 token 计费和解析器开销，而问题往往只是三子句的合取，成本与需求不匹配。
AI.method: 提出 2B 参数的类型化决策模型。答案不通过生成文本获得，而是从指定位置的隐藏状态直接读取，并限制在调用方声明的选项集中；同一请求中的所有问题可在同一次前向传播中回答。模型支持本地推理，并报告了一次针对性第二轮训练及其迁移效果。模型已在 Hugging Face 开源。
AI.result: 在单块笔记本 GPU 上决策耗时 30.9 ms，生成 0 个输出 token；前沿 API 调用为 8758 ms，托管系统每个问题需生成 21 至 212 个 token。单块消费级 GPU 上可持续每秒 32 次决策，且状态不离开本机。第三方 68 个决策问题队列上得分为 0.941，Brier 分数 0.042，而托管服务 Jev 为 0.765 和 0.133。内部 42 族套件一轮耗时 32 秒，电费 0.000217 美元；测得最准的托管模型需 155.2 分钟和 10.636 美元。多步算术上仅 0.560，对手为 0.98 至 1.00；第二轮训练改善了目标五类任务，但未迁移到其余 13 类。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，对于大量简单但需结构化输出的分支决策，专门的小型类型化模型可在速度、成本、隐私和输出可靠性上显著优于前沿 API 与托管服务。同时，它存在明确局限：单次前向传播难以处理需要中间结果的多步算术，且针对性训练迁移性有限。模型已开源。

title: Measuring the Assistant's Harmlessness Preferences on the User Turn
summary: Post-training turns a general next-token predictor into a chat model with a persistent assistant persona. If that persona is a character the model plays only on its own turns, its preferences should govern what the assistant says, not what the model predicts other speakers will say. We test this boundary and find that it does not hold: a safety-relevant preference of the assistant---for harmless over harmful tasks---shapes the model's predictions even on the user's turn, where the assistant is not the one speaking. We find that this preference is small or near-zero in pretrained base models, that it emerges through post-training, replicated across open-weight model families, grows with scale, and can be moved by narrow finetuning that never touches user turns. We claim that this is evidence that post-training does not merely install a shallow assistant persona, but instead generalises beyond just the local assistant turn, into the model's representation of the user.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究后训练是否只塑造助手自身回合的浅层人设。结果显示，助手对“无害优于有害”的安全偏好会溢出到对用户回合的预测，说明后训练会影响模型对用户表征的更广泛泛化。
AI.motivation: 后训练使通用下一词预测器变成具有持久助手人设的聊天模型。若助手人设仅作用于助手自己的回合，其偏好应只影响助手说什么，而不应影响模型预测用户会说什么。作者试图检验这一边界是否成立。
AI.method: 作者通过比较预训练基座模型与后训练模型，检测助手安全偏好是否影响对用户回合的预测；并在多个开放权重模型家族中复现，考察规模效应，以及用不涉及用户回合的窄范围微调是否能改变该偏好。
AI.result: 助手“偏好无害任务而非有害任务”的安全相关性偏好在基座模型中很小或接近零，但在后训练后出现，并在不同开放权重模型家族中复现，随规模增长而增强，且可通过不触碰用户回合的窄微调被改变。
AI.conclusion: 后训练并非只安装一个仅作用于助手回合的浅层助手人设，而是将其泛化到模型对用户的表征中，使助手的偏好也会塑造对用户回合的预测。

title: StenoVLA-3D: 3D-Aware Reasoning VLA for Navigation Through Gastrointestinal Stenoses
summary: Autonomous endoscopic navigation requires the policy model to predict actions from texture-poor monocular observations, make safe control decisions, and retain evidence of lesions after they leave the field of view. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) models primarily rely on visual appearance and short-term context, limiting geometric grounding and episode-level reporting. We introduce StenoVLA-3D, a 3D-aware VLA framework for navigating through stenotic regions. We integrate point-maps into the Cosmos-Reason 2 backbone through learned geometry-gated fusion, and also propose a temporal state branch to model traversal progress. Our reasoning-and-action backbone predicts grounded reasoning with actions, while dedicated heads estimate stenosis shape and generate the final lesion report. We further introduce EndoCausal, an episode-level dataset with lesion annotations, actions, and temporally grounded reasoning. On 40 held-out recorded test episodes, StenoVLA-3D reaches 95.2\% semantic accuracy and 83.4\% action accuracy. On the physical 3-DoF endoscope, it attains 88.9\% and 77.8\% task success in esophageal and colonic phantoms (36 trials each), substantially outperforming the evaluated baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出StenoVLA-3D，一种用于狭窄区域自主内镜导航的3D感知VLA框架，通过点图融合、时序状态分支和专用头部实现推理、动作预测与病灶报告，并构建EndoCausal数据集，在记录测试和物理内镜实验中大幅超越基线。
AI.motivation: 自主内镜导航需从纹理稀疏的单目观测中预测动作、做出安全控制决策，并在病灶离开视野后保留其证据。现有VLA模型主要依赖视觉外观和短期上下文，限制了几何 grounding 和 episode 级报告能力。
AI.method: 将点图通过几何门控融合集成到Cosmos-Reason 2骨干中，并引入时序状态分支建模穿越进度；推理与动作骨干联合预测 grounded reasoning 和动作，专用头部估计狭窄形状并生成最终病灶报告；同时提出EndoCausal episode级数据集，包含病灶标注、动作和时序 grounded reasoning。
AI.result: 在40个留出记录测试episode上，语义准确率95.2%，动作准确率83.4%；在物理3自由度内镜上，食管和结肠体模中任务成功率分别为88.9%和77.8%（各36次试验），显著优于评估基线。
AI.conclusion: StenoVLA-3D通过3D感知和几何门控融合提升了狭窄区域内镜导航的语义理解、动作精度和病灶报告能力，并在物理实验中验证了有效性。

title: Action-Slot: Structured Action-Centric Representation Learning for Multi-Agent Atomic Activity Understanding
summary: Atomic activity understanding aims to recognize and localize structured traffic behaviors that jointly encode motion patterns and their grounding in road topology. Unlike conventional action recognition, atomic activities are multi-agent, multi-label, and topology-aware: multiple activities co-occur while many agents remain inactive. We introduce Action-Slot, a structured action-centric representation learning framework. Slot attention is widely used for object-centric decomposition, but its permutation-invariant design and object-level inductive bias are misaligned with atomic activity semantics. We reformulate slot learning as structured activity decomposition through three designs: (1) category-aligned action slots that anchor slots to predefined activity categories, (2) parallel spatio-temporal slot updating for holistic video-level reasoning, and (3) background and negative-slot regularization that enforces competition between foreground activities and irrelevant regions. Together these establish an activity-centric inductive bias that disentangles concurrent and asynchronous activities directly from raw video. Beyond recognition, the learned representations encode transferable spatio-temporal grounding signals. We further propose an attention-difference-based pseudo mask selection framework that suppresses false positives by measuring attention changes before and after candidate region removal, enabling weakly supervised localization without dense annotations. To support systematic evaluation, we introduce TACO, a balanced synthetic dataset with full atomic activity coverage and pixel-level annotations. Experiments on OATS, TACO, and annotated nuScenes show superior recognition, strong sim-to-real transfer, and state-of-the-art weakly supervised localization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Action-Slot，一种以活动为中心的结构化表示学习框架，用于识别和定位多智能体、多标签、拓扑感知的原子交通活动；同时提出 TACO 合成数据集与注意力差异伪掩码选择方法，实现弱监督定位。
AI.motivation: 原子活动理解不同于传统动作识别：它涉及多智能体、多标签和道路拓扑，多个活动可能同时发生而许多智能体并不活跃。现有 slot attention 的排列不变性和对象级归纳偏置与原子活动语义不匹配，因此需要活动中心的结构化分解方法。
AI.method: Action-Slot 通过三项设计改造 slot learning：1）类别对齐的动作槽，将槽锚定到预定义活动类别；2）并行时空槽更新，实现整体视频级推理；3）背景与负槽正则，促使前景活动与无关区域竞争。此外，提出基于注意力差异的伪掩码选择框架，通过比较移除候选区域前后的注意力变化抑制假阳性，实现无需密集标注的弱监督定位。并构建 TACO 合成数据集，提供完整原子活动覆盖和像素级标注。
AI.result: 在 OATS、TACO 和标注 nuScenes 上的实验表明：识别性能更优，具有较强的仿真到真实迁移能力，并达到最先进的弱监督定位效果。
AI.conclusion: Action-Slot 建立了活动中心的归纳偏置，能够直接从原始视频中解耦并发和异步活动，学习可迁移的时空定位信号，并在识别与弱监督定位任务上验证了有效性。

title: Rethinking Diffusion Segmentation: When Does It Rely on Its Noisy State, and Does Diffusion Matter?
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly adapted from generation to conditional prediction, where a conditioning signal is combined with an evolving noisy representation of the target. In fully supervised segmentation, however, the conditioning image can already support direct target prediction, so endpoint performance alone establishes neither reliance on the added diffusion state nor a deterministic advantage over image-only prediction. For state reliance, we disrupt target-derived state content or correct image-state pairing during retraining of twelve published methods across three datasets, with ten matched seeds per setting. All 40 original-method comparisons whose evaluated-mask routes remained downstream of noised-quantity reconstruction exhibited state reliance, whereas all 30 comparisons with a segmentation-supervised bypass preserved reference performance. Rerouting five originally bypass-capable methods by forcing segmentation supervision through noise-to-mask reconstruction converted all 30 corresponding comparisons from preserved performance to state reliance. For deterministic utility, matched image-only counterparts achieved similar or better performance in 28 of 35 settings overall, including 16 of 20 whose native methods relied on both audited state properties. These results identify supervision path as a determinant of state reliance in the audited methods. Separately, matched image-only counterparts show that diffusion-specific computation often provides no deterministic endpoint advantage, including in methods that rely on the audited state properties. More generally, when conditioning already supports strong target prediction, diffusion-specific claims require additional evidence that the added state is used and that diffusion-specific computation improves the claimed capability beyond a matched condition-only counterpart.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了扩散模型用于全监督分割时是否真正依赖扩散状态以及是否带来确定性优势。通过扰动状态内容、纠正图像-状态配对、重路由监督路径，并与仅图像条件基线对比，作者发现是否依赖扩散状态取决于监督路径，而扩散特定计算通常没有确定性终点优势。
AI.motivation: 在完全监督分割中，条件图像本身已能支持直接预测，因此仅凭终点性能无法证明模型依赖扩散引入的噪声状态，也无法证明其相对仅图像预测有确定性优势。
AI.method: 在三个数据集上重训练12种已发表方法，每种设置10个匹配随机种子；通过破坏目标衍生状态内容或纠正图像-状态配对来检验状态依赖；重路由5种原本可绕过的方法，强制分割监督经过噪声到掩码重建；并与匹配的仅图像条件对应方法比较性能。
AI.result: 所有40项评估掩码路径位于噪声量重建下游的方法比较均表现出状态依赖；所有30项存在分割监督旁路的方法比较保持参考性能。重路由5种原可旁路方法后，30项比较全部从性能保持转为状态依赖。匹配的仅图像对应方法在35种设置中的28种达到相似或更好性能，包括20种原生方法依赖所审计状态属性中的16种。
AI.conclusion: 监督路径是所审计方法中状态依赖的决定因素。匹配的仅图像对应方法表明，扩散特定计算往往不提供确定性终点优势，即使在依赖所审计状态属性的方法中也是如此。当条件已能支持强目标预测时，扩散特定主张需要额外证据：所添加状态确实被使用，且扩散特定计算比匹配的仅条件对应方法更能提升所声称能力。

title: A Topological Representation with Object-Path Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Instance Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation requires embodied agents to navigate environments using natural language instructions and visual observations. Existing approaches typically decompose navigation into sequential language-guided decisions or rely on online exploration without prior environmental knowledge. Scene graph representations offer compact semantic memory but remain decoupled from downstream navigation, which still depends on dense metric maps. To close this gap, we propose an object--path graph that unifies open-vocabulary semantic reasoning with topological navigation. The proposed representation jointly supports semantic grounding, graph-based localization, and navigation within a single lightweight topological framework. Building on this graph, we introduce a navigation strategy that combines global path planning with local inter-node execution through lightweight node localization and semantic visual servoing, enabling navigation directly over the graph without dense metric reconstruction. Experiments on HM3D and Replica demonstrate competitive performance in open-vocabulary object grounding through the proposed hierarchical graph structure, while achieving effective navigation performance. Real-world robot experiments further validate the practicality of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种 object-path graph，将开放词汇语义推理与拓扑导航统一起来，无需稠密度量地图即可实现视觉语言导航，并在 HM3D、Replica 及真实机器人上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言导航方法多依赖顺序语言决策或在线探索，场景图虽能提供紧凑语义记忆，但与下游导航解耦且仍依赖稠密度量地图，因此需要统一语义推理与拓扑导航的轻量框架。
AI.method: 构建 object-path graph，联合支持语义 grounding、基于图的定位和导航；基于该图提出全局路径规划与局部节点间执行相结合的导航策略，利用轻量节点定位和语义视觉伺服直接在图上导航，避免稠密度量重建。
AI.result: 在 HM3D 和 Replica 数据集上，所提分层图结构在开放词汇物体 grounding 上取得有竞争力的性能，并实现有效导航；真实机器人实验进一步验证了框架的实用性。
AI.conclusion: object-path graph 能够弥合语义推理与拓扑导航之间的差距，实现无需稠密度量地图的开放词汇导航，具有轻量化和实际部署潜力。

title: STAR: Scene- and Task-Aware 4D Radar Preprocessing Towards End-to-End Cognitive Radar
summary: Four-dimensional (4D) Radar has emerged as a key sensor for environmental perception, providing range, azimuth, elevation, and Doppler measurements while remaining robust to illumination changes and adverse weather conditions. However, conventional Radar preprocessing methods, such as constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detection, select measurements primarily based on signal-level criteria and may therefore discard information valuable for downstream perception during point cloud generation. In addition, existing 4D Radar perception pipelines typically optimize Radar data processing and downstream perception independently, preventing task objectives from directly guiding the preprocessing stage. To address these limitations, we propose a Scene- and Task-Aware Radar (STAR) Preprocessor together with an end-to-end training framework. The STAR Preprocessor incorporates scene context and downstream task objectives to generate task-relevant Radar points, enabling the Radar representation to be optimized directly for perception. On the K-Radar benchmark, the proposed method achieves 74.3 AP, outperforming the previous state of the art by 5.6 AP points. Furthermore, applying the task-relevant points generated by STAR to various existing 3D detectors improves detection performance in most evaluation settings and yields an overall positive average gain over point clouds produced by conventional preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种场景和任务感知的4D雷达预处理器STAR及端到端训练框架，通过结合场景上下文和下游任务目标生成任务相关的雷达点云，以提升感知性能。
AI.motivation: 传统雷达预处理方法（如CFAR）基于信号级标准选择测量，可能丢弃对下游感知有价值的信息，且现有4D雷达感知流程通常独立优化雷达数据处理和下游感知，无法让任务目标直接指导预处理阶段。
AI.method: 提出STAR预处理器，融入场景上下文和下游任务目标，生成任务相关的雷达点云，并采用端到端训练框架，使雷达表示直接针对感知任务进行优化。
AI.result: 在K-Radar基准上，该方法达到74.3 AP，比之前的最优方法高出5.6 AP。将STAR生成的任务相关点云应用于多种现有3D检测器，在大多数评估设置中提升了检测性能，并相对于传统预处理点云取得了整体正向平均增益。
AI.conclusion: STAR预处理器通过场景和任务感知生成任务相关的雷达点云，有效提升了4D雷达感知性能，并可广泛适用于现有3D检测器。

title: Some Dialects Are More Equal Than Others: Non-Prestigious Arabic Dialectal Bias in LLMs
summary: Previous work on Egyptian Arabic in NLP has focused largely on the prestigious Cairene Egyptian Arabic (CEA) dialect, resulting in a lack of representation for the less prestigious Sa'idi Egyptian Arabic (SEA) dialect both in LLM and resource development. Does this lack of representation influence an LLM's view of the acceptability of SEA (upstream), and does an upstream bias against SEA lead to worse performance (downstream)? We investigate the upstream effect of SEA dialectal features on LLM preferences in a Targeted Syntactic Evaluation (TSE) task which reveals a significant bias against SEA across multiple LLMs. We then analyze the effect of these same features on downstream model performance on MMLU benchmarks and show that models experience a degradation in performance when presented with SEA. This work highlights the need for further exploration on how sub-dialectal variation impacts language technologies.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了埃及阿拉伯语中少被关注的萨伊迪方言（SEA）在LLM中的代表性缺失是否导致模型偏见，并进一步影响下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 以往NLP研究主要关注声望较高的开罗埃及阿拉伯语（CEA），导致声望较低的萨伊迪埃及阿拉伯语（SEA）在LLM和资源开发中代表性不足。作者想知道这种缺失是否影响LLM对SEA可接受性的判断，以及上游偏见是否导致下游性能下降。
AI.method: 采用目标句法评估（TSE）任务考察SEA方言特征对多个LLM偏好的上游影响；随后分析这些相同特征对下游MMLU基准性能的影响。
AI.result: TSE任务显示多个LLM对SEA存在显著偏见；在MMLU基准中，当输入呈现SEA时，模型性能出现下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调需要进一步探索次方言变异如何影响语言技术，并呼吁关注SEA等低资源方言在LLM中的代表性与公平性。

title: Odometry-Aided Real-Time Mapping for Underwater Robots Using Forward-Looking Sonar
comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: Reliable perception is essential for underwater vehicles operating in complex environments, where light attenuation and scattering often degrade visibility and compromise optical sensing. Forward-looking sonar (FLS) offers an alternative by providing high-frame-rate acoustic imaging under poor optical conditions. However, real-time FLS mapping remains challenging due to unresolved target elevation, spatially non-uniform noise, and fragmented target boundaries, which hinder feature extraction and introduce geometric ambiguity during projection. To address these challenges, we propose a cascaded feature reconstruction pipeline combining fast Fourier transform (FFT)-based denoising, fast multiscale constant false alarm rate (MCFAR) detection, and gradient-adaptive boundary connection to extract geometric features from degraded sonar images with low latency. We integrate attitude-aware geometric projection with incremental occupancy accumulation to construct a depth-referenced 2.5D map for local mapping in confined underwater environments. The sonar's vertical position is referenced to an external sensor, while target elevation is assigned under an explicit geometric assumption rather than measured directly by FLS. Experiments in a 3 m X 5 m pool demonstrate centimeter-scale planar mapping accuracy, with a root-mean-square error (RMSE) below 3 cm across three sequences and an average processing time of 42.4 ms per frame.

AI.tldr: 针对水下前视声呐实时建图中目标高度未解析、噪声非均匀和边界破碎等问题，提出一种级联特征重建与2.5D建图流程，在泳池实验中实现厘米级平面建图精度和42.4 ms/帧的低延迟处理。
AI.motivation: 水下复杂环境中光衰减和散射导致光学感知退化，前视声呐虽能提供高频声学成像，但实时建图仍受目标高度未解析、空间非均匀噪声和破碎目标边界困扰，造成特征提取困难和投影几何歧义。
AI.method: 提出级联特征重建流程：基于FFT去噪、快速多尺度恒虚警率（MCFAR）检测和梯度自适应边界连接，从退化声呐图像中低延迟提取几何特征；结合姿态感知几何投影与增量占据累积，构建深度参考的2.5D地图用于受限水下环境局部建图；声呐垂直位置参考外部传感器，目标高度基于显式几何假设而非直接测量。
AI.result: 在3 m×5 m泳池实验中，三个序列的平面建图精度达到厘米级，均方根误差（RMSE）低于3 cm，平均每帧处理时间42.4 ms。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能在受限水下环境中实现低延迟、高精度的实时前视声呐2.5D建图。

title: WebMRIQC: A Web-Based Implementation of MRIQC for Accessible MRI Image Quality Assessment in Resource-Constrained Settings
summary: Reliable quality control (QC) of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for reliable diagnostic neuroimaging, yet standard manual assessment is subjective and time-consuming. MRIQC has established standardized automated extraction of image-quality metrics (IQMs), but its reliance on local computational imaging skills and capacity including high-performance computing, limits its adoption in resource-constrained settings (RCS). We present WebMRIQC (webmriqc.mailab.io), an open-source browser-based platform that wraps the validated MRIQC engine behind a zero-installation web interface. WebMRIQC automates the DICOM-to-BIDS conversion of de-identified MRI scans, executes the unmodified containerized MRIQC pipeline on a shared compute node governed by a fair-share job queue, and returns an interactive in-browser dashboard. The dashboard grounds every IQM in published quality thresholds, benchmarks each scan against the normative distribution of high-resource open datasets, and supports cross-site multicentre implementation of optimized scan protocols in RCS.We describe the system architecture and a validation framework establishing measurement equivalence between WebMRIQC and native MRIQC across thirteen IQMs on the BraTS-Africa and BraTS 2021 datasets. Preliminary results indicate strong agreement for contrast-, signal and noise-based metrics, demonstrating that web-based implementation lowers the barrier to standardized MRI QC and provides a foundation for harmonized, regionally adapted quality benchmarks across RCS imaging sites. The code is publicly available here https://github.com/CAMERA-MRI/WebMRIqc.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 WebMRIQC，一个基于浏览器的开源平台，将已验证的 MRIQC 引擎封装为零安装 Web 界面，用于在资源受限环境中实现标准化 MRI 质量控制。
AI.motivation: MRI 质控对神经影像诊断至关重要，但人工评估主观且耗时；MRIQC 虽能自动提取图像质量指标，却依赖本地计算影像技能和高性能计算资源，限制了其在资源受限场景中的采用。
AI.method: WebMRIQC 自动完成去标识 MRI 扫描的 DICOM 到 BIDS 转换，在共享计算节点上通过公平共享作业队列运行未修改的容器化 MRIQC 流程，并返回交互式浏览器仪表板；仪表板将每个指标对照已发表阈值和开放数据集规范分布进行基准比较，支持跨站点多中心协议优化。作者还在 BraTS-Africa 和 BraTS 2021 数据集上，对 13 个图像质量指标开展与原生 MRIQC 的测量等价性验证。
AI.result: 初步结果显示，在对比度、信号和噪声相关指标上，WebMRIQC 与原生 MRIQC 具有高度一致性，表明基于 Web 的实现可降低标准化 MRI 质控的门槛。
AI.conclusion: WebMRIQC 为资源受限成像站点提供了可行且标准化的 MRI 质控方案，并为跨区域协调、区域适配的质量基准奠定基础；代码已公开。

title: Audio-based UAV Localization with Adaptive Temporal Correspondence via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Audio-based localization provides a low-cost and illumination-independent sensing solution for anti-UAV early warning. However, existing methods typically rely on a predefined fixed audio segment length, which limits temporal correspondence and creates a trade-off between sufficient acoustic evidence and timely localization. To address this issue, we propose an audio-based localization framework with adaptive temporal correspondence. A probe segment is first used to extract a compact acoustic state that characterizes the reliability and consistency of the observation. Guided by the state, a reinforcement learning controller dynamically determines the required audio window size for each localization decision. The selected audio segment is then processed by a Mamba-based localization network with adaptive temporal feature modulation for 3D position estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive 3D localization accuracy with substantially reduced temporal correspondence latency compared to SOTA methods and exhibits strong generalization across scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于音频的自适应时间对应反无人机3D定位框架，利用探针段提取声学状态，并用强化学习控制器动态选择音频窗口，结合Mamba定位网络实现低延迟高精度定位。
AI.motivation: 现有音频定位方法多依赖预设固定音频段长度，导致时间对应受限，需在充足声学证据与及时定位之间权衡，难以兼顾精度与延迟。
AI.method: 先用探针段提取描述观测可靠性与一致性的紧凑声学状态；由强化学习控制器根据该状态动态确定每次定位所需的音频窗口大小；再由基于Mamba并带自适应时间特征调制的定位网络进行3D位置估计。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在3D定位精度上具有竞争力，同时显著降低时间对应延迟，并优于当前最优方法，且在不同场景中表现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 自适应时间对应可有效解决固定音频段长度的权衡问题，为低成本、光照无关的反无人机音频定位提供更及时且鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Evaluating the Generalization of Neuroimaging Foundation Models on African Brain MRI
comment: MICCAI AFRICAI Workshop, Strasbourg, France, 2026, 10 Pages, 1 Figure, 2 Tables
summary: Neuroimaging foundation models pretrained on large, predominantly western cohorts are increasingly proposed as general-purpose backbones for brain MRI analysis. Yet, their ability to generalize to underrepresented clinical populations remains largely untested. We evaluate four recent foundation models (BrainIAC, Neuro-JEPA, NeuroVFM, and Primus) on a three-way diagnostic classification task (Control, Dementia, Parkinson's disease) using a cohort of 88 subjects from a Nigerian clinical brain MRI dataset, across four modality configurations (T1w, T2w, T1w+T2w, FLAIR), and compare against an end-to-end trained ViT3D baseline. The frozen backbones collapse to majority-class predictions, while Neuro-JEPA on FLAIR shows modest but still limited discrimination. In contrast, the end-to-end trained ViT3D achieves higher accuracy and MCC on every task (up to 53.4% accuracy, MCC=0.27) and is the only model with non-trivial recall. Our findings suggest that these frozen neuroimaging foundation models are insufficient for fine-grained diagnostic classification in small, non-western clinical cohorts, motivating parameter-efficient adaptation and broader multi-site external validation for equitable deployment in global health settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了四个神经影像基础模型在尼日利亚临床脑MRI数据集上的泛化能力，发现冻结模型在诊断分类任务中表现不佳，而端到端训练的ViT3D基线优于它们。
AI.motivation: 神经影像基础模型多基于西方人群大规模数据预训练，但其在代表性不足的临床人群中的泛化能力尚不清楚，这促使作者在非西方小样本队列中测试这些模型。
AI.method: 使用88名来自尼日利亚临床脑MRI数据集的受试者，进行三分类诊断任务（对照、痴呆、帕金森病），评估四个基础模型（BrainIAC、Neuro-JEPA、NeuroVFM、Primus）在四种模态配置（T1w、T2w、T1w+T2w、FLAIR）下的表现，并与端到端训练的ViT3D基线进行比较。
AI.result: 冻结的基础模型退化为多数类预测，Neuro-JEPA在FLAIR上显示出微弱但有限的区分能力。端到端训练的ViT3D在所有任务上取得更高的准确率和MCC（最高53.4%准确率，MCC=0.27），且是唯一具有非平凡召回率的模型。
AI.conclusion: 这些冻结的神经影像基础模型不足以在小规模非西方临床队列中进行细粒度诊断分类，需要参数高效适配和更广泛的多中心外部验证，以实现全球卫生环境中的公平部署。

title: TAC-Time: Texts as Channels For Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
summary: Most existing time series forecasting methods rely solely on numerical observations, overlooking rich contextual information from auxiliary texts. Recent multimodal approaches attempt to incorporate textual signals, but they often treat text as static features or use large language models as forecasting backbones, limiting their ability to capture temporal dynamics and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose TAC-Time, a unified framework that transforms textual information into additional temporal channels. By modeling text features jointly with numerical sequences in a shared temporal backbone, TAC-Time preserves temporal continuity and periodic structures while remaining efficient and scalable. This formulation also enables systematic interpretability analyses. We show strong cross-modal dependencies through attention and frequency-domain analyses, and identify predictive textual signals whose correlation-aware alignment yields partial forecasting improvements. Extensive experiments on real-world multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that TAC-Time outperforms prior methods.

AI.tldr: 提出TAC-Time框架，将文本信息转化为额外的时间通道，与数值序列在共享时序骨干中联合建模，实现高效、可扩展的多模态时间序列预测，并在真实基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测仅依赖数值观测，忽略辅助文本的丰富上下文信息；现有多模态方法将文本视为静态特征或使用大语言模型作为预测骨干，限制了时序动态捕捉能力并增加计算成本。
AI.method: 提出TAC-Time统一框架，将文本特征转化为额外的时间通道，与数值序列在共享时序骨干中联合建模，保持时间连续性和周期结构，同时支持系统可解释性分析；通过注意力和频域分析展示跨模态依赖，识别预测性文本信号并进行相关性对齐。
AI.result: 在真实多模态基准上的大量实验表明，TAC-Time优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: TAC-Time有效利用文本信息提升时间序列预测性能，兼具高效性、可扩展性和可解释性。

title: Video-STLayout Pre-training
summary: In recent years, pre-training has become fundamental to learning effective video representations, enabling strong transfer to downstream tasks. A popular framework in pre-training involves aligning features of a video encoder with that of another modality, for example, language or audio. We introduce Video-STLayout pre-training, a novel strategy for obtaining rich video representations informed by spatio-temporal layout of object bounding boxes. Object layouts can easily be obtained by applying an off-the-shelf object detector on the video frames. Our method uses a contrastive loss to align video features with the layout features from a trained layout encoder. We show the effectiveness of our approach in the task of activity recognition in complex scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出 Video-STLayout 预训练方法，利用视频帧中物体边界框的时空布局信息，通过对比损失对齐视频特征与布局编码器特征，从而学习丰富的视频表示，并在复杂场景活动识别中验证有效。
AI.motivation: 视频预训练对下游任务迁移至关重要，现有方法常将视频特征与语言或音频等其他模态对齐。物体时空布局可由现成目标检测器方便获得，因此可作为额外监督信号来增强视频表示学习。
AI.method: 使用现成目标检测器在视频帧上获取物体边界框布局，训练布局编码器；采用对比损失，将视频编码器特征与布局编码器特征进行对齐，完成 Video-STLayout 预训练。
AI.result: 在复杂场景下的活动识别任务中，该方法展现出有效性，说明基于物体时空布局的预训练能够获得具有良好迁移能力的视频表示。
AI.conclusion: Video-STLayout 为视频预训练提供了一种新策略，表明物体时空布局信息可有效指导视频表示学习，并提升复杂场景活动识别等下游任务性能。

title: Memory vs. Context? Influential Factors of Factual Recall in Language Models
comment: Accepted to the BlackboxNLP 2026 Reproducibility Challenge (Special Track), EMNLP 2026
summary: We reproduce and stress-test the work of Yu et al. (2023), who characterize how language models (LMs) arbitrate between memorized knowledge and contradictory in-context statements. We replicate their world-capitals experiments on 31 models spanning Pythia, GPT-2, Qwen3, and Ministral families, including base and post-trained variants, and extend evaluations to five additional knowledge relation types from the ParaConflict dataset. We empirically confirm most of their original findings: larger models and higher-frequency entities tend to favor memorized answers, with substantial family-level variance. However, several conclusions do not generalize cleanly: entity-frequency effects disappear on Qwen3-14B and 32B; post-training shifts the memory-context trade-off inconsistently across families; question phrasing alone can change a model's reliance on memorized knowledge by up to 80 percentage points; and semantically unrelated prose can mimic coherent supporting context. Our results clarify where Yu et al.'s claims hold and to what extent they generalize to other prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文复现并压力测试 Yu 等人（2023）关于语言模型如何在记忆知识与矛盾上下文之间进行取舍的研究，并在更多模型和知识关系类型上检验其结论的泛化性。
AI.motivation: 原研究揭示了语言模型处理记忆与上下文冲突的机制，但其结论是否在不同模型家族、训练阶段、提示措辞和知识类型上稳健尚不明确，因此需要系统复现与扩展验证。
AI.method: 在 Pythia、GPT-2、Qwen3 和 Ministral 等 31 个模型（含基座与后训练变体）上复现世界首都实验，并扩展到 ParaConflict 数据集中的五种额外知识关系类型，同时进行提示措辞和无关文本等压力测试。
AI.result: 多数原始发现得到验证：更大模型和高频实体更倾向于记忆答案，且存在显著的模型家族差异。但若干结论不能干净泛化：Qwen3-14B 和 32B 上实体频率效应消失；后训练对记忆—上下文权衡的影响在不同家族间不一致；仅改变问题措辞就可使模型对记忆知识的依赖变化高达 80 个百分点；语义无关的散文也能模拟连贯的支持性上下文。
AI.conclusion: 研究明确了 Yu 等人结论的适用范围，并表明其向其他提示泛化的程度有限，提示措辞和上下文表面形式会显著影响语言模型的知识仲裁行为。

title: XYEval: Agents say yes to bad advice
summary: Effective communication between users and AI agents is essential for human-AI collaboration. The XY problem is a well-known communication pitfall where a person asks about their attempted solution rather than their actual problem. We extend prior sycophancy evaluation to the XY problem in agentic settings, evaluating whether agents can resist plausible but misleading suggestions from users and communicate their reasoning. We introduce XYEval, a meta-evaluation framework that can transform an existing benchmark into an XY problem evaluation. We evaluate five models across six diverse benchmark suites. Agents suffer large XY drops under XY mutation across benchmarks, with relative drops reaching up to 46.7%. With $τ^2$-bench, we further show that agent performance drops more when encountering a pedantic user who requires detailed explanations before approving a better solution. Our findings suggest that current agents lack the ability to effectively reason and communicate when facing misleading suggestions. A simple system instruction baseline that encourages awareness of XY problems only offers partial mitigation. Extensive trace analyses provide behavioral insights into how and why these XY drops occur across execution trajectories. Our results show that mitigating the XY problem remains challenging, requiring agents to both recognize user misdirection and clearly communicate the underlying problem.

AI.tldr: 论文研究AI代理在与用户沟通时面临的XY问题，即用户询问尝试的解决方案而非实际问题。作者提出XYEval框架，将现有基准转化为XY问题评估，发现代理在误导性建议下性能大幅下降，且难以有效推理和沟通。
AI.motivation: 用户与AI代理的有效沟通对人机协作至关重要，而XY问题是一种常见的沟通陷阱。先前关于谄媚的评估未涉及代理场景下的XY问题，因此需要探究代理能否抵抗看似合理但具有误导性的用户建议并清晰表达推理。
AI.method: 提出XYEval元评估框架，可将现有基准转化为XY问题评估。在六个多样化基准套件上评估五个模型，并使用τ²-bench测试遇到要求详细解释的迂腐用户时的表现。还进行了大量轨迹分析以提供行为洞察，并测试了简单的系统指令基线。
AI.result: 代理在XY变异下性能大幅下降，相对下降高达46.7%。在τ²-bench中，遇到迂腐用户时性能下降更严重。简单的系统指令基线仅能部分缓解问题。轨迹分析揭示了XY下降在执行轨迹中的发生方式和原因。
AI.conclusion: 当前代理在面对误导性建议时缺乏有效推理和沟通的能力。缓解XY问题仍然具有挑战性，需要代理既能识别用户的误导，又能清晰地沟通底层问题。

title: OpenFlyScan: A Quality-Guided Aerial Reconstruction System for Consumer Drones
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-fidelity scenes for large-scale embodied simulation, but constructing large-scale urban assets remains constrained by expensive equipment and delayed quality feedback. Preset surveys can leave complex surfaces insufficiently observed, with defects discovered only after reconstruction, requiring return visits and repeated processing. We present OpenFlyScan, a quality-guided aerial reconstruction system for consumer drones that integrates a GS quality model, a reacquisition planner, and a custom-designed mobile app. The model learns from GS rendering errors to predict regional reconstruction quality. Based on these predictions, the planner then generates complementary reacquisition strips to be executed through the app, which also supports automated oblique surveys and data transfer without additional hardware on board. Across real aerial scenes, the model effectively identifies regions that are likely to be poorly reconstructed. In the Expo West field experiment, targeted reacquisition improves PSNR at additional views by 10.95 dB. With consumer drones, OpenFlyScan integrates capture, targeted reacquisition, and reconstruction to support rapid, low-cost urban asset creation. Code and models will be made publicly available at https://openflyscan.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 OpenFlyScan，一个面向消费级无人机的质量引导航空重建系统，集成 GS 质量预测模型、补采规划器和定制移动应用，用于低成本、快速地构建城市级 3DGS 资产。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 可支持大规模具身仿真，但现有城市资产构建依赖昂贵设备且质量反馈滞后；预设航线可能遗漏复杂表面，缺陷往往在重建后才发现，导致返工和重复处理。
AI.method: 系统包含从 GS 渲染误差中学习区域重建质量的质量模型、基于预测生成互补补采航带的规划器，以及支持自动化倾斜摄影与数据传输的移动应用；无需额外机载硬件。
AI.result: 在真实航空场景中，模型能有效识别可能重建较差的区域；在 Expo West 现场实验中，针对性补采使新增视角的 PSNR 提升 10.95 dB。
AI.conclusion: OpenFlyScan 利用消费级无人机整合采集、针对性补采与重建，支持快速、低成本的城市资产创建，代码与模型将公开。

title: ME-Brain-1.0: Memory, Cognition and Action for Evolving Embodied Intelligence
summary: Current embodied systems largely rely on pretrained capabilities that remain fixed after deployment, limiting their ability to learn from physical interaction. We introduce MachEmbodied-Brain (ME-Brain), a self-evolving embodied system organized around a closed loop of action execution, experience acquisition, experience evolution, and improved execution. Evolvable Memory consolidates multimodal trajectories into hierarchical, reusable experience; Cognitive Core transforms physical experience into transferable skills; and the Action Model combines event-driven keyframes, EventCell local-world prediction, and action-conditioned memory modulation to focus computation on decision-critical moments, regions, and historical evidence. Together, these modules shift embodied intelligence from train-and-freeze to deploy-and-evolve without model retraining. Cognitive Core outperforms the strongest comparison models by 8.2 and 9.6 points on embodied and agent benchmarks. The Action Model achieves 47.88% mean success on RoboMME, a 3.26-point improvement over the strongest baseline. On RoboDojo, it reaches a 21.51 mean Score and 16.03% success rate, exceeding $π_{0.5}$ by 10.10 and 9.12 points. On the six-task ME-RealBench, ME-Brain achieves a 69.5 mean Score and 66.7% success rate, outperforming DM0.5 by 12.8 and 11.7 points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出自进化具身系统 ME-Brain，通过行动执行、经验获取、经验演化和改进执行的闭环，使具身智能无需重新训练即可在部署后持续进化。
AI.motivation: 当前具身系统多依赖部署后固定的预训练能力，难以从物理交互中持续学习，限制了适应与提升。
AI.method: ME-Brain 包含三个核心模块：Evolvable Memory 将多模态轨迹整合为分层可复用经验；Cognitive Core 将物理经验转化为可迁移技能；Action Model 结合事件驱动关键帧、EventCell 局部世界预测和动作条件记忆调制，将计算聚焦于关键决策时刻、区域和历史证据。
AI.result: Cognitive Core 在具身与智能体基准上分别比最强对比模型高 8.2 和 9.6 分；Action Model 在 RoboMME 上达到 47.88% 平均成功率，比最强基线高 3.26 分；在 RoboDojo 上达到 21.51 平均分和 16.03% 成功率，分别超过 π0.5 10.10 和 9.12 分；在六任务 ME-RealBench 上达到 69.5 平均分和 66.7% 成功率，分别超过 DM0.5 12.8 和 11.7 分。
AI.conclusion: ME-Brain 将具身智能从“训练后冻结”转向“部署后进化”，无需模型重训练即可通过闭环经验演化提升执行能力，并在多个基准上取得领先表现。

title: Taramandal-GPT: Enhancing Astrodynamics Problem-Solving with Knowledge Retrieval and Structured Thinking
comment: Proceedings of All India Hindi Technical Conference, 05-06 February 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable progress in natural language understanding, yet their effectiveness in specialized fields like astronomy and astrodynamics remains limited due to challenges in multi-step reasoning, symbolic manipulation, and domain-specific terminology. To address this, we present Taramandal-GPT (Constellation-GPT), a domain-adapted framework built on the Qwen3-8b backbone, enhanced with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline and a fallback mechanism for improved contextual precision. We evaluate it on the Astrodynamics Problems Benchmark (APBench), a dataset of 299 questions covering foundational to advanced levels of space science. Using a dual evaluation method - numeric margin-based scoring and semantic similarity assessment - Taramandal-GPT achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art open- and closed-source models, with notable strength in thinking-intensive tasks. These results highlight the value of specialized LLMs for domains demanding accuracy and interpretability, positioning Taramandal-GPT as a step toward reliable Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistants for astrophysics, spacecraft engineering, and space exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出面向天体动力学与空间科学的领域适配框架 Taramandal-GPT，基于 Qwen3-8b，结合 RAG 与回退机制，并在 APBench 上评估，表现具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型在天文学、天体动力学等专业领域受限于多步推理、符号操作和术语理解，现有能力不足，需要专门的领域适配方案。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-8b 为骨干，加入检索增强生成（RAG）流水线和回退机制以提升上下文精度；构建 APBench 基准（299 道题，覆盖基础到高级空间科学）；采用数值边际评分和语义相似度双重评估。
AI.result: Taramandal-GPT 在 APBench 上相比先进的开源和闭源模型取得有竞争力的表现，尤其在思考密集型任务上优势明显。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明专业领域大语言模型对需要准确性和可解释性的任务具有价值，Taramandal-GPT 是迈向可靠的天体物理、航天器工程和太空探索 AI 助手的一步。

title: From Tables to Quantified Statements: Evaluating LLM Inference Generation through Executable Verification
summary: LLMs can generate fluent descriptions from tables, but their outputs may remain logically unsupported by the structured data. We introduce STAT-TO-TEXT, a controlled task in which LLMs generate quantified natural language inferences from statistical tables using quantified constructions such as all, some, no, and most. To evaluate these inferences, we use an LLM generated Python checker code which when executed verifies the corresponding truth conditions against the table. We compare four open-weight LLMs across model families and scales, evaluating faithfulness, logical accuracy, table coverage, and diversity. Our results show that model scale and family matter, with the largest model (GPT-OSS-120B) consistently producing the most faithful inferences without sacrificing greater table coverage and quantifier diversity, as opposed to smaller models. These findings are supported by human annotation, which shows that the automated checker closely aligns with human judgments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 STAT-TO-TEXT 任务，让大语言模型从统计表中生成带有量词（all、some、no、most 等）的自然语言推断，并用 LLM 生成的 Python 检查器验证其真实性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽能生成流畅的表格描述，但这些描述可能在逻辑上并不被结构化数据支持，因此需要评估其推断是否忠实、逻辑是否准确。
AI.method: 构建 STAT-TO-TEXT 受控任务，要求模型生成量化自然语言推断；使用 LLM 生成的 Python 检查代码，执行后对照表格验证真值条件；比较四个开放权重模型在不同模型家族和规模下的忠实性、逻辑准确性、表格覆盖率和多样性，并进行人工标注验证自动检查器。
AI.result: 模型规模和家族会影响表现；最大模型 GPT-OSS-120B 始终生成最忠实的推断，同时未牺牲表格覆盖率和量词多样性，而较小模型表现较差。人工标注表明自动检查器与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: STAT-TO-TEXT 可用于评估 LLM 从统计表生成量化推断的忠实性与逻辑性；模型规模对可靠推断很重要，且自动检查器可作为与人类判断一致的有效评估工具。

title: U-PEN Mamba: Progressive Expansion with Selective State-Space Modeling for Efficient Retinal Vessel Segmentation
summary: Accurate retinal vessel segmentation is important for computer-aided ophthalmic analysis, yet thin vessels, low contrast, and severe foreground-background imbalance remain challenging for encoder-decoder networks. This paper presents U-PEN Mamba, a U-shaped retinal vessel segmentation architecture that couples progressive nonlinear feature expansion with selective state-space modeling. The proposed network enriches local vessel responses with progressive expansion, models long-range spatial dependencies through a Mamba Global Context (MGC) block with linear sequence complexity, and uses attention-based decoder fusion to recover fine vascular boundaries. We evaluate U-PEN Mamba on CHASE DB1 and DRIVE using a consistent patch-based preprocessing pipeline and compare it with convolutional, attention-based, transformer-based, and Mamba-based segmentation baselines. U-PEN Mamba obtains the best mean intersection over union among the compared methods, achieving 0.8394 on CHASE DB1 and 0.8221 on DRIVE, with Dice scores of 0.8187 and 0.8078, respectively, using 21.6M trainable parameters. Ablation studies show that the MGC block contributes the largest gain over the U-Net baseline, while projection dimension and state size provide practical accuracy-efficiency control. These results indicate that selective state-space modeling is a promising global-context mechanism for parameter-efficient retinal vessel segmentation. Code is available at: https://github.com/areyesan/UPEN_Mamba.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 U-PEN Mamba，一种结合渐进非线性特征扩展与选择性状态空间建模的 U 形视网膜血管分割网络，在 CHASE DB1 和 DRIVE 上取得优于多种基线的最佳 mIoU。
AI.motivation: 视网膜血管分割对计算机辅助眼科分析很重要，但细小血管、低对比度和严重的前景-背景不平衡仍使编码器-解码器网络面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出 U-PEN Mamba：用渐进扩展增强局部血管响应，通过具有线性序列复杂度的 Mamba 全局上下文（MGC）模块建模长程空间依赖，并采用基于注意力的解码器融合恢复精细血管边界。使用统一的基于 patch 的预处理流程，与卷积、注意力、Transformer 和 Mamba 基线比较，并进行消融实验。
AI.result: U-PEN Mamba 在比较方法中取得最佳平均 IoU：CHASE DB1 为 0.8394，DRIVE 为 0.8221；Dice 分别为 0.8187 和 0.8078，参数量为 21.6M。消融实验表明 MGC 模块相对 U-Net 基线增益最大，投影维度和状态大小可控制精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，选择性状态空间建模是一种有前景的全局上下文机制，可用于参数高效的视网膜血管分割。代码已开源：https://github.com/areyesan/UPEN_Mamba。

title: Mitigating Entity Type Confusion in Cross-Domain NER via Multidimensional Quantification and Reasoning Enhancement
summary: Cross-domain Named Entity Recognition (CD-NER) aims to transfer the rich knowledge in the source domain to the target domain. Recent studies adopting decomposition or generation paradigms have achieved significant performance improvements, demonstrating high accuracy in entity span detection. However, during entity type classification, models severely suffer from entity type confusion, the erroneous tendency that models classify entities of one type in the text as another similar but incorrect type. To address this issue, we first propose a Multidimensional Confusion Quantification Model (MCQM) that quantifies a model's confusion extent between entity types from three dimensions: source-target hierarchy analysis, semantic similarity analysis, and explicit data evaluation. Moreover, we propose the Progressive Bidirectional Reasoning Chain (PBRC). PBRC leverages the source-target hierarchy and confusion analysis from the MCQM to prompt the LLM to generate two-stage reasoning information. The two-stage reasoning information is utilized to augment the knowledge of the model, significantly mitigating entity type confusion and improving the model's generalization performance. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves new state-of-the-art results on all domains of the CrossNER dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文针对跨域命名实体识别中的实体类型混淆问题，提出多维混淆量化模型MCQM和渐进式双向推理链PBRC，在CrossNER数据集所有域上取得新的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 跨域命名实体识别旨在将源域知识迁移到目标域。现有分解或生成方法在实体跨度检测上表现较好，但在实体类型分类时严重存在实体类型混淆，即把某一类型实体误判为相似但错误的另一类型。
AI.method: 提出MCQM，从源-目标层级分析、语义相似性分析和显式数据评估三个维度量化模型在不同实体类型间的混淆程度；提出PBRC，利用MCQM得到的源-目标层级和混淆分析来提示LLM生成两阶段推理信息，并用该信息增强模型知识。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法显著缓解了实体类型混淆，提升了模型泛化性能，并在CrossNER数据集的所有域上达到新的最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: MCQM与PBRC能有效应对跨域命名实体识别中的实体类型混淆问题，验证了混淆量化与LLM两阶段推理增强相结合的有效性。

title: When Evidence Conflicts: Reliability-aware Meta-review Generation
summary: Generating coherent meta-reviews from multiple peer reviews is challenging when reviewer evidence conflicts and varies in reliability. Existing approaches typically formulate meta-review generation as a multi-document summarization task and aggregate reviewer feedback uniformly, making it difficult to determine which opinions should be prioritized under disagreement. In this paper, we study meta-review generation through reliability-aware evidence aggregation. Our framework first extracts aspect-level opinions from peer reviews and identifies conflicting evidence within each aspect. It then estimates opinion-level support and review-level quality to measure evidence reliability. Based on these signals, the framework assigns reliability-aware weights to reviewer feedback, enabling the generator to prioritize better-supported arguments while preserving diverse perspectives. Experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves meta-review generation over strong baselines on both automatic and human evaluations, with clear gains in conflict recognition and resolution under high-conflict review scenarios. The code and implementation details are publicly available at https://github.com/Wangxz729/reliability-aware-meta-review.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究元评论生成中的可靠性感知证据聚合，通过识别冲突、估计观点支持度与评论质量，为不同评审意见分配可靠性权重，从而生成更连贯的元评论。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将元评论生成视为多文档摘要并均匀聚合评审意见，当评审证据存在冲突且可靠性不一时，难以判断应优先采纳哪些观点。
AI.method: 提出一个可靠性感知的证据聚合框架：先抽取评审中的方面级观点并识别各方面内的冲突证据；再估计观点级支持度和评论级质量以衡量证据可靠性；最后基于这些信号为评审反馈分配权重，使生成器优先考虑支持度更高的论点，同时保留多样观点。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在自动评估和人工评估中均持续优于强基线，尤其在高冲突评审场景下，冲突识别与解决方面有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过可靠性感知的证据聚合，可以有效改进元评论生成质量，并更好地处理评审意见冲突；代码与实现细节已公开。

title: All-in-One Multilingual Scene Text Recognition with Script-aware Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Multilingual scene text recognition (STR) remains challenging due to the scarcity of training data for most languages and the difficulty of serving diverse scripts within a single model. Existing solutions either deploy one recognizer per language, inflating cost and introducing error accumulation, or rely on massive vision-language models (VLMs) that are expensive and still inaccurate on many scripts. In this work, we pursue an all-in-one multilingual recognizer that is simpler than per-language experts, lighter than VLMs, and more accurate than both. First, we construct TextMuSS-10M, a large-scale synthetic scene text dataset spanning 10 scripts and 229 languages. It provides balanced and sufficient supervision where real data is unavailable. Second, we propose ScriptMoE, a script-aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture. It shares a single visual encoder and replaces the dense decoder with a sparse MoE block, which consists of an image-level router dispatches each image to the top-2 script-aligned experts and a shared expert absorbs cross-script knowledge. Extensive experiments on our assembled TextMuSS-Bench (10 scripts, 10,899 images) show that ScriptMoE achieves the highest accuracy of 82.06%, outperforming the strongest STR baseline by 1.31%. On the CC-OCR end-to-end multilingual task, replacing only the recognizer in PP-OCRv5 with ScriptMoE lifts F1 score from 65.71% to 80.89%, slightly surpassing the best VLM (80.73%) at a fraction of the parameter count.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向多语言场景文本识别的统一模型 ScriptMoE，并构建大规模合成数据集 TextMuSS-10M，在多个多语言基准上取得领先精度，且参数量远小于 VLM。
AI.motivation: 多语言场景文本识别面临多数语言训练数据稀缺、单一模型难以服务多种文字体系的问题。现有按语言部署多个识别器成本高且易误差累积，而大型视觉语言模型昂贵且在部分文字上仍不准确。
AI.method: 构建覆盖 10 种文字体系、229 种语言的大规模合成场景文本数据集 TextMuSS-10M；提出 ScriptMoE，采用脚本感知的稀疏混合专家架构：共享单一视觉编码器，用稀疏 MoE 块替换密集解码器，其中图像级路由器将每张图分配给 top-2 脚本对齐专家，并设置共享专家吸收跨脚本知识。
AI.result: 在自建 TextMuSS-Bench（10 种文字、10,899 张图像）上达到 82.06% 最高准确率，超过最强 STR 基线 1.31%。在 CC-OCR 端到端多语言任务中，仅将 PP-OCRv5 的识别器替换为 ScriptMoE，F1 从 65.71% 提升至 80.89%，略超最佳 VLM 的 80.73%，且参数量远更少。
AI.conclusion: ScriptMoE 是一种比按语言专家更简单、比 VLM 更轻量且更准确的多语言统一识别器，验证了合成数据与脚本感知 MoE 在多语言 STR 中的有效性。

title: Performance-Preserving Online Adaptation in Social Navigation via Diffusion Steering
summary: In social navigation, modeling the complex interactions between humans and robots is difficult, and deep reinforcement learning has therefore been actively studied. However, because simulation alone cannot fully reproduce diverse scenarios, robot dynamics, and the social conventions that vary across deployment environments, fine-tuning in the deployment environment is promising. In doing so, learning that preserves the base model's performance is required, so as not to compromise the primary objective of navigation, namely avoiding pedestrians and reaching the destination. In this study, we propose a method that applies diffusion steering via reinforcement learning (DSRL), which trains only the noise policy while keeping the diffusion policy fixed, thereby achieving learning that preserves performance. Furthermore, we integrate diffusion-based RL policies trained with multiple seeds to construct the base policy, improving learning performance. Our evaluation shows that, compared with other methods, the proposed method enables efficient learning while preserving performance, and we confirm flexible behavior control through adaptation to social conventions, as well as its effectiveness on a physical robot through hardware-in-the-loop simulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DSRL方法，通过强化学习仅训练噪声策略并固定扩散策略，实现社交导航中的高效微调且保持基础性能。
AI.motivation: 社交导航中深度强化学习依赖仿真，但仿真无法完全复现多样场景、机器人动力学和部署环境中的社交规范，因此需要在部署环境中微调，同时避免损害导航的主要目标（避让行人和到达目的地）。
AI.method: 提出扩散引导强化学习（DSRL），固定扩散策略仅训练噪声策略；并集成多个种子训练的扩散RL策略构建基础策略。
AI.result: 与其他方法相比，所提方法在保持性能的同时实现高效学习，并验证了适应社交规范的灵活行为控制，以及通过硬件在环仿真在实体机器人上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DSRL能够在社交导航部署环境中有效微调，保持基础模型性能并适应社交规范，具有实际机器人应用潜力。

title: Open-Jev Judgments on CallScreenBench: Calibrated One-Pass Scam Screening with a Small Language Model
summary: Screening a phone call for fraud needs a trustworthy probability after every caller turn, in milliseconds. Jev-style typed decisions promise exactly that: declared options go in, one calibrated probability per option comes out of a single forward pass, with no generated text. We test an open implementation of this readout, JevLite, on scam-call screening: Qwen3-4B is LoRA-tuned so that the temperature-scaled softmax over two answer-label logits is P(scam). On 41 held-out CallScreenBench scenarios (577 per-turn decisions) a three-seed ensemble reaches AUROC .974 with calibration error .052, non-inferior to an LLM judge (MiniMax-M3) at a pre-registered .02 margin, with no false alarms on legitimate calls, decisions 1.14 turns earlier under the same hang-up rule, and 64.5 ms per decision on one consumer GPU, 4.9x lower than the same backbone fine-tuned to generate its answer. The gain is in the readout and calibration, not accuracy: a fine-tuned ModernBERT encoder is not significantly worse, the recipe was selected with test-set exposure, and all callers are synthetic. We claim no architectural novelty; the contribution is the application and an evaluation reporting calibration, false alarms and decision timing alongside AUROC.

AI.tldr: 该论文在诈骗电话筛查任务上测试了JevLite读出头：对Qwen3-4B进行LoRA微调，用两个答案标签logit的温度缩放softmax输出P(scam)，在CallScreenBench上实现高AUROC、低校准误差、零误报和低延迟，并强调贡献在于应用与评估而非架构创新。
AI.motivation: 诈骗电话筛查需要在每个来电者轮次后以毫秒级给出可信的诈骗概率。Jev风格的类型化决策承诺可在一趟前向传播中为每个声明选项输出一个校准概率，且无需生成文本，因此作者希望检验这种读出方式在真实筛查场景中的效果。
AI.method: 使用开源JevLite实现，对Qwen3-4B进行LoRA微调，并将两个答案标签logit上的温度缩放softmax作为P(scam)。在41个留出的CallScreenBench场景共577个逐轮决策上评估三种子集成，并与LLM评委MiniMax-M3、微调ModernBERT编码器比较；报告AUROC、校准误差、误报、决策时机和延迟，且采用预注册的0.02非劣效性边界。
AI.result: 三种子集成达到AUROC 0.974、校准误差0.052，在预注册0.02边界下不劣于MiniMax-M3；对合法通话无误报；在相同挂断规则下提前1.14轮做出决策；单张消费级GPU上每次决策64.5毫秒，比同一骨干微调为生成式回答低4.9倍。性能提升主要来自读出与校准而非准确率；微调ModernBERT编码器没有显著更差；配方选择存在测试集暴露，且所有来电者均为合成数据。
AI.conclusion: 论文不声称架构新颖性；其主要贡献是将JevLite应用于诈骗电话筛查，并提供一种同时报告校准、误报和决策时机以及AUROC的评估方式。

title: Dissecting Agentic Forensics: The Role of Triage, Prompting, and Evidence Arbitration in Open-World Fake Image Detection
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics and Disinformation Detection (AI4MFDD), ECCV 2026. 34 pages (17 main paper incl. references, 17 appendix), 7 figures, 5 tables
summary: Image forensics is increasingly an open-world problem: manipulations range from fully synthetic images to localized edits, splicing and swapping, while most forensic detectors remain specialized to a single manipulation family. Agentic AI has recently emerged as a promising solution. In principle, such systems can assess the reliability of individual detectors, identify out-of-scope evidence, and arbitrate conflicting reports. However, it remains unclear which components actually drive performance and whether their benefits persist under distribution shift. To answer these questions, we study a training-free agentic framework built around specialist detectors, per-detector triage, and conflict-aware evidence arbitration. Using six configurations and three multimodal large language model backbones, we dissect the role of triage, prompting, and reasoning quality on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data. Our results show that naive detector fusion suffers from severe false-positive rates on authentic images. Triage and prompting consistently improve performance by filtering unreliable evidence and exposing detector limitations. However, the dominant factor is represented by reasoning itself: A stronger judge substantially outperforms a weaker one, particularly under distribution shift. Most notably, manipulation recall is nearly saturated across all configurations, indicating that the main challenge of open-world image forensics is not detecting manipulations, but calibrating trust in specialized forensic tools and arbitrating conflicting evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究开放世界图像取证中的智能体框架，分析专用检测器、分诊、提示和推理对性能的影响，并考察其在分布内与分布偏移下的表现。
AI.motivation: 图像篡改类型多样（全合成、局部编辑、拼接、替换等），而多数取证检测器仅针对单一篡改类型。智能体AI有望协调多个检测器，但尚不清楚哪些组件真正影响性能，以及其优势能否在分布偏移下保持。
AI.method: 构建无需训练的智能体框架，包含专用检测器、逐检测器分诊和冲突感知证据仲裁；使用六种配置和三种多模态大语言模型骨干，在分布内和分布外数据上分析分诊、提示和推理质量的作用。
AI.result: 朴素检测器融合在真实图像上假阳性率严重；分诊和提示通过过滤不可靠证据、暴露检测器局限而持续提升性能；推理本身是主导因素，更强判断模型显著优于较弱模型，尤其在分布偏移下；所有配置中篡改召回率几乎饱和。
AI.conclusion: 开放世界图像取证的主要挑战并非检测篡改，而是校准对专用取证工具的信任，并在冲突证据之间进行仲裁。

title: Efficient Reasoning Exploration via State-Conditioned Latent Steering with Progress Guidance
summary: Best-of-$N$ is a widely used inference strategy for complex reasoning, whose effectiveness depends on whether sampled candidates can cover diverse and high-quality reasoning paths. However, post-trained reasoning models often suffer from \emph{exploration collapse}, where independent rollouts repeatedly follow similar reasoning paths and limit the gains from increasing the rollout budget. Existing methods alleviate this issue by promoting broader exploration, but do not explicitly guide exploration toward continuations that make meaningful progress, resulting in limited exploration efficiency. To address this, we propose \emph{\underline{S}tate-conditioned \underline{P}rogress-guided \underline{S}teering} (SPS), a training-free latent steering framework. Specifically, SPS constructs a state-conditioned Direction Bank containing multiple progress-guided steering vectors for different prefix-state regions. During online inference, SPS retrieves a suitable steering vector based on the current prefix state and applies it at high-uncertainty transitions to guide the next reasoning step toward meaningful progress. Extensive experiments across multiple model scales and benchmarks demonstrate that SPS consistently outperforms strong baselines. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of its key designs and offer valuable insights for future research. The code is available at https://github.com/rattlesnakey/SPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPS（状态条件化进展引导的潜空间干预）框架，一种无需训练的方法，通过在推理时对高不确定性步骤施加与当前前缀状态匹配的进展引导向量，提升Best-of-N采样中推理路径的多样性与质量，缓解探索坍塌问题。
AI.motivation: Best-of-N推理策略依赖候选路径的多样性与高质量，但后训练推理模型常出现探索坍塌：独立采样反复走相似路径，增加采样预算收益有限。现有方法虽促进更广探索，却未显式引导探索走向有意义的进展，导致探索效率不高。
AI.method: 提出SPS，一种无需训练的潜空间引导框架。首先构建状态条件化的方向库（Direction Bank），为不同前缀状态区域存储多个进展引导的干预向量；在线推理时，根据当前前缀状态检索合适的干预向量，并在高不确定性转移处施加，引导下一步推理朝有意义进展方向进行。
AI.result: 在多个模型规模和基准上，SPS持续优于强基线。进一步分析验证了其关键设计的有效性，并为未来研究提供了有价值的见解。
AI.conclusion: SPS通过状态条件化、进展引导的潜空间干预，有效提升Best-of-N推理的探索效率与最终性能，是一种无需训练且通用的改进方案。

title: Estimating Accurate Hand Pose in Camera Space with Vision Transformer
summary: Monocular RGB-based hand pose estimation has emerged as a critical research frontier in computer vision. The local hand pose estimation methods predict hand poses relative to the wrist, while global hand pose estimation also requires estimating the wrist's position in the camera coordinate system. However, this camera-space estimation confronts two fundamental challenges: (1) depth ambiguity in monocular settings, and (2) the coupling effect of hand local poses and global wrist positions in the perspective projections. In particular, this coupling reflects that the projections are jointly determined by local hand poses, wrist positions, and camera intrinsics. To overcome these challenges, our framework proposes two key innovations: Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision for hand-depth information extraction and Perspective Information Embedding for resolving above coupling effect of local pose and wrist position, both integrated within the mainstream encoder-decoder architecture. Besides, we propose a novel framerate-aware multi-dataset training strategy for sequential pose refinement. Our fully integrated approach achieves at most 37.1\% superiority in CS-MJE over SOTA on HO3D. Project page: https://github.com/Mine268/CS-ViT.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向单目RGB手部姿态估计，提出融合Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision、Perspective Information Embedding和帧率感知多数据集训练的框架，以提升相机空间中的全局手部姿态估计精度。
AI.motivation: 单目相机空间全局手部姿态估计面临两个根本挑战：一是单目设置下的深度歧义，二是透视投影中手部局部姿态与全局手腕位置的耦合效应，即投影由局部手姿、手腕位置和相机内参共同决定。
AI.method: 在主流编码器-解码器架构中集成两项创新：Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision用于提取手部深度信息，Perspective Information Embedding用于解决局部姿态与手腕位置的耦合效应；此外提出帧率感知的多数据集训练策略，用于序列姿态细化。
AI.result: 在HO3D数据集上，该完整方法在CS-MJE指标上相比SOTA最高取得37.1%的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够有效缓解单目深度歧义和透视投影耦合问题，提升全局手部姿态估计性能，并通过帧率感知多数据集训练支持时序姿态优化。

title: Monitorable Chart Reasoning Agents via Verifiable Process Rewards
summary: Chart reasoning agents are increasingly used to extract actionable insights in critical domains, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks. Yet, high benchmark accuracy alone is insufficient for deployment, where stakeholders must be able to audit and verify how a model reaches its answer. Existing LVLM-based chart agents produce either answer-only predictions or free-form rationales that are hard to verify, obscuring whether an error arose from misreading the chart, extracting a wrong value, or miscomputing. We propose Chart-RVR, a reinforcement learning framework for training monitorable chart agents with verifiable process rewards. Chart-RVR decomposes chart reasoning into three auditable blocks: Structure, identifying the chart type; Evidence, reconstructing the underlying data table in JSON; and Derivation, exposing the stepwise trace that computes the answer. Across six in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, Chart-RVR attains state-of-the-art accuracy among comparable-sized LVLMs. Beyond accuracy, we assess monitorability using a triangulated protocol that combines ground-truth surrogate metrics, an oracle information-gain measure, and an LLM-as-auditor scoring Process Verifiability and Evidence Localization, showing that Chart-RVR yields rationales that are markedly more verifiable and evidence-grounded than those from CoT prompting, SFT, and existing chart-specific baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Chart-RVR，一个基于强化学习的框架，用于训练可监控、可验证的图表推理智能体。它将图表推理分解为结构、证据、推导三个可审计模块，在多个基准上取得同等规模LVLM中的最优准确率，并显著提升推理过程的可验证性与证据支撑度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LVLM的图表智能体通常只输出答案或难以验证的自由形式推理，导致无法审计模型如何得到答案，也难以判断错误来自读图、取值还是计算。仅靠高基准准确率不足以支撑关键领域中的实际部署。
AI.method: Chart-RVR将图表推理分解为三个可审计模块：Structure（识别图表类型）、Evidence（用JSON重建底层数据表）、Derivation（输出逐步计算答案的推理轨迹）。并采用带可验证过程奖励的强化学习进行训练。评估上使用三角验证协议，结合真实标注替代指标、oracle信息增益度量，以及LLM-as-auditor对过程可验证性与证据定位进行评分。
AI.result: 在六个域内和域外基准上，Chart-RVR在同等规模LVLM中达到最先进准确率。其生成的推理依据在可验证性和证据支撑方面明显优于CoT提示、SFT以及现有图表专用基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过可验证过程奖励与结构化推理分解，Chart-RVR能在保持高准确率的同时提升图表智能体的可监控性，使推理过程更可审计、更可核查，为关键领域部署提供了更可靠的方案。

title: LIBERO-VPro: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Visual Robustness of Robotic Foundation Models
summary: Robotic foundation models achieve impressive performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, yet these evaluations typically assume clean, timely, and consistent visual observations throughout execution. We introduce LIBERO-VPro, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the closed-loop visual robustness of robotic foundation models by perturbing the visual evidence available during execution. LIBERO-VPro covers four complementary dimensions, including Visual Evidence Degradation, Camera Staleness, Visual Source Consistency, and Task-Relevant Scene Variation, spanning 12 challenge categories, 96 experimental settings, and 3,296 task-condition cases. We evaluate three vision-language-action models and three world-action models over approximately 196,000 simulated episodes, complemented by 200 real-world rollouts on a Franka Research 3. Our results reveal that strong nominal performance can mask substantial weaknesses in visual grounding and adaptation. Models often remain successful despite severe object-level occlusion, yet degrade sharply when local interaction cues are disrupted or familiar spatial priors are violated. They are also highly sensitive to stale or missing observations and struggle when changed task preconditions require behavioral adaptation. Finally, VLAs and WAMs exhibit distinct robustness profiles, showing that visual robustness is multi-dimensional and architecture-dependent. LIBERO-VPro provides a systematic diagnostic framework for developing robotic foundation models that can more reliably ground and adapt their actions under challenging visual conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出LIBERO-VPro基准，系统评估机器人基础模型在闭环执行中的视觉鲁棒性，覆盖四个维度并揭示模型在视觉扰动下的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常假设视觉观测干净、及时且一致，无法反映真实执行中的视觉扰动，因此需要系统评估闭环视觉鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建LIBERO-VPro，沿视觉证据退化、相机陈旧、视觉源一致性、任务相关场景变化四个维度扰动视觉输入；包含12类挑战、96种设置、3296个任务条件案例；评估3种VLA和3种WAM模型，约19.6万次仿真回合及200次Franka Research 3真机测试。
AI.result: 名义性能强会掩盖视觉基础与适应弱点：严重物体遮挡下仍常成功，但局部交互线索破坏或空间先验违背时性能骤降；对陈旧或缺失观测高度敏感；任务前提变化时适应困难；VLA与WAM鲁棒性模式不同，视觉鲁棒性多维度且依赖架构。
AI.conclusion: LIBERO-VPro提供系统诊断框架，助力开发在挑战性视觉条件下更可靠地进行视觉基础与动作适应的机器人基础模型。

title: Tactile-JEPA: Topology-Aware Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Distributed Tactile Sensors
summary: Tactile sensing is an essential modality for robots performing contact-rich, dexterous manipulation, particularly under visual occlusion. While pre-trained image encoders are standard in robot learning pipelines, tactile encoders are still commonly trained from scratch from raw, noisy signals, which might limit their expressivity. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) approaches focus predominantly on vision-based tactile sensors, leaving distributed electronic skins largely unaddressed. These sensors, however, have a distinctive property: their sensing elements are sparse and irregularly arranged over the surface they cover, which makes direct reuse of visual SSL methods suboptimal. We present Tactile-JEPA, an efficient self-supervised pre-training method that uses the spatial arrangement of tactile sensors to learn topology-aware representations. Specifically, it is trained to predict the embeddings of masked sensing elements from the unmasked remainder, using the sensor connectivity graph to guide spatial masking. Our analysis shows that effective tactile representations require capturing both local contact details and the global state of the tactile surface, which we achieve through dual-scale masking. Across three diverse datasets spanning magnetic and piezoresistive sensors, different robot embodiments, and single- and paired-sensor configurations, Tactile-JEPA reduces force estimation error by 6.3% and in-hand orientation error by 20.8% over the prior state-of-the-art, with consistent gains in other downstream applications, including policy learning. Overall, our results demonstrate that the benefit of tactile sensing depends critically on the quality of encoder pre-training, a problem which Tactile-JEPA addresses directly. Code is available at https://github.com/E-Kovtun/tactile.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Tactile-JEPA，一种利用触觉传感器空间拓扑结构的自监督预训练方法，通过掩码预测学习拓扑感知表征，在多个数据集和下游任务中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 触觉感知对机器人接触丰富且视觉遮挡下的灵巧操作至关重要，但触觉编码器通常仍从原始噪声信号从头训练，且现有自监督方法主要面向视觉触觉传感器，未充分处理稀疏、不规则分布的分布式电子皮肤。
AI.method: Tactile-JEPA 使用传感器连接图引导空间掩码，让模型从可见传感元素预测被掩码元素的嵌入；通过双尺度掩码同时捕捉局部接触细节和全局触觉表面状态。
