AI.result: 在涵盖磁性和压阻传感器、不同机器人本体以及单/双传感器配置的三个数据集上，Tactile-JEPA 将力估计误差降低 6.3%，手内方向误差降低 20.8%，并在策略学习等下游应用中获得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 触觉感知的收益关键取决于编码器预训练质量，Tactile-JEPA 直接针对该问题，证明了拓扑感知自监督预训练的有效性。

title: Vision Transformers versus convolutional neural networks for fine-grained orchid genus identification in a species-rich, data-poor flora: a controlled benchmark on the Orchidaceae of New Guinea
summary: New Guinea is the world's richest island flora (~2,856 orchid species), yet most species are represented by only a handful of photographs, far fewer than direct species-level classification requires. Methods for fine-grained identification in such species-rich, data-poor floras are needed, and it remains unclear which backbone architecture and pretraining strategy best support them. We built a two-stage system that first predicts the genus of a query photograph, then retrieves visually similar reference images of candidate species using FAISS. We compared four pretrained backbones -- two Vision Transformers (ViTs; DINOv2, BioCLIP 2) and two CNNs (ConvNeXt V2-L, EfficientNetV2-L) -- fine-tuned under an identical protocol on a fixed, species-stratified partition of 16,701 photographs spanning 120 genera and 1,350 species, assessing accuracy, calibration, error structure, species retrieval, and open-set detection of novel genera. DINOv2 attained the best genus performance (macro top-1 66.9%, 95% CI 63.7-70.6; global top-1 88.9%); both ViTs outranked both CNNs, and general-purpose self-supervised pretraining (DINOv2) outperformed domain-matched biological pretraining (BioCLIP 2) by 7.1 points of macro top-1. Errors concentrated on two abundant genera acting as error attractors. DINOv2 embeddings achieved species Recall@5 of 86.6% and genus Recall@5 of 98.7%; temperature scaling reduced every backbone's Expected Calibration Error to about 0.03; and a distance-based open-set gate flagged unseen genera (mean AUROC 0.958). A self-supervised Vision-Transformer backbone combined with embedding retrieval is an effective, deployable strategy for fine-grained identification in species-rich, data-poor floras. The system is released as an open web application (the New Guinea Orchid Identifier), offering a practical template for other hyperdiverse, under-documented taxa.

AI.tldr: 该研究为新几内亚约2856种兰花构建了两阶段识别系统：先预测属，再用FAISS检索相似参考图像。比较四种预训练骨干后发现，自监督ViT（DINOv2）效果最佳，并发布了开放网页应用。
AI.motivation: 新几内亚是世界上最丰富的岛屿植物区系，但多数兰花物种仅有少量照片，远不足以支撑直接的物种级分类；因此需要适用于物种丰富、数据匮乏区系的细粒度识别方法，且尚不清楚哪种骨干架构与预训练策略最合适。
AI.method: 构建两阶段系统：第一阶段预测查询照片的属，第二阶段用FAISS检索候选物种的视觉相似参考图像。在16,701张照片（120属、1,350种）的物种分层固定划分上，以相同协议微调四种预训练骨干：两种ViT（DINOv2、BioCLIP 2）和两种CNN（ConvNeXt V2-L、EfficientNetV2-L）。评估准确率、校准、错误结构、物种检索及开放集新属检测，并采用温度缩放和基于距离的开放集门控。
AI.result: DINOv2属级性能最佳（macro top-1 66.9%，95% CI 63.7-70.6；global top-1 88.9%）；两种ViT均优于两种CNN；通用自监督预训练DINOv2比领域匹配的生物预训练BioCLIP 2高7.1个macro top-1百分点。错误集中在两个数量最多的属（错误吸引子）。DINOv2嵌入的物种Recall@5为86.6%、属Recall@5为98.7%；温度缩放将所有骨干的期望校准误差降至约0.03；距离开放集门控可标记未见属（平均AUROC 0.958）。
AI.conclusion: 自监督ViT骨干结合嵌入检索是物种丰富、数据匮乏区系中细粒度识别的有效且可部署策略。系统已作为开放网页应用（New Guinea Orchid Identifier）发布，为其他超多样、记录不足的类群提供了实用模板。

title: URA-NER: A Unified Retrieval-Augmented Framework with Retrieval Alignment and Uncertainty Reduction for Low-Resource NER
comment: 8 pages,3 figures, accepted at IJCNN 2026, conference WCCI 2026
summary: In-context learning (ICL) based on large language models (LLMs) has shown promising potential in alleviating performance bottlenecks caused by the limited availability of annotated data in Named Entity Recognition (NER). However, existing methods still face issues of retrieval misalignment and generation uncertainty, making their performance heavily dependent on the LLM's capabilities. As the parameter scale of LLMs decreases, their performance in few-shot settings deteriorates significantly. In this paper, we propose a novel unified retrieval-augmented framework, URA-NER, including three key components: Progressive Granularity Retrieval (PGR), Model-aware Representation Enhancement (MaRE), and Reason-aware Knowledge Verification. PGR is a two-stage retrieval mechanism that achieves stage alignment. It first retrieves demonstrations for span detection based on the query's global semantics, and then for type classification based on the specific entity context, providing fine-grained local information. Moreover, MaRE employs entity pre-recognition to guide the construction of representations, ensuring the query and demonstrations are aligned within the LLM's semantic space and attention pattern. In addition, to mitigate generation uncertainty, we propose RaKV, a closed-loop "generation-retrieval-verification" process. It explicates the LLM's reasoning paths, leverages them for the retrieval of external knowledge, and reorganizes the knowledge into verification evidence aligned with the original reasoning paths. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple low-resource NER datasets. Results demonstrate that URA-NER significantly enhances the performance of LLMs under low-resource settings, with particularly pronounced gains for smaller LLMs, achieving new state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的检索增强框架URA-NER，用于低资源命名实体识别。该框架包含渐进粒度检索、模型感知表示增强和推理感知知识验证三个组件，显著提升了LLM在低资源设置下的性能，尤其对小规模LLM提升明显，并在多个基准上取得新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的上下文学习在NER中虽能缓解标注数据不足的问题，但存在检索错位和生成不确定性，导致性能严重依赖LLM能力，且随着LLM参数规模减小，少样本性能显著下降。
AI.method: 提出了URA-NER框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 渐进粒度检索（PGR）：两阶段检索机制，先基于查询全局语义检索用于跨度检测的演示，再基于特定实体上下文检索用于类型分类的演示，实现阶段对齐；2) 模型感知表示增强（MaRE）：利用实体预识别指导表示构建，确保查询和演示在LLM语义空间和注意力模式中对齐；3) 推理感知知识验证（RaKV）：闭环“生成-检索-验证”过程，显式化LLM推理路径，检索外部知识并重组为与原始推理路径对齐的验证证据。
AI.result: 在多个低资源NER数据集上的实验表明，URA-NER显著提升了LLM在低资源设置下的性能，对较小LLM的提升尤为明显，并在多个基准上取得了新的最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: URA-NER通过统一检索增强框架有效解决了ICL在NER中的检索错位和生成不确定性问题，显著提升了低资源场景下LLM的NER性能，尤其有利于小规模LLM。

title: A paired synthetic construction-site image dataset for robust computer vision under adverse conditions
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Dataset and code are publicly available
summary: Computer-vision systems used for construction monitoring can degrade under adverse environmental and visual conditions, yet such conditions remain underrepresented in existing construction image datasets. We present ConSynth-X, a paired synthetic construction-site image dataset containing 34,199 images derived from 3,109 real-world source scenes. The dataset comprises 11 condition-specific subsets spanning precipitation, fog, nighttime illumination, adverse weather at night, and small-object or long-distance views. Each synthetic image is linked to its corresponding source scene, enabling controlled comparison across environmental and visual conditions. ConSynth-X includes source-derived annotations, generation metadata, provenance information, and image-quality indicators, supporting object detection, image captioning, visual grounding, and visual question answering. Technical validation evaluates source-synthetic fidelity and alignment with real adverse-condition imagery using embedding-based similarity and distributional analyses. The dataset provides a structured resource for evaluating and improving the robustness of construction vision and vision-language models under challenging field conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出ConSynth-X，一个成对的合成建筑工地图像数据集，包含34,199张图像，覆盖11种恶劣环境与视觉条件子集，用于评估和提升建筑视觉及视觉-语言模型的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 建筑监测中的计算机视觉系统在恶劣环境和视觉条件下性能会下降，但现有建筑图像数据集对此类条件覆盖不足。
AI.method: 从3,109个真实场景生成配对合成图像，构建11个条件子集（降水、雾、夜间光照、夜间恶劣天气、小目标/远距离视角等）；每张合成图像关联源场景，并包含标注、生成元数据、来源信息和图像质量指标；通过基于嵌入的相似性和分布分析进行技术验证。
AI.result: 数据集包含34,199张图像，支持目标检测、图像描述、视觉定位和视觉问答；验证表明合成图像与源场景具有保真度，且与真实恶劣条件图像对齐。
AI.conclusion: ConSynth-X为评估和改进建筑视觉与视觉-语言模型在挑战性现场条件下的鲁棒性提供了结构化资源。

title: Calibrated Decisions at Scale: Converting Police Crash Narratives into Probabilistic Crash Variables with a System One Model (Jev)
summary: Crash datasets that carry an investigator narrative hold information the coded fields omit. Coding those narratives at scale has been blocked by three obstacles. Frontier large language models are costly at that scale, their generated text cannot be verified, and no rule says how much output a human must check. This paper formulates narrative coding as gated, typed decisions answered by Jev, a System One model that returns probabilities over analyst-defined options and generates no text. A screen covered 499,500 Texas narratives and 195,857 were coded with a 27-question schema. Cost is governed by schema size rather than narrative length. The probabilities are audited against coded fields and against 2,416 blinded human judgments drawn under a stated sampling design. Two frontier large language models are benchmarked on the same records. Against human labels the typed model attains an F1 of 0.908. One frontier model gains 0.059 and the other is indistinguishable from it. Calibration varies by model rather than by paradigm, so each model must be audited. Recalibration on the same labels reduces calibration error by a factor of 3.3. Agreement with coded fields understates fidelity to the narrative by a median of 0.26 in kappa. A resolution-floor bound covers any model that reports probabilities on a discrete grid. A review budget over flagged records gives the records a human must read per variable and per year. Adding the calibrated variables to the coded fields raises the injury and fatal crashes attributed to nine factors by 10,747 per year.

AI.tldr: 本文将事故叙述编码建模为带门控的类型化决策，使用不生成文本、只输出选项概率的Jev模型，大规模处理德州事故叙述，并审计其保真度、成本、校准与人工复核需求。
AI.motivation: 事故数据集中的调查员叙述包含编码字段遗漏的信息，但大规模编码受三大障碍限制：前沿大语言模型成本高、生成文本不可验证、且缺乏人工应检查多少输出的规则。
AI.method: 将叙述编码形式化为门控、类型化决策；Jev返回分析者定义选项上的概率且不生成文本。筛查499,500条德州叙述，按27题模式编码195,857条；用编码字段和2,416份盲法人工判断审计概率，并与两个前沿大语言模型在相同记录上基准比较；还进行重校准、分辨率下限界和复核预算分析。
AI.result: 类型化模型相对人工标签的F1为0.908；一个前沿模型提高0.059，另一个与之无显著差异。校准差异主要随模型而非范式变化，重校准使校准误差降低3.3倍。与编码字段的一致度会低估对叙述的保真度，kappa中位数低0.26。离散概率网格上的模型受分辨率下限界约束；复核预算给出每变量、每年需人工阅读的记录数。加入校准变量后，九类因素导致的伤害与致命碰撞每年增加10,747起。
AI.conclusion: 类型化概率编码能以可控成本、可审计方式大规模提取事故叙述信息，但每个模型都需单独校准和人工复核；该方法能显著补充传统编码字段，并揭示更多与伤害和致命碰撞相关的因素。

title: Do LiDAR Language Models Really Understand Spatio-temporal Relationships?
summary: Recent 4D LiDAR language models aim to reason about objects and their evolving spatial relationships. Yet, in our evaluation, always selecting the same option nearly matches the multiple-choice accuracy of two B4DL-derived configurations. We introduce LiDAR-Hallu, a geometry-referenced benchmark and diagnostic protocol with 10,000 questions across 150 nuScenes scenes. It covers object existence, ego-relative position, distance ordering, relative motion, and temporal localization, with explicit rules for selecting objects, comparing times, and determining reference answers. Our protocol combines fixed-answer and candidate-content controls, cross-scene pairs with identical prompts but opposite reference answers, and relation-specific recall. Analysis of 100,000 recorded responses reveals failures hidden by aggregate accuracy. Candidate duration alone makes temporal answers predictable without observing LiDAR. On paired questions, the models frequently give the same answer to scenes requiring opposite answers. Relation-specific analysis further shows that both configurations miss every positive lateral-motion case across all tested conditions. Temporal-shuffle contrastive decoding provides little net improvement, as repairs are largely offset by new errors and the main failures persist. These results show that evaluating spatio-temporal reasoning requires testing whether models distinguish the queried physical relationships, rather than relying on individual-answer accuracy alone. The source code, checkpoints, and data are released at https://github.com/Awesome4D/4DMLLM_Hallucination_Bench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LiDAR-Hallu，一个面向4D LiDAR语言模型的几何参照基准与诊断协议，包含1万道题、覆盖150个nuScenes场景，用于揭示聚合准确率掩盖的时空推理失败。
AI.motivation: 现有4D LiDAR语言模型评测中，始终选择同一选项几乎可匹配部分B4DL衍生配置的多选题准确率，说明仅靠单题准确率无法判断模型是否真正理解所询问的物理关系。
AI.method: 构建包含物体存在性、自车相对位置、距离排序、相对运动、时间定位等任务的基准，并设计固定答案与候选内容控制、同提示但相反参考答案的跨场景配对、关系特定召回分析，以及时间打乱对比解码等诊断方法。
AI.result: 分析10万条回答发现：仅凭候选时长即可预测时间答案；配对问题中模型常对需要相反答案的场景给出相同回答；两种配置在所有条件下均漏掉全部正向横向运动案例；时间打乱对比解码净提升很小，修复常被新错误抵消，主要失败仍存在。
AI.conclusion: 评估时空推理不能只依赖单题准确率，而应测试模型是否能区分所询问的物理关系；LiDAR-Hallu 提供了相应基准与诊断协议，并公开代码、检查点和数据。

title: VPRune: Efficient Training-free Pre-LLM Visual Token Pruning
summary: Visual token pruning is a promising approach to reducing the inference cost of large vision-language models (LVLMs), yet aggressive token reduction often causes substantial performance degradation. We identify three key factors behind this degradation: text-guided selection bias, information loss from discarded tokens, and positional distortion caused by sequence compaction. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{VPRune}, a training-free pre-LLM pruning framework consisting of visual-only diversity selection, similarity-guided token recycling, and position-preserving restoration. Experiments on FastVLM-1.5B across multiple vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that VPRune achieves a favorable accuracy--compression trade-off, with particularly pronounced advantages under aggressive compression. Furthermore, evaluations on edge-device show that VPRune effectively reduces end-to-end inference latency while maintaining superior task performance, demonstrating its practicality for resource-constrained LVLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出VPRune，一种无需训练的前LLM视觉token剪枝框架，通过多样性选择、相似性回收和位置保留修复，在压缩视觉token的同时保持大视觉语言模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法在激进压缩下会导致性能大幅下降，原因包括文本引导的选择偏差、丢弃token的信息损失以及序列压缩造成的位置扭曲。
AI.method: VPRune框架包含三个组件：仅基于视觉的多样性选择、相似性引导的token回收、以及位置保留修复。该框架无需训练，在LLM之前进行剪枝。
AI.result: 在FastVLM-1.5B及多个视觉语言基准上，VPRune实现了更好的精度-压缩权衡，尤其在激进压缩下优势明显；在边缘设备上有效降低端到端推理延迟并保持优越任务性能。
AI.conclusion: VPRune是一种实用且有效的视觉token剪枝方法，适用于资源受限环境下的大视觉语言模型部署。

title: Re:CAP - Auditing Retrieval Coverage in Production RAG Pipelines
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is hard to monitor in production: exhaustive relevance labels do not exist for non-stationary multi-million-passage corpora that re-index in real time. As a result, retrieval quality is generally understudied and often deprioritised in favour of generation-oriented metrics. In this work, we propose auditing retrieval coverage by probing for evidence of missing documents rather than enumerating every relevant one. Our method Re:CAP (REtrieval Coverage Audit by iterative Probing) is a reference-free audit loop applied to a deployed RAG pipeline's initial answer and retrieved context: it identifies the topics already covered, generates probing questions for plausibly missing topics, retrieves candidate documents, and applies an LLM-as-judge to retain only those that introduce previously-unretrieved information. On four public benchmarks, Re:CAP recovers 9-29% of gold labels that flat BM25 top-500 cannot reach, rising to 48% on TREC-COVID. On MuSiQue Re:CAP beats flat hybrid top-500 by +12.9 pp on recall at less than half the document budget. An ensemble BM25, dense, and hybrid baseline (top-500 each) still leaves out 21.2% of gold docs on TREC-COVID that Re:CAP recovers; human annotators judge that 78.9% of those structurally distinct documents add new information to the baseline answer (Fleiss $κ$ = 0.79, n = 123), and 73.9% on live production traffic (n = 180). End-to-end recall is reproducible to within $\pm$1% across three independent runs, making Re:CAP a stable instrument for periodic retrieval audits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Re:CAP，一种通过迭代探测缺失文档来审计 RAG 检索覆盖度的方法；它不依赖完整相关性标注，在多个基准上能找回基线检索遗漏的金标文档，并在生产流量中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的 RAG 检索质量难以监控：非稳态、百万级且实时重建索引的语料库没有穷尽的相关性标签，导致检索质量常被忽视，评估偏向生成指标。
AI.method: Re:CAP（REtrieval Coverage Audit by iterative Probing）是无参考审计循环，作用于已部署 RAG 管线的初始答案与检索上下文：识别已覆盖主题，针对可能缺失主题生成探测问题，检索候选文档，并用 LLM-as-judge 仅保留引入先前未检索信息的文档。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准上，Re:CAP 找回 flat BM25 top-500 无法触及的 9–29% 金标，TREC-COVID 上达 48%；MuSiQue 上以不到一半文档预算超过 flat hybrid top-500 的 recall +12.9 个百分点。TREC-COVID 上 BM25、稠密、混合集成基线各 top-500 仍遗漏 21.2% 金标文档，Re:CAP 可找回；人工标注认为其中 78.9% 的结构不同文档为基线答案增加新信息（Fleiss κ=0.79, n=123），生产流量中为 73.9%（n=180）。端到端 recall 三次独立运行可复现至 ±1%。
AI.conclusion: Re:CAP 可作为稳定、可复现的检索覆盖度审计工具，用于周期性审计已部署 RAG 管线的检索质量，弥补缺乏穷尽相关性标签时检索评估不足的问题。

title: Robotic Valve Turning: Axial Misalignment Correction Using Reaction Torque Feedback
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: In this work, we propose a haptic update control law that uses reaction torques to correct axial misalignment during robotic valve manipulation. Unlike vision-based estimates, which can be affected by calibration errors, occlusion, and uncertainty in the contact geometry, reaction torques arise directly from the physical interaction between the gripper and valve. A geometric relationship exists between the error (misalignment) vector and these torques. The primary aim of this work is to propose a stable controller exploiting this geometric property. Our control law is proven to be uniformly asymptotically stable. Simulations are performed for verification. Furthermore, we experimentally test the robustness of our method using a Kinova Gen3 robotic arm for initial misalignments ranging from $-15^\circ$ to $15^\circ$ at 3 different valve positions and report the resulting data distribution. The absolute value of the median misalignment across all 18 test cases is found to be within $2.46^\circ$ and that of reaction torques within $0.23\mathrm{Nm}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于触觉反馈的更新控制律，利用反作用力矩修正机器人阀门操作中的轴向错位，并通过稳定性证明、仿真和实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 视觉估计易受标定误差、遮挡和接触几何不确定性影响；而反作用力矩直接来源于夹爪与阀门的物理交互，因此更适合用于错位修正。
AI.method: 建立错位向量与反作用力矩之间的几何关系，设计利用该性质的稳定控制律，证明其一致渐近稳定性，并进行仿真验证；实验使用Kinova Gen3机械臂，在3个阀门位置、初始错位-15°至15°条件下测试鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在全部18个测试案例中，中位错位绝对值在2.46°以内，中位反作用力矩绝对值在0.23 Nm以内。
AI.conclusion: 基于反作用力矩的触觉更新控制律能有效、稳定地修正轴向错位，并具有实验验证的鲁棒性。

title: Zeva-Ego: Egocentric Mid-Training with In-Context Causal Learning for Robot Manipulation
summary: Egocentric video offers a scalable source of physical interaction experience, yet translating it into robot-executable knowledge and enabling continual adaptation remain challenging. We introduce Zeva-Ego, a unified framework that learns physical priors from human experience and evolves through robot interaction. An Action-Centric Encoder (ACE) converts egocentric visual transitions into action-centered supervision for VLA mid-training, while In-Context Causal Learning (ICCL) enables parameter-free adaptation from action-effect feedback at deployment. Scaling Ego data to 10K hours improves RoboTwin success from 63.8% to 75.3%, matching 2K hours of robot demonstrations (74.7%), corresponding to an empirical data ratio of roughly 4-5:1. With accumulated interaction experience, ICCL further improves success from 58% to 89% within four attempts without parameter updates. These results demonstrate a scalable path toward embodied intelligence that learns from human experience and continuously improves through its own interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出Zeva-Ego框架，从自我中心视频学习物理先验，并通过机器人交互持续适应。
AI.motivation: 自我中心视频可扩展地提供物理交互经验，但将其转化为机器人可执行知识并实现持续适应仍具挑战。
AI.method: 使用Action-Centric Encoder (ACE)将自我中心视觉转换转化为动作中心监督用于VLA中期训练；In-Context Causal Learning (ICCL)在部署时基于动作-效果反馈实现无参数适应。
AI.result: 将Ego数据扩展至1万小时，RoboTwin成功率从63.8%提升至75.3%，匹配2000小时机器人演示的74.7%，数据比例约4-5:1；ICCL在四次尝试内将成功率从58%提升至89%，无需参数更新。
AI.conclusion: 展示了从人类经验学习并通过自身交互持续改进的具身智能可扩展路径。

title: Bridging Reconstruction and Generation: A Latent Distribution Perspective on Evaluation and Improvement
summary: In latent generative models, reconstruction quality is often assumed to correlate with generative performance. However, reconstruction FID (rFID) can exhibit weak or even negative correlation with generation FID (gFID). We attribute this discrepancy to a latent distribution mismatch: reconstruction evaluates the decoder on encoder-induced latents, whereas generation uses the same decoder on latents produced by the generative model. To characterize this shift, we introduce generation-aware reconstruction (GAR), which constructs a continuous trajectory from standard reconstruction toward generation by perturbing encoder latents with noise and denoising them through the generative model before decoding. GAR probes the decoder behavior along this trajectory, making the transition from encoder to generation-time latent distributions observable and diagnosable. The resulting trajectory-based diagnostic, GAR-FID, exhibits strong empirical correlation with gFID across diverse tokenizers and scales. Importantly, intermediate GAR latents become more generation-aware while preserving correspondence with their source images, thereby retaining paired supervision that is absent for fully generated latents. This correspondence enables decoder adaptation on intermediate GAR latents, consistently improving generative quality across model scales. Overall, latent distribution mismatch provides a useful perspective for evaluating and improving latent generative models.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出潜生成模型中重建质量与生成性能并不总是一致，并将重建FID与生成FID的弱相关甚至负相关归因于潜分布不匹配，提出GAR诊断与改进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有观点常假设重建质量越好，生成性能也越好；但实验发现重建FID（rFID）与生成FID（gFID）可能弱相关甚至负相关。作者认为这是因为重建使用编码器产生的潜变量，而生成使用生成模型产生的潜变量，二者存在潜分布不匹配。
AI.method: 提出Generation-Aware Reconstruction（GAR）：通过向编码器潜变量加入噪声，再经生成模型去噪后解码，构造从标准重建到生成过程的连续轨迹。基于该轨迹提出GAR-FID诊断指标，用于观察和诊断解码器在编码器潜分布到生成时潜分布之间的行为变化。进一步利用中间GAR潜变量仍与源图像保持对应关系的特点，进行解码器适配。
AI.result: GAR-FID与gFID在不同分词器和模型规模下表现出强经验相关性。中间GAR潜变量更具生成感知性，同时保留与源图像的配对监督信息，可用于解码器适配，并在多种模型规模上持续提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 潜分布不匹配为评估和改进潜生成模型提供了有用视角，GAR既能诊断重建与生成之间的差距，也能通过中间潜变量适配提升生成性能。

title: You Can Tell Who's Asking: What the Web's Questions Are Made Of, and Where They Come From
comment: Accepted to the 13th Web as Corpus Workshop (WaC-13) at EMNLP 2026. 14 pages, 4 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/bodhiumlabs/tell-whos-asking
summary: Questions scraped from the web are used across academia and industry as a proxy for what people want to know. Across QA training data, retrieval benchmarks, and content strategy, questions on a page are assumed to reflect human intent. We test this assumption at scale by extracting 13.4B question occurrences across 110 FineWeb snapshots (2013-2025), and report three findings. First, you can tell who is asking: provenance (the host/page of questions) leaves a signal in question form, and a logistic model can separate genuine user questions from templated/manufactured ones at AUC 0.725 via length and surrounding context rather than question type, though only 0.554 against commerce FAQ writing. Second, question frequency does not measure demand: the most-frequent questions are boilerplate/templated (over 70% of the top thousand), so occurrence counts measure how often a string was published and not how often it was asked. Third, over twelve years the genuine share of occurrences fell by 79% (42-56% after controlling for crawl composition), with question length and context decreasing. We present the first diachronic, occurrence-level measurement of web question provenance, and find the crawlable web's questions have shifted from being asked by humans toward manufactured for machines to read.

AI.tldr: 本文通过提取110个FineWeb快照（2013-2025）中的134亿个问题出现，检验了网页问题反映人类意图的假设。研究发现：问题来源留下信号；问题频率并不代表需求；12年间真实问题占比下降79%，表明网络问题已从人类提问转向为机器制造。
AI.motivation: 学术界和工业界常将网页抓取的问题作为人们想要了解什么的代理，用于QA训练数据、检索基准和内容策略，但这一假设缺乏大规模验证。
AI.method: 从110个FineWeb快照（2013-2025）中提取134亿个问题出现，使用逻辑回归模型基于长度和上下文区分真实用户问题与模板化/制造问题，并分析问题频率、来源和时间趋势。
AI.result: 1）来源留下信号，逻辑模型区分真实与模板化问题的AUC为0.725，但对商业FAQ写作仅0.554；2）问题频率不衡量需求，最常见问题中超过70%是模板化内容；3）12年间真实问题占比下降79%（控制爬取组成后为42-56%），问题长度和上下文减少。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个对网络问题来源的历时性、出现级测量，发现可爬取网络的问题已从人类提问转向为机器阅读而制造。

title: ScaleMPA: Rethinking Scalable RRT* Acceleration With a Grid-Native Representation
summary: Real-time motion planning remains challenging in large and high-dimensional environments. Prior acceleration of RRT* follows tree-centric state organization, which reduces per-query cost but preserves superlinear end-to-end complexity and limits parallelism through structural dependencies. This paper presents ScaleMPA, a motion-planning accelerator that rethinks RRT* with a grid-native representation. By replacing hierarchical traversal with direct grid-based access, ScaleMPA reduces the planner critical path and exposes fine-grained parallelism. To make this reformulation practical under sparse high-dimensional planning, ScaleMPA further proposes a multi-resolution grid search engine and a hash-grid memory system. Implemented in 28 nm CMOS, ScaleMPA achieves millisecond-level planning latency and delivers 4.7$\times$--44.4$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art motion-planning accelerators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScaleMPA，一种采用网格原生表示的RRT*运动规划加速器，通过多分辨率网格搜索与哈希网格内存系统，在28nm CMOS上实现毫秒级规划延迟，相比现有最优运动规划加速器取得4.7倍至44.4倍加速。
AI.motivation: 大规模高维环境中的实时运动规划仍具挑战。现有RRT*加速方法采用树中心的状态组织，虽降低单次查询成本，但端到端复杂度仍为超线性，并因结构依赖限制并行性。
AI.method: ScaleMPA重新思考RRT*的表示方式，用直接网格访问替代分层遍历，以缩短规划关键路径并暴露细粒度并行；同时提出多分辨率网格搜索引擎和哈希网格内存系统，以应对稀疏高维规划，并在28nm CMOS中实现。
AI.result: ScaleMPA实现毫秒级规划延迟，相比当前最优运动规划加速器获得4.7倍至44.4倍的速度提升。
AI.conclusion: 网格原生重构能有效加速RRT*并提升并行性，适合稀疏高维运动规划，可显著优于传统树中心加速方案。

title: A$^2$Safe: Counterfactual Evidence-Aligned Adaptive Agent Collaboration for Safe and Effective Visual Question Answering
summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) requires not only producing safe and effective responses, but also grounding safety decisions in the multimodal evidence that determines risk. Recent safety-alignment methods improve refusal behavior and contextual risk awareness, yet correct safety outcomes may still rely on superficial textual or visual correlations, particularly when risk emerges from interactions between individually benign image and question content. To address this issue, we propose A$^2$Safe, a counterfactual evidence-aligned adaptive agent collaboration framework for safe and effective VQA. A$^2$Safe organizes localized visual observations, textual intent, and cross-modal risk relations through a Grounded Safety Evidence Board, making the basis of safety decisions explicit. Counterfactual safety evidence alignment enforces invariance to safety-irrelevant changes while requiring appropriate safety-state and response-mode transitions when risk-critical evidence is minimally altered. The resulting evidence state further supports adaptive collaboration, enabling direct answering when grounded evidence is sufficient and invoking policy critique and response revision when evidence is risky, uncertain, or conflicting. Under complementary safety-critical and general VQA protocols, A$^2$Safe achieves a 95.72 SIUO safety score, reduces the benign refusal rate on MOSSBench to 14.67%, and maintains an average general VQA score of 78.34 with 27.8% token overhead. These results support counterfactual evidence-aligned adaptive collaboration for safe and effective multimodal question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出 A$^2$Safe 框架，通过反事实证据对齐与自适应智能体协作，提升多模态大模型在视觉问答中的安全性与有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法虽改善拒答与风险意识，但安全判断可能依赖浅层文本或视觉相关性，尤其当风险源于图像与问题中各自良性内容的交互时，难以保证决策真正基于多模态证据。
AI.method: 构建 Grounded Safety Evidence Board，显式组织局部视觉观察、文本意图与跨模态风险关系；采用反事实安全证据对齐，使模型对安全无关变化保持不变，并在风险关键证据微调时要求安全状态与响应模式相应转变；进而支持自适应协作，在证据充分时直接回答，在证据风险、不确定或冲突时触发策略批判与响应修订。
AI.result: 在安全关键与通用 VQA 协议下，A$^2$Safe 取得 95.72 的 SIUO 安全分数，将 MOSSBench 上良性拒答率降至 14.67%，通用 VQA 平均分为 78.34，额外 token 开销为 27.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，反事实证据对齐与自适应协作能同时提升多模态问答的安全性和有效性，为安全 VQA 提供可行路径。

title: Efficient LLM Distillation for Bangladesh Legal Context: A Smartphone-Compatible Retrieval-Augmented Generation Model
summary: Legal information in Bangladesh is inaccessible to most citizens. Statutory text is English-only, trained lawyers are concentrated in urban centres, and cloud-dependent AI fails where mobile connectivity is unreliable, a setting in which hallucinated legal text causes direct harm. The system addresses statutory interpretation only; queries that require judicial precedent or case-law reasoning fall outside its scope. We target the statutory access gap by compressing a 9-billion-parameter Gemma-2 teacher into a 2-billion-parameter student through two-phase progressive knowledge distillation. Phase 1 performs supervised fine-tuning on 9,429 quality-gated legal question-answer pairs (65% acceptance from 14,514 generated queries); Phase 2 minimises sparse Kullback-Leibler divergence against the teacher's top-50 per-token logits at temperature tau = 4.0, implemented via QLoRA (4-bit NF4, rank-32 LoRA adapters). Prior legal language models target general legal English; this system specialises in Bangladeshi statutory law. Every response is grounded through hybrid retrieval combining dense semantic search (60%) and BM25 (40%) across 36,029 statutory passages from the Bangladesh Constitution and national legislation. On a 50-query English benchmark, the distilled model reaches ROUGE-L 0.4715 and BERTScore F1 0.5679, a 103% ROUGE-L and 143% BERTScore gain over the retrieval-augmented undistilled baseline (ROUGE-L 0.2323, BERTScore 0.2340). The adapter quantises to 1.6 GB (GGUF Q4_K_M) and runs at 4-8 tokens per second on a Pixel 6 with no network access. Cross-lingual evaluation on 50 Bangla queries yields ROUGE-L 0.4083 and BERTScore 0.8133, showing effective retrieval from Bangla input against an English-only corpus. In a single-evaluator pilot, a practising lawyer rated 50 responses at a weighted mean of 4.16/5 (90% rated 4 or 5), supporting utility beyond text-overlap metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对孟加拉国法律信息难以获取的问题，将90亿参数Gemma-2教师模型通过两阶段渐进式知识蒸馏压缩为20亿参数学生模型，并结合混合检索，实现可在手机离线运行、基于孟加拉国成文法的法律问答系统。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国法律文本多为英文，律师集中于城市，且依赖云端的AI在网络不稳定地区不可用；法律场景中幻觉内容会造成直接危害。因此需要面向成文法、可离线、可检索增强且能处理孟加拉语查询的专用法律模型。
AI.method: 采用两阶段渐进知识蒸馏：第一阶段在9,429条质量过滤后的法律问答对上监督微调；第二阶段通过QLoRA（4-bit NF4、rank-32 LoRA）最小化与教师模型top-50 token logits之间的稀疏KL散度，温度τ=4.0。推理时使用混合检索，结合稠密语义搜索（60%）和BM25（40%），检索孟加拉国宪法及国家立法中的36,029个法条段落。
AI.result: 在50条英文查询基准上，蒸馏模型达到ROUGE-L 0.4715、BERTScore F1 0.5679，相比未蒸馏的检索增强基线分别提升103%和143%。适配器量化后为1.6 GB（GGUF Q4_K_M），在Pixel 6上无网络下以4–8 tokens/秒运行。50条孟加拉语查询跨语言评估达到ROUGE-L 0.4083、BERTScore 0.8133。单一评估者试点中，执业律师对50个回答的加权均分为4.16/5，其中90%为4或5分。
AI.conclusion: 该系统通过知识蒸馏与混合检索，将大模型压缩为可在手机离线运行的法律问答模型，有效提升孟加拉国成文法检索与回答质量，并支持孟加拉语输入检索英文语料。但其范围仅限于成文法解释，不处理判例法推理或司法先例查询。

title: HDND: Hierarchical Dynamic Neural Decoding for Multilingual Word/Character Retrieval from Non-Invasive Brain Recordings
summary: While deep learning has enabled language decoding from intracranial brain recordings, extending this capability to non-invasive recordings remains an unresolved challenge. Decoding individual words from non-invasive brain recordings is particularly difficult, as word-level neural evidence is weak, temporally distributed, and entangled with acoustic, lexical, and semantic structure. Existing retrieval pipelines often collapse these factors into a single representation, potentially discarding information available at intermediate temporal scales. Here, we introduce Hierarchical Dynamic Neural Decoding (HDND), a hierarchical dynamic decoding framework that treats word decoding as structured refinement rather than flat label retrieval. HDND combines intermediate neural representations, contextual semantic predictions, and, for selected reading conditions, an auxiliary character-form objective. We evaluate HDND across seven electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) datasets spanning English, Dutch, Mandarin, and Cantonese listening, reading, and reading-aloud conditions. Across the nine-condition word-retrieval benchmark, the proposed HDND yields a higher participant-averaged balanced Top-10 point estimate than the matched contextual word-decoding baseline in every condition and achieves the highest mean among all compared methods in eight of nine conditions. Across the same nine matched conditions, HDND also yields higher token-micro and pooled word-macro Top-10 point estimates in every setting. Sentence retrieval favors HDND in eight of nine conditions, while auditory speech-segment retrieval is mixed across the six listening conditions. These results show that hierarchical residual refinement can improve multilingual word retrieval from heterogeneous non-invasive brain recordings.

AI.tldr: 提出分层动态神经解码框架HDND，将单词解码视为结构化细化，在多种非侵入式脑记录数据集上提升多语言词汇检索性能。
AI.motivation: 非侵入式脑记录中单词级神经证据微弱、时间分布且与声学、词汇和语义结构纠缠，现有检索流程常将因素压缩为单一表示，可能丢失中间时间尺度信息。
AI.method: HDND结合中间神经表示、上下文语义预测，并在部分阅读条件下加入辅助字符形态目标；在7个EEG/MEG数据集（英、荷、中、粤，听、读、朗读）上评估。
AI.result: 在9条件词检索基准中，HDND在每条件均优于匹配的上下文词解码基线（参与者平均平衡Top-10），8/9条件均值最高；token-micro和pooled word-macro Top-10在所有设置中均更高；句子检索8/9条件更优；听觉语音段检索在6个听条件下结果混合。
AI.conclusion: 分层残差细化能改善异质非侵入式脑记录下的多语言词汇检索。

title: AgentSTAR: Agentic Shape Tracking and Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
summary: In this work, we present a method for shape reconstruction and tracking from video via agentic analysis-by-synthesis. Unlike prior methods which first estimate dense pixel correspondences and then recover object motion from them, our method infers a structured 3D object model, including its geometry and kinematic structure, and uses this model to optimise object track estimates over time. In our optimisation loop, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) agent iteratively refines shape or generalised pose through a render-and-compare loop, combining coarse visual reasoning with numerical pose optimisation for precise state estimation. This structured formulation enables our method to track through large motion, articulation, and severe occlusion without relying on pixel-matching objectives. Quantitatively, on ARCTIC, our method substantially outperforms state-of-the-art 3D point-tracking baselines for articulated objects, and on HOT3D it outperforms all evaluated rigid-object tracking baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于智能体分析-合成的方法，从视频中重建形状并跟踪，通过VLM智能体迭代优化结构化3D模型。
AI.motivation: 现有方法先估计稠密像素对应再恢复运动，难以处理大运动、关节运动和严重遮挡。
AI.method: 推断结构化3D物体模型（几何与运动学结构），用该模型优化跟踪；VLM智能体在渲染-比较循环中迭代细化形状或广义姿态，结合粗视觉推理与数值姿态优化。
AI.result: 在ARCTIC上显著优于最先进的铰接物体3D点跟踪基线，在HOT3D上优于所有评估的刚体跟踪基线。
AI.conclusion: 该结构化方法无需依赖像素匹配目标，即可在大运动、关节运动和严重遮挡下实现有效跟踪。

title: A Monolithic Force-Proprioception Soft Acutuator Enabled by Single-Material 3D printing
summary: Pneumatic proprioceptive actuators integrate actuation and sensing for soft robots that attract interest due to functional potential. Existing approaches often suffer from assembly errors or stress concentrations caused by heterogeneous materials. In this work, we propose the Monolithic Force-Proprioception Soft (MFPS) design and fabrication method that integrates an Asymmetric Origami Bending (AOB) chamber and a Force-Proprioception Soft (FPS) sensor with single material through one-step Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) fabrication. Based on the resistance response to strain of conductive thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), we design and analyze the structure of the FPS sensor, and conduct parametric analysis on the sensing characteristics. The FDM fabrication parameters of the MFPS actuator are analyzed, followed by actuator fabrication and characterization of the actuation and proprioception performance. Experimental results show that the MFPS actuator achieves a bending angle of 40°, an output force of 12.5 N, and a resistance change of 26.9% as the applied external force increased from 0 to 45 N. A two-finger force-proprioception gripper is developed based on the MFPS actuator. The grasping and force-proprioception capabilities are experimentally validated, proving that the MFPS design method provides a new approach for the development of self-sensing actuators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种单片力-本体感知软执行器（MFPS），将非对称折纸弯曲气腔与力感知软传感器用单一材料通过一步FDM打印集成，并验证了其驱动、感知及抓取能力。
AI.motivation: 现有气动本体感知执行器常因异质材料集成导致装配误差或应力集中，因此需要一种单材料、一体化制造的自感知软执行器方案。
AI.method: 设计并分析基于导电热塑性聚氨酯（TPU）应变电阻响应的FPS传感器结构，进行传感特性参数分析；分析MFPS执行器的FDM制造参数，完成执行器制造，并对其驱动与本体感知性能进行表征；基于MFPS执行器开发两指力-本体感知夹爪并实验验证。
AI.result: MFPS执行器实现40°弯曲角度、12.5 N输出力；当外力从0增至45 N时电阻变化达26.9%；两指夹爪的抓取与力感知能力得到实验验证。
AI.conclusion: MFPS设计方法为自感知执行器的发展提供了一种新途径。

title: Adaptive Cortically Constrained EEG-Vision Alignment for Zero-Shot Brain-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval requires robust alignment between noisy EEG responses and visual representations. Existing EEG-vision alignment methods often operate in sensor space and apply fixed visual supervision to all responses, ignoring both spatial mixing in scalp EEG and response-wise variability in alignment reliability. We propose an adaptive cortically constrained EEG-vision alignment method for zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval. The method reconstructs EEG responses into predefined ROI-level source-pattern representations and encodes them with a Neuro-ROI Attention Encoder. To handle response-wise variability, we introduce an evidence-based adaptive visual supervision strategy that weights detail-controlled visual targets using model-based alignment evidence. On THINGS-EEG, the proposed method achieves strong 200-way zero-shot retrieval performance, with ROI-level attribution providing post hoc interpretability of the learned source-pattern representations. These results show that cortically constrained representation learning and adaptive supervision can jointly support EEG-vision alignment for zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应皮层约束的EEG-视觉对齐方法，用于零样本脑到图像检索，并在THINGS-EEG上取得强200类检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG-视觉对齐方法多在传感器空间进行，并对所有响应使用固定视觉监督，忽略了头皮EEG的空间混叠以及不同响应间对齐可靠性的差异。
AI.method: 将EEG响应重建为预定义ROI级源模式表示，并用Neuro-ROI注意力编码器编码；同时引入基于证据的自适应视觉监督策略，利用模型对齐证据对细节受控的视觉目标进行加权。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG数据集上实现了强200-way零样本检索性能，ROI级归因还提供了对所学源模式表示的事后可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 皮层约束表示学习与自适应监督可共同支持零样本脑到图像检索中的EEG-视觉对齐。

title: QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Ministral LLM for Sequence-to-Function Protein Annotation
summary: Functional annotation of newly sequenced proteins remains a bottleneck in molecular biology: the number of sequences in public repositories grows far faster than the capacity for manual curation. Most computational approaches consider annotation as multi-label classification over a fixed ontology, which constrains predictions to a predefined label set. In this work we study the the protein annotation as a sequence-to-text generation problem. We fine-tune the 3B-parameter Ministral 3 base model with QLoRA (4-bit NF4 quantization with low-rank adapters) on sequence annotation pairs. We assess predictions with an LLM-as-expert protocol: a GPT model prompted as a senior molecular-biology curator scores organism identification as binary and function annotation quality. We conclude that QLoRA-fine-tuned compact LLMs can generate curator-style annotations with genuine biological value for a substantial subset of proteins. We also discuss future directions in data quality, model scaling, and evidence grounding that are needed to make the approach sufficiently reliable for practical use.

AI.tldr: 该研究将蛋白质功能注释视为序列到文本的生成任务，使用QLoRA微调3B参数的Ministral 3模型，并通过LLM-as-expert协议评估，发现紧凑型LLM能为相当一部分蛋白质生成有生物学价值的注释。
AI.motivation: 新测序蛋白质的功能注释仍是分子生物学的瓶颈：公共数据库序列增长远超人工注释能力，且现有计算方法多将注释视为固定本体上的多标签分类，限制了预测范围。
AI.method: 将蛋白质注释建模为序列到文本生成问题，使用QLoRA（4位NF4量化与低秩适配器）在序列-注释对上微调30亿参数的Ministral 3基础模型；评估采用LLM-as-expert协议，由GPT作为资深分子生物学策展人，对生物体识别进行二分类评分并评估功能注释质量。
AI.result: QLoRA微调的紧凑型LLM能够为相当一部分蛋白质生成具有真实生物学价值的策展人风格注释。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了紧凑型LLM在蛋白质注释中的潜力，但要在实际应用中足够可靠，仍需在数据质量、模型扩展和证据 grounding 等方向进一步改进。

title: LoopCD: Loop-wise Contrastive Decoding for Improving Reasoning in Looped Language Models
summary: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) perform "latent reasoning" by recursively refining internal latent representations with shared weights, offering a more effective alternative to explicit verbal reasoning. Despite their effectiveness, we find that LoopLMs remain prone to loop instability: unstable refinement across iterations can produce localized uncertain "hard" tokens associated with reasoning errors. To address this, we propose LoopCD, loop-wise contrastive decoding that enhances the reasoning performance of LoopLMs by intervening on these tokens at inference time. Specifically, we exploit the internal dynamics of LoopLMs and contrast the logits from earlier iterations with logits from the last refined iteration to form the final sampling distribution. We find that this strategy is highly efficient, introducing only negligible inference overhead and requiring no additional training, while effectively improving reasoning performance by naturally refining reasoning-critical hard tokens. Extensive experiments show that our method improves the performance of recent representative LoopLMs across various reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 循环语言模型（LoopLMs）通过共享权重递归精炼内部潜在表示进行潜在推理，但存在循环不稳定问题。为此提出LoopCD，一种循环级对比解码方法，在推理时对比早期迭代与最终精炼迭代的logits，从而提升推理性能，且几乎不增加开销、无需额外训练。
AI.motivation: LoopLMs虽然有效，但仍易出现循环不稳定：跨迭代的不稳定精炼会产生局部不确定的“困难”token，这些token与推理错误相关。因此需要一种推理时干预方法来改善这些token的生成。
AI.method: 提出LoopCD（loop-wise contrastive decoding），利用LoopLMs的内部动态，将较早迭代的logits与最后一个精炼迭代的logits进行对比，形成最终采样分布。该方法无需额外训练，推理开销可忽略，并能自然精炼对推理关键的困难token。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LoopCD能提升近期代表性LoopLMs在多种推理任务上的性能，同时保持高效率和低推理开销。
AI.conclusion: LoopCD通过在推理时干预循环不稳定产生的困难token，有效增强LoopLMs的推理能力，是一种高效且无需训练的对比解码策略。

title: Vimarsha: Faithful ASR Evaluation for Indian Languages with Demographic Diversity, In-the-Wild Audio and Spelling Variations
summary: Evaluation benchmarks for Indian language automatic speech recognition (ASR) suffer from two systematic biases: optimistic scores from clean, controlled audio conditions, and pessimistic scores from overly rigid transcription standards that penalize valid linguistic variations. We introduce Vimarsha, a 100-hour benchmark spanning all 22 scheduled Indian languages, designed to address both distortions. Vimarsha combines demographically diverse on-field recordings with carefully mined in-the-wild audio selected for acoustic difficulty, alongside a lattice of variations framework that encodes multiple valid transcriptions per utterance. Evaluations of 10 state-of-the-art ASR models reveal substantial shifts in model rankings under realistic conditions, geographic and demographic performance disparities, and systematic failure modes across speaking rates and acoustic environments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Vimarsha，一个覆盖印度全部22种官方语言的100小时语音识别基准，旨在同时纠正现有基准过于乐观和过于悲观的两类偏差，并揭示真实条件下ASR模型的性能变化。
AI.motivation: 现有印度语言ASR评测存在系统性偏差：干净可控音频导致分数偏乐观，而过于严格的转写标准惩罚合法语言变体导致分数偏悲观。
AI.method: 构建100小时基准Vimarsha，涵盖22种印度官方语言；结合人口多样化的实地录音与按声学难度筛选的野外音频；采用“变体格”框架，为每句话编码多个有效转写；评测10个先进ASR模型。
AI.result: 在现实条件下，模型排名发生显著变化；出现地理和人口统计层面的性能差异；在语速和声学环境方面存在系统性失败模式。
AI.conclusion: Vimarsha能够更真实地评估印度语言ASR，暴露现有基准偏差和模型鲁棒性问题，为更公平、更贴近实际的语音识别评测提供新标准。

title: InsertAnything: Generalizable Contact-Rich Precision Insertion from Simulation to Reality
summary: Contact-rich precision insertion is a key manipulation skill in robotic assembly. Tight clearances make insertion more sensitive to alignment errors and prone to collisions and jamming, while variations in geometry and clearance across parts further complicate policy reuse. We present a reinforcement learning framework that trains insertion policies entirely in simulation for direct deployment without real-world demonstrations or policy fine-tuning. By combining target poses with compact three-dimensional fingertip force feedback, the policy learns to search for alignment and correct its motion despite errors in the estimated hole position. A decoupled gated reward coordinates alignment and insertion. Force-signal smoothing and state-independent standard deviations stabilize the learning process. The resulting policies perform real-world insertion across multiple hole geometries with a minimum nominal clearance of 0.02 mm and improve success while reducing peak contact forces under hole-position errors. Cross-clearance and cross-geometry evaluations further confirm policy generalization. The system achieved the first perfect score of 20/20 on ManipulationNet's peg-in-hole benchmark under its Human-in-the-Loop protocol, with fully autonomous insertion motions. A single policy trained only on a simulated hexagonal insertion task achieved an overall success rate of 95.0% across eight unseen real-world insertion tasks. These results show that learning entirely in simulation can yield precision insertion skills that can be deployed directly and reused across real-world tasks. The project website (https://mzhsoul.github.io/InsertAnything/) provides open-source simulation and real-robot experiment scripts, assets, and trained checkpoints.

AI.tldr: 提出一种完全在仿真中训练的强化学习框架，用于接触丰富的精密插入任务，无需真实演示或策略微调即可直接部署。
AI.motivation: 紧密间隙使机器人插入对对齐误差敏感，容易发生碰撞和卡死；零件几何与间隙变化又使策略复用困难。
AI.method: 在仿真中训练插入策略，结合目标位姿与紧凑的三维指尖力反馈，使策略在孔位估计有误差时搜索对齐并修正运动；采用解耦门控奖励协调对齐与插入，并通过力信号平滑和状态无关标准差稳定学习。
AI.result: 真实世界插入覆盖多种孔几何，最小标称间隙0.02 mm，在孔位误差下提高成功率并降低峰值接触力，跨间隙与跨几何评估显示泛化能力；在ManipulationNet的销孔基准Human-in-the-Loop协议下取得首个20/20满分，且插入动作完全自主；仅用仿真六边形插入任务训练的单一策略在八个未见真实插入任务上总体成功率达95.0%。
AI.conclusion: 完全在仿真中学习可产生可直接部署并跨真实任务复用的精密插入技能；项目网站提供开源仿真、真实机器人实验脚本、资产及训练检查点。

title: Bridge3D: Enabling Vision-Language-Action Models to See and Act in 3D
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable generalization in robotic manipulation via large-scale multimodal pretraining. However, VLA models are mainly trained on 2D-centric observations, which inherently constrains their capacity for precise spatial manipulation. Previous methods enhance 3D awareness by introducing implicit spatial priors, but still lack explicit geometry guidance. In this paper, we propose Bridge3D that integrates both implicit and explicit 3D geometry guidance into pre-trained 2D VLA models, enabling them to ''see'' and ''act'' in 3D. Bridge3D introduces two strategies: 1) Implicit Fusion, which enriches visual tokens with features from 3D foundation models to improve ''seeing'' in 3D; 2) Explicit Conditioning, which integrates action denoising with an explicit 3D semantic field to achieve ''acting'' in 3D. Furthermore, we utilize the proposed layer-wise linear probing to improve learning efficiency. Experiments show that Bridge3D achieves superior performance against state-of-the-art methods. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, Bridge3D exceeds $π_0$ by 14.0 percentage points, while in real-world experiments, it outperforms Spatial Forcing by 11.7 percentage points. These results demonstrate Bridge3D's strong capabilities in high-precision and spatial-sensitive manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Bridge3D，将隐式和显式3D几何引导集成到预训练2D VLA模型，使其在3D中“看”和“动”。
AI.motivation: VLA模型主要在2D观测上训练，限制了精确空间操作能力。现有方法引入隐式空间先验，但缺乏显式几何引导。
AI.method: 两种策略：1) 隐式融合，用3D基础模型特征丰富视觉token以改善3D“看”；2) 显式条件化，将动作去噪与显式3D语义场结合以实现3D“动”。还采用层线性探测提高学习效率。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0上超过π0 14.0个百分点；真实实验中超过Spatial Forcing 11.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Bridge3D在高精度和空间敏感操作任务中表现出强大能力。

title: Positive Pair Geometry Matters: Optimal Transport for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
summary: Contrastive self-supervised learning has achieved strong performance by learning representations from multiple augmented views of the same image. However, most existing methods construct positive pairs using independently sampled stochastic augmentations, which may alter semantic content and ignore the intrinsic geometry of the data distribution. In this work, we propose OTCLR, an optimal transport-aware framework for contrastive learning representations that generates geometry-consistent positive samples. Instead of directly contrasting two randomly augmented views, we construct intermediate views between the original image and its augmented variants through entropic optimal-transport displacement interpolation. These transport-interpolated samples serve as positive views that better preserve image structure while explicitly modeling spatial distributional geometry. To further promote smooth representation learning, we evaluate auxiliary Sinkhorn regularization terms that encourage transport-interpolated views to remain consistent with their endpoint images. The proposed method can be incorporated into standard contrastive learning pipelines without modifying the encoder architecture. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets show that our approach improves representation quality and transfer learning performance compared with conventional augmentation-based contrastive learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OTCLR，一种基于最优传输感知的对比自监督学习框架，通过在原始图像与增强图像之间生成几何一致的中间视图作为正样本，提升表征质量与迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 现有对比学习方法通常使用独立采样的随机增强构造正样本对，可能改变语义内容，并忽略数据分布的内在几何结构。
AI.method: OTCLR利用熵最优传输位移插值，在原始图像和其增强变体之间构建中间视图作为正样本，以更好保留图像结构并显式建模空间分布几何；同时引入辅助Sinkhorn正则项，使传输插值视图与端点图像保持一致；该方法可直接融入标准对比学习流程，无需修改编码器架构。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，与传统的基于增强的对比学习基线相比，该方法提升了表征质量和迁移学习性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过最优传输生成几何一致的正样本并加入Sinkhorn正则，能够有效改进对比学习表征，且易于集成到现有框架中。

title: From Articles to Publishers: Aggregating Language Model Predictions for News Source Reliability Inference
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems (TCSS)
summary: Traditionally, the reliability of news publishers is assessed by expert organisations that evaluate editorial practices, transparency and factual standards at source. When this process is translated into a computational approach, the problem is often formulated at the level of individual articles, with models being trained on a set of pre-labelled articles and their performance being evaluated in a test phase. In this work, we investigate news source reliability inference as a source-level prediction problem. We propose a two-stage framework in which transformer-based language models first estimate the reliability of individual articles and subsequently aggregate article-level predictions to infer the reliability of previously unseen publishers. To approximate realistic deployment conditions, we enforce a strict publisher-disjoint evaluation protocol, ensuring that no publisher appears in both training and test sets. Experiments on 19,476 political news articles from 439 English-language publishers labeled with NewsGuard reliability ratings show that aggregation substantially improves robustness and performance, increasing accuracy from approximately 0.60 at the article level to 0.69 at the publisher level. Finally, we analyze how prediction errors vary across political orientations, revealing statistically significant associations between political leaning and misclassification patterns. Overall, our findings show that publisher reliability can be inferred from aggregated textual signals alone, supporting scalable and content-based approaches to automated news source assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究将新闻来源可靠性评估转化为来源级预测问题，提出两阶段框架：先用Transformer模型预测单篇文章可靠性，再聚合文章级预测以推断未见发布者的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统新闻发布者可靠性评估依赖专家组织，计算化方法通常按单篇文章建模，难以直接评估整个来源；本文希望实现更贴近实际部署的来源级可靠性推断。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：基于Transformer的语言模型先估计单篇文章可靠性，再聚合文章级预测得到发布者级可靠性。采用严格的发布者不相交评估协议，确保训练集和测试集中没有相同发布者。使用19,476篇政治新闻、439个英文发布者及NewsGuard可靠性评级进行实验。
AI.result: 聚合显著提升稳健性和性能，准确率从文章级约0.60提升到发布者级约0.69。还分析了不同政治倾向下的预测错误，发现政治倾向与误分类模式之间存在统计显著关联。
AI.conclusion: 仅依靠聚合文本信号即可推断发布者可靠性，说明基于内容的自动化新闻来源评估具有可扩展性和可行性。

title: When Residualization Helps an Audit: Format Effects, Slice Gains, and Their Limits
summary: Evaluation scores used around LLM systems -- including reward models, rerankers, and LLM judges -- can track surface form instead of the quality they claim to measure. When presented with a terse correct solution and a commented buggy solution for the same MBPP problem, a public preference reward model selects the correct one no better than a coin flip (0.507). Subtracting the predictable surface component from such scores is increasingly common, but removal alone does not yield a more valid measurement: the removed component may carry construct-relevant signal, and residualization cannot tell which is which. Under designed interventions -- unit-test labels with comment-only edits -- residualization attenuates the reward model's format effects by about 0.12 on both correct and buggy code, while the correct-versus-buggy margins move by less than 0.01. In observational NLI and QA settings, we freeze a held-out replication before scoring and re-evaluate it using labels from disjoint annotators; this supports only a narrower conclusion: better agreement with the construct labels on a pre-declared slice where a surface-only predictor errs, not a repaired score. Full-population agreement falls in every observational setting with a reported positive slice gain, and within-question ranking falls in every such QA setting. When construct and surface features are entangled, residualization can decorrelate a score while degrading construct alignment, and, in a controlled model, configurations just as damaging to construct alignment pass every pre-adjustment check, so no committed gate is a guarantee. We assemble these distinctions into a reporting protocol whose outcomes, refusal included, state what an adjusted score may be claimed to show: an audit-time diagnostic reported beside the construct-alignment cost it incurs, never a replacement for the raw score.

AI.tldr: 论文指出LLM评估分数（奖励模型、重排序器、LLM裁判等）可能追踪表面形式而非真实质量；仅靠残差化去除表面成分不能保证测量更有效，甚至可能损害构念对齐。作者提出报告协议：调整后分数只能作为审计时诊断，并须附上构念对齐代价，不能替代原始分数。
AI.motivation: 奖励模型、重排序器和LLM裁判等评估分数常受格式、注释等表面特征影响，而现有做法通过残差化减去可预测的表面成分。但作者质疑：被移除的成分可能包含构念相关信号，残差化无法区分二者，因此“去除表面成分”未必产生更有效的测量。
AI.method: 设计干预实验：在MBPP中用单元测试标签与仅注释编辑，比较残差化对格式效应和正确/错误边际的影响；在NLI和QA观测设置中，预先冻结留出复制，并使用不重叠标注者的标签重新评估；再用受控模型检验预调整检查能否保证构念对齐。
AI.result: 公开偏好奖励模型在简洁正确解与注释错误解之间选择正确的准确率仅0.507；残差化将格式效应约降低0.12，但正确与错误的边际变化小于0.01。观测设置中仅支持较窄结论：在预声明且表面预测器出错的切片上构念标签一致性更好，而非修复了分数；整体一致性在所有观测设置中下降，QA中问题内排序也下降。残差化可能使分数去相关同时损害构念对齐；受控模型中，对构念对齐同样有害的配置可通过所有预调整检查。
AI.conclusion: 调整后的分数不应被视为原始分数的替代品，而应作为审计时诊断，并同时报告其所造成的构念对齐成本。作者提出一种报告协议，其结论（包括拒绝给出结论）应明确说明调整后分数可以声称什么。

title: FedMust: Semi-supervised Multi-task Student-Teacher Federated Learning for Multi-organ CT Segmentation
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publication at the 7th International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2026)
summary: Multi-organ segmentation using deep learning requires large amounts of annotated patient data; however, institutions often lack sufficiently large and diverse annotated datasets. Privacy constraints further prevent institutions from sharing patient data to overcome this limitation. Moreover, due to the labor-intensive nature of annotation and the scarcity of diverse expertise, institutions typically have labels for only a small portion of their local data, leaving the larger unlabeled portion unused. In this work, we propose a flexible semi-supervised federated multi-task student-teacher framework that leverages federated learning (FL) to improve multi-organ segmentation using both labeled and unlabeled data across participating sites. At each communication round, the proposed framework initiates local training, where clients with labels for the same task form a federation to produce an aggregated teacher model. The resulting teachers generate task-specific features for all data at each client. Subsequently, all clients form a second federation to train a multi-task student model with a shared encoder and task-specific decoders that replicate the teacher-generated features across all segmentation tasks. The aggregated student model is then used to update the local teachers and initiate the next training round. Extensive experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with local and federated single-organ models, yielding an average performance gain of 13 percent across clients. The experiments also demonstrated the impact of multi-task learning and unlabeled data and the applicability of the framework in relaxing labeled-data requirements for client participation. The code is available at https://github.com/AshknMrd/FedMust.

AI.tldr: 提出一种灵活的半监督联邦多任务学生-教师框架，利用联邦学习跨站点使用有标签和无标签数据提升多器官分割性能。
AI.motivation: 多器官分割依赖大量标注数据，但机构常缺乏足够多样化的标注数据；隐私限制阻碍数据共享；标注耗时且专业稀缺，导致大量无标签数据未被利用。
AI.method: 提出半监督联邦多任务学生-教师框架。每轮通信：有相同任务标签的客户端组成联邦，训练聚合教师模型；教师为各客户端所有数据生成任务特定特征；所有客户端再组成第二联邦，训练共享编码器和任务特定解码器的多任务学生模型，以复现教师特征；聚合学生模型更新本地教师并进入下一轮。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法优于本地和联邦单器官模型，客户端平均性能提升13%。实验还展示了多任务学习和无标签数据的影响，以及该框架在放宽客户端参与所需标注数据要求方面的适用性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效利用无标签数据和多任务学习，在联邦环境下提升多器官分割，并降低对标注数据的依赖。

title: Patch-to-Global: Random Patch Diffusion for Globally Consistent Megapixel Artifact Inpainting in Whole Slide Images
summary: Although deep learning has advanced Whole Slide Image (WSI) Analysis, tissue artifacts like bubbles and folds often cause silent failures by concealing essential morphology. Current pathology image restoration methods are mostly restricted to small patches, struggling to maintain global structural coherence at a megapixel scale. We introduce RestorePath, a framework for globally consistent megapixel scale inpainting that reconstructs diagnostic structures in histological image to prevent incorrect high-confidence predictions and lower error rates. Our model utilizes a Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) conditioned on Pathology Foundation Model (PFM) embeddings, integrating Large Kernel Attention (LKA) to manage long-range dependencies during random patch diffusion. Enhanced by Distance-Weighted Interpolation (DWI) and an Adaptive Guidance Scale (AGS), RestorePath ensures structural consistency and fidelity by modulating information from surrounding patches. Evaluations across TCGA-BRCA, BACH, and Camelyon16 datasets for images ranging from 512 to 4608 pixels demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in maintaining histological consistency. RestorePath significantly improves downstream Computational Pathology (CP) tasks, outperforming both raw artifact images and the conventional Detect-and-Discard (D&D) approach. The code is available at https://github.com/PathfinderLab/RestorePath

AI.tldr: 提出RestorePath，一个基于潜在扩散模型和病理基础模型嵌入的全局一致百万像素级组织图像修复框架，用于修复气泡、折叠等伪影，提升下游计算病理任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有病理图像修复方法多局限于小图像块，难以在百万像素尺度保持全局结构一致性；组织伪影会掩盖关键形态，导致模型高置信度错误预测。
AI.method: RestorePath利用潜在扩散模型，条件于病理基础模型嵌入，集成大核注意力（LKA）处理随机块扩散中的长程依赖，并采用距离加权插值（DWI）和自适应引导尺度（AGS）调节周围图像块信息，确保结构一致性与保真度。
AI.result: 在TCGA-BRCA、BACH和Camelyon16数据集上，图像尺寸从512到4608像素，RestorePath在保持组织学一致性方面达到最先进性能，并显著改善下游计算病理任务，优于原始伪影图像和传统“检测并丢弃”（D&D）方法。
AI.conclusion: RestorePath能够实现全局一致的百万像素级组织图像修复，重建诊断结构，防止高置信度错误预测并降低错误率，代码已开源。

title: TACIT: Tactile Contact Supervision for Spatial Attention in Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Visuomotor policies trained from a few demonstrations may reproduce demonstrated trajectories without reliably following changes in object position. Existing approaches with explicit attention typically obtain spatial priors from human annotation or visual models. We introduce TACIT (tactile contact informs attention), which uses measured tactile contacts from teleoperated demonstrations to supervise spatial attention without additional point annotation. Gaussian targets over preceding camera point clouds supervise an attention head whose pooled output conditions a visuotactile diffusion policy. Targets are used only during training; tactile observations remain inputs at inference. In the primary real-robot benchmark, with ten demonstrations per task and five demonstrated placement regions, TACIT achieves 66.7% success on ball placement and 73.3% on peg insertion, compared with 10.0% and 20.0% for input-matched 3D visuotactile fusion and 20.0% and 43.3% for vision-only DP3. TACIT enters the 150 mm palm-to-object approach region within 12 seconds in all 30 trials per task; all remaining failures occur after arrival. Across three training seeds on real ball and simulated peg, TACIT outperforms input-matched fusion and an architecture-matched control without explicit attention supervision, supporting the contribution of supervision beyond branch capacity. Pre-contact and contact-time supervision show no consistent ordering. These results demonstrate that measured tactile contact provides effective spatial supervision for approach behavior from few demonstrations within the evaluated workspace.

AI.tldr: 提出TACIT，用遥操作演示中的触觉接触信号监督空间注意力，无需额外点标注；注意力汇聚输出条件化视觉-触觉扩散策略。真实机器人上仅10次演示，球放置和插销成功率显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 少样本视觉运动策略易复现轨迹但不能可靠跟随物体位置变化；现有显式注意力依赖人工标注或视觉模型获得空间先验。
AI.method: 利用遥操作演示中测得的触觉接触，在前序相机点云上生成高斯目标，监督注意力头；其池化输出条件化视觉-触觉扩散策略。监督仅训练时使用，推理时仍以触觉观测为输入。
AI.result: 在每任务10次演示、5个放置区域的真实机器人基准：球放置66.7%、插销73.3%；输入匹配3D视觉-触觉融合为10.0%和20.0%；纯视觉DP3为20.0%和43.3%。每任务30次试验均在12秒内进入150mm掌-物接近区域，剩余失败均发生在到达后。三个种子下优于输入匹配融合和无显式注意力监督的架构匹配控制。接触前与接触时监督无一致排序。
AI.conclusion: 在这些工作空间内，测得的触觉接触可为少演示下的接近行为提供有效空间监督。

title: From Semantic Decisions to Feasible Trajectories: Self-Evolving LLM-Guided Optimal Control for Narrow-Space Parking
summary: Autonomous parking in nonconvex and narrow environments remains challenging. Although optimal-control methods can explicitly enforce vehicle dynamics and collision constraints, nonconvexity compromises solver robustness and can cause failures. Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic reasoning capabilities, but directly generating dense trajectories makes it difficult to guarantee physical feasibility. We introduce SE-LLM-OCP, a unified framework in which LLMs make high-level discrete maneuver decisions, while an optimal-control module enforces low-level vehicle dynamics and collision constraints. Online, the LLM proposes sparse maneuver plans, decomposing the parking task into a sequence of short-horizon trajectory-optimization problems. A low-level solver then sequentially solves optimal-control problems. If the solver fails, the LLM aggregates failure evidence from the solver and validation stages to guide replanning. Offline, SE-LLM-OCP automatically evolves a structured decision-making knowledge base from scratch, driven by accumulated online failures. We validate our proposed framework in simulation on a car-like vehicle model and on a differential-drive robot. Our experimental results show that SE-LLM-OCP enables safer autonomous parking in narrow scenarios and demonstrates transfer of the same maneuver representation to a different kinematic platform.

AI.tldr: 提出SE-LLM-OCP统一框架，由LLM负责高层离散机动决策，最优控制模块负责底层车辆动力学与碰撞约束。在线将泊车任务分解为短时域轨迹优化，求解失败时由LLM聚合失败证据进行重规划；离线则从在线失败中自动演化结构化决策知识库。仿真在类车模型和差速驱动机器人上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 非凸狭窄环境下的自主泊车仍具挑战。最优控制方法虽能显式处理动力学与碰撞约束，但非凸性损害求解器鲁棒性并可能导致失败；LLM虽具强语义推理能力，但直接生成密集轨迹难以保证物理可行性。
AI.method: 提出SE-LLM-OCP：LLM进行高层离散机动决策，最优控制模块保证低层动力学与碰撞约束。在线阶段，LLM提出稀疏机动计划，将泊车任务分解为一系列短时域轨迹优化问题，并由低层求解器顺序求解；若求解失败，LLM聚合来自求解器和验证阶段的失败证据以引导重规划。离线阶段，系统由累积的在线失败驱动，从零自动演化结构化决策知识库。
AI.result: 在类车车辆模型和差速驱动机器人上的仿真实验表明，SE-LLM-OCP能在狭窄场景中实现更安全的自主泊车，并证明相同机动表示可迁移到不同运动学平台。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM的高层语义推理与最优控制的低层物理约束相结合，可提升非凸狭窄环境下自主泊车的安全性与鲁棒性；离线知识库演化与跨平台机动表示迁移进一步增强了框架的适应能力。

title: Touch2Robot: Robot Touch in the Human Demonstration Loop
summary: Human demonstrations offer a scalable way to collect manipulation data, but their contacts may be unstable or infeasible when transferred to a robot hand. Collecting demonstrations directly on the target robot avoids this mismatch, but substantially increases the cost of data collection. To address this trade-off, we present \textbf{Touch2Robot}, a framework that lets humans collect demonstrations while seeing how the target robot hand would contact the object. We capture human hand motion, tactile-glove measurements, and object motion during human manipulation. These recordings guide object-specific RL policies to reproduce the demonstrated object motion while favoring contacts consistent with the recorded human touch. We distill the learned behaviors into a unified real-time retargeter that maps incoming human observations and object geometry to robot hand configurations. During collection, the predicted robot configuration is synchronized with the tracked object pose in simulation to reconstruct robot-object contacts, which are visualized to help the demonstrator adapt subsequent interactions to the target hand. Across four real-world tasks, Touch2Robot improves average real-robot replay completion from 37.9\% to 72.1\% over visual-only feedback, while reducing the collection time per replay-successful demonstration from 58.6~s to 18.2~s. Reconstructed target-hand contacts achieve 44.2\% F1 against real-robot tactile measurements, and policies trained on Touch2Robot demonstrations improve downstream Diffusion Policy performance by 29.1 percentage points over visual-only feedback. These results show that bringing robot touch into the human demonstration loop improves both the quality and efficiency of scalable dexterous data collection. \textit{Project webpage: \href{https://Touch2Robot.github.io/}{https://Touch2Robot.github.io/}.}

AI.tldr: Touch2Robot 让人类在采集操作演示时看到目标机器人手的接触情况，从而提升机器人手数据采集的质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 人类演示可扩展采集操作数据，但人类接触迁移到机器人手时可能不稳定或不可行；直接在目标机器人上采集又成本过高。
AI.method: 采集人手运动、触觉手套测量和物体运动；用这些记录引导物体特定的强化学习策略复现物体运动并偏好与人类触觉一致的接触；蒸馏为统一实时重定向器，将人类观测和物体几何映射为机器人手配置；采集中同步仿真中的机器人配置与物体位姿，重建并可视化机器人-物体接触，帮助演示者调整后续交互。
AI.result: 在四个真实任务中，真实机器人回放完成率从仅视觉反馈的37.9%提升至72.1%；每次回放成功演示的采集时间从58.6秒降至18.2秒；重建目标手接触相对真实机器人触觉测量的F1为44.2%；用Touch2Robot演示训练的策略使下游Diffusion Policy性能提升29.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将机器人触觉引入人类演示循环，可同时提升可扩展灵巧数据采集的质量和效率。

title: The Visual Target Matters: Learning across the Visual Hierarchy for Brain-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Brain-to-image retrieval seeks to identify the visual stimulus that elicited a non-invasive neural response. Candidate images are typically represented by pretrained vision models, whose internal representations vary in abstraction across depth. Existing methods usually train the neural encoder to recover a fixed final-layer visual target. Under this formulation, the visual hierarchy is reduced to a single prescribed endpoint, preventing representations at other depths from directly shaping the visual target. This limitation motivates learning how information across visual depths should contribute to the retrieval target. To this end, we introduce NeuroGlyph, which learns a trial-independent visual target from multiple depths of a frozen visual backbone. NeuroGlyph decomposes the target into factor-specific subspaces. Each subspace learns an image-conditioned allocation over visual depth. The resulting subspaces are fused into a single embedding for retrieval. Across THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG, NeuroGlyph outperforms final-layer supervision in all controlled comparisons. It also surpasses the post hoc best fixed-layer oracle in three of four comparisons. Parameter-matched ablations support both factorized target construction and image-conditioned depth allocation. Under comparable 200-way retrieval protocols, NeuroGlyph achieves the strongest system-level performance in six of eight reported metrics. These results support learning retrieval targets across the visual hierarchy rather than prescribing one visual depth.

AI.tldr: 提出NeuroGlyph，用于脑到图像检索。它从冻结视觉骨干的多个深度学习逐试次无关的视觉目标，并按因子分解为子空间，每个子空间学习图像条件下的深度分配，再融合为检索嵌入。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常让神经编码器恢复固定的最终层视觉目标，将视觉层级压缩为单一端点，使其他深度的表征无法直接影响视觉目标。因此，需要学习不同视觉深度信息应如何贡献于检索目标。
AI.method: NeuroGlyph从冻结视觉骨干的多个深度学习试验无关的视觉目标；将目标分解为因子特定子空间；每个子空间学习图像条件下的视觉深度分配；融合各子空间形成单一嵌入用于检索。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG和THINGS-MEG上，NeuroGlyph在所有受控比较中优于最终层监督；在四项比较中的三项超过事后最佳固定层oracle；参数匹配消融支持因子化目标构建和图像条件深度分配；在可比的200路检索协议下，八项指标中六项取得最强系统级性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，应跨视觉层级学习检索目标，而不是预设单一视觉深度。

title: Estimation and Control of Tensegrity Manipulator Kinematics based on Strut Inclination Angles
summary: Unlike conventional rigid-link robots defined by discrete joints, continuum robots pose a fundamental challenge for expressing their complex continuous bending configurations for closed-loop control. Several modelling approaches have been proposed for conventional continuum robots, but tensegrity-based continuum robots remain largely open. Moreover, many of these approaches assume a continuous elastic backbone and are therefore not directly applicable to tensegrity manipulators, whose bodies are networks of rigid struts and tensioned cables. This work presents a reduced-order model for shape and posture control of a tensegrity-based continuum manipulator. The manipulator is modelled as a serially connected parallel-link mechanism. The proposed method is formulated as an optimization problem that uses geometric constraints of the tensegrity structure together with information from the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensors embedded in the strut elements. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first experimental demonstration of a real-time IMU-based shape estimation method on a full-scale tensegrity manipulator and demonstrates posture control using a simple Proportional-Integral (PI) controller. The results show that the proposed method can estimate the shape of both single-module tensegrity structures and multi-module tensegrity manipulators from arbitrary static configurations and achieve desired postures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于张拉整体连续机械臂形状与姿态控制的降阶模型，将机械臂建模为串联并联连杆机构，结合几何约束与IMU数据，实现实时形状估计与PI姿态控制。
AI.motivation: 传统刚性连杆机器人由离散关节定义，连续机器人复杂连续弯曲构型难以表达并用于闭环控制；现有建模方法多假设连续弹性主干，不适用于由刚性杆和张力索组成的张拉整体连续机器人。
AI.method: 将张拉整体连续机械臂建模为串联连接的并联连杆机构；构建优化问题，利用张拉整体结构的几何约束和嵌入杆件中的IMU传感器信息进行形状估计；使用简单PI控制器实现姿态控制。
AI.result: 首次在全尺寸张拉整体机械臂上实验演示基于IMU的实时形状估计方法并实现姿态控制；结果表明该方法可从任意静态构型估计单模块和多模块张拉整体结构的形状，并达到期望姿态。
AI.conclusion: 所提降阶模型可支持张拉整体连续机械臂的形状与姿态闭环控制，验证了基于IMU的实时形状估计和PI姿态控制方法的可行性。

title: Relightable 3D Avatar Reconstruction with Semantic-Adaptive Motion-Illumination Responses
summary: Reconstructing expressive and relightable 3D head avatars from monocular videos remains challenging in computer vision, as it requires accurate modeling of both non-rigid facial motion and illumination-dependent appearance. Existing Gaussian avatar methods commonly rely on globally coupled representations, in which Gaussian primitives share a unified motion or illumination response model. Such uniform modeling neglects the distinct motion patterns and material/reflectance properties of different facial semantic regions, thereby limiting fine-grained animation accuracy and reducing relighting plausibility. To address this limitation, we propose SAMIRA, a 3D Gaussian avatar framework for semantic-adaptive motion-illumination response modeling. For motion response modeling, the Semantic-Adaptive Motion Response module rasterizes current-to-reference mesh displacements into a topology-consistent UV space and leverages facial semantics to route displacement features through semantic-specific modulators, predicting localized Gaussian geometric residuals beyond coarse mesh binding. For illumination response modeling, the Semantic-Adaptive Illumination Response module learns compact diffuse and specular response factors for each facial region, allowing Gaussians in different regions to adapt their illumination responses to novel environment lighting. These response factors are incorporated into deferred physically based shading, providing a lightweight approximation of semantic-dependent illumination effects. Extensive experiments on self-reenactment, cross-reenactment, and relighting demonstrate that SAMIRA improves both fine-grained expression reconstruction and relighting realism over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAMIRA，一种用于语义自适应运动-光照响应建模的3D高斯头部化身框架，旨在从单目视频重建富有表现力且可重光照的3D头部化身。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯化身方法通常采用全局耦合表示，使高斯原语共享统一的运动或光照响应模型，忽略了不同面部语义区域在运动模式和材质/反射属性上的差异，限制了细粒度动画精度和重光照合理性。
AI.method: SAMIRA包含两个模块：语义自适应运动响应模块将当前帧到参考帧的网格位移光栅化到拓扑一致的UV空间，并利用面部语义通过语义特定调制器路由位移特征，预测局部高斯几何残差；语义自适应光照响应模块为每个面部区域学习紧凑的漫反射和高光响应因子，使不同区域的高斯能适应新环境光照，并将这些因子融入延迟物理着色中。
AI.result: 在自再现、跨再现和重光照任务上的大量实验表明，SAMIRA在细粒度表情重建和重光照真实感方面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义自适应的运动与光照响应建模能够有效提升3D头部化身的表情动画精度和重光照效果，为表达性和可重光照头部化身重建提供了新框架。

title: MIRA: Real-Time Full-Duplex Human-Robot Interaction for Embodied Companions
summary: Real-time embodied companion interaction requires a robot to infer user intent from streaming speech, generate timely responses, and execute expressive, interruptible motions. Existing systems typically decouple dialogue orchestration from gesture synthesis, relying on offline motion generation from complete audio. This separation leaves open how a deployed robot can dynamically synchronize response content, prosodic timing, and physical safety under incremental inputs and uncertain turn boundaries. We present MIRA, a unified framework for full-duplex embodied companion interaction. Given streaming user speech, dialogue history, and vocal affect, MIRA predicts both the response text and an explicit embodiment cue. Discrete social behaviors (\eg listening, greeting) are mapped to validated robot trajectories, while open-ended speaking is paired with streaming, co-speech motion. This generative motion is governed by a predict-more-than-commit sliding window that provides temporal look-ahead for motion continuity while limiting physical commitment to a short, cancellable prefix. Crucially, we design CORTEX, a dual-timescale interaction policy that manages low-latency streaming and deliberative turn decisions, backed by a robot-side execution layer that enforces physical safety constraints at the control rate. We deploy MIRA on an Astribot S1 humanoid robot. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate competitive audio-motion alignment relative to state-of-the-art motion-generation baselines, while real-robot deployment measurements characterize streaming responsiveness and interruption handling.

AI.tldr: 提出MIRA，一个用于全双工具身陪伴交互的统一框架，可从流式语音、对话历史和语音情感中预测回复文本与具身线索，并生成可中断的共语手势，在Astribot S1人形机器人上部署验证。
AI.motivation: 现有系统通常将对话编排与手势合成解耦，依赖完整音频进行离线动作生成，难以在增量输入和不确定轮次边界下动态同步回复内容、韵律时序与物理安全。
AI.method: MIRA接收流式用户语音、对话历史和语音情感，同时预测回复文本与显式具身线索；离散社交行为映射到已验证机器人轨迹，开放式说话配以流式共语动作；采用predict-more-than-commit滑动窗口提供时序前瞻并仅承诺可取消的短前缀；设计CORTEX双时间尺度交互策略管理低延迟流式与审慎轮次决策，并通过机器人端执行层在控制频率下施加物理安全约束。
AI.result: 在Astribot S1人形机器人上部署；定量评估显示音频-动作对齐效果与最先进动作生成基线相比具有竞争力；真实机器人部署测量刻画了流式响应性和打断处理能力。
AI.conclusion: MIRA能够在增量输入和不确定轮次边界下统一实现回复内容、韵律时序、动作连续性与物理安全的动态同步，支持实时、可打断的具身陪伴交互。

title: Adapting Tree-Structured Speculative Decoding to DeepSeek-V4 for Efficient Inference
summary: Repeated execution of the target model during autoregressive decoding is a major source of LLM inference latency. Unlike linear speculation, which follows a single candidate chain, tree-structured speculation retains multiple branches from shared prefixes; under the same budget, this broader coverage can improve acceptance and efficiency. Adapting it to DeepSeek-V4 is nontrivial: its CSA/HCA online compressed attention concentrates the difficulty on the target-verify side, where branches diverging from a shared prefix compress into different states, breaking cross-branch state consistency. We integrate tree-structured speculative decoding into the DeepSeek-V4-Flash pipeline via branch-aware causal verification, temporary state isolation, and accepted-path state refresh, keeping verification and compressed-state updates consistent across branches. Across budgets D=5 to D=8, batch sizes 1 to 64, and three datasets (GSM8K, MBPP, ShareGPT), tree speculation achieves a higher accepted length than the matched linear configurations in all settings (e.g., at D=8 about 2.83--3.41 versus 2.39--2.84) and improves throughput in nearly all configurations---marginal only at the smallest budget---by up to about 18.5%. More importantly, the gains follow stable, transferable regularities: the relative gain grows with the budget and is most pronounced for less predictable workloads at small-to-medium batch sizes, while beyond a certain budget throughput plateaus and decouples from the still-rising accepted length. These results show that retaining multiple candidate paths under the same budget can effectively improve DeepSeek-V4 decoding efficiency, and offer experience for adapting speculative decoding to future models with compressed, sparse, or structured context representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文将树结构推测解码集成到DeepSeek-V4-Flash推理流程中，通过分支感知因果验证、临时状态隔离和接受路径状态刷新，解决压缩注意力下跨分支状态不一致问题。在多个预算、批量大小和数据集上，树推测相比线性推测获得更高的接受长度，吞吐量最高提升约18.5%，并揭示了增益随预算和负载可预测性变化的规律。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码中反复执行目标模型是LLM推理延迟的主要来源。线性推测仅沿单条候选链，而树结构推测可在相同预算下保留共享前缀的多个分支，扩大覆盖以提高接受率和效率。但将其适配到DeepSeek-V4时，其CSA/HCA在线压缩注意力导致从共享前缀分出的分支压缩为不同状态，破坏跨分支状态一致性，因此需要专门解决该验证侧难题。
AI.method: 通过分支感知因果验证、临时状态隔离和接受路径状态刷新，将树结构推测解码集成到DeepSeek-V4-Flash流水线中，确保跨分支的验证与压缩状态更新保持一致。
AI.result: 在预算D=5至D=8、批量大小1至64及GSM8K、MBPP、ShareGPT三个数据集上，树推测在所有设置下均比匹配的线性配置获得更高接受长度（如D=8时约2.83–3.41对2.39–2.84），并在几乎所有配置中提升吞吐量，最高约18.5%（最小预算下增益微弱）。增益呈现稳定规律：相对增益随预算增大而增加，在中小批量下对可预测性较低的工作负载最显著；超过一定预算后吞吐量趋于平台并与仍在上升的接受长度解耦。
AI.conclusion: 在相同预算下保留多条候选路径能有效提升DeepSeek-V4解码效率，并为未来具有压缩、稀疏或结构化上下文表示的模型适配推测解码提供了经验。

title: Structure Before Sampling: Community-Aware Core-Set Selection for Data-Efficient Text-to-Speech
summary: Text-to-speech (TTS) corpora are costly to record, yet many utterances add little new phonetic information. Core-set selection reduces this cost by choosing a small training subset under a fixed audio-duration budget. We represent a corpus as a phonotactic graph that links each utterance to its most phonemically similar ones, and we first test whether this graph has structure. In Bangla and English corpora, its clustering is 199 and 56 times that of a size-matched random graph, and its modularity is more than twice that of a degree-preserving random graph. We then propose Community Representative, a selector that samples across graph communities and spreads its choices within each one, starting from utterances rich in rare phonemes. At every budget and in both languages, it covers more rare phoneme bigrams than random and entropy-based selection, and this lead holds on held-out utterances. TTS models trained on its 20% core-sets have a significantly lower character error rate (CER) than models trained on equal-duration random or entropy-based subsets in both languages. When all models train for the same number of epochs, the Bangla core-set model also outperforms full-corpus training (3.93% vs. 4.47% CER) with 4.5x less training time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于音位配列图的语音语料核心子集选择方法 Community Representative，在固定音频时长预算下挑选更具音位信息量的样本，以降低 TTS 语料录制与训练成本。
AI.motivation: TTS 语料录制成本高，但许多语音样本提供的新音位信息很少；因此希望在固定音频时长预算下选择一个小规模训练子集，以更低成本获得有效训练数据。
AI.method: 将语料表示为音位配列图，把每条语音连接到音位上最相似的语音；先验证该图具有显著社群结构。随后提出 Community Representative 选择器：在图中不同社群间采样，并在社群内分散选择，优先从富含稀有音位的语音开始。
AI.result: 在孟加拉语和英语语料中，该图的聚类系数分别是同规模随机图的 199 倍和 56 倍，模块度超过度保持随机图的两倍。在每个预算和两种语言中，该方法覆盖的稀有音位二元组均多于随机选择和基于熵的选择，且在留出语音上仍保持优势。用其 20% 核心子集训练的 TTS 模型，在两种语言中 CER 均显著低于等时长随机或熵基子集训练的模型。相同训练轮数下，孟加拉语核心子集模型甚至优于全语料训练，CER 为 3.93% 对 4.47%，训练时间减少 4.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于音位配列图社群结构的核心子集选择能有效提升稀有音位覆盖和 TTS 性能，在降低数据与训练成本的同时，甚至可能超过全语料训练效果。

title: An Unexpected Robot Policy: Early Evaluations of GPT-6 Astra on RoboDojo and Beyond
summary: Embodied AI systems are often organized into System 1 and System 2. System 1 is typically a pretrained policy that generates actions at high frequency, whereas System 2 is often instantiated as a vision-enabled language model for high-level planning. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can act as the policy for robot manipulation without task-specific finetuning. We call this setting LLM as policy. We evaluate three LLMs on all 42 RoboDojo tasks and compare their scores with 40 public policies. Astra and GPT-5.5 use the official 50-episode-per-task protocol; DeepSeek-Flash uses 10 episodes per task. GPT-6 Astra achieves 22.48% average success rate and 28.97 Score over 2,100 trials, ranking above every public entry. Yet GPT-5.5 and DeepSeek-Flash reach only 0.88% and 1.92% average success rate with the same post-processing. We find that Astra exhibits a sharply polarized capability profile. It generalizes well to tasks that require semantic understanding but not high-precision control. In contrast, it performs poorly on tasks that require precision, dynamic control, or complex bimanual coordination. In-context experiments show no aggregate benefit from one-shot demonstrations, while selected interaction traces show within-episode corrections under perturbations. Overall, the evaluated LLMs vary substantially in manipulation performance. Astra stands out and provides initial evidence for the potential of a general-purpose manipulation model, although reliable precision and dynamic control remain limitations in the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了大语言模型能否无需任务特定微调直接作为机器人操作策略，在RoboDojo全部42个任务上对比三个LLM与40个公开策略，发现Astra表现突出但能力两极分化。
