AI.motivation: 具身AI常分为System 1（高频预训练策略）和System 2（视觉语言模型高层规划），作者想探究LLM能否直接充当操作策略，即“LLM as policy”，而无需任务特定微调。
AI.method: 在RoboDojo全部42个任务上评估Astra、GPT-5.5和DeepSeek-Flash三个LLM：Astra与GPT-5.5采用官方每任务50回合协议，DeepSeek-Flash采用每任务10回合；将结果与40个公开策略对比；并进行one-shot演示的上下文实验和扰动下的交互轨迹分析。
AI.result: Astra在2100次试验中平均成功率22.48%、Score 28.97，排名超过所有公开条目；GPT-5.5和DeepSeek-Flash相同后处理下平均成功率仅0.88%和1.92%。Astra能力呈两极分化：语义理解类任务泛化好，但精度、动态控制或复杂双臂协调任务表现差。one-shot演示无总体收益，部分交互轨迹显示扰动下回合内纠正。
AI.conclusion: 所评估LLM在操作性能上差异显著，Astra表现突出，为通用操作模型潜力提供了初步证据，但可靠精度与动态控制仍是该评估设定下的局限。

title: End-to-end Jordanian dialect speech-to-text self-supervised learning framework
summary: Speech-to-text engines are extremely needed nowadays for different applications, representing an essential enabler in human-robot interaction. Still, some languages suffer from the lack of labeled speech data, especially in the Arabic dialects or any low-resource languages. The need for a self-supervised training process and self-training using noisy training is proven to be one of the up-and-coming feasible solutions. This article proposes an end-to-end, transformers-based model with a framework for low-resource languages. In addition, the framework incorporates customized audio-to-text processing algorithms to achieve a highly efficient Jordanian Arabic dialect speech-to-text system. The proposed framework enables ingesting data from many sources, making the ground truth from external sources possible by speeding up the manual annotation process. The framework allows the training process using noisy student training and self-supervised learning to utilize the unlabeled data in both pre- and post-training stages and incorporate multiple types of data augmentation. The proposed self-training approach outperforms the fine-tuned Wav2Vec model by 5% in terms of word error rate reduction. The outcome of this work provides the research community with a Jordanian-spoken data set along with an end-to-end approach to deal with low-resource languages. This is done by utilizing the power of the pretraining, post-training, and injecting noisy labeled and augmented data with minimal human intervention. It enables the development of new applications in the field of Arabic language speech-to-text area like the question-answering systems and intelligent control systems, and it will add human-like perception and hearing sensors to intelligent robots.

AI.tldr: 本文面向低资源语言，尤其是约旦阿拉伯语方言，提出一种端到端、基于Transformer的语音转文本框架，并结合自监督学习、噪声学生训练和数据增强来提升性能。
AI.motivation: 当前语音转文本需求广泛，但阿拉伯语方言等低资源语言缺乏标注语音数据，因此需要利用无标注数据的自监督和自训练方法。
AI.method: 提出端到端Transformer模型及低资源语言框架，包含定制化音频到文本处理算法；支持多源数据接入、加速人工标注、噪声学生训练、自监督学习、预训练与后训练阶段利用无标注数据，以及多种数据增强。
AI.result: 所提出的自训练方法在词错误率上比微调后的Wav2Vec模型降低5%，并提供了一个约旦口语数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低资源语言提供了端到端解决方案，通过预训练、后训练、噪声标注和增强数据，以最少人工干预推进阿拉伯语语音转文本应用，如问答系统、智能控制以及机器人听觉感知。

title: What Makes a Good Medical Image Tokenizer? Rethinking Reconstruction and Generation in Medical Image Tokenization
summary: Latent diffusion models now dominate medical image generation, and every such pipeline rests on a \emph{tokenizer} that compresses images into the latent codes for image generation to operate on. Thereby, the tokenizer choice bounds every downstream task from reconstruction fidelity and generation quality to the representations available for downstream analysis. Yet, medical imaging pipelines routinely utilize tokenizers from natural imaging on the hypothesis that their behavior carries over. However, this is an assumption never tested in the medical imaging regime, where datasets are orders of magnitude smaller and images exhibit far lower inter-sample variance. We present a systematic evaluation of medical image tokenizers evaluating thirty configurations across ten model families on twelve datasets at three compression factors, spanning reconstruction, generation, latent geometry, downstream classification, and memorization. We find that (1) performance on image reconstruction and generation strongly correlate, unlike prior reports on natural images; (2) modern tokenizers use nearly all of their codebook entries, but still leave most of the latent space unused; (3) training-set memorization is mild and is further suppressed by stronger latent space compression; and (4) discrete quantization can largely preserve downstream classification, with lookup-free schemes being the main exception.

AI.tldr: 本文对医学图像分词器进行了系统性评估，覆盖30种配置、10个模型族、12个数据集和3种压缩率，考察重建、生成、潜在空间几何、下游分类和记忆化等维度，揭示了医学图像分词器与自然图像分词器不同的行为规律。
AI.motivation: 潜在扩散模型已成为医学图像生成的主流，而分词器决定了潜在码的质量，进而影响重建、生成及下游任务。然而，医学图像流程常直接沿用自然图像的分词器，假设其行为可以迁移；但医学数据集规模小得多、样本间方差低，这一假设从未在医学图像领域被验证。
AI.method: 在12个医学数据集上，对10个模型族的30种分词器配置，在3种压缩率下进行系统评估，评估维度包括图像重建、生成质量、潜在空间几何、下游分类任务和训练集记忆化。
AI.result: （1）图像重建与生成性能强相关，与自然图像上的先前报道不同；（2）现代分词器几乎用满码本条目，但潜在空间仍有大部分未被利用；（3）训练集记忆化程度较轻，且更强的潜在空间压缩进一步抑制了记忆化；（4）离散量化基本能保持下游分类性能，但无查找（lookup-free）方案是主要例外。
AI.conclusion: 医学图像分词器的行为不能简单从自然图像迁移；分词器选择需在重建、生成、压缩和下游任务间权衡，离散量化通常可行，但无查找方案需谨慎使用。

title: Canonical Procedural Actions: An Auditable Annotation Protocol for Tool-Use Agent Traces
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Includes ancillary files for reproducing the reported analyses
summary: Tool-use agent traces identify messages and API calls, but procedural analyses also need explicit units of action and inspectable links to their evidence. We present Canonical Procedural Actions (CPAs), an annotation protocol that records a procedural function, its first agent-event anchor, the agent events that realize it, and separate contextual evidence. Multiple actions may share a message anchor without an inferred within-message order. A retail case study produces a versioned 24-entry codebook through open induction, recorded consolidation, and successive application audits. Two isolated LLM contexts annotate 32 trajectories disjoint from development at the trajectory level, producing 499 and 491 occurrences with anchor-label overlap A=0.982. Requiring identical context-event references reduces overlap to 0.798. These are structural repeatability measures, not semantic accuracy: 16 of 26 task IDs also occur in development, and historical tool payloads were truncated to 110 characters. Retrospective controls show that collapsing all labels raises overlap to 0.986, while simple endpoint rules reproduce the tool-anchored portion with 0.997 overlap. Assistant-message actions have 0.971 overlap, with a per-label minimum of 0.816. Applying the frozen codebook to 244 further trajectories yields 4,058 records, including eight diagnostic outcomes. The contribution is an explicit, auditable annotation instrument and a case study of its construction and measurement limits; human-reference validity and downstream utility remain to be established.

AI.tldr: 提出 Canonical Procedural Actions (CPAs) 标注协议，用于工具使用智能体轨迹中的程序性动作标注，并报告零售案例中的构建、结构可重复性测量与局限。
AI.motivation: 工具使用 agent traces 能识别消息和 API 调用，但程序性分析还需要显式的动作单元以及可检查的证据链接。
AI.method: 设计 CPAs：记录程序功能、首个 agent-event anchor、实现该动作的 agent events 和独立上下文证据；允许多个动作共享 message anchor 且不推断消息内顺序。通过开放归纳、记录合并和连续应用审计，构建版本化 24 条目 codebook。两个隔离 LLM 上下文标注 32 条未参与开发的轨迹，并将冻结 codebook 应用于 244 条进一步轨迹。
AI.result: 两标注者分别产生 499 和 491 个 occurrence，anchor-label overlap A=0.982；要求相同 context-event 引用时降至 0.798。回溯控制显示，折叠所有标签使重叠升至 0.986；简单端点规则复现 tool-anchored 部分的重叠为 0.997；assistant-message actions 重叠为 0.971，按标签最低为 0.816。应用于 244 条轨迹得到 4,058 条记录，含 8 个诊断结果。局限包括 16/26 task IDs 也出现在开发集、历史工具载荷截断至 110 字符；这些是结构可重复性而非语义准确率。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是显式、可审计的标注工具，以及对其构建和测量局限的案例研究；人类参考效度和下游效用仍待验证。

title: Smoothness as a Constraint for Stable Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Embodied AI systems, particularly humanoid robots deployed in real world scenarios require whole-body control policies that are both task-responsive and physically smooth. However, smoothness is not uniform across the body: lower body must remain sufficiently reactive, while the upper body must be tightly regulated to preserve stability. Existing reinforcement learning approaches typically impose smoothness through auxiliary terms in the reward function, which compete with task objectives, treating the body as uniform and provide no direct control over the physical quantities responsible for smooth behavior. We introduce DeCap (Decoupled Constraint-aware policy), a constrained reinforcement learning algorithm that decouples whole-body smoothness into separate upper- and lower-body constraint groups, each formulates smoothness as explicit constraints on physical motion limits. To improve constraint satisfaction near feasibility boundaries, DeCap incorporates a bounded barrier penalty that activates proactively as limits are approached and remains bounded at the constraint limit. On real-world humanoid whole-body control task, DeCap reduces upper-body action rate by 2.50x and acceleration by 2.18x relative to reward-based smoothness policies, while also improving lower-body smoothness and reducing transient motion. We demonstrate that a fixed set of smoothness constraints transfers across diverse terrains, alleviating the need of extensive reward tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出DeCap，一种解耦约束感知的约束强化学习算法，将人形机器人全身平滑性拆分为上下半身独立约束，在真实全身控制任务中显著提升平滑性并减少奖励调参。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习通常通过奖励函数中的辅助项实现平滑，会与任务目标竞争，且将全身统一处理，无法直接控制导致平滑行为的物理量，难以兼顾下半身响应性与上半身稳定性。
AI.method: DeCap采用约束强化学习，将全身平滑性解耦为上半身和下半身两组独立约束，每组将平滑性建模为对物理运动极限的显式约束；并引入有界障碍惩罚，在接近约束边界前主动激活，且在约束极限处保持有界。
AI.result: 在真实人形机器人全身控制任务中，相比基于奖励的平滑策略，DeCap将上半身动作速率降低2.50倍、加速度降低2.18倍，同时改善下半身平滑性并减少瞬态运动；固定约束集可跨多种地形迁移，减少大量奖励调参需求。
AI.conclusion: 解耦约束感知方法能有效实现人形机器人全身平滑控制，兼顾任务响应与物理平滑，并具备跨地形泛化能力，为替代奖励塑形提供可行方案。

title: ARSTAG: An Agentic Real2Sim2Real System for Task-Specific Robot Data Generation
comment: 12 pages, 15 figures and tables. Project webpage: https://boweili666.github.io/ARSTAG/
summary: Adapting visuomotor policies to new manipulation tasks often requires substantial manual engineering or teleoperated data collection. Simulation can provide task-specific data at scale, but constructing the scene, designing expert behavior, and configuring data generation still require significant per-task effort. We present ARSTAG, an agentic Real2Sim2Real system that turns a single RGB image and a natural-language instruction directly into robot policy-learning data. A hierarchy of language agents constructs a task-scoped simulation scene, generates robot-feasible demonstrations, and expands the training distribution through task-consistent randomization, while a coordinator agent manages cross-stage feedback and recovery. Across seven manipulation tasks spanning grasping, placement, and stacking, the ARSTAG-generated demonstrations enable sim-to-real transfer of three visuomotor policy architectures to a dual-arm robot, with pi0.5 achieving an average real-world success rate of 74.6%. Ablations show that task-consistent randomization substantially improves robustness, and policy performance increases with generated dataset size. Project webpage: https://boweili666.github.io/ARSTAG/.

AI.tldr: 提出 ARSTAG——一个智能体化的 Real2Sim2Real 系统，可从单张 RGB 图像和自然语言指令直接生成机器人策略学习数据，并实现仿真到真机的迁移。
AI.motivation: 将视觉运动策略迁移到新操作任务通常依赖大量人工工程或遥操作数据采集；仿真虽能规模化提供任务数据，但场景搭建、专家行为设计与数据生成配置仍需逐任务投入大量人力。
AI.method: 采用分层语言智能体架构：自动构建任务范围内的仿真场景、生成机器人可行的示范数据，并通过任务一致性随机化扩展训练分布；由协调智能体负责跨阶段反馈与失败恢复，形成从真实图像到仿真再到真实的闭环流程。
AI.result: 在涵盖抓取、放置与堆叠的七项操作任务上，ARSTAG 生成的示范数据使三种视觉运动策略架构成功迁移至双臂机器人，其中 pi0.5 平均真实世界成功率达 74.6%；消融实验表明任务一致性随机化显著提升鲁棒性，且策略性能随生成数据集规模增大而提升。
AI.conclusion: ARSTAG 证明仅凭单张图像与语言指令即可自动化生成高质量任务数据并支撑 sim-to-real 策略学习，减少逐任务人工工程，且数据规模与随机化策略是关键性能因素。

title: LLJ Cards: Best practices for the Use of LLMs as Judges
summary: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a popular alternative for evaluation. Often referred to as LLMs as judges (LLJs), these systems have been widely adopted by researchers and practitioners across a broad range of measurement tasks, driven by their strong performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness relative to human judgment. However, a growing body of work has shown that the use of LLJs raise concerns about their validity and reliability as evaluators. Existing efforts to address these challenges have largely focused on developing bias-mitigation techniques and refining prompting strategies. While these approaches represent an important step forward, they primarily offer technical fixes and leave a more fundamental challenge unaddressed: the lack of standardized, transparent, and reproducible evaluation practices. In this paper, we introduce LLJ Cards, a framework that synthesizes best practices from measurement theory, natural language generation, and machine learning literature into practical guidelines for LLJ-based evaluations. While LLJs offer a promising path toward scalable evaluation, their effective use requires grounding in rigorous evaluation principles to ensure validity, reliability, and reproducibility. LLJ Cards addresses this need by providing a structured framework for applying these principles in the design and reporting of automated evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LLJ Cards 框架，旨在为基于大语言模型作为评测者（LLJ）的自动化评估提供标准化、透明且可复现的实践指南。
AI.motivation: LLM 作为评测者因可扩展、低成本而被广泛采用，但其效度和信度受到质疑；现有研究多聚焦于偏差缓解和提示策略等技术性修补，缺乏标准化、透明和可复现的评估实践。
AI.method: 提出 LLJ Cards 框架，综合测量理论、自然语言生成和机器学习文献中的最佳实践，形成用于 LLJ 评估设计和报告的具体指南。
AI.result: LLJ Cards 为在自动化评估的设计与报告中应用效度、信度和可复现性原则提供了结构化框架。
AI.conclusion: LLJ 虽有潜力实现可扩展评估，但必须建立在严谨的评估原则之上；LLJ Cards 通过提供结构化指导来满足这一需求。

title: LegendBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Legend Understanding with Counterfactual Interventions
summary: Legends are fundamental to chart understanding, as reliable interpretation requires correctly binding legend entries to corresponding visual marks. While vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to chart understanding, their legend understanding is poorly diagnosed by aggregate accuracy, which can be satisfied by superficial shortcuts and confound legend-specific errors with other reasoning failures. To enable fine-grained diagnosis and controlled testing, we introduce LegendBench, a parametric benchmark and generation pipeline that produces targeted legend-centric test cases. LegendBench contributes (1) a capability-task taxonomy spanning legend parsing, legend grounding, legend-conditioned reasoning, and legend-aware abstention to localize failures, and (2) counterfactual group generation, where each base chart yields multiple variants under controlled legend interventions to probe model invariance and sensitivity. Using LegendBench, we evaluate both general-purpose VLMs and specialized chart models and generate their capability profiles, revealing persistent bottlenecks in reliable legend-to-mark binding and counterfactual consistency. We then use these capability profiles to guide targeted fine-tuning, demonstrating that bottleneck-specific interventions can effectively close the localized capability gaps and generalize to unseen data. We further leverage our counterfactual design to conduct fine-grained diagnostic experiments, analyzing encoding-channel effects, legend-order shortcuts, and abstention under varying visibility.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LegendBench——一个以图例为中心的参数化基准与生成流程，用于细粒度诊断视觉语言模型在图表图例理解上的能力，并据此指导针对性微调。
AI.motivation: 图例是图表理解的基础，但现有VLM评估依赖聚合准确率，无法诊断图例理解的细粒度问题：高分可能来自浅层捷径，且图例相关错误会与其他推理失败混淆。
AI.method: 构建LegendBench，包含：(1) 能力-任务分类体系（图例解析、图例定位、图例条件推理、图例感知弃答）；(2) 反事实组生成，对基础图表施加受控图例干预生成多个变体以探测模型不变性与敏感性。用其评估通用VLM和专用图表模型，生成能力画像，并据此进行针对性微调与细粒度诊断实验（编码通道效应、图例顺序捷径、不同可见度下的弃答）。
AI.result: 评估揭示了模型在可靠的图例-标记绑定和反事实一致性上存在持续瓶颈；基于能力画像的瓶颈特定干预能有效弥补局部能力差距，并泛化到未见数据。
AI.conclusion: 图例理解需要细粒度、受控的诊断评估；利用能力画像进行瓶颈导向的干预可有效提升模型在特定图例能力上的表现。

title: PrismGPT: Proxy-Guided Learning for Region-Aware Photo Editing with Self-Synthesized Reasoning
summary: Professional photo finishing relies on both global adjustments and region-specific local edits guided by semantic masks, yet current automated methods handle this workflow only partially. We present PrismGPT, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) framework that produces structured, region-aware editing plans from a single input image without relying on commercial black-box tools. Training a VLM to simultaneously diagnose aesthetic deficiencies at both global and local levels while predicting precise editing parameters is challenging due to the vast combinatorial decision space. We address this through proxy-guided learning: two simpler proxy tasks -- operation decomposition and region-aware aesthetic ranking -- teach the foundational skills the model needs, while a competence-based dynamic scheduler automatically rebalances the multi-task training ratio, progressively shifting emphasis from the proxy tasks to the primary editing task as each skill is mastered. Crucially, all reasoning traces used for supervised fine-tuning are self-synthesized by the same base model, eliminating the need for a stronger external teacher. Experiments on MIT-Adobe FiveK and SPIRE, a new professionally retouched benchmark we introduce, show that PrismGPT achieves state-of-the-art results while using only ~6% of the training data compared to the previous best method.

AI.tldr: 提出 PrismGPT，一个视觉语言模型框架，能从单张输入图像生成结构化、区域感知的修图编辑方案，在 MIT-Adobe FiveK 和新基准 SPIRE 上取得最优结果，且训练数据仅需先前最佳方法的约 6%。
AI.motivation: 专业照片精修既需要全局调整，也需要由语义掩码引导的局部区域编辑，但现有自动化方法只能部分覆盖该流程。直接训练 VLM 同时诊断全局/局部美学缺陷并预测精确编辑参数，面临巨大的组合决策空间难题。
AI.method: 采用代理引导学习：通过操作分解和区域感知美学排序两个更简单的代理任务，让模型先掌握基础能力；再用基于能力的动态调度器自动重新平衡多任务训练比例，逐步从代理任务转向主编辑任务。所有用于监督微调的推理轨迹均由同一基础模型自合成，无需更强外部教师。
AI.result: 在 MIT-Adobe FiveK 和作者新提出的专业修图基准 SPIRE 上，PrismGPT 达到当前最优性能，并且训练数据量仅为先前最佳方法的约 6%。
AI.conclusion: PrismGPT 表明，通过代理引导、动态多任务调度和自合成推理轨迹，VLM 可以在不依赖商业黑盒工具和外部强教师的情况下，实现结构化、区域感知的自动照片精修，并显著提升数据效率。

title: What do VLM-Based Vision-Language Navigation Models Rely on: Interpreting and Steering Policy Behavior
summary: Modern Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) models rely mostly on pre-trained large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to predict navigation actions. While this fusion of language instructions and visual observations allows multimodal reasoning, it obscures how information is routed across modalities or what mechanisms drive navigation decisions. Thus, it remains unclear whether VLN models ground their predictions in relevant semantic cues or can track task progress. In this work, we study the interpretability and steerability of VLN models. We use intervention-based metrics that measure how visual observations, instructions, and visual memory causally influence navigation decisions. Our results show that these navigation policies are sensitive to all input modalities and do not depend on a single one. We further show that these agents encode navigation progress and retain semantic structure from their VLM backbones, enabling concept-level steering through internal activations. Finally, we extract activation vectors for abstract behaviors to transfer them zero-shot to out-of-distribution real-world scenarios, improving performance without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言导航（VLN）模型的可解释性与可操控性，发现导航策略对视觉观测、指令和视觉记忆均有因果依赖，并可通过内部激活进行概念级调控及零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 现代VLN模型多依赖预训练大视觉语言模型（VLM）预测动作，但这种多模态融合掩盖了信息如何跨模态路由以及导航决策由何种机制驱动，因此尚不清楚模型是否基于相关语义线索或能否跟踪任务进度。
AI.method: 采用基于干预的指标，衡量视觉观测、指令和视觉记忆对导航决策的因果影响；分析内部激活，进行概念级调控；提取抽象行为的激活向量，并零样本迁移到分布外真实场景。
AI.result: 导航策略对所有输入模态均敏感，而非依赖单一模态；智能体编码了导航进度并保留VLM骨干的语义结构，支持概念级调控；抽象行为激活向量可零样本迁移到分布外真实场景，无需额外微调即可提升性能。
AI.conclusion: VLN模型具有多模态因果敏感性和可解释、可调控的内部表示，其抽象行为向量可有效迁移至真实场景，为理解与改进VLN模型提供了新途径。

title: LLM-based Conversational AI Knowledge Assistant for MyBuddy Humanoid Robot
comment: This work has been accepted as poster presentation for NeurIPS 2026 WiML Workshop
summary: Humanoid robots are increasingly being popular and developed for human-centered applications, yet their ability to provide intelligent conversations and natural interactive knowledge assistance remains constrained by traditional rule-based dialogue systems, pre-defined responses and limited knowledge repositories. Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful foundation for enabling natural, adaptive, and context-aware Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), which provides a significant opportunity to address such limitations by enabling robots to understand natural speech language, reason over complicated queries, maintain high-quality conversational context, and generate knowledge-rich responses. In this work, we originally present and implement an LLM-based versatile Conversational AI Knowledge Assistant for the Raspberry-Pi-powered 13-Axis MyBuddy humanoid robot, which integrates LLM-driven language understanding and AI reasoning with real-time speech recognition, knowledge retrieval via extensible access of internet engines (e.g., Wikipedia, arXiv), flexible dialogue management, and natural speech synthesis to enable much more intelligent multi-turn continuous conversations and advanced emotional-support Human-Robot Interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的多功能对话式AI知识助手，用于Raspberry Pi驱动的13轴MyBuddy人形机器人，集成了LLM驱动的语言理解、实时语音识别、互联网知识检索、灵活对话管理和自然语音合成，实现了智能多轮连续对话和情感支持的人机交互。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在以人为中心的应用中日益普及，但其提供智能对话和自然交互式知识辅助的能力受限于传统的基于规则的对话系统、预定义响应和有限的知识库。大语言模型（LLM）的出现为自然、自适应和上下文感知的人机交互（HRI）提供了强大的基础，有望解决这些限制。
AI.method: 本文实现了一个基于LLM的多功能对话式AI知识助手，用于Raspberry Pi驱动的13轴MyBuddy人形机器人。该系统集成了LLM驱动的语言理解和AI推理、实时语音识别、通过可扩展的互联网引擎（如Wikipedia、arXiv）进行知识检索、灵活的对话管理以及自然语音合成。
AI.result: 实现了更智能的多轮连续对话和高级情感支持的人机交互。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了LLM在增强人机交互方面的潜力。

title: Lightweight Pedestrian Head-Orientation Recognition Network for Safe Pedestrian-Vehicle Interaction
summary: Pedestrian head orientation recognition plays an important role in autonomous driving by providing valuable cues for understanding pedestrian attention and anticipating potential crossing behavior. However, reliable recognition in real-world traffic scenes remains challenging because pedestrian head regions are often captured at low resolution. To address this challenge, we propose a lightweight Low-Resolution Head Orientation Convolutional Neural Network (LRHO-CNN) for pedestrian head orientation recognition. We construct a new dataset by extracting pedestrian head images from multiple public datasets and manually annotating them into eight orientation categories. The collected images are systematically preprocessed and augmented to increase data diversity and better represent variations in illumination and image quality. The experimental analysis compares LRHO-CNN with three fine-tuned baseline models, namely ResNet-18, ResNet-34, and VGG-16. The results demonstrate that LRHO-CNN achieves the highest classification accuracy among the evaluated models. LRHO-CNN is further evaluated on the JAAD and PIE datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in recognizing pedestrian head orientation in real-world traffic scenes and providing informative head-orientation cues that can support downstream pedestrian behavior and intention prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轻量级低分辨率行人头部朝向识别网络 LRHO-CNN，并构建八类朝向数据集，用于自动驾驶中理解行人注意力与过街意图。
AI.motivation: 真实交通场景中行人头部区域常为低分辨率，导致现有方法难以可靠识别头部朝向；该信息对自动驾驶理解行人注意力和预测过街行为很重要。
AI.method: 从多个公开数据集提取行人头部图像并人工标注为八类朝向，经系统预处理与增强提升多样性；提出轻量级 LRHO-CNN，并与微调后的 ResNet-18、ResNet-34、VGG-16 进行对比，再在 JAAD 和 PIE 数据集上评估。
AI.result: LRHO-CNN 在所评估模型中取得最高分类准确率，并在 JAAD 和 PIE 数据集上验证了其在真实交通场景中识别行人头部朝向的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LRHO-CNN 能有效识别低分辨率行人头部朝向，为下游行人行为和意图预测提供有用的头部朝向线索，具有自动驾驶应用价值。

title: Toward a Unified Mathematics of Concepts
summary: Concepts are commonly defined as abstract, compact representations of knowledge and treated as basic units of intelligent behavior. Yet, cognition, psychology, and AI lack a shared mathematical language for them. Modern systems represent concepts as vectors, distributions, symbols, graphs, and other structures, but these formalisms are typically treated as competing rather than as solutions to a common problem. We propose an operation-based view that evaluates mathematical frameworks by the conceptual operations they support, identifying thirteen operations (including similarity, composition, generalization, and grounding) that recur across cognition, psychology, and AI. We show that ten frameworks embody distinct commitments to concepts as self-contained content, relational structure, or evolving process, and that these commitments determine which operations each supports naturally. For example, vector-based models facilitate graded similarity and generalization but struggle with explicit composition, whereas symbolic models support composition but offer but generalize poorly. No single framework we examined naturally supports all operations without extension. We test this account empirically using categorization as a case study, operationalizing nine theories on the same items against human judgments. Despite addressing the same conceptual question, the theories produce different procedures and results, demonstrating that mathematical commitment shapes what a theory can explain. We call for hybrid formalisms that treat content, relation, and process as jointly primary.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以“操作”为核心视角，比较认知、心理学与AI中十种概念数学框架所天然支持的概念操作，并以归类为案例实证检验九种理论，指出没有单一框架能自然支持所有操作，因而呼吁融合内容、关系与过程的混合形式化。
AI.motivation: 概念是智能行为的基本单位，但认知、心理学与AI缺乏共享的数学语言；现有向量、分布、符号、图等表示常被视作竞争方案，而非对同一问题的不同回答。
AI.method: 提出基于操作的评估框架，识别跨领域反复出现的十三种概念操作（如相似性、组合、泛化、接地）；分析十种数学框架对概念作为自足内容、关系结构或演化过程的不同承诺，并用归类任务将九种理论在同一项目上操作化，与人类判断比较。
AI.result: 十种框架因本体承诺不同而自然支持不同操作：例如向量模型利于渐进相似性与泛化但难以显式组合，符号模型支持组合但泛化较差；没有一个被考察框架无需扩展即可自然支持所有操作。归类案例中，九种理论虽回答同一概念问题，却产生不同程序与结果。
AI.conclusion: 数学承诺塑造理论能解释什么；应发展混合形式化，将内容、关系与过程视为同等基本，以更全面刻画概念与智能行为。

title: Benchmarking Off-the-Shelf Multimodal AI Models Against Dermatologists on Patient-Captured Skin Images
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) has advanced at a rapid pace in recent years. Initially, breakthroughs in large language models caught widespread attention. However, recent generations of frontier AI models have adopted multimodal capabilities as a first class citizen, with vision capabilities being central to that. In this paper, we evaluate three recently released models on the task of diagnosing dermatological conditions from patient-submitted images. The models chosen are at the low to mid tier in terms of pricing and thus represent a floor on current AI capabilities, not a ceiling. We evaluate AI performance relative to a panel of three certified dermatologists, who grade each image, and we present four interesting findings. Firstly, depending on the metric, the tested AI models are either on par or slightly trail humans in terms of inter-clinician agreement. Secondly, we find that asking AI models for a confidence rating produces poorly calibrated answers, meaning use of confidence thresholds should not be relied upon in a clinical setting. Thirdly, the effect of providing additional patient metadata is strongly model-specific, with one of the three models degrading on every metric considered. Finally, model cost is not predictive of performance. The best-performing model we tested costs on average $0.0045 per case.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三个近期发布的低至中端多模态AI模型在根据患者提交图像诊断皮肤病方面的表现，并与三位认证皮肤科医生进行比较。
AI.motivation: 近年来AI快速发展，前沿模型普遍具备多模态能力，视觉能力尤为关键。作者希望评估当前可负担AI模型在皮肤病诊断中的实际能力，将其视为当前AI能力下限而非上限。
AI.method: 选取三个近期发布、价格低至中端的AI模型，在患者提交图像上进行皮肤病诊断；以三位认证皮肤科医生组成的专家组对每张图像评分作为对照；评估指标包括与临床医生间一致性、模型置信度校准、额外患者元数据的影响以及模型成本与性能的关系。
AI.result: 第一，根据不同指标，AI模型在临床医生间一致性上与人类相当或略低；第二，要求AI模型给出置信度评分会产生校准不佳的结果，因此临床环境中不应依赖置信度阈值；第三，提供额外患者元数据的影响高度依赖具体模型，其中一个模型在所有考虑指标上均下降；第四，模型成本不能预测性能，表现最好的模型平均每例成本仅为0.0045美元。
AI.conclusion: 当前低至中端AI模型在皮肤病图像诊断上已接近但未明显超越人类医生的一致性，且置信度不可靠、元数据影响因模型而异、成本与性能不相关。临床使用需谨慎，并应针对具体模型进行验证。

title: When Quantization Preserves Accuracy but Not Evidence: Explanation-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Medical LLMs
summary:
Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large language models, and PTQ methods are usually optimized and evaluated with generic reconstruction, perplexity, or answer accuracy. But in explanation-critical domains, preserving only the final answer may be insufficient, since users may also inspect generated rationales to judge whether a prediction is trustworthy. We study this issue in medical multiple-choice question answering, where rationales should provide evidence that supports the selected answer.
  We propose an explanation-aware objective for transformation-based PTQ. Our method builds an offline faithfulness cache from full-precision teacher rationales and uses it during optimization to preserve answer-supporting evidence tokens and evidence-conditioned answer behavior. We instantiate it on OSTQuant under W4A4KV4 quantization and evaluate four 7B--8B medical and instruction-tuned LLMs on MedExQA, MedExpQA, and ChallengeClinicalQA. While a same-calibration OSTQuant baseline preserves task accuracy, it can substantially weaken answer-supporting rationales. Our objective is to preserve the full-precision model's answer-supporting behavior rather than improve gold-label accuracy, and our method better preserves the full-precision model's answer behavior and rationale-to-answer support. These results suggest that PTQ for explanation-critical settings should evaluate preservation of answer-supporting evidence, not only answer accuracy. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant.

AI.tldr: 论文研究解释关键领域中的训练后量化（PTQ），提出解释感知的量化目标EAQuant，在医学多选题问答中保留答案支撑证据，而不仅是最终答案准确率。
AI.motivation: PTQ通常以重构误差、困惑度或答案准确率进行优化和评估，但在医疗等解释关键领域，用户会查看推理依据来判断预测是否可信，仅保留最终答案可能不够。
AI.method: 提出用于变换式PTQ的解释感知目标：从全精度教师模型的推理依据构建离线忠实缓存，并在优化中保留支撑答案的证据token及证据条件下的答案行为。在OSTQuant上以W4A4KV4量化实例化，评估四个7B-8B医学和指令微调LLM，使用MedExQA、MedExpQA和ChallengeClinicalQA数据集。
AI.result: 相同校准的OSTQuant基线虽保持任务准确率，但可能显著削弱答案支撑推理依据。本方法能更好地保留全精度模型的答案行为及推理依据对答案的支持，目标并非提升金标签准确率。
AI.conclusion: 解释关键场景下的PTQ应评估答案支撑证据的保留情况，而非仅关注答案准确率。代码与评估脚本已开源。

title: Evaluating Decision Models for Text Annotation in Computational Social Science
summary: Computational social science increasingly relies on large language models for text annotation, and the validity of published findings now rests on the labels generated by such models. Decision models, a new model class built for categorical question answering, answer typed questions with a choice, a probability distribution over the label set, and a confidence score rather than free text, at a small fraction of frontier inference prices. Whether their answers are accurate, and whether that stated confidence can be trusted on social science constructs, are unknown. Here, we mirror the evaluation of Ziems et al. (2024) on 18 computational social science classification tasks (7,977 items), comparing the first commercial decision model and two open-weight counterparts against 19 frontier and open-weight language models under the same zero-shot protocol. The decision model trails the per-task best LLM on 14 of 15 evaluation tasks, with a median deficit of 11.6 macro-F1 points, at a median 44 times lower measured cost. Its confidence is better calibrated than the verbalized confidence of 16 of the 19 LLMs, yet three frontier models show lower median calibration error (0.157 against 0.066). While items above 0.9 confidence are typically labeled accurately (median accuracy 0.815), on one task, empathy in peer-support dialogues, the model reports high confidence while performing near chance. Nonetheless, our results suggest that decision models are useful as a first step in the annotation pipeline: routing low-confidence items to an LLM matches or exceeds the LLM alone at a quarter to half of its cost.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了新型决策模型在计算社会科学文本标注中的准确性与置信度校准，发现其性能低于最佳LLM但成本极低，且可作为标注流程中低置信度样本路由的第一步。
AI.motivation: 计算社会科学日益依赖大语言模型进行文本标注，而决策模型以类型化问答、概率分布和置信度分数输出，成本远低于前沿模型，但其准确性和置信度在社会 sci 构念上是否可信尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在Ziems et al. (2024)的18个计算社会科学分类任务（7,977条）上，以相同零样本协议，将首个商用决策模型和两个开放权重对应模型与19个前沿及开放权重语言模型进行比较。
AI.result: 决策模型在15个评估任务中的14个上落后于每任务最佳LLM，宏F1中位差11.6分，但测量成本中位低44倍；其置信度校准优于19个LLM中的16个，但三个前沿模型校准误差更低（0.157 vs 0.066）；高于0.9置信度的样本通常标注准确（中位准确率0.815），但在同伴支持对话共情任务上高置信度却接近随机。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型可作为标注流程的第一步：将低置信度样本路由给LLM，能在LLM单独使用成本的1/4至1/2下达到或超过其效果。

title: SAFe: Segment-guided Aggregation of Feature Densities for Anomaly-aware Segmentation
summary: Visual segmentation systems encounter objects outside their training distribution during real-world deployment, hindering reliable autonomous systems that depend on scene parsing in the perception stage. Many recent methods address this by using self-supervised foundation models to train density estimators that yield low likelihood in anomalous image regions. Although promising, these methods suffer from poor feature semantics or they lack spatial consistency, both of which undermine critical downstream decisions. We address this problem with~\method, a generative method based on class-conditional density estimation over self-supervised representations. SAFe trains lightweight normalizing flows that produce class-conditional normalized likelihood estimates over frozen DINOv3 features. We combine density estimates from transformer features with density scores over multi-scale convolutional features to capture both global semantics and local detail. We introduce a method-agnostic post-processing step based on SAM3 that connects per-location likelihoods into spatially coherent segments while suppressing false positives, and enables instance-level anomaly detection without retraining. The post processing further distinguishes novel categories among anomalous objects by a similarity-based agglomerative clustering scheme. SAFe sets a new state of the art on the PANIC, OoDIS, SMIYC ObstacleTrack with strong performance on the ISSU benchmark.

AI.tldr: SAFe 是一种基于自监督表示的类别条件密度估计生成方法，通过轻量归一化流与 SAM3 后处理实现异常分割，在多个基准上取得新最优。
AI.motivation: 视觉分割系统在真实部署中会遇到训练分布之外的物体，影响依赖场景解析的自动驾驶等系统可靠性；现有基于自监督基础模型的密度估计方法存在特征语义差或缺乏空间一致性的问题。
AI.method: SAFe 在冻结的 DINOv3 特征上训练轻量归一化流，进行类别条件的归一化似然估计；融合 transformer 特征密度与多尺度卷积特征密度以兼顾全局语义与局部细节；引入基于 SAM3 的方法无关后处理，将逐位置似然连接为空间一致的分割，抑制误报，无需重训练即可实现实例级异常检测；并通过基于相似度的凝聚聚类区分异常物体中的新类别。
AI.result: SAFe 在 PANIC、OoDIS、SMIYC ObstacleTrack 上取得新的最优性能，在 ISSU 基准上也有强劲表现。
AI.conclusion: SAFe 通过类别条件密度估计与空间一致后处理有效解决了异常分割中的语义与空间一致性问题，并刷新了多项基准的最优结果。

title: Mobile Imaging Solutions for Medical Diagnosis: Trends and Applications
summary: Advances in processing power, camera technologies, and mobile image analysis have made smartphones and other mobile devices, such as laptops, increasingly suitable for medical diagnosis and healthcare applications. Researchers have developed low-cost solutions for the early detection and monitoring of various health conditions, including eye and ENT diseases, malnutrition, heart rate variability, skin and oral conditions, and injuries, using images captured by non-medical devices such as smartphones and webcams. This survey examines existing research on mobile image-based medical diagnosis, with an emphasis on its potential to enable low-cost and accessible healthcare. We comparatively analyze state-of-the-art solutions across different healthcare application categories, examining their advantages and limitations. Based on this analysis, we identify desirable characteristics of mobile image-based diagnostic tools and highlight areas where existing approaches have made progress as well as areas requiring further research. We also discuss application-specific and common challenges and outline directions for future research. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive overview of mobile image-based healthcare solutions and their potential to support low-cost disease diagnosis and monitoring, particularly for underserved populations in remote and resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于移动图像（智能手机、摄像头等）的医疗诊断研究，分析不同应用领域的先进方案，并讨论其优势、局限、挑战与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 处理能力、相机技术和移动图像分析的进步使手机等移动设备适合医疗诊断；研究希望为偏远和资源匮乏地区提供低成本、可及的健康筛查与监测方案。
AI.method: 综述现有移动图像医疗诊断研究，按不同医疗应用类别对最新方案进行比较分析，评估优缺点，归纳理想工具特征，并讨论应用特定与共性挑战及未来研究方向。
AI.result: 已有低成本方案可用于眼科、耳鼻喉、营养不良、心率变异性、皮肤、口腔及损伤等的早期检测或监测，这些方案多使用智能手机、网络摄像头等非医疗设备采集图像；综述总结了各方案的进展与不足。
AI.conclusion: 基于移动图像的医疗方案在低成本疾病诊断与监测方面具有较大潜力，尤其适用于偏远和资源受限人群；但仍需进一步研究以解决现存挑战并推动应用落地。

title: Assessing Readability with LLMs: The Role of Reasoning and Few-Shot Prompting
summary: Readability assessment is essential for tailoring texts to intended audiences across educational, healthcare, and information retrieval domains. However, traditional readability formulas struggle to generalize across genres and languages, while supervised machine learning models rely on scarce, domain-specific annotated corpora, limiting their applicability--particularly for less-resourced languages. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a highly scalable, multilingual alternative that requires no task-specific training, yet the impact of advanced prompting strategies on their performance remains underexplored. In this paper, we conduct a systematic benchmark of diverse open-source LLMs for multilingual readability assessment, focusing on the prediction of discrete readability levels required by educational frameworks. In addition to English, we evaluate our approach on a less-resourced language, Slovenian, to establish whether LLMs remain effective in low-resource settings. Specifically, we investigate the influence of explicit reasoning, demonstrating that Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and reasoning-oriented models yield significant improvements over direct answering. Furthermore, our exploration of few-shot in-context learning reveals that providing just one labelled example per category (1-shot) substantially enhances prediction quality compared to zero-shot settings, with additional examples offering diminishing returns. By comprehensively comparing these approaches against traditional unsupervised metrics and state-of-the-art supervised baselines, we establish the viability of out-of-the-box LLMs as robust, cross-lingual readability assessors.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测了多种开源大语言模型在多语言可读性评估中的表现，重点研究思维链提示、推理型模型和少样本上下文学习对离散可读性等级预测的影响，并在英语和低资源斯洛文尼亚语上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统可读性公式难以跨体裁和跨语言泛化，监督机器学习模型又依赖稀缺的领域标注语料，尤其不利于低资源语言；LLM 虽具可扩展多语言潜力，但高级提示策略对其可读性评估性能的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 对多种开源 LLM 进行多语言可读性评估基准测试，预测教育框架所需的离散可读性等级；在英语和斯洛文尼亚语上实验；比较直接回答、Chain-of-Thought 提示、推理导向模型，以及零样本、1-shot 和更多少样本上下文学习；并与传统无监督指标和最优监督基线对比。
AI.result: CoT 提示和推理型模型相比直接回答有显著提升；每类仅提供一个标注示例的 1-shot 学习即显著优于零样本，继续增加示例收益递减；在斯洛文尼亚语等低资源场景中 LLM 仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 开箱即用的 LLM 可作为稳健的跨语言可读性评估器，在无需任务特定训练的情况下，为多语言和低资源可读性评估提供可行方案。

title: Learning tactile perception from high-bandwidth single-point sensing
summary:
Tactile sensing is increasingly being incorporated into learning-based robotic manipulation, yet many existing approaches rely on spatially distributed sensors. Here we introduce SpectRobot, a framework that transforms single-point tactile signals into compact time-frequency spectrograms. These spectrograms encode high-bandwidth tactile histories as fixed-size image-like representations. They can be processed by standard vision encoders and integrated into learning pipelines originally developed for vision, while preserving temporal and frequency information unavailable to conventional cameras.
  Rather than increasing spatial density through arrays of tactile elements, SpectRobot exploits the rich dynamics contained in sparse, high-bandwidth single-point measurements. In our implementation, the sensors are mounted away from the contact surface while remaining mechanically coupled to it, reducing direct exposure to wear and potentially improving robustness in harsh environments and for long-term deployment on dexterous robots.
  Our experiments demonstrate that: (1) a robot can exploit single-point vibration signals to solve a visually occluded manipulation task; (2) temporal history strongly influences policy performance, while sensing bandwidth controls the spectral information available, with measurements extending to 100~kHz; and (3) the same representation can be used across different tactile sensing technologies mediated by acceleration, force, or strain. We further show that capabilities previously associated with research-grade instrumentation can be accessed using readily available, off-the-shelf hardware. We believe that broader access to high-bandwidth tactile sensing could facilitate the integration of contact dynamics into embodied learning systems and, for some tasks, offer an alternative or complement to increasing the spatial density of tactile sensing.

AI.tldr: 提出SpectRobot框架，将单点高带宽触觉信号转换为时频谱图，作为固定尺寸图像表示，可用标准视觉编码器和学习流程处理，用于机器人操作任务。
AI.motivation: 现有触觉学习方法多依赖空间分布传感器，成本高、易磨损，且可能丢失高频动态信息；希望利用稀疏单点高带宽测量中的丰富动力学，避免增加空间密度。
AI.method: 将单点触觉信号转换为紧凑的时频谱图；传感器远离接触面但保持机械耦合；使用标准视觉编码器及视觉学习流程；在视觉遮挡操作任务中测试，分析时间历史与带宽（至100 kHz）影响，并跨加速度、力、应变等不同触觉传感技术验证。
AI.result: (1) 单点振动信号可解决视觉遮挡操作任务；(2) 时间历史显著影响策略性能，带宽决定频谱信息，测量达100 kHz；(3) 同一表示可跨不同触觉传感技术；(4) 用现成硬件实现研究级能力。
AI.conclusion: 高带宽触觉传感的普及可促进接触动力学融入具身学习系统，某些任务中可作为增加触觉空间密度的替代或补充。

title: Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
comment: Project Page: https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/large-model-team/blog/uranus/ Inference Code: https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/Uranus-OSS Inference Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/D-Robotics/Uranus-Demo-Data SDK Code: https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/Uranus-SDK Model Weights: https://huggingface.co/collections/D-Robotics/uranus
summary: Scalable simulation is essential for robot data generation, policy training, evaluation, and safe iteration, yet real-world interaction is costly and conventional simulators require labor-intensive construction. We present Uranus, a data-driven robot simulator built around a joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model. Uranus offers three key capabilities: (1) streaming, open-ended rollout, which receives future joint-position trajectories online and autoregressively generates one latent frame per step, corresponding to four RGB frames, without a fixed horizon; (2) low-latency generation, achieving 24 FPS after inference optimization; and (3) scalable, extensible robot control, providing a unified interface for synchronized multi-view generation across diverse robot embodiments and camera configurations. We conduct comprehensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, providing an objective assessment of Uranus and clearly identifying its current limitations. We release the code and model weights to empower the community with practical tools and insights.

AI.tldr: 提出 Uranus，一种数据驱动机器人模拟器，基于关节轨迹条件自回归扩散模型，支持流式开放式生成、低延迟推理和多视角多具身统一接口，并开源代码与权重。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人交互成本高，传统模拟器构建费力；可扩展仿真对机器人数据生成、策略训练、评估和安全迭代至关重要。
AI.method: 采用联合轨迹条件自回归扩散模型：在线接收未来关节位置轨迹，每步自回归生成一个 latent frame，对应四帧 RGB，无固定时域；进行推理优化；提供统一接口以同步生成多视角，适配不同机器人形态和相机配置。
AI.result: 推理优化后达到 24 FPS；支持开放时长流式 rollout；可跨多种机器人形态与相机配置生成多视角；在分布内和分布外数据上完成定量与定性评估，并明确当前局限。
AI.conclusion: Uranus 是实用且可扩展的数据驱动机器人模拟器，能降低成本并支持多种仿真需求；作者开源代码和模型权重以推动社区研究。

title: Feasibility Distance Fields for Heterogeneous Constraints in Robot Configuration Space
comment: Configuration space, distance fields, Eikonal equation, feasibility, self-collision, singularity, Cartesian compliance, multi-robot systems, medial axis, safe control
summary: Robot manipulators are monitored by constraint-specific indicators whose units and gradient scales are not comparable, so they do not provide a common measure of the configuration-space motion remaining before violation. We define the feasibility distance field (FDF) as the distance, under a fixed positive-definite joint-space metric, to the union of infeasible configuration sets. Classical distance-to-set theory gives 1-Lipschitz continuity, almost-everywhere differentiability, and unit dual-gradient norm wherever the nearest projection is unique. The robotics contribution is an admissibility analysis showing when practical constraints define non-empty closed sets. We derive admissible formulations for external and self-collision, joint limits, dexterity, Cartesian and task-projected compliance, joint torque under payload, and dynamic manipulability. Since every field uses the same metric, heterogeneous constraints compose by a pointwise minimum, conditioned constraints retain a fixed distance space, and multi-robot constraints produce block-sparse gradients that identify which robots must react. We generate projection-based labels and train neural approximations with a distance loss and an Eikonal penalty. Simulations on a UR5e and a dual-arm cell evaluate seven fields using value, projection, sign, gradient, composition, and moving-obstacle diagnostics. Across 8,000 configurations, the largest feasible-side secant ratio is 0.920, mean learned gradient norms range from 0.994 to 0.998, and projection residuals range from 0.011 to 0.034 rad. Across 24 random obstacle paths, the external and composed collision fields achieve 90.4% and 91.6% success within 3 cm, with sign-error rates below 2%. The results support a common configuration-space margin and identify approximation errors near medial axes and sparsely sampled boundaries.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可行距离场（FDF），用统一正定关节空间度量衡量机器人构型距离不可行约束集合的距离，并给出约束可容许性分析、组合方式以及神经网络近似方法。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人约束指标单位和梯度尺度不可比，无法提供统一的构型空间剩余可行运动度量，因此需要一种可比较、可组合且具有良好几何性质的统一裕度表示。
AI.method: 定义 FDF 为在固定正定关节空间度量下到不可行构型集合并集的投影距离；利用距离集合理论分析其 1-Lipschitz、几乎处处可微及单位对偶梯度范数性质；对多种实际约束进行可容许性分析并给出表示；通过逐点最小值组合异构约束，保持条件约束距离空间，并利用块稀疏梯度处理多机器人约束；生成投影标签，用距离损失和 Eikonal 惩罚训练神经网络近似。
AI.result: 在 UR5e 和双臂单元上评估七类场；8000 个构型中最大可行侧割线比 0.920，学习梯度范数均值 0.994 至 0.998，投影残差 0.011 至 0.034 rad；24 条随机障碍路径中，外碰撞和组合碰撞场在 3 cm 内成功率分别为 90.4% 和 91.6%，符号错误率低于 2%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持使用统一的构型空间裕度，并指出近似误差主要出现在中轴附近和边界稀疏采样区域。

title: CoaG: Cylinders on a Grid: Coarse 3D Layout Control for Video Generation
summary: We ask how little geometry a person has to draw to control both where people stand and where the camera moves in a generated video. Our answer is a ground plane and one cylinder per person. A user draws a grid on the ground, places one cylinder where each person should stand, moves the cylinders and the camera over 81 frames, and the model renders a photoreal video in which the people occupy the cylinders' positions, move as the cylinders move, and are seen from the drawn camera. Appearance comes from a text prompt and a background reference image; layout and motion come from the geometry. Because no dataset pairs such a signal with video, we build the pairs ourselves: an automatic engine writes 2000 captions from a combinatorial seed, generates a clip for each with a text-to-video model, and lifts every clip back to its geometry with person tracking, background inpainting, an agentic ground-mask loop, feed-forward multi-view reconstruction and a plane fit, with no real footage and no manual labels. A LoRA on Wan2.2-Fun-Control trained on 1935 such tuples follows drawn layouts and camera paths on hold-out clips: the generated people match the cylinders' count, order, position and height, the text changes who they are, the reference image changes where they are, and dolly-in, orbit, pan and crane paths are followed, dolly-out only weakly.

AI.tldr: 提出只用地面网格和每人一个圆柱作为极简几何控制信号，即可同时控制生成视频中人物的位置、动作与相机运动；通过自动构建大规模几何-视频配对数据并训练LoRA实现。
AI.motivation: 研究如何用尽可能少的几何输入，同时控制生成视频中人物的站位、运动以及相机路径，避免复杂标注或真实拍摄数据。
AI.method: 用户在地面画网格，为每人放置一个圆柱，并在81帧内移动圆柱和相机；模型根据文本提示和背景参考图生成真实感视频。为获取训练数据，构建自动引擎：从组合种子生成2000条描述，用文本到视频模型生成片段，再通过人物跟踪、背景修复、智能地面掩码循环、前馈多视角重建和平面拟合将视频反推为几何。最终在Wan2.2-Fun-Control上训练LoRA，使用1935个此类数据元组。
AI.result: 在留出片段上，生成人物在数量、顺序、位置和高度上与圆柱匹配；文本改变人物身份，参考图改变场景位置。相机路径中，推近、环绕、平移和升降可较好跟随，拉远仅能较弱跟随。
AI.conclusion: 极简几何信号足以实现可控的真实感视频生成，且无需真实素材或人工标签，可通过自动数据构建流程扩展训练数据。

title: Written as a Record, Read as an Address: What a Forward Pass Leaves in an Operation's KV Cache
summary: When a language model reads an operation such as "Swap the contents of Box F and Box B", its forward pass writes keys and values for those tokens into the KV cache. Prior work on entity tracking establishes what models use: bindings are resolved at query time rather than stored as explicit latent state. We ask what they write at the operation span and how it is accessed. We split a forward pass into a frozen writer and a reader: the writer's cache is recomputed without gradients, while the reader sees only the instruction and operation tokens, with all state descriptions hidden, and is trained in isolation. Anything the reader recovers was therefore already present in the unmodified cache. On a synthetic boxes task, a base reader recovers $\leq 0.06$ of queried bindings against $0.75$--$1.00$ after training, and recoverability tracks the operation's read/write footprint. We find two modes of access. Across Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, operation-span transplants causally redirect which visible state is read even when the two worlds hold identical values, revealing a routing record. Isolation training preserves routing and adds direct access to the payload, the value the operation read, from the single operand-name token in a narrow mid-depth band (layers 12--15 of 32 in Llama-3.1-8B, 14--17 in Mistral-7B) --- the same site that holds the routing record. The same recipe extends to further operations, ToMi and GSM8K, but is bounded by training coverage and costs open-book accuracy. Operation tokens thus leave localized, causally recoverable records that support both routing and direct payload access, though the model that writes them reads mainly the address they carry and not the value.

AI.tldr: 该研究探究语言模型在执行“交换盒子内容”等操作时，KV缓存中究竟写入了什么、又如何被读取。通过冻结写入器与隔离训练读取器，发现操作token会留下可因果恢复的局部记录，支持路由与直接负载访问。
AI.motivation: 已有实体追踪工作表明，绑定主要在查询时解析而非显式存储为潜在状态；但模型在操作跨度上写入了什么、这些信息如何被访问仍不清楚。
AI.method: 将前向传播拆分为冻结的写入器和读取器：写入器缓存无梯度重算，读取器仅看到指令与操作token，隐藏状态描述并单独训练。在合成盒子任务上测试，并在Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B上做操作跨度移植与隔离训练，进一步扩展到ToMi和GSM8K。
AI.result: 基础读取器仅恢复≤0.06的查询绑定，训练后达0.75–1.00，且可恢复性跟随操作的读写足迹。发现两种访问模式：操作跨度移植可因果改变读取哪个可见状态，形成路由记录；隔离训练保留路由，并在Llama-3.1-8B第12–15层、Mistral-7B第14–17层的中层窄带中，从单个操作数名称token增加对操作所读取负载的直接访问，且该位置也是路由记录所在。
AI.conclusion: 操作token会留下局部、因果可恢复的记录，同时支持路由和直接负载访问；但写出这些记录的模型主要读取其中携带的地址，而非值本身。该方法可扩展到更多操作、ToMi和GSM8K，但受训练覆盖限制，并会牺牲开卷准确率。

title: Think Like a World Model, Act Like a VLA: Distilling World-Model Representations into Compact Robot Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map observations to actions with no objective that accounts for how the world responds, so their robustness is bounded primarily by data coverage. World models carry precisely that missing objective and are better grounded for it, yet rolling the future forward costs seconds per decision and rules them out of the control loop. We show the two can be separated. What a world model knows about physical scenes lives in its \emph{internal features}; generating the future is merely the objective that produced them, so the grounding can be inherited while the generative machinery is left behind. We add one feature-alignment term to ordinary VLA training: a frozen world model is run over the training frames once and cached, and the student learns to agree with that cache. No teacher is loaded during training, the projector is discarded after it, and the deployed policy is identical to the undistilled baseline, running in $32$~ms and $1.86$~GB on a consumer RTX~5090, so every gain is attributable to the representation rather than to added capacity or test-time compute. A $0.8$B student reaches $97.9\%$ on LIBERO, improves from $48.2\%$ to $50.5\%$ on RoboCasa-GR1 humanoid manipulation, and the same objective carries over to real hardware, on both a single-arm and a bimanual platform. The gain survives changes of student scale, backbone, alignment layer, and teacher, indicating a broad representational prior rather than a fragile alignment between two particular networks. Project page: https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/.

AI.tldr: 提出将世界模型的物理场景表征蒸馏到VLA策略中的方法：仅用其内部特征做对齐，不保留未来生成过程，从而在不增加推理开销的情况下提升VLA的鲁棒性与操作性能。
AI.motivation: VLA模型直接将观测映射为动作，缺乏对世界如何响应的目标，鲁棒性主要受数据覆盖限制；世界模型虽有此目标且更接地，但未来 rollout 每次决策耗时数秒，无法进入控制回路。
AI.method: 在普通VLA训练中加入一个特征对齐项：冻结世界模型对训练帧只运行一次并缓存内部特征，学生策略学习与该缓存一致。训练时不加载教师，投影器训练后丢弃，部署策略与未蒸馏基线完全相同，在消费级RTX 5090上运行32 ms、1.86 GB。
AI.result: 0.8B学生模型在LIBERO达到97.9%；RoboCasa-GR1人形操作从48.2%提升到50.5%；同一目标可迁移到真实单臂和双臂平台；增益在学生规模、骨干、对齐层和教师变化下依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的 grounding 可通过内部特征继承，而生成式机制可以丢弃；性能提升来自表征先验而非增加容量或测试时计算，且不是两个特定网络间的脆弱对齐，具有较广泛的适用性。

title: SE(3) Neural Potential Fields for 6-DoF Trajectory Planning Directly from Images Without Explicit 3D Reconstruction
summary: Reaching a 6-DoF grasp pose in clutter requires a collision-free trajectory, conventionally obtained by reconstructing the scene in 3D and planning inside that reconstruction, at the cost of its accuracy and compute. Potential fields learned directly from images remove that dependency but inherit the classical weakness of artificial potential fields: where attractive and repulsive gradients cancel, the descent grazes the obstacle instead of going around it, and can stall short of the goal. We present an SE(3) neural potential field learned from posed RGB images and supervised with a navigation function, the geodesic distance to the grasp through free space recovered from those same images during training, which removes both failures. On two tabletop scenes, from obstacle-blocked starts executed on a UR10, the field converges within 3 cm of the grasp from every start and every path it executes is collision-free against the ground-truth geometry, against 25% and 0% under image supervision alone; mean clearance rises from under a centimeter to 8.6-8.8 cm and arm-link contacts fall from 20.6-50.4% to 2.7-5.5% of executed configurations. Executed grasp success is 90.0% and 40.0% on the two scenes, the residual failures being refusals of the Cartesian executor rather than of the field. Planning takes about 2 s against 67-133 s for RRT* on a reconstruction of the same images, though under a common offline harness the two are comparable: the deployed margin is the cost of collision-checking a dense reconstruction, not planner complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从带位姿RGB图像中学习的SE(3)神经势场，并用导航函数（自由空间中到抓取位姿的测地距离）进行监督，以解决杂乱环境下6-DoF抓取的无碰撞轨迹生成问题。
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖3D重建和在其上规划，精度与计算成本受限；直接从图像学习势场虽避免重建，却继承人工势场的吸引与排斥梯度抵消、沿障碍物擦过或停滞等缺陷。
AI.method: 学习SE(3)神经势场，输入为带位姿的RGB图像；训练时用导航函数监督，即从同一图像恢复的自由空间中到抓取位姿的测地距离，以消除势场失效模式。在UR10和两个桌面场景中，从障碍物阻挡的起始位姿执行抓取。
AI.result: 势场可从所有起始点收敛到抓取位姿3厘米以内，且每条执行路径相对真值几何均无碰撞；仅用图像监督时碰撞率为25%和0%。平均间隙从不足1厘米升至8.6-8.8厘米，机械臂连杆接触率从20.6-50.4%降至2.7-5.5%。两个场景执行抓取成功率分别为90.0%和40.0%，剩余失败源于笛卡尔执行器拒绝而非势场。规划约2秒，而基于同图像重建的RRT*为67-133秒；统一离线测试下二者相当，部署时的差距主要来自对稠密重建做碰撞检查的成本，而非规划器复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 用导航函数监督的SE(3)神经势场能显著提升图像驱动抓取规划的安全性和成功率，并大幅降低部署规划时间；其优势来自避免重建与稠密碰撞检查，而非规划算法本身更复杂。

title: ChartJudgeBench: Evaluating LMM Judges for Chart-to-Code Generation
summary: Building strong chart-to-code systems increasingly relies on reinforcement learning, whose effectiveness depends critically on the quality of the reward signal. Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) play a natural critical role in jointly assessing chart visual appearance and task requirements. They are therefore increasingly used as visual critics and reward models, yet their reliability as judges remains largely unexplored. To this end, we introduce ChartJudgeBench, a diagnostic vision-language benchmark for assessing LMM judges in chart-to-code workflows. It includes 1,003 Chart Perception Alignment (CPA) instances for pairwise chart comparison and 650 Chart Reasoning Judgment (CRJ) instances for binary Accept/Reject verification in Chart Reproduction and Chart Editing. Together, these tasks emulate the core judging decisions required in agentic refinement and RL-based chart optimization. Our evaluation of strong LMMs reveals four systematic limitations: (i) positional bias in pairwise comparison, (ii) a strong tendency to overpredict Accept, (iii) difficulty in matching visual styles and aesthetics, and (iv) an unexpected leniency bias in RL-trained models. These findings show that current LMM judges require explicit reliability validation before being used as critics or reward models in chart-to-code optimization. The code and data are available on ChartJudgeBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ChartJudgeBench，一个用于评估图表到代码工作流中 LMM 评判可靠性的诊断性视觉语言基准，并揭示当前 LMM 作为视觉评论器或奖励模型时的四类系统性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 图表到代码系统日益依赖强化学习，而奖励信号质量至关重要；LMM 被越来越多地用作视觉评论器和奖励模型，但其作为评判者的可靠性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建 ChartJudgeBench 基准，包含 1,003 个用于成对图表比较的 Chart Perception Alignment（CPA）实例，以及 650 个用于图表复现和图表编辑中二元 Accept/Reject 验证的 Chart Reasoning Judgment（CRJ）实例，以模拟智能体式细化和基于 RL 的图表优化中的核心评判决策，并评测强 LMM。
AI.result: 评估显示强 LMM 存在四类系统性局限：(i) 成对比较中的位置偏差；(ii) 强烈倾向于过度预测 Accept；(iii) 难以匹配视觉风格与美学；(iv) RL 训练模型中出现意外的宽松偏差。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LMM 评判者在被用作图表到代码优化中的评论器或奖励模型之前，需要经过显式的可靠性验证；代码与数据已在 ChartJudgeBench 提供。

title: OSWorld-Pro: Process-based Evaluation for Computer Use Agents
summary: Evaluation of Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) is often limited to the final deliverables they create (at the end of hundreds of steps) and assessed with functional verifiers, as seen in OSWorld. However, such evaluation of end-state performance lacks transparency into how and why agents fail in various tasks, obfuscating critical insight for subsequent improvement. For instance, agents that err during keyboard inputs would require a different mitigation strategy from those that fail to precisely provide click-based inputs on the graphical UI. We introduce OSWorld-Pro: a set of over 300 tasks containing over 2800 subgoals to enable the procedural evaluation of CUAs grounded in over 67,000 human annotations. We use robust human-aligned LLM-Judges to evaluate the fulfillment of OSWorld-Pro subgoals and thereby reveal the progress that models make throughout a series of sequentially dependent subgoals. Our findings reveal that OSWorld-Pro is challenging even for state-of-the-art LLMs, with top performers like Claude Opus 5 achieving only 75.7% vs. 83.4% on OSWorld. Furthermore, we identify critical process-focused failure modes of various models (e.g. subgoal-irrelevant actions and click-based mistakes) to provide insights to improve performance and efficiency of CUAs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OSWorld-Pro，一个包含300多个任务、2800多个子目标和67000多条人工标注的数据集，用于对计算机使用智能体（CUA）进行过程性评估。通过人类对齐的LLM评判器评估子目标完成情况，揭示模型在连续依赖子目标中的进展与失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有CUA评估多局限于最终交付物（经过数百步后）并用功能验证器评分，如OSWorld。这种终态评估缺乏对智能体如何以及为何失败的透明度，无法为后续改进提供关键洞见。例如，键盘输入错误与点击输入不精确需要不同的缓解策略。
AI.method: 构建OSWorld-Pro数据集，包含300多个任务和2800多个子目标，基于67000多条人工标注。使用稳健的人类对齐LLM评判器来评估子目标的完成情况，从而揭示模型在一系列顺序依赖子目标中的进展。
AI.result: OSWorld-Pro即使对最先进的大模型也具有挑战性：顶级模型如Claude Opus 5仅达到75.7%，而OSWorld上为83.4%。此外，识别出多种模型的关键过程性失败模式，例如子目标无关动作和基于点击的错误。
AI.conclusion: 过程性评估能够揭示终态评估所掩盖的失败模式，为提升CUA的性能和效率提供可操作的改进思路。

title: Beyond Emotion Prompts: Fine-Grained Text-to-Image Generation Driven by Valence-Arousal-Dominance
summary: Although text-to-image models can accurately depict subjects and scenes, creators still struggle to specify the fine-grained emotions an image should convey without rewriting its content description. Natural language can suggest emotions, but it offers no control scale with stable meanings and ordered intensities. We propose EMOTRANS, which transforms psychologically grounded valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) coordinates into generation conditions that are independent of the content text and modulated across denoising stages, making emotional style a finely adjustable creative variable. To support this goal, we construct EMOVAD, an art-painting dataset that pairs objective content descriptions with separately collected emotional ratings from multiple annotators. We also coordinate emotional expression and content preservation through dual-branch training with a shared model. Objective and human evaluations show that the framework improves the accuracy of three-dimensional emotion control and produces perceptible, orderable continuous changes while maintaining competitive text alignment and image quality. This work provides a practical emotion-driven approach to image generation that extends objective content depiction to fine-grained emotional adjustment.

AI.tldr: 提出 EMOTRANS，将心理学中的效价-唤醒-支配度（VAD）坐标转化为与内容文本解耦、并可在去噪阶段调节的生成条件，使图像情感风格成为可精细调节的创作变量；同时构建 EMOVAD 艺术绘画数据集，并通过双分支训练兼顾情感表达与内容保持。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型虽能准确描绘主体和场景，但创作者难以在不重写内容描述的情况下指定图像应传达的细粒度情感。自然语言虽可暗示情感，却缺乏含义稳定、强度有序的控制尺度。
AI.method: 提出 EMOTRANS，将 VAD 坐标转为独立于内容文本的生成条件，并在不同去噪阶段进行调制；构建 EMOVAD 数据集，包含客观内容描述与多名标注者单独收集的情感评分；采用共享模型的双分支训练，以协调情感表达与内容保持。
AI.result: 客观评估与人工评估表明，该框架提升了三维情感控制的准确性，能产生可感知、可排序的连续变化，同时保持有竞争力的文本对齐度和图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种实用的情感驱动图像生成方法，将客观内容描绘扩展至细粒度情感调节，使情感成为可精细调控的创作变量。

title: MSI-Bench: Evaluating Multi-Speaker Voice Interaction for Collaborative AI Agents
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/M2cha4l1124/MSI-Bench ; Code: https://github.com/boson-ai/MSI-Bench
summary: Voice provides a natural and immediate interface for AI agents. Many settings in which voice agents could be useful, including meetings, households, and collaborative work, are inherently multi-speaker. Supporting these settings introduces challenges that are largely absent from one-on-one interaction. We introduce the Multi-Speaker Interaction Benchmark (MSI-Bench) for evaluating multi-speaker voice interaction. Each test case is a short multi-party multi-turn audio scene with participant context, expected tool calls, and atomic rubrics. The benchmark targets three capability families: multi-speaker memory, multi-speaker instruction following, and multi-speaker reasoning. It comprises 1,152 test cases, evenly split between Mandarin Chinese and English (576 each). The strongest configuration on each split passes all rubrics on only 66.8% of English and 54.5% of Mandarin cases, and the strongest open-weight configuration on 34.0% and 19.3%. Failure analysis separates perception from reasoning: open-weight models are bottlenecked by the multi-speaker audio front-end, while frontier systems still fail speaker-scoped decision making on clean transcripts---and models across the board often respond when no one has addressed them. These results identify speaker-grounded perception, speaker-scoped decision making, and conversational restraint as concrete targets for future voice agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多说话人交互基准 MSI-Bench，用于评估多说话人语音交互，覆盖多说话人记忆、指令遵循和推理，包含中英各576例、共1152个测试用例。
AI.motivation: 语音是 AI 智能体的自然即时接口，但会议、家庭和协作等有用场景本质上是多说话人的，这带来许多一对一交互中不存在的挑战，因此需要专门的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建 MSI-Bench：每个测试用例是短的多方多轮音频场景，包含参与者上下文、预期工具调用和原子评分标准；基准针对三类能力：多说话人记忆、多说话人指令遵循、多说话人推理；共1152例，中英文各576例。
AI.result: 最强配置在英文和中文分别仅通过66.8%和54.5%的全部评分项；最强开源配置分别为34.0%和19.3%。失败分析表明：开源模型受限于多说话人音频前端，前沿系统在干净转写上仍无法做好说话人范围决策，且各类模型常在没有被呼叫时作出响应。
AI.conclusion: 研究将说话人 grounding 感知、说话人范围决策和对话克制确定为未来语音智能体的具体改进目标。

title: AC-DC: Adaptive Communication for Scalable Dynamic Average Consensus in Multi-Robot Ergodic Search
summary: We study scalable peer-to-peer dynamic average consensus (DC) for multi-robot systems under finite-range, finite-rate, and interference-constrained communication. We introduce Adaptive Communication for Dynamic Average Consensus (AC-DC), which jointly adapts Who communicates with whom, When, and over What parts of the consensus state, using local inputs and successfully received neighbor information. Each robot's consensus state estimates the current average of the robots' local inputs. AC-DC updates these estimates as local inputs change and averages the values exchanged between robot pairs. In AC-DC, robot pairs update without waiting for every robot to complete a communication round, and the selected-state messages carry consensus state coordinates independent of team size for a fixed state representation. We apply AC-DC to dynamic-priority multi-robot ergodic search: one consensus stream estimates team visitation for motion coordination, while the other fuses regional measurement information to update uncertainty maps and search targets. Across twelve settings with up to 80 robots and 20 paired trials per setting, AC-DC has the lowest mean (i) normalized covariance-trace area under the curve (AUC) and (ii) attempted modeled communication payload among the compared decentralized methods. Averaged across settings, AC-DC achieves paired AUC reductions of 27.5% relative to state-of-the-art baselines, with 8.7x less communication traffic. As the number of robots increases, we observe that AC-DC's communication payload approaches that of the ideal centralized baseline (one ground compute-station communicating directly with all robots): with 120 robots in a fixed 600 x 600 m scaling test, AC-DC uses 19.3 MB versus 19.2 MB for the ideal centralized baseline, while remaining peer-to-peer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向多机器人系统的可扩展点对点动态平均共识方法 AC-DC，在有限通信范围、有限速率和干扰约束下，联合自适应决定“与谁通信、何时通信、交换共识状态的哪些部分”，并将其用于多机器人遍历搜索任务。
AI.motivation: 多机器人系统需要在通信受限条件下实现可扩展的动态平均共识，以跟踪不断变化的局部输入平均值，同时降低通信负担并维持协调与信息融合性能。
AI.method: AC-DC 利用局部输入和成功接收的邻居信息，自适应选择通信对象、通信时机和交换的共识状态分量；机器人对之间无需等待所有机器人完成一轮通信即可更新。该方法被应用于动态优先级多机器人遍历搜索：一个共识流估计团队访问情况以协调运动，另一个共识流融合区域测量信息以更新不确定性地图和搜索目标。
AI.result: 在最多 80 个机器人、12 种设置、每种设置 20 次配对试验中，AC-DC 在分散式方法中取得了最低的平均归一化协方差迹 AUC 和最低的模拟通信负载；相比先进基线，平均 AUC 降低 27.5%，通信流量减少 8.7 倍。在 600 x 600 m 固定区域的 120 机器人扩展测试中，AC-DC 使用 19.3 MB，接近理想集中式基线的 19.2 MB，同时仍保持点对点通信。
AI.conclusion: AC-DC 能在通信受限的多机器人系统中实现可扩展的动态平均共识，显著提升搜索性能并大幅降低通信量；随着机器人数量增加，其通信负载接近理想集中式方案，但仍保持点对点架构。

title: The Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: We Are Not Probing or Steering Concepts
summary: The Linear Representation Hypothesis associates high-level concepts with directions in language models, but it remains unclear how these concept-related linear structures are organized within the model. We propose the Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: the probability measure induced over answers by the model's continuation distribution organizes these linear structures, with its statistics represented along linear directions shared across questions. All continuations yielding the same answer form an answer basin, whose mass is their total probability. These basin masses define the pushforward probability measure over answers. We posit that concept-related linear structure emerges from differences in the answer measure rather than being determined by changes in concept labels. Experiments across models and tasks link concept-consistent effects and their reversals in probing and steering to the alignment between concept labels and the answer measure.

AI.tldr: 提出答案盆地表示假说，认为语言模型中概念相关的线性结构由模型续写分布诱导的答案概率测度组织，每个答案对应一个答案盆地，其总概率即盆地质量，并构成答案上的推前概率测度。
AI.motivation: 线性表示假说将高层概念与语言模型中的方向关联，但这些概念相关线性结构在模型内部如何组织仍不清楚。
AI.method: 定义答案盆地：所有产生同一答案的续写构成一个盆地，其总概率为盆地质量；这些质量定义答案上的推前概率测度。并在多个模型和任务上开展探测与引导实验，分析概念标签与答案测度之间的对齐关系。
AI.result: 实验将探测和引导中概念一致效应及其反转，与概念标签和答案测度之间的对齐程度联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 概念相关的线性结构可能源于答案测度的差异，而不是由概念标签的变化直接决定。

title: Document Retrieval-Aware Chunking (D-RAC): Universal Retrieval-Aware Ingestion of Enterprise Documents via PDF Normalization and Multimodal Markdown Conversion
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems over enterprise knowledge bases must ingest heterogeneous document formats -- PDFs, Word documents, presentations, and scans -- whose content is locked inside complex visual layouts, multi-column pages, and dense tables. Rule-based extraction and OCR destroy reading order, flatten tables, and lose heading hierarchy, while fully agentic chunking over extracted text incurs high token costs and hallucination risk. We present Document Retrieval-Aware Chunking (D-RAC), an extension of our Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC) framework to arbitrary document formats. D-RAC first normalizes any input document into PDF, exploiting the fact that virtually every format has a faithful, deterministic PDF rendering. A single multimodal LLM pass then converts rendered pages into retrieval-optimized Markdown -- rewriting tables as self-contained prose statements and preserving heading hierarchy -- after which chunking proceeds exactly as in W-RAC: deterministic parsing into ID-addressable units followed by lightweight LLM-based chunk planning over identifiers rather than text. Source text is never regenerated during chunking, preserving W-RAC's cost, determinism, and observability benefits while unlocking every renderable format as a first-class input. On the 236-document, 795-page PDF subset of the RAG-Multi-Corpus benchmark spanning five enterprise domains, D-RAC converts and chunks the entire corpus in 72 minutes with zero errors, producing 1,748 retrieval-ready chunks. Compared to agentic chunking with frontier LLMs, D-RAC reduces chunking-stage output tokens by 95.7%, cutting chunking cost by 77.8% (GPT-4.1 pricing) to 85.6% (Gemini 2.5 Pro pricing) and chunking time by 75%. D-RAC scales linearly to documents of 500+ pages.

AI.tldr: 提出 D-RAC 文档检索感知分块框架，将任意可渲染文档统一转为 PDF，再经多模态 LLM 转成检索优化的 Markdown，最后沿用 W-RAC 的确定性标识符分块与轻量规划，实现低成本、高确定性的企业文档 RAG 预处理。
AI.motivation: 企业知识库中文档格式异构，复杂版面、多栏和表格使传统规则提取与 OCR 破坏阅读顺序、表格结构和标题层级；而全智能体式分块 token 成本高且易产生幻觉。
AI.method: D-RAC 先将任意文档标准化为 PDF，利用各格式均有确定性 PDF 渲染的特性；再用单次多模态 LLM 将页面转为检索优化 Markdown，把表格改写为自包含叙述并保留标题层级；随后按 W-RAC 方式确定性解析为可 ID 寻址单元，并基于标识符而非原文进行轻量 LLM 分块规划，分块时不重新生成源文本。
AI.result: 在 RAG-Multi-Corpus 的 236 文档、795 页 PDF 子集上，D-RAC 72 分钟零错误转换并分块，生成 1748 个检索就绪块；相比前沿 LLM 的智能体分块，分块阶段输出 token 减少 95.7%，成本降低 77.8%（GPT-4.1 定价）至 85.6%（Gemini 2.5 Pro 定价），分块时间减少 75%，并可线性扩展至 500 页以上文档。
AI.conclusion: D-RAC 在保留 W-RAC 成本、确定性和可观测性优势的同时，将任意可渲染文档变为一等信息源，为企业 RAG 提供高效、可扩展且低幻觉风险的文档分块方案。

title: Beyond Visual Quality: A Study of Test-Time Planning with World Action Models
summary: World action models generate actions together with visual predictions of their consequences. These paired outputs create the potential for planning by sampling multiple actions from one state, comparing their imagined outcomes, and choosing the action with the most promising predicted outcome. However, how to use imagined futures to guide action selection remains unclear. We examine this planning potential empirically. First, we estimate an oracle upper bound on selection by choosing the sampled candidate whose realised outcome is best. In a controlled same-state analysis, this choice raises success from 68.9% under uniform random selection to 79.2%. We then test selectors based on visual quality, physical consistency, and task progression as controlled interventions. Some tested selectors yield higher observed success, but the gains are uneven and the matched selectors leave much of the measured opportunity unrecovered. To investigate this gap, we examine whether sampled actions lead to different outcomes, whether these differences are visible in the predictions, and whether a score recognises them. Counterfactual branching from the same states shows that selection opportunity is concentrated in relatively few decisions in the initial candidate sets. Action spread and outcome coverage need not increase together. In a further evaluation across trajectory phases with complete action execution, the tested scores again recover little of the available improvement despite a small gain from learned value. These findings distinguish producing consequential action choices from recognising them in generated futures, motivating the evaluation of WAM predictions through their usefulness for decisions rather than visual quality alone.

AI.tldr: 本文实证考察世界动作模型（WAM）能否利用其生成的未来视觉预测来指导动作选择，发现虽然理论上存在通过采样与选择提升成功率的机会，但当前基于视觉质量、物理一致性或任务进展的选择器只能有限利用这一机会。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型可同时生成动作及其视觉后果预测，这为通过采样多个动作、比较想象结果并选择最优动作提供了规划潜力，但如何利用想象未来指导动作选择仍不明确。
AI.method: 在受控同状态分析中，比较均匀随机选择与基于真实结果最优选择的 oracle 上界；测试基于视觉质量、物理一致性、任务进展以及学习价值等选择器；通过反事实分支分析同一状态下候选动作是否导致不同结果、这些差异是否体现在预测中、以及评分是否能识别差异；并在完整执行动作的轨迹阶段进一步评估。
AI.result: oracle 选择将成功率从均匀随机选择的 68.9% 提升至 79.2%，显示存在选择机会；但受测选择器提升不均匀，且匹配选择器远未恢复全部可测机会。选择机会集中在初始候选集中的少数决策上，动作分布与结果覆盖不一定同步增加。在完整轨迹阶段评估中，受测评分仍只能恢复少量可用提升，学习价值仅带来小幅增益。
AI.conclusion: 生成有后果的动作选择与在生成未来中识别这些选择是不同能力；应通过预测对决策的有用性而非仅凭视觉质量来评估 WAM 预测。

title: Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
summary: Dormant tree pruning is labor-intensive yet essential for maintaining modern high-productivity fruit orchards. In this work, we focus on pruning of modern planar tree training systems - V-Trellis apples and UFO cherries - where trunks and primary branches are trained into approximately planar walls. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline to learn a closed-loop visuomotor controller for robotic pruning. This controller is trained entirely using simulation and synthetically generated data and deployed in real orchards in a zero-shot manner. The pipeline comprises synthetic generation of planar orchard tree meshes, construction of a physics-based orchard simulator, automated collection of successful pruning trajectories via motion planning, and policy learning with a novel hybrid reinforcement-learning algorithm that combines offline demonstrations with online simulated rollouts. The controller uses optical-flow inputs from a wrist-mounted camera - avoiding the need for full 3D-reconstruction - and continuously guides the cutter through cluttered branch environments to a specified cutpoint with correct tool orientation. In exhaustive simulated task-space evaluations over 3,000 pruning points, the policy attains 49.9% success on V-Trellis apples and 46.0% on UFO cherries. We validate the learned controller across 38 physical trials - comprising 28 outdoor field trials in commercial and experimental orchards and 10 indoor laboratory tests - demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. The learned policy also outperforms a classical RRT-Connect baseline on physical hardware in laboratory trials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端管线，用于学习闭环视觉运动控制器以实现机器人修剪。控制器完全通过仿真和合成数据训练，并零样本部署到真实果园。方法包括合成平面果园树网格、物理模拟器、运动规划自动采集修剪轨迹，以及结合离线演示与在线模拟rollout的混合强化学习算法。
AI.motivation: 休眠期修剪劳动密集，但对维持现代高产果园（如V-Trellis苹果和UFO樱桃等平面树形系统）至关重要，因此需要自动化机器人修剪方案。
AI.method: 构建端到端管线：合成生成平面果园树网格、搭建基于物理的果园模拟器、通过运动规划自动收集成功修剪轨迹、使用混合强化学习（离线演示+在线模拟rollout）训练策略。控制器仅依赖腕部相机光流输入，无需完整3D重建，并持续引导切割器在杂乱枝条环境中以正确姿态到达指定切点。
AI.result: 在3000个修剪点的模拟评估中，策略在V-Trellis苹果上成功率为49.9%，UFO樱桃为46.0%。在38次物理试验（28次商业和实验果园室外试验、10次室内实验室测试）中验证了零样本仿真到现实迁移，且学习策略在实验室硬件上优于经典RRT-Connect基线。
AI.conclusion: 证明了仅用仿真和合成数据训练的闭环视觉运动控制器可实现零样本sim-to-real迁移，用于真实果园机器人修剪，并优于经典运动规划基线。

title: Decomposing Error and Style in Automated Clinical Coding
summary: In automated clinical coding, where the label space spans tens of thousands of diagnosis and procedure codes, models are currently evaluated against a single gold annotation, treating any deviation as error. But we find when two teams code the same 110 ACI-Bench encounters, they agree on only 73% of codes (Jaccard similarity) for the same note; even after an independent clinical audit removes erroneous codes, agreement rises only to 77%. Is that gap error or something systematic? We model the systematic component as coding style $ψ$, a coder- or site-specific policy over what to code and how much to document, and recast coding as $p(\mathrm{code}\mid\mathrm{note},ψ)$, estimating $ψ$ with a 10-dimension rubric. If style were noise, conditioning on it would do nothing. Instead, across five datasets a model conditioned with a data-matching style raises ICD F1 by up to 26 points and an extreme mismatched one lowers it by up to 21. Four prompt based coding methods spanning 39-49 F1 converge to 52-56 once style is supplied (All p<0.05). Much of what single-gold evaluation charges to model error is recoverable, unmodeled style.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现自动临床编码评估中，单一金标准会把编码风格差异误判为模型错误；作者将编码风格ψ建模为10维评分规则，并证明在给定风格后，多种编码方法的ICD F1显著提升。
AI.motivation: 临床编码标签空间巨大，现有模型通常只与单一金标准比较，任何偏差都视为错误。但同一病历由不同团队编码时一致性仅73%，临床审核后也仅升至77%，说明差异中可能存在系统性编码风格而非单纯错误。
AI.method: 将编码视为条件概率p(code|note,ψ)，其中ψ表示编码者或机构特定的编码风格政策；用10维评分规则估计ψ；在五个数据集上测试数据匹配风格和极端不匹配风格对ICD F1的影响，并评估四种提示式编码方法在提供风格后的表现。
AI.result: 数据匹配的编码风格可使ICD F1最多提升26个点，极端不匹配风格可使F1最多下降21个点；四种提示式编码方法原本F1为39-49，提供风格后收敛到52-56，且所有p<0.05。
AI.conclusion: 单一金标准评估中很大一部分被归为模型错误的差异，实际上来自未建模的编码风格，这些差异在建模风格后是可恢复的。

title: SPARSER: Sparse Variable Projection by Exploiting Separable Structure in Robotic Perception
summary:
Robotic perception often requires solving large nonlinear least-squares (NLS) problems. While sparsity has been widely exploited to scale solvers, a complementary and underused structure is \emph{separability}: some variables, such as visual landmarks, appear linearly in the residuals and admit a closed-form solution once the remaining variables, such as poses, are fixed. Variable projection (VarPro) exploits this structure by analytically eliminating the linear variables, yielding a reduced problem with favorable computational properties. However, its use in robotic perception has been limited by gauge symmetries, such as invariance to global translations and rotations, which introduce challenges for standard VarPro methods.
  We present SPARSER (\textbf{S}parsity \textbf{P}reserving \textbf{A}nalytic \textbf{R}eduction for \textbf{S}eparable \textbf{R}obotic \textbf{P}erception), a VarPro framework for gauge-symmetric problems that jointly exploits separability and sparsity. Our method constructs a \emph{matrix-free Schur complement operator} for efficient evaluation of reduced costs, gradients, and Hessian-vector products, enabling integration with iterative NLS solvers. We characterize the applicable problem class, identify common cases admitting further analytical simplifications, and show that IRLS-based robust costs preserve most of the exploitable structure.
  Across synthetic and real SLAM, SNL, and SfM benchmarks, SPARSER is on average $5\times$--$7\times$ faster than state-of-the-art baselines on CPU and GPU, with gains exceeding $40\times$ on individual datasets. On outlier-corrupted multi-robot SLAM data, the robust variant is $2\times$--$16\times$ faster than a state-of-the-art GNC solver. We release open-source C++ code and all datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPARSER，一种针对规范对称问题的变量投影框架，联合利用可分离性和稀疏性，通过无矩阵Schur补算子加速非线性最小二乘求解，在SLAM、SNL、SfM等基准上实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 机器人感知中大规模非线性最小二乘问题求解常利用稀疏性，但可分离性（如视觉地标在残差中线性出现）未被充分利用。变量投影(VarPro)可解析消去线性变量，但受规范对称性（全局平移/旋转不变性）限制，难以直接应用。
AI.method: 提出SPARSER框架：针对规范对称问题，构建无矩阵Schur补算子，高效计算约简后的代价、梯度和Hessian-向量积，并与迭代NLS求解器集成；刻画适用问题类别，识别可进一步解析简化的常见情况，并证明基于IRLS的鲁棒代价保留大部分可开发结构。
AI.result: 在合成和真实SLAM、SNL、SfM基准上，SPARSER在CPU和GPU上平均比最先进基线快5-7倍，个别数据集加速超过40倍；在含异常值的多机器人SLAM数据上，鲁棒变体比最先进的GNC求解器快2-16倍。
AI.conclusion: SPARSER有效结合可分离性与稀疏性，解决了规范对称下的VarPro应用难题，显著提升机器人感知中NLS求解效率，并开源了C++代码和数据集。

title: SRPR-Net: Semantic and Relational Prompt Refinement for Automated SAM-based Instance Segmentation
summary: Instance segmentation is a fundamental computer vision task with diverse real-world applications. Recently, prompt-driven foundation models have shown promising generalization. However, automated prompting remains limited by insufficient semantic guidance and inter-instance modeling. To address this challenge, we propose a novel architecture, named Semantic Relational Prompt Refinement Network (SRPR-Net), for automated SAM-based instance segmentation. A sequential prompt refinement mechanism is introduced to enrich detector geometry with visual-language semantics and then incorporate same-image instance dependencies, enabling context-aware box adjustment before SAM segmentation. Experiments on multiple standard benchmarks demonstrate that SRPR-Net achieves consistent improvements in segmentation performance over existing state-of-the-art approaches. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/JeremyXSC/SRPR-Net.

AI.tldr: 提出SRPR-Net，一种基于SAM的自动化实例分割架构，通过语义关系提示细化提升分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有提示驱动基础模型泛化能力强，但自动提示受限于语义引导不足和实例间关系建模欠缺。
AI.method: 设计顺序提示细化机制：先用视觉-语言语义丰富检测器几何信息，再融合同图实例依赖关系，实现SAM分割前的上下文感知框调整。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准上，SRPR-Net相比现有最先进方法取得一致的分割性能提升。
AI.conclusion: SRPR-Net有效解决了自动提示中的语义与实例关系建模问题，提升了基于SAM的实例分割表现，代码已公开。

title: D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model
comment: 26 pages, including references and appendices. Project website: https://nebulis-lab.com/D-JEPA
summary: Latent world models predict the consequences of actions, but accurate prediction does not guarantee that latent distance reflects which candidate will execute successfully. We identify a decision-local prediction gap: among the few futures competing for execution, a candidate predicted closer to the goal can produce a worse realized outcome than an available alternative. We introduce D-JEPA, a decision-aligned latent world model that learns decision-relevant relations among candidate futures from executed outcomes.
