A bounded, permutation-equivariant operator jointly reasons over goal-relative predictive features and ordinal evidence, refining pretrained predictive geometry where action choices are most consequential. Restricted predictor adaptation and a shared ordinal interface extend this alignment across complementary predictive geometries. D-JEPA further realizes the learned decision structure in JEPA-compatible future representations, enabling deployment through native latent-distance planning. Evaluations across latent control, manipulation, pretrained action-producing models, physical robots and autonomous driving demonstrate improved action selection, including 87.89% success on PushT, a 15.04-point average gain on RoboTwin, and a 17-point gain on physical robot tasks. These results establish decision-relevant relational structure as a direct bridge between predictive world modeling and effective control.

AI.tldr: 论文提出D-JEPA，一种决策对齐的潜在世界模型，通过从已执行结果中学习候选未来之间的决策相关关系，弥合预测与决策之间的差距，从而改进动作选择。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型能预测动作后果，但预测准确并不保证潜在距离能反映哪个候选动作会成功执行；存在“决策局部预测差距”——被预测更接近目标的候选未来，实际执行结果可能反而更差。
AI.method: D-JEPA学习已执行结果中候选未来之间的决策相关关系；使用有界、置换等变算子联合推理目标相对预测特征与序数证据，在最关键的动作选择处细化预训练预测几何；通过受限预测器适配和共享序数接口扩展对齐；并在JEPA兼容的未来表示中实现所学决策结构，支持原生潜在距离规划。
AI.result: 在潜在控制、操作、预训练动作生成模型、物理机器人及自动驾驶任务上，动作选择均得到改善：PushT成功率达87.89%，RoboTwin平均提升15.04个百分点，物理机器人任务提升17个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 决策相关的关系结构可作为连接预测世界建模与有效控制的直接桥梁。

title: Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Includes references and appendices
summary: Scientific workflows often require choosing among known relations before a deterministic calculation can proceed. Whether observations share a culture, treatment or reference standard can change the scientific meaning of the resulting count or comparison. We evaluate Jev as a semantic decision component using a harness that follows its documented guidance and assigns arithmetic to code. The study compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded Choices across ten scientific cases, each repeated five times. We measure semantic selections, downstream outputs and final claim labels separately. Jev matched five other configurations at complete semantic correctness and achieved the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Across three comparison models, seven wrong selections on one culture-history question changed downstream counts while preserving the correct final label. These results identify a useful role for Jev in prepared scientific decision tasks and show why evaluating that role requires checking the relations and quantities that a workflow will reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文评估 Jev 作为科学工作流中的语义决策组件，在十个科学案例、二十个 Choices 上比较十二种模型配置，并分别衡量语义选择、下游输出与最终结论标签。
AI.motivation: 科学工作流在确定性计算前常需选择已知关系，例如观察是否共享文化、处理或参考标准；这种选择会改变计数或比较的科学含义，因此需要评估语义决策组件的角色。
AI.method: 构建遵循 Jev 文档指导的 harness，并将算术分配给代码；在 10 个科学案例、20 个 source-grounded Choices 上比较 12 种模型配置，每例重复 5 次，并分别测量语义选择、下游输出和最终 claim 标签。
AI.result: Jev 在完整语义正确性上与另外五种配置持平，并在成功响应中取得最低观测中位延迟；在三个比较模型的一个 culture-history 问题上，七次错误选择改变了下游计数，却仍保留正确的最终标签。
AI.conclusion: Jev 在准备好的科学决策任务中有用，但评估其作用必须检查工作流将要复用的关系和数量，而不能只看最终标签。

title: DolphinBench: Mapping the Pareto Frontier of Agent Memory
summary:
Agents today often take real-world actions that depend on long-term memory and context recall over time. However, most current memory benchmarks are built for a conversational question-answer format, where the question itself signals that some fact must be retrieved, and often which one. Moreover, benchmarks rarely require anything beyond accuracy from submissions, allowing memory systems to make unreasonable cost/time tradeoffs to achieve higher scores.
  We present DolphinBench, a benchmark that evaluates memory directly through an agent's task completion. DolphinBench includes three knowledge-work personas with roughly 500k tokens of user messages per persona and evaluates agents on tasks that depend on information from that history. We verify all 200 tasks per persona by running an agent with and without the relevant history, requiring success with it and failure without it.
  Finally, we require all evaluations to report total cost and latency alongside accuracy, which enables us to evaluate agent memory systems holistically. No existing memory benchmark combines all three. The dataset and evaluation code are available at https://dolphinbench.ai.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DolphinBench，一个通过智能体任务完成情况直接评估长期记忆的基准，强调任务依赖历史信息，并要求同时报告成本、延迟与准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆基准多采用对话问答形式，问题本身已暗示需要检索的事实，且通常只关注准确率，导致记忆系统可能以不合理的成本或时间换取高分，无法全面评估智能体长期记忆能力。
AI.method: 构建包含三个知识工作角色的基准，每个角色约有 50 万 token 的用户消息历史；每个角色设计 200 个依赖该历史的任务。任务通过运行智能体在有相关历史和无相关历史两种条件下验证：有历史需成功，无历史需失败。评估要求同时报告总成本、延迟和准确率。
AI.result: DolphinBench 提供了依赖历史的任务评估方式，并验证了任务确实需要相关记忆。作者指出，现有记忆基准没有同时结合任务完成评估、历史必要性验证以及成本/延迟报告这三个要素。数据集与评估代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: DolphinBench 能够从任务完成、记忆必要性和资源开销三个维度更全面地评估智能体记忆系统，弥补现有基准在真实长期记忆评估上的不足。

title: The Copy Ceiling: An Input-Exposure Control for Ontology-Grounded Generation over Curated Corpora
summary: When a language model answers from a curated corpus via graph-based retrieval, a large grounding uplift does not establish reasoning over the retrieved structure: the context may already expose the gold answers. We propose exposure accounting, which classifies each gold item by whether the shown context exposes it and whether the answer recovers it. Its scalar reference is the copy ceiling, the recall a verbatim copy of the context achieves; signed gain over copy measures the model's recall relative to this deterministic, judge-free baseline. Across ten models, unaided recall averages 0.26 and grounded recall 0.92, yet gain over copy is uniformly negative (-0.067 to -0.022). Of 11,360 gold-item observations, representing 1,136 target instances evaluated under ten models, only three unexposed items receive lexical credit. A stratified model-judged audit of 423 observations, with a symmetric quotation-verification policy, estimates that 97.1% of credited items assert the requested relation; all three unexposed credits fail relational adjudication. On targets the scaffold does not expose, lexical recovery falls from 0.121 unaided to 0.004 grounded; adjudication validates 71 of the 92 unaided credits and none of the three grounded credits, without establishing full-frame relational recovery rates. Rephrasing questions outside the graph's title vocabulary reduces exposure from 0.964 to 0.328, while an absence-triggered fallback activates on only 2 of 506 questions. A paired production study improves judged quality by +0.27 pooled, but negative controls do not establish content specificity beyond a well-formed on-corpus block. These results support exposure accounting as a standing control for corpus-derived evaluations. The accounting distinguishes exposed-item omissions from beyond-exposure recoveries; it does not determine whether reasoning occurred.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“暴露核算”方法，用于检验基于图检索的语料问答中，语言模型的高 grounding 提升是否只是复制了上下文中已暴露的答案。
AI.motivation: 当模型通过图检索从策展语料作答时，较大的 grounding 提升并不能证明模型对检索结构进行了推理，因为上下文本身可能已经暴露了金标答案。
AI.method: 提出 exposure accounting，将每个金标项按上下文是否暴露、答案是否恢复来分类；以 copy ceiling（逐字复制上下文的召回率）为标量参照，用 signed gain over copy 衡量模型相对复制基线的召回。实验覆盖十种模型、11,360 条金标项观测、1,136 个目标实例，并进行分层模型评判审计、引文验证、问题改写、缺失触发回退和配对生产研究。
AI.result: 十种模型上，unaided recall 平均 0.26，grounded recall 0.92，但 gain over copy 全为负（-0.067 至 -0.022）。仅 3 个未暴露项获得词面 crédit；423 条审计观测中 97.1% 被认可项确实断言了所需关系，但 3 个未暴露 crédit 均未通过关系裁定。未暴露目标上，词面恢复从 unaided 0.121 降至 grounded 0.004；裁定验证 92 个 unaided crédit 中的 71 个，grounded 的 3 个为 0。问题改写脱离图标题词汇后，暴露率从 0.964 降至 0.328；缺失触发回退仅对 506 个问题中的 2 个激活。配对生产研究使评判质量合并提升 +0.27，但负控制未能证明内容特异性。
AI.conclusion: 暴露核算可作为语料衍生评估的常设控制，用于区分“暴露项遗漏”和“超出暴露的恢复”；但它并不能判定模型是否真正进行了推理。

title: A Switched Adaptive Control Framework for Aerial Manipulators Under Dynamic Transitions
summary: Aerial manipulators represent the forefront of aerial robotics. Although potentially capable of complex interaction tasks, controlling aerial manipulators throughout the dynamic transitions occurring during task execution presents significant challenges. Abrupt or discontinuous changes in system dynamics generated by the transitions suggest the use of a switched approach, yet the available aerial manipulation methods are not designed for coping with switched regimes. In addition, most available methods fall short in coping with the tight couplings between the aerial vehicle and the manipulator, as well as in coping with the state-dependent uncertainties arising from the difficulty in modeling such couplings. We propose a switched-based adaptive control framework for aerial manipulators not relying on a priori knowledge of the vehicle-manipulator couplings and of state-dependent uncertainties. To guarantee stable manipulation despite changes in system dynamics, the framework provides a class of switching signals characterizing those transition phases for which the system is guaranteed to remain stable. Comparative experiments further validate the effectiveness of the proposed switched-based framework over the state of the art.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于切换的自适应控制框架，用于空中机械臂，无需先验知道飞行器-机械臂耦合与状态相关不确定性，并给出可保证稳定的切换信号。
AI.motivation: 空中机械臂在执行任务时会发生动态切换，现有方法难以处理切换工况、飞行器与机械臂之间的紧密耦合以及状态相关不确定性，因此需要新的控制框架。
AI.method: 采用基于切换的自适应控制方法，设计一类切换信号来刻画过渡阶段，使系统在动态变化下仍保持稳定，且不依赖飞行器-机械臂耦合和状态相关不确定性的先验知识。
AI.result: 对比实验验证了所提出的基于切换的框架优于现有先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效应对空中机械臂任务执行中的动态切换、耦合和不确定性，实现稳定操作。

title: DiaSeg: Diagonal Segment Extraction from DTW Paths for Interpretable Gait Analysis
comment: Accepted for publication in Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery (Springer), September 2026. 28 pages, 4 figures
summary: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is the dominant approach for measuring similarity between time series, yet standard practice discards the optimal warping path after computing a single distance value, losing local alignment information most relevant to clinical diagnosis. We introduce DiaSeg, a framework that extracts diagonal segments from DTW paths with controlled breaks, characterizing each segment by five geometric features (effective length, interruption count, cost variation, temporal position, and path context), and enabling unsupervised pattern discovery without domain-specific feature engineering. Validated on 91 subjects across six clinical conditions (healthy aging, Parkinson's, Huntington's, ALS, brain tumor, and stroke), three findings emerge. First, diagonal segments form consistent unsupervised patterns (silhouette 0.33) aligned with biomechanical phase annotations, with label-based validation confirming near-perfect separation of healthy and pathological gait (ARI up to 0.986). Second, segments discriminate pathology at 69% (supervised) and 75% (patient-level clustering), with pathology manifesting through distributional shifts in segment length; combining segment and cycle-level features further improves classification to 91.7%. Third, while cycle-based methods achieve higher accuracy (91%), diagonal segments provide phase-specific interpretability unavailable in global representations, localizing where coordination breaks down within the gait cycle. DiaSeg thus transforms DTW from a black-box distance into a source of interpretable temporal features for neurodegenerative disease assessment.

AI.tldr: DiaSeg框架从DTW路径中提取对角线段，并提取五个几何特征，用于无监督模式发现和临床诊断，实现可解释的步态分析。
AI.motivation: 标准DTW在计算距离后丢弃最优弯曲路径，导致丢失对临床诊断重要的局部对齐信息。
AI.method: 提出DiaSeg，从DTW路径中提取受控中断的对角线段，用五个几何特征（有效长度、中断次数、成本变化、时间位置和路径上下文）描述每个线段，无需领域特征工程进行无监督模式发现。在91名受试者（六种临床状况：健康衰老、帕金森、亨廷顿、ALS、脑肿瘤和中风）上验证，并比较监督分类、患者级聚类及结合线段和周期级特征。
AI.result: 三个发现：1）对角线段形成一致的无监督模式（轮廓系数0.33），与生物力学相位标注对齐，标签验证显示健康与病理步态近乎完美分离（ARI高达0.986）。2）线段区分病理的准确率：监督69%，患者级聚类75%，病理表现为线段长度分布偏移；结合线段和周期级特征将分类提升至91.7%。3）基于周期的方法准确率更高（91%），但对角线段提供相位特异性可解释性，定位步态周期中协调中断的位置。
AI.conclusion: DiaSeg将DTW从黑箱距离转变为可解释的时间特征来源，用于神经退行性疾病评估。

title: H2RBench: A Real-to-Sim Benchmark for Evaluating Human-to-Robot Transfer
comment: 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), Austin, TX, USA
summary: Learning robot manipulation policies from human video demonstrations constitutes a promising avenue for scalable robot learning. However, comparing different human-to-robot (H2R) transfer methods remains challenging, as existing approaches are evaluated under different settings, including differing task suites, scene layouts, object instances, and amounts of robot supervision. To address this challenge, we present H2RBench, a Real2Sim benchmark for evaluating H2R transfer methods. H2RBench provides a standardized protocol built on real human video demonstrations and simulated robot demonstrations, and includes four manipulation tasks spanning diverse interaction requirements. We evaluate multiple representative H2R transfer methods, each adopting a different strategy for bridging the embodiment gap. Using H2RBench, we systematically characterize how each method scales with the amount of human demonstrations, revealing that methods differ substantially in their ability to leverage additional human data. We further show that simulation performance is broadly predictive of real-world robot performance, with an overall Pearson correlation of r = 0.89, Spearman correlation of \r{ho} = 0.85 and Mean Maximum Rank Violation (MMRV) of 0.06 across method-task configurations. These results establish H2RBench as a practical and scalable benchmark for comparative H2R evaluation prior to real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 H2RBench，一个基于 Real2Sim 的基准，用于在统一条件下评估人类视频到机器人操作策略迁移（H2R）方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 H2R 迁移方法在任务集、场景布局、物体实例和机器人监督量等不同设置下评估，难以公平比较。
AI.method: 构建标准化评估协议，基于真实人类视频演示和仿真机器人演示，涵盖四类具有不同交互需求的操作任务；评估多种代表性 H2R 迁移方法，并分析其随人类演示数据量增加的性能变化。
AI.result: 不同方法利用额外人类数据的能力差异显著；仿真性能与真实机器人性能高度相关，Pearson r=0.89，Spearman ρ=0.85，MMRV=0.06。
AI.conclusion: H2RBench 可作为实际部署前进行 H2R 方法比较评估的实用且可扩展基准。

title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
summary: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences. By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a single input image or text prompt. Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorldCrafter，一种视频世界模型，通过可相机查询的隐式 3D 感知记忆，实现长时间、跨视角一致的交互式场景探索。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型虽能交互式探索动态环境，但难以在长时程和不同视角下持续遵守先前观察到的内容。
AI.method: 学习可相机查询的隐式 3D 感知记忆；让请求视角决定多视角证据如何压缩进视频生成器有限的 token 预算；联合训练记忆编码器与姿态条件读出模块，在去噪前将历史观察整合为固定数量的目标视角特定 token，无需显式深度对应；结合近期时序上下文和少步蒸馏，支持从单张图像或文本提示进行流式场景探索。
AI.result: 在静态和动态场景实验中，WorldCrafter 在长时程一致性和相机控制精度上取得显著提升，同时在分钟级探索中保持视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: WorldCrafter 能有效利用视角相关的隐式 3D 记忆，提升视频世界模型的长时程一致性与相机可控性，并支持流式交互探索。

title: Human-LLM Deliberation as Interactive Proof: Conditions for Verifiability Without Transparency
summary: When an LLM supplies an argument that a user could not readily construct, how can the user decide whether to accept its claim? Inspired by interactive proofs, we model human-LLM deliberation as an interaction between a prover with unrestricted internal search and a resource-bounded human verifier. The verifier requests and checks supporting details without access to the LLM's internal state. Passed checks accumulate evidence toward an acceptance threshold. We prove anytime-valid soundness against adaptive provers: the probability of ever accepting a false claim is at most a chosen error level, provided the task supplies bounds on false passes and human checking errors that remain valid after every relevant history. A finite-horizon completeness bound additionally requires bounds on the adequacy of honest responses and sufficient diagnostic progress. Further checks can strengthen the evidence for acceptance, but each requires another adequate response and reliable human effort. Whether this tradeoff permits certification depends on the verifier's effort budget, cognitive load, expertise, and fatigue. We identify conditions under which the supplied bounds certify a specified sequence of local checks but not a specified global check under the same resource budgets.

AI.tldr: 该文将人-LLM审议建模为不受限搜索的证明者与资源受限的人类验证者之间的交互，借鉴交互式证明：验证者请求并检查支持细节，累积证据至接受阈值。证明自适应证明者下的随时有效可靠性：若任务提供每次相关历史后仍有效的假通过和人类检查错误界限，则接受错误主张的概率至多预设错误水平。有限时域完备性还需诚实回答充分性和诊断进展界限。
AI.motivation: 当LLM给出用户难以自行构造的论证时，用户如何判断是否应接受其主张？研究动机是形式化人类在有限认知资源下验证LLM主张的过程，并分析证据积累与验证成本之间的权衡。
AI.method: 借鉴交互式证明，将人类-LLM审议视为证明者与验证者的交互。证明者有不受限内部搜索，人类验证者资源受限且无法访问LLM内部状态。验证者请求并检查支持细节，通过的检查累积证据至接受阈值。论文给出可靠性、完备性界限，并考虑自适应证明者、假通过界限、人类检查错误、诚实回答充分性、诊断进展以及验证者努力预算、认知负荷、专长和疲劳等因素。
AI.result: 证明随时有效可靠性：在任务提供每次相关历史后仍有效的假通过和人类检查错误界限时，错误接受概率不超过选定错误水平。有限时域完备性需额外满足诚实回答充分性和诊断进展界限。进一步检查可增强接受证据，但每次都需要另一个充分回答和可靠的人类努力。论文还识别出在相同资源预算下，可认证某指定局部检查序列但不能认证某指定全局检查的条件。
AI.conclusion: 该框架表明，人-LLM审议中能否认证主张取决于验证者的努力预算、认知负荷、专长和疲劳等资源条件。通过检查可累积证据，但验证成本也随之增加；局部检查与全局检查在相同资源约束下的可认证性可能不同。

title: DexTacWAM: A Visuo-Tactile World-Action Model for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact dynamics that are often only partially observable from vision. Recent World-Action Models (WAMs) couple predictive video world modeling with action generation, but remain largely vision-centric and therefore cannot directly model these contact dynamics. We present DexTacWAM, a visuo-tactile WAM that encodes each fingertip independently, aggregates the resulting features through a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor, and injects the tactile latent into a video diffusion world model for joint visuo-tactile world modeling. Across six contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on a 22-DoF bimanual platform, DexTacWAM achieves the highest score on every task, averaging 70.6 versus 38.0 for the strongest baseline. Ablations attribute the gain to modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state rather than tactile conditioning alone: removing tactile world modeling reduces the four-task mean from 74.7 to 26.6 while keeping the same tactile features and action expert. After four hours of tactile-encoder adaptation with a frozen pretrained vision VAE, our continual vision-to-touch learning extends the pretrained video model to touch using roughly 100 demonstrations per task without tactile midtraining, while retaining visual prediction quality within 0.5 dB of vision-only counterparts. The compressor retains 89.4% of pre-fusion contact recall while enabling 2.26x faster training and 1.29x faster inference. Together, these results show that pretrained video priors can be extended to distributed multi-finger contact dynamics in a data- and compute-efficient manner.

AI.tldr: 提出DexTacWAM，一种视觉-触觉世界动作模型，通过将触觉潜在表示注入视频扩散世界模型，实现接触丰富的灵巧操作，在六个任务上平均得分70.6，远超基线38.0。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作依赖接触动力学，而视觉往往只能部分观测。现有世界动作模型（WAMs）主要基于视觉，无法直接建模接触动力学。
AI.method: 独立编码每个指尖，通过手指和姿态感知的触觉压缩器聚合特征，将触觉潜在表示注入视频扩散世界模型进行联合视觉-触觉世界建模。采用持续视觉到触觉学习，冻结预训练视觉VAE，仅需每任务约100个演示适应触觉编码器。
AI.result: 在22自由度双臂平台的六个接触丰富任务上均获最高分，平均70.6 vs 最强基线38.0。消融显示，移除触觉世界建模使四任务平均从74.7降至26.6。压缩器保留89.4%接触召回率，训练加速2.26倍，推理加速1.29倍。视觉预测质量与纯视觉模型相差0.5 dB以内。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视频先验能以数据和计算高效的方式扩展到分布式多指接触动力学。

title: ToneCL: Contrastive Learning for Few-Shot Syllable-Level Tone Classification
summary: Tone languages constitute over 50-70% of the world's languages, but the vast majority are low-resource, lacking the large transcribed corpora needed for automatic tone classification. Existing datasets are typically collected at the sentence level, whereas field linguists require fine-grained syllable-level annotations. We propose ToneCL, a lightweight contrastive learning framework for few-shot syllable-level tone classification. We simulate low-resource conditions on Mandarin and Vietnamese, limiting labeled data to tens of examples per tone class. ToneCL is pretrained on unlabeled speech with augmentations that preserve tonal identity, then fine-tuned on few-shot examples. Experiments show our method consistently outperforms baselines, achieving 91.6% on six-speaker Mandarin at 10 shots. Cross-lingual transfer is also effective: pretraining on Vietnamese and fine-tuning on Mandarin reaches 91.0\% accuracy at 10 shots. Ablation confirms that frequency band rejection is the most critical augmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出ToneCL，一种轻量级对比学习框架，用于小样本音节级声调分类，在低资源条件下表现优异并支持跨语言迁移。
AI.motivation: 声调语言占全球语言的50-70%，但大多为低资源语言，缺乏大规模转写语料用于自动声调分类；现有数据集多为句子级，而田野语言学家需要细粒度的音节级标注。
AI.method: ToneCL采用对比学习，先在无标注语音上利用保持声调特性的增强进行预训练，再在小样本标注数据上微调；在普通话和越南语上模拟低资源场景（每声调仅数十例），并进行消融实验。
AI.result: 在六说话人普通话10-shot设置下达到91.6%准确率，优于基线；跨语言迁移（越南语预训练、普通话微调）10-shot达到91.0%；消融表明频带剔除是最关键的增强方法。
AI.conclusion: ToneCL能有效实现低资源小样本音节级声调分类，跨语言迁移有效，频带剔除增强对性能至关重要。

title: SocioVerse2: A Longitudinal Dynamic Social Simulation Framework under a Human-AI Co-evolutionary Paradigm
summary: Social simulation offers the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot supply, and generative agents have transformed it by acting as silicon samples that unite agent-based modeling with real behavioral data. Existing platforms verify collective behavior, align simulated populations with real societies in cross-sections, and employ autonomous agents for the research process. However, two social science requirements remain without systematic support: intervention in the content of a simulation and the researcher's control over the process that produces it. We present SocioVerse2, which extends SocioVerse 1.0 into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm built from two loops and one infrastructure. The longitudinal simulation loop simulates the target population with evolving environments and forks counterfactual branches via interventions. The controllable research loop takes the study itself as an editable state and updates state versions via controllable editing. The social science agentic infrastructure carries both loops through composable skills with researcher checkpoints, a population service over five persona pools, and an environment service over 21 real-world signal sources with point-in-time guarantees. We validate SocioVerse2 across three case families and seven case studies, from reproducing canonical agent-based models to modeling policy processes on real records and nowcasting macro-economic indices beyond the response model's knowledge cutoff. With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions in their respective disciplines. Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-source resources.

AI.tldr: 提出 SocioVerse2，将 SocioVerse 1.0 扩展为“人类—AI 共同演化”范式，由纵向模拟循环、可控研究循环和社科智能体基础设施组成，支持干预模拟内容并让研究者控制研究过程。
AI.motivation: 社会模拟能为社会科学提供现实世界难以提供的实验工具，生成式智能体使其可作为“硅样本”结合真实行为数据；但现有平台缺乏对模拟内容进行干预和研究者对生成过程进行控制的系统支持。
AI.method: 构建两个循环和一个基础设施：纵向模拟循环用演化环境模拟目标人群，并通过干预分叉反事实分支；可控研究循环将研究本身视为可编辑状态，通过可控编辑更新状态版本；社科智能体基础设施提供带研究者检查点的可组合技能、覆盖五个角色池的人口服务，以及基于21个真实世界信号源并具时点保证的环境服务。
AI.result: 在三个案例族、七个案例研究中验证 SocioVerse2，包括复现经典基于智能体模型、基于真实记录建模政策过程，以及预测超出响应模型知识截止点的宏观经济指标。
AI.conclusion: 人类—AI 共同演化范式使这些案例超越系统演示，成为探讨各自学科前沿问题的实质性研究；代码、数据服务和工作台已作为开源资源发布。

title: GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay
comment: We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Github Repo: https://github.com/TencentARC/GameHorizon & Project Page: https://gamehorizon-suite.github.io
summary: Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different horizons for diverse model families. GameHorizon Suite consists of three components. First, GameHorizon-Annotator is a scalable and automated annotation pipeline for multi-horizon instructions. Second, utilizing the pipeline, we construct GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset with temporally aligned videos, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions. It comprises 5,000 hours of recordings from 21 games, collected by 100 human expert players. Third, we build GameHorizon-Bench with reproducible offline and stepwise online testing. The offline track enables reproducible evaluation using thousands of standardized questions organized into three primary tasks and a series of diagnostic variants, while the online track tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay capabilities and localizes failures to specific steps within long-horizon gameplay. Based on our GameHorizon Suite, we evaluate 47 models through more than one million model invocations, revealing a meaningful hierarchy of task difficulty and pronounced differences in model capabilities. Our work can provide a standardized yardstick for evaluating gameplay capabilities across horizons and model families. We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GameHorizon，一个统一的数据与评测套件，用于衡量不同模型家族在不同时间跨度上的游戏能力，包含自动标注器、大规模游戏数据集和多层次基准，并系统评测了47个模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频游戏数据集和基准要么覆盖游戏范围窄，要么缺少语言指令，要么依赖高方差的在线 rollout，难以系统评估AI在视觉理解、指令分解、目标规划和精确动作控制等多时间跨度上的游戏能力。
AI.method: 构建 GameHorizon Suite 三部分：1）GameHorizon-Annotator，可扩展的自动化多跨度指令标注流水线；2）GameHorizon-Data，首个大规模AAA游戏数据集，含5000小时、21款游戏、100名专家玩家的时间对齐视频、玩家动作和多跨度指令；3）GameHorizon-Bench，提供可复现离线评测和逐步在线测试，离线含数千标准化问题、三类主任务及诊断变体，在线验证离线分数并定位长程游戏失败步骤。基于该套件评测47个模型，超百万次调用。
AI.result: 评测揭示出有意义的任务难度层级，以及不同模型能力之间的显著差异；在线测试可检验离线分数是否反映真实游戏能力，并定位长程 gameplay 中的具体失败步骤。
AI.conclusion: GameHorizon 为跨时间跨度和跨模型家族的游戏能力评估提供了标准化标尺，并将发布数据集、标注器和基准以促进未来研究。

title: Minimum Time Trajectories for a Car-Like Mobile Robot Moving with Rigid Wheels Under Non-Sliding Constraints
summary: This paper studies the minimum time trajectoriesvof a car-like mobile robot navigating in an obstacle free environment. The robot, with forward and backward speeds, is controlled by bounded front-wheels acceleration and limited front-wheels steering rate. The paper extends previous results which solved this problem for the kinematic car-like robot. However, the kinematic model assumes pure rolling at the wheels ground contacts. This assumption requires non-sliding constraints for the front and rear wheels that can only be handled by the robot dynamics. This paper formulates the non-sliding constraints based on the robot dynamics then augments the kinematic model time-optimal path primitives with three new path primitives associated with the non-sliding constraints. The three non-sliding path primitives together with the kinematic model twelve path primitives form the car-like robot time optimal trajectories. Approximate analytic solutions for the non-sliding path primitives are also provided. Examples study the time-optimal path primitives along representative maneuvers, illustrating how the non-sliding constraints influence the time optimal trajectories of the car-like robot.

AI.tldr: 研究无障环境下可前进后退的类车机器人最小时间轨迹，在运动学时间最优路径基元基础上引入动力学非滑动约束，新增三个非滑动路径基元并给出近似解析解，通过示例分析其对时间最优轨迹的影响。
AI.motivation: 已有类车机器人时间最优轨迹研究多基于运动学模型，并假设车轮纯滚动，忽略了只能由动力学处理的前后轮非滑动约束；为获得更符合实际的时间最优轨迹，需要将非滑动约束纳入模型。
AI.method: 基于机器人动力学建立非滑动约束，扩展运动学模型的时间最优路径基元，新增三个与非滑动约束相关的路径基元，并推导这些非滑动路径基元的近似解析解，最后用代表性机动示例进行分析。
AI.result: 得到由运动学模型十二个路径基元与三个非滑动路径基元共同构成的类车机器人时间最优轨迹；提供了非滑动路径基元的近似解析解；示例表明非滑动约束会影响时间最优轨迹的形态。
AI.conclusion: 将动力学非滑动约束引入运动学时间最优路径基元框架，可更完整地描述类车机器人的时间最优轨迹，且非滑动约束对实际时间最优机动具有不可忽略的影响。

title: Hierarchical Prompt Learning for Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
summary: Hyperbolic vision-language models (VLMs) represent image and text features in a geometry naturally suited to hierarchy, but their adaptation to downstream tasks has largely relied on fixed prompts. Existing prompt learning methods, meanwhile, treat class labels as a flat set and do not exploit available taxonomic structure. We address this gap with a hierarchical prompt learning plug-in for frozen hyperbolic VLMs. Given a fixed offline parent-class hierarchy, it augments a class prompt learner with a separate parent prompt learner, parent-level supervision, hyperbolic entailment regularization, and parent-feedback logit fusion. We instantiate the method with CoOp, CoCoOp and MaPLe, yielding HyPLO, CoHyPLO and MaHyPLO. Across the standard 11-dataset benchmark, all variants improve base-to-new generalization and cross-dataset transfer, and remain comparable to their prompt learning baselines under domain shift. Six hierarchical metrics and embedding analyses show that the method produces more taxonomically consistent predictions and induces a hierarchy-consistent organization of parent, class, and image embeddings in hyperbolic space. Its gains are largest when novel classes must be placed within a fixed taxonomy, and smallest for fine-grained confusions among sibling classes or shifts affecting only the image distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于冻结双曲视觉-语言模型的分层提示学习插件，通过引入父类层级信息增强类提示学习，提升基类到新类泛化与跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 双曲视觉-语言模型天然适合表示层级结构，但其下游任务适配主要依赖固定提示；现有提示学习方法将类标签视为扁平集合，未利用可用的分类层级结构。
AI.method: 给定固定的离线父类层级，在类提示学习器基础上增加独立的父提示学习器、父级监督、双曲蕴含正则化和父反馈logit融合。以CoOp、CoCoOp、MaPLe实例化，得到HyPLO、CoHyPLO和MaHyPLO。
AI.result: 在标准11数据集基准上，所有变体均提升基类到新类泛化和跨数据集迁移，在域偏移下与提示学习基线相当。六种层级指标和嵌入分析表明，该方法产生更符合分类学一致性的预测，并在双曲空间中形成父类、类、图像嵌入的层级一致组织。增益在需要将新类放入固定分类体系时最大，在兄弟类间细粒度混淆或仅影响图像分布的偏移时最小。
AI.conclusion: 分层提示学习插件能有效利用层级结构改进双曲视觉-语言模型的提示学习，生成层级一致的表示与预测，但其增益取决于任务对层级结构的需求程度。

title: Linguistic Features for Interpretable Textual Entailment
summary: Despite the success of neural models in natural language processing, their black-box nature limits interpretability and conceals the linguistic phenomena underlying their predictions. We present SLITE, an explainable hybrid model for Recognizing Textual Entailment that integrates two complementary layers of semantic analysis: a structural-relational layer, based on semantic compatibility and incompatibility between compositional entities, and a distributional-informational layer, based on structured patterns of information change between embedding-based representations of the premise and the hypothesis. We propose 17 features that combine entity-level semantic relations, polarity-sensitive lexical matching, and alignment measures over semantic sub-representations of the similarity matrix, including measures based on entropy and transfer entropy. A logistic regression trained on these features achieves an accuracy of 83% on three-class SICK and 96% on SICK-CE, outperforming IsoLex by 4 percentage points and falling within 2 percentage points of RoBERTa with a fraction of its computational complexity. Ablation studies and SHAP analysis confirm that structural-relational features are the primary drivers of classification, while distributional-informational features provide essential complementary contributions, particularly for detecting neutrality and contradiction. Our results demonstrate that further exploration of hybrid approaches is a viable and scientifically productive alternative to massive neural architectures, and we hope they will strengthen the dialogue between linguistic theory and computational modeling of inference

AI.tldr: 提出可解释混合模型SLITE用于文本蕴含识别，结合结构关系层和分布式信息层，提取17个特征，在SICK和SICK-CE上分别达到83%和96%准确率，性能接近RoBERTa但计算量小得多。
AI.motivation: 神经模型在NLP中成功但黑箱特性限制可解释性，隐藏了预测背后的语言现象，需要开发可解释且高效的混合方法。
AI.method: SLITE模型包含结构关系层（基于组合实体间的语义兼容/不兼容）和分布式信息层（基于嵌入表示间的结构化信息变化模式）。提取17个特征，涵盖实体级语义关系、极性敏感词汇匹配、相似度矩阵子表示的熵和转移熵等对齐度量，使用逻辑回归训练。
AI.result: 在三分类SICK上准确率83%，SICK-CE上96%，比IsoLex高4个百分点，比RoBERTa低2个百分点但计算复杂度低得多。消融和SHAP分析表明结构关系特征是分类主要驱动，分布式信息特征提供必要补充，尤其检测中性和矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 进一步探索混合方法是替代大规模神经架构的可行且科学有效的选择，有助于加强语言理论与推理计算建模的对话。

title: Classifier-Free Guidance in Flow Matching: Non-Autonomous Potentials, Overshoot, and Posterior-Mean Control
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) improves conditional generation in Flow Matching, but strong guidance can distort the generated distribution and reduce diversity. We provide a geometric account of this behavior by viewing Flow Matching as a time-varying gradient flow and characterizing how CFG reshapes its underlying potential. This view explains how stronger alignment can be accompanied by mean displacement and trajectory concentration, and motivates controlling guidance through the model-implied terminal posterior mean. We therefore propose Posterior-Mean-Capped CFG (PMC-CFG), a training-free, per-sample method that adaptively retains the strongest feasible guidance without additional network evaluations. Experiments on synthetic and large-scale image-generation benchmarks show that PMC-CFG limits guidance-induced distortion and concentration while improving the alignment--diversity trade-off, with particularly strong benefits when nominal guidance is large.

AI.tldr: 本文从几何角度分析Flow Matching中无分类器引导（CFG）导致分布失真和多样性下降的机制，并提出无需训练的PMC-CFG方法，通过模型隐含的终端后验均值自适应控制引导强度，改善对齐-多样性权衡。
AI.motivation: 强CFG虽提升条件对齐，但会扭曲生成分布、降低多样性；现有方法缺乏对这种现象的几何解释和有效控制。
AI.method: 将Flow Matching视为时变梯度流，刻画CFG对潜在势能的重塑；基于模型隐含的终端后验均值，提出PMC-CFG——一种无需训练、逐样本自适应保留最强可行引导的方法，且不增加网络评估。
AI.result: 在合成和大型图像生成基准上，PMC-CFG限制了引导引起的失真和轨迹集中，改善了对齐-多样性权衡，尤其在名义引导强度较大时收益显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何视角理解CFG，并以后验均值封顶引导强度，可在不牺牲对齐的情况下提升生成多样性和分布质量。

title: onPanda: Efficient Annotation of On-Policy Alignment Data for LLMs and Agents via Token-Level Correction
summary: We present onPanda, an interactive tool for efficiently annotating LLM alignment data and agent trajectories. onPanda adopts token-level correction as its core interaction: while reading a model response, the annotator locates the first inappropriate token and either picks a substitute from the model's candidate tokens or types the correct text via free-form editing. The system then truncates everything after that position and continues generation from the corrected prefix, repeating this locate-correct-continue loop until a satisfactory response is obtained. This mechanism lets annotators precisely steer model outputs at low cost: a small controlled study suggests that onPanda reduces median annotation time by 52% over manual post-editing. Since the vast majority of tokens in the final response are generated by the model itself, the resulting data largely preserves the model's sampling distribution and is well suited for constructing on-policy SFT and preference data. Furthermore, the token-level corrections recorded during annotation provide fine-grained supervision with precise positions and naturally paired positive--negative samples. onPanda also connects to external tools and harnesses, enabling interactive trajectory annotation in realistic environments. In addition, we release Panda-CVL, a dataset annotated with onPanda, together with a benchmark for token-level correction.

AI.tldr: onPanda 是一个交互式工具，用于高效标注 LLM 对齐数据和智能体轨迹，核心是 token 级修正：标注者定位第一个不合适的 token，选择替代或自由编辑，系统截断后续并继续生成，循环直至满意。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 对齐数据标注和智能体轨迹标注效率低、成本高，且难以保留模型采样分布以构建 on-policy 数据。
AI.method: 采用 token 级修正交互：定位首个不当 token，从候选 token 中选择或自由输入正确文本，截断后续内容并从修正前缀继续生成，重复“定位-修正-继续”循环；同时连接外部工具和环境，支持轨迹标注。
AI.result: 小规模对照研究表明，onPanda 将中位标注时间较手动后编辑减少 52%；生成的最终响应大部分 token 由模型自身生成，保留了采样分布，适合构建 on-policy SFT 和偏好数据；记录 token 级修正提供细粒度监督和自然配对的正负样本；发布了 Panda-CVL 数据集及 token 级修正基准。
AI.conclusion: onPanda 能低成本精确引导模型输出，高效生成高质量对齐数据，并支持真实环境下的轨迹标注，配套数据集和基准有助于推动 token 级修正研究。

title: PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control
summary: Diffusion models offer flexible motion generation, but translating this flexibility into feedback-responsive humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical systems steer motion through references that may exceed a separate tracker's capabilities, leaving recovery and physical execution largely to the tracker. Action-only diffusion generates actions directly but lacks an explicit future-state trajectory for test-time motion objectives. Joint state-action diffusion provides this representation, yet representative controllers often depend on privileged full-body states, and support for learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remains fragmented. We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion policy that brings these complementary steering capabilities into one directly executed policy using proprioceptive observations. Conditioned on proprioceptive history and optional task context, PredActor jointly generates executable actions and an internal future-state trajectory. Classifier-free guidance strengthens text-conditioned behavior, while classifier guidance steers predicted states toward test-time objectives. Only actions are executed, without a separate motion-reference tracker or externally estimated full-body states as policy inputs. In simulation, PredActor reaches all 15 destination targets and achieves a text retrieval score of 0.580, compared with 0.373 for conditional action diffusion, with similar observed disturbance survival. To make this guided policy practical onboard, rolling denoising and computation-preserving runtime optimizations reduce the complete callback to 16.790 ms median and 19.383 ms p95 on a Jetson Orin NX, both below the 20 ms control period. We deploy PredActor on a Unitree G1; evaluations across simulation and physical hardware demonstrate text-conditioned motion, disturbance response, joystick control, and semantic interpolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PredActor，一种基于本体感觉的预测式动作扩散策略，可同时生成可执行动作和内部未来状态轨迹，并在仿真与 Unitree G1 实机上实现文本条件运动、扰动响应、手柄控制和语义插值。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在动作生成中具有灵活性，但用于反馈响应式人形控制仍面临挑战：分层系统依赖可能超出跟踪器能力的参考轨迹，动作扩散缺乏显式未来状态轨迹，联合状态-动作扩散又常依赖特权全身状态，且行为选择与测试时运动引导能力分散。
AI.method: PredActor 以本体感觉历史与可选任务上下文为条件，联合生成可执行动作和内部未来状态轨迹；使用无分类器引导增强文本条件行为，使用分类器引导将预测状态导向测试时目标；仅执行动作，无需单独运动参考跟踪器或外部估计全身状态作为策略输入；并通过滚动去噪和计算保持优化实现实时运行。
AI.result: 仿真中，PredActor 到达全部 15 个目标点，文本检索得分 0.580，高于条件动作扩散的 0.373，扰动生存表现相近。在 Jetson Orin NX 上，完整回调中位数为 16.790 ms，p95 为 19.383 ms，均低于 20 ms 控制周期。在 Unitree G1 上部署后，仿真与实机评估展示了文本条件运动、扰动响应、手柄控制和语义插值。
AI.conclusion: PredActor 将互补的引导能力统一到一个直接执行、仅依赖本体感觉的策略中，无需独立跟踪器和特权全身状态，并可在 onboard 计算约束下实现实用的人形机器人反馈响应控制。

title: IMPLICIT-Bench: Measuring Implicit Bias in Text-to-Image Models under Neutral Prompts
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models are typically evaluated for bias using slot-based templates such as ``a photo of a [profession]''. Such templates probe only \emph{explicit} demographic attributes (e.g., gender, skin tone) in isolation. They overlook a broader \emph{implicit} bias that arises in natural prompts: when stereotype-relevant attributes are left unspecified, models still default to stereotypical outputs. We introduce IMPLICIT-Bench, a benchmark for measuring implicit bias in T2I models under such prompts. The key design is a structured-knowledge-graph (KG) construction of controlled prompt triplets: neutral, stereotype, and anti-stereotype variants that differ only along a single bias dimension while preserving scene semantics. This enables precise attribution of bias effects that template benchmarks cannot achieve. IMPLICIT-Bench comprises 5,493 prompts across 11 bias categories, validated through multi-model agreement, CLIP-based verification, and human evaluation. Using this benchmark, we show that state-of-the-art T2I models exhibit systematic bias under neutral prompts, a failure mode largely invisible to existing evaluations. We then use IMPLICIT-Bench to evaluate debiasing methods, uncovering a fundamental trade-off between bias reduction and semantic fidelity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出IMPLICIT-Bench，一个衡量文本到图像（T2I）模型在自然提示下隐含偏见的基准。它通过知识图谱构建受控提示三元组（中性、刻板印象、反刻板印象），覆盖11个偏见类别共5,493个提示，揭示了现有评估忽视的系统性偏见，并发现去偏方法在减少偏见与保持语义保真度之间存在权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型偏见评估主要使用基于槽位的模板（如“一张[职业]的照片”），仅探测显式、孤立的人口统计属性（如性别、肤色），忽略了自然提示中更广泛的隐含偏见：当刻板印象相关属性未指定时，模型仍默认输出刻板印象内容。
AI.method: 引入IMPLICIT-Bench，关键设计是基于结构化知识图谱（KG）构建受控提示三元组：中性、刻板印象和反刻板印象变体，仅在一个偏见维度上不同且保持场景语义。基准包含11个偏见类别下的5,493个提示，并通过多模型一致性、CLIP验证和人工评估进行验证。
AI.result: 使用该基准发现，最先进的T2I模型在中性提示下表现出系统性偏见，这是现有评估几乎无法察觉的失败模式。评估去偏方法时，揭示了偏见减少与语义保真度之间的基本权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了有效测量T2I模型隐含偏见的基准，揭示了现有评估的盲点，并指出了去偏方法中偏见减少与语义保真度之间的权衡。

title: NeuIDO: Neural Intrinsic Dynamics Operator for Physics-Informed 4D World Models
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026; Project Page: https://github.com/JiajingLin/NeuIDO
summary: World models aim to capture environmental dynamics and predict future trajectories, showing growing potential for embodied intelligence. Physics-informed 4D generation integrates physical simulation to predict 3D object interactions, offering a promising pathway toward world models. However, this paradigm relies on manually imposed dynamical assumptions rather than internalizing world dynamics, and thus still leaves a gap toward a true world model. To bridge this gap, we propose NeuIDO, a novel world dynamics modeling framework that learns a unified intrinsic dynamics representation from visual observations, advancing physics-informed 4D generation toward a world model. Specifically, we formulate world modeling as a neural operator learning problem and introduce a two-stage training strategy to learn a generalizable mapping from the visual observation distribution to the intrinsic dynamics distribution. Building on this observation-dynamics mapping, NeuIDO enables zero-shot dynamics inference directly from videos and can be further aligned with complex real-world dynamics via few-shot adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuIDO effectively unifies the intrinsic dynamics underlying diverse visual observations into a shared representation and rapidly infers dynamics in novel scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeuIDO，一种从视觉观测中学习统一内在动力学表征的世界动力学建模框架，将物理信息驱动的4D生成推进为真正的世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有物理信息4D生成依赖人工设定的动力学假设，未能内化世界动力学，因此与真正的世界模型仍有差距。
AI.method: 将世界建模形式化为神经算子学习问题，采用两阶段训练策略，学习从视觉观测分布到内在动力学分布的通用映射，并支持零样本动力学推断与少样本适应。
AI.result: 实验表明，NeuIDO能够将不同视觉观测背后的内在动力学统一到共享表征中，并快速推断新场景中的动力学。
AI.conclusion: NeuIDO通过学习统一内在动力学表征，弥合了物理信息4D生成与世界模型之间的差距，实现了零样本和少样本动力学建模。

title: HappyWorld-Bench
summary: Evaluating world models requires assessing both the quality of the worlds they generate and their consistency and responsiveness under exploration, interaction, and modification. We introduce HappyWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates whether generated worlds remain reliable as agents interact with them. Our design is built on a hierarchical capability framework of six world capabilities (W1-W6), from generative construction to unified world modeling, instantiated across three independent evaluation tracks: video world models, spatial world models, and embodied world models. HappyWorld-Bench comprises 1,138 video prompts, 300 spatial scenes, and 254 embodied test cases. Across all three tracks, we build and operate HappyWorld-Arena to organize human A/B comparisons and derive model-level Elo ratings, which complement newly designed automated metrics that capture behavioral correctness. We evaluate 14 video world models, 9 spatial systems, and 8 embodied candidates under this unified framework. Results reveal remaining reliability gaps across all three tracks: video models exhibit reduced consistency during extended rollouts and revisits, spatial models achieve at best 70.14% placement accuracy and 73.33% edit execution, and embodied models struggle to preserve state across multi-step actions and respond precisely to altered action conditions and physical rules. These findings highlight the need to evaluate world models not only by visual quality, but also by state consistency and the correctness of their responses to actions and interventions.

AI.tldr: 提出 HappyWorld-Bench 综合基准，从视频、空间和具身三条轨道评估世界模型在交互、探索与修改下的可靠性，结合人评 Elo 与自动指标，并揭示各类模型仍存在明显可靠性差距。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多关注世界模型的生成质量或视觉质量，而忽视其在交互、探索和修改过程中是否保持一致、可靠并正确响应动作与干预。
AI.method: 基于六类世界能力的分层框架 W1-W6，构建视频、空间、具身三条评测轨道，包含 1,138 个视频提示、300 个空间场景和 254 个具身测试用例；通过 HappyWorld-Arena 进行人类 A/B 比较并得出模型级 Elo，同时设计自动指标衡量行为正确性；共评估 14 个视频世界模型、9 个空间系统和 8 个具身候选。
AI.result: 三类轨道均存在可靠性不足：视频模型在长时 rollout 和重访时一致性下降；空间模型最高仅达到 70.14% 放置准确率和 73.33% 编辑执行率；具身模型在多步动作中难以保持状态，且对改变的动作条件和物理规则响应不够精确。
AI.conclusion: 评估世界模型不能只看视觉质量，还必须考察状态一致性以及其响应动作和干预的正确性；当前世界模型在这些方面仍有显著可靠性差距。

title: Range-Aided SLAM Initialization Exploiting Accurate Heading Information
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, accepted to OCEANS 2026 MTS/IEEE Conference and Exhibition
summary: This paper presents a novel initialization method for range-aided simultaneous localization and mapping (RA-SLAM). The general SLAM problem has a well-known separable structure where landmark and robot positions can be solved for in a linear fashion given known robot headings. This paper considers the case where highly accurate heading information is available, which is typical of autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) navigation, to solve for the range transponder and robot positions. The proposed approach consists of two steps. First, using a generalized trust region subproblem (GTRS), the positions of the transponders relative to the AUV are solved for given the nonlinear range measurements. Second, the relative transponder positions and the known heading of the AUV are used to estimate the transponder and AUV positions by solving a linear least-squares problem. These transponder and AUV position estimates, combined with the highly accurate heading information, provide a reliable initialization method for the general nonlinear RA-SLAM problem. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is tested on a real-world AUV dataset where long baseline (LBL) range measurements are provided in concert with highly accurate heading information provided by an inertial navigation system (INS).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向距离辅助同时定位与建图（RA-SLAM）的新型初始化方法，利用高精度航向信息分两步求解应答器与AUV位置。
AI.motivation: 通用SLAM具有可分离结构，在已知机器人航向时地标与机器人位置可线性求解；AUV导航通常可提供高精度航向信息，因此需要一种可靠的RA-SLAM初始化方法。
AI.method: 方法分两步：首先在给定非线性距离测量下，利用广义信赖域子问题（GTRS）求解应答器相对AUV的位置；然后结合相对应答器位置和已知AUV航向，通过线性最小二乘估计应答器与AUV位置。
AI.result: 在真实AUV数据集上验证，该数据集同时提供长基线（LBL）距离测量和惯性导航系统（INS）提供的高精度航向信息，结果表明所提方法有效。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法结合应答器与AUV位置估计及高精度航向信息，可为一般非线性RA-SLAM问题提供可靠的初始化。

title: CAST: Collision-Aware Assembly with Construction Robots using Simultaneous Trajectory Estimation and Planning
summary: Multi-robot systems have shown increasing viability in construction due to their ability to execute high-precision actions while reducing human exposure to hazardous tasks. However, these environments have high-dimensional configuration spaces and possess substantial collision-avoidance constraints, which include other robots, assembly objects, and workspace boundaries. We utilize a single factor graph for trajectory estimation and planning that incorporates measured robot states together with explicit collision and learned cable constraints. This supports changing workspaces and enables synchronized, high-dimensional robot motion planning while accounting for the stiff, vibration-induced uncertainty of heavy robotic systems. We demonstrate the success of our framework on the construction of a post-and-lintel structure using one robot arm as a timber gripper, and a second robot as a nail-fastener.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于多机器人施工的因子图轨迹估计与规划框架，融合实测机器人状态、显式碰撞约束和学习线缆约束，实现高维同步运动规划，并完成柱梁结构建造演示。
AI.motivation: 多机器人系统可高精度施工并减少人员暴露于危险任务，但施工环境具有高维配置空间，且需处理机器人、装配对象和工作空间边界之间的碰撞约束，同时还要应对重型机器人系统因刚性引起的振动不确定性。
AI.method: 使用单一因子图统一进行轨迹估计与规划，将实测机器人状态、显式碰撞约束和学习到的线缆约束结合；支持变化的工作空间，实现同步、高维机器人运动规划，并考虑重型机器人系统的振动不确定性。
AI.result: 在柱梁结构建造任务中成功验证该框架：一台机械臂作为木材抓取器，另一台机器人作为钉钉紧固器。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效应对多机器人施工中的高维规划、碰撞约束、线缆约束和振动不确定性，并适用于动态工作空间中的实际建造任务。

title: AnalogDepth: Multi-view Geometry from FPV drones under Analog Video Transmission
summary:
Analog video transmission (VTX) remains widespread in FPV drones due to low latency, weight and low cost. However analog VTX suffers from complex spatially structured image degradation which differ fundamentally from digital image corruption (e.g. AWGN) used in standard training augmentation. This work shows that this type of noise severely degrades the accuracy of Depth Anything 3 (DA3), a state-of-the-art feed forward visual geometry foundation model.
  To address this gap, we present AnalogDepth, a parameter-efficient training pipeline that adapts DA3 to analog FPV imagery using student-teacher knowledge distillation with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) injected into the DINOv2 backbone. Rather than synthesizing noise analytically, we build a noise bank from static FPV recordings under diverse conditions and compare real-noise injection against PSD-matched Gaussian synthesis and AWGN as baselines. Experiments on six real FPV flight sequences across three indoor scenes show that training with our noise bank consistently reduces per-frame depth RMSE and 3D reconstruction Chamfer distance compared to the pretrained DA3 baseline and both Gaussian noise variants. These results demonstrate that replicating the spatial structure of real analog transmission noise is critical for effective adaptation.

AI.tldr: 模拟FPV视频传输噪声会严重降低Depth Anything 3的深度估计精度。本文提出AnalogDepth，通过LoRA注入与师生知识蒸馏，并利用真实噪声库，将DA3适配到模拟FPV图像，从而提升深度估计与3D重建效果。
AI.motivation: 模拟视频传输（VTX）因低延迟、轻量和低成本仍在FPV无人机中广泛使用，但其噪声具有复杂空间结构，与AWGN等标准数字图像退化不同，导致现有训练增强不适用，并使先进视觉几何基础模型DA3精度显著下降。
AI.method: 提出参数高效训练流程AnalogDepth：采用学生-教师知识蒸馏，在DINOv2主干中注入Low-Rank Adaptation（LoRA）；从多条件下静态FPV录制构建噪声库，而非解析合成噪声；并比较真实噪声注入、PSD匹配高斯合成与AWGN基线。
AI.result: 在三个室内场景的六段真实FPV飞行序列上，使用噪声库训练相比预训练DA3基线和两种高斯噪声变体，持续降低逐帧深度RMSE和3D重建Chamfer距离。
AI.conclusion: 复现真实模拟传输噪声的空间结构对于有效适配DA3至模拟FPV图像至关重要。

title: SLICEChat: Progressive In-Encoder Token Pruning for Whole-Slide Pathology Language Models
summary: Whole-slide pathology images (WSIs) contain gigapixel-scale visual content, creating a major scalability challenge for slide-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches process thousands of patch tokens and typically apply compression only after slide encoding, leaving multimodal attention computationally expensive. We introduce SLICEChat, a slide-level MLLM that integrates progressive token pruning within a hybrid Mamba--Transformer slide encoder. Mamba layers enable efficient long-range propagation, while Transformer layers preserve global interactions as the sequence is progressively shortened. Between stages, language-supervised, region-aware pruning removes spatially coherent low-utility regions under a controlled keep-rate schedule, producing compact slide representations before multimodal fusion. On SlideBench VQA, SLICEChat achieves 79.84% accuracy on TCGA and 59.09% on BCNB cohorts, outperforming prior slide-level pathology MLLMs, and achieves the highest overall WSI-Bench metrics. It also provides competitive memory usage and the inference latency among the evaluated models. These results demonstrate accurate and computationally efficient multimodal reasoning over gigapixel WSIs.

AI.tldr: 提出 SLICEChat，一种在混合 Mamba-Transformer 幻灯片编码器中集成渐进式 token 剪枝的幻灯片级多模态大模型，用于高效处理千兆像素级病理全切片图像。
AI.motivation: 全切片病理图像包含千兆像素级视觉内容，现有幻灯片级多模态大模型需处理数千个 patch token，且通常仅在幻灯片编码后压缩，导致多模态注意力计算开销巨大，存在严重可扩展性挑战。
AI.method: SLICEChat 在混合 Mamba-Transformer 编码器中引入渐进式 token 剪枝：Mamba 层实现高效长程传播，Transformer 层在序列逐步缩短时保持全局交互；阶段间采用语言监督、区域感知的剪枝策略，在受控保留率下移除空间连贯的低效用区域，从而在多模态融合前生成紧凑幻灯片表示。
AI.result: 在 SlideBench VQA 上，SLICEChat 在 TCGA 队列达到 79.84% 准确率，在 BCNB 队列达到 59.09%，优于先前幻灯片级病理多模态大模型，并在 WSI-Bench 上取得最高总体指标；同时内存使用和推理延迟在评估模型中具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SLICEChat 能够对千兆像素级全切片图像进行准确且计算高效的多模态推理。

title: TReViS: Temporal Repetition Structure Aware Video Synthesis for Self-supervised Repetitive Action Counting
comment: Accepted for publication in Image and Vision Computing (Elsevier). This is the author-accepted manuscript and not the final published version of record. The DOI and link to the published version will be added when available
summary: Fully supervised repetitive action counting (RAC) has achieved strong performance, but requires dense temporal annotations that are costly and difficult to scale. We propose TReViS, a self-supervised video synthesis framework that enables training RAC models without any repetition labels. TReViS estimates the underlying temporal repetition structure of an unlabeled video via a Temporal Self-Similarity Matrix, infers its cycle statistics, and synthesizes new training sequences that preserve realistic repetition patterns while introducing controlled temporal variability. These synthesized videos are paired with pseudo-labels and used to train existing RAC architectures from scratch. Across multiple datasets and backbones, TReViS consistently outperforms prior self-supervised methods and achieves performance competitive with several supervised baselines, while remaining fully label-free, demonstrating the effectiveness of structure-aware video synthesis for label-free RAC. The source code is available at https://github.com/yfqi/TReViS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TReViS，一种自监督视频合成框架，无需重复动作标签即可训练重复动作计数（RAC）模型。
AI.motivation: 全监督RAC依赖密集时序标注，成本高且难以扩展，因此需要无标签的训练方法。
AI.method: TReViS利用时序自相似矩阵估计无标签视频的重复结构，推断周期统计信息，并合成保留真实重复模式且引入可控时序变化的新训练序列；合成视频配伪标签，用于从头训练现有RAC架构。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和骨干网络上，TReViS持续优于先前自监督方法，并达到与部分监督基线相当的性能，同时完全无需标签。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的视频合成能有效支持无标签重复动作计数，展示了自监督RAC的潜力。

title: LiAuto-MindViT: A Hybrid Vision Backbone with Adaptive Bidirectional Mamba
summary: While Mamba-based models have shown strong potential for long sequence modeling, adapting them to vision is challenging due to the requirement of local neighborhood correlations and multi-directional spatial contexts for visual understanding. In this paper, we present LiAuto-MindViT, a novel hybrid vision backbone that synergizes the strengths of CNNs, Mamba, and Transformers. The core of our design is the Adaptive Bidirectional Mamba (ABM), which eliminates the directional bias of unidirectional SSMs through bidirectional selective scanning with learnable alpha blending, enabling content-adaptive directional fusion without the overhead of exhaustive multi-path routing. To further accelerate inference, we propose a deployment-friendly Reparameterized ConvSE (RepConvSE) module that leverages structural reparameterization to reduce latency and memory access overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiAuto-MindViT achieves state-of-the-art performance on image classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation while enabling efficient inference through reparameterization.

AI.tldr: 提出 LiAuto-MindViT，一种融合 CNN、Mamba 与 Transformer 的混合视觉主干网络，在分类、检测和分割任务上达到 SOTA，并支持高效推理。
AI.motivation: 将 Mamba 用于视觉任务存在挑战，因为视觉理解需要局部邻域相关性和多方向空间上下文，而单向 SSM 存在方向偏差。
AI.method: 设计自适应双向 Mamba（ABM），通过双向选择性扫描和可学习 alpha 融合消除方向偏差，实现内容自适应的方向融合；同时提出可重参数化的 ConvSE（RepConvSE）模块，降低推理延迟和内存访问开销。
AI.result: 在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割任务上取得 SOTA 性能，并通过重参数化实现高效推理。
AI.conclusion: LiAuto-MindViT 能有效融合 CNN、Mamba 和 Transformer 的优势，兼顾视觉任务性能与部署效率。

title: DualWAM: Dual-System World Action Models for Asynchronous Global Planning and Local Refinement
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate robot actions and predict future world states, transferring priors from video pretraining to robot control. However, future visual prediction is computationally expensive, so existing WAMs often rely on long action chunks to amortize inference cost across control steps, at the cost of closed-loop responsiveness. We present \method, a dual-system WAM that preserves broader-horizon world-action generation while enabling high-frequency closed-loop action updates by decoupling global planning and local refinement. \systwo periodically performs high-noise bidirectional denoising over a broader world-action chunk to establish a global plan, while wrist-only \sysone extracts a temporally aligned short window from the intermediate denoising state and completes low-noise refinement using the latest wrist observations, which provide action-aligned cues about local geometry, motion, and contact during interaction. The two systems operate asynchronously along a shared denoising trajectory: each global plan is reused across multiple local updates, while \sysone repeatedly incorporates fresh interaction feedback. Across zero-shot manipulation tasks on Franka and Galbot, \method improves success over the strongest evaluated baseline by 4.5 percentage points on average, while achieving a 16.6$\times$ critical-path speedup. Further studies show that role-matched egocentric and UMI data improve success by 14 percentage points, and that the decoupled design naturally supports edge--cloud deployment with substantially lower communication overhead than the baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出一种双系统世界动作模型（WAM），通过解耦全局规划与局部精修，在保持长时域世界-动作生成的同时实现高频闭环动作更新。
AI.motivation: 现有WAM因未来视觉预测计算昂贵而依赖长动作块来分摊推理成本，牺牲了闭环响应能力。
AI.method: 双系统异步共享去噪轨迹：全局系统周期性对更广时域的世界-动作块进行高噪声双向去噪以生成全局计划；仅用腕部观测的局部系统从中间去噪状态提取时间对齐短窗口，结合最新腕部观测完成低噪声精修。
AI.result: 在Franka和Galbot零样本操作任务中，平均成功率比最强基线提高4.5个百分点，关键路径加速16.6倍；角色匹配的自我中心与UMI数据使成功率提升14个百分点；解耦设计支持边云部署并显著降低通信开销。
AI.conclusion: 解耦的全局规划与局部精修设计能兼顾长时域生成与高频闭环更新，提升操作性能与效率，并利于边云部署。

title: Topographic Training Concentrates Causal Circuits Without Improving Neuron Monosemanticity
comment: Accepted at the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Mechanistic interpretability of vision transformers seeks to decompose model computation into human-readable units, but learned representations entangle many concepts in each neuron. Feature superposition is widely treated as the central obstacle to this decomposition, yet most mitigations (sparse autoencoders, dictionary learning) are post-hoc and leave the underlying network unchanged. We ask whether a spatial-locality training loss (TopoLoss) can act as a lightweight, training-time prior that improves interpretability of standard mech-interp tools. Training ViT on ImageNet-100 across multiple TopoLoss weights $α$, we measure causal sufficiency of topographic clusters via activation patching and feature geometry via sparse autoencoders fit to the same residual stream. At $α=1.0$, topographic clusters are 2.79$\times$ more causally sufficient than random unit sets of the same size, with the effect increasing monotonically in $α$. SAE L0 sparsity decreases by 11% and dead-feature fraction rises 19-fold, yet standard neuron-level monosemanticity scores are unchanged, indicating that topographic pressure acts at circuit level, concentrating causal mass into spatially local structures without disentangling individual neurons. This dissociation suggests current neuron-level monosemanticity metrics are insensitive to a class of real interpretability gains, and positions cheap architectural priors as a viable training-time complement to post-hoc tooling.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在ViT训练时加入空间局部性损失TopoLoss，能否提升标准机制可解释性工具的效果，并发现其作用在回路层面而非单个神经元层面。
AI.motivation: 视觉Transformer的机制可解释性旨在将计算分解为人类可读单元，但神经元常混合多个概念，特征叠加被视为核心障碍；现有稀疏自编码器和字典学习多为事后处理，不改变原网络。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-100上训练ViT，并设置不同TopoLoss权重α；通过激活补丁测量地形簇的因果充分性，并对同一残差流拟合稀疏自编码器以分析特征几何。
AI.result: 当α=1.0时，地形簇的因果充分性比同规模随机单元集高2.79倍，且随α单调增强；SAE的L0稀疏度下降11%，死亡特征比例上升19倍，但标准神经元级单义性分数不变。
AI.conclusion: TopoLoss在回路层面将因果质量集中到空间局部结构，而未解耦单个神经元；这说明当前神经元级单义性指标对这类真实可解释性增益不敏感，廉价架构先验可作为事后工具的训练期补充。

title: Steerable and Reactive Grasping Through Modular Design with a Three-Point Interface
summary: Dexterous grasping requires deciding where to grasp, reaching the target, and maintaining stable contact. We connect these stages through a compact three-point interface that separates global geometric reasoning from local contact control. Given object geometry and optional language commands, our framework samples contact triples from a precomputed grasp-affordance heatmap. A model-based reactive controller tracks the object, avoids collisions, and guides the hand toward the selected contacts. In the final centimeters, a Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy uses proprioceptive feedback to refine and stabilize the grasp despite reaching and perception errors. It observes only finger joint states and its recent actions, with no target points, visual observations, or object geometry, so a single policy is shared across objects and grasp configurations. In simulation, we compare grasp-and-lift success against squeeze and end-to-end baselines, characterize reaching convergence, and demonstrate grasp steering; hardware demonstrations on two training objects and one unseen object illustrate the full pipeline. Our modular framework uses geometry to guide the reach and local feedback to secure the grasp.

AI.tldr: 提出一种模块化灵巧抓取框架，通过三点接触接口将全局几何推理与局部接触控制分离：先从抓取可供性热图中采样接触三元组，再用基于模型的反应式控制器引导机械手接近目标，最后在最后几厘米内用仅依赖本体感觉的强化学习策略稳定抓取。
AI.motivation: 灵巧抓取需要同时解决抓哪里、如何到达以及如何保持稳定接触的问题，并需应对到达误差和感知误差；研究希望将全局几何规划与局部接触控制有效连接，并让局部策略能跨物体和抓取配置复用。
AI.method: 基于物体几何和可选语言指令，从预计算的抓取可供性热图中采样接触三元组；使用基于模型的反应式控制器跟踪物体、避碰并引导手部接近所选接触点；在最后阶段使用强化学习策略，仅观察手指关节状态和近期动作，不使用目标点、视觉观测或物体几何信息，以细化并稳定抓取。
AI.result: 在仿真中，将抓取并提起成功率与挤压基线和端到端基线进行比较，分析到达收敛性，并展示抓取引导；在硬件上对两个训练物体和一个未见物体进行了完整流程演示。
AI.conclusion: 该模块化框架能够利用几何信息引导到达，并利用局部反馈确保抓取稳定，说明分离全局几何推理与局部接触控制是有效的灵巧抓取方案。

title: AlignMorph: Tuning-Free Diffusion Image Morphing via Explicit Semantic Transport
summary: Image morphing aims to produce a smooth and semantically consistent transition between two input images. Existing diffusion-based morphing methods either require expensive per-pair optimization or rely on implicit spatial alignment, which easily fails under large layout discrepancies. To address these limitations, we propose AlignMorph, a novel tuning-free diffusion framework guided by the principle of transport-then-denoise. We explicitly decouple geometric alignment from generative denoising to avoid structural entanglement. Our framework consists of two core components. (1) Global Semantic Transport, which achieves diffusion-compatible semantic alignment via entropic optimal transport and reliability-aware latent warping; and (2) Coordinate-Aligned Generation, which uses a symmetric bi-phase attention handoff to maintain consistent spatial coordinates throughout denoising. Without any tuning, AlignMorph effectively eliminates ghosting and achieves superior structural coherence and temporal smoothness on morphing benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/51xOne/Alignmorph.

AI.tldr: AlignMorph是一种无需调优的扩散框架，通过“先传输后去噪”原则实现图像变形，解耦几何对齐与生成去噪。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的图像变形方法要么需要昂贵的逐对优化，要么依赖隐式空间对齐，在大布局差异下容易失败。
AI.method: 提出AlignMorph框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 全局语义传输，通过熵最优传输和可靠性感知的潜在扭曲实现扩散兼容的语义对齐；(2) 坐标对齐生成，使用对称双阶段注意力交接在去噪过程中保持空间坐标一致。
AI.result: 无需任何调优，AlignMorph有效消除了鬼影，在变形基准上实现了更优的结构连贯性和时间平滑性。
AI.conclusion: AlignMorph通过解耦几何对齐与生成去噪，克服了现有方法的局限性，实现了高质量的无调优图像变形。

title: Learning Beyond What Humans Can Demonstrate
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project website: http://guardrail-policy.github.io/
summary: Behavior cloning for robot manipulation relies on expert demonstrations. However, for tasks that require dynamic stability, precise contact timing, or dexterous coordination, human operators may find it hard or even impossible to collect data. We study this infeasible-demonstration regime and propose GLIDE: Guardrails for Learning from Infeasible Demonstrations Efficiently, a framework that infers task-specific failure modes and converts them into executable guardrails for data collection and policy deployment. Given a task description and the conditioning teleoperation code, GLIDE writes guardrails that use system states to filter teleoperation and policy commands, constrain failure-prone actions, and iteratively improve from trajectory feedback. Across three tasks, GLIDE discovers emergent guardrails that go beyond domain-expert hardcoded ones, improving data collection over naive VR teleoperation and domain-expert hardcoded guardrails. After refinement, GLIDE raises data-collection success from 0-10 percent to 70-90 percent across the three tasks. During policy execution, mixed-data guarded policies reach 70 percent, 60 percent, and 60 percent success on Tomato plate transfer, Marker handover and stand, and Wine serving tasks. These results show that GLIDE can support policy learning when direct demonstrations are infeasible. Project website: http://guardrail-policy.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文研究无法直接收集专家演示的机器人操作任务，提出GLIDE框架，通过自动推断任务失败模式并生成可执行护栏，来辅助数据收集与策略部署。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆依赖专家演示，但涉及动态稳定性、精确接触时序或灵巧协调的任务中，人类操作者难以甚至无法收集有效演示数据。
AI.method: GLIDE（Guardrails for Learning from Infeasible Demonstrations Efficiently）根据任务描述和条件遥操作代码，推断任务特定失败模式，并生成可执行护栏；护栏利用系统状态过滤遥操作与策略命令、约束易失败动作，并基于轨迹反馈迭代改进。
AI.result: 在三个任务中，GLIDE发现了超越领域专家硬编码护栏的涌现护栏，优于朴素VR遥操作和专家硬编码护栏；数据收集成功率从0-10%提升到70-90%。策略执行阶段，混合数据加护栏策略在番茄盘转移、马克笔交接与放置、倒酒任务上分别达到70%、60%、60%成功率。
AI.conclusion: GLIDE能够支持在直接演示不可行情况下的策略学习，表明自动生成护栏可有效缓解不可行演示问题。

title: MIGU: Multimodal Instruction Grounding under Uncertainty for Manipulation Planning
summary: Understanding natural human instructions is crucial for deploying robots in human-centric environments. We study multimodal instruction grounding, where language and gesture provide complementary but uncertain cues. We present MIGU, a modular framework that combines semantic and geometric evidence into a unified grounding belief and connects it to manipulation planning. MIGU constructs a 3D geometric likelihood by propagating viewing-direction and depth uncertainty through eye-finger geometry while accounting for hand-direction estimation error. A vision-language model (VLM) provides semantic priors over candidate objects and regions, which are combined with the geometric likelihood through Bayes-inspired fusion. The resulting belief supports behavior planning to either proceed directly to downstream planning or request clarification. Grounded targets then define goals for mobile manipulation and tabletop task-and-motion planning. On a real-world benchmark, MIGU outperforms all evaluated baselines, while ablations support the benefit of explicit multimodal uncertainty modeling. Project website: multimodal-instruction.github.io

AI.tldr: 论文提出MIGU模块化框架，用于融合语言与手势的多模态指令 grounding，将语义与几何证据统一为 grounding 信念并连接操作规划。
AI.motivation: 在人类中心环境中部署机器人需要理解自然人类指令，而语言和手势提供的线索互补但存在不确定性，因此需要显式建模多模态不确定性。
AI.method: MIGU通过眼-指几何传播视线方向与深度不确定性，并结合手方向估计误差构建3D几何似然；利用视觉语言模型提供候选物体与区域的语义先验，再通过贝叶斯启发式融合。所得信念支持行为规划，可直接进入下游规划或请求澄清；确定的目标用于移动操作和桌面任务与运动规划。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准上，MIGU优于所有评估基线；消融实验支持显式多模态不确定性建模带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: MIGU能有效融合语言与手势进行不确定条件下的指令 grounding，并支持机器人操作规划与必要时澄清，验证了多模态不确定性建模的重要性。

title: Learning to Drive on Mars: Visual Multimodal Traversability Estimation for Off-World Navigation
summary: Autonomous navigation on Mars requires vehicles to distinguish between traversable terrains across diverse and visually challenging environments. However, progress in learning-based navigation for off-world environments has been limited by the lack of large-scale datasets. Since landing in Jezero Crater, the Mars 2020 Perseverance rover has traversed terrain ranging from sandy dunes, rocky patches, and flat bedrocks. As a result, this paper presents a dataset spanning 500 sols and 45km of trajectories driven by both human operators and the onboard planner, ENav. Our dataset contains grayscale stereo image pairs, poses, accelerometer readings, rocker-bogie angles, and estimates of tilt and wheel slip. Building on this dataset, we introduce an uncertainty-aware traversability-estimation framework that learns terrain representations from multimodal driving experience. We compare our proposed method against existing approaches on the Mars 2020 dataset and show that our method achieves an AUROC of 0.874 and an F1 score of 0.758, outperforming the strongest baseline by 0.058 and 0.156, respectively, while also achieving the highest average precision and recall. Finally, we show that the visual representations can be integrated into path planners, such as ENav, on a physical rover test bed. Videos, code, and the M2020 dataset will be available at https://darren-chiu.github.io/learning-to-drive-on-mars.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于火星2020毅力号漫游车的大规模数据集（500个火星日、45公里轨迹），并引入不确定性感知的可通行性估计框架，用于火星自主导航。
AI.motivation: 火星自主导航需区分可通行地形，但缺乏大规模数据集限制了基于学习的导航方法在非地球环境中的进展。
AI.method: 构建包含灰度立体图像对、位姿、加速度计读数、摇臂-转向架角度、倾斜和车轮滑移估计的多模态数据集；提出不确定性感知的可通行性估计框架，从多模态驾驶经验中学习地形表示。
AI.result: 在火星2020数据集上，该方法AUROC达0.874，F1为0.758，分别超过最强基线0.058和0.156，并取得最高平均精度和召回率；视觉表示可集成到ENav等路径规划器中，并在物理漫游车测试台上验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为火星自主导航提供了大规模数据集和有效的不确定性感知可通行性估计方法，并展示了其与路径规划器集成的可行性。

title: A Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network for Real-Time Recognition of Hand-Drawn Geometric Shapes
summary: Recognizing hand-drawn geometric shapes is a foundational sub-problem of sketch recognition, with applications in education, human-computer interaction, and diagram digitization. This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of a desktop application that recognizes four basic hand-drawn geometric shapes, circle, square, rectangle, and triangle using a compact Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). A dataset of 2,000 labeled 28x28-pixel shape images was collected independently and released publicly. The classifier consists of three convolutional blocks (16, 32, and 64 filters) with max-pooling, an in-model data-augmentation stage (random horizontal flip, rotation, and zoom), a dropout-regularized dense layer of 128 units, and a 4-way linear output layer, totaling 97{,}956 trainable parameters. The network is trained with the Adam optimizer on a sparse categorical cross-entropy objective computed directly on logits. On an 80/20 train-validation split, the model achieves 94.80% training accuracy and 96.01% validation accuracy with a validation loss of 0.1437. A Tkinter-based graphical interface allows a user to draw a shape with the mouse and receive an immediate class prediction with a confidence score. We situate this system within the broader sketch and shape-recognition literature, compare its accuracy against related hand-drawn shape classification studies, and discuss the limitations inherent to a small, single-contributor dataset. The complete source code, trained model, and per-class datasets are released publicly to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并评估了一个桌面应用，使用紧凑 CNN 识别圆、正方形、矩形和三角形四种手绘几何图形，公开了数据集、代码和模型，验证准确率达到 96.01%。
AI.motivation: 手绘几何图形识别是草图识别的基础子问题，可应用于教育、人机交互和图表数字化；作者希望构建一个轻量、可复现且可交互的系统，并评估其在该任务上的效果与局限。
AI.method: 自建并公开 2000 张 28x28 标注图像数据集；采用三卷积块（16、32、64 个滤波器）加最大池化、内置数据增强（随机水平翻转、旋转、缩放）、dropout 正则化的 128 单元全连接层和 4 类线性输出层，共 97,956 个可训练参数；使用 Adam 优化器，基于 logits 计算稀疏分类交叉熵；Tkinter 图形界面支持鼠标绘制并即时输出类别预测和置信度。
AI.result: 在 80/20 训练-验证划分下，模型取得 94.80% 训练准确率、96.01% 验证准确率和 0.1437 验证损失；论文还将准确率与相关手绘形状分类研究进行比较，并讨论了小规模、单一贡献者数据集的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该紧凑 CNN 能有效识别四种手绘几何图形，并可集成到桌面应用中；通过公开完整源码、训练模型和按类数据集支持可复现性，但受限于数据集规模和来源单一。

title: Toward a foundation model for forest point clouds
summary: Forest inventories increasingly rely on artificial intelligence (AI) models to derive forest attributes from large-scale 3D point clouds. Current models are typically specialized to a single task, sensor, and forest type, making adaptation expensive in terms of annotations, computation, and expertise. We ask whether a single pretrained model can instead learn transferable representations across diverse forest inventory settings. Inspired by recent developments in language modelling and computer vision, we take a step toward a foundation model (FM) for 3D forestry. Using LitePT as backbone, we first establish a strong supervised baseline that sets a new state of the art on forest semantic and instance segmentation, tree species classification, and age regression benchmarks. We then curate a large-scale unlabelled corpus spanning airborne, UAV, and mobile laser scanning across diverse forest ecosystems, and pretrain the same backbone using self-supervised learning. We systematically evaluate representation learning strategies by comparing training from scratch, supervised pretraining, and self-supervised pretraining across four representative forestry tasks, under varying annotation budgets. Compared with training from scratch, self-supervised pretraining accelerates model convergence and consistently improves performance when annotations are scarce. Compared with task-specific supervised pretraining, self-supervised pretraining yields more transferable representations across downstream forestry tasks. These findings identify the practical regime in which pretrained representations are most valuable and suggest that instance discrimination, rather than forest semantics, is the main remaining obstacle to a general-purpose 3D forest foundation model. Code and models are available at: https://github.com/prs-eth/ForPT.

AI.tldr: 本文探索面向3D林业的基础模型（FM），以LitePT为骨干，构建大规模多平台激光点云无标注语料并进行自监督预训练，系统比较从零训练、监督预训练与自监督预训练在四类林业任务及不同标注预算下的表现。
AI.motivation: 当前森林调查中的AI模型通常针对单一任务、传感器和森林类型专门设计，适配新场景时在标注、算力和专业知识上成本高昂。作者希望验证能否用单一预训练模型学习跨多种森林调查场景的可迁移表征。
AI.method: 以LitePT为骨干，首先建立强监督基线；随后构建覆盖机载、无人机和移动激光扫描、跨多种森林生态系统的大规模无标注语料，采用自监督学习进行预训练；在四类代表性林业任务和不同标注预算下，系统对比从零训练、监督预训练与自监督预训练等表征学习策略。
AI.result: 监督基线在森林语义与实例分割、树种分类和树龄回归基准上取得新的最优结果；相比从零训练，自监督预训练可加速收敛，并在标注稀缺时持续提升性能；相比任务特定的监督预训练，自监督预训练能获得更强的跨下游林业任务迁移表征。
AI.conclusion: 研究明确了预训练表征最具价值的实际应用区间，并指出实例判别而非森林语义，是构建通用3D森林基础模型的主要剩余障碍。代码与模型已开源。

title: Relationally Grounded Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted at the NeuRo-SymBolic World Models (RoBoWoMo) Workshop at IROS 2026
summary: Latent world models learn predictive representations for autonomous driving, but the relational semantics these states preserve often remain implicit. We investigate whether traffic scene graphs can serve as privileged semantic supervision for latent world representations. Building on LAW, we construct actor-centric scene graphs from nuScenes 3D annotations, encode their serialized relational structure using a frozen text embedding model, and align the visual latent representations with this semantic target during training. We remove the supervision branch at inference, so it requires neither scene graphs nor 3D annotations and adds no test-time computation. On nuScenes, our method reduces average trajectory L2 error from 0.661 to 0.622 (5.9%) and collision rate from 0.456 to 0.217 (52.4%) relative to our retrained LAW baseline. It also outperforms an unstructured caption-style semantic target, supporting the benefit of explicit relational structure for latent world-model representation learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究用交通场景图作为潜在世界模型的语义监督信号，在训练时对齐视觉潜在表示与场景图语义，推理时移除监督分支，在nuScenes上提升了轨迹预测精度并大幅降低碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型学习预测性表示，但其状态所保留的关系语义通常是隐式的；作者希望验证交通场景图能否作为特权语义监督来改进潜在世界表示。
AI.method: 基于LAW，从nuScenes 3D标注构建以行为者为中心的场景图，用冻结文本嵌入模型编码其序列化关系结构，并在训练时将视觉潜在表示与该语义目标对齐；推理时移除监督分支，因此无需场景图或3D标注，也不增加测试时计算。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上，相比重训的LAW基线，平均轨迹L2误差从0.661降至0.622（降低5.9%），碰撞率从0.456降至0.217（降低52.4%）；同时优于非结构化的caption式语义目标。
AI.conclusion: 显式关系结构（场景图）对潜在世界模型的表示学习有益，可作为有效的特权语义监督，且不增加推理开销。

title: Spatial Action Review: A Visual Analytics Dashboard for Auditing Language-to-Action Hand-offs in Electron Microscopy
comment: Accepted at the IEEE VIS 2026 Workshop on Visual Analytics in the Age of Autonomous Science (VAxAutoSci)
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly explored as interfaces for scientific image analysis, where a visual question-answering (VQA) response may be paired with a spatial output that guides a downstream stage. A supervisor reads the language answer, while a downstream workflow such as segmentation or region review consumes the point-set output. We call this transition from inspecting the answer to relying on its point action the language-to-action hand-off. A silent failure occurs when the answer is correct while the paired action misses annotated objects needed downstream, so answer-based oversight clears a region whose action is unreliable. We introduce Spatial Action Review, a visual analytics dashboard for auditing this failure mode in electron microscopy (EM) mitochondria analysis. It links paired answer-action records through an answer-action ledger, a task-by-dataset risk map, and an image-region audit view, connecting aggregate patterns to image evidence while an adjustable action-reliability gate supports re-audit. The review ends in a human-AI hand-off, where a supervisor records whether the action is accepted, escalated, held under a stricter gate, or flagged for model revision. Across 541 image regions from an EM-adapted Qwen3-VL case-study run, point actions fail the gate in 54.4% of records with a correct VQA response, and 27.4% of all records are silent failures. A correct answer is associated with only a 5.8-percentage-point higher probability of a reliable action, with a bootstrap interval spanning zero; the point-biserial correlation between answer correctness and object coverage is 0.061. This weak coupling persists across five model conditions on 753 matched image regions. Spatial Action Review makes answer-action mismatches visible and ties them to image evidence and a recorded decision before MLLM outputs enter autonomous scientific workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spatial Action Review可视化分析仪表板，用于审计多模态大语言模型在科学图像分析中“语言到动作交接”的静默失败模式，即VQA答案正确但配对点集动作遗漏下游所需对象。
AI.motivation: MLLM作为科学图像分析接口时，监督者关注语言答案，但下游工作流依赖点集动作输出。答案正确而动作不可靠会导致基于答案的监督清除不可靠区域，形成静默失败，现有方法缺乏对此类失败的审计工具。
AI.method: 开发Spatial Action Review仪表板，包含答案-动作账本、任务-数据集风险图和图像区域审计视图，连接聚合模式与图像证据，并可通过可调动作可靠性门控重新审计。最终形成人机交接，监督者记录接受、升级、严格门控保留或标记模型修订。
AI.result: 在EM适应Qwen3-VL案例的541个图像区域中，54.4%的正确VQA响应记录点动作未通过门控，27.4%为静默失败。正确答仅与动作可靠概率高5.8个百分点相关，bootstrap区间跨零；答案正确性与对象覆盖的点二列相关系数为0.061。弱耦合在753个匹配图像区域的五种模型条件下持续存在。
AI.conclusion: Spatial Action Review能揭示答案-动作不匹配，并将其与图像证据和记录决策关联，从而在MLLM输出进入自主科学工作流前进行审计。

title: DeCo: Efficient Decouple-to-Couple Learning for Multi-Task Visual Grounding
summary: Multi-task visual grounding requires models to jointly understand linguistic semantics and perform accurate visual localization and segmentation. Despite the success of multimodal large language models, effectively adapting them to multiple grounding objectives remains challenging. Existing methods commonly enforce task cooperation through shared representations, while overlooking the intrinsic conflict between task-oriented feature interests. In this paper, we introduce $\textbf{DeCo}$, an efficient $\textbf{De}$couple-to-$\textbf{Co}$uple learning framework that resolves this dilemma through a two-stage paradigm: task-specific representation decoupling followed by complementary prior coupling. Specifically, we first propose Task-aware Semantic Decoupling (TSD) to route shared visual cues into individual features under salient word-level guidance, alleviating representation interference between localization and segmentation. Furthermore, we observe that segmentation naturally provides informative localization priors due to dense supervision. Based on this insight, we introduce Hybrid Prior Coupling (HPC), which integrates sentence-level semantic prior with mask-derived spatial prior for enhanced grounding. Built upon a frozen multimodal encoder, DeCo requires lightweight trainable parameters while achieving strong generalization across multiple grounding objectives. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD, and RefDIOR demonstrate that DeCo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both natural and remote sensing benchmarks. The code and models are available at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/DeCo.

AI.tldr: 提出DeCo，一个“解耦到耦合”的两阶段学习框架，用于多任务视觉定位，在自然图像和遥感基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多任务视觉定位需同时理解语言并进行视觉定位与分割，但现有多模态大模型难以有效适配多个定位目标；现有方法多依赖共享表示促进任务合作，忽视了定位与分割之间任务特征兴趣的内在冲突。
AI.method: DeCo采用两阶段范式：先任务特定表示解耦，再互补先验耦合。具体包括任务感知语义解耦（TSD），在显著词级引导下将共享视觉线索路由到各自特征，减少任务干扰；以及混合先验耦合（HPC），融合句子级语义先验与分割掩码导出的空间先验。方法基于冻结的多模态编码器，仅需轻量可训练参数。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD, RefDIOR等数据集上实验，DeCo在自然和遥感基准上均达到最先进性能，并具有强泛化能力。
